Section 01 Organizational Structure of Ship Management 
 
1 
船舶管理组织 
Ship Management Organization 
1.1 
船舶管理组织机构由船长领导下的甲板部和轮机部组成。 
The ship management organizational structure is composed of the Deck Department and the Engine 
Department under the leadership of the Master. 
1.2 
船长是船舶实施管理的领导，甲板部和轮机部是进行生产管理活动的工作部门。
The Master is the leader for implementing ship management on board, while the Deck Department 
and the Engine Department are the working departments for carrying out production and 
management activities. 
1.3 
船长及各部门以行政方式执行船舶管理体系所赋予的管理职能。 
The Master and all departments shall exercise respectively their managerial roles and functions 
authorized by the Ship Management System in an administrative manner.

3 
组织机构的职能 
Functions of the Organization 
3.1 
船长：领导全船全面贯彻和执行公司的安全和环境保护的方针、目标，监督和实
施船舶的各项管理工作。 
Master: The Master is responsible for leading the overall implementation of the ship’s safety and 
environmental protection policies and objectives, as well as supervising and implementing 
management activities on board. 
3.2 
甲板部：甲板部船员包括所有驾驶员、水手长、木匠及全部水手、实习生、大厨
及服务员。在大副领导下，执行船长指令，负责落实和实施船舶安全管理体系中
赋予甲板部的生产管理工作。 
Deck Department: the staff of the Deck Department includes every deck officers, bosun, carpenter 
as well as all sailors, cadets, chief cook and stewards. This department is responsible for 
implementing and carrying out, under the leadership of the Chief Officer and following the Master’s 
direction, the production and management activities delegated to the Deck Department by the ship’s 
Safety Management System. 
3.3 
轮机部：轮机部船员包括所有轮机员、电机员、机工长、机工及实习生。在轮机
长的领导下，执行船长指令，负责落实和实施船舶安全管理体系中赋予轮机部的
生产管理工作。 
Engine Department: the staff of the Engine Department includes all engineers, electrician engineers, 
chief motormen, motormen and cadets. This department is responsible for implementing and 
carrying out, under the leadership of the Chief Engineer and following the Master’s direction, the 
production and management activities delegated to the Engine Department by the ship’s Safety 
Management System. 
3.4 
安委会：由船长、轮机长、安全员，和安全代表组成船舶安全和健康委员会（简
称安委会）。安委会的主要任务是执行公司管理方针，防止船上职业安全事故、受
伤和疾病、骚扰或欺凌发生，确保船员得到职业健康保护。安委会每月至少召开
一次会议，对船舶的安全和人员健康情况进行总结并布置下阶段的安全任务。安
委会还具有安全监督职能，以促进在安全健康上的管理响应，确保安全措施
的落实，并就安全建议给予积极的反馈。 
Safety & Healthy Committee: The Committee of Safety and Health (S&H Committee) consists of 
the Master, the Chief Engineer, the Safety Officers, and the Safety Representatives. The main target 
of S&H Committee is to implement the management policy of company, to prevent occupational 
accidents, injuries and illness, harassment or bullying on board ships, and to ensure that crew 
members receive occupational health protection. The S&H Committee shall summon a meeting at 
least monthly to summarize the safety of the ship and health status of the staff on board as well as to 
arrange tasks of next phase. The Committee of Safety and Health also has the functions of safety 
supervision, to promote management response in safety and health, ensure the implementation of 
safety measures, and take positive feedback on safety recommendations. 
3.4.1 
船长担任安委会主任。船长应做好安委会会议纪要、船上职业健康安全、消除船
上骚扰与欺凌等各种活动记录。根据“消除船上骚扰与欺凌指导”和国际海事
组织通函MSC-MEPC.2/Circ.3 船上职业健康及安全程序基本要素导则做好全
船培训。 
The ship Master is the director of the S&H Committee. The ship master shall do good records of 
safety committee meetings, keep records of on-board occupational health and safety, and eliminating 
harassment and bullying on board. To do good training for all crew as guidance on eliminating

3.4.2 
安全员Safety Officer： 
1) 公司统一委任每艘船舶的大管轮和大副为船舶的安全员（Safety Officer）。安
全员是代表公司在船上的安全顾问。 
Safety Officer: The Company will appoint the C/O and the 2/E of each ship as safety officers of the 
ship. Safety officers are shipboard safety consultants representing the Company. 
2) 安全员须以体系文件和强制性法规及劳动保护法规为依据，从安全大局出发，
在安全工作中给部门提供支持和建议，督促船员学习并履行安全和健康相关法
规，监督分配给船员的安全职责和任务，检查所分管的安全设施和所属人员的
人身安全行为及操作。对船员在船安全技能操作进行培训。 
Safety officers must, based on the system documents and mandatory laws and regulations as well as 
labor protection laws and regulations, and from the point of overall safety view, provide supports and 
suggestions to each department during safety works, urge and supervise the crew to learn and fulfill 
safety and health related laws and regulations, and supervision of safety duties & tasks assigned to 
crew on board , and check the safety facilities in their charge as well as the personal safety behaviors 
and operations of relevant staff. In addition, the safety officers shall be responsible for the training of 
the crew’s onboard safety skills and operations. 
3) 公司应确保为安全员得到适当的培训以行使其精通于与安全有关的ISM规则的
重要要求并行使其职责。 
Company shall ensure that the Safety Officer is provided with appropriate training to discharge his 
duties and is versed with the important aspects of ISM code related to safety. 
4) 船舶安全员应每月按照“安全员检查清单SHIP-01-01-01”的项目进行安全检
查以识别船舶存在的危害及对健康、安全和环境的潜在风险，并向船长报告发
现的问题，每月在安全会议上通报检查情况。 
The ship safety officer shall conduct safety inspections monthly in accordance with the items listed 
in the " Checklist for Safety Officer’s inspection  SHIP-01-01-01" to identify hazards existing on 
the ship and potential risks to health, safety, and the environment. They shall report the discovered 
issues to the captain and brief on the inspection situation at the monthly safety meeting. 
3.4.3 
安全代表：安全代表由各部门选举产生，当船员发生重大变动后，船舶各部门应
选举一位安全代表；安全代表应该是有向船长陈述和建议的能力，并自年满18 岁
起连续海上服务时间不得少于2 年；安全代表的选举和认命，应该记录在安委会
的会议记录中。安全代表应立足于现实；了解法规要求；并考虑合理可行性，以
坚定、合理和有益的方式，就健康和安全事宜向安委会反馈，提出意见和建议。
安全代表有权利就潜在危险和危险事件，通过安委会，向船长反馈，并就风险评
估结果、健康和安全培训等一般健康和安全事项向船长提出建议，以及引进新的
技术。 
Safety Representatives: The safety representatives are elected by the deck and engine 
department When there is a substantial change in those working on board, each ship department 
shall elect a safety representative; the safety representative shall be competent to make 
representations and recommendations on health and safety to the master. The regulations specify 
that no safety representative may have fewer than two years’ consecutive sea service since 
attaining the age of 18. The election or appointment of every safety representative should be 
written in the minutes of safety committee meetings. Safety representatives should be sure of 
the facts, be aware of the legal position, be conscious of what is reasonably practicable, to put 
forward their views and recommendations to safety committee in a firm but reasonable and

potential hazards and dangerous occurrences, and to the master on general health and safety 
matters, such as the findings of the risk assessment, health and safety training, and the 
introduction of new technology. 
3.4.4 
安委会成员被称作安全人员。作为安全人员：安全员、安全代表和安全委员会的
其他成员，都被分配给了不同的安全角色，在确保船上人员安全方面,特定人员被
赋予了具体职责。船上的每一个人都负有安全责任。 
Safety committee members are called safety officials, as safety officials, the safety officers/safety 
representatives and other members of the safety committee are designated safety role on board, 
specific responsibilities are also given to those with designated roles in ensuring the safety of 
those on the ship. Every person on board has a responsibility for safety.  
3.5 
伙委会：伙委会由大厨、电机员、水手长、机工长、三副、三管轮组成“船舶伙
食管理委员会”（简称伙委会），负责会同大厨根据船长指令进行伙食询价、洽谈、
供应商的确认、订购、验收、结算船舶伙食的工作，对船舶伙食的订购、验收、
结算进行全过程监督。三副和三管轮每2 个月轮流管理伙食账目,负责对伙食票据
进行审核。电机员任伙委会主任，负责伙委会活动的组织、记录，向船长报告有
关情况，保存由船长签字后的“伙委会活动记录”备查，对伙食的管理进行全程
跟踪监督，有责任向船长报告船舶伙食管理中出现的问题。 
Victual Committee: The Shipboard Victual Committee (“Food Management Committee”) consists 
of the Chief Cook, the Electrician Engineer, the Bosun, the Fitter, the Third Officer, and the Fourth 
Engineer, and is responsible for the inquiry, negotiation, ordering, acceptance and settlement of food 
together with the Chief Cook in accordance with instructions from the Master. The Third Officer and 
four Engineer take turns to manage the food accounts every 2 months, including the review of food 
related receipts and invoices. The Electrician Engineer is appointed as the director of the Victual 
Committee, responsible for organizing and documenting Victual Committee activities, reporting 
relevant situations to the Master, safekeeping the Victual Committee Activity Record signed by the 
Master for record, following up and supervising the entire process of food management, as well as 
reporting to the Master any issue occurred during the process of food management.

第02 节船舶消防安全制度 
Section 02Shipboard Fire-fighting Safety Regulations 
 
1. 
船舶消防规则 
Shipboard Fire-fighting Rules 
1.1 
船长是船舶消防的总指挥，当船长不能履行其职责时由大副替代。 
The Master is the commander of shipboard fire-fighting activities, and shall be substituted by the 
Chief Officer when the Master is not in the position to fulfill his responsibilities. 
1.2 
船舶消防部署由三副在船舶应变部署表中统筹安排部署,船舶应变部署表应在船员
变化时，开航前编妥，经船长签字批准后张贴在驾驶台、集控室、餐厅、生活区走
廊或其他公共场所。 
Shipboard fire-fighting deployment shall be specified and arranged by the Third Officer in the Muster 
List, which shall be developed before sailing in case of crew changes, and shall be displayed, upon 
approval by the Master, at the bridge, central control room, mess rooms, corridors of the living spaces, 
or other public spaces. 
1.3 
船员应变任务卡应根据船舶应变部署表内的规定写明船员在船舶消防中的职责及
需携带物品，并显示在床头附近。在港交接班期间，新的应变部署表制定前，上船
接班人应承担交班人在应变部署表所司职责。 
The crew’s Emergency Response Task Card shall be completed according to the requirements 
specified in the Shipboard Muster List, stating the responsibilities of the crew during fire-fighting 
activities on board as well as the items to be carried along. This task card shall be displayed in the 
vicinity of bedside. During crew changing in port before a new Muster List been developed, the crew 
members onboard shall assume all the responsibilities of the one who handed over the watch as 
specified in the Muster List. 
1.4 
每月至少一次召开全体船员大会（如果换班人员超过25％，离港后24 小时内），由
三副讲解消防知识、灭火方法、本船消防器材使用及应变部署，任何2 个月的授课
期内应包括该船的全部消防（和救生）设备，并记入航海日志。 
A crew safety meeting shall be held at least once a month (within 24 hours after departure from a port 
if the changing crew members are over 25%), and in this meeting, the Third Officer shall explain 
fire-fighting knowledge, fire extinguishing methods, usage of onboard fire-fighting equipment as well 
as emergency response deployment. During any 2-month training period, fire-fighting (and life-saving) 
equipment onboard shall be all included, and recorded in the Deck Log Book. 
1.5 
船舶消防演习每月至少应进行一次（如有25%以上的船员未参加船上的上个月弃船
和消防演习，应在该船离港后24 小时内举行该两项演习）并在航海日志中详细记
录，在轮机日志中记录演习起始时间及相关内容，与航海日志时间保持一致。 
Fire drills shall be held at least once a month (if over 25% crew members were absent from last

departure from a port), and recorded in detail in the Deck Log Book. The start and end time as well as 
relevant items of the drills recorded in the Engine Log Book shall be consistent with what’s been 
recorded in the Deck Log Book. 
1.6 
船舶机舱、生活区、舵机房、专用舱室、货舱的火警装置应保持良好，有故障时应
尽快修复，未恢复前应安排甲板/机舱值班人员加强值班巡视检查。 
Fire alarm devices in the engine room, accommodation spaces, steering gear room, dedicated 
warehouse and cargo holds (if installed), shall be kept in a good condition, and shall be repaired as 
soon as possible in case of breakdown. Deck/engine room watch keeping officers shall be arranged to 
strengthen the patrol inspections during watch before the breakdown is completely repaired. 
1.7 
各船必须建立全船消防安全检查巡视制度，该防火巡查可结合《船舶保安计划》的
保安巡视一起执行。巡视应考虑到夜间巡查、单人巡视、不良天气等影响，评估风
险并制定巡视路线和巡视要求。巡视制度包括甲板、机舱、生活区公共场所。巡视
路线应分别张贴于驾驶台和集控室。夜间航行，值班水手接班前要巡查生活区内部
公共场所，每班至少按巡视路线巡视检查一次，巡查情况要记入航海日志。 
Every ship must establish the fire safety patrol inspection regulations, The fire safety patrol can be 
combined with security patrol in “Shipboard Security Plan”, The inspection should take into account 
the influence of night inspection, single-person inspection, bad weather, etc., assess the risks, 
formulate patrol routes and inspection requirements, The inspection system includes deck, engine 
room and public places of accommodation. The patrol routes map should be post on the bridge and 
engine control room respectively. During night navigation, the watch-keeping seaman shall patrol the 
public spaces of the accommodation before taking over the watch, and such patrol shall be performed 
following the patrol routes at least once per watch, with the patrol results recorded in the Deck Log 
Book.  
1.8 
船舶在港内及在港外锚地停泊时，未经港口当局批准不得进行热工作业。 
When the ship is berthing in a port or anchoring at an anchorage outside the port, it is not allowed to 
carry out any hot work onboard without approval of the port Administration.  
1.9 
船舶在航行途中，未经船长批准不得进行热工作业。在进行热工作业时，必须按照
《热工作业检查表》逐项检查、落实并填写检查表。 
When the ship is at sea, it is not allowed to carry out hot work without the approval of the Master. 
During hot work, it is required to check and implement item by item in accordance with the Hot Work 
Checklist and fill in the checklist. 
1.10 
船舶装运危险货物时应严格遵守船舶手册《危险货物运输注意事项》，并做好防火
工作。 
When the ship is loaded with dangerous goods, the Carriage of Dangerous Goods Precautions 
provided in the Ship Manual shall be strictly followed, and relevant fire protection precautions shall

各种消防设备和器材的配备、布置和标识必须符合消防控制图的要求，包括国际通
岸接头。三副负责消防设备和器材的检查维护，船长、大副核查，使其保持随时可
用的良好状态。 
The arrangement and identification of all sorts of fire-fighting equipment and devices must comply 
with the requirements as specified in the Fire Control Plan, including the international shore 
connections. The Third Officer shall be responsible for inspection and maintenance, while the Master 
and the Chief Officer for review, so that these equipment and devices are kept in a good ready-for-use 
condition.

各种手提式灭火器，应按规定时间进行检查、检验，保持外部清洁，附近无其它阻
挡异物，做到随时取用。 
All portable fire extinguishers shall be inspected and tested at stipulated intervals, and maintained in a 
clean condition with no obstruction in the vicinity, so that they are always ready for use. 
1.13 
消防水管系各阀应保持活络，消防栓周围清爽无障碍，消防隔离阀应予以文字标明。
消防泵和应急消防泵要按规定定期检查、试验。 
The valves of fire mains shall be kept in a free moving condition, the vicinity of fire hydrants shall be 
free of obstruction, and the fire isolation valve be identified with characters. Periodical inspections 
and tests shall be carried out to the fire pump and emergence fire pump according to procedures.  
1.14 
消防泵、应急消防泵、按钮、警铃等消防设施要张贴IMO 要求的标识，消防管路
要按照体系文件要求进行红色环带和流向标识。 
Identifications required by IMO shall be displayed at fire-fighting facilities such as fire pumps, 
emergency fire pumps, buttons, fire alarms etc., and red ring band and flow direction identification 
shall be marked on fire mains according to requirements specified in the system documents. 
1.15 
固定灭火系统的门口或消防控制站门外应配置应急钥匙。进入前先通风，并有警示
标志。 
Emergency keys shall be equipped at the doorway of fixed extinguishing systems or fire control 
stations. Prior to entering such places, it is required to ventilate first, and marked warning signs.  
1.16 
大型灭火系统操作位置附近应有该系统管系分布路径和阀门的控制及操作示意图，
还应有大副拟订经船长批准的操作规程和各舱室灭火所需瓶数的说明。各气瓶应编
号，管系阀门和其他各种属具应有醒目标志，这些编号和标志必须和示意说明图相
一致，所有高级船员均应会操作大型灭火系统。 
In the vicinity of fixed fire extinguishing systems, there shall be pipeline layouts and diagrams for 
valve control and operation, as well as procedures developed by the Chief Officer and approved by 
the Master and instructions on the quantity of extinguishers needed in each space. Each extinguisher 
shall be numbered, and the pipeline valves as well as all other accessories shall be clearly identified; 
such numbering and identification must be consistent with that in the diagrams. All officers onboard

组织对船员消防知识和灭火技能的培训。

每月至少组织一次消防演习并在演习结束后进行评议和总结。

督促各防火责任人做好各自管辖的消防设备的维修和保养。

检查督促有关责任人按“船舶防火定期检查表”内容认真进行检查，对需岸基支持
的缺陷及时报告公司主管部门。“船舶防火定期检查表”存放于船长文件夹备查。

发现火灾隐患时要及时召开船舶安全会议进行检查研究，清除隐患。

根据生产运输特点，及时召集甲板部研究制订切实的防火措施，责成三副、水手长、

装载易燃易爆危险品时，严格按“危险货物运输注意事项”要求操作。

holds.  
2.2.4 
制定并张贴防火巡视路线图, 检查督促防火巡视制度的贯彻执行。

implementation of fire protection patrol inspection procedure.  
2.2.5 
检查督促甲板部物料间、油漆间内物品正确堆放，固定良好。

stored and well secured. 
2.2.6 
经常检查甲板消防管路处于正常状况，无锈蚀、漏泄和破损。 
To regularly check that the fire pipe lines on deck are in a good condition, no corrosion, leakage or 
breakage.

负责甲板部的明火作业安排并将计划呈送船长审批后执行，并且要派专人看火及备

负责对船员进行消防知识传授和技能的训练。

编制应变部署表，经船长批准后张贴并分解至各队员的应变任务卡上。

易燃、易爆、易挥发或易腐蚀的物品（不限于：油漆、汽油、煤油、氧气乙炔、化
学品等），应严格按照MSDS 说明要求进行存放，化学品的存贮应远离油漆和润滑
油，应存贮在通风良好和安全的舱室内。在明显位置显示操作说明和危险警告，备
妥适当的人员保护装置。 
Flammable, explosive, volatile or corrosive items (not limited to: paints, gasoline, 
kerosene, oxygen and acetylene, chemicals, etc.) should be stored in strict accordance 
with MSDS instructions. The chemicals should be stored away from paints and lubricants 
in well-ventilated and safe compartments. Operating instructions and Danger Warnings 
shall be displayed in obvious places, and appropriate personnel protection devices shall 
be prepared. 
3.6 
禁止在船上燃放烟花鞭炮，禁止摆弄救生信号弹。 
It is prohibited to set off fireworks and firecrackers on board, or to play with life-saving signal 
rockets.  
3.7 
尽可能将所有电器固定并采用永久性连接。保持所有电线线路维护良好、清洁干燥。 
Secure all electrical appliances and provide permanent connections whenever possible. 
Keep all electric wiring well maintained, clean and dry. 
3.8 
软质导线应尽可能短，且布置时应避免其在使用过程中受到擦伤或切断。 
Flexible leads should be as short as practicable and arranged to prevent their being 
chafed or cut in service. 
3.9 
请勿使用临时插头、插座或保险丝。Do not use makeshift plugs, sockets or fuses. 
3.10 
切勿超过电线和保险丝的额定负载能力，否则会导致电线过热，破坏绝缘层并可能
引发短路，从而引发火灾。 
Never exceed the rated load capacity of the wires and fuses as this may causes the wires 
to overheat, destroying insulation and resulting in a possible short-circuit, which could 
start a fire.  
3.11 
使用含可充电锂离子电池的设备时需格外谨慎，包括手机、IPAD、笔记本电脑、充
电宝、游戏机等个人设备。此类设备在充电时不得无人看管，因电池过充或损坏可
能引发火灾隐患。 
Take care with devices containing rechargeable lithium-ion batteries, including personal

离开房间随手闭灯，靠近窗口的台灯尤应注意关闭，航行中不得锁门睡觉。 
Turn off lights when leaving rooms, especially the reading lamp close to the window, and it is not 
allowed to lock the door while sleeping during navigation at sea.  
3.13 
房间长时间无人时，房间内的电器设备应进行断电、并拔下电源插头。 
When a room is unoccupied for an extended period of time, electrical equipment in the

3.14 
船舶任何场所禁止使用明火电炉，在船上除厨房、配膳间和餐厅外，其它场所禁止

Use of electric furnace with naked flame is prohibited on any place on board the ship. Electric ovens

3.15 
在船员房间内禁止使用电加热器（船舶建造时安装除外），不准任意接拆电气线路,

及机舱内烘烤衣服、鞋、袜等。 
In seafarers’ rooms, it not allowed to use electric stoves, kettles and heaters (except those installed 
during construction of the ship), connect or disconnect electrical circuits at will, wire for new lights or 
install antenna for radios without permission, use paper or cloth covering electric lights. It not allowed 
to dry clothes, shoes, stocks and etc. on electric heaters in seafarers’ room and/or in engine room.  
3.16 
确保所有固定式电加热器都配备有合适的防护罩，防护罩需牢固地安装在加热器上，
并保持在原位。 
Ensure that all fixed electric heaters are fitted with suitable guards securely attached to 
the heater and that the guards remain in position. 
3.17 
使用烘干柜或类似设备时，请勿因烘干空间装载过满而遮挡通风口。检查通风口周
围的任何滤网或细网罩，并定期清洁，以防其被衣物上积累的绒毛堵塞。 
When using drying cabinets or similar appliances, do not allow the ventilation apertures 
to be covered up by overfilling the drying space. Inspect any screens or fine mesh covers 
around the ventilation apertures and clean them regularly so that they do not become 
blocked by accumulated fluff from clothing. 
3.18 
任何类型的加热器上或加热器上方禁止晾晒衣物，杜绝火灾风险。 
The drying of clothes on or over any type of heater is prohibited to eliminate the risk of 
fire.  
3.19 
为满足船员生活需要，每个房间配置保温瓶，除在驾驶台、集控室、TOP4 房间各
配置一把自动断电式电水壶外，再在各配餐间或餐厅配置一把，供饮水所需。其它

When using electric appliances and stoves in the galley, the cook is not allowed to leave the galley. If

第03 节 船舶防止污染管理规定 
Section 03 Ship’s Pollution Prevention Management Regulations 
 
1. 
目的 
Purpose 
保护海洋环境，防止船舶对海洋及港口的水域和空气环境造成污染，特制定本管理
规定。 
The purpose of this regulation is to protect the marine environment, and prevent pollution from ships 
to the waters of the sea and the ports as well as to the air environment.  
2. 
适用范围 
Application 
本规定适用于公司所有船舶的防污染管理工作。 
These regulations shall be applicable to the pollution prevention works of all ships under the 
management of the Company. 
3. 
船长在防污染方面的职责 
Master’s Roles on Pollution Prevention 
3.1 
船长是船舶防污染工作的第一责任人，全面负责船舶防污染工作，监督船舶各部门做
好防污染工作。 
The Master is the primary responsible person of the ship’s pollution prevention works, and shall be 
responsible for the ship’s overall pollution prevention, and the supervision of all shipboard departments 
to carry out pollution prevention in a well manner. 
3.2 
当发生污染事故时，指挥船员按照船上油污应急计划实施应急行动，并按规定及时向
有关当局和公司报告。 
In the event of an occurrence of pollution accident, the Master shall direct the crew to take emergency 
response measures in accordance with the SOPEP, and report to relevant Administration and the 
Company according to specified regulations. 
3.3 
如实记录事故经过及所采取的措施，协助污染事故调查。 
Record truthfully the process of the entire accident and measures taken, and assist in the investigation of 
the pollution accident. 
3.4 
在船组织实施船上油污应急计划、船舶垃圾管理计划和船舶能效管理计划。 
Organize shipboard implementation of the Shipboard Oil Pollution Emergency Plan, the Shipboard 
Garbage Management Plan and the Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan. 
4. 
船舶防污染文书管理 
Management of Ship’s Pollution Prevention Documents 
4.1 
船舶应具有下列防污染文书： 
The ship shall maintain the following pollution prevention documents:  
4.1.1 
国际防止油污证书(IOPP)  
International Oil Pollution Prevention Certificate (IOPP)  
4.1.2 
国际防止大气污染证书（IAPP） 
International Air Pollution Prevention Certificate（IAPP） 
4.1.3 
国际防止生活污水污染证书 
International Sewage Pollution Prevention Certificate 
4.1.4 
油类记录簿； 
Oil Record Book; 
4.1.5 
垃圾记录簿； 
Garbage Record Book;

4.2 
油类记录簿的管理 
Management of the Oil Record Book 
4.2.1 
适用于船舶机器处所的油类和含油污水的作业记录。 
Applicable to operation records of the oil and oily water at machinery spaces onboard the ship. 
4.2.2 
油类记录簿应由轮机长负责保管。 
The Chief Engineer shall be responsible for the safe keeping of the Oil Record Book. 
4.2.3 
按照油类记录簿的填写要求，每完成一项相关操作应及时和如实地记录在油类记录簿
内，由负责轮机员记录填写并签字，然后由轮机长签字确认。 
The Oil Record Book shall be filled in accordance with its requirements, and each and every relevant 
operation shall be recorded in the Oil Record Book timely and truth fully ,the Engineer in charge shall 
fill in and sign the record, and then the chief engineer shall sign for confirmation. 
4.2.4 
油类记录簿应采用英文如实、正确记录。如果记录错误，应使用单横线划去错误部分，
由记录人在旁边签字确认并标明日期。所修改的错误部分应能够清晰辨明，不得涂黑
或缺页，正确的记录在其后面填写。 
The Oil Record Book shall be truthfully and correctly recorded in English. In case of any error found in 
the record, the error shall be struck out using a single horizontal line, and confirmed by the recorder by 
signing at nearby place and identified with date. All corrected errors shall be legible, without any 
blacking or missing of pages, and correct records shall be filled in after it. 
4.2.5 
每记录完一页，由船长审核并签字。 
Every record page shall be reviewed and signed by the Master once used up. 
4.2.6 
油类记录簿每记完一本，应在船保留至少三年。 
Every used up volume of the Oil Record Book shall be stored onboard the ship for at least three years.  
4.2.7 
需要时，按船旗国要求的油类记录簿，及时向公司船管部申领。 
If necessary, the Oil Record Book required by the flag State shall be requisitioned from the Fleet 
Department of the Company in a timely manner.  
4.2.8 
油类记录簿的记录和保管遵守记录簿前言说明。 
The recording and safekeeping of the Oil Record Book shall follow the instructions given the preamble 
of the record book.

Management of the Garbage Record Book

4.3.2 
由大副负责用英文记录和保管。如果记录错误，应使用单横线划去错误部分，由记录
人在旁边签字确认并标明日期。所修改的错误部分应能够清晰辨明，不得涂黑或 缺
页，正确的记录在其后面填写。 
The Chief Officer shall be responsible for the recording in English and safekeeping. In case of any error

填写垃圾记录簿时，应将日期、作业代号和细目的数码记入相应的表格内，所要求的
细节应按年月日顺序记入空栏。 
When filling in the Garbage Record Book, date, job code and details shall be recorded in corresponding 
table, and all required details shall be recorded in blank columns in the order of year, month and day.   
4.3.4 
每记录完一页由船长审核签字。 
Every record page shall be reviewed and signed by the Master once used up.  
4.3.5 
垃圾记录簿每记录完一本，应在船保留三年。 
Every used up volume of the Garbage Record Book shall be stored onboard the ship for three years. 
4.3.6 
当需要时，按船旗国要求的垃圾记录簿，及时向公司船管部申领。 
If necessary, the Garbage Record Book required by the flag State shall be requisitioned from the Fleet 
Department of the Company in a timely manner. 
4.4 
关于《船上油污应急计划》、《船舶垃圾管理计划》和《压载水管理计划》、《船舶能效
管理计划》和《消耗臭氧物质记录簿》的管理。 
Management of the Shipboard Oil Pollution Emergency Plan, the Shipboard Garbage Management 
Plan, the Ballast Water Management Plan, the Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan, and the Ozone 
Depleting Substances Record Book. 
4.4.1 
船长应按照船舶证书的管理规定，妥善保管《船上油污应急计划》、《船舶垃圾管理计
划》、《压载水管理计划》、《船舶能效管理计划》。         
The Master shall, according to the requirements specified under shipboard certificates management 
regulations, properly safe keep the Shipboard Oil Pollution Emergency Plan, the Shipboard Garbage 
Management Plan, the Ballast Water Management Plan, the Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan.  
4.4.2 
船长应按照文件附录中各单项手册的有关要求，督促相关负责人认真、及时地填写有
关记录，并向公司和有关部门提交相关数据和报告。 
The Master shall urge relevant responsible person to fill in relevant records in a careful and timely 
manner, and submit related data and reports to the company and relevant departments, according to 
related requirements specified under the manual of each single item as annexed to this document.  
4.4.3 
轮机长应按照填写说明及时认真记录《消耗臭氧物质记录簿》并妥善保管。 
The Chief Engineer shall carefully and timely record and safe keep the Ozone Depleting Substances 
Record Book according to the filling in instructions. 
5. 
防污染设备和材料的管理 
Management of Pollution Prevention Equipment and Materials 
5.1 
防污染设备管理 
Management of Pollution Prevention Equipment 
5.1.1 
船舶防污染设备为船舶的重要设备。 
Pollution prevention equipment are important equipment of the ship.  
5.1.2 
船舶防污染设备应根据说明书的要求及具体情况进行定期和有效的维护管理，使之始
终满足MARPOL73/78 公约的相关要求并保持在良好的工况下，确保船的防污染工作
的持续和有效。

Pollution prevention equipment of the ship shall be regularly and effectively maintained according to the 
requirements as specified in the operation and maintenance instructions as well as specific situations, so 
that they can always be compliant with relevant requirements of MARPOL 73/78, and keep a good 
working condition, ensuring continuous and effective pollution prevention of the ship.  
5.1.3 
曲柄箱、齿轮箱、油底壳等更换下来的废油，应收集入污油舱，不得直接排放至舱底。 
Waste oil from crankcases, gearboxes, sump and etc. shall be collected in the waste oil collect tank, and 
direct discharge to the bottom of engine room is not allowed.  
5.1.4 
保持机械设备的油管、阀门、道门等不滴漏油。 
Oil pipes, valves, access doors and etc. of the machinery shall be kept free of oil spill and  leakage.  
5.1.5 
燃油、滑油分油机排渣柜中的油渣，应及时排入污油舱(柜)，不得排入舱底。 
Sludge in the sludge tank of the fuel oil and lubrication oil purifiers shall be discharged into the  waste 
oil collect tank in a timely manner, and it is not allowed to directly discharge into the  bottom of engine 
room.  
5.1.6 
清洗零部件使用过的污油，应集中倒入污油舱（柜），不得倒入舱底。 
Waste oil from component washing shall be collected into the waste oil collect tank, and it is not 
 allowed to directly discharge into the bottom of E.R.  
5.1.7 
燃油、润滑油等集油柜出现高液位时，应及时驳空，以防溢入舱底。 
In case of high level of the collection tank of fuel oil and lubrication oil and etc., such tank shall  
be 
emptied in a timely manner, so as to avoid overflowing into the bottom of engine room.  
5.1.8 
油柜及其它设备的集油盘（槽）通至各集油柜的管路要保持畅通，有缺损部位要及时
修复。 
Pipelines from oil tanks and oil trays or troughs of other equipment leading to the collection tank shall be kept a 
clear and unblocked condition, and timely repair must be performed in case of missing and damaged parts.  
5.1.9 
机舱值班人员应经常检查各海、淡水泵的填料盘根和有关阀门盘根及管系，如发现有
漏泄现象应采取相应措施及时修复。  
Engine room duty crews shall regularly check the packing of each sea-water and fresh water pump as 
well as the packing and pipelines of relevant valves, and in case of leakage found, corresponding 
measures shall be taken to repair in a timely manner.  
5.1.10 严禁将洗涤剂废水倒入舱底，以免造成油水分离器监控装置失灵。 
It is prohibited to discharge the washing water mixed with detergents into the bottom of engine room, so 
as to avoid failure of the oily water separator’s monitoring devices.  
5.1.11 甲板上的机器设备、液压千斤顶、液压管系应定期和及时检修保养，因故漏泄在甲板
的残油要及时清理，防止流入海域。 
Machinery, hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic pipelines on the deck shall be regularly and timely 
serviced and maintained, and oil residues on the deck due to leakage shall be cleaned in a timely 
 manner, so as to avoid flowing into the sea. 
5.2 
防污染材料的管理 
Management of Pollution Prevention Materials 
5.2.1 
船舶防污染材料库由二管轮管理。 
The Third Engineer is responsible for the management of shipboard pollution prevention materials store 
room. 
5.2.2 
防污染材料要保存于专用的处所，该处所便于到达和方便取用，以应对突发溢油事件
时使用。 
Pollution prevention materials shall be stored in dedicated places which are easy to access and 
convenient to use, so as to make it ready for use when responding to an emergency oil spill incident. 
5.2.3 
防污染材料要列出清单，每月进行检查、清点、维护并做好记录，记录应张贴在防污
染材料库，材料清单应保存在SOPEP 手册中。 如果发现短少及时补充。A list of the

pollution prevention materials shall be prepared, so that monthly inspection, stock counting and 
maintenance can be performed according to such list, with proper records maintained. Such records shall 
be displayed in the storeroom of pollution prevention materials, and the list of materials shall be kept in 
the SOPEP Manual. In case of shortage found, replenishment shall be made in a timely manner. 
5.2.4 
除非发生漏油事故，防污染材料库内的物品不得动用。 
Unless in the event of oil spill accident, the items in the storeroom of pollution prevention materials 
should not be used.  
6. 
生活污水防污染管理 
     Management of Sewage Pollution prevention 
6.1 
管理与要求 
Management and Requirements 
6.1.1 
轮机长直接负责生活污水防污染的管理工作，检查、监督、指导相关人员做好防污设
备的使用和维修保养工作，组织轮机员制定防污设备操作规程以及设备维修保养、备
件申请计划等。 
The Chief Engineer is directly responsible for the management of sewage pollution prevention, 
inspecting, supervising and guiding relevant personnel to properly use, service and maintain the 
pollution prevention equipment, as well as organizing the engineers to develop pollution prevention 
equipment operation procedures and equipment service and maintenance, spare part requisition plan and 
etc. 
6.1.2 
三管轮具体负责生活污水处理装置的使用管理和维修保养并做记录。 
The Fourth Engineer is specifically responsible for the management of usage and maintenance of  
the 
sewage treatment plant as well as proper recording.  
6.1.3 
值班机工操作生活污水处理装置时，需经三管轮认可后方能进行操作。 
Prior to the operation of the sewage treatment plant by the watch-keeping motorman, approval  must be 
obtained first from the Fourth Engineer.  
6.1.4 
轮机长要检查、监督、指导三管轮的防污染工作，并确保遵循MARPOL73/78 公约附
则IV 的要求,及时对生活污水系统进行正确转换。 
The Chief Engineer must inspect, supervise and guide Fourth Engineer’s pollution prevention works, 
ensuring the compliance with the requirements as specified under MARPOL 73/78 Annex VI, as well as 
changeover the correct sewage treatment system in a timely manner. 
6.1.5 
船在港内停泊时，三管轮对生活污水直排出海阀进行封闭并悬挂警示牌。 
When the ship is berthing at a port, the Fourth Engineer shall close the valves for direct discharge of 
sewage into the sea and hang warning signs on them.  
6.1.6 
 生活污水装置运行时要及时投放消毒药剂，并做好记录。 
When the sewage treatment plant is running, disinfectants must be done in a timely manner and  
 properly recorded. 
6.1.7 
《生活污水记录簿》由三管轮日常记录，轮机长保留在船三年。 
The Sewage Water Record Book shall be recorded daily by the third engineer and shall be remain on 
board by C/E at least 3 years. 
6.2 
生活污水的排放 
Discharge of sewage 
6.2.1 
船舶在主权水域航行、锚泊或停泊在锚地、港池内，必须遵守主权国家和港口当局的
有关规定。 
When navigating in other territorial waters, mooring or berthing at an anchorage or at a port, the ship 
must follow relevant regulations of the sovereignty country and the port Administration. 
6.2.2 
停航期间，将船上的生活污水处理装置投入使用，或储存于粪便柜中待港口接收。 
During Non-voyage, the sewage treatment plant onboard the ship shall be put in use, or the sewage shall

6.2.3 
航行中不得将储存柜内的粪便和污水顷刻之间排光，应以不小于4 节的船速，       
并以中等速率进行排放。 
During navigation, manure and sewage in the collect tank shall not be discharged completely in a short 
time; instead, discharge shall be conducted at an intermediate speed, while the ship shall keep a speed of 
no less than 4 knots.  
6.2.4 
除此之外，船舶生活污水的排放必须遵守MARPOL73/78 附则IV 第11 条的规定。 
Besides, the discharge of shipboard sewage must be compliant with Regulation 11 under MARPOL 
73/78 Annex IV. 
7. 
污油（油渣）及含油垃圾的防污染管理 
Management of the Prevention of Pollution from slop Oil (Sludge) and Oil Containing Garbage 
7.1 
管理与要求 
Management and Requirements 
7.1.1 
轮机长直接负责污油（油渣）及含油垃圾的防污染管理工作，检查、检测、指导相关
人员做好日常污油（油渣）及含油垃圾的管理和焚烧炉的使用和维修保养工作，组织
轮机员制定焚烧炉的操作规程以及设备维修保养、备件申请计划等。 
The Chief Engineer is directly responsible for management of the prevention of pollution from  waste 
oil (sludge), inspecting, supervising, testing and guiding relevant personnel to carry out daily 
management of the prevention of pollution from waste oil (sludge) and proper use, service  and 
maintenance of the incinerator, as well as organizing the engineers to develop incinerator operation 
procedures and equipment service and maintenance, spare part requisition plan and etc. 
7.1.2 
三管轮具体负责焚烧炉的使用管理和维修保养并做好相关的记录。 
The Fourth Engineer is specifically responsible for the management of usage and maintenance of  
the 
incinerator as well as proper recording. 
7.1.3 
严禁一切污油（油渣）及含油垃圾直接排放（倾倒）入海。 
It is strictly prohibited to directly discharge (or dump) any waste oil (sludge) and oil containing  garbage 
into the sea. 
7.2 
污油（油渣）及含油垃圾的焚烧 
Incineration of waste oil (sludge) and oil containing garbage 
7.2.1 
船舶在主权水域航行、锚泊或停泊在锚地、港界内，必须遵守主权国家和港口当局的
规定，禁止焚烧作业。 
When navigating in other territorial waters, mooring or berthing at an anchorage or at a port, the ship 
must follow relevant regulations of the sovereignty country and the port Administration, and prohibit 
any incineration operation. 
7.2.2 
船上焚烧作业必须遵守MARPOL73/78 附则VI 第16 条的规定。 
Shipboard incineration operation must follow Regulation 16 under MARPOL 73/78 Annex VI. 
7.2.3 
船上所产生的污油（油渣）及含油垃圾在不违反MARPOL73/78 附则VI 第16 条规定
的基础上要进行焚烧处理。焚烧污油（油渣）作业的时间、数量等按照要求记入《油
类记录簿》。含油垃圾的焚烧作业，以及焚烧炉灰烬的清理和收集要记入《垃圾记录
簿》，特别注意，在操作人一栏中，应填写实施焚烧作业人员的名字，而非记录人的
名字。 
Waste oil (sludge) as well as oil containing garbage are to be disposed by incineration, provided that the 
provisions of Regulation 16 under MARPOL 73/78 Annex VI are not violated. Time,  quantity and etc. 
of the incineration operation of waste oil (sludge) shall be recorded in the Oil Record Book according to 
requirements. Incineration operation of oil containing garbage, and cleaning and collection of incinerator 
ashes shall be recorded in the Garbage Record Book, in particular, the name of the incineration operator, 
rather than the name of the recording person,  should be filled in the operator column.

8. 
船舶垃圾防污染管理 
Management of Prevention of Pollution from Shipboard Garbage 
8.1 
船舶垃圾防污染管理遵守《船舶垃圾管理计划》的相关规定。 
Shipboard pollution prevention management shall comply with relevant requirements as specified in the 
Ship’s Garbage Management Plan. 
8.2 
船舶垃圾的存放与管理 
Management and Storage of Shipboard Garbage 
8.2.1 
大副负责船上垃圾的处理工作。 
The Chief Officer is responsible for the disposal of shipboard garbage. 
8.2.2 
船舶应设有带垃圾类别标志的金属带盖垃圾桶。垃圾存放应严格按照73/78 防污公约
附则V 中垃圾分类的要求存放。 
The ship shall be equipped with metal trash cans with lids and signs of garbage category. Garbage shall 
be kept in strict accordance with the requirements of garbage classification  specified in Annex V to the 
MARPOL 73/78. 
8.2.3 
不允许处理入海的垃圾，如含有害或危险物质成份的垃圾和油污垃圾及塑料制品应到
港后办理岸上接收。 
Garbage that cannot be disposed by dumping into the sea, such as garbage containing hazardous or 
dangerous substances, oil contaminated garbage and plastic products, shall be disposed via onshore 
reception upon arrival at a port. 
8.2.4 
来自有疫情港口的船舶垃圾，应提前申请卫生检疫部门进行卫生处理。 
For shipboard garbage from a port where there is epidemic, prior application shall be submitted  to 
the 
Hygiene and Quarantine Department in advance for hygienic treatment. 
8.2.5 
塑料垃圾不得焚烧处理。必须收集并妥善保存，抵港后交岸处理，记入《垃圾记录簿》
中。索取接受证明，并与《垃圾记录簿》一并保存。 
Plastic garbage shall not be incinerated. It must be collected and properly stored, and then  handed over 
to port reception facilities upon arrival at a port, as well as properly recorded in the Garbage Record 
Book. A Certificate of Reception shall be claimed, and safe kept together with the Garbage Record Book. 
8.2.6 
按照73/78 防污公约附则V 的要求，船上应张贴垃圾分类和排放公告牌。 
According to requirements specified in Annex V to the MARPOL 73/78, bulletins of garbage 
classification and discharge shall be displayed onboard. 
8.3 
航行中的垃圾处理 
Garbage Disposal During Navigation 
处理按照73/78 防污公约附则V 中第3 条、第4 条、第5 条的要求执行。船上产生的
油类固体垃圾，使用焚烧炉进行焚烧，记录在《垃圾记录簿》的相应栏内。没有垃圾
焚烧炉的船舶收集在带盖的铁制垃圾筒内，放置远离热源且通风良好场所到港后交岸
接收。大副负责索要接收证明，并记录在垃圾记录簿内。 
Garbage disposal during navigation shall be carried out in strict accordance with Regulations 3 -5 
specified in Annex V of MARPOL 73/78. Oil and solid wastes formed onboard shall be incinerated by 
the incinerator, and recorded in the corresponding column of the Garbage Record Book. For ships 
without incinerators, such wastes shall be collected in iron bins with lids, and stored in places far from 
heat sources and well ventilated, and handed over to port reception facilities upon arrival at a port. The 
Chief Officer shall be responsible for obtaining a certificate, which shall be recorded in the Garbage

抵港垃圾处理 
Garbage Disposal at Ports 
8.4.1 
船舶抵港禁止向港口水域倾倒垃圾和废弃物。 
Upon arrival at ports, it is strictly prohibited for ships to dump garbage and wastes into the port  waters. 
8.4.2 
抵港船舶禁止使用焚烧炉焚烧垃圾。 
Incineration of garbage by incinerators are prohibited upon arrival at a port. 
8.4.3 
航行中未能处理或不允许处理的垃圾、抵港后应向港口当局申请接收处理。 
For garbage that failed to be or were not allowed to be disposed onboard during the voyage, port 
reception request shall be submitted to the port authority upon arrival.

凡含有危险、有毒等垃圾的品名、性质、数量应事先报告港口当局，经批准后方能进
行处理。 
Where there are dangerous and hazardous substances and etc., name, nature, and quantity of such 
substances shall be reported to the port Administration in advance, upon approval of which shall the 
garbage be disposed.  
8.4.5 
在港船舶垃圾桶安放在指定位置不得悬挂在舷外，不得散落、漏泄在露天甲板。 
For ships at ports, garbage bins shall be placed at specified locations, and shall not be hanged overboard, 
nor be scattered around or leaked onto the weather deck.  
8.4.6 
留存船上的塑料制品垃圾、含油垃圾（包括废旧的滤芯）及其它污染物垃圾，应在抵
港后申办岸上接收。 
Plastic products, oil containing garbage (including used filter elements) and other pollutants kept on 
board shall be handed over to shore reception facilities for further disposal after arrival. 
8.4.7 
垃圾交岸时，船舶应向接收方索取相关作业证明。在中国港口交岸污染物时，还应索
取污染物接收单证和主管海事机关认可的污染物接收证明，并与垃圾记录簿一起保
存。 
When handing over garbage to the shore receiving facilities, the ship shall request relevant certificates of 
work from the receiving party. When handing over pollutants for disposal at Chinese ports, pollutant 
receipts and Certificate of Reception of pollutants approved by the Administration in charge shall be 
claimed, and stored together with the Garbage Record Book. 
9. 
机器处所防污染管理 
Management of Prevention of Pollution from Machinery Spaces 
9.1 
管理与要求 
Management and Requirements 
9.1.1 
轮机长直接负责机舱防污染管理工作，监督检查指导各有关人员做好防污设备的使用
和维修保养工作。组织轮机员制定防污设备操作规程以及设备维修保 养、备件申请
计划等。 
The Chief Engineer is directly responsible for the management of prevention of pollution in machinery 
spaces, supervising, inspecting and guiding relevant personnel to properly use, service and maintain the 
pollution prevention equipment, as well as organizing the engineers to  develop 
pollution

equipment operation procedures and equipment service and  maintenance, spare part requisition plan

9.1.2 
三管轮具体负责机舱防污设备的使用管理和维修保养并做记录，按轮机长的指令和遵
照防污染规则进行污油处理和污水排放以及油渣的处理工作。严禁一切油污水未经油
水分离器直接排放入海。油水分离器排出阀应在抵港前锁闭，并在附近悬挂“未经轮
机长许可，不得动用油水分离设备”、“严禁排油入海”等 警告标语。 
The Fourth Engineer is specifically responsible for the management of usage and maintenance  of 
the 
pollution prevention equipment in machinery spaces as well as proper recording, and  carrying 
out

Discharge of Bilge Water in Engine Room

船舶在主权水域航行、锚泊或停泊在锚地、港池内，必须遵守主权国家和港口当局的

When navigating in other territorial waters, mooring or berthing at an anchorage or at a port, the ship 
must follow relevant regulations of the sovereignty country and the port Administration, and discharge 
of bilge water towards overboard is strictly prohibited. 
9.2.2 
航行在特殊区域以外的船舶排放污水应遵照73/78 防污公约附则1 第15.A 条：

accordance with Regulation 15.1.A specified in Annex I of MARPOL 73/78:

For ships engaged in voyages within special areas, discharge of sewage shall be carried out in

the Oil Record Book shall be carried out in a well manner, with close attention paid to the filling of 
discharge time and volume. The Chief Engineer should record accurately, and pay special attention to 
the use of the oil water separator with a 15PPM concentration monitor  that comes along with a memory 
function, and the record on the Oil Record Book shall be consistent with that on the memory card. 
10. 
污油、污水舱（柜）管理 
Management of waste oil and bilge( tanks) 
10.1 
机舱人员应详细了解污油舱（柜）、污水舱（柜）的容量及测量孔、透气孔、标准排
放接头的位置。 
Engine room staff shall have a detailed knowledge of the capacity of the waste oil tanks and the bilge 
tanks, as well as the locations of the measuring hole, the vent hole and the standard discharge 
connections. 
10.2 
污油舱（柜）、污水舱（柜）的液位警报系统，要经常检查试验，使其处于正常状态。
The level alarm systems of waste oil tanks and bilge tanks shall be inspected and tested regularly so that 
they are kept in a normal condition. 
10.3 
驳运污油舱（柜）、污水舱（柜）的污油水时，应坚守岗位，勤测量，以防发生溢漏。
When transferring waste oil and bilge water in waste oil tanks and bilge tanks, relevant personnel shall 
stick to their posts and take measurements frequently, to prevent the occurrence of leakage. 
10.4 
污油舱（柜）、污水舱（柜）高液位报警时，要及时处理，以防溢入舱底。 
When the high level alarm of waste oil tanks and bilge tanks sound, actions shall be taken in a timely 
manner to prevent overflow into the bilge. 
10.5 
三管轮抵港前应将污油、污水舱（柜）的污油水按照轮机长的指示处理妥当，并将剩
余存量报告轮机长。 
Prior to arrival at a port, the Fourth Engineer shall, according to the instructions given by the Chief 
Engineer, properly dispose the waste oil and bilge water in the waste oil tanks and bilge tanks, and 
report the remained volume to the Chief Engineer. 
11. 
申请接收处理污油、污水程序 
Procedures for applying for port reception and disposal of waste oil and bilge water 
11.1 
国内港口 
Domestic ports 
11.1.1 轮机长应通过船长向船舶所在港口的海事局书面申请，污油、水必须由经当地海事局
认可，并与公司有协议的接收单位的船、车接收。船舶得到书面确认后，船长应通知
机务总管。 
The Chief Engineer shall apply through the Master in writing to the marine safety administration of the 
port where the ship is located, and waste oil and bilge water must be approved by local maritime

authority, and received by vessels or vehicles of the receiving unit that has entered an agreement with

11.1.2 轮机长要详细查验污油、污水接收单位是否具有海事局批准的作业执照和申请，以防
止污油、污水接收后不能开具海事局签发的船舶残油接收处理证明。 
The Chief Engineer is to check in detail whether the receiving unit of waste oil and bilge water  is 
issued with license and application approved by the marine safety administration so as to avoid that the 
Certificate of Reception and Disposal of Oil Residues cannot be issued by the marine safety 
administration after reception of waste oil and bilge water.  
11.1.3 接收作业完毕，应向接受单位索取具有接受时间、地点、数量的单据，船长依此向海
事局申请签发船舶残油接受处理证明，并将此证明交轮机长附于油类记录簿上存档。 
Upon completion of the reception, a receipt specifying receiving time, location and quantity shall be 
requested from the receiving unit, and with this receipt, the Master shall apply to the marine safety 
administration for issuing the Certificate of Reception and Disposal of Oil Residues, which shall be then 
handed over to the Chief Engineer for attaching to the Oil Record  Book for record. 
11.2 
国外港口 
Foreign ports 
11.2.1 船长通过代理向所在港口有关当局申请接收处理污油或污水,并通知机务总管。 
The Master shall apply to relevant port Administration via an agent for port reception and  disposal 
of 
waste oil and bilge, and shall notify the technical superintendent. 
11.2.2 接收作业完毕，要有关当局签发船舶污油或污水接收证明并在油类记录簿上签注。 
Upon completion of reception, relevant authority shall issue a certificate of reception of waste oil or 
bilge water, and endorse on the Oil Record Book. 
11.3 
污油、污水接收注意事项 
Precautions for reception of waste oil and bilge water 
11.3.1 当机舱污水超过船上的储存能力时，应及时向船舶所在港口当局申请接收。 
When the volume of engine room bilge water exceeds the ship's storage capacity, port reception shall be 
applied in a timely manner to the port Administration. 
11.3.2 当接收车、船的输油管连接好本船标准排放接头时，应检查、紧牢另一舷的接头盲板。 
When the transfer pipe of the receiving vehicle or vessel is connected with the standard discharge 
connection of the ship, the blind flange of the connection at the other side shall be inspected and firmly 
fastened. 
11.3.3 堵好甲板出水孔，备好漏油的应急工具、用品。 
The deck drain shall be blocked, and emergency tools and supplies for responding to oil spill shall be 
well prepared. 
11.3.4 指派专人进行操作排放和值守。 
Dedicated personnel shall be appointed to carry out discharge and keep watch. 
11.3.5 加强与接收方的密切联系，确认泵的起动、停止信号和压力、排量等。 
Close communication with the receiving unit shall be strengthened to confirm start and stop signals of 
the pump as well as pressure and discharge volume and etc. 
11.3.6 加强输送管路的检查，严守当值岗位，防止发生冒油。 
Inspection against the transfer piping shall be enhanced and watch-keeping practices shall be strictly 
followed to avoid the occurrence of oil spill.  
11.3.7 接收作业结束时，在确认输送管内无残油后方可将其拆除。 
Upon completion of the reception operation, the transfer pipe shall not be disconnected before 
confirming that the pipe is free of oil residue inside.  
12. 
压载水防污染管理

Management of Prevention of Pollution from Ballast Water 
12.1 
压载水的排放必须严格遵守《压载水管理计划》的相关要求。 
For discharge of ballast water, the ship must strictly observe the Ballast Water Management Plan 
relevant requirements. 
12.2 
操作压载水时，所压入的水是清洁的，所使用的泵浦、管系未曾被污染过。 
When operating ballast water, the water ballasted in must be clean, and pumps as well as pipelines have 
never been polluted. 
12.3 
港口锚地排放压载水，应征得港口当局同意，方可进行排放。 
For discharge of ballast water at the anchorage of a port, permission must be first obtained from the port 
Administration before discharge.  
12.4 
在压载水作业时要严格执行甲板、轮机联系制度。 
During ballast water operation, a communicating mechanism between the deck and the engine room 
shall be strictly implemented.  
12.5 
排放压载水过程中要注意观察水质是否被污染。 
During discharge of ballast water, attention shall be paid to check the water quality if been polluted. 
13. 
甲板积水防污染管理 
Management of Deck Water Accumulation for Pollution Prevention 
13.1 
本管理规定适用于公司旗下所有船舶在进行以下作业时的甲板排水管理： 
This regulation applies to the management of deck drainage for all ships owned by the company during 
the following operations: 
13.1.1 干散货装卸作业 
Dry bulk cargo loading and unloading operations 
13.1.2 燃油加注（ bunkering ）作业 
Bunkering operations 
13.1.3 其他可能产生液压油、燃油或其他污染物泄漏的甲板作业。 
Other deck operations that may cause leakage of hydraulic oil, fuel oil or other pollutants. 
13.2 
作业前准备Pre-operation Preparation 
13.2.1 风险评估： 在开始任何货物或燃油作业前，大副应结合天气、海况、货物种类以及
甲板机械状况进行风险评估。 
Risk Assessment: Before commencing any cargo or fuel operation, the Chief Officer shall conduct a 
risk assessment considering weather conditions, sea conditions, cargo type and the condition of deck 
machinery 
13.2.2 安装泄水孔塞：Installation of Scupper Plugs: 
a. 在作业开始前，甲板部船员必须将所有甲板泄水孔的 scupper plugs （泄水孔塞）
安装到位并确保其紧固。 
Prior to the start of operations, deck department crew must install scupper plugs in all deck 
scuppers and ensure they are securely fastened. 
b. 安装前需检查泄水孔塞的状况，确保其无老化、开裂、变形，尺寸与泄水孔匹
配，能够有效密封。 
Before installation, inspect the condition of the scupper plugs to ensure they are free from 
aging, cracking and deformation, match the size of the scuppers, and can provide an effective 
seal. 
13.2.3 检查排水阀： 对于装有通向污油水舱或集污舱的排水阀的船舶，应检查该阀门是否
处于关闭状态，并确认其操作灵活、无泄漏。 
Inspection of Drain Valves: For ships equipped with drain valves leading to the oily water tank or 
sewage collection tank, check that the valves are in the closed position and confirm they operate 
flexibly without leakage.

13.2.4 检查甲板机械： 轮机部应配合检查货舱舱口盖、克令吊、绞车等甲板机械的液压管
路，及时发现并处理潜在泄漏点。 
Inspection of Deck Machinery: The engine department shall cooperate in inspecting the hydraulic 
pipelines of deck machinery such as cargo hold hatch covers, cranes and winches, and promptly 
identify and address potential leakage points. 
13.3 
作业期间监控 
Monitoring During Operations 
13.3.1 定期检查：Regular Inspections: 
a. 作业期间，值班人员应至少每两小时检查一次甲板状况，特别是在甲板机械附
近。 
During operations, on-duty personnel shall inspect the deck condition at least every two hours, 
especially in the vicinity of deck machinery. 
b. 检查重点包括：Key inspection items include: 
1) 泄水孔塞是否仍在原位且密封有效。 
Whether the scupper plugs remain in place and provide an effective seal. 
2) 甲板是否有积水。 
Whether there is water accumulation on the deck. 
3) 甲板是否有任何油污痕迹（包括液压油、燃油）。 
Whether there are any oil stains (including hydraulic oil and fuel oil) on the deck. 
13.4 
积水处理： 
Treatment of accumulation water 
13.4.1 如果甲板出现清洁的雨水或海浪积水，且确认无油污污染，可根据实际情况，在值班
驾驶员监督下，临时移开部分泄水孔塞进行排放。排放过程必须持续监控，一旦发现
有任何油污迹象，立即停止排放并重新堵塞泄水孔。 
If the accumulated water on the deck is clean rainwater or seawater and confirmed to be free from oil 
contamination, some scupper plugs may be temporarily removed for drainage under the supervision of 
the on-duty officer based on actual conditions. The drainage process must be continuously monitored; 
if any sign of oil contamination is detected, stop drainage immediately and re-plug the scuppers. 
13.4.2 如果甲板积水已被油类污染，或怀疑被污染，绝对禁止通过泄水孔直接排放入海。 
If the accumulated deck water is contaminated with oil or suspected of being contaminated, direct 
discharge into the sea through scuppers is strictly prohibited. 
13.4.3 在有SLOP TANK 的船舶上，可以将积水排入SLOP TANK 舱内。仔细检查并确认SLOP 
TANK 中的雨水没有与油水或油膜混合，可经泄放阀排放出海。 
For ships equipped with a slop tank, the accumulated water may be discharged into the slop tank. 
Carefully checking and confirming that no oil water or traces of oily sheen is mixed with the rainwater 
in the SLOP TANK， can be drained out passing the outlet valve. 
13.4.4 在无SLOP TANK 的船舶上，可以使用移动泵或手提泵将积水收集至临时收集容器（如
便携式污水桶），转运至机舱污水柜后续经油水分离器处理出海，并按要求做好相应
记录 
On ships without SLOP TANKs, shift pumps or portable pumps can be used to collect the accumulated 
water into temporary collection containers (such as portable bilge bucket), transfer it to the engine 
room bilge water tank, and then discharge overboard through the oil-water separator, and make 
corresponding records as required 
13.4.5 积水处理负责人 
 Person in charge of accumulated water treatment 
 大副负责指导规范识别和操作积水处理。在出水阀处制作警示牌，上面写 明：“严
 禁将混有油膜的积水排出”

The chief officer is responsible for guiding the specification identification and operation accumulated 
water treatment. The warning board should be made and hung up the outlet valve“Oil sheen is mixed 
with accumulated water shall be prohibited pumped out ” 
13.5 
污染应急： 一旦发现油污泄漏，立即按照《船上油污应急计划》采取行动，包括停
止作业、控制污染源、围控和清除油污。 
Pollution Emergency Response: In case of oil leakage, immediately take actions in accordance with 
the Shipboard Oil Pollution Emergency Plan, including stopping operations, controlling the pollution 
source, containing and removing the oil. 
13.6 
作业后恢复Post-operation Restoration 
13.6.1 排水与清理：Drainage and Cleaning: 
a. 作业结束后，在确认甲板无任何油污后，方可移除所有泄水孔塞，排干甲板积
水。 
After the operation, all scupper plugs may be removed to drain the accumulated deck water only 
after confirming there is no oil contamination on the deck. 
b. 如果甲板存在油污，必须先使用吸油材料等彻底清理干净，然后才能进行排水。 
If there is oil contamination on the deck, it must be thoroughly cleaned using oil-absorbent 
materials, etc., before drainage can be carried out. 
13.7 
设备存放： 将泄水孔塞清洁干净，存放于指定位置，便于下次取用。 
Equipment Storage: Clean the scupper plugs and store them in the designated location for easy access 
in future use. 
 
重要提示：停止高风险操作 
如果雨势非常大且持续不断，雨水在后部排水管处积聚，则船长必须考虑停止所有船
舶上的高风险操作，如加油作业 
Important: Stop High Risk Operation 
If the rain is so heavy and continuous that rainwater is building up at the aft gutter bar, the 
captain must consider stopping high risk operations like bunkering. 
 
14. 
防止船舶造成空气污染操作规程 
Operation procedures for prevention of air pollution from ships 
14.1 
证书和文件要求 
Requirements on qualifications and documents 
14.1.1 400 总吨及以上的国际航线船舶，必须持有《国际防止空气污染证书》（IAPP）； 
Ships of 400 GT and above that engaged in international voyages must carry onboard the International 
Air Pollution Prevention Certificate（IAPP）;  
14.1.2 2000 年1 月1 日及以后建造的船舶所安装的输出功率超过130KW 的柴油发动机，以
及 2000 年1 月1 日及以后经过主要改装的输出功率超过130KW 的柴油发动机，其氮
氧化物的释放均应符合《船用柴油机NOX 排放控制技术规则》要求，并持有发动机
国际防止空气污染证书（EIAPP），以及每台柴油发动机的技术文件和参数记录簿。 
For diesel engines with an output power of over 130 KW installed on ships constructed on and after 
January 1, 2000, and diesel engines with an output power of over 130 KW substantially modified on and 
after January 1, 2000, their emission of nitrogen oxides shall be in compliance with the requirements 
specified in the Technical Code on Control of Emission of Nitrogen Oxides from Marine Diesel Engines, 
and the ship shall carry onboard the Engine International Air Pollution Prevention Certificate (EIAPP) 
as well as technical documents and parameter record books of every diesel engine.  
14.1.3 每台机器NOX 排放总量（计算）应保持在； 
The total emission of NOx (calculated) of each machine shall be maintained at:

14.1.4 2000 年1 月1 日及以后安装在船上的焚烧炉都应满足MARPOL73/78 附则Ⅵ的要求，
并持有型式认可证书和厂商的操作手册。 
Incinerators installed onboard on and after January 1, 2000 shall be in compliance with the requirements 
specified in Annex VI to MARPOL 73/78, and hold Type Approval Certificate as well as Operation 
Manual of the manufacturer. 
14.2 
船上焚烧 
Shipboard Incineration 
14.2.1 船上船员应熟悉焚烧炉操作规程，并能在附则要求范围内、按操作手册进行作业,严
禁焚烧附则所规定的禁烧污染物质。 
The crew of the ship shall be familiar with the incinerator operation procedures, and carry out the 
operation within the scope of requirements of the annex and according to the operation manual. It is 
strictly prohibited to incinerate the pollutants specified in the annex. 
14.2.2 特定的物质禁止焚烧，如多氯联苯（PCBS）。 
It is prohibited to incinerate specific substances, such as polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs).  
14.2.3 船上应保存焚烧炉的使用记录。 
Records of incinerator usage shall be kept on board. 
14.3 
消耗臭氧物质的排放 
Discharge of Ozone Depleting Substances 
14.3.1 禁止任何故意释放消耗臭氧物质的行为，船上所有含有消耗臭氧物质的设备的安装、
维修和拆除，均应按附则要求实施；须回收的，均应回收到接收设施中。 
Any deliberate emissions of ozone-depleting substances shall be prohibited, and the installation, 
maintenance and demolition of all shipboard equipment containing ozone depleting substances  shall be 
implemented according to requirements specified in the Annex, and shall be recycled to  
the receiving 
facility if recycle is necessary.  
14.3.2 在进行相应的船舶修造作业时，涉及到船上消耗臭氧物质的，须由修理厂进行相应的
接收和储存，严禁排放任何消耗臭氧的物质。 
During corresponding ship repair and construction operation, if shipboard consumption of  ozone 
depleting substances is involved, then they must be received and stored at the dockyards, and no ozone 
depleting substances shall be discharged. 
14.3.3 船舶应保存相关文件，记录使用消耗臭氧物质的设备维护，检查检验以及物质供应和
消耗的情况。 
The ship shall safe keep relevant documents, record the maintenance, inspection, and survey of  the 
equipment consuming ozone depleting substances as well as the status of supply and consumption.  
14.3.4 船舶制冷或其他涉及使用消耗臭氧物质设备的维护、检查和检验纳入船舶日常维护工
作，并记入《消耗臭氧物质记录簿》。供应、使用消耗臭氧物质的情况由轮机长保存
相关记录。 
Shipboard refrigeration equipment or maintenance, inspection and survey of other equipment that use 
ozone depleting substances shall be included in the maintenance routine of the ship, and recorded in the 
Ozone Depleting Substances Record Book. The records of ozone depleting substance supply and usage 
shall be kept by the Chief Engineer.

 耗臭氧物质记录簿”按要求记录，在轮机长处保存。 
According to the requirements on “ozone depleting substances” specified in Regulation 12 of the 
Revised MARPOL Ann VI, the ship shall maintain a list of equipment containing ozone-depleting 
substances and an ozone-depleting substances record book starting from July 1, 2010.The Ozone 
Depleting Substances Record Book shall be recorded according to requirements, and kept at the Chief 
Engineer’s office.  
14.4 
加装燃油 
Bunkering 
在加装燃油时应与供油单位共同提取燃油样品并封存，油样在船保存至燃油基本用
完，但不少于12 个月。 
A sample of the fuel oil shall be taken sealed together with the supplier during bunkering operations, and 
retained under the ship's control until the fuel oil is substantially consumed, but in any case for a period 
of not less than 12 months from the time of delivery.  
14.5 
燃油使用 
Use of fuel oil 
按照MARPOL 公约附则VI 第14（6）条的规定，船舶进入特殊区域（硫氧化物排放
控制区）前需进行由高硫油转换为低硫油的燃油转换作业；根据欧盟规定，船舶在欧
盟所属港口停泊（锚泊、系泊、卸货）2 小时以上必须使用含硫量不大于0.1%m/m 的
燃油。船舶应： 
In accordance with Regulation 14.6 of Annex VI to MARPOL, prior to entry into special areas (SOx 
emission control areas), the ship shall carry out fuel oil changeover operation from high sulfur fuel oil to 
low sulfur fuel oil; and according to EU regulations, while ships are operating (anchoring, mooring, and 
unloading cargoes) in EU ports for more than 2 hours, the Sulphur content of fuel oil used on board 
ships must not exceed 0.1 % m/m. The ship shall:  
14.5.1 在进入特殊区域（硫氧化物排放控制区）前需进行由高硫油转换为低硫油的燃油转换
作业操作程序。 
Prior to entry into special areas (SOx emission control areas), the ship shall carry out fuel oil changeover 
operation from high sulfur fuel oil to low sulfur fuel oil.  
14.5.2 到达欧盟港口后，立刻更换为含硫量不大于0.1% m/m 的燃油。 
Upon arrival at an EU port, the fuel oil shall be changed over to another fuel oil with a sulfur content not 
exceeding 0.1% m/m. 
14.5.3 其它地区使用任何燃油的含硫量不得大于0.5% m/m 的燃油. 
The sulfur content of any fuel oil used in other areas shall not be greater than 0.5% m/m. 
14.5.4 应在航海日志和轮机日志中记录使用低硫燃油操作的日期、时间和船舶位置。 
The date, time, and position of the ship when low sulfur fuel oil is used for operation shall be recorded 
in the Deck Logbook and the Engine Logbook. 
15. 
加装燃、润油管理 
Management of fuel oil and lubrication oil bunkering operations 
15.1 
船舶加装燃油、润滑油工作的总负责人是轮机长，燃油主管人是二管轮，润滑油主管
是大管轮，任何加油的文件、单据、油样应交轮机长签署，并予以确认。 
The Chief Engineer is general responsible person for the bunkering operations of fuel oil and lubricating 
oil, and the Third Engineer is the specific person in charge of fuel oil，and the Second Engineer is the 
specific person in charge of lubricating oil. Any bunkering documents, receipts and samples shall be 
signed and confirmed by the Chief Engineer. 
15.2 
船长应将加油港口的有关防污染规定及加油要求，及时通知轮机长。  
The Master shall notify the Chief Engineer in a timely manner of the pollution prevention regulations

and bunkering requirements of the bunkering port.  
15.3 
船舶应熟悉加装燃油相关程序，对所加装燃油质量进行把关，做好加油记录。详细记
录燃油加入的舱柜、调驳及使用的起、止时间。 
The ship shall be familiar with fuel oil bunkering related procedures, check on the quality of fuel oil 
bunkered, and maintain proper bunkering records. Tanks to which fuel oil are bunkered as well as 
starting and ending time of transferring and using shall be recorded in detail. 
15.4 
在接收燃油时，应注意燃油中硫的含量，所使用的燃油含硫量应符合船舶营运区域所
适用的《MARPOL 73/78》公约的最新要求以及港口国的规定。 
When receiving fuel oil, attention shall be paid to the sulfur content of the fuel oil, and the sulfur content 
of the fuel oil used shall meet the latest requirements of the MARPOL 73/78 applicable in the ship’s 
operation area as well as the regulations of the port state. 
15.5 
在加装燃油前应向供应商索要燃油的安全数据单（MSDS）并保留在船上备查；加装
燃油作业结束后应要求供油单位提供相关加油单据，并在船上保存至少三年。 
Prior to bunkering, the Material Safety Data Sheet(MSDS) of the fuel oil shall be requested from the 
supplier and safe kept onboard the ship for future check; and upon completion of fuel oil bunkering 
operation, relevant bunkering note shall be requested from the supplier, and stored onboard for at least 
three years.  
15.6 
做好加装燃油、润滑油的全过程管理。全过程是指油船（车）到达至离开本轮或本轮
靠上至离开加油码头。各部门应将加装燃油、润滑油作为全船的工作。 
Management of the entire process of the bunkering operations of fuel oil and lubricating oil shall be 
carried out in a well manner. The entire process refers to the entire period from arrival of the bunkering 
vessel (vehicle) to departure of the vessel from the ship or from the moment the ship arrives at the 
bunkering dock to departure. All departments shall treat the bunkering operations of fuel oil and lub. oil 
as work of the whole ship. 
15.7 
原则上加油在白天完成，如果必须在夜晚加油时，必须增加值班人员和准备充足的照
明设备。 
In principle, bunkering shall be completed during the day, and if it is necessary to bunker at night, 
watch-keeping personnel must be added and adequate lighting devices must be prepared.  
15.8 
靠码头加油时，值班水手应经常巡视及调整系泊缆绳，在潮水涨落幅度大港口更要加
强上述工作。 
When berthing at a dock for bunkering, the watch-keeping seaman shall regularly patrol and adjust the 
mooring lines, and such measures shall be enhanced at a port where the tidal range is huge.  
15.9 
加油场所应悬挂“船用油移油操作程序”及“禁止吸烟”的警告牌。 
Warning boards such as “Operation Procedures for Transferring Marine Fuel Oil” and “Smoking 
Prohibited” shall be displayed at bunkering places. 
15.10 将加油过程的时间、数量等相关事宜记入航海日志和轮机日志中。 
Relevant matters such as duration of the bunkering process and quantity shall be recorded in the Deck 
Logbook and the Engine Logbook. 
16. 
其它防污染管理事项 
Other Pollution Prevention Related Management Matters 
16.1 
排放货舱污水 
Discharge of cargo hold bilges 
16.1.1 排放前应确认货舱污水无油污、无毒，则在远离港口以外排放；否则参阅污油、污水
的有关规定执行。 
Prior to discharge, it is necessary to confirm that bilges of the cargo hold is free of oil and  nontoxic, 
and then discharge to waters far away from the port; otherwise the discharge shall be  conducted 
by 
following related regulations on waste oil and bilge water.

16.1.2 在港口排放应征得港口当局认可。 
Approval shall be obtained from the port Administration if discharge at the port. 
16.1.3 排放使用的泵浦、管系，操作结束后应用清水进行冲洗。 
Upon completion of the discharge operation, pumps and pipelines used for discharge shall be washed by 
clean water. 
16.2 
船舶在港界内禁止进行锅炉吹灰； 
Soot blowing operations for boilers shall be prohibited in the boundary of a port. 
16.3 
尾轴防污事项：油封形式的船舶尾轴要经常检查外渗情况，以防滑油外溢。 
Pollution prevention matters of tail shaft: oil seals in the form of tail shaft shall be regularly checked for 
overflow, so as to avoid overflowing of lubricating oil tank.  
16.4 
其他 
Miscellaneous 
16.4.1 通机舱的舵机房污水沟，停航时应将其腰节阀关闭。 
For bilge drainage of the steering gear room leading to the engine room, its drain valve shall be  closed 
during lay-up.  
16.4.2 禁止乱设接头或软管绕开油水分离设备强行排放，污水出海阀应带锁闭措施。 
It is prohibited to connecting joints or hoses to bypass the oil-water separators for force discharge, and 
the bilge discharge valve shall be fitted with a locking device. 
16.4.3 除非紧急情况，禁止使用通用泵及消防泵排放机舱污水，与其连接的阀门应当关紧、
锁闭，不得随意开启。 
Unless under emergency circumstances, the use of general-purpose pumps and fire pumps to discharge 
engine room bilge is prohibited, and the valves connecting to them shall be closed and locked, and shall 
not be opened at will. 
16.4.4 下水管通机舱的洗手盆（槽），停航时禁止使用。 
The sewer pipes of the basins or sinks connecting to the engine room shall not be used during lay-up.  
16.4.5 停航期间不要在洗衣机和其它洗手盆内洗涤油污较大的衣物。 
During lay-up, washing of heavily oil contaminated clothes in washing machine and other  basins shall 
be avoided. 
16.4.6 停船期间不要在厨房水池内洗涤含食油较浓的餐具及炊具。 
During lay-up, tableware and kitchenware with thick oil shall not be washed in the sinks of the  kitchen. 
16.4.7 船舶除锈不得将铁锈、油漆皮丢入水中。 
During shipboard de-rusting, rust and paint skin shall not be thrown into water.  
16.4.8 船舶在港内喷涂油漆作业需经港口当局批准，采取防污措施，防止油漆滴落水中造成
污染。 
If the ship need to carry out painting jobs at a port, approval shall be obtained from the port 
Administration, and pollution prevention measures shall be taken to avoid causing pollution due to paint 
falling into the water. 
16.4.9 不准在港口水域冲洗装载有毒、含腐蚀性货物、粉尘飞扬散装货物的船舶甲板和舱室
（包括油污甲板）。 
It is not allowed to wash ship decks and spaces (including oil contaminated decks) carrying toxic, 
corrosive and dusty cargoes in bulk in the area of port waters. 
16.4.10 禁止在港内水域未经港口当局批准擅自使用化学消油剂。 
It is prohibited to use chemical oil dispersant in port waters without approval from the port 
Administration. 
16.4.11 禁止在露天甲板堆放油桶和易引起污染的物品。 
Storage of oil drums and items that tend to cause pollution at the weather deck is prohibited. 
16.4.12 甲板上各油舱（柜）透气孔（帽）的集油槽抵港前必须用一端带链条及密封垫床的螺

16.4.13 如船舶发生操作性溢油或事故性溢油时，溢油现场人员应立即采取关闭相应设备、使

16.4.15 在船舶待泊、靠泊期间，如发现本船有大片油迹，应立即向船长报告。

immediately reported.

ship is not capable of troubleshooting the issues, the technical superintendent of the company shall be

第04 节 船舶安全活动制度 
Section 04 Regulations on Shipboard Safety Activities 
1.0 船舶安全自查 
Self-check of ship safety 
1.1 船舶各部门应至少每月要检查所分管的安全设施和所属人员的人身安全行为，分别填
写《甲板部安全设施检查表》、《轮机部安全设施检查表》、《甲板部人身安全行为检查
表》、《轮机部人身安全行为检查表》，报船长确认。 
Each department of a ship shall check the safety facilities in their charge as well as the 
personal safety behaviors of relevant staff at least once a month, and complete respectively 
the Deck Department Safety Facilities Checklist, the Engine Department Safety Facilities 
Checklist, the Deck Department Personal Safety Behavior Checklist, and the Engine 
Department Personal Safety Behavior Checklist, which shall be then submitted to the Master 
for confirmation.  
1.2 船长应组织安委会成员核查船员安全自查的落实情况，并不定期抽查船上各种记录。 
The Master shall organize members of the S&H Committee to audit the crew’s 
implementation of safety self-check, and spot check all sorts of records on board from time 
to time.  
2.0 船舶安委会活动会 
Shipboard S&H Committee Meeting 
2.1 安委会活动会是船长和其他安委会成员就健康和安全相关事宜进行磋商的座谈会, 对
船舶各项管理活动进行总结，防止船上职业安全事故、受伤和疾病、骚扰或欺凌发生，
确保船员得到职业健康保护。每月至少进行一次，在船舶安全日之前进行，还应在船
上发生任何严重事故或事故后召开会议。部门长应将本部门近期的安全工作在会上向
船长报告。 
The S&H Committee meeting is a forum for consultation between the master and other 
safety officials relating to health and safety, and summarizing all shipboard managing 
activities in the meeting. It shall be hold at least once a month ahead of the Shipboard Safety 
Day, a meeting should also be held after any serious incident or accident on the ship. The 
head of the department shall report the recent safety activities of their department to Master 
on this meeting.  
2.2 会议讨论船舶管理中的缺陷，发现其中的事故/险情和不符合规定情况，按照《不符合
规定的情况、事故和险情的报告和处理程序》处理。 
The meeting shall discuss the deficiencies raised during ship management, thus to discover 
the accidents, hazardous occurrences and non-conformities behind them, and handle them in 
accordance with the Reports and Analysis of Non-conformities, Accidents and Hazardous 
Occurrences Procedure.  
2.3 对于在船舶工作和操作中发生的险失事件（Near Miss），船长需收集各部门的险失报告，
验证各部门及时采取了措施予以纠正和防范，防止事态的继续发展。 
For Near Miss events occurred during works and operations, the Master is required to collect 
Report of Near Miss, and verify that the corrective and preventative measures in a timely 
manner so as to prevent such events from worsening.  
2.4 安全代表的选举和认命，应该记录在安委会活动会议记录表中。安全代表应在安委活动
会上报告潜在危害和危险事件，并立足于现实，了解法规要求，考虑合理可行性，以
坚定、合理和有益的方式，就健康和安全事宜，提出意见和建议。 
The election or appointment of every safety representative should be written in the S&H 
committee meeting record. The safety representative shall to report the potential hazards and 
dangerous occurrences, Safety representatives should be sure of the facts, be aware of the

2.5 安委会活动会议不得用于指导或培训目的。安委会活动会议的决议和讨论结果，要在
部门安全议上向全体船员宣贯。 
The S&H Committee meeting should not be used for the purposes of instruction or training. 
Resolutions and results of discussions at the S&H Committee meetings need to be 
disseminated to all crew members at the department safety meetings. 
2.6 船长将会议情况记入安委会活动记录表，安委会活动记录在月底统一汇报海务主管。 
The Master shall record the meeting contents in the ship S&H committee meeting record. 
Records of hip S&H committee meeting shall be reported centrally to the Marine Department 
at the end of the month. 
2.7 安委会应对讨论的所有事项采取有效行动，船长和安全员应确保在计划的时间内适当
地处理会议中发现的问题。如果需要公司提供支持，应通知机务总管，船长应该保存
公司的答复和采取的行动。 
The committee shall take effective action in all matters. Master and Safety Officer should 
ensure that issues identified in the meeting are suitably addressed within an identified time 
frame. For the suggestions and requests made in the Safety Committee that require support 
from the Company, the master should report to the Fleet Operations Superintendent. A record 
of response or action taken by the company should be maintained by master. 
3.0 部门安全会 
Departmental Safety Meeting 
3.1 各部门按照船长的指令或根据本部门的情况，召开部门安全会。每一位部门成员都要
在会上发言，报告自己发现的不安全、不符合规定的现象和存在的隐患，提出改进措
施和建议。 
All departments shall hold departmental safety meetings according to the Master’s 
instructions or each department’s situation. Each member in the department shall speak on 
the meeting, reporting the unsafe and non-conforming matters and existing potential risks 
found by himself, and putting forward improvement actions and recommendations.  
3.2 甲板部和轮机部的部门安全会可以一起召开，一起召开的全船安全会，由船长主持。 
Departmental safety meetings of the Deck and Engine are allowed to be held together, and 
the Master will preside the shipboard safety meeting when they are held together. 
3.3 各部门长将会议情况详细记入安全活动记录表，参加人员签名。因值班或其他原因不
能参加安全活动人员，部门长要将活动内容进行传达。 
All the head of the departments shall record in detail the contents of the meeting into the 
Safety Activity Record SHIP-01-04-01, which shall be signed by the attendants. For those 
who are absent from the safety activities due to watch-keeping or other reasons, the head of 
the department shall convey the content of such activities to them. 
4.0 船舶安全活动日制度 
Shipboard Safety Day 
4.1 每月的28 日是船舶安全活动日的时间,如有特殊情况可以顺延，但记录中须做出说明。 
The 28th of every month is the Shipboard Safety Day, which can be postponed in case of 
special circumstances, provided that explanations are given in the records.  
4.2 回顾安全行动，总结一个月来的安全生产、人员健康和防污染的情况，找出薄弱环节，
商讨改进措施。对险失、不符合规定的情况、险情、事故进行总结、分析，提出改进
措施。 
Review of safety activity, summarize safe situation, personnel health and pollution 
prevention for the past month shall, so as to find out the weak sides and discuss improvement

 第05 节 驾驶台规则 
Section 05 Bridge Regulations 
 
1 驾驶台是船舶航行的指挥中心，其范围包括操舵室、海图室、两翼甲板及标准罗经甲板。
航行中，除船舶领导和当值人员外，其他人不得随意进入。 
The bridge is the commanding center for navigation, and it includes the wheelhouse, the chart room, wings 
of the bridge deck and the standard compass deck. During navigation, all other personnel are not allowed 
to enter without permission, except ship leaders and persons on watch. 
2 驾驶台值班人员必须认真履行值班职责, 不得从事与值班无关的活动；不得嬉笑闲谈、
高声喧哗或收听广播；除船长和引航员外，其他任何人不得坐着值班，也不得在驾驶台
用餐和睡眠。 
The watch-keepers in the bridge must carefully perform his watch keeping duties, and shall not do 
anything that is not relevant to watch-keeping, or laugh and chat loudly or listen to radio. Except for the 
Master and the pilot, no person is allowed to be seated while keeping watch, or eat and sleep at the bridge. 
3 VHF DSC 在接收到DSC 遇险信息时通信频道会自动切换到16 频道，此功能会对关键安
全操作期间的语音通信造成影响，在关键安全操作期间，驾驶员可以根据需要提前禁用
频道自动切换功能，等关键安全操作结束以后再及时恢复这一功能。当自动切换功能禁
用时，设备应提供视觉指示。 
VHF DSC will automatically switch the communication channel to channel 16 when it receives the DSC 
distress message, this function will impact the voice communications during safety critical operations, the 
officer can disable the automatic channel switching function in advance according to the need, and then 
restore this function in time after the end of the safety critical operation. Equipment should provide a visual 
indication when the automatic switching function is disabled. 
4 航行值班时，负责航行指挥的驾驶员严禁使用手机和个人电子设备，除非为了船舶安全
航行需要并得到船长的许可或者有其它驾驶员接替他的航行值班职责时。 
During the navigational watch, the Officer-of-the watch in charge of the navigational command is strictly 
prohibited from using mobile phones and personal electronic devices, unless for the safety of navigation 
and with the permission of the master or when another Officer takes over his navigational watch duties. 
5  航行值班时，禁止上网和收发邮件操作，除非这种操作是下班之后或者是了船舶航行
安全需要并得到船长的许可，且仅限于下列情况：： 
During the navigational watch, Internet access and e-mail operations are prohibited unless such operations 
are out of duty hours or when necessary for the safety of the ship's navigation and approved by the master, 
and are limited to the following situations: 
a)  接收海图和出版物、执照和许可证的更新； 
Updates for nautical charts and publications, licences and permits 
b)  接收天气信息； 
Weather information. 
c)  接收航行警告； 和 
Navigational warnings; and 
d)  接收与船舶运营和航次计划相关的信息。 
Information relevant to the ship’s operations and passage plan 
6 
参与驾驶台值班人员需要认识到使用助航仪器的潜在风险，比如:甚高频电话、船舶自
动识别系统、电子海图等。 
Bridge watch keepers shall to be aware of the potential risks associated with the use of navigational aids,

such as VHF/AIS/ECDIS, etc. 
a) 所有航行值班人员不能依赖VHF 通信作为避免碰撞的手段，因为存在以下风险： 
All navigation watch-keeping officers should not rely on VHF radio as a means of avoiding collisions, 
due to the following risks: 
 两艘或多艘船舶之间通过VHF 无线电通信达成的避免碰撞的协议行动，如果没有
考虑到这种协议行动的风险，可能不符合 COLREGS 的要求。 
The agreed actions between two or more vessels, made over the VHF radio to avoid collision and 
without considering the risks of such an agreed action, may not comply with the requirements of the 
COLREGS. 
 由于语言障碍，船只之间通过 VHF 无线电通信达成的避免碰撞协议可能会被误解
或曲解。 
Agreement reached via VHF radio communication between vessels for collision avoidance could be 
misunderstood or misinterpreted due to language difficulties 
 在能见度受限的情况下航行、在黑暗中航行以及在有多于一艘船的情况下航行时，
可能会对驶近船只的身份存在不确定性。 
Uncertainty may exist over the identity of approaching vessels, when navigating in restricted 
visibility, during period of darkness, and in circumstances when there is more than one vessel. 
 一种被称为对流层传播的自然现象可能导致无线电信号在邻近地表的大气层中传
播，最高可达约 7620 米。因此，这些信号会受到绵延数英里的天气条件的直接影
响。 
A natural phenomenon known as Tropospheric Propagation may cause radio signals to travel in the 
part of the atmosphere adjacent to the surface and extending up to some 7,620 meters. Such signals 
are thus directly affected by weather conditions extending over some miles. 
 由于繁忙的无线电通信、静音控制、静电噪声和无线电通信干扰等原因，通过VHF
无线电通话中的重要信息可能会被打断或接收不清楚； 
Important messages in the conversation through VHF radio could be interrupted or are not being 
received clearly due to busy radio traffic, squelch control, static noise and interference of radio 
communication; 
 试图通过甚高频无线电取得联系或通过甚高频无线电进行冗长的通话，而不是在充
裕的时间内立即采取适当的行动来遵守 COLREGS 并避免碰撞，从而损失宝贵的
时间。 
The loss of valuable time in trying to make contact on VHF radio or else having a lengthy 
conversation on VHF radio instead of taking appropriate and immediate action, in ample time, to 
comply with the COLREGS and to avoid a collision. 
 在夜间、能见度受限或在 VHF 无线电范围内附近有两艘以上的船只时，在没有 
AIS 信息的情况下可能难以识别船只。 
Identification of vessels without AIS information may be difficult during night-time, in restricted 
visibility or when there are more than two vessels in the vicinity within the VHF radio range. 
b) 所有值班人员也不能依赖AIS 信息避碰，原因如下： 
All watch-keeping officers should also not rely on AIS to determine collision risk due to the following 
considerations: 
 使用AIS 并不免除 OOW 在确定是否存在碰撞风险时始终遵守《碰撞规章》，特
别是第 7 条的责任。 
The use of AIS does not negate the responsibility of the OOW to comply at all times with the 
Collision Regulations, particularly rule 7 when determining whether a risk of collisions exists. 
 
AIS 数据的提供和显示不应优先于系统雷达目标跟踪（如 ARPA）产生的数据。
The availability and display of AIS data should not be given priority over the data produced by 
systematic radar target-tracking (e.g. ARPA).

 AIS 目标数据仅基于目标船只在地面上的航向和速度，而为了符合 COLREG 的要
求，此类数据必须基于船只在水中的航向和速度。 
AIS target data will only be based on the target vessels’ course and speed over ground whilst for 
compliance with the COLREG such data must be based on the vessels’ course and speed through the 
water. 
 从目标获得的定位数据的质量和可靠性因发射船的全球导航卫星系统设备的精度
而异。 
The quality and reliability of position data obtained from targets will vary depending on the accuracy 
of the transmitting vessel’s GNSS equipment. 
 在船上使用AIS 无意对航行值班的组成产生任何特殊影响，航行值班的组成应根据
《海员标准公约》（STCW）和《国际船舶和港口设施保安规则》（COLREGS）
确定。 
The use of AIS on board ship is not intended to have any special impact on the composition of the 
navigational watch, which should be determined in accordance with the STCW Convention and 
COLREGS. 
 AIS 定位来自目标的全球导航卫星系统接收器，通常是全球定位系统。这可能与雷
达探测到的目标不完全一致。 
AIS positions are derived from the target’s GNSS receiver, usually GPS. This may not coincide 
exactly with the target as detected by radar. 
 接收到的 AIS 数据是另一艘船传送的数据，可能会出现错误。 
Received AIS data is whatever another vessel transmits and is subject to potential errors. 
 AIS 的一个最新发展是能够提供合成 AIS 目标和虚拟导航标记，使沿岸当局能够
在显示屏上的任何位置提供 AIS 标志。航海者应注意，这种能力可能导致出现虚
拟的 "AIS 目标"。 
A recent development of AIS is the ability to provide synthetic AIS targets and virtual navigation 
marks enabling coastal authorities to provide an AIS symbol on the display in any position. Mariners 
should note that this ability could lead to the appearance of virtual” AIS targets. 
c) 
 ECDIS 有三种显示模式。There are three display modes on an ECDIS. 
 
基本显示：不能从海图中删除的重要物标，如海岸线和船舶安全等深线。 
Base Display: Important objects that cannot be deleted from the charts, such as coastline 
and own ship’s safety contour. 
 
标准显示：与基本显示相比不那么重要的对象，如干燥线、固定和漂浮助航设备的
指示以及航道和航道的边界等。 
Standard Display: Objects less important than base display, such as drying line, indication of fixed 
and floating aids to navigation and boundaries of fairways, channels, etc. 
 
其它显示：其它物体，如现场水深、海底电缆和管道、渡轮航线以及所有孤立危险
的详细信息。 
Other Display: Other objects, such as spot soundings, submarine cables and pipelines, ferry routes 
and details of all isolated dangers. 
 
基本显示不得用于导航。它只能显示非常基本的信息，重要的导航信息将不会显示。
Base display shall not be used for navigation. It displays only very basic information and important 
navigational information will not be displayed. 
 
在航次计划设计过程中请使用"全部"显示模式来直观地检查预定航线。一旦制定了
详细的航行计划，并使用航海信息层进行了适当的注释，就可以将显示的详细程度
降低到更接近于"标准"显示，以便在航行监控期间提供清晰的显示。 
Please use the "All" display mode to visually check the intended routes during the voyage planning

驾驶台当值人员应衣着整洁，仪表端庄，不得穿着背心、短裤、拖鞋值班。 
The watch-keepers at the bridge shall dress in a clean and tidy manner and present himself in decent 
manner. Wearing vest, pants and slippers are not allowed while keeping watch.  
8 
必须保持驾驶台内外整洁，必要的航行用具和图书资料应在指定地点整齐放置；禁止
随地吐痰和丢弃杂物。航行中驾驶台每天的日常清洁工作由04:00－08:00 班值班水手
负责，到港前应彻底清洁；离港前，由值班水手及时对驾驶台进行全面的清理。 
The bridge must be kept clean and tidy both inside and out, and necessary navigation tools and nautical 
publication shall be stored at dedicated places in a neat and tidy manner, and it is prohibited to split and 
litter. During navigation, the daily cleaning work of the bridge is the responsibility of the watch-keeping 
seaman for 04:00－08:00. Prior to arrival at a port or departure from a port, a thorough cleaning of the 
bridge shall be carried out by the watch-keeping seaman.  
9 
航行中，在任何时候不得将操舵室的全部门窗关闭，尤其在能见度不良的情况下，驾
驶室通往两翼甲板的门应处于开启状态，了望人员应在两翼甲板值守。 
During navigation, it is not allowed to close all doors and windows of the wheelhouse at any time,
