10 
无关人员不得擅自动用驾驶台的各种设备、航海文件、图书资料等；未经船长批准，
不得将上述物品销毁或携带出驾驶台。 
Unauthorized persons are not allowed to use any equipment, nautical document, publications etc. on the 
bridge; and without the Master’s permission, the afore-mentioned items shall not be destroyed or brought 
away from the bridge.  
11 
操舵室和标准罗经附近不得放置铁质或磁性物品。 
Iron or magnetic items are not allowed to be placed in the vicinity of the wheelhouse and the standard 
compass.  
12 
夜间航行时，严禁有碍正常航行和了望的灯光外露。 
During night navigation, it is not allowed to reveal any light that will cause obstruction to normal 
navigation and look-out.  
13 
在港期间，驾驶台无人值守时，二副负责将可携带的贵重设备和重要物品妥善保管；
驾驶台所有门窗均应闭锁；未经船长批准，不得允许外来人员参观；如外来人员参观
或检修，应派相关人员陪同。 
In port, when the bridge is left unattended, the Second Officer shall be responsible for properly 
safekeeping valuable devices and important items that are portable. And be sure the doors and windows 
should be locked. Without the Master’s permission, visits are not allowed without master’s permission, 
and relevant personnel shall be dedicated to accompany in case of visits or overhauls.  
14 
值班驾驶员负有维持驾驶台秩序，保持驾驶台的整洁，保证本规则的严格执行的责任。 
The Officers on Watch shall be responsible for maintaining the order of the bridge, keeping the bridge in a 
cleaning and tidy condition, as well as ensuring that these procedures are strictly followed.  
15 
船长根据驾驶台的具体情况，编制“船长常规命令”并张贴在驾驶台，所有驾驶员和
值班水手都要遵守执行。 
The Master shall develop Master’s Standing Orders according to actual situations at the bridge, which 
shall be displayed at the bridge, and must be followed by all officer on watch and watch-keeping seaman. 
16 
根据船长指令呼叫船长。如果需要呼叫船长，特别是在担心船舶安全的情况下，应尽
早让船长有足够的时间了解并有效地应对这种情况。如果不及时呼叫船长，会导致以
下风险的增加: 
Call master according to the master order. If the Master needs to be called, particularly where 
there is concern about the safety of the ship, this should be done early enough to allow the 
Master enough time to understand and respond effectively to the situation.  
Failing to call the Master promptly can lead to an increased level of risk of: 
 碰撞Collision; 
 搁浅Grounding; 
 生命安全Safety of life; 
 环境损害Damage to the environment; 
 船期延迟Ship delays; 
 货物泄漏或溢出Cargo leaks or spills; 
 财产损失Property damage 
 商业损失Commercial losses 
 因延误或损坏而造成的声誉损失Reputation losses due to delays or damage 
17 
呼叫船长并不意味着当班驾驶员不能够处理这种局面，过分自信和一个人出错可能导
致事故。

船长常规命令 
Master’s Standing Orders 
 
1. 作为当班驾驶员，你负责安全航行。在船长接手驾驶台指挥之前，值班驾驶员有全权使
用主机和所有助航仪器、并且为了航行安全呼叫额外值班人员上驾驶台。使用驾驶台检
查表以帮助你采取各项措施。 
As the Officer of the Watch (OOW), you will remain fully responsible for safe navigation at all times and 
shall involve yourself fully and participate in safe navigation of the vessel. Use Bridge Check Lists to 
assist you in your actions. 
2. 你自己必须完全熟悉船舶操纵性能及驾驶台所有设备的正确操作，包括显示和故障报
警。 
You must familiarise yourself fully with the vessel’s manoeuvring characteristics and also the correct 
operation of all equipment on the bridge. This includes displays and fault alarms 
3. 接班之前，你必须核实船位和计划航线，明白船长签发的任何特别指示。 
Before taking over the watch you must review vessel’s position and planned track for your entire watch 
and understand any special orders issued by the Master.  
4. 下面情况就得叫船长： 
Occasions to call the Master: 
  当能见度受到限制时。 
When restricted visibility is encountered of expected. 
  当交通状况、密度或其他船只的移动引起担忧时。 
When traffic conditions, density or the movements of other vessels are causing concern. 
  当收到遇险警报或看到遇险信号时。 
When a distress alert has been received or a distress signal has been sighted. 
  当在保持航线方面遇到困难时。 
When difficulties in maintaining course are experienced. 
  当最近观察到的位置与船舶的预期位置有明显的差异时。 
When there is significant difference between the latest observed position and the 
expected position of the ship. 
  在未能在预期时间内看到陆地、识别航标或获得水深数据的情况下。 
In case of failure to sight land, identify a navigation mark or get soundings by the 
expected time. 
  当意外地看到陆地或航标或水深数据的意外变化时。 
When there is unexpected sighting of land or a navigation mark or unexpected change in 
soundings. 
  当对航行计划的修改需要立即批准时。 
When amendments to the passage plan require immediate approval. 
  当发动机、推进机械遥控装置、舵机或任何重要的航行设备、警报或指示器发生故
障时。 
When there is a breakdown of the engines, propulsion machinery remote control, 
steering gear or any essential navigational equipment, alarm or indicator. 
  当通讯或GMDSS 无线电设备发生故障时。 
When communications or GMDSS radio equipment malfunctions. 
  在恶劣天气下，如果对天气损害的可能性有任何怀疑时。

In heavy weather， if any doubt about the possibility of weather damage. 
  当船舶遇到航行危险，如冰或废弃的船只时。 
When the ship meets hazards to navigation, e.g. ice or a derelict vessel. 
  当对船舶的安全有疑问时。 
When there are concerns about the ship’s security. 
  在任何紧急情况下。 
In any emergency situation. 
  在任何情况下，如果情况超出了值班驾驶员的经验范围，或者对船舶的安全或遵守
法规要求的能力有任何怀疑时。 
In any cases when the situation is beyond the experience of the OOW or if there is any 
doubt about the safety of the ship, or ability to comply with regulatory requirements. 
5. 如果能见距离少于3 海里、或者与他船最近会遇距离少于1 海里，警报给当班轮机员或
轮机长并减速。 
Alert the duty engineer or the Chief Engineer and reduce the ship speed if visibility is less than 3 miles 
and when there is dense traffic with a CPA of less than 1 mile. 
6. 我来到驾驶台并不意味着我已接手指挥。我要接手指挥时，我会清楚地口头通知你（例
如：“现在我来指挥”或者“船舶指挥都归我了”，对此应在航海日志上记上一条）。
你将继续跟踪船舶进程，如有任何紧迫局面正在形成或船舶正在危险地驶近航海危险物
就得通知我。 
My presence on the bridge does not mean that I have taken over command. When I take over command, I 
will inform you clearly and verbally (e.g: “Let me take charge/con now” or “She is all mine” and a log 
book entry should be made). You will continue to track the vessel’s progress and advise me if any close 
quarter situation is developing or the vessel is approaching dangerously close to any navigational hazard 
7. 关于可能有关危险局面的生成，永远不要犹豫的提出你的关注。交互检查驾驶台团队成
员的行动，对所关注的问题开诚布公地予以沟通，就可能会避免“一个人的错误”。也
要指示哪些瞭望人员和舵手不要有官阶距离，要进行开诚布公地沟通。 
You shall not assume that I am fully aware of all hazards and must speak up of your concerns on safe 
navigation and of all potentially dangerous situations developing. Cross Check the bridge team member’s 
action and communicate freely and openly on concerns you may have to avoid “One Man Error”. Instruct 
the lookout and helmsman also to communicate freely and openly without hesitation or holding back. 
8. 永远要采取及早的、大幅度的避让行动。。 
Always take early and substantial action to keep well clear.  
9. VHF 和AIS 设备不应用于避碰目的，覆盖在ECDIS 上的AIS 信息应该用作识别工具，
而不是作为避碰工具。所有航行值班人员应注意本章体系文件SHIP-01-05 描述的风险。 
The VHF and AIS facility should not be used for collision avoidance purpose. AIS information overlaid on 
ECDIS should be used as an identification tool and not as a collision avoidance tool. All navigation 
watch-keeping officers on shall ware the risks described in section 5 Bridge Regulations SHIP-01-05. 
10. 以较大的最近会遇距离CPA 通过他船和以较大的安全界限远离危险物永远是最好的。
这样就可以应对比如舵机、主机和电力失灵的紧急情况。 
A Larger CPA from passing traffic and Safety Margin from navigational hazards is always better. This 
allows for managing emergencies such as steering, engine and power failures. 
11. 在开阔海域，必须与其它船舶保持至少2.0 海里CPA。对于沿海水域，必须保持1 海里
的CPA。如果上述局面无法保持，应立即叫船长上驾驶台。 
In open seas, where sufficient sea room is available a minimum CPA of 2.0 nautical miles 
must be maintained from other vessels. For coastal waters, a minimum CPA of 1 nautical

called to the bridge immediately. 
12. 禁止当班驾驶员在驾驶台进行不必要的文件工作和通信（与安全航行和GMDSS 值守无
关的）。 
Non-navigational paperwork and communications (not related to the safe navigation and GMDSS watch). 
13. 航行值班时，负责航行指挥的驾驶员严禁使用手机和个人电子设备，除非为了船舶安全
航行需要并得到船长的许可或者有其它驾驶员接替他的航行值班职责时。 
During the navigational watch, the Officer-of-the watch in charge of the navigational command is strictly 
prohibited from using mobile phones and personal electronic devices, unless for the safety of navigation 
and with the permission of the master or when another Officer takes over his navigational watch duties. 
14.  航行值班时，禁止上网和收发邮件操作，除非这种操作是下班之后或者是了船舶航行
安全需要并得到船长的许可，且仅限于下列情况：： 
During the navigational watch, Internet access and e-mail operations are prohibited unless such operations 
are out of duty hours or when necessary for the safety of the ship's navigation and approved by the master, 
and are limited to the following situations: 
a) 接收海图和出版物、执照和许可证的更新； 
Updates for nautical charts and publications, licences and permits 
b) 接收天气信息； 
Weather information. 
c) 接收航行警告； 和 
Navigational warnings; and 
d) 接收与船舶运营和航次计划相关的信息。 
Information relevant to the ship’s operations and passage plan 
16. 任何时候都要保持视觉和听觉瞭望，以便有良好的“情景意识”。从日落到日出，驾驶
台团队必须包括当班驾驶员和一个瞭望人员。当瞭望人员经常用来操舵时，呼叫一个额
外的瞭望人员。在能见度受到限制或交通密集期间，必须呼叫船长以增强驾驶台团队。 
At all times keep a good "situational awareness" by maintaining a visual and auditory outlook. The bridge 
team must include the on-duty officer and a lookout from sunset to sunrise. An extra lookout must be 
called when the lookout is often used to steer. The captain must be called to strengthen the bridge team 
during periods of restricted visibility or heavy traffic. 
17. 如果有任何原因你发现你的接班者不适宜接班，应叫我、并继续保持值守直到我来接替
你。永远不要把班交给受到酒精影响的人。 
If for any reason your reliever is found unfit for taking over watch, call me and continue to remain on 
watch till I relieve you. Never hand over the watch to a person under the influence of alcohol. 
18. 如果关键情况下收到卫星或高频电话呼叫，应礼貌地告诉呼叫方我们正忙于操纵船舶，
叫他们等会在打过来。除非船舶已经安全靠泊了，否则不得在驾驶台使用手机。 
If there are Inmarsat or non-navigational VHF calls during critical situations - tell the calling party politely 
that we are busy with manoeuvring and ask them to call back. Nothing is more important than Safe 
Navigation, No Use of Mobile phones on bridge. 
19. 自动雷达标绘ARPA 为避碰目的使用时、应设置“对水速度”，为抛锚目的使用时、应
设置“对地速度”。 
The ARPA should be set for “Speed through the water” for collision avoidance and to “Speed over the 
ground” for anchoring。 
20. 值班驾驶员注意，ECDIS 目前是主要的导航模式，但是如果航程涉及任何纸质海图，
则需要清楚地识别从 ENC 到纸质海图的过渡。 不要仅仅依赖 ECDIS。 作为谨慎的
航海人员，应保持态势感知。

Reasonable setting of display modes and layer in accordance with the requirements of the Change Over of 
Bridge Watch Checklist SHIP-03-02-03. The alarms and parameters setting of ECDIS should be handed 
over by each officer during change of watch. 
 
如果你需要与我联系又不能用电话和我联系上，就拉响总警报一短声。当船员在甲板

候都得有一个驾驶员在驾驶台上。 
If you need to contact me and are not able to contact me on the phone, make one short ring on General

第06 节 机舱规则 
Section 06 Engine Room Rules 
 
1. 机舱是船舶动力中心，除船长、轮机长和轮机部工作人员外，其他人员非工作需要不
得随意进入。未经船长、轮机长许可，不准带领非本轮人员进入。 
Engine room is the propulsion center of the ship, and persons with non-working purposes are not allowed 
to enter without permission, except the Master, the Chief Engineer and the staff of the Engine Department. 
Without permission from the Master and the Chief Engineer, it is not allowed to bring any non-shipboard 
person into the engine room.  
2. 在机舱值班和工作的人员要严格遵守劳动纪律和各项操作规程，不得打闹和高声喧哗；
禁止吸烟、喝酒，不准做与值班无关的事情。 
Crew on watch-keeping or working in the engine room shall strictly follow working disciplines and all 
operation procedures, and it is prohibited to quarrel and fight noisily, smoke, drink or do anything not 
relevant to watch-keeping.  
3. 人员进入机舱，必须穿好工作服，工作鞋，戴安全帽；如必要，戴防护耳罩（塞）等。
严禁任何人赤膊或穿拖鞋进入机舱。 
Any one entering the engine room must be dressed in working suits, shoes and safety helmet, and if 
necessary, earplugs are also required. It is prohibited for any one who is bare to the chest or wearing 
slippers to enter the engine room.  
4. 机舱内各种机电设备除紧急情况外，未经轮机长、主管人员或值班轮机员的同意，不
得任意启动，不准拨弄各种报警装置、开关和阀门。 
Unless under emergency circumstances, it is not allowed to start any mechanical and electrical equipment 
in the engine room, or fiddle with any alarm device, switch or valve, without permission from the Chief 
Engineer or engineer in charge or Duty Engineer.  
5. 值班期间，值班轮机员严禁使用手机和个人电子设备，除非为了航行安全并得到轮机
长的许可或者有其它轮机员接替他的值班职责时。 
During the watch, the engineer on duty is strictly prohibited from using mobile phones and personal 
electronic devices, unless for the safety of navigation and with the permission of the chief engineer or 
when another engineer takes over his duty. 
6. 值班期间，禁止上网和收发邮件操作，除非这种操作是在下班之后或者是为了船舶航
行安全需要并得到轮机长的许可，且仅限于下列情况： 
During the watch, Internet access and e-mail operations are prohibited unless such operations are out of 
duty hours or when necessary for the safety of the ship's navigation and approved by the chief engineer, 
and are limited to the following situations: 
1) 更新PMS,执照和许可证； 
Updates to the PMS, licenses and permits; 
2) 由轮机长酌情决定的有关技术事项、规则和条例的附加信息； 
Additional information on technical matters, rules and regulations, at the Chief Engineer’s discretion; 
3) 机舱人员计算机形式的培训； 和

4) 与驾驶台和船上其他部门的基本沟通，以及岸上技术支持（如主管和设备供应商服
务技术人员）。 
Essential communication with the bridge and other departments on the ship, and shore-based technical 
support (such as superintendents and equipment supplier service technicians). 
7. 机舱内各场所和各种设备要经常保持清洁；工具、备件、物料要放在指定地点，标志
明显，整齐堆放、固定。 
All places and equipment in the engine room shall be kept in a clean condition frequently, and tools, stores 
and spare parts shall be placed at designated areas in an orderly and secured manner and with clear 
identifications. 
8. 每次检修完毕要将现场收拾干净，把工具及剩余物料放回原处。废旧的油污棉纱、破
布不准乱丢，要集中放在指定的铁箱（桶）内，定期焚烧处理或依据防污染的有关规
定进行处理。 
Upon completion of each repair and overhaul, the site must cleaned up with used tools and remaining 
stores returned to their original positions. Used oily cotton yarn and wiping rags are not allowed to litter, 
and shall be collected into dedicated metal containers (barrels), and disposed by incineration on regular 
basis or according to relevant pollution prevention requirements.  
9. 机炉舱的照明，尤其是通道、紧急出口、各操纵场所、主要设备监测仪表等处的照明
必须经常保持良好。不得在机炉舱内晾晒衣服被褥等物。 
Engine and boiler rooms shall be always kept in a well-illuminated condition, especially at passageways, 
emergency exits, all operation places, main equipment monitoring instruments and etc. Air drying of 
clothes, beddings and etc. in the engine and boiler rooms is not allowed. 
10. 要保持机舱的通道、上下梯口、应急逃生通道的畅通，无遮挡和阻碍物，标识清楚。
通往机舱的管子弄水密门或道门航行中要保持关闭。吊装天窗、道门使用后及时关闭。 
Access to the engine room, gangway port and emergency escape exits must be kept in a clear and 
unblocked condition, with clear and obvious identifications. The watertight doors or access doors of the 
pipe tunnels leading to the engine room shall remain closed during navigation. Skylights for hoisting and 
manholes are to be closed after use in a timely manner. 
11. 易燃、易爆、易挥发或易腐蚀的物品严格按照MSDS 说明要求进行存放，酸性化学品和
碱性化学品分开存放，化学品的存贮应远离油漆和润滑油。易燃、易爆、易挥发或易
腐蚀的物品要妥善存贮在通风良好和安全的专用仓库（室）内或其它安全可靠地方。
应在明显位置显示操作说明和危险警告，备妥适当的人员保护装置 
Items that are flammable, explosive, volatile or easily corrosive shall be stored in strict accordance with 
the MSDS instructions, acidic chemicals and alkaline chemicals are stored separately, the storage of 
chemicals should be away from paint and lubricating oil. That should be stored in a well-ventilated and 
safe dedicated stores (or rooms) or other safe and reliable places. Operating instructions and hazard 
warnings shall be displayed in a prominent position, and appropriate personnel protection devices shall be 
prepared. 
12. 机舱通道控制要执行船舶《保安计划》中的有关规定。

Access to the engine room shall be controlled according to relevant requirements specified in the Ship’s

13. 有关人员如果因传达领导指示或联系工作，要到机舱与值班人员当面讲清或用电话通
知，不准在高处大声呼喊。 
If relevant personnel needs to convey instructions from the top management or to liaise for work, such 
person shall have a face to face talk clearly with the watch-keeping person by going to the engine room or 
notify the person on duty with telephone. It is not allowed to shout at a higher place. 
14. 船舶发出各种应变警报信号后，轮机部船员除应变部署表有职责者按规定执行外，其
余人员要一律迅速进入机舱听候轮机长或值班轮机员的指挥。 
When all sorts of emergency alarms are sounded on board the ship, except those who should assume and 
fulfill any duty as specified in the Muster List, all other personnel in the Engine Department shall quickly 
get into the engine room, and follow the command of the Chief Engineer or the Duty Engineer. 
15. 如果有外来人员在机舱工作时，要指派专人监修和配合。 
If there are external personnel working in the engine room, dedicated personnel shall be delegated to 
supervise the repair work and provide cooperation. 
16. 机舱需要明火作业，按照《热工作业的安全规定》有关须知执行。 
In case that working with naked fire is required in the engine room, such work shall be carried out in 
accordance with relevant instructions specified in the Hot Work Safety Regulations. 
17. 如果非本轮人员因为参观或对机舱内设备进行检查、测量、试验需要进机舱，必须经
轮机长许可，由主管人员陪同，并要通知值班人员。 
If, due to visit or inspection, measurement or test of equipment in the engine room, personnel not 
belonging to the ship need to get into the engine room, such person shall be accompanied by a responsible 
person, with permission obtained from the Chief Engineer first, and should notify the personnel on duty. 
18. 应急发电机室等装有机电设备的专用舱室均被视为机舱的延伸部分，应执行本规则的
规定。 
Dedicated machinery rooms, where mechanic and electrical equipment such as emergency generators are 
installed, shall be considered as the extension of the engine room, and in which requirements specified 
under these rules shall be followed. 
19. 机舱值班安排表，参考《SHIP-05-01 航行制度和航次计划》。 
Watch arrangement of engine room, refer to the SHIP-05-01 Navigation Regulation and Voyage Plan. 
20. 无人机舱值班，参考《SHIP-06-14 无人值班机舱船舶的值班规定》。 
Watch of unmanned machinery space, refer to the SHIP-06-14 Duty Regulation for UMS Ships. 
21. 轮机长根据机舱的实际情况，编制“轮机长命令”,并张贴在机舱集控室，所有机舱人
员都要遵照执行。 
The Chief Engineer shall, according to actual situations, prepare the Chief Engineer’s Orders, which shall 
be posted in the Engine Control Room, and followed by all personnel in the engine room.  
22. 机舱应急处理Engine Room emergency Treatment 
22.1 
曲拐箱爆炸Crankcase Explosion 
在一台运转的柴油机里，曲拐箱内或者临近曲拐箱的地方产生热点或者过热导致曲拐

箱爆炸，因为热点，流经此处的滑油汽化，油蒸汽循环到曲拐箱较冷的部位冷凝后析
出的油滴与空气充分混合形成油雾，如果油雾比例恰当，遇到热源，将被点燃，发生
初次爆炸，爆炸导致曲拐箱内压力突升，引起第二次爆炸，如果没有装设安全阀，爆
炸将掀开曲拐箱道门，初次爆炸形成的真空吸引周围的空气进入曲拐箱，与正在燃烧
的油与油蒸汽混合导致灾难性的二次爆炸。爆炸引起曲拐箱道门破裂甚至对主机内部
产生严重损害 
The initiation of a crankcase explosion is a 'hot spot' or overheated part within or adjacent to the crank 
case of an operating engine. Due to the 'hot spot', the lube oil coming in contact with it gets evaporated. 
The evaporated oil circulates to the cooler parts of the crankcase and there it condenses forming a mist of 
finely divided oil particles well mixed with air. If this mist having right proportion of air circulates back to 
the hot spot, it will be ignited and a primary explosion occurs. The explosion may cause considerable 
pressure rise in the crankcase causing secondary explosion and blow off the crankcase doors if crankcase 
relief valves are not fitted and the vacuum which follows the primary explosion will draw the atmospheric 
air into the crankcase where it will mix with evaporated and burning oil to cause a catastrophic secondary 
explosion. The explosion will rupture the crankcase doors and even cause heavy damage to the inside of 
the engine. 
 
如下的结果引起曲拐箱产生热源： 
Hot spots are created in the crankcase as a result of the following: 
1) 活塞吹下的可燃气体或火星进入曲拐箱。 
Hot combustion gas or sparks from piston blow past entering crankcase 
2) 相邻扫气箱发生火灾导致活塞杆、隔板发热。 
Fires in the adjacent scavenge trunks resulting in heating of diaphragm, piston rod, etc. 
3) 由于滑油供应失败或者供应量不足，在曲拐箱轴承、活塞杆填料函、定时链条等处
产生摩擦热导致温度升高。 
Increase in temperature of parts due to frictional heat generated at the crankcase bearings, pistonrod 
glands, timing chain, etc. due to inadequate or failure of L.O. supply. 
4) 轴承与其他运动部件间隙不足。 
Inadequate clearance between bearings and other moving parts. 
5) 柴油机长时间过载 
Prolonged overloading of engine. 
6) 由于滑油里混有燃油导致滑油闪点降低。 
Reduction of flash point of crankcase oil due to contamination with fuel. 
22.1.1 曲拐箱爆炸的征兆Indication of crankcase explosion 
很难获取曲拐箱爆炸的早期信号，但是通过在机舱里谨慎的观察能够获得少量预爆炸
信号，曲拐箱爆炸将导致： 
It is difficult to read the early signs of crankcase explosions but there are few pre-explosion signs that can 
be read by an alert watch keeper in engine room. Crankcase explosion will lead to: 
1) 排气温度突然升高Sudden increase in the exhaust temperature

2) 柴油机负载突然升高Sudden increase in the load on the engine 
3) 柴油机不规则运转Irregular running of the engine 
4) 柴油机发出奇怪的声音Incongruous noise of the engine 
5) 有气味的白色油雾Smell of the white mist. 
22.1.2 探测到热点后采取的行动Actions after detecting hot spot 
1) 降低柴油机速度以便减少产生热量Reduce the engine speed to reduce heat generation. 
2) 给运动部件表面增加滑油供应量Increase lubrication to the running surfaces. 
3) 远离曲拐箱道门避免受伤，准备好灭火器材，打开天窗。 
Keep clear off crankcase doors to prevent personnel injury, keep fire extinguisher ready and open 
skylight. 
4) 通知驾驶台，停主机，打开示功阀，合上盘车机转车，用滑油不断循环预防柴油机
咬死。 
Inform bridge, stop engine, open indicator cocks, engage turning gear and turn the engine with lube 
oil circulation continuing to prevent engine seizure. 
5) 三十分钟或者更长时间后，当柴油机有效冷却后，停滑油泵打开曲拐箱道门。 
After about 30 minutes or more, when the engine is sufficiently cooled down, stop lube oil pumps 
and open crank case door. 
6)  通过观察和探摸尝试着定位热点Try to locate the hot spot by observation and feeling over. 
7) 一旦定位了热点，为了预防再次发生，要做永久性修理。 
Once the hot spot is located, permanent repair must be carried out in order to prevent recurrence. 
8) 全面检查曲拐箱记录曲拐箱拐档差 
Inspect crankcase thoroughly and record crankshaft deflection. 
9) 启动滑油泵检查所有部件的滑油量是否恰当 
Start lube oil pump and check for proper lubrication of all parts. 
10) 如果所有都正常，通知驾驶台，启动主机，逐渐加速到正常转速。 
If everything is normal, inform bridge, start the engine, and gradually increase the speed. 
22.1.3 预防Prevention 
通过预防产生热点和其它检查能够预防曲拐箱爆炸，描述如下： 
Prevention of crankcase explosion can be done by preventing the generation of hot spots and other checks 
as stated below: 
1) 往复运动部件提供恰当润滑，避免高温。 
By providing proper lubrication to the reciprocating parts, thus avoiding high temperatures. 
2) 避免柴油机过载。Avoiding overloading of the engine. 
3) 使用白合金轴承避免温度升高 
Using bearings with white metal material which prevents rise in temperature. 
4) 确保柴油机充分冷却Ensure adequate cooling of the engine 
5) 确保滑油适当分离和化验分析。Ensure proper purification and analysis of lube oil 
6) 按计划表更换和清洁滑油滤器 
Lube oil filter should be changed over and cleaned as per schedule

7) 通过扫或排气孔检查活塞、活塞环和缸套保持适当润滑。 
Ensure proper cylinder lubrication by checking the condition of piston, piston rings and liner through 
scavenge or exhaust ports 
8) 按计划表清洁扫气箱，并定期放残。 
Clean scavenge spaces as per schedule and drain scavenge space regularly 
9) 保持盘根箱格栅处于良好状态。Maintain stuffing box gland in good condition 
10) 定期进行检查测试曲拐箱油雾探测器，确保其功能正常； 
Check and test the crankcase oil mist detector regularly to make sure it is functioning normally. 
11) 曲拐箱上应安装压力安全阀及时释放压力。应对它们进行周期性的压力测试。
Pressure relief valves should be fixed on the crankcase for the instant release of pressure. They 
should be periodically pressure tested. 
12) 压力安全阀装有钢丝网预防释放的火焰进入机舱。 
Pressure relief valves should be provided with wire mesh to prevent the release of flames inside the 
engine room. 
13) 曲拐箱道门由结实而又坚固的材料制成，透气孔不能太大，不能堵塞任何东西。
Crankcase doors should be made of strong and durable material. Vent pipes shouldn't be too large and 
should be checked for any choke up. 
14) 如果安全阀有轻微跳动迹象，请与曲拐箱保持安全距离。 
Safe distance should be kept from the crankcase and the relief valves in case the indications are 
sighted. 
15) 灭火介质保持备用状态，在很多系统里，惰性气体覆盖系统直接与曲拐箱连接。 
Fire extinguishing medium should be kept standby. In many systems, inert gas flooding system is 
directly connected to the crankcase. 
16)  曲拐箱里任何异常噪音都要警惕和消除。 
Be alert and rectify for any abnormal noise in crankcase. 
17) 柴油机所有安全警报和脱扣装置进行测试直至满意。 
All safety alarms and trips fitted on engine to be tried out satisfactorily. 
18) 值守和保持所有运转机构的温度和压力 
Proper watch on all running gears temperature and pressures to be maintained. 
19) 按照说明书的要求定期吹通油雾探测器的取样管 
Blow through all sampling tubes of Oil Mist Detector (OMD) regularly as per maker’s instructions. 
20) 定期检查和校正油雾探测器的灵敏度和零位。 
Zero adjustment and sensitivity of OMD to be checked regularly 
21) 检查曲拐箱安全阀上的任何泄露，用手或者工具（如果有）检查安全阀的有效性
Check for any oil leakage at crankcase relief doors and check for the operation by hand or tool (if 
provided)

扫气箱着火Scavenge Fire 
当柴油机气缸内过热的燃气和扫气箱内的油渣汇聚时，将会发生扫气箱着火。 
Scavenge fires occur when oil and carbon particles from the engine cylinder accumulates in the scavenge

space. 
下面是可能发生扫气箱着火的征兆，值班人员保持警惕，能注意到这些征兆。 
Following are some signs of a possible scavenge fire. These symptoms can be noticed if the watch keeper 
is alert all the time. 
1) 突然失去动力和排温升高。 
A sudden loss of power and high exhaust temperatures 
2) 扫气空气温度升高。 
High scavenge air temperatures 
3) 柴油机运转异常或者排除过量的废气。 
Irregularity in the running of the engine or excessive gases in the exhaust 
4) 扫气箱着火也导致严重的增压器喘振，有火星从扫气箱放残管喷出。 
Scavenge fires also leads to heavy surging of turbochargers and sparks from the scavenge drains. 
5) 通常烟囱里冒黑烟和火星。 
Unusual smoke or sparks from the funnel. 
22.2.1 扫气箱着火的原因Causes of scavenge fire 
1) 由于活塞环漏泄、粘着、缸套过度磨损、不当的气缸润滑或者活塞环天地间隙不够
都能引起燃烧产物吹入扫气箱。 
Blow past of combustion products caused by leaky, sticky or broken piston rings, worn out liner, 
faulty cylinder lubrication, or insufficient axial clearance of the piston rings. 
2) 雾化不良，喷油压力错误，喷油定时错误，压缩压力损失，柴油机过载，冷却循环
失效或因结垢引起冷却不良导致过热的活塞传递热量至活塞下部。 
Overheated piston dissipates heat to the under piston area caused by faulty atomization and injection 
pressure, faulty fuel pump timing, loss of compression, engine overload, failure of coolant 
circulation or insufficient cooling due to formation of scale. 
3) 排气背压或者排气孔脏污，透平进口、叶片脏污，废气锅炉或者废气节能器脏堵都
导致废气倒灌。 
Blow back of exhaust gases caused by exhaust back pressure or deposits on exhaust ports, fouling of 
grid before turbine inlet, fouling of turbine blades, choking of Exhaust Gas Boiler or economizer gas 
outlet. 
4) 由于喷油器缺陷，不正确地设定喷油压力或者燃油过度喷入致使燃油附着在缸套
上，都使扫气箱里出现燃油。 
Presence of fuel oil in the scavenge spaces due to defective fuel injectors, incorrect pressure setting 
of injectors or fuel particles landing on the cylinder liner due to excessive penetration. 
5) 过量的气缸润滑油进入扫气箱。 
Excessive cylinder lubrication which is drained down to scavenge spaces. 
6) 扫气总管脏污。Fouled scavenge manifold. 
7) 缸套内部缺陷 Defects in cylinder liner. 
22.2.2 采取的行动Actions to be taken 
如果注意到以上任何一个问题或者怀疑已经发生扫气箱着火，立即通知船长/轮机长，

不要对出现的情形恐慌，当采取正确的措施时，注意两个目标： 
If any of the above is noticed or there is a suspicion that a scavenge fire might have started, the first thing 
is to inform Master / Chief Engineer and not to panic about the situation. While taking corrective actions 
two objectives must be kept in mind: 
1) 着火遏制在扫气箱内To contain the fire within the scavenge space 
2) 防止对主机的损坏或者把损坏降低到最小 
To prevent or minimize damage to the main engine 
采取以下步骤Following are the steps to be taken: 
1) 通知驾驶台，降低柴油机转速。Inform bridge and reduce the speed of the engine 
2) 切断受影响气缸的燃油供给，关闭阀门。 
Cut off fuel supply to the affected unit and shut off valves. 
3) 增大气缸油供应Cylinder lubrication must be increased. 
4) 保持缸套和活塞的冷却介质供应。Coolant flow through jacket and piston to be maintained. 
5) 稍微关闭扫气箱放残阀，避免火星窜入机舱。 
The scavenge drains should be tightly shut to prevent flow of spark in engine room. 
6) 一旦柴油机停下来，打开示功考克，合上盘车机转车预防咬缸。 
Once engine is stopped open indicator cocks, engage turning gear and turn engine to prevent engine 
seizure. 
7) 关闭柴油机前扫气空气管路上的阀门，增压器空气吸口用帆布覆盖避免空气进入。 
Scavenge air duct flap valve before engine to be shut. The turbocharger air suction can be covered to 
prevent air ingress into the engine. 
8) 监视扫气箱的温度。Monitor temperature of the scavenge spaces. 
9) 对扫气箱周围冷却。Boundary cooling of scavenge spaces may be carried out. 
10) 为了灭火，二氧化碳、干粉、蒸汽或者窒息用的CO2 都可以供给扫气箱。 
In order to extinguish the fire carbon dioxide, dry powder, steam or CO2 smothering etc. (as 
applicable to the vessel) may be supplied to the trunking. 
11) 应该保持警惕不要试图打开扫气箱，这样可能导致扫气箱爆炸。 
It should be kept in mind that no attempts are made to open the scavenge trunk as it may lead to a 
severe explosion 
12) 远离扫气箱安全阀（如果有）以防伤人。 
Keep clear of scavenge space relief valve (if fitted) to prevent injury to personnel. 
22.2.3 扫气箱着火的预防Prevention of scavenge fire 
由于预防总比纠正好，那么使用一些预防措施有助于确保扫气箱不再着火，或者至少
最大程度降低发生的几率。 
Since prevention is always better than cure, a few simple steps would help to ensure that a scavenge fire 
never occurs on the ship or at least minimizes the chances of its development. Here are these simple tips 
on avoiding scavenge fires. 
1) 保持扫气箱和扫气口清洁 
Scavenge trunking and scavenge ports should be kept clean 

78

机舱规则 
Engine Room Rules 
版本/修改：3.0/4.0

2) 检查活塞环、缸套、活塞裙和水封无缺陷 
Piston rings, cylinder liner, piston skirt and the water seals should be inspected for any defect. 
3) 恰当地紧固贯穿螺栓预防柴油机晃动 
Vibration of the engine should be prevented by tightening the tie bolts properly. 
4) 避免气缸过度润滑 
Excess cylinder lubrication must be avoided 
5) 如果采用定时润滑，必须按照PMS 要求检查定时机构 
In case of timed lubrication, the time has to be checked as per PMS. 
6) 保持活塞环充足的润滑和适当的保养 
Piston rings must be properly maintained and lubricated adequately. 
7) 维护好活塞杆填料环避免滑油进入扫气箱 
Piston rod stuffing box must be maintained to prevent oil ingress in the scavenge space. 
8) 避免柴油机超期运行或者任何气缸超载 
Prolonged engine or any cylinder over loading to be avoided 
9) 缸套的磨损必须在允许的限度内 
Cylinder liner wear must be within admissible limits 
10) 实施扫气箱的循环检查和维护 
Routine inspection and maintenance of the trunk should be carried out 
11) 清除没有燃烧的残油和结碳 
The unburned oil and carbon particles should be removed from the trunk 
12) 定期对扫气箱放残和清通放残管路 
Scavenge drains should be drained and cleaned periodically to prevent choke up 
13) 有定期地测试压力安全阀（如果有） 
Pressure relief valves (if fitted) should also be tested on regular basis 
14) 为了保持较低的排气阻力，保护格栅、喷嘴环、透平叶片不允许有太多的结垢.   
To keep the exhaust resistance low, heavy deposit must not be allowed to collect on the protective grating, 
nozzle rings, and turbine blades.   
15) 如果低负荷运转时辅助鼓风机没有启动，没有燃烧的燃油将积存在活塞的顶部，这
将带来扫气箱着火的风险。 
If auxiliary blower does not start during low load running, un-burnt fuel may accumulate on top of pistons, 
which will involve risk of scavenge air box fire. 
22.3 
废气锅炉（节能器）着火Exhaust gas boilers（Economizer）Fire 
由于潜在损害，废气锅炉烟灰着火意味着巨大风险，像没有充分传热，烟灰积存，烟
灰发热，烟灰中附着火星，烟道废气流速等各种因素造成烟灰着火。 
Soot-fire accidents in exhaust gas boiler represent a major risk due to the potential damage. Various factors 
such as inadequate heat transfer, soot deposit, soot calorific value, spark load, and flue gas velocity 
contribute to the start of a soot-fire. 
1) 近段时间增多的烟灰着火次数通常与较差的燃油质量有关，经常与所加装的低等燃
油质量有关 。

The increased number of soot fires in recent times is related to the general poorer fuel quality and often 
linked to a specific low-grade bunker. 
2) 使用的低档燃油越多导致烟灰着火次数也越多，正在不断增长的长冲程柴油机 ，
由于使用的较多润滑油易产生烟灰 
The increasing use of low-grade fuel results in higher soot levels. The growing number of long stroke 
diesel engines, which calls for larger quantities of lubrication oil, also adds to the soot build-up. 
3) 另一个原因就是主机停车后循环水泵没有有效地运转 
Another cause may be that the circulating pump is not operated sufficiently after M/E operation stop. 
4) 柴油机的燃油没有充分燃烧，增加了烟灰的热值。 
Inadequate combustion of fuel in the engine can lead to fuel carry over, thus increasing the calorific value 
of soot. 
5) 如果不调整清洁周期将增加烟灰着火的风险 
If the cleaning intervals are not adjusted accordingly this will increase the soot fire risk. 
这种火灾发展的三个步骤：Such a fire may develop in three steps: 
1) 烟灰燃烧，热量积聚  
Soot burning and heat accumulation 
2) 产生蒸汽，蒸汽闭锁，热交换失灵 
Steam build-up, steam blockage, and loss of heat exchange 
3) 表面高温氧化，EGE 熔化 
High temperature oxidation of surfaces and meltdown of the EGE 
当怀疑节能器着火时，采取下面的步骤 
When fire in the economizer is suspected, following action to be taken 
1) 降低主机转速或者停主机（如果航行条件允许）进而停止供空气 
Reduce RPM or stop the main engine (If navigation circumstances permit) to stop oxygen supply to the 
fire. 
2) 不要停止热水循环泵的运转否则你将熔化整个节能器 
Do NOT stop the circulating pumps or you might melt the whole economizer. 
3) 对外围进行冷却 
Arrange for boundary cooling. 
4) 因为有氧气供应所以禁止使用吹灰器灭火，高温火灾有产生蒸汽的风险，喷射蒸汽
可能导致氢燃烧 
Never use soot blowers for fire fighting, as air will feed the fire with oxygen, and steam will involve a risk 
of high temperature fire. Injecting steam might result in a secondary hydrogen fire. 
5) 停止整台柴油机的空气循环，对柴油机排气阀关闭用的气源保持正常压力，用帆布
覆盖透平的空气滤网，停鼓风机，采取其他适当的措施。 
Stop the air circulation through the engine, and thereby the air supply to the fire, i.e. keep air pressure on 
the diesel engine’s exhaust valve closing mechanism (closed valves), cover the air filter of the 
turbocharger, stop the auxiliary blower, and any other appropriate action. 
6) 如果安装有水洗系统也可以用来灭火，水洗系统正常连接在船舶的消防系统里

Water washing, if fitted, may be used to extinguish the fire. This is normally connected to the ship’s fire 
fighting water system. 
在一个运转良好的系统里，任何火灾刚开始都是零星的，如果迅速采取以上的应急措
施可以迅速灭火，热水循环泵使热水循环有助于冷却水管，减少火灾带来的热损失 
In a well-run plant any fire that starts will be small, and if the above emergency action is taken 
immediately, the fire will be damped down quickly, and water circulated by the pump will help keep the 
tubes cool and reduce any heat damage caused by the fire. 
22.3.1 节能器着火的预防Prevention of economizer fires 
1) 主机停车后继续保持循环水泵运转，冷却加热管。 
Operate the circulating pump sufficiently after M/E operation stops to cool down the heating tubes. 
2) 为了避免在管壁上积聚烟灰，每天吹灰两到三次，应该采用适当的方法吹灰确保管
壁清洁 。 
To prevent the soot from adhering and growing up on the tubes, soot blowing must be carried out two to 
three times in a day. Soot blowing should be done in proper way to ensure tubes are being cleaned 
properly. 
3) 定期清洗节能器清除烟灰，如果清洗效果不佳，没有燃烧的烟灰很容易着火。  
Periodic water washing of economizers must be carried out to remove the soot.   If the water cleaning is 
insufficient, the unburned soot is easily catch fire. 
4) 为了预防烟灰着火，最有效的措施就是预防形成烟灰，这意味着主机燃烧保持最佳
状态 
For soot fire prevention, the most effective measure is to prevent formation of soot. This means optimum 
M/E combustion. 
无论如何，考虑到柴油机使用燃油质量，不能避免产生烟灰，因此最可能实施的方法
中，坚持清除烟灰很重要。 
However, soot cannot be prevented considering the quality of the fuel used in the marine diesel engines. 
Therefore, it is important to remove the adhered soot in the best possible manner. 
22.4 
主机启动空气管爆炸Main Engine Starting Air Line Explosion 
主启动空气管是高压系统，空气管里的油迹是着火的潜在因素，启动空气管内绝对不
允许油类聚集。 
This is high pressure system. A trace of oil in air system makes it a potential for fire. Oil should never be 
allowed to accumulate in the line. 
22.4.1 预防措施 Precautions to be taken 
空压机油水分离器和空气管滤器要保证正常工作，不能有油随空气转运到空气启动管 
Drain traps of air compressor and line filters should be working properly. No oil carry over should take 
place. 
1) 按照PMS 要求维护气缸气动阀，不能有燃烧的废气进入空气启动管线。 
Unit starting valves should be maintenance as per PMS. No combustion gases should pass into starting 
line air. 
2) 启动空气爆破片应按照PMS 的要求维护

任何轮机员都必须仔细阅读轮机长的常规命令和夜航命令并执行； 
Any engineer should read carefully and comply with the Standing Orders and Night Orders of the Chief

夜间值班轮机员应确保警报的正确设置和操作，任何的偏差应立即报告轮机长；

3. 
值班轮机员是轮机长的代表，首要职责是确保主推进装置和付机的安全和经济运转； 
The Duty Engineer is Chief Engineer’s representative and his primary responsibility is to ensure the 
safe and economical operation of the main propulsion machinery and auxiliaries.  
4. 
值班轮机员主要职责是操作机械装置的安全且处于良好状态并确保船上人命安全、货
物、船舶和机器的安全； 
The main duty of the Duty Engineer is to operate the engine plant in a manner that ensures the safety of 
life onboard, the cargo, the vessel and the machinery. Revolutions and power setting indicated by the 
chief engineer must be maintained. 
5. 
船舶在海上时，轮机员值班地点是机舱，除非是轮机长同意，或其他轮机员接班，在

The engineer is on duty in the engine room whilst navigation. He does not leave his station on any 
situation, unless instructed to do so by the chief engineer or he is properly relieved by another engineer. 
He is responsible for the prompt answering of the telephone and telegraph.

Engineer’s discretion;

第07 节 船舶海事处理规则 
Section 07 Rules for Handling Maritime Accident 
 
1.0 船舶发生海事时，应执行本须知。 
In the event of a maritime accident, these instructions shall be followed.  
2.0 船长编写海事报告或海事声明的主要内容： 
The Master shall prepare the following main content of the Maritime Accident Report or the Note of 
Sea Protest:  
2.1 船名、船东、国籍及船籍港、航次、出发港和目的港。 
Name of ship, shipowner, nationality and port of registry, voyage number, port of departure and port of 
destination. 
2.2 事故发生的时间、位置、吃水。 
Date/time, position and draft of the ship when the accident occurred.  
2.3 航向、航速，如属碰撞还应有双方的相对位置和交换的信息以及对方船的船名、船东、
管理公司、国籍、船舶保险人、保赔协会以及船籍港、航次、货物、出发港和目的港。 
Course and speed of the ship, in the event of a collision accident, relevant locations of and information 
exchanged between both ships, and the opposing part ship’s name, shipowner, management company, 
nationality, insurer, P&I club, as well as port of registry, voyage number, cargoes carried, port of 
departure and port of destination. 
2.4 天气、风向风速、流向流速、潮汐情况、视程。 
Weather, wind speed and direction, current speed and direction, tide condition, visual range. 
2.5 船体周围的水深、底质、潮差和搁浅时间及当时的潮高。 
Water depth around the ship, nature of bottom, tidal range, time of stranding, and tide height when the 
accident occurred.  
2.6 为减少风浪冲击所采取的各种调整航速、航向的措施。 
Adjust the ship’s speed and course as necessary to minimise stress on the vessel’s hull. 
2.7 事故发生的原因和经过情况。 
Root cause and process of the accident. 
2.8 船体、设备、机件、属具等损坏情况。 
Damage of hull, equipments, mechanical parts, belongs etc. 
2.9 货物受损情况。 
Damages to cargoes. 
2.10 人员伤亡及抢救措施。 
Casualties and first aid measures. 
2.11 漏油、污染等情况。 
Presence of oil spillage, pollution etc. 
3.0 检验和出证： 
Survey and Issuance of Certificate:  
3.1 因海事而遭受损坏或构成是否适航问题时，船管部应申请船级社验船师对受损部位进
行检验。明确海损范围、原因和程度，并取得由其签署的海损鉴定书及临时适航证书
（如需要）。 
Where damages incurred due to a maritime accident or such accident may pose seaworthiness problem to 
the ship, the Fleet Department should apply for a survey against the damaged part to a surveyor of the 
classification society. To identify the scope, root causes and extent of damage, and take an Inspection 
Certification of Average and an Interim Seaworthiness Certificate (if necessary), both of which shall be 
endorsed by the surveyor. 

87

船舶海事处理规则 
Rules for Handling Maritime Accident

Effective Date: 2021/8/15

Page: 2/4 
 
3.2 如水线下受损，船管部应安排潜水员进行水下检查，搞清船体包括船底板，螺旋桨、
舵等的损坏情况，要求潜水员出具检查报告。鉴于潜水员的检查客观上有不尽完整和
详细的可能，因此，在检验报告中可加注“水下部位待下一次坞修时一并检验并以坞
修检验为准”以保留索赔权利。 
Where damages occurred below the waterline, the Fleet Department shall arrange divers to carry out 
underwater inspection, determining the damaging status of the bottom plate, the propeller, the rudder and 
etc., and request the divers to issue an inspection report. As it is possible that the inspection carried out by 
the divers may objectively not complete and detailed, it is recommended to annotate “parts below 
waterline are to be surveyed at next dock repair, and the dock repair survey shall prevail” in the survey 
report, so as to reserve the right for further claim. 
3.3 如海事涉及两艘或两艘以上船舶，或固定建筑物，或其他财产遭受损失时，如时间和
条件允许船长（或派大副）应上对方船上或其他受损现场察看船、货、物的受损情况，
海务部应通知相关保险人派检验人参加检验，或安排联合检验，明确受损范围、程度
及原因，防止对方以后任意扩大损失范围。 
If the maritime accident involves two or more ships, or fixed architecture, or when other property loss 
incurred, the Master (or the Chief Officer designated by the Master) shall check the damages of the ship, 
the cargoes or any other damaged parts by boarding the other ship or visiting other damaged sites; the 
Marine Department shall notify relevant insurer to send surveyors to participate in the survey, or arrange a 
joint survey, so as to identify the scope, extent and root cause of damages, preventing the other from 
extending the damage scope at will in future. 
3.4 事故如发生在海上，不能登对方船察看时，船长可约对方船共同驶往附近方便的港口
进行检验及处理，否则，海务部应通知我方保险公司跟踪对方船舶并适时委托验船师
进行检验。 
In the event of an accident occurred at sea, where it is not possible to board the other ship to check, the 
Master may request the other ship to proceed to the nearest convenient port together to conduct the survey 
and other procedures, otherwise the Marine Department shall notify our insurer so that the insurer may 
follow up with the other ship and entrust a surveyor to carry out the survey. 
3.5 不论是船损或货损，当涉及两个或两个以上责任方时，海务部应通知对方派代表参加
相关检验。 
Be it ship damage or cargo damage, when two or more responsible parties are involved, the Marine 
Department shall notify the other party to send a representative to participate in relevant survey. 
3.6 如发生火灾，船管部应通知保险人安排检验，以确定损失情况及损坏修理范围。对于
货损，应要求货物检验人分清火灾直接损坏或因救火造成的货损，以利共同海损理算。 
In the event of a fire, the Fleet Department shall notify the insurer to arrange survey, so as to determine 
the damages and scope of damage repair. For cargo damages, the cargo surveyor shall be requested to 
identify whether the damage is directly caused by fire, or is caused due to fire extinguishing, so as to 
calculate the general average. 
3.7 如发生机损，到达第一个港口后，船管部应根据情况安排船级社验船师对事故原因、
损失范围、适航性等出具检验报告。 
In case of machinery damage, upon arrival at the first port, the Fleet Department shall, in accordance with 
specific situation, arrange the surveyor from the classification society to issue a survey report specifying 
root causes, scope of damage, seaworthiness and etc. 
3.8 发生严重油污事故后，海务部应通过保赔协会安排海事鉴定人员予以核定，特别应对
污染程度、范围，对油污区船舶，其它建筑物的受污损，以及对海洋生态资源损坏已
采取的清除措施及费用是否合理等方面出具检验报告。 
In the event of a severe oil pollution accident, the Marine Department shall notice the P&I club to verify,

and a survey report shall be issued especially covering the extent and scope of the pollution, damages to 
ships in the oil polluted area and other architecture, removal measures already taken against damages to 
the marine ecosystem, as well as whether the cost is reasonable. 
4.0 损坏修理 
Damage repair 
4.1 由于发生海事已属于不适航的船舶，船舶应根据公司指示挂靠附近港口修理。 
As ships with maritime accident occurred are not seaworthy, such ships shall call at the nearest port for 
repair according to instructions from the company.  
4.2 海事引起的应修项目力争一次修妥。但有些项目由于某种原因，或者当地无条件修理
者，如影响船级，船管部应取得船级社的同意，留待以后修理。 
Items to be repaired caused by a maritime accident shall be completed once and for all to the greatest 
extend possible. However, for items due to some reasons that cannot or are not possible to be repaired 
locally, if the class is affected, the Fleet Department shall obtain permission from the classification 
society to carry out the repair in the future. 
4.3 海事发生后，相隔一个时期第一次进坞检修时，应注意水线以下部位受损项目，如果
初时未被潜水员发现又确系该海事所造成，船管部应请验船师检验并出具报告，船舶
还应写延伸海事报告或声明，以便向责任方或保险公司取得赔偿。 
At the first docking  within an interval after occurrence of a maritime accident, attention shall be paid to 
the damaged items below the waterline; if the damaged items were not originally found by the diver, but 
it is certain that these items are caused by the maritime accident, the Fleet Department shall request the 
surveyor to carry out an survey and issue relevant report, and the ship shall complete an extended 
Maritime Accident Report or Note of Sea Protest, so as to claim from the responsible party or the insurer.  
5.0 海事处理 
Handling Maritime Accident 
5.1 如有律师或港口有关当局登船询问有关海事情况，海务部应通过保险人尽可能安排律
师上船协助指导船长、大副、轮机长及当事船员接受询问。未经公司许可，不向对方
提供任何记录。 
Should there be lawyer or port Administration boarding the ship to inquire about the maritime accident, 
the Marine Department shall notice the insurer to arrange lawyer board the ship as well to the great 
extend possible, to assist the Master, the Chief Officer, the Chief Engineer and involved seafarers to 
undertake the inquiry. Unless otherwise permitted by the company, it is not allowed to provide the other 
party with any record. 
5.2 船舶如在引航员操纵下或拖轮协助的情况下发生海事，船长应尽可能取得引航员或拖
轮的报告和旁证材料。并在事故发生时注意有无第三者在场，如在码头附近有目击者
时，应取得目击者的证词； 若有其他船舶在场，应将该船名、船籍港、船旗国记下告
知公司，并通过代理或我驻外机构人员设法联系，争取其提供证明。 
For ships where maritime accidents occur under manoeuvring by the pilot or the assistance of a tugboat, 
the Master shall try to obtain reports and circumstantial evidences from the pilot or tugboat, and also pay 
attention to whether there is a third party present at the occurrence of the accident; if there is any witness 
in the vicinity of the wharf,  testimony shall be obtained from such witness; and if there is another ship 
present, name, port of registry, and flag of the ship shall be recorded and reported to the company, and 
such ship shall be contacted via agent or personnel of our overseas institutions, so as to obtain testimony 
from it. 
5.3 船长应向公司及时汇报事故发生情况及原因，以及采取的措施，并按公司指示协助处
理善后事宜。 
The Master shall report to the company in a timely manner on the occurrence and  cause of the accident

6.0 处理海事前，有关文件和资料的准备如下： 
Prior to handling a maritime accident, the following relevant documents and materials shall be 
prepared:  
6.1 海事报告或海事声明。 
Marine Accident Report or Note of Sea Protest. 
6.2 船舶碰撞通知书，在船舶发生碰撞第一时间内查明对方船舶的大致情况后，抢先发出
碰撞的文字通知，并抄报公司。  
Notice of Collision, which is the text notice sent out firstly after the occurrence of collision as soon as the 
information of the other ship is generally identified, and shall be copied to the company.   
6.3 航海日志、轮机日志、车钟记录簿摘要及航向记录。 
Deck Log Book, Engine Log Book, Abstract of the Bell Log Book as well as Course Record. 
6.4 取得轮机长关于舵机和主机操纵情况良好的记述。 
A descriptive record made by the Chief Engineer about the good operational condition, the steering gear 
and the main engine. 
6.5 作出事故示意图。 
Make the accident schematics. 
6.6 旁证材料（引航员和拖轮报告或证明，现场目击者证明，相片和录像等）。 
Circumstantial evidences (report or testimony of the pilot and tugboat, testimony of witnesses, photos and 
videos on site). 
6.7 船舶损坏检验报告。 
Ship damage survey report. 
6.8 海图。（做出标有双方船位置和风、流、潮等表明事情经过的海图，并保留海图上原标
航向、船位记录） 
Nautical chart. (Chart marked with both ships’ positions as well as elements to describe the process of the 
accident such as wind, current, tide and etc., and maintaining original course, and position records)  
6.9 及时根据厂家操作说明保存VDR/SVDR 数据，及时保存ECDIS 信息和数据。 
Save VDR/SVDR date as per manufacturer instructions, Save ECDIS information and data in time. 
6.10 两名以上船员的证明材料，并在海事报告上签署。 
Evidences provided by two or more seafarers, who shall endorse the Maritime Accident Report with their 
signatures. 
6.11 其它能说明情况的材料。 
Other materials that may describe the situation.

船舶现场操作风险评估规定 
Reg. for Shipboard on-site Operational Risk Assessment 
版本/修改：3.0/0 
Ver./Rev.: 3.0/0 
SHIP-01-08 
SHIP-01-08 
 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司

Effective Date: 2018/04/01 
第1/3页 
Page: 1/3 
 
第08 节 船舶现场操作风险评估规定 
Section 08 Regulations for Shipboard On-Site Operational Risk Assessment 
 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose and Scope 
1.1 为了防范船舶现场操作中存在的对人员、船舶和环境的风险，特制定本规定。 
These regulations are established to prevent risks against person, ship and environment present in the 
ship’s on-site operations. 
1.2 本规定适用于公司所管理的船舶。 
These regulations shall be applicable to all ships managed by company. 
2.0 船舶现场操作风险评估的概念 
Concept of Shipboard On-Site Operational Risk Assessment 
2.1 公司在安全管理体系的建立和运行过程中制定了风险评估程序，船舶现场操作时根据
风险评估程序进行了识别和评估，制定了相应的防范措施。 
The company has established a risk assessment procedure during the establishment and operation of the 
Safety Management System, and upon on-site operations onboard the ship, risks shall be identified and 
assessed according to the procedure, so as to develop corresponding preventative measures. 
2.2 鉴于船上操作的多样性和复杂性，在执行体系文件规定的同时，船舶现场操作执行者
还需要对所面临的特殊情况进一步识别风险及其危害性，并采取额外的防范措施。 
Due to the diversity and complexity of shipboard operations, while following the regulations specified in 
the system documents, the operator of shipboard on-site operations shall also need to further identify the 
risks and hazards of the special circumstances faced, and take extra preventative measures. 
2.3 船舶现场操作风险评估应采用《风险评估程序》所给出的方法。 
Shipboard on-Site operational risk assessment shall be adopted the methods given in the Risk Assessment 
Procedure. 
3.0 职责 
Responsibilities 
3.1 船长负责本船现场操作风险评估的培训、组织、监督、评价和改进。 
The Master is responsible for the training, organization, supervision, appraisal and improvement of 
shipboard on-site operational risk assessment. 
3.2 船长或操作执行者负责本船现场操作风险评估的实施和记录。 
The Master or the operator is responsible for the implementation and recording of shipboard on-site 
operational risk assessment. 
4.0 船舶现场操作风险评估活动 
Shipboard On-Site Operational Risk Assessment Activities 
4.1 在执行体系文件所规定的安全措施的基础上，船长或操作执行者要根据自身专业知识
和经验，对可能存在的特殊情况进行评估，判定可能对船舶、人员和海洋环境构成的
风险，并制定必要的额外防范措施。这些特殊情况包括： 
On the basis of implementing the safety measures provided in the system documents, the Master or the 
operator shall, based his own professional knowledge and experiences, carry out assessment on possible 
special circumstances, identify risks that may pose threat to the ship, persons onboard and the marine 
environment, and develop necessary extra protective and preventative measures. These special 
circumstances may include:  
4.1.1 操作现场的特殊情况，例如天气、海况、照明、时间限制、空间限制、周边可能存在
的其他危险和限制条件等； 
Special circumstances at operation site, such as weather, sea condition, lighting, time restrictions, space

restrictions, as well as other hazards and restrictions that may be present in the vicinity;  
4.1.2 参与操作人员的特殊情况，例如人员数量、经验、技能、体能等状态； 
Special circumstances of the operation involved, such as personnel quantity, experiences, skills, 
physical performance and etc.; 
4.1.3 其他特殊情况，例如相关联的其他操作、上级的特殊要求等； 
Other special circumstances, such as other related operations, special requirements from superiors and 
etc.; 
4.1.4 体系文件未涵盖的其他操作。 
Other operations not covered in the system documents. 
4.2 风险评估的执行 
Performing Risk Assessment 
4.2.1 按照体系文件中的各项操作检查表所规定的评估要求执行，并保存记录； 
Risk assessment shall be carried out in accordance with the requirements specified in all operation 
checklists under the system documents, and properly recorded. 
4.2.2 对于没有被体系文件的检查表所涵盖的风险，一经识别，现场操作执行人应对其进行
评估并制定额外的防范措施，并报告部门负责人或船长。 
For risks not covered in the checklists of the system documents, if identified, the on-site operators shall 
carry out an assessment and develop extra protective and preventative measures, and also report to the 
head of the department or the Master. 
5.0 识别风险的方法 
Methods to identify risks 
5.1 识别风险可通过提出并回答以下问题发现可能存在的风险： 
Risks can be identified through bringing forward and answering the following questions to discover 
possible existing risks:  
a. 存在什么危害 
What hazards are present? 
b. 谁（什么）会受到伤害 
Who or what will be hurt? 
c. 伤害怎样发生 
How does the hazard happen? 
5.2 在进行风险识别时，要充分考虑发生危害的根源及性质： 
When identifying risks, it is necessary to adequately consider the root cause and nature of the hazards:  
a. 机械伤害 
    Mechancial hazard 
b. 高空坠落 
    Falling from aloft 
c. 冲击和撞击 
    Impact and bump 
d. 中毒、窒息、触电及辐射 
    Intoxication, suffocation, electric shock and radiation 
e. 暴露于化学性危害因素和物理性危害因素的工作环境 
    Working environment exposed to chemical hazards and physical hazards 
f. 人机工程因素（比如工作环境条件或位置的舒适度、重复性工作等） 
Human-machine engineering elements (such as comfortability of working environment conditions or 
location, repetitive works and etc.)

h. 有毒有害物料、气体的泄漏 
Leakage of poisonous and hazardous material and gas 
5.3 可能造成的后果包括： 
Possible consequences may include:  
a. 人身伤害、死亡（包括割伤、挫伤、擦伤、烫伤、肢体损伤等） 
    Injuries and death (including cuts, bruise, contusion, scald, injury of limbs and etc.) 
b. 疾病（如头痛、呼吸困难、失明、皮肤病、癌症、肢体不能正常动作等） 
Diseases (such as headache, breathlessness, loss of sight, skin changes, cancer, limbs cannot move 
normally and etc.) 
c. 财产损失 
    Loss of property 
d. 环境破坏 
    Damages to the environment 
6.0 风险评估应包括以下内容 
Risk assessment shall include the following contents:  
6.1 识别风险，界定风险的定义及范围； 
Identify risks and define the definition and scope of the risks;  
6.2 分析风险发生的概率及其危害后果； 
Analyze the probability of risks and their consequences; 
6.3 确认风险的等级； 
Identify level of risks; 
6.4 分析公司已有的安全措施是否足以防范风险； 
Analyze if the company’s existing safety measures are adequate to prevent risks;  
6.5 提出风险防范措施建议 
Put forward recommendations of protective and preventative measures

7.1 各种船舶操作检查表

7.2 船舶安全会议记录

禁止含有石棉材料在船使用规定 
Prohibiting Use Asbestos Containing Materials Onboard

第09 节 禁止含有石棉材料在船使用规定 
Section 09 Regulations for Prohibiting the Use of Asbestos Containing Materials Onboard 
 
1.0 目的和适用范围 
Purpose & Scope 
为了防止石棉材料对人体和环境的危害，遵守和执行公约的要求及有关规定，要求没
有实施有害物质清单的船舶必须执行该规定。 
In order to prevent the hazards of asbestos containing materials posed to human and the environment, as 
well as to comply with and follow the requirements of conventions and relevant regulations, all ships 
without Inventory of Hazardous Materials should follow these regulations.  
2.0 公约和通函的有关要求； 
Relevant Requirements of Conventions and Circulars:  
2.1 IMO 于2000 年以 MSC.99(73)形式通过了 SOLAS 2000 年修正案，要求 2002 年7 月1
日及以后，对所有船舶，除了规定的高温/高压环境下使用的水密接头和内衬、特定的
叶片和高温下的绝缘装置外，不允许含有石棉材料的新的设备、装置和材料装船使用。 
IMO adopted the SOLAS Amendments, 2000 in the form of Resolution MSC.99 (73), requiring that, for 
all ships, new installation of materials which contain asbestos shall be prohibited except for watertight 
joints and linings used for the circulation of fluids at specified high temperature/ high pressure 
environment, particular vanes as well as supple and flexible thermal insulation assemblies used for 
specified hight temperatures.   
2.2 根据IMO 于2009 年通过的MSC.282(86)决议-关于SOLAS 公约修正案，就石棉在船上
的使用作了进一步严格规定，要求自2011 年1 月1 日起，对于所有船舶，应禁止新装
含有石棉的材料。 
The Resolution MSC.282(86) - Amendments to the SOLAS, as amended, adopted by IMO in 2009, had 
stipulated further stricter regulations, requiring that, from 1 January 2011, for all ships, new installation of 
materials which contain asbestos shall be prohibited.  
2.3 MSC.1/Circ.1379-SOLAS 2000 修正案II-1/3-5 通函，则对石棉适用范围予以了明确：
2011 年1 月1 日之前船上已购买的备品备件（对现有船）或造船厂购买的备品备件（对
在建船），2011 年1 月1 日及以后不允许作为工作部件装船使用。 
With a view to ensuring a uniform approach towards the application of SOLAS regulation II-1/3-5 
concerning the application of materials containing asbestos, MSC.1/Circ.1379 has specified that, any 
material purchased prior to 1 January 2011 being kept in the ship's store or in the shipyard for a ship 
under construction, should not be permitted to be installed after 1 January 2011 as a working part.  
3.0 石棉种类 
Types of asbestos 
石棉大致分为 6 个种类：温石棉、青石棉、铁石棉（铁闪石）、直闪石石棉、透闪石
石棉、阳起石石棉。一般通过偏光显微镜，辅以电子显微镜技术和/或 X 射线衍射仪，
以上种类均能够检测被检出。石棉在船上的常见位置参见附件表格一。  
Asbestos can be divided into the following 6 types in general: chrysotile, crocidolite, amosite (grunerite), 
anthophyllite, tremolite, and actinolite. Normally, all of the above-mentioned types can be detected via a 
polarizing microscope, with the help of electron microscopic technique and/or an X-ray diffractometer. 
For common locations of asbestos on board the ship, please refer to Exhibit One in the appendixes.    
4.0 职责 
Responsibilities 
4.1 轮机长是船舶的负责人。禁止含有石棉的材料在船使用，监督和检查船上储存或所申

第10 节 船舶有害物质清单维护管理规定 
Section 10 Inventory of Hazardous Materials Maintenance Management Onboard 
 
1 
目的和范围 
Purpose and Scope 
1.1 本规定是为了满足SOLAS 第II-1 / 3-5 条关于新安装含石棉材料、 《2009 年香港国际
船舶安全与环境无害化拆船公约》和欧盟拆船法规第1257/2013 号（EU）的需要。 
These regulations apply to SOLAS Chapter II-1 Regulation 3-5 - New installation of materials containing 
asbestos, Hong Kong International Convention for the Safe and Environmentally Sound Recycling of 
Ships, 2009 and EU Regulation on Ship Recycling, REGULATION (EU) No 1257/2013. 
1.2 本规定是跟踪在有害物质清单（IHM）船上检验期间船上发现的所有有害物质，并记录
在IHM 第I 部分中，以及包含危险物质的新安装，以确保IHM 第I 部分在船舶的使用
寿命期间持续更新。同时，在更新安装和更换操作过程中，将按照相关法规对有害物
质的管理。 
The purpose of the regulation is to keep track of all hazardous materials found onboard the vessel during 
IHM onboard survey and stated in IHM part I, and the new installations that contain hazardous materials, 
to ensure IHM Part I is updated continuously during the ship's operation life. In the meantime, 
management of hazardous materials will be done in accordance with related regulations during change, 
new installation and replace operations. 
1.3 本规定适用于持有有害物质清单的船舶。 
The regulation shall be applicable to those ships with IHM. 
2 
有关人员责任： 
Responsibilities for Related Personnel:  
2.1 主管船管副总经理：公司指定为清单维护责任人(DP),全权监督船上与所有有害物质（受
香港公约和欧盟拆船法规管控的）相关活动。 
VGM in Charge of Fleet Management is a Designated Person (DP) as responsible for Maintaining the 
Inventory, the person has the overall authority to oversee all hazardous materials (regulated in Hong Kong 
Convention (HKC) and EU Ship Recycling Regulation (EU SRR)-related activities on the ship. 
2.2 机务总管：控制船上更换和新装的设备和材料。负责安排各项检验。 
Technical Superintendent: Control the replacement and new installation of the equipment and materials 
onboard the vessel. Responsible for application surveys. 
2.3 采购员：控制设备和材料的来源。在采购订单上，要求供应商提供 MD（材料声明）
和 SDoC（供应商符合声明）。 
Purchaser: Control source of equipment and materials. On the Purchase Order, ask supplier to provide MD 
(Material Declaration) and SDoC (Suppliers Declaration of Conformity). 
2.4 船长：记录船舶运营期间与有害物质相关的任何更改，包括更换初始IHM 部分中发现
的有害物质和新安装的有害物质,建立专用文件夹，保存附录所列文件。 
Ship Master: Record any changes related to regulated HMs during the ship’s operation including 
replacement of HMs found in the initial IHM Part I and new installation of HMs，establish special file and 
keep the relating documents. 
2.5 轮机长和大副：负责对接收备件、物料的MD 和SDoC 进行核对并交船长存档，对新
发现的有害物质和新安装的有害物质报告船长。 
Chief Engineer & Chief Officer: Check the MD and SDoC of receipt spare parts and ship’s stores, then 
hand over the Captain, report the new HMs found and new installation of HMs.  
3 
IHM 第一部分维护程序 
Procedures to maintain the IHM Part I 
3.1 由公司安排相关船级社认可的检测机构完成初步IHM检查和IHM第一部分完成有害物
质列入。完成初次检验，持有船级社签发《有害物质清单符合声明》。  
初始 IHM 清单中所述的有害物质当有任何更改时，都由船上的船员按照附录六记录。 
An initial IHM survey has been finished by relating class recognized organization and the initial IHM Part 
I has been developed accordingly, where HMs have been listed Completed initial survey, and issued the

Whenever any changes for those HMs stated in the initial IHM Part I shall be recorded by the crew 
onboard in accordance with the Appendix.  
3.2 船舶运营期间对备件和物料采购单进行审查和筛选潜在的含有HM（PCHM）物品，其
中涉及以下条款 
A purchase list for spare parts and stores procurement during the ship’s operation will be reviewed and 
screened out where potentially containing HMs (PCHMs), include the following with reference to the 
regulations: 
3.2.1 油漆和涂料 
Paints and Coatings 
3.2.2 要安装在船上的机器、设备和材料（例如，通过焊接或螺栓固定、铆接或水泥浇筑，
牢固地装配在船上），如发动机、泵、阀门、加工材料、导航和通讯设备、电气和电
子设备、垫片、填料、电缆、管套、绝缘材料、密封件，等 
Machinery, equipment and materials to be installed on board the ship (i.e., securely fitted with the ship, 
such as by welding or with bolts, riveted or cemented, and used at their position), e.g. engine, pump, valve, 
processed materials, navigation and communication equipment, electrical and electronic equipment, gasket, 
packing, cable, pipe lagging, insulations, sealing, etc. 
3.2.3 结构材料，例如：面板、绝缘材料、穿墙电缆、门、窗户、地板等。 
Structural materials, e.g. panels, insulations, cable penetration, door, window, floor, etc.  
3.2.4 除外: 
Exclusions:  
1） 未固定的物品，如便携式灭火器、遇险照明弹、救生圈等不需要列在IHM第I部分； 
The items which are not fixed, such as portable fire extinguishers, distress flares, lifebuoys, etc., are 
not required to be listed in the part I of IHM.  
2） 固定在适当位置的含铅酸或其他有害物质的电池应列在IHM的第一部分中，但未固
定的电池（例如消耗电池和储存的电池）则不需要在第一部分中列出； 
The batteries containing lead acid or other hazardous materials that are fixed in place should be listed 
in the part I of IHM, but those not fixed, such as consumer batteries and batteries in store are not 
required to be listed in the part I.  
3） IHM第II和第III部分中规定的运营产生的废物和存储（包括常规消费品）无需在IHM
第I部分中列出； 
Operationally generated wastes and Stores including regular consumable goods that are regulated in 
IHM Part II and III are not required to be listed in the part I of IHM. 
4） 表B中列出的固体金属或金属合金中固有的材料，例如钢，铝，黄铜，青铜，镀层
和焊料，但前提是它们可用于一般结构，例如船体，上层建筑，管道或设备和机械
的外壳，不需要在清单中列出； 
Materials listed in Table B that are inherent in solid metals or metal alloys, such as steels, aluminum, 
brasses, bronzes, plating and solders, provided they are used in general construction, such as hull, 
superstructure, pipes or housings for equipment and machinery, are not required to be listed in the 
Inventory. 
5） 尽管电气和电子设备必须在清单中列出，但设备中安装的印刷线路板（印刷电路板）
中可能包含的有害物质的数量无需在清单中报告。 
Although electrical and electronic equipment is required to be listed in the Inventory, the amount of 
hazardous materials potentially contained in printed wiring boards (printed circuit boards) installed in 
the equipment does not need to be reported in the Inventory. 
3.3 在3.2 之后，购买潜在含有害物质的物品后，将按照附录从供应商，经销商或修船厂收
集两个文件（《材料声明》和《供应商符合声明》），应正确填写《材料声明》和《供应
商符合声明》并存储在船上专用文件夹中。 
Following 3.2, when the PCHM items are purchased, the two documents (MD and SDoC) will be collected 
from the suppliers, dealers or the ship repairing yard in accordance with the Appendix, the MD and SDoC shall 
be filled out correctly and stored onboard special file. 
3.4 购买的零件中是否包含有害物质，需要检查收集的《材料声明》和《供应商符合声明》。

3.4.1 如果高于表A中HM的阈值水平，则意味着要购买的零件包含禁止的HM，这些零件不
允许安装在船上，因此，这些零件需要退回; 
If above the threshold level of HMs in Table A, which means the parts to be purchased containing 
prohibited HMs, which are not allowed to be installed onboard the vessel, therefore, these parts need to 
be rejected;  
3.4.2 如果超过表B中HM的阈值水平，则这些零件将标记为HMs零件，当船员将其安装在船
上时，它将被船员记录，记录表请参见附录六; 
If above the threshold level of HMs in Table B, the parts will be marked with HMs Parts, it will be recorded 
by the crew when they are installed onboard the vessel, the record form refers to Appendix 6; 
3.4.3 如果低于表A和B中HM的阈值水平，则无需执行任何操作，这意味着要购买的零件无
有害物质的; 
If below the threshold level of HMs in Table A & B, then don’t need to do anything, which means the parts to 
be purchased are clean; 
3.5 根据步骤3.1 和步骤3.4 中所述的记录，对IHM 第I 部分进行相应地更新。 
In accordance with the record stated in 3.1 and 3.4, the IHM Part I will be updated accordingly.  
3.5.1 在IHM第I部分中添加，更改或删除HM，在该位置进行新的安装，修改，维修，更换，
拆卸或更改结构，机械和/或设备的位置，更新涂层，更改标志，所有者或操作员； 
Add, change or delete HMs in IHM Part I where new installation, modification, repair, exchange, removal, or 
alteration of location of structure, machinery and/or equipment, renewal of coating, change of flag, owner or 
operator is undertaken; 
3.5.2 如果机械，设备，涂料等与相同的零件或涂料进行交换/更新，则无需更新其库存； 
Where machinery, equipment, coating, etc. is exchanged/ renewed with an identical part or coating, update of 
their inventory is not required; 
3.5.3 船上移除的物品应明确标明，以便在移除的物品上划上划线（参见附录七）； 
The item removed out of board should be clearly specified in such manner that a cross line is put on the 
removed item (Refer to Appendix 7); 
3.5.4 为了显示HM的位置，应采用总体布置图中指明的地点名称等； 
In order to show location of HM, names of location which are indicated in General Arrangement, etc. should 
be used; 
3.5.5 表示危险物质近似数量的标准单位应为kg，除非认为其他单位（例如，m3用于液体或
气体的材料，m2用于地板或墙壁的材料）更合适。近似数量应四舍五入到至少两个有
效数字； 
Standard unit to show the approximate quantity of hazardous materials should be kg, unless other units (e.g. 
m3 for materials of liquid or gases, m2 for materials used in floors or walls) are considered more appropriate. 
An approximate quantity should be rounded up to at least two significant figures; 
3.5.6 要安装的相同项目可以一起列出在具有一般位置的清单中，但是，它们的位置应该尽
可能小，因为它们可以识别； 
Same items to be installed may be listed together in the Inventory with general location, but, their location 
should be as small as they can be identified; 
3.5.7 清单的修订应包括修订日期、变更/删除项目的和 DP 签名（参见附录七）； 
Revision of the Inventory should include date of revision, summary of change/ deletion of items, and 
signature of DP (Refer to Appendix 7); 
3.5.8 清单副本应保留在船上。 
A copy of the Inventory should be kept on board.

当香港公约和欧盟SRR 管制的有害物质从船上移走时，船员应填写危险废物追踪表。
（参考附录5）

有害物质清单第II 部分和第III 的编制和检验 
Development of Part II and Part III of the Inventory of Hazardous Materials and Survey 
6.1 一旦做出拆船决定，公司在申请最终检验前应编制有害物质清单第II 部分和第III 部分，
并考虑到拟拆解船舶在进拆船厂前的一段营运时间，最大限度地减少船上的货物残余、
燃油残余和废料。 
Once the decision to recycle a ship has been taken, Part II and Part III of the Inventory are to be 
developed by company before the final survey, taking into account that a ship destined to be recycled is to 
conduct operations in the period prior to entering the Ship Recycling Facility in a manner that minimizes 
the amount of cargo residues, fuel oil and wastes remaining on board 
6.2 主管机务负责有害物质清单第II 部分（操作产生的废料）和第III 部分（物料）的编制，
依据拆船时间，向船级社申请最终检验，对检验合格的船舶签发《国际适合拆船证书》
/《适合拆船符合证明》(有效期不超3 个月) 。 
Technical Superintendent is responsible for the preparation of Part II (Waste Generated by 
Operation) and Part III (Materials) of the Hazardous Materials List, and applies for final 
inspection to the classification society according to the time of dismantling, and issues the " 
International Ready for Recycling Certificate " / " Ready for Recycling Statement of 
Compliance" for ships that pass the inspection 。（period not exceeding three months） 
6.3 按照公约要求选择合规的拆船厂实施拆船工作。 
Select a compliant Ship Recycling Facility to carry out ship recycling work in accordance 
with the requirements of the convention.

第01节 
个人安全须知 
Section 01 Instructions on Personal Safety 
 
1. 作业前对所进行的工作的危险性进行评估，根据评估的结果采取必要的安全防护措施,
并熟知所进行工作的安全须知和操作规程。 
Prior to operation, risk of the work shall be assessed, and take necessary safety precautions according to 
the result of the assessment, and the safety instructions and operation procedures of the work shall be 
familiarized. 
2. 进入工作场所，必须穿工作服、工作鞋，戴安全帽, 必要时戴防护眼镜、皮手套等必要
的劳保用具。 
Any one entering working places must be dressed in working suits, shoes and safety helmet, and if 
necessary, should wear glasses, leather gloves and so on personal protective equipment. 
3. 行走时必须留意易于绊、跌及碰头的凸起物或高度低于1.85 米的通道，这些凸起物或
通道须涂以黄底黑斜杠醒目的警示色标志。 
When walking, attention must be paid to protrusions that tend to make person stumble, fall and bump into 
head, or walkways with a height of less than 1.85 meters, and such protrusions and walkways must be 
painted with yellow bottom, black slash, eye-catching warning signs. 
4. 上下楼梯，注意防滑、防跌，要抓牢扶手栏杆，携带的物品或用具需装入工具袋或桶
内携带，严禁两手脱离楼梯扶手栏杆。 
When going up and down stairs, attention shall be paid to avoid slipping and falling, and hold on securely 
to the railing. Items or tools carried along need to be placed in a work bag or a barrel, and it is prohibited 
to release both hands from the armrest hand rail of the stairs. 
5. 洒落或漏泄的油迹、油脂、水渍等，要及时清除，防止滑倒跌伤。 
Spilled or leaked oil stain, grease, water stain etc. shall be promptly removed to prevent slipping injuries. 
6. 需要登上梯子作业时，梯子要牢固固定，或有人看护协助，防止梯子滑落跌伤；在超
过基准面2 米的高空工作时，须系上安全带、安全绳，并系固于坚固稳妥之处。任何
梯级如果有损坏应尽快修复，如果未能及时修复则应在损坏处设置明显标志，以提醒
人员注意。 
When it is necessary to climb up a ladder to carry out jobs, the ladder must be be firmly fixed, or guarded 
and assisted by someone else, so as to prevent the ladder from falling and causing injuries; when working 
aloft at a height of more than 2 meters above the datum plane, safety belt and rope must be tied and 
secured to a strong safe place. If broken, any footstep must be repaired as soon as possible, and if the 
repair cannot be done in a timely manner, an obvious sign shall be displayed at the broken footstep to 
remind persons to watch out. 
7. 注意临时打开的人孔盖、盖板、地板等开口和拆除的栏杆、护栏要在其周围架设围栏
或警示绳，防止人员跌落。 
Attention shall be paid to the temporary opening of manhole covers, cover plates and floors, and in case 
railings, and guardrails have to be removed, fences or warning ropes shall be set up around them to 
prevent personnel from falling. 
8. 夜间尤其是后半夜被叫起进行作业或值班时，一定要头脑清醒，保持足够的安全警觉；
作业负责人或交班人确认其头脑清醒时才可交付工作，若认为不能安全作业或值班时，
通知部门长。 
When the crew members are requested to perform operations or watch-keeping at night, especially after 
midnight, they shall be clear-headed and with adequate safety vigilance; the responsible operator or the 
person to hand over the watch-keeping duty must confirm that the person to take over the job is sober and 
clear-headed before handing over the job, and shall notify the head of the department if he deems that the 
one to take over the job is not in a position to perform safe operation or watch-keeping.  
9. 室内严禁私自乱拉电线，如需要临时接线时要通知电机员，离开房间时应关闭所有室

11. 使用的工具不能随处摆放，以免跌落砸伤他人，使用完毕放回原处。 
Tools shall not be placed anywhere, so as to avoid falling and crushing on others, and shall be put back to

12. 严禁在床上或禁止吸烟的处所吸烟，烟蒂放入注水的烟灰缸内，并确认烟蒂熄灭。 
It is strictly prohibited to smoke in bed or places where smoking is prohibited, and cigarette butts shall be 
put into an ashtray with water filled in, and confirm the butts are quenched.  
13. 在船舶横摇超过10 度时禁止乘坐电梯；船长与大副、轮机长与大管轮不得同时乘坐电
梯。船舶发生应急事件时严禁乘坐电梯。 
In the event that the ship rolls over 10 degrees, it is prohibited to take elevators; The Master and Chief 
Officer, the Chief Engineer and Second engineer shall not take the elevator at the same time. Elevator is 
strictly forbidden when the ship is in an emergency situation. 
14. 进行舷外作业必须系好安全带并穿救生衣，且两人以上，并保持专人在上方舷边保护
协助。During overboard operations, safety belt and life jacket must be worn, and the operation must be 
carried by two persons or more, with dedicated persons offering protection and assistance at the gunwale 
above.  
15. 高空作业必须系安全带，必须有专人在下方甲板上保护和协助。 
During working aloft, safety belt must be fastened with dedicated person offering protection and 
assistance on the deck below.  
16. 大风浪航行，未经船长许可，禁止到甲板作业。如必须到甲板作业时，必须穿救生衣，
走安全通道，必要时系安全绳，安排专人看护。 
When sailing in wind waves, operation on the deck is prohibited without the Master’s approval. In case 
deck operation cannot be avoided, life jackets must be worn, and the safe walkway shall be used, and if 
necessary, safety ropes shall be fastened, with dedicated person on guard. 
17. 进入油漆间、电瓶间、二氧化碳（包括其他灭火药剂）存放间必须先通风后进入。 
Prior to entry into paint rooms, battery rooms, carbon dioxide (including other fire extinguishing 
chemicals) storage rooms, such rooms must be well ventilated. 
18. 当操作处理化学物品/油漆/危险液体时，必须穿戴物品安全数据表上规定的的保护服，
这些设备包括防飞溅护罩，橡胶手套，橡胶围裙。 
When handling chemicals / paints / hazardous liquids, the protective clothing specified on the material 
safety data sheet must be worn. Equipment including a splash shield, rubber gloves, rubber apron. 
19. 工作在高噪音场所的所有人员必须穿戴护耳装置。 
Ear protectors are worn by all personnel while working in locations with high noise levels.  
20. 航行期间，人在室内时禁止锁闭房门。 
During navigation, doors are not allowed to be closed when there are still people indoor.  
21. 禁止高空抛物。从高处往低处传递物件时，应用绳子吊下，绝不允许从高处扔下,在吊
下物件之前要招呼下面的人员并要求其闪避。 
No high altitude throwing. When transferring objects from high places to low places, ropes shall be used 
to hoist then down, and it is absolutely prohibited to drop them from height, and it is necessary to shout 
the persons down to dodge prior to hoisting objects down.  
22. 当船员在高温或太阳曝晒的场所工作时，应穿浅色较厚的工作服并多次饮水，适时到
阴凉的地方休息，以防中暑。

30. 停止工作权Stop work authority（SWA） 
30.1 在作业开始前，作业负责人应将“停止工作权”政策和方法传达给所有参与工作的人
员，以确保在作业现场相关人员完全理解和接受。 
The means by which the Stop Work Authority will be communicated across the workforce during work 
planning or tool box meeting to ensure full understanding and acceptance in all circumstances. 
30.2 公司船岸员工，包括承包商，如果看到任何可能会导致事故的人的不安全行为、物的
不安全状态和不安全环境因素，都有干预和停止工作的责任和义务。 
The employees onboard and ashore and contractors have been given the responsibility and obligation to 
intervene and stop work if they see something unsafe that may cause an accident. 
30.3 SWA 程序一般包括五个步骤： 
A typical SWA procedure includes five steps: 
• 停止不安全活动； 
Stop the unsafe activity; 
• 告诉作业负责人，以使这个问题能够得到解决； 
Tell the person in charge so the issue can be addressed; 
• 与相关人员讨论所关切的问题，并在必要时纠正这一问题； 
Discuss the concerns with those involved and correct the issue as necessary; 
• 重新开始工作。 
Start the activity again; 
• 与可能受到影响的其他人员和承包商分享所学到的知识和教训。 
Share what has been learned with other employees and contractors who may be affected. 
30.4 公司承诺，使用“停止工作权”绝不会导致纪律处分或歧视，即使后来证明不存在当
时察觉到的危险。 
The commitment by the vessel operator that the use of Stop Work Authority will never result in 
disciplinary action or discrimination even if it later turns out that the perceived danger was not present. 
30.5 停止工作权政策由公司指定人员签发，需在驾驶台、集控室、餐厅及甲板办公室张贴。 
Stop Work Authority Policy shall be issued by the company's designated personnel and must be posted 
in the bridge, engine control room, mess room, and deck office.

第02 节 工作场所的安全规定 
Section 02 Regulations on the Safety of Workplaces 
 
1.0 工作场所要有醒目的安全警示标志，光线充足，夜间作业照明保持良好。 
Obvious safety warning signs shall be displayed at workplaces where lighting must be sufficient, and 
shall be kept in a well illuminated condition at night. 
2.0 工作场所要保持清洁，垃圾分类放入指定的容器内。 
The workplace shall be kept clean and garbage shall be classified and placed in a designated container. 
3.0 电工工作台、试验台必须铺设绝缘材料。 
The workbench and test stand used by the electrician shall covered with insulating materials.  
4.0 易于绊、跌或碰头的凸起物要有醒目的警示标志。 
Projections that tend to make person stumble, fall and bump into head shall be displayed with 
eye-catching warning signs.  
5.0 防护栏杆、扶手、梯子、跳板等必须牢固可靠。 
Hand rails, armrests, ladders, race boards and etc. must be reliable and secured.  
6.0 临时打开的舱、柜人孔盖、地板、盖板等须有防护设施和警示标志；临时拆除的栏杆
或护栏等，须有临时的防护措施，并设置警示标志，防止人员跌落。 
Manhole covers of spaces and tanks, floor and cover plates and etc., if temporarily opened, protection 
devices and warning signs must be displayed; and in case guardrails or hand rails are removed for the 
time being, temporary protection measures must be taken, and warning signs shall be displayed, so as to 
prevent persons from falling off. 
7.0 各种工具、设施应处于良好状态，有潜在安全隐患应及时修复或设立警告标识。 
All sorts of tools and facilities shall be kept in good condition, and potential safety risks shall be repaired 
or displayed with warning signs in a timely manner. 
8.0 可移动的物体必须绑扎牢固。 
Movable objects must be firmly secured. 
9.0 在消防、救生、防污器材存放处严禁存放无关物品，保持逃生通道清爽无障碍，照明
良好。 
It is prohibited to store irrelevant items at the places where fire-fighting, life-saving and pollution 
prevention equipment and devices are stored, and the escape exits shall be kept in a clear and unblocked 
condition, with well illuminated lighting.  
10.0 落水管保持畅通，及时清除洒落在通道处的油、水、冰雪及货物。 
The scupper pipes shall be kept in an unblocked condition, and oil, water, icy snow as well as cargoes 
scattered around at the access should be cleaned in a timely manner.  
11.0 氧气、乙炔钢瓶分开存放，并固定。氧气管为蓝色，乙炔管为红色，并标示瓶内气体：
满（FULL）或空（EMPTY）。 
Oxygen and acetylene are separately stored and secured. The oxygen hose blue, the acetylene hose is red, 
and the bottle is marked with the condition of the air: FULL or EMPTY. 
12.0 船用油漆、化学品存放在专用的库房或处所内,包括没有用完的油漆、化学品。 
Marine paints and chemicals shall be stored in a dedicated room or space, including paints and chemicals 
not consumed. 
13.0 电站、配电板、分电箱等高压电部位应有高压电警示标志，并在操作位置的地板上铺
设绝缘垫。 
High voltage parts such as power stations, switchboards and distribution boxes should have high voltage 
warning signs and insulation mats shall be laid on the floor of the operating site.

标示。如必要，在航行期间设置安全绳。 
Safe accesses shall be established at the place of the main deck leading to pilot ladder, helicopter landing

shall be adopted during the voyage. 
15.0 从舵机房入口到舵机应急操作位置的通道，应设置带有单面扶手栏杆的防滑通道，舵
机周围要有防滑通道。  
The access from the entrance of the steering gear room to the emergency operation site shall be

the steering gear.  
16.0 禁止吸烟的场所要有禁烟标志，允许吸烟的场所的烟灰缸里要注水。 
Places where smoking is prohibited shall display non-smoking signs and ashtrays shall be filled with 
water where smoking is allowed. 
17.0 甲板下为油舱的甲板区域应用醒目油漆标出，并有禁止明火的文字或符号标示。 
The deck area of oil tanks below the deck shall be marked with eye-catching paint, and letters or symbols 
prohibiting naked fire shall be displayed. 
18.0 油柜玻璃管液位计自闭阀保持常闭状态。 
The self-closing valves for the glass level meter of oil tanks shall be kept in closing condition. 
19.0 油舱、柜测量管自闭器保持常闭状态。 
Self closing devices for the measuring tubes of oil tanks shall be kept in closing condition. 
20.0 所有高噪音处所应标示“高噪音，佩带耳封”，并张贴明显标志。 
All these areas are to be identified by the Master and all entrances to such spaces should carry a warning 
symbol with a supplementary sign stating HIGH NOISE LEVELS, USE EAR PROTECTORS.

第03 节 甲板一般作业的安全规定 
Section 03 Regulation on the Safety of General Deck Operation 
 
1.0 甲板作业必须由船长、大副或轮机长指定的专人领导下进行，严格遵守操作规程。 
Deck operations must be conducted under the leadership of a dedicated person designated by the Master, 
the Chief Officer or the Chief Engineer, and the operating procedures shall be strictly followed. 
2.0 多人协同作业须听从专人指挥，不得擅离岗位。 
During operations carried out by multiple persons in a coordinated manner, commands must come from a 
dedicated person, and the members shall not leave their post without permission. 
3.0 进行甲板作业时必须佩戴安全帽、穿戴工作服及劳保防护用品，严禁穿拖鞋、赤脚和
赤膊作业，衣服必须系好钮扣，必要时用带缚牢，防止被机械绞进。做到防滑、防冻
或防暑。 
During deck operations, safety helmet, working suits and personal protective equipment shall be worn, 
and wearing slippers, barefoot and shirtless is strictly prohibited, while clothes buttons must be fastened, 
and secured using belt when necessary, to avoid being gripped into the machine. Measures shall be taken 
to prevent slip, freezing or heatstroke. 
4.0 舷外和高空作业应避开恶劣天气，舷外和高空作业必须穿系安全带，舷外作业还须穿
救生衣，须二人以上并指定专人负责安全保护。 
Bad weather shall be avoided during overboard operation and working aloft, during which, safety belts 
must be worn, and life jacket shall also be worn for overboard operation, and besides, the operation must 
be carried out by at least two persons, with dedicated person responsible for safety protection.  
5.0 不宜单独作业时，不准一人勉强作业。两人以上作业时，应确定负责人，有主有从。
尤其是雨、雪天，作业人员视线不好，要互相照应、提醒，密切配合。 
When it is not suitable to carry out operation by a single person, it is not allowed for a single person to 
carry out operation. When the operation is carried out by two persons or above, a responsible person shall 
be determined, with leading and subordinate roles. In the event that the visibility of operators is limited, 
especially during rainy or snowy days, they shall take care and remind each other, and offer close 
cooperation.  
6.0 进行有可能损伤眼睛的作业时和进入有飞溅物的作业现场时，必须戴好防护眼镜。 
When carrying out operations which might cause harms to the eyes, or entering operation site where 
spattering objects are existent, safety goggles must be worn.  
7.0 使用高压皮龙水枪作业时应两人操作，一人握牢水枪，一人协助拖带皮龙，站位尽量
远离船舷、舱盖、舱口等平台及各甲板开口的边缘，防止跌落。 
When using high-pressure fire hose water gun, the operation shall be carried out by two persons, with one 
holding the water gun firmly, and the other one assisting in towing the fire hoses, and the standing places 
shall be away from the shipboard, platforms such as hatch covers and hatches as well as the edge of each 
deck openings, so as to prevent from falling off. 
8.0 使用电动（或气动）除锈工具前，须检查绝缘是否良好，引线、接线绝缘良好，严禁
拆除防护罩作业。多人作业时注意周围环境，除锈方向不能面向他人，要保持安全距
离。 
Prior to use electric or pneumatic tools to remove rusts, inspection shall be performed to confirm if the 
insulation is in a good condition, and the lead and the connecting terminal are well insulated; it is strictly 
prohibited to remove the protection hood during operation. During multiple person operations, attention 
shall be paid to the surrounding environment, and the direction for removing rusts shall not face other 
people, while a safe distance shall be maintained.  
9.0 解系缆作业时，要合理站位，严禁跨于缆绳的正上方，绝不可站在绳圈内或接近绷紧

During mooring operations, a reasonable standing position shall be maintained and it is strictly prohibited
