10.0 使用梯、凳登高作业时要有防滑措施或专人扶持。高度超过2 米以上按高空作业的安
全规定执行。 
When using ladders and stools for high work, anti slippery measures shall be taken or the ladders and 
stools shall be held by hand by dedicated person. If the height is over 2 meters, the Regulations on the 
Safety of Working Aloft shall be followed. 
11.0 在夜间或光线较暗处所作业，必须安置好充分的照明设备。 
When working at night or in a dark place, adequate lighting devices must be prepared. 
12.0 甲板所有防护栏杆和防止跌落的防护设施必须安全可靠。 
All protective railing and protective equipment against falling down on the deck must be safe and reliable. 
13.0 操作大锤时要注意周围环境，对面不能站人，操锤者不得戴手套以防止大锤脱手伤人。 
Attention shall be paid to the environment around when operating a big hammer. No person is allowed to 
stand in the opposite direction, and the operator shall not wear gloves, so as to avoid injuries of others in 
case the hammer slips out of hand.  
14.0 锚机、缆机、起货机停止使用后，应把操作手柄放至中位并使用锁定装置固定。 
After use of anchor windlass, mooring winch and cargo winch, the operating handle shall be placed back 
to the middle position and secured using a locking device. 
15.0 保持甲板通道畅通，及时清除漏泄的油、水、雪及撒落的货物，防止滑跌摔伤。 
The deck shall be kept unobstructed, and leaked oil stain, water, snow and scattered goods shall be 
cleaned in a timely manner to prevent slipping injuries. 
16.0 临时打开的人孔盖、盖板要设置防跌落护栏和警示标志，不用时及时恢复。 
Protective guarding rails and warning signs shall be established for manhole covers and cover plates 
opened for temporary purposes, which shall be resumed to their original state when not in use. 
17.0 进入货舱、压载舱的人梯始终保持牢固可靠。 
Ladders leading to the cargo holds and ballast tanks shall be always kept in a secured and reliable 
condition. 
18.0 在油漆间、电瓶间及其他易燃易爆处所及其附近严禁进行热工作业。 
Hot work is strictly prohibited at or in the vicinity of the paint room, battery room and other places where 
inflammable and explosive items are stored.  
19.0 进行热工作业必须遵守热工作业的安全规定。 
Regulations on the Safety of Hot Work must be followed when carrying out hot work. 
20.0 进入封闭处所必须遵守进入封闭处所的安全规定。 
Regulations on Safety of Entry into Enclosed Space should be followed when entering enclosed spaces. 
21.0 进行开关舱作业、系解缆作业、开关舱作业及其他作业时严格遵守相关的规定。 
Relevant regulations must be strictly observed when carrying out hatch opening and closing operations, 
mooring and unmooring operations, tank washing operations as well as other operations.

第04 章 机舱一般作业的安全规定 
Section 04 Regulations on the Safety of General Engine Room Operations 
 
1.0 进入机舱必须遵守机舱规则，按操作规程进行操作，不得违章作业。 
When entering the Engine Room, the Engine Room Rules must be observed, and all operations shall be 
carried out following the operation procedures without any violation. 
2.0 进入机舱必须穿工作服、工作鞋，离开集控室须戴安全帽。工作服必须穿戴整齐，袖
口、裤脚要扎紧系好，防止被转动的机械设备缠绕。 
Any one entering the Engine Room must be dressed in boiler suits and safety shoes, and safety helmets 
must be equipped when leaving the Engine Control Room. Boiler suits must be neatly dressed, and the 
cuffs and trousers shall be securely tied, so as to avoid being caught by rotating mechanical equipment.  
3.0 进入机舱注意易于绊、跌和碰头的凸起物，严禁在悬吊的重物下停留。 
When entering the Engine Room, attention shall be paid to projections that tend to make person stumble, 
fall and bump into head, and it is strictly prohibited to stay under suspended heavy objects. 
4.0 上下楼梯时不得两手脱离栏杆扶手。 
Both hands should not get off from the hand rails at same time whilst going up and down stairs. 
5.0 机舱环境保持整齐清洁，垃圾分类存放带盖的金属容器内，标识清晰。 
The environment of the Engine Room shall be kept clean and tidy, and the trash shall be stored in a metal 
container with lid, and clear identification. 
6.0 临时拆除或打开的栏杆、人孔盖、盖板等必须设置防护设施和警示标识，不用时应及
时恢复。 
Guarding facilities and warning signs shall be established for hand rails, manhole covers, cover plates and 
etc. removed or opened temporary, which shall be timely resumed to their original state when not in use. 
7.0 在进行设备检修，须关闭启动装置或电源时，必须悬挂禁止启动、严禁合闸等警示牌。 
When the starting devices or power source must be shut down during equipment overhaul, warning signs 
such as Start Prohibited, Switch on Prohibited and etc. must be displayed.  
8.0 严禁在手上沾有油、水等导电物质时操作或启动电气设备，防止触电。 
It is strictly forbidden to operate or start electrical equipment when the hands are covered with conductive 
substances such oil, water and etc., so as to prevent electric shock. 
9.0 进行车床、台钻、砂轮作业时必须遵守相关的安全操作规定。 
When operating lathes, work bench drills, and grinding wheels, relevant provisions specified under safe 
operation regulations must be followed. 
10.0 检查和操作运转的机械设备时，严禁用手去触摸运转的部件，防止挤伤、碰伤。 
When checking and operating mechanical equipment in running condition, it is strictly prohibited to 
touch the running parts with bare hands, so as to prevent crushing and bruising injuries.  
11.0 拆卸带有压力的管路、阀门必须事先关闭压力源泄放内部压力。待确认后，才能进行
作业。 
Prior to dismantling the pressurized pipeline and valves, the pressure source must be first shut off to 
releasing the internal pressure. No operation shall be carried out until no remaining pressure confirmed. 
12.0 主、副机在未停稳，示功阀未打开前，严禁拆卸缸头附件。 
Prior to stable shut off of the Main Engine and Auxiliary Engine, and opening of the indicator valves, it is 
strictly prohibited to dismantle attachments to the cylinder head. 
13.0 使用电、气动工具时应先进行检查试验启动、控制阀（或按钮）的效能，严禁使用失
控或操作不灵的工具，不允许使用拆除了安全防护罩的手动工具。 
When using electric and pneumatic tools, the effectiveness of start and control valves (or buttons) shall be 
checked and tested firstly, and it is strictly prohibited to use tools that are out of control or ineffective, or

14.0 进行铲、凿、锤击等作业可能伤及眼睛时，须戴防护眼镜，也要防止工具意外脱手伤
人。 
During operations using shovels, chisels, hammers and etc. that may cause injury to the eye, protective 
glasses must be worn, and attention must be paid to prevent injuries of others by the tools slipped out of 
hands. 
15.0 进行上、下多层作业时，使用的工具严禁随处乱放，防止坠落伤及他人。 
During upper and lower multi-floor operations, it is strictly prohibited to place the tools in use 
everywhere in a disorderly manner, so as to prevent injuries of others due to falling of the tools. 
16.0 在进行起重作业前须对起重设备和用具进行检查或试验，确保限位及切断功能正常。 
Prior to weight lifting operations, the lifting equipment and appliances must be inspected or tested to 
ensure that limit switch and cut-out functions are working well. 
17.0 对设备、零部件进行化学药品清洗时，必须穿戴好防护服、鞋靴、手套及防护眼镜。 
When carrying out chemical cleaning of equipment and parts, it is necessary to wear protective suits, 
shoes, chemical gloves and goggles. 
18.0 对柴油机喷油器进行雾化压力试验时，必须配戴护目镜，严禁用手探摸喷嘴和油雾。 
When carrying out atomizing pressure test to the diesel engine fuel injector, safety goggles must be 
equipped and it is strictly prohibited to touch the nozzle and oil mist by hand. 
19.0 禁止用手指伸入螺孔或其他孔内探察或对正孔心，以防挤伤。 
It is prohibited to put fingers into the tapped hole or other holes for prying or aligning the hole center, so 
as to prevent crushing injuries. 
20.0 进入扫气道、管隧及其它封闭处所时，执行进入封闭处所的相关规定。 
When entering the scavenging spaces, airway, pipelines or other enclosed spaces, relevant regulations 
regarding entry into enclosed spaces shall be followed. 
21.0 进入主机曲轴箱、扫气箱检查或作业时，做好内部通风，内部温度不得高于摄氏45 度。
工作时，必须使用低压安全防爆灯。主、副机盘车设备必须有专人看管，并听从主管
人员指令进行操纵，防止启动、人工转动盘车机时伤人。 
When entering crankcase or scavenging space of the Main Engine for inspection or operation, the internal 
spaces shall be well ventilated, with an internal temperature not exceeding 45℃. When working, low 
voltage safety explosion-proof lamp must be used. The turning gears of the main and auxiliary engines 
shall be taken care of by dedicated person, who shall operate them by following instructions from the 
responsible person, so as to prevent personal injuries when the turning gear starts or is turned manually. 
22.0 严禁在通道、梯口、机舱逃生口和台阶附近堆放杂物，保持通道畅通，并有足够的照
明。 
It is strictly prohibited to stack miscellaneous items in the passageway, at the stairs, escape trunk of the 
Engine Room or in the vicinity of the steps, and the accesses shall be kept unobstructed and equipped 
with adequate lighting. 
23.0 在通道、梯口、门口等低矮处要张贴或涂抹警告标识，地面要喷涂防滑漆和安全斑马
线。 
At low places such as the passageway, gangway, doorway and so on, warning signs must be displayed or 
painted, while the surface of the floor must applied with anti-slippery paint and painted with safety zebra 
crossing. 
24.0 电站、配电箱、电源箱、分电箱等高压部位要标示高压警示标识。 
High voltage warning signs shall be displayed at high voltage parts such as power station, switch box, 
power box and distribution board. 
25.0 在电、气焊间之外进行热工作业时，严格执行热工作业安全规定。

第05 节 进入封闭处所作业的安全须知 
Section 05 Safety Instruction for Enclosed Space Entry 
1 
目的Purpose 
规范船舶进入封闭处所流程，控制作业风险，确保人员安全。本须知规定了进入前
的风险评估、许可、空气检测、持续监护及应急响应的强制性要求。 
Standardize the process of entering enclosed spaces on board, control operation risks and 
ensure personnel safety. This instruction sets forth mandatory requirements for risk 
assessment, permit issuance, atmosphere testing, continuous monitoring, and emergency 
response prior to any entry. 
2 
 定义Definition 
2.1 
封闭场所：系指可能含有有害空气或缺氧以及具有以下特征之一的处所 
Enclosed space: means a space which may contain a hazardous atmosphere or lack of 
oxygen and has any of the following characteristics  
2.1.1 入口和出口有限 The limited openings for entry and exit； 
2.1.2 通风不足；或者 Inadequate ventilation; or  
2.1.3 非设计为持续人员居留的处所Not designed for continuous human occupancy. 
并且，该处所可能含有有害空气，包括但不限于：a) 氧气含量不足（低于19.5%）
或过量（高于23.5%）；b) 存在可燃气体或蒸气；c) 存在有毒气体、蒸气或化学品。
Additionally, the space may contain a hazardous atmosphere including but not limited to: a) 
oxygen deficiency (below 19.5%) or enrichment (above 23.5%); b) presence of flammable 
gases or vapors; c) presence of toxic gases, vapors, or chemicals. 
包括但不限于具有不同特征的处所，例如货舱、污水处所、压载水舱和其他液舱、
泵房、锚链舱和发动机曲拐箱。 
This includes but is not limited to spaces that are diverse in their characteristics such as 
cargo holds, bilge spaces, ballast and other tanks, pump-rooms, chain lockers and engine 
crankcases.  
注：应根据船舶实际情况和结合上述描述，识别、评估和标志船舶封闭处所并填写
“封闭处所清单”，经公司主管机务审批同意后在船执行。 
Note: The vessel shall, based on its actual conditions and in combination with the above 
description, identify, assess and mark enclosed spaces on board, and complete the 
“Enclosed Space Register”which shall be reviewed and approved by the Technical 
superintendent before implementation on board. 
2.2 
责任人员：指由船长指定的，具备管理级适任能力的人员（即船长、大副、轮机长
或大管轮）,负责执行风险评估、确保所有安全措施落实，并最终授权进入。 
Responsible person means a competent person at the management level (typically the 
Master, Chief Officer, Chief Engineer, or Second Engineer) appointed by the Master. This 
person is responsible for conducting the risk assessment, ensuring all safety measures are 
implemented, and authorizing the entry.

3 
 职责Responsibilities 
3.1 
船长:对船上所有封闭处所进入作业的安全负最终责任。 
Bears the overall responsibility for the safety of all enclosed space entry operations on 
board. 
3.1.1 审批进入封闭处所检查表和许可证  
Approves Enclosed Space Entry Checklist and Permit 
3.1.2 确保本须知得到遵守，并保证船员接受充分的培训和演习。 
Ensures compliance with this procedure and that crew members receive adequate training 
and drills. 
3.2 
作业负责人 Responsible Person 
3.2.1 进入封闭处所作业，甲板部由大副负责，轮机部由大管轮负责；特殊情况下，也可
由轮机长、船长担任。其职责包括负责工作计划的制定和人员任务分配，监控进入
封闭处所操作。 
The operation of entering enclosed spaces, the Chief Officer in the charge of the deck 
department and the Second Engineer in the charge of the engine department. Under special 
circumstances, the Chief Engineer and Master can also serve as the responsible person. Its 
responsibilities include the formulation of work plan and personnel task allocation, 
monitoring the operation of entering enclosed spaces. 
3.2.2 作业负责人必须到现场确认控制措施已落实，决定是否可以进入封闭处所，并有责
任保证: 
The responsible person must go to the site to confirm that the control measures have been 
implemented, decide whether to enter the enclosed space, and have the responsibility to 
ensure: 
1） 
保持封闭处所通风；Keep the enclosed space ventilated; 
2） 
对舱室内的空气进行检测且结果令人满意； 
The atmosphere in the tank was tested and the results were satisfactory; 
3） 
针对已识别的危险情况备有安全措施； 
Safety measures should be prepared for the identified dangerous situations; 
4） 
备有控制进入封闭处所的相应措施； 
Have corresponding measures to control access to enclosed spaces; 
5） 
工作结束后，确保所有进入人员已安全撤离。 
After the work is completed, ensure that all personnel entering have been safely 
evacuated. 
注意：作业负责人禁止担任作业组长或进入人员。 
Attention: The responsible person is prohibited from simultaneously acting as the 
operation team leader or an Entrant. 
3.3 
进入人员 Entry personnel 
熟悉和了解进入封闭处所程序和存在的风险，遵守工作中的安全规则和规范，熟悉

工作程序，正确使用 PPE。一旦收到撤离通知，立即撤离。 
Be familiar with and understand the procedures and risks of entering the enclosed space, 
abide by the safety rules and specifications at work, be familiar with the work procedures, 
and use PPE correctly. Once the evacuation notice is received, evacuate immediately. 
3.4 
作业组长 Operation team leader 
作为一名进入封闭处所人员，负责现场工作的操作和监控，负责与监护员联系、报
告现场异常情况。 
As a person entering the enclosed space, he is responsible for the operation and 
monitoring of on-site work, contacting the Guardian and reporting on-site abnormalities. 
3.5 
监护人Attendant 
在封闭处所作业过程中一直保持在入口进行守护，同进入处所的人员以及值班人员
保持联系，并在发生事故时启动紧急程序的人员。在发生紧急情况时立即启动警报
和应急程序，且不得在无自给式呼吸器（SCBA）及后备支援的情况下独自进入救援。
监护人必须经过适当培训，且任何时候都不能离开工作现场，除非有胜任的人替代。
监护人员不得兼任进入人员。 
Personnel who keep guard at the entrance during the operation in the enclosed space, keep 
in touch with the personnel entering the enclosed space and the personnel on duty. Sounds 
the alarm and initiates emergency procedures immediately in case of an incident and must 
NOT enter the space alone for rescue without wearing SCBA and having backup support. 
The safety guardian must be properly trained and must not leave the work site at any time 
unless replaced by a competent person. An attendant cannot simultaneously serve as an 
entrant. 
4 
封闭处所作业工作许可证管理流程 
Work Permit Management Process for Operation in Enclosed Space 
4.1 
封闭处所作业申请Enclosed space Work permits Requisition 
4.1.1 在计划作业和签发许可证前，船长须将风险评估报告和《封闭处所作业申请表》
（SHIP-02-05-04）报送机务总管审核。 
Prior to scheduling operations and issuing permits, the master shall submit the risk 
assessment report and the Enclosed space Work permits Requisition (SHIP-02-05-04) to 
the technical superintendent for review. 
4.1.2 机务总管全面核查风险评估报告的完整性、有效性及申请表填报内容，确认作业条
件符合安全要求后，在申请表上签字确认,并发送到船舶。特殊情形下，若机务总管
无法签署申请表，可通过微信等便捷方式先行通知船长审批意见，后续及时补签完
善表格并送交船长。 
The technical superintendent shall conduct a comprehensive review of the completeness 
and validity of the risk assessment report as well as the information filled in the 
application form. After verifying that the operating conditions meet safety requirements, 
he shall sign the application form and forward it to the vessel. In special circumstances, if 
the technical superintendent is unable to sign the application form , he may first notify the 
master of the approval opinion via convenient means such as WeChat, and subsequently 
complete the signature on the form in a timely manner and submit it to the master.

4.1.3 船长收到机务总管审批通告的《封闭作业申请表》，或收到其微信确认许可后，方
可签发封闭舱室工作许可证。 
The captain may issue the enclosed space work permit only after receiving the Enclosed 
space Work permits Requisition approved by the technical superintendent or obtaining the 
approval confirmation via WeChat from the technical superintendent. 
4.1.4 密闭处所作业完成后，船长应在“封闭处所作业申请表”上填写作业完成情况和完
工时间并签署，然后将此表发送船管部。 
Upon completion of enclosed space work operations, the Master shall complete the 
Enclosed space Work permits Requisition Form, detailing the work performed and the 
time of completion, and sign it. The form shall then be submitted to the fleet Department 
of company. 
4.2 
风险评估：进入封闭处所前大副或轮机长或大管轮，应对场所进行书面风险评估，
以判定场所内缺氧或危险气体可能对作业人员的影响，并制定相应的控制措施和应
急计划。必要时，由船长亲自进行风险评估；评估认为本轮具备作业条件时，部门
长制定相应的作业计划呈船长审核，签发许可证（注意许可证要求一舱一证)，单独
填写《进入封闭处所检查表和许可证》，否则不得进行作业。 
Prior to entry into the enclosed space, the chief officer or chief engineer or second 
engineer shall conduct a written risk assessment of the site to determine the possible 
effects of oxygen deprivation or dangerous gases on the operators, and develop 
corresponding control measures and an emergency plan. When necessary, the master 
himself shall carry out the risk assessment; when the assessment considers that the 
operation conditions are met, the head of department shall make the corresponding 
operation plan and submit it to the master for examination and issue the work permit (note 
that one cabin requires one work permit), and separately fill in the Enclosed Space Entry 
Checklist and Permit; otherwise, no operation shall be carried out. 
4.3 
部门长查核拟参加封闭处所作业人员的经验及能力，特别是培训和演习的完成情。
The head of department shall check the experience and ability of the operators intending to 
participate in the operation in enclosed space, in particular the completion of training and 
exercises. 
4.4 
部门长按获批准的《进入封闭处所检查表和许可证》进行作业准备，包括通风换气、
气体检测与监测、照明布置等； 
The head of department shall prepare the work according to the approved Enclosed Space 
Entry Checklist and Permit, including ventilation, gas detection and monitoring, lighting 
arrangement, etc.; 
4.5 
同步作业Simultaneous Operations（SIMOPS） 
4.5.1 若密闭舱室内同时开展动火、高空作业、电气等多项交叉作业，须严格执行体系相
关规定，取得全部对应作业许可后方可开工。 
If multiple overlapping operations such as hot work, working aloft and electrical work are 
carried out simultaneously in an enclosed cabin, relevant regulations of the management 
system shall be strictly implemented, and all corresponding work permits must be 
obtained before commencement. 
4.5.2 凡外部作业可能危及密闭舱室作业安全的，均须按体系要求落实管控。例如压载水

操作会对舱内人员构成安全风险，开展密闭舱室作业前，相关压载阀必须执行上锁
挂牌管理。 
Where external operations may jeopardize the safety of work in enclosed spaces, control 
measures shall be implemented in accordance with the relevant system requirements. For 
instance, ballast water operations pose safety risks to personnel inside the spaces. Prior to 
carrying out work in enclosed spaces, relevant ballast valves must be locked and tagged. 
4.5.3 出现以下情况时需立即暂停同步作业：作业条件变化、启动应急程序、天气条件恶
化、需开展关键作业。 
The simultaneous operation must be immediately suspended under the following 
circumstances: changes in operation conditions, activation of emergency procedures, 
deterioration of weather conditions, or the need to carry out key operations. 
4.6 
部门长或现场指挥，按《进入封闭处所检查表和许可证》进行逐项检查，确认所有
准备工作就绪后，签字并宣布作业开始。 
The head of department or on-site command shall carry out the item-by-item inspection 
according to the Enclosed Space Entry Checklist and Permit, confirm that all the 
preparation work is ready, sign and announce the start of the operation. 
4.7 
现场指挥，有序组织进入人员，依次进入封闭处所，并记录进入的时间；监护人员
严密监视场所内的情况；救护人员现场外待命，做好进入救援的准备工作。 
On-site command, organize the entry personnel in order, enter the enclosed space in turn, 
and record the time of entry; guardians closely monitor the situation in the place; rescue 
personnel wait for orders outside the site, and make preparations for entering and rescuing 
4.8 
作业完毕，现场指挥，组织进入人员有序撤离，清点好人数，记录人员撤出时间，
再次确认全部人员均撤出后，关闭作业封闭处所；通知值班的高级船员；在“许可
证”完工处签署确认并将其归档。 
After completion of operation, on-site command, organize entry personnel to evacuate in 
an orderly manner, count the number of personnel, record the withdrawal time of 
personnel, reconfirm that all personnel are withdrawn, close the work enclosed space; 
notify the officer on duty; sign and confirm at the completion of "Work Permit" and file it. 
5 
 其它重点注意事项 Other key precautions 
可参《安全作业》中《个人安全须知》《工作场所的安全规定》和《船舶应急操作
指南》中“封闭处所救助”规定执行，重点强调如下: 
Implementation of other key precautions shall be in accordance with the Instructions on 
Personal Safety and Regulations on the Safety of Workplaces of Safe Operations, and the 
"Rescue people from enclosed space" of the Ship’s Emergency Response guideline, with 
the following key points emphasized: 
5.1 
禁止单人进入封闭空间，除非该空间不适合多人进入。 对于这些空间，现场监护人
必须与人员保持视觉接触。 
Single-person entry into enclosed spaces is prohibited, except if space is unsuitable for 
entry by multiple people. For these spaces the attendant must maintain visual contact with 
the person. 
5.2 
需根据下列情况，对封闭处所通风换气：

Ventilation to closed space is required in accordance with the following circumstances: 
5.2.1 进入场所作业前或因故暂停作业、封舱的场所，在重新作业前； 
Before entering the place for operation or the place where the operation is suspended or 
the cabin is closed for some reason, before re-operation; 
5.2.2 对多层封闭空间，在进入不同空间作业时； 
For multi-layer enclosed space, when entering different space for operations; 
5.2.3 执行清舱作业或进行相关场所检查前。 
Before carrying out the clearance operation or conducting relevant site inspection. 
5.3 
以下空间必须采用机械通风，不间断地向作业现场灌输新鲜空气： 
The following spaces must be mechanically ventilated and fresh air must be pumped 
continuously to the operating site: 
5.3.1 自然通风换气不好的空间；Space with poor natural ventilation; 
5.3.2 作业过程中易产生空气质量变化的空间； 
Space which is prone to air quality change in the course of operation; 
5.3.3 对可能存在可燃气体的舱室使用机械通风时，电动机械要防爆。 
When mechanical ventilation is used in cabin where combustible gases may be present, 
electrical machinery shall be explosion-proof. 
5.4 
封闭处所的检测和监视要求Inspection and monitoring requirements for enclosed space 
5.4.1 进入封闭处所前或恢复作业前，必须测定作业现场的空气质量。为保证测试准确，
应在停止通风 10 分钟后进行测试；测后立即恢复通风，并在作业期间保持通风并检
测；气体测试仪使用前的功能检测按照《监视和测量装置的管理规定》的规定执行
并做好记录。 
Air quality must be determined before entering enclosed space or resuming operations. In 
order to ensure the accuracy of the test, the test should be carried out after 10 minutes of 
stopping ventilation; the ventilation should be restored immediately after the test, and 
ventilation and testing should be maintained during the operation; the function testing of 
the gas tester before the use shall be carried out and recorded in accordance with the 
provisions of the Management Regulations on Monitoring and measuring regulations. 
5.4.2 如没有测气仪或测试仪不能正常使用/或根据判断场所可能具有测气仪不能测试的危
险气体，而当时情况又必须进入到封闭处所作业时，应在充分通风的前提下，佩戴
必要的自给式呼吸设备，做好相关保护措施后，才可进入封闭处所，但不要明火作
业。 
If there is no gas tester or tester cannot be used normally/or there may be dangerous gas 
which cannot be tested by the gas tester according to the judgment of the place, and at that 
time, it is necessary to enter the enclosed place for operation, wear the necessary 
self-contained breathing apparatus under the premise of full ventilation, do the relevant 
protective measures before entering the enclosed space, but do not conduct hot work 
operation. 
5.4.3 应以气体测试仪，确认封闭处所内气体的含量为安全： 
A gas tester shall be used to confirm that the gas content within the enclosed space is safe. 

137

进入封闭处所作业的安全须知                  版本/修改：3.0/9.0                             SHIP-02-05  
Safety Instruction for Enclosed Space Entry        Version/Revise: 3.0/9.0                           SHIP-02-05

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd         Effective Date: 2026/06/26            Page: 7/10 
 
氧气含量应为 20.5％和21%之间（最理想条件20.9%），要低于23%；氢气、碳氢
化合物浓度不超过 LFL (爆炸下限)的1%，一氧化碳浓度不超过12.5ppm，硫化氢浓
度不超过 3.2ppm，二氧化碳浓度不超过0.5%。 
The gas tester should be used to confirm that the gas content in the enclosed place is safe: 
the oxygen content should be between 20.5% and 21% ( 20.9% is considered ideal.) and 
lower than 23%; the hydrogen and hydrocarbon concentration should not exceed 1% of 
LFL (the lower explosive limit), and the carbon monoxide concentration should not 
exceed 12.5ppm. H2S concentration is no more than 3.2ppm，The level of carbon dioxide 
has been checked and is less than 0.5% by volume. 
5.4.4 应当为进入封闭处所的人员提供经校准的、试验合格的多功能气体测试仪，用以在
需要的情况下来监控氧气、一氧化碳和其它气体的含量。舱室内有人员进入时，应
以不超过 30 分钟的时间间隔对空气进行检测，并在状况发生恶化时提示舱室内的
人员离开。如果工作过程中情况发生变化， 应增加空气检测频率。可能出现的情况
变化包括气温升高、使用耗氧移动设施、在封闭处所内可能会产生蒸汽的工作等。
当工作中断或人员休息过后再次进入时，应再次对空气进行检测。 
A calibrated, well-tested multi-function gas tester shall be provided for persons entering 
enclosed spaces to monitor the content of oxygen, carbon monoxide and other gases if 
necessary. When there are personnel entering the cabin, the air shall be tested by no more 
than 30 minutes intervals and the personnel in the cabin shall be advised to leave when 
conditions deteriorate. If conditions change during work, the air detection frequency shall 
be increased. Possible changes include the rising of temperature, the use of oxygen 
consuming mobile facilities, and the possible production of vapor in enclosed spaces. 
When work is interrupted or personnel reenter after a break, the air shall be tested again. 
5.4.5 检测点的选择必须根据实际情况合理布点，从空间不同浓度有代表性的剖面取得样
品，以在隐蔽处取得为好。 
The selection of detection points must be reasonable according to the actual situation, and 
the samples must be obtained from the representative sections with different 
concentrations in the space in order to obtain the samples in the hidden place. 
5.4.6 隔离：对相连的管道、阀门、电气线路等进行有效隔离、上锁/挂牌。 
Isolation: Effectively isolate, lock out/tag out connected pipelines, valves, electrical 
circuits, etc. 
5.5 
人员安排、防护和救护措施 
Personnel Arrangements, Protection and Ambulance Measures 
5.5.1 进行工作安排时，应考虑各参加人员的素质、能力和身体状况，选择适任人员参加
作业。 
During the work arrangement, the quality, ability and physical condition of each 
participant shall be considered and the competent person shall be selected to take part in 
the work. 
5.5.2 工作完成时，需对进入口进行重新关闭；并通知驾驶台/机舱值班人员。 
The entrance should be re-closed when the work is completed, and the bridge/engine room 
watch officer should be notified. 
5.6 
设备和防护措施检查 Inspection of equipment and protective measures 

138

进入封闭处所作业的安全须知                  版本/修改：3.0/9.0                             SHIP-02-05

5.6.1 通讯系统（设备）协调一致并试验正常。 
The communication system (equipment) is coordinated and tested normally. 
5.6.2 作业人员身体避免裸露，要穿戴安全帽、工作服和工作鞋。必要时配备安全带、安
全索等安全防护用品。 
Operators shall not be exposed, and shall wear helmets, work clothes and work shoes. If 
necessary, safety belt, safety rope and other safety protection articles shall be provided. 
5.6.3 作业场所应有充分照明，一切电气设备应符合安全、防爆要求。 
The work site shall be adequately illuminated and all electrical equipment shall comply 
with safety and explosion-proof requirements. 
5.6.4 进入场所后，须在处所入口处安排监护人员值班留守，作业人员没有全部出来前，
监护人员不能离开。 
After entering the premises, the guardians shall be kept on watch at the entrance to the 
premises, and the guardians shall not be allowed to leave until the workers are all out. 
5.6.5 作业中，进入封闭处所人员，不得以任何理由离开预定工作位置擅自进入空间深处
或其它相邻的非预定空间。 
In the course of operations, persons entering enclosed space shall not, for any reason, 
leave the predetermined position and enter into the deep space or other adjacent 
non-predetermined space without authorization. 
5.6.6 进入密封工作场所人员同外面人员应确定定期联络间隔。 
Periodic contact intervals should be established between persons entering the enclosed 
space and those outside. 
5.6.7 场所入口处放置急救设备供随时使用，做好救助安排，如备用的隔绝式呼吸器、安
全带、救生索，规定好内外联络信号。救生索外端必须生根。 
First-aid equipment is placed at the entrance of the premises for use at all times and rescue 
arrangements are made, such as the spare isolated breathing apparatus, safety belt and 
lifeline, and internal and external communication signals are provided. The outer end of 
the lifeline must be fixed. 
5.6.8 作业人员进入作业点前和离开作业点时，必须清点人数。 
The number of workers must be counted before entering the operation point and when 
leaving the operation point. 
5.6.9 原则上不允许进入未除气或缺氧空间工作，当必须进入时，下舱人员必须备有性能
完全可靠的自给式呼吸器，使用人员须经良好训练，船长或大副、轮机长应持续监
督工作，在确保以上各项准备工作就绪的同时，还应保证：预先制定相关人员均理
解并同意的通讯方法；监护人员及备用的自给式呼吸器和救生器材，处于随时可用
状态；所有必要进行的作业，要采取可以避免起火危险的方式进行。 
In principle, no work is allowed in the unde-gassed or anoxic space. When it is necessary 
to enter, the crew must be equipped with self-contained breathing apparatus with 
completely reliable performance. The personnel must be well trained. The master or chief 
officer and chief engineer shall continue to supervise the work. While ensuring that the 
above preparations are ready, it shall also ensure that: the communication method which 
understood and agreed by the relevant personnel in advance is established. The custodian 
and spare self-contained breathing apparatus and life-saving equipment shall be in a

ready-to-use condition. All essential work is carried out in a way that will avoid creating 
an ignition hazard. 
5.6.10 当船上实施熏蒸作业时,应严格遵守有关指示进行，同时可参阅《IMDG Code》第五
部分     “船舶安全使用杀虫剂”。与熏蒸过的舱室相邻接的场所应等同视为熏蒸
场所进行处理。 
When fumigating operations are carried out on board, instructions should be strictly 
followed. Also see "Safe use of pesticides on ships" in Part V of IMDG Code. Places 
adjacent to fumigated cabins shall be treated as fumigation sites. 
6 
应急程序 Emergency response procedure 
6.1 
撤离封闭处所 Evacuate the enclosed spaces 
在人员已经进入封闭处所之后，如果许可证上所限定的任一项条件有了改变且变得
不安全时，应立即命令他们脱离该处所，在对现场情况重新做出评定和许可证上限
定的安全条件得到恢复之前不许重新进入。 
After the personnel have entered the enclosed space, if any of the conditions specified in 
the permit have changed and become unsafe, they should be ordered to leave the space 
immediately and should not be allowed to re-enter until the site conditions are 
re-evaluated and the safety conditions specified in the permit are restored. 
6.2 
 封闭处所的救助工作 Rescue in enclosed spaces 
当在封闭处所发生涉及人员伤害的事故时，首要行动是发出警报。虽然速度往往在
抢救生命中是至关重要的，但在必要的援助人员和设备集合就绪之前，不应试图进
行救援工作。并按照体系应急计划中《船舶应急操作指南》的“10.0 封闭处所人员
救助”的要求进行。 
When an accident involving personal injury occurs in a enclosed space, the first action is 
to give an alarm. Although speed is often crucial in saving lives, rescue efforts should not 
be attempted until the necessary aid personnel and equipment are assembled. And the 
rescue shall be carried out in accordance with the requirements of Section 10.0 "Rescue 
people from enclosed space" in the Ship’s Emergency Response guideline of the SMS. 
7 
培训与演习 
7.1 
所有涉及封闭处所进入作业（包括进入、监护、救援职责）的船员，必须每两个月
至少参加一次相关的安全培训和演习。 
All crew members involved in enclosed space operations (including entry, attendant, and 
rescue duties) must participate in relevant safety training and drills at least once every two 
months. 
7.2 
培训内容应包括但不限于：识别进入封闭处所后可能会面临的危险；进入过程中，
由于暴露在危险状态中能识别对健康造成不利影响的迹象；对进入封闭处所人员所
需防护装备的了解；气体检测装置的试验和使用；通风程序、通信方法、急救、复
苏技术和救援设备的使用；以及关于进行封闭处所相关体系文件培训。 
The training should include, but not be limited to: identification of possible risks to enter 
enclosed space; identification of the signs of adverse health effects due to exposure to 
hazardous conditions during entry; understanding of the necessary protective equipment 
for persons entering enclosed space; testing and use of gas detection devices; ventilation

7.3 
每次封闭处所进入和救助演习应以安全的方式进行，演习应包括：检查并使用进入
所需的个人保护设备；检查并使用通讯设备和程序；检查并使用气体探测仪；检查

shall include: inspection and use of personal protective equipment required for entry; 
inspection and use of communications equipment and procedures; inspection and use of 
gas detectors; inspection and use of rescue equipment and procedures; and incorporating a 
simulated rescue exercise.

第06 节 热工作业的安全规定 
 
Section 06 Regulations on the Safety of Hot Work 
 
1 
热工作业的场所 
 
Hot work place 
1.1 
在电焊、气焊割间以外的场所进行烧焊与火焰切割、烘烤作业，必须实施热工作业许可制度，填
 
写热工作业检查表。 
 For welding, gas cutting and baking operations performed at a place other than the electric welding 
and gas cutting workshop, baking operation, a hot work permit system must be implemented, under 
such permit system, the Hot Work Checklist shall be filled in. 
1.2 
在电焊、气焊割间内进行热工作业先要得到轮机长的授权，还要认真检查工作间以确保场地和设
 
备处于良好的状态并且这个场地适宜作为经授权的热工作业区域，检查时需特别注意指定的热工
 
作业区域内的火灾探测系统和隔离措施。 
1.3 
Hot work permit and approval from Chief Engineer is required for the hot work in engine room 
 
workshop. Engine room workshop is to be inspected regularly to ensure that the space and equipment 
 
are maintained in a good condition and that the space remains suitable to be the authorized hot 
 
workspace. When carrying out this inspection special attention is to be paid to the fire detection system 
 
and the isolation method in the designated hot work space. 
1.4 
正常情况下当船舶在港内（包括锚地、系浮筒）时不允许进行热工作业。然而，船舶在港期间
 
有可能因为非常重要的原因而进行热工作业。在这种情况下，要考虑所有的热工作业注意事项
 
并得到港口当局的许可及确保港口规定在任何时候都得到了遵守。在任何工作开始前与港口当
 
局间建立起全面的联系。 
 
Under normal circumstances hot work is not permitted while the vessel is within the harbour limits of a 
 
Port. However there may be occasions when hot work, while the vessel is in port, is essential. In this 
 
event all the normal hot work precautions are to be taken and importantly permission from the port 
 
representative is to be obtained and it is to be ensured that port requirements are adhered to at all times. 
 
Full liaison should be established with port authorities before any work is started.  
2 
热工作业审批流程 
 
Approval Process for Hot Work Operations 
2.1 
在拟定热工作业计划及签发热工作业许可证前，船长须先行将风险评估报告与热工作业申请表
 
通过邮件报送至主管机务总管。 
 
Prior to formulating the hot work plan and issuing the hot work permit, the master shall first submit   
 
the risk assessment report and Hot Work Permits Requisition to the technical superintendent in charge 
 
via email. 
2.2 
机务总管需对前述风险评估报告的完整性、有效性，以及热工作业申请表所载内容进行全面审
 
核，经确认作业条件满足安全要求后，在热工作业申请表上履行签署手续。特殊情形下，若机务
 
总管无法签署申请表，可通过微信等便捷方式通知船长审批意见，后续及时补签完善表格    
 
并送交船长。

The technical superintendent in charge shall conduct a comprehensive review of the completeness and 
 
validity of the aforementioned risk assessment report, as well as the contents stated in the Hot Work 
 
Permits Requisition. After confirming that the working conditions meet the safety requirements, he 
 
shall sign the Hot Work Permits Requisition. 
 In special circumstances, if the technical superintendent is unable to sign the application form , he 
may first notify the master of the approval opinion via convenient means such as WeChat, and 
subsequently complete the signature on the form in a timely manner and submit it to the master. 
  
2.3 
船长须在取得机务总管批准的热工作业申请表后，方可正式签发热工作业许可证。 
 
The captain may formally issue the hot work permit only after obtaining the Hot Work permits 
 
Requisition approved by the technical superintendent in charge. 
2.4 
热工作业完成后，船长应在“热工作业申请表”上填写作业完成情况和完工时间并签署，然后将
 
此表发送船管部。 
 
Upon completion of hot work operations, the Master shall complete the Hot Work Permit Application 
 
Form, detailing the work performed and the time of completion, and sign it. The form shall then be 
 
submitted to the fleet Department of company. 
3 
热工作业安全操作规定 
 
Regulations on the safe operations of hot work 
 
大副或轮机长在施焊前应对所进行的作业做出风险评估，并依据“热工作业检查表”
 
进行检查和填写，大副和轮机长相互告知该项作业，如需，提供必要的协助。下列
 
几种情况应予以考虑并采取防护措施： 
 
The Chief Officer or the Chief Engineer shall assess the risks of work to done prior to the 
 
start of welding, and check item by item and fill in the Hot Work Checklist, The C/O and 
 
C/E should inform each other about the hot work, if need, give some assistances. Taking 
 
the following conditions into consideration and taking preventative measures: 
3.1 
电焊线、氧气、乙炔管应妥善铺设，避免在运转的设备上方、热源附近、及油、水中通过，避免
 
打结、扭曲并防止砸、割、烫等造成的损坏。 
 
Welding wire, oxygen and acetylene hoses should be properly laid, to avoid passing over the running 
 
equipment, near a heat source, or through oil and water, and tying and twisting, and to prevent 
 
damages caused due to smashing, cutting and ironing. 
3.2 
热工作业施工现场及可能危及到的处所必须配备消防器材等。 
 
 The hot work site and spaces that may be possibly endangered must be equipped with fire-fighting 
appliances. 
3.3 
在实施烧焊、火焰切割或其他热工作业前，仔细检查工作区域内、区域以下或附近处所，清除可
 
能由火花、热力点燃的可燃固体、液体和气体。 
 
Prior to conducting welding, gas cutting and other hot work, spaces in, below or near the work site 
 
shall be carefully checked, so as to eliminate flammable solids, liquids and gases that may be ignited 
 
by sparks or heat. 
3.4 
在装有油脂、污油或其他可燃物体的表面严禁进行热工作业。

It is strictly prohibited to perform hot work on the surface where grease, sump oil or other flammable 
 
objects are loaded. 
3.5 
关闭或专人看护火花可能飞溅到的舷窗及其他开口。 
 
Side lights and other openings to which sparks may spatter shall be closed or guarded by dedicated 
 
person. 
3.6 
在舱壁、甲板、天花板或其附近进行热工作业时，注意检查隔板的另一面，以及设有电线、管道
 
或其他设施会受到的热力或静电影响。 
 
When performing hot work on or in the vicinity of bulkheads, decks and ceilings, attention shall be 
 
paid to check the other side of the partition, as well as wires, pipes, or other facilities that may be 
 
impacted by heat or electrostatic effects. 
3.7 
在封闭处所、舷外、高空进行热工作业还必须遵守相关作业的安全规定。 
 
Relevant safety regulations must be followed when carrying out hot work in enclosed spaces, 
 
overboard or aloft. 
3.8 
严禁焊、割带有压力的容器、管路。对有残余易燃、易爆物质的容器作业时，必须先清洗干净、
 
通风并经过测氧、测爆符合作业要求后方可进行。 
 
It is strictly prohibited to weld or cut pressurized containers and pipes. When working on vessels 
 
inside which residues of flammable and explosive substances remain, such vessels must be first 
 
cleaned off and ventilated, and then test against oxygen and explosive substances; hot work shall only 
 
be carried out if the test results meet requirements. 
3.9 
在对有色金属、合金、镀锌件以及油漆或其他保护敷料的工件进行热工作业时，可能会产生烟
 
雾。空气中的含氧量可能会降低，更可能产生有毒气体。必须注意通风。 
 
When performing hot work on non ferrous metal, alloy and galvanized parts and other workpieces 
 
with protective coatings, smoke may occur during work. Oxygen levels in the air may drop, and more 
 
likely to produce toxic gases. Attention must be paid to ventilation. 
3.10 
在空气流通不畅的处所作业时，要特别注意通风，施焊时间不宜过长，照明灯具必须使用低压
 
安全灯具，引线尽可远离施工区域，或对引线采取保护措施。 
 
When performing hot work in a space where air circulation is insufficient, attention shall be especially 
 
paid to ventilation; the welding time shall not be long, and the lighting must be low voltage safety 
 
lighting devices, the lead of which shall be away from the hot work site as far as possible, or protected 
 
by protective measures. 
3.11 
在施工完毕必须切断焊机电源，将焊钳、焊线、工具整理归位，施焊工件完全冷却后才可离去，
 
并在以后的两个小时内派专人对动火施工现场及周围区域进行不定期的循环检查，以防死灰复
 
燃。 
 
Upon completion of work, the power supply of the welding machine must be disconnected, and the 
 
electrode holder, welding wire and tools shall be put back to their original places. The operator shall 
 
wait until the welding workpiece is completely cooled down before leaving, and send dedicated person 
 
over within two hours from then to carry out continuous inspections against the hot work site and 
 
nearby areas from time to time, so as to avoid fire caused by those workpieces. 
3.12 
同步作业Simultaneous Operations（SIMOPS）

3.12.1 动火作业与密闭舱室作业、高空作业、电气作业等多项作业交叉开展时，必须严格遵守体系规
 
定，取得所有对应作业许可后方可施工作业。 
 
If multiple overlapping operations such as hot work, confined space work, working aloft and electrical 
 
work are carried out simultaneously, relevant system regulations must be strictly followed,and all 
 
corresponding work permits shall be obtained before commencement. 
3.12.2 若外部作业会对动火作业安全构成威胁，须按体系要求落实安全管控。如在带电设 备上实施动 
 
火作业，必须先切断设备电源，并严格执行《锁闭挂牌规定》 (SHIP-02-21)。 
 
If external operations pose a threat to the safety of hot work, safety control measures shall be 
 
implemented in accordance with the system requirements. When conducting hot work on live 
 
equipment, the power supply of the equipment must be cut off first, and the provisions of the 
 
Regulations on Lock Out / Tag Out  (SHIP-02-21) shall be strictly followed. 
3.12.3 出现以下情况时需立即暂停同步作业：作业条件变化、启动应急程序、天气条件恶化、需开展关
 
键作业。 
 
The simultaneous operation must be immediately suspended under the following circumstances: 
 
changes in operation conditions, activation of emergency procedures, deterioration of weather 
 
conditions, or the need to carry out key operations. 
4 
严格遵守“十不准烧”的安全规定 
 
Strict Compliance with the Safety Regulations of the 10 Prohibitions of Hot Work 
4.1 
不是电、气焊工或无操作证且又无持证焊割工在场指导的不准烧。 
 
It is prohibited to carry out hot work if the operator is not an electric or gas welding operator or does 
 
not hold a qualification certificate, and there is not qualified welding and cutting operator offering 
 
guidance at site. 
4.2 
在容器或狭小舱室内无人监护不准烧。 
 
It is prohibited to carry out hot work in unattended containers or narrow spaces. 
4.3 
不了解焊、割地点周围情况（如该处是否能动用明火，有无易燃易爆物品等）不准烧。 
 
It is prohibited to carry out hot work if the nearby situation of the welding or cutting site is unknown 
 
(such as whether it is allowed to use naked flame, or if there is flammable and explosive substances 
 
and etc.). 
4.4 
不了解焊割物内部是否有易燃易爆的危险性不准烧。 
 
It is prohibited to carry out hot work if there is flammable or explosive substances inside the items to 
 
be welded or cut. 
4.5 
盛装过易燃易爆的液体、气体的容器（如钢瓶、油箱、贮罐等）或管子等未经彻底清洗的不准烧。 
 
It is prohibited to carry out hot work if vessels or pipes used to hold flammable and explosive liquids 
 
and gases (such as steel bottles, fuel tanks, storage tanks and etc.) are not thoroughly cleaned. 
4.6 
用可燃材料（如塑料、软木等）作保温层、冷却层、隔音、隔热的部位或火星能飞溅到的地方，
 
未经采取切实可靠的安全措施之前不准烧。 
 
It is prohibited to carry out hot work if positions, where combustible materials (such as plastics, cork, 
 
etc.) are used for thermal insulation, cooling, sound insulation and heat insulation, or where sparks 
 
may spatter to, are not protected via feasible and reliable safety measures. 
4.7 
有压力或密封的容器、管子等不准烧。

It is prohibited to carry out hot work against pressurized or sealed vessels and pipes. 
4.8 
焊、割处所附近有易燃易爆物品，在未经清理或采取有效的安全措施之前，不准烧。 
 
It is prohibited to carry out hot work if there are flammable and explosive substances in the vicinity of 
 
welding or cutting site and such substances are not cleaned off or effective safety measures are not 
 
taken. 
4.9 
在特殊区域内，未经消防和港口安全部门批准不准烧。 
 
It is prohibited to carry out hot work at special areas without approval from the fire-fighting and port 
 
safety authorities. 
4.10 
附近如有与热工作业相抵触的工种在作业（如装油、油漆、喷涂202 胶水等）不准烧。 
 
It is prohibited to carry out hot work if there are other conflicting operations being carried out in the 
 
vicinity (such as bunkering fuel, loading paints, applying 202 glue and etc.). 
5 
电焊作业安全注意事项 
 
Safety precautions of welding operations 
5.1 
操作员必须熟知电焊设备的性能、操作程序和安全使用须知。 
 
The operator must be familiarized with the performance, operating procedures and safety instructions 
 
of the welding machine. 
5.2 
操作员必须穿戴带有适当过滤强光的烧焊护罩或烧焊护目罩（只建议气体焊接和火焰切割使用护
 
目镜）、皮质防护手套、专用电气焊保护服和绝缘鞋。 
 
The operator should normally wear welding shields or welding goggles with appropriate shade of filter 
 
for welding（goggles are only recommended for gas welding and flame cutting）, leather gauntlets, 
 
dedicated protective clothing for electric and gas welding purposes and insulated shoes. 
5.3 
操作员站在水中，或身体的任何部分浸在水里时，不得进行烧焊作业。 
 
It is prohibited to conduct welding operations if the operator is standing in water or any part of his 
 
body is immersed in water. 
5.4 
如果焊接是在高温或潮湿的条件下进行，则会增加操作人员触电的风险;身体出汗和衣服受潮大
 
大降低了身体的抵抗力。在这种情况下，应推迟作业，直到能够达到足够的安全水平为止。 
 
There are increased risks of electric shock to the operator if welding is done in hot or humid conditions; 
 
body sweat and damp clothing greatly reduce body resistance. Under such conditions, the operation 
 
should be deferred until such time that an adequate level of safety can be achieved. 
5.5 
操作员衣服尤其是所戴的手套尽量保持干爽，以免触电。 
 
The clothing of the operator, especially the gloves, must be kept in a dry condition to avoid electric 
 
shock. 
5.6 
在狭窄的场地内，电焊操作员身体可能会碰触到周围的金属结构，应使用干绝缘垫和其他非导电
 
材料隔离身体与周围的金属结构。 
 
In a narrow place where the operator’s body may touch the metal structures around, a dry insulation 
 
pad and other non-conductive materials shall be used to insulate the body against surrounding metal 
 
structures. 
5.7 
操作员应尽量避免在潮湿及高热下施焊，这样极易发生触电危险。 
 
The operator should try to avoid carrying out welding operations under wet and high temperature 
 
conditions, which may be extremely likely to cause electric shock.

5.8 
烧焊完成时，或暂停工作，应将焊条从电焊钳上取出并切断电源。 
 
Upon completion or suspension of the welding operation, electrodes should be removed from the 
 
electrode holder and power supply and the power shall be disconnected. 
5.9 
在敲打焊渣时必须戴防护眼镜，并注意敲打的角度以防碎屑飞溅伤人。 
 
When hammering welding slag, safety goggles must be worn, and attention shall be paid to the 
 
hammering angle, so as to prevent debris from spattering around, thus to cause person injuries. 
5.10 
电焊机应保持干燥，金属外壳必须可靠接地，电焊机及其周围禁止堆放杂物。 
 
The welding machine should be kept in a dry condition, and the metal housing must be reliably 
 
grounded, and furthermore, it is prohibited to stack miscellaneous items on and in the vicinity of the 
 
welding machine. 
5.11 
电焊钳，电缆绝缘必须保持完好，没有任何一个带电体外露，以免发生触电危险。 
 
The insulation of the electrode holder cable must be kept intact, with no charged part exposed, so as to 
 
avoid the risk of electric shock. 
5.12 
电焊机和接线的各部分接头要牢固，导电良好；在发生故障或拆、接电缆线时必须先切断电源后
 
再进行检修作业。 
 
All joints between the welding machine and the wiring must be firmly secured, and in a good 
 
conductive condition; and in the event of failure or demolition and connection of cables, the power 
 
source must be disconnected prior to the performance of the overhaul operation. 
5.13 
禁止在施焊过程中调整工作电流, 开机后应逐步调整电流，施焊间隙应注意防止焊钳、焊条碰地，
 
必须在绝缘物体上安放稳妥。 
 
It is prohibited to adjust the working current during welding operations. The working current shall be 
 
adjusted gradually after the welding machine is switched on, and during welding intervals, attention 
 
shall be paid to prevent the electrode and the holder from touching the ground, and they shall be 
 
securely placed on an insulated object. 
5.14 
焊工在焊接过程中应连续值班，对意外触电危险保持警惕，随时切断电源，及时报警，及时进行
 
人工呼吸。如果要在困难的条件下进行这项工作，最好再雇一名助手。 
 
An assistant should be in continuous attendance during welding operations and they should be alert to 
 
the risk of accidental shock to the welder and ready to cut off power instantly, raise the alarm and 
 
provide artificial respiration without delay. It may be desirable to have a second assistant if the work is 
 
to be carried out in difficult conditions. 
6 
气焊（割）作业安全注意事项 
 
Safety precautions of gas welding (and cutting) operations 
6.1 
气焊（割）操作员必须熟知气焊（割）设备的性能、构造及操作规程和安全使用规定。 
 
The operator must be familiarized with performance, structure, operating procedures and safety 
 
instructions of the gas welding (and cutting) equipment. 
6.2 
必须使用合格的氧气、乙炔瓶及氧气、乙炔胶管。氧气瓶、乙炔瓶不使用时要分开贮存在不同的
 
舱中，旋紧保护盖并固定，保持舱室空气流通。空、重瓶分别存放并有明显的标记。气瓶的放置
 
应有可靠绝缘铺垫以防气瓶带电，并配置回火控制器。

It is a must to use qualified oxygen and acetylene bottles as well as oxygen and acetylene hoses. When 
 
not in use, the oxygen bottles and acetylene bottles shall be stored in separate spaces, and the 
 
protective lid must be tightened and secured, while air circulation shall be kept in the space. Empty  
 
and heavy bottles shall be stored separately and clearly identified. Reliable insulation pads shall be 
 
used at the place for storing gas bottles, so as to prevent the bottles from being charged with electricity, 
 
and backfire controller shall also be equipped. 
6.3 
每年测试固定氧气和乙炔气体分配管路系统并由轮机长做好记录。 
 
Fixed Oxygen and Acetylene gas distribution piping system should be tested annually and recorded by 
 
Responsible Chief Engineer. 
6.4 
在移动、储存和使用气瓶的全过程严禁碰撞和敲击气瓶。气瓶放置、使用应远离高温、明火、熔
 
融金属飞溅物和易燃、易爆物品，相距不得小于10 米，禁止曝晒。 
 
Collision and knocking of the bottles are strictly prohibited during the whole process of moving, 
 
storage and use of the bottles. Gas bottles shall be placed and used away from high temperature, naked 
 
flame, molten metal splash as well as flammable and explosive materials, with a distance not less than 
 
10 meters, and exposure to direct sunlight is prohibited. 
6.5 
使用前必须对气瓶外部进行检查，重点检查瓶阀、接口螺纹，如发现异常须及时妥善处理后才能
 
使用。气瓶内气体不得用尽，氧气瓶至少保留0.2Mpa，乙炔瓶余气要大于0.05Mpa。 
Before the use of the bottles, inspection shall be carried out against the exterior of the bottle, focusing 
on the check of bottle valve and joint threads, and in case of any abnormal condition found, proper 
measures shall be taken to address them prior to use. The gas in the bottle shall not be exhausted, and 
at least 0.2Mpa shall be remained in the oxygen bottle, while the remaining gas in the acetylene 
bottle shall be greater than 0.05Mpa. 
6.6 
气瓶、气阀不得沾有油脂，不得使用沾有油污的手套、棉纱、工具及穿着油污工作服接触气瓶。
 
焊（割）设备及其零件不得沾有油污，防止氧气遇油脂剧烈燃烧。 
 
Gas bottles and valves shall not be stained with grease, and shall not be in contact with greasy gloves, 
 
cotton yarn, tools and grease stained work clothes. Welding (cutting) torch and its components shall 
 
not be stained with grease dirt, so as to prevent fierce combustion of grease due to contact with 
 
oxygen. 
6.7 
安装减压器前，必须首先使瓶口朝着避开人体、火源的方向稍微打开瓶阀吹除瓶口杂质，开阀应
 
缓慢。装卸减压阀时必须注意连接螺丝是否滑丝，以免旋装不牢泄漏而发生事故。 
 
Prior to the installation of pressure reducer, it is a must to first let the bottle mouth facing the opposite 
 
direction of the human body and the fire source, and open the bottle valve slightly to blow off the 
 
impurities at the mouthpiece. The valve shall be opened gradually. During installation and disassembly 
 
of pressure reducer, attention must be paid to check if the connecting screw is smooth, so as to avoid 
 
accidents due to leakage caused by insecure tightening. 
6.8 
减压器表面要清洁，严禁油污，气压表要准确。减压器如遇冻结时应用蒸汽或热水解冻，严禁火
 
烤。定期检查减压器。

The surface of the pressure reducer shall be kept clean and free of oil stain, and the air pressure gauge 
 
must be accurate. In case that the pressure reducer is frozen, steam or hot water shall be used to thaw, 
 
and it is strictly prohibited to bake with fire. Regular inspections shall be conducted to the pressure 
 
reducer. 
6.9 
施焊（割）时应正确调整氧气、乙炔的出口压力（氧气0.3—0.5Mpa，乙炔0.01—0.05Mpa）。 
 
焊（割）把手使用前必须进行吸射检查。无吸射能力严禁使用。检查胶管与焊（割）设备间连接 
 
有否漏气，确认无漏气方能使用。开启顺序先开乙炔气阀→点火→逐渐打开氧气阀；关闭顺序先
 
关氧气阀，再关乙炔阀。 
 
During welding (cutting) operations, the outlet pressure of oxygen and acetylene (oxygen 0.3 - 0.5Mpa, 
 
acetylene 0.01 - 0.05Mpa) shall be correctly adjusted. Injection inspection must be carried out prior to 
 
the use of welding (cutting) torches. It is strictly prohibited to use torches without injection capability. 
 
Inspection shall be carried out to check if there is any leakage at the connection between the rubber 
 
hoses and the welding (cutting) torches, and to confirm that no gas leakage is present prior to use. The 
 
start operating sequence is: open the acetylene valve→ ignition→ gradually open the oxygen valve; 
 
and the shutdown operating sequence is to turn off the oxygen valve first, and then close the acetylene 
 
valve. 
6.10 
焊（割）把手作业使用时间过长，如有发热必须立即停止使用，并采取冷却措施防止回火。 
 
In case that the welding (cutting) torch is operating for an extended duration, if heating occurs, the 
 
operation must be immediately stopped, and cooling measures shall be taken to prevent backfire. 
6.11 
在氧气、乙炔阀均开启状况下，严禁用手或其它物体堵住焊嘴，以防氧气进入乙炔管倒流入乙炔
 
瓶，引起爆炸。 
 
In the event that the oxygen and acetylene valves are both open, it is strictly prohibited to block the 
 
welding nozzle with hand or other objects, so as to prevent the oxygen from getting into the acetylene 
 
hose, and back flowing into the acetylene bottle, thus causing explosion. 
6.12 
焊（割）把手在操作间歇时必须关闭气源，放置于空气流通的地方。严禁放在容器（桶、柜）舱
 
口等空气流通不畅的地方，以免焊（割）具泄漏的易燃混合气体滞留引起燃爆事故。 
 
At the operating intervals of the welding (cutting) torch, gas source must be turned off, and stored in a 
 
place where air circulation is present. It is strictly prohibited to place them at the hatch of containers 
 
(barrels and tanks) and other places where the air circulation is not smooth, so as to prevent the 
 
flammable mixed gas leaked from the welding (cutting) torch from retaining, and thus to cause 
 
combustion and explosion accident. 
6.13 
焊（割）把手使用完毕应彻底切断气源，挂在空气流通的地方。严禁带气源的焊(割)具放入工具
 
箱、物料间。 
 
Upon completion of operating the welding (cutting) torch, gas source must be completely turned off, 
 
and hung in a place where air circulation is present. It is strictly prohibited to place the welding 
 
(cutting) torch still with gas source attached into the toolbox or provision rooms. 
6.14 
氧气管与乙炔管不准互为代用，不准用氧气吹除乙炔管内的阻塞物。氧气管为蓝色，乙炔管为红
 
色，严禁用其它胶管代用。

7 
风险评估 
 
Risk Assessment 
7.1 
在进行风险评估时，应考虑到下列因素： 
 
The following factors should be taken into account when conducting risk assessment: 
7.1.1 热工作业检查表和许可证是否完成并到达许可； 
 
If complete the inspections in the Hot Work Checklist and take the Permit. 
7.1.2 一旦作业过程中有紧急情况发生，救助器材和施救方案的及时性和有效性； 
 
The timeliness and effectiveness of the rescue equipment and rescue plan, in case that an emergency 
 
occurs during the operation; 
7.1.3 操作过程中其他可合理预见到的风险（例如：火灾、爆炸、绊倒、跌落、窒息、触电和烧伤）。 
 
Other reasonably foreseeable risks during the operation（fire, explosion, trips, falls, asphyxiation, 
 
electric shock and burn injury）. 
7.2 
对操作过程中已识别的风险进行综合评估后，根据风险的可能性和危害程度，确定风险级别，评
 
估已采取的防范措施的充分性，如果不充分，应进一步采取额外措施，将风险级别降低到可容忍
 
程度，方可进行相关作业。 
 
Upon comprehensive assessment of the risks identified during the operation, risk levels shall be 
 
determined according to possibility and degree of harm of the risks, so as to evaluate the adequacy of 
 
the preventive measures taken, and if the measures are not adequate, further additional measures shall 
 
be taken to reduce the level of risk to a tolerable degree prior to the start of relevant operations. 
7.3 
如果在操作过程中采取了额外措施，作业完成后，相关负责人应对所采取的额外措施进行有效性
 
评估，并提出改进建议。 
 
If additional measures are taken during the operation, upon completion of the work, relevant 
 
responsible person shall evaluate the effectiveness of the additional measures taken and put forward 
 
recommendations for improvement.

第07 节 开关舱作业的安全规定 
Section 07 Regulation on Hatch Cover Operation 
 
1.0 开关舱人员熟知开关舱操作程序及相互间的联系信号。 
The hatch opening and closing operators shall be familiar with the operating procedures of hatch opening 
and closing and the contact signals between them. 
2.0 开关舱由专人指挥，指挥者必须熟悉本轮开关舱设备的性能，参与操作人员必须将劳
动保护用品穿戴整齐。作业前，要对开关舱设备、绳索、属具进行检查，如发现异常
时，应停止作业，严禁凑合使用。 
Hatch opening and closing operations shall be directed by dedicated personnel, who must be familiar with 
the performance of shipboard hatch opening and closing equipment, and the operators involved must wear 
labour protection equipment in a neat manner. Prior to operation, inspections shall be carried out to check 
the devices, ropes and accessories used for hatch opening and closing, and in case of abnormal condition 
identified, the operation shall be stopped, and it is strictly prohibited to use without addressing the issues. 
3.0 操作前，指挥者要围绕舱口巡视一周，边巡视边呼喊警示他人，确认舱盖上及周围无
人、导轨上无障碍物、制动销全部摘除、紧固件全部打开后方可下令开关舱。 
Prior to operation, the person in charge of commanding shall patrol around the hatch and shout loud to 
warn others during patrolling, so as to confirm that there is no person on and in the vicinity of the hatch 
covers, no obstacles on the guiding rails, the detent pins are all removed, and the fasteners are all 
loosened before giving instructions to open or close the hatch.  
4.0 开关舱操作者在听到指挥员的开关舱命令后，先大声复诵命令，然后确认操作手柄的
正确开关方向后，大声呼喊警示他人，而后才可操作。  
Upon hearing the order to open or close hatch from the commanding personnel, the hatch opening and 
closing operator shall first repeat the order loudly, and then shout loud to warn others upon confirming the 
correct opening and closing direction of the operating handle, after which shall the operation be started 
formally.   
5.0 开启钢质机械链条（钢丝绳）拉动式，折叠式液压舱盖时应注意： 
When opening hatch covers that are pulled by steel chains (or ropes) and folding type hydraulic hatch 
covers, attention shall be given to the following:  
5.1 船应保持正浮且无较大吃水差，以防止舱盖出轨事故发生。 
The ship shall be kept to upright position without too big trim, so as to prevent the hatch cover from 
running out of the rails.   
5.2 开关舱时严禁任何人上下舱盖，严禁将手脚放于舱盖、导轨上，所有人员必须避开钢
丝绳、链条和舱盖危及的范围。 
During hatch opening and closing operations, it is strictly prohibited for any one to go upwards or 
downwards the hatch covers, or put hands and feet on the hatch covers or guide rails. All personnel must 
avoid entering into the range where the steel wire rope, chain and hatch covers may endanger. 
5.3 操车要慢，要使钢丝绳、舱盖链条、舱盖缓慢均匀地受力。 
Operation shall be gradually carried out, so that the lashing wire rope, hatch cover chains and hatch 
covers bear the force evenly and gradually.  
5.4 打开的舱盖应可靠到位，并打上制动销或保险钩。 
The opened hatch cover shall be reliably in place, and secured wih detent pin or safety hook.  
6.0 关闭钢质机械链条（钢丝绳）式、折叠式液压舱盖时应注意： 
When closing hatch covers that are pulled by steel chains (or ropes) and folding type hydraulic hatch 
covers, attention shall be given to the following:

6.1 应遵循先挂关舱钢丝，后解脱保险钩，再动车关舱的操作顺序。 
The operating sequence shall be observed: first hang the hatch closing wire rope, release the safety hook 
and then run the closing mechanism to close the hatch. 
6.2 确认挂关舱钢丝的人员已到安全位置以及舱盖危及范围内无人后，方可 操作。 
The operation shall not be started until it is confirmed that the person to hang the steel wire rope for hatch 
closing has reached a safe position and there is no person present in the range where the hatch cover may 
endanger. 
6.3 必须保持舱盖在导轨上运行平稳、不扭曲。 
The hatch covers must be kept stable and not distorted on the rails. 
6.4 风雪雨天或视线不良时，要特别谨慎操作。 
Special caution shall be taken in case of windy, snowy and rainy weather or restricted visibility.  
6.5 开关舱盖出现故障时，应在安全位置采取可靠措施予以排除。 
In the event of breakdown of the hatch covers, reliable safety measures shall be taken at a safe position to 
eliminate the breakdown. 
6.6 禁止在货舱有人的情况下进行开关舱作业。 
It is prohibited to carry out hatch opening and closing operations if there is still person present in the 
cargo holds.  
7.0 海上开关舱注意事项 
Precautions for opening and closing hatches at sea 
7.1 航行期间开舱必须经船长批准。 
Approval must be obtained from the Master for opening hatches during voyages.  
7.2 除进行清舱作业、对货舱及舱盖临时修理或检查货物外，不可开舱航行，舱盖打开后
应妥善固定。 
Except for hold cleaning, temporary repair of cargo holds and hatch covers or inspection of cargoes, it is 
not allowed to sail with the hatches in an opening condition. The hatches shall be properly secured after 
opening. 
7.3 除特殊情况外，在夜间、大风浪、雾航时严禁开舱。船长在开舱前要认真观测和分析
气象，按照“船舶现场操作风险评估程序规定”进行风险评估。当风力超过6 级和船
舶横摇超过5 度，不可开舱，以确保船舶及设备的安全。 
Unless there is a special circumstance, it is strictly prohibited to open hatches at night, in wind waves or 
navigating in restricted visibility. Prior to opening the hatches, the Master must carefully observe and 
analyze the weather, and perform risk assessment according to the Regulations for Shipboard On-Site 
Operational Risk Assessment. In the event that the wind is over a wind scale of 6 and the heel of the ship 
rolls over 5 degrees, it is not allowed to open hatches, so as to ensure the safety of the ship and equipment 
on board.

第08 节 货舱进入安全管理规定 
Section 08 Safety Management Regulations for Cargo Hold Entry 
 
1 
适用范围Scope of Application 
本规定适用于公司管理船舶的船员日常货舱进入作业，以及港内装卸货期间装卸工
人进入货舱作业的所有安全管理行为。 
This regulation applies to all safety management activities related to crew members' daily entry into 
cargo holds of ships managed by the company, as well as stevedores' entry into cargo holds during 
cargo loading and unloading at ports. 
2 
通用安全管控要求General Safety Control Requirements 
2.1 
货舱入口锁闭管理（Lock Management of Cargo Hold Access） 
2.1.1 
载运货物航行途中，各下舱道门均应保持锁闭，钥匙由船长统一保管。 
During the voyage with cargo on board, all cargo hold access doors shall be kept locked, and the 
keys shall be uniformly kept by the Master. 
2.1.2 
船舶在港期间，未与工头联合确认货舱内大气安全前，各下舱道门均应保持锁闭，
钥匙由船长统一保管。 
During the port stay, all cargo hold access doors shall be kept locked with keys uniformly held by 
the Master until the Master and the stevedore foreman jointly confirm that the atmosphere inside the 
cargo hold is safe. 
2.1.3 
若货舱内的澳洲梯处于封闭围井内，在未确认围井内大气安全之前，该澳洲梯入口
也应保持锁闭。 
If the Australian ladders in the cargo hold are located in closed trunks, the access to such ladders 
shall also be kept locked until the atmosphere inside the trunks is confirmed safe. 
2.2 
通风及防擅自进入要求（Ventilation and Unauthorized Entry Prevention） 
当打开货舱道门盖来提供自然通风时，可能会使人误以为里面的空气是安全的，因
此应在入口处安排船员值守，或者使用机械式障碍物（如绳子或铁链）拦在入口处
并悬挂警告标识，以防止意外进入。该情况需在交接班时进行交接。 
When opening cargo hold access covers for natural ventilation, it may lead to the misunderstanding 
that the internal air is safe. Therefore, a crew member shall be assigned to stand guard at the 
entrance, or mechanical barriers (such as ropes or iron chains) shall be used to block the entrance 
with warning signs posted to prevent unauthorized entry. This situation shall be handed over during 
shift change. 
2.3 
进入通用前置要求（General Pre-entry Requirements） 
任何人员进入货舱前，均需按规定完成充分通风、气体检测及安全确认，获得相应
批准并采取防护措施后方可进入。 
Before any personnel enter the cargo hold, sufficient ventilation, gas detection, and safety 
confirmation shall be completed in accordance with relevant regulations. Entry is only permitted 
after obtaining the corresponding approval and taking protective measures. 
3 
船员进入货舱安全须知Safety Instructions for Crew Entering the Cargo Hold 
3.1 
安全须知 Safety Instructions 

153

货舱作业的安全规定 
Regulation on Operation in Hold 
版本/修改：3.0/1.0 
Ver./Rev.: 3.0/1.0 
SHIP-02-08 
SHIP-02-08 
 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd 
生效日期：2026/06/26 
Effective Date: 2026/06/26 
第2/9页 
Page: 2/9 
 
3.1.1 
船员在航期间进入货舱前，需依据《SHIP-02-05 进入封闭处所的安全规定》要求进
行，获得许可后由船长签发进入许可并领取入口钥匙。 
Before crew members enter the cargo hold during navigation, they shall comply with the 
requirements of SHIP-02-05 Safety Rules for Enclosed Space Entry. After obtaining 
approval, the master shall issue an entry permit and the crew shall collect the access key. 
3.1.2 
单人禁止进入，必须 2 人及以上结伴作业，且指定专人在舱口全程监护。 
Entry by a single person is prohibited; at least two crew members shall work in pairs, and a 
designated person shall stand guard at the hatch throughout the operation. 
3.1.3 
进入前穿戴齐全防护装备（工作服、工作鞋、安全帽、手套），携带对讲机、手电
筒（夜间 / 舱盖关闭时），高空 / 临边作业系安全绳、安全带。 
Before entry, wear complete personal protective equipment (PPE) including work clothes, work 
shoes, safety helmet, and gloves; carry a walkie-talkie and flashlight (for nighttime/hatch cover 
closed situations); use safety ropes and safety belts for high-altitude/edge operations. 
3.2 
船员舱内作业安全要求Safety Requirements for Crew's On-board Operations 
3.2.1 
上下货舱梯子需双手攀爬，严禁一手负重一手攀梯，梯口盖板必须插好安全销或用
挂钩挂牢，严禁随意开启。 
Climb the cargo hold ladder with both hands; it is strictly prohibited to climb with one hand 
carrying loads. The hatch access cover must be secured with safety pins or hooks and shall not be 
opened arbitrarily. 
3.2.2 
舱内及入口保持充足照明，便携式照明设备需固定在远离易燃物处，存在爆炸风险
时禁止使用便携式照明。 
Maintain adequate lighting inside the cargo hold and at the entrance. Portable lighting equipment 
shall be fixed away from flammable materials to avoid fire hazards; portable lights are prohibited if 
there is a risk of explosion. 
3.2.3 
舱内工具、物料需用吊车或绳索绑扎牢固运送，严禁抛掷；严禁同舱垂直上下同时
作业，严禁向低层抛掷任何物品。 
Tools and materials for on-board operations must be transported by crane or firmly bound with 
ropes; throwing is strictly prohibited. Simultaneous vertical operations in the same cargo hold are 
strictly prohibited, and throwing any items to lower levels is forbidden. 
3.2.4 
攀登护肋板作业前，确认羊角挂钩、护肋板搭挂牢固，作业时系安全绳、安全带；
有坠落危险的部位需设置警示并限制通行。 
Before climbing frame ribs for operations, confirm that the clevis hooks and frame ribs are securely 
fastened; wear safety ropes and safety belts during operations. Warning signs shall be set and access 
restricted for areas with falling hazards. 
3.2.5 
作业期间保持货舱持续通风，若感到头晕、异味等不适，立即与舱口监护人联络并
撤离货舱。 
Maintain continuous ventilation of the cargo hold during operations. If feeling dizzy, smelling 
unusual odors, or experiencing other discomfort, immediately contact the hatch guard and evacuate 
the cargo hold.

complete the operation record.

船员作业应急处置Emergency Disposal for Crew Operations 
3.3.1 
一旦货舱内发生危险，舱口值守人员应马上通知驾驶台值班人员或甲板值班人员，

Watch (OOW) on the bridge or the deck duty officer. The OOW or deck duty officer shall 
immediately sound the alarm and assemble personnel for rescue. Rescue entry into the cargo hold is 
prohibited without appropriate safety protection measures (such as not wearing a breathing 
apparatus).

4.1.1 
港内装卸货作业前，大副应提前完成货舱现场风险评估，结合货物性质、货舱状况、
通风条件出具评估报告，报船长审核确认。 
Before port cargo loading/unloading operations, the Chief Officer shall complete the on-site risk 
assessment of the cargo hold in advance, issue an assessment report considering cargo properties, 
cargo hold conditions, and ventilation status, and submit it to the Master for review and 
confirmation. 
4.1.2 
按要求对货舱进行充分通风（自然 / 机械通风），重点检查澳洲梯、直梯等通道
通风情况，通道下部被货物堵塞时需先清理再通风。 
Conduct sufficient ventilation of the cargo hold (natural/mechanical ventilation) as required, 
focusing on checking the ventilation of Australian ladders, straight ladders, and other passages. If 
the lower part of the passage is blocked by cargo, it shall be cleared before ventilation.

由适任人员使用经校准的气体检测设备，对货舱内氧气、二氧化碳、可燃气体、有

（SHIP-02-08-01）》。

oxygen, carbon dioxide, flammable gases, and toxic gases inside the cargo hold. The detection 
results must meet safety standards (oxygen: 19.5%-22%, CO₂: <0.5%, flammable gases: <1% 
LFL, toxic gases: <50% OEL), and fill in "Checklist of Cargo Hold Entry (SHIP-02-08-01)".

根据风险评估及检测结果，填写船舶处所简易示意图（附件 2），用 “可安全进入 
/ 进入不安全” 标识标注货舱及通道安全状态，张贴于船舶梯口处，大副签字确认。
Based on the risk assessment and detection results, fill in the simplified ship space diagram

(Appendix 2), mark the safety status of the cargo hold and passages with "Safe to Enter/Unsafe to

船长应在船舶梯口处放置关于封闭空间程序的简要说明以及一份商定的应急响应

Australian ladder passages) must be kept locked. The keys shall be uniformly kept by the Chief 
Officer, and unauthorized entry by any person is prohibited.

进入前船岸协同要求Ship-Shore Coordination Requirements Before Entry 
4.2.1 
装卸工人登船后，船方大副 / 值班驾驶员向其负责人或全体作业人员进行安全交
底，明确货舱安全状态、作业规范、应急撤离路线及禁止行为，确认其理解并遵守。 
After stevedores board the ship, the Chief Officer/OOW of the ship shall conduct safety briefing for 
their supervisor or all operating personnel, clarifying the cargo hold safety status, operational 
specifications, emergency evacuation routes, and prohibited behaviors, and confirming their

Stevedores must operate within the cargo hold and passages designated by the ship; entry into 
non-operational cargo holds, other enclosed spaces of the ship, and dangerous areas is prohibited. 
4.3.2 
进入货舱前需向船方现场监护人报备，按船方指令分批进入，严禁擅自单独进入货

Before entering the cargo hold, stevedores shall report to the ship's on-site guard and enter in 
batches in accordance with the ship's instructions. Unauthorized individual entry into the cargo hold 
is strictly prohibited, as well as climbing over or damaging cargo hold safety warnings and isolation 
facilities. 
4.3.3 
遵守船员现场安全指令，上下梯子需双手攀爬，严禁抛物、打闹，严禁在梯口、护

Enclosed Space Emergency Response Plan 
封闭处所应急响应计划 
Speed is of great importance when responding to an enclosed space rescue situation. However it should be 
borne in mind that ill-prepared rescue attempts, without proper equipment and human assistance, can lead to 
more casualties. The following are steps that should be taken during an enclosed space rescue situation: 
封闭处所救援响应，速度是非常重要的，但是必须谨记的是，没有适当的设备和人力协助的
准备不足的救援尝试，会导致更多的伤亡。以下是封闭处所救援时应该采取的步骤： 
1 
alarm has been sounded and information on the specific kind of emergency, including, location of the 
incident has been announced; 
发出警报并广播特定种类应急相关的信息，包括事故的位置； 
2 
Crew muster at their designated muster location; 船员在指定的集合地点集合； 
3 
 consult the Enclosed Space Register or Permit to Work, where details of the specific enclosed space in 
question are given. Pay particular attention to unique details of the enclosed space such as vertical ladders in 
the space, Australian l adders, access and egress points and any others to make rescue easier; 
查阅《封闭处所登记册》或作业许可证，其中包含有关特定封闭处所的详细信息。特别注意
封闭处所的特有的细节，诸如处所内的直梯、澳大利亚梯、进入点和出口点以及任何其他能
使救援更容易的细节； 
4 
as per the drill plan, the rescue team should don the self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) and prepare 
to enter the space and await instructions from the on-scene commander; 
按照演练计划，救援队应穿戴自给式呼吸器（SCBA）
，作好进入封闭处所的准备并等待现场指
挥员的指令； 
5 
 as time is of essence in enclosed space emergencies, the master should assess whether to alert the telemedical 
assistance service (TMAS) or to alert other medical assistance at shore to give support for the recue team on 
board and give more time for the shore-based rescue resources to arrive to ship; 
发生封闭处所紧急情况时，时间是至关重要的，船长应该评估是否通知远程医疗援助服务
（TMAS）或通知岸上其他医疗援助，以支持船上的救援队，并为岸基救援资源到达船舶提
供更多时间； 
6 
 In case the ship is at sea, possible deviation to a port of refuge should also be considered; 
如果船舶在海上，还应考虑绕航去避风港的可能性； 
7 
rescue team should have an on-scene commander, who will lead the rescue while one or more members will 
be assisting the commander; 
救援队应有一名现场指挥员，由现场指挥员指挥救援，同时有一名或多名队员协助现场指挥

第09 节 高空作业的安全规定 
Section 09 Regulations on the Safety of Working Aloft 
 
1.0 船舶高空作业是指在坠落高度基准面2 米以上有可能坠落处进行的作业。如在船舶桅
杆、雷达架上、上层建筑、烟囱、舷墙外部、空货舱、机炉舱顶部等处进行的作业。 
Work at height onboard a ship means work in any place over 2 meters from the datum plane where a 
person could fall and be injured, such as work carried out on the mast, radar frame, superstructure, 
chimney, exterior of bulwark, empty cargo hold, top of engine and boiler room, and etc. 
2.0 作业前由作业负责人勘查作业现场进行风险评估，向作业人员讲解安全注意事项。 
Prior to work, the responsible person shall survey the job site to carry out a risk assessment, and explain 
safety precautions to the operators. 
2.1 在进行风险评估时，应考虑到下列风险： 
The following risks should be taken into account when conducting risk assessment: 
 高空作业检查表中列明的相关风险； 
 Relevant risks stated in the Working aloft Checklist; 
 一旦作业过程中有紧急情况发生，救助器材和施救方案的及时性和有效性。 
The timeliness and effectiveness of the rescue equipment and rescue plan, in case that an emergency 
occurs during the operation; 
 操作过程中其他可合理预见到的风险。 
Other reasonably foreseeable risks during the operation. 
2.2 对操作过程中已识别的风险进行综合评估后，根据风险的可能性和危害程度，确定风
险级别，评估已采取的防范措施的充分性，如果不充分，应进一步采取额外措施，将
风险级别降低到可容忍程度，方可进行相关作业。 
Upon comprehensive assessment of the risks identified during the operation, risk levels shall be 
determined according to possibility and degree of harm of the risks, so as to evaluate the adequacy of the 
precautionary measures taken, and if the measures are not adequate, further additional measures shall be 
taken to reduce the level of risk to a tolerable degree prior to the start of relevant operations. 
3.0 现场负责人员要对作业的全过程负责，监督、指导作业人员正确使用安全带、保险绳
等防护用品。负责人员不得离开现场从事其他工作。 
The on-site responsible person shall be responsible for the whole process of operation, and supervise and 
guide the operators to correctly use protective tools such as safety belt, safety rope and etc. The 
responsible person shall not leave the site for other work. 
4.0 高处作业应派身体好、技术精的人员。不准实习期间的新船员和患有高血压、心脏病、
恐高症等禁忌症者参加高处作业。登高人员在作业中突感不适应立即报告，现场指挥
人员应给予重视和帮助。 
Strong and skilled personnel shall be selected for work at height. No new crew member during internship 
or personnel suffering from contraindications such as hypertension, heart disease, acrophobia and etc. 
shall be allowed to participate in work at height. The personnel working at height shall immediately 
report if feeling any sudden discomfort during work, and the on-site commanding person shall pay special 
attention to that and provide help. 
5.0 作业人员衣着必须穿戴工作服、工作鞋、安全帽，系安全带、保险绳及其它防护用品。 
Operators must wear overalls, work shoes, safety helmets, safety belts, safety ropes and other protective 
equipment. 
6.0 脚手架、跳板、坐板、梯子完好适用，并使用稳妥固定，吊索与座板使用鲁班结系固，
移动时必须由人力进行。便携式直梯工作角度为75±5 度，使用时必须有人护助并采

取防滑措施。禁止使用缺档的梯子，禁止两人同时在一个梯子上作业。 
Scaffolding, race board, sitting boards and ladders shall be intact and fit for use, and firmly secured, while 
the sling and sitting boards shall be fastened using Luban knot, and must be moved by human force. The 
movable straight ladder has a working angle of 75 + 5 degrees, and when in use, there must be dedicated 
person to protect and help and anti slippery measures shall be taken. It is prohibited to use ladder with 
missing rung, and it is prohibited for two persons to work on one single ladder at the same time. 
7.0 在进行高空搭跳板作业时必须使用足够强度的（直径20 毫米以上）吊踏板用的白棕绳，
事先检查绳索、跳板状况，确保绳索、跳板状况良好后才能使用。绳索使用后要悬挂
存放，禁止堆放在地板上。 
When performing tower crane operations at height, sisal ropes with sufficient strength (above 20 mm in 
diameter) for lifting pedals must be used; inspections shall be carried out in advance to check the 
conditions of the ropes and the race boards prior to use. Ropes shall be hung for storage after use and 
shall not be piled up on the floor. 
8.0 作业人员必须系好安全带，安全绳应悬挂在作业者的正上方固定可靠的装置上且不宜
过长，不得与座板同系一处，必须生根。 
Operators must fasten the safety belt, and the safety rope shall be hung on the securely fixed device right 
above the operator, and it should not be too long, and may not be tied to the same place with the seat 
board, and it must be firmly fixed. 
9.0 使用的工具、拆装的零部件必须放进吊桶，禁止随意放置避免坠落伤及他人，用吊绳
系好上下传送，禁止抛掷。 
Tools in use and parts for installation or from disassembly must be placed in the bucket, and it is 
prohibited to store at will, so as to avoid falling and injuring others. The bucket shall be tied firmly to 
ropes for sending up and down, and it is prohibited to throw those tools and parts. 
10.0 不允许在同一垂直方向的上、下部位同时作业。确需同时作业则必须设置安全隔离层。 
It is prohibited to carry out operations at the upper and lower parts along the same vertical direction at the 
same time. A safe isolation layer must be installed for simultaneous operation. 
11.0 在低强度顶棚上作业时必须铺设脚手板，以防止踩塌顶棚。在坡度较大的顶面作业应
采取防滑措施。 
When carrying out operations on a low strength roof, foot board must be laid to prevent collapsing of the 
roof. When carry out operations on a top surface with a big gradient, anti-slippery measures should be 
taken. 
12.0 作业现场应悬挂防坠落、防坠物的安全警示标志。指挥人员要监护作业现场下方的一
定范围内无人员通过。当必要、恰当时，须布置安全网。 
Safety warning signs shall be displayed at operating site to warn the dangers of falling and falling objects. 
The commander shall monitor a certain area below the operating site so as to ensure that no person is 
passing below. A safety net should be rigged where necessary and appropriate. 
13.0 在起货设备的使用过程中，禁止上桅杆、吊货柱等高处作业。在烟囱、汽笛、雷达天
线等处作业时必须事先向有关人员通报，并在以上设备处悬挂“有人作业，禁止使用”。 
During the process of using derrick and cargo handling gear, it is prohibited to carry out operations at 
height on the mast or cargo davits. When carrying out operations on places such as chimney, siren and 
radar aerial, notification must be given to persons concerned in advance, and warning signs such as 
“Under operation, use prohibited” must be displayed on the above places. 
14.0 以下特殊情况的高处作业必须由船长批准： 
Work at height under the following special cases must be approved by the Master: 
 阵风风力6 级以上需要抢修时（必须采取可靠的安全措施）；

第10 节 舷外和水上作业的安全规定 
Section 10 Regulations of Outboard & On-water Operation 
 
1.0 在船舷外部工作（包括下软梯查看水尺）属于舷外作业；利用艇、筏等浮具在水上进
行工作属于水上作业，下列情况属舷外或水上作业： 
Works done outside the board (including draft reading by the ladder) belong to outboard operation; while 
works carried out on water via floating vehicles such as boat, raft belong on-water operation. Overboard 
or on-water operation include the following:  
 收、放舷梯、引水梯、挂安全网； 
Collect and rig accommodation ladder, pilot/combination ladder and rig safety nets; 
 下软梯察看水尺，或进行舷外检查； 
    Check draft by rope ladder, or conduct outboard inspection; 
 描涂水尺、载重线标志、船名等； 
    Paint draft and loadline markings, name of vessel etc.; 
 对船壳外板进行的除锈、刷漆、清洁及焊补作业等。 
Carry out operations such as de-rusting, painting, cleaning and welding to the shell plate of the hull. 
2.0 舷外和水上作业必须遵守下列安全规定： 
During outboard and on-water operations, the following safety regulations must be followed:  
2.1 必须按舷外和水上作业检查表检查，并经船长批准。 
Inspections must be carried out in accordance with the Outboard & On-water Work Checklist, and shall 
be approved by the Master. 
2.2 作业人员应穿戴救生衣、系安全带、安全绳，及其它适合安全作业的劳保防护用品。 
Operators shall wear life jackets, safety belts, safety ropes, and other suitable protection equipment for 
safe work. 
2.3 至少两人以上，禁止一人独自进行作业。 
Operations must be carried out by at least two persons, and it is prohibited for one person to carry out the 
job alone. 
2.4 在航行中、强风或大涌浪条件下，禁止舷外或水上作业。 
During the navigation, under strong winds or rough sea conditions, it is prohibited to carry out outboard 
or on-water works. 
2.5 选派身体好、技术高的人员进行作业。 
Strong and skilled personnel shall be selected for operations. 
2.6 作业前，水手长应讲解注意事项，布置安全措施，必要时应进行操作示范。 
Bosun should explain the necessary attentions during work and arrange precaution measures before 
operation, if necessary, he should do the operation demonstration. 
2.7 必须有专人在现场指挥、协助，不得随意离开；工具和物件要用专用工具袋传递，严
禁抛置；作业现场应放置带安全绳的救生圈。 
There must be a dedicated person on site for commanding and assistance, and such person shall not leave 
without permission; tools and articles shall be passed using special tool bags, and it is strictly prohibited 
to throw; operation site shall be equipped life buoys with ropes. 
2.8 事先通告有关人员关闭舷边出水阀，禁止使用与出水孔相连接的浴室、厕所等设备，
并通知机舱螺旋桨不得转动，必须系牢锚。 
Notice shall be given to relevant personnel in advance to notify the close of outboard outlet valve, and the 
use of equipment such as bathroom and toilet which are connected to the drain are prohibited, and inform 
the engine room that it is not allowed to rotate the propeller, the anchor should be firmly secured. 
2.9 在进行舷外搭跳作业时必须使用足够强度的（直径20 毫米以上）吊踏板用的白棕绳，

While rigging outboard stages, Manila ropes with sufficient strength (above 20 mm in diameter) for 
lifting stages must be used, check the ropes prior to use, ensure the ropes are in good condition. 
2.10 上下跳板或浮具时，应使用软梯，禁止人员随同浮具起落。 
When getting on and off stages or floating equipment, rope’s ladders shall be used, and it is prohibited for 
personnel to go up and down with the equipment. 
2.11 作业现场的指挥人员要时刻注意观察过往的船只，及时通知和提醒浮具上的工作人员。 
The commanding officer on site shall usually observe the passing by ships, and notify and remind 
operators on the floating equipment in time. 
2.12 舷外、水上作业人员应相互照顾，确保安全。 
Outboard and on-water operators shall take care of each other, to ensure safety. 
2.13 舷外使用跳板作业必须按高空作业的安全规定中有关条款执行。 
If stages are used for outboard operations, relevant provisions under the Regulations on the Safety of 
Working Aloft shall be followed. 
3.0 风险评估 
Risk Assessment 
3.1 在进行风险评估时，应考虑到下列风险： 
The following risks should be taken into account when conducting risk assessment: 
 舷外和水上作业检查表中列明的相关风险； 
Relevant risks stated in the Outboard & On-water Work Checklist; 
 一旦作业过程中有紧急情况发生，救助器材和施救方案的及时性和有效性； 
Once an emergency occurs, the timeliness and effectiveness of the rescue equipment and rescue plan 
should be taken into account; 
 操作过程中其他可合理预见到的风险。 
Other reasonably foreseeable risks during the operation. 
3.2 对操作过程中已识别的风险进行综合评估后，根据风险的可能性和危害程度，确定风
险级别，评估已采取的防范措施的充分性，如果不充分，应进一步采取额外措施，将
风险级别降低到可容忍程度，方可进行相关作业。 
Upon comprehensive assessment of the risks identified during the operation, risk levels shall be 
determined according to possibility and degree of harm of the risks, so as to evaluate the adequacy of the 
preventive measures taken, and if the measures are not adequate, further additional measures shall be 
taken to reduce the level of risk to a tolerable degree prior to the start of relevant operations. 
3.3 如果在操作过程中采取了额外措施，作业完成后，相关负责人应对所采取的额外措施
进行有效性评估，并提出改进建议。 
If additional measures are taken during the operation, upon completion of the work, relevant responsible 
person shall evaluate the effectiveness of the additional measures taken and put forward recommendations 
for improvement.
