第11 节 收放救生艇筏作业的安全规定 
Section 11 Regulations on the Safety of Survival Craft Launching and Recovery Operations 
 
1.0 救生艇筏的释放应遵守厂家说明书，遵守国际海事组织法规和指南的要求，避免发生
救生艇筏事故。 
The survival craft launching should comply with the manufacturer's instructions, comply with the 
requirements of IMO regulations and guidelines，to avoid survival craft accidents. 
2.0 在进行放艇作业和演习之前，应检查救生艇筏及其安全设备是否已按照船舶维护手册
和任何相关技术文件进行维护，并注意所有必要的预防措施。如有磨损或腐蚀的异常
情况应立即向负责人员报告。 
Before conducting the survival craft launching and drills, it should be checked that the survival craft and 
its safety equipment have been maintained in accordance with the ship’s maintenance manuals and any 
associated technical documentation, as well as noting all the precautionary measures necessary. Abnormal 
conditions of wear and tear or corrosion should be reported to the responsible officer immediately. 
3.0 放艇前，应进行空艇放、收试验（重力式）或模拟试验（自由降落式）一次，以确认
释放/回收装置是安全可靠的。 
Prior to lowering a lifeboat and rescue boat, an empty boat lower and recovery test (for gravity type) or a 
simulated test (for free fall type) shall be carried out, so as to confirm that the release/recovery devices are 
safe and reliable.  
4.0 全体人员必须穿戴工作服、工作鞋、安全帽、手套等防护用品，穿好救生衣，演习时
按应变部署表个人职责携带规定的物品，到指定的集合站集合。 
All operators must wear personnel protective equipment such as overalls, work shoes, safety helmets and 
gloves, as well as life jackets, if conduct drill, and carry along items needed for their duties specified 
under the Muster List, and muster at the designated muster station.  
5.0 在集合站列队、点名、报数，艇长核查艇员人数、着装、携带的物品。 
Line up, call names and count number of persons at the muster station. The coxswain shall review number 
of the crew, dresses and items carried.  
6.0 重力式救生艇收、放注意事项：  
Precautions on launching and recovery of gravity lifeboat:  
6.1 按照重力式救生艇收放检查表的相关内容进行检查，逐项确认后方可进行收放艇操作。 
Inspections shall be carried out according to relevant content of the Gravity Type Lifeboat Launching and 
Recovery Checklist, and confirmation must be done item by item before the launching and recovery 
operation. 
6.2 艇员按各自职责进行备艇工作；每个艇员完成自己职责规定的准备工作后，应及时、
明确地向艇长报告。 
The crew shall prepare the lifeboat according to their respective duties, and upon completion of the 
preparatory work required by their duties, each crew member shall report to the coxswain in a clear, 
timely manner. 
6.3 艇备妥后，人员远离救生艇下方（确保艇下无人），艇长向船长报告艇已备妥。 
Once the lifeboat is prepared, all personnel shall be away from the area below lifeboat (and confirm that 
no one is under the lifeboat), and the coxswain shall report to the Master that the lifeboat is well prepared. 
6.4 艇长巡视现场确认艇下无人、手摇把未在绞艇机上并大声呼喊警示他人后，方可按船
长命令下令放艇。 
The coxswain shall patrol the site to confirm that there is no person under the lifeboat and the hand crank 
handle is not on the winch, and shout loud to warn others, before giving the order to launch the boat

according to the Master’s instructions. 
6.5 操作放艇装置的船员在听到艇长的放艇命令后，应先确认手摇把没有在绞艇机上，并
大声呼喊警示他人后，方可放艇。 
Upon hearing the order from the coxswain to launch the boat, the seafarer responsible for operating the 
launching device shall first confirm that the hand crank handle is not on the boat winch and shout loud to 
warn others, before launching the boat.  
6.6 当艇靠妥大船的艇甲板时，随艇下的人员才能登艇。在艇降落到水面的过程中，艇上
的人员都必须手扶安全索；全封闭艇在艇架原始位置随艇人员登乘；人员应系好安全
带。 
The crew shall only embark when the lifeboat is securely parked on the boat deck of the ship. During the 
process of lowering on the water surface, all persons on the lifeboat must hold the safety line tightly; for 
closed lifeboat, the crew shall embark at the original position of the davit, and all crew shall wear safety 
belt. 
6.7 艇下水前启动艇机，确认艇底塞已塞牢。 
The engine of the lifeboat shall be started before launching, and it is necessary to confirm that the drain 
plug is blocked firmly. 
6.8 操作脱钩时要前后钩同时脱，或先脱后钩再脱前钩；收艇时，艏艉同时挂钩，大部分
艇员必须由软梯登上大船，只留下两至三人在艇。 
When releasing the hooks, the fore and aft hooks must be released at the same time, or the aft hook first 
then the fore hook; while recovery the lifeboat, the fore and aft hooks shall be hung at the same time, and 
most of the crew must board the ship via pilot ladder, leaving only two to three persons in the boat. 
6.9 在大船艇甲板上的负责指挥的驾驶员指挥收艇。 
The Conning Deck Officer command the recovery operation on the ship. 
6.10 当救生艇挂妥吊艇钩头后，指挥员应确认手摇把不在绞艇机上并大声呼喊警示他人后，
方可下令收艇。 
Upon the lifeboat being securely hooked, the Conning Deck Officer shall confirm that the hand crank 
handle is not on the boat winch and shout loud to warn others, before giving the order to recover the boat. 
6.11 操作绞艇机的船员听到指挥员的收艇命令后，应确认收艇电钮开关的正确性、手摇把
不在绞艇机上并大声呼喊警示他人后，方可按动电钮收艇。 
Upon hearing the order from the Conning Deck Officer to recover the boat, the seafarer responsible for 
operating the boat winch shall confirm that the electric button switch for recovery is in the right position, 
the hand crank handle is not on the boat winch and shout loud to warn others, before pushing the electric 
button switch to recover the lifeboat. 
6.12 当艇收到和靠妥大船的艇甲板时，艇上的人员全部下艇。在艇收回艇架的过程中不允
许有人在艇内。 
The crew should disembark when the lifeboat securely parked on the boat deck. During the process of 
recovering the lifeboat to the davit, no person is allowed to stay in the boat. 
6.13 将救生艇固定绑扎好。 
Properly secure the lifeboat. 
6.14 收放艇时要保持匀速，禁止忽快忽慢。 
During lifeboat lowering and recovery, the operation must be kept at a steady speed, and large variation in 
speed is prohibited. 
6.15 收放救生艇作业参考舷外和水上作业的安全规定。

For the safety of launching and recovery operations, please refer to the Regulations on the Safety of

7.0 自由降落式救生艇收放注意事项： 
Precautions on launching and recovery of free-fall lifeboat: 
7.1 按照自由降落式救生艇收放检查表的相关内容进行检查，逐项确认后方可进行收放艇
操作。 
Inspections shall be carried out according to relevant content of the Free-fall Lifeboat Launching and 
Recovery Checklist, and confirmation must be done item by item before the launching and recovery 
operation. 
7.2 随艇下人员进入救生艇后,脱下救生衣、安全帽进入规定座位,正确系好保险带.（驾驶
员逐个检查艇员的安全带是否正确,然后进入自己的座位系妥安全带）。 
The boat members go down with the lifeboat, should take off the life jacket and safety helmet, sit down in 
his seat and secure the safety belt (The deck officer need check if the safety belt wear properly one by 
one, then he sit down in his seat, and secure his safety belt)

Comply with the manufacturer's instructions.

9.0 风险评估Risk Assessment 
9.1 在进行风险评估时，应考虑到下列风险： 
The following risks should be taken into account when conducting risk assessment: 
 重力式救生艇收放检查表和自由降落式救生艇收放检查表中列明的相关风险； 
Relevant risks stated in the Gravity Type Lifeboat Launching and Recovery Checklist and Free-fall

 操作过程中其他可合理预见到的风险。 
Other reasonably foreseeable risks during the operation.

determined according to possibility and degree of harm of the risks, so as to evaluate the adequacy of the 
preventive measures taken, and if the measures are not adequate, further additional measures shall be 
taken to reduce the level of risk to a tolerable degree prior to the start of relevant operations. 
9.3 如果在操作过程中采取了额外措施，作业完成后，相关负责人应对所采取 的额外措施

第12 节 收放舷梯的安全规定 
Section 12 Regulations on Gangway and Accommodation Ladder 
 
1.0 收放舷梯也属舷外作业，还须参照舷外和水上作业的安全规定执行。 
As rigging gangway/accommodation ladder belongs to outboard operation, should follow the Regulations 
on the Safety of Outboard and On-Water Operations too. 
2.0 收放舷梯前应对升降机械、钢丝绳、滑车和转盘平台支架等进行检查,确认设备完好且
钢丝、卷筒等无障碍后方可作业。 
Before rigging gangway and accommodation ladder, should inspect the lifting machinery, steel wire, 
block and turntable platform brackets, so as to confirm there are in good condition, and the steel wire, reel  
are free of obstacles. 
3.0 船靠离码头时水手长负责指挥收放舷梯。在活动的梯子上进行安装栏杆、护绳及安全
网作业时,应先检查上平台支架是否已可靠支好,并使用止荡索。在舷梯上的操作人员
必须穿好救生衣，工作人员互相照应，防止跌落。 
During berthing or unberthing, the Bosun is responsible to conduct operations on rigging the gangway 
and accommodation ladder. When rigging railings, ropes and safety nets on a movable ladder, it is 
necessary to check whether the platform support is reliable and whether a frapping line is used. The crew 
on the accommodation ladder/gangway should wear life jackets, and should take care of each other to 
avoid falling. 
4.0 舷梯落岸，舷梯的下踏板要避开障碍物,安放平稳,严禁扭曲。 
When the accommodation ladder/gangway is put on wharf, the lower step should be stably placed by 
avoiding any obstruction, and warping is strictly prohibited.  
5.0 由于潮汐、装卸货、码头环境等因素影响,舷梯不能放置码头时,要注意随时调整舷梯
高度。梯口值班人员负责调整舷梯和提醒上下人员注意安全, 必要时应按规定加装桥
梯。舷梯调整必须是在空载情况下，严禁在舷梯上有人时进行。 
Due to the impacts of tides, loading or unloading of cargoes, condition of the wharf and etc. when 
accommodation ladder/gangway cannot be rigged at a wharf, attention should be paid to adjust the height 
of the accommodation ladder/gangway from time to time. Watch-keeping personnel at the 
accommodation ladder/gangway should be responsible for adjusting the accommodation ladder/gangway 
and reminding persons getting up or down to watch out, and if necessary, a portable ladder should be 
added according to provisions. Adjustment of the accommodation ladder/gangway must be carried out 
when there is no load on the ladder/gangway, and it is prohibited to carry out when there is still person on 
the ladder/gangway. 
6.0 由于涨落潮、移泊等原因需要松紧缆绳时, 应收起桥梯，绞起舷梯, 或专人看好梯口
禁止人员上下。 
Due to reasons such as flood and ebb tides, shifting berth and etc. when it is necessary to slack or heave 
up the mooring lines, the portable ladder should be stowed, and the gangway should be hoisted, or 
dedicated personnel should keep watch at the ladder/gangway to forbid person going up and down. 
7.0 在无法使用舷梯时,要正确地搭设桥梯,并绑扎牢固、装妥扶手、挂好安全网方可人员
上下。禁止从船舷直接跳上码头,或从码头直接上船。 
When gangway/accommodation ladder is not rigged, a portable ladder should be properly rigged and 
firmly secured, with armrests and safety net properly rigged before allowing persons to go up and down. 
It is prohibited for any one to jump from the board of the ship to the wharf, or vice versa. 
8.0 舷梯、桥梯必须按规定张挂安全网。舷梯、桥梯处应有防坠落、防滑等安全指示标志。
舷梯、桥梯的扶手、扶绳、阶梯必须保持清爽、干净、牢固, 便于上下人员抓牢、踏实。

Gangway/accommodation ladder and the portable ladder must be rigged with safety nets according to 
provisions. Safety warning signs such as warnings against falling off and slipping and etc. should be 
displayed at the gangway/accommodation ladder and the portable ladder. Armrests, rope handrails and 
steps must be kept clean, secure and unblocked, and convenient for person getting up and down to hold it 
firmly and step onto it securely. 
9.0 锚泊时上下舷梯、软梯, 要随时调整好高度。软梯上部应在舷墙或附近甲板处拴牢固
定, 翻越舷墙必须有扶手和在甲板生根的上下步梯，并在梯口备好带安全绳的救生圈
及吊包绳。 
When getting up and down via accommodation ladder/gangway or rope ladder at anchoring, it is 
necessary to properly adjust the height at any time. The upper part of the rope ladder is fixed on the 
bulwark or the deck in the vicinity of the bulwark; for crossing the bulwark, there must be handrails and 
step ladder rooted on the deck, and safety buoys with safety rope and bag hanging ropes should be 
prepared at the ladder. 
10.0 舷梯和舷梯必须清楚地标明最大设计使用角度和最大安全负荷，人数和总重量。人员
上下舷梯时禁止超载，禁止用舷梯吊运物品。 
Gangways and accommodation ladders must be clearly marked with the manufacturer’s name, the model 
number, the maximum designed angle of use and the maximum safe loading, both by numbers of persons 
and by total weight. It is prohibited to overload the gangway/accommodation ladder with people getting 
up and down, or to use the gangway/accommodation ladder to hoist any items. 
11.0 舷梯、软梯经常保养,尤其是升降钢丝、转盘平台支架、栏杆、机械设备的制动部分等
部件要保证完好, 如损坏应及时修理或更换。舷梯钢丝必须在滚筒上排列整齐避免由
于钢丝叠绕、卡死造成舷梯发生事故。 
Periodically maintenance should be conducted for the gangway/accommodation ladder and rope ladder, 
especially the integrity of components such as the braking part of the hoisting wire, rotary platform 
bracket, railings, machinery and equipment should be ensured, and repair or replacement should be done 
in a timely manner in case of damage. Steel wire of the gangway/accommodation ladder must be reeled 
neatly on the reel, so as to avoid twisting or jamming of the wire, thus causing the gangway/ 
accommodation ladder stop abruptly, and therefore leading to accident.  
12.0 安全网应由天然或合成纤维绳制成。绳的直径不得小于5 毫米, 网眼直径不得大于200
×300 毫米；悬挂绳直径不得小于10 亳米，两绳间的距离不得大于2 米。 
The safety net should be made of natural or synthetic fiber ropes. The diameter of the rope should not be 
less than 5mm, and the diameter of the net holes should not be greater than 200 x 300mm; the diameter of 
suspension rope should not be less than 10 mm, while the distance between the two ropes should not be 
greater than 2 meters. 
13.0 安全网的尺寸要求:桥梯安全网应伸出左、右侧不得小于⒈5 米, 舷梯安全网应符合相
关要求。安全网要严格按要求设置,无论舷梯、桥梯与码头成直角或平行，安全网的上
缘都应系在本船上,下缘系在码头上,左、右缘应超过舷梯或桥梯左、右1.5 米。 
Requirements of safety net dimensions: the safety net of portable ladder should extend toward left and 
right not less than 1.5 meters, while the safety net of gangway/accommodation ladder should be 
compliant with relevant requirements. The safety net should be rigged strictly according to requirements, 
whether the gangway/accommodation ladder is at right angle to or parallel to the wharf, the upper edge of 
the safety net should be tied to the ship, while the lower edge tied to the wharf, and the left and right 
edges should extent over the gangway/accommodation ladder towards left and right by 1.5 meters.

第13 节 涂装作业的安全规定 
Section 13 Regulations on the Safety of Painting Operations 
 
1.0 油漆的使用：油漆含有有毒或刺激性物质，而溶剂中会挥发易燃或潜伏爆炸性气体。
在使用前必须查看油漆桶上的说明，针对新种类油漆应及时向船管部或供应商咨询相
关的安全注意事项和防范措施，掌握其使用方法，还应根据使用油漆提供的安全数据
表进行风险评估。警告使用油漆的船员使用中可能引起的特殊危险。 
Application of paint: Paint contains toxic or irritant substances, and its solvent will volatilize flammable 
or latent explosive gas. Prior to use, it is necessary to check the instructions on the paint package, and for 
new types of paint, the Fleet Department or the supplier shall be timely consulted for related safety 
precautions and preventive measures, so as to master their method of use, a risk assessment should be 
carried out using the safety data sheet provided with the product. Seafarers using such paints should 
be warned of the particular risks arising from their use.   
2.0 准备和预防 
Preparation and Precautions 
2.1 工作时应戴上防护镜和口罩。 
Safety goggles and masks shall be worn at work. 
2.2 对于不同类型、不同厂家生产的涂料，要认真阅读产品说明书和安全技术资料。 
For different types of coatings produced by different manufacturers, it is necessary to carefully read the 
product description and safety technical information. 
2.3 室内和封闭空间作业应保持良好的通风，在油漆过程中和油漆干之前都应保持通风,
严禁吸烟或使用明火。 
Interior and enclosed spaces should be well ventilated, both while painting is in progress and until the 
paint has dried, it is strictly prohibited to smoke or use naked lights. 
2.4 当在机器附近进行涂漆时，应隔离电源，使机器不能移动或在无意中启动。应张贴适
当的警告告示。应该穿贴身的衣服。 
When painting is done in the vicinity of machinery, the power supply should be isolated and make the 
machine not move or being started up inadvertently. Appropriate warning notices should be posted. 
Close-fitting clothing should be worn. 
2.5 严禁在高温物体表面（如运行着的主、副机的排烟管等）喷涂油漆，以防发生火灾。 
It is strictly prohibited to spray paint on the surface of high temperature objects (such as exhaust pipes of 
the main and auxiliary engines), thus to prevent fire. 
2.6 船舶涂漆因工艺要求不同，要选用不含苯，或含苯量低的涂料和稀释剂。 
Due to different process requirements for ship painting, paint and diluent with no benzene or low benzene 
content shall be selected. 
2.7 进入油漆储存间时必须先通风，严禁在油漆间吸烟，油漆间内所有防爆灯具必须安全
可靠，开关要设置在室外。 
When entering the paint storage room, ventilation must be first conducted. It is strictly prohibited to 
smoke in the paint room, and all explosion-proof lighting in the paint room must be safe and reliable, 
while the switch shall be installed outside the paint room. 
3.0 使用喷漆设备 
Use of paint-spraying equipment 
3.1 使用喷漆设备，应遵守制造商的使用说明。 
Because there are many different types of paint-spraying equipment in use, seafarers should comply 
with the manufacturer’s instructions for use.

SHIP-02-13

Page: 2/2 
 
3.2 无空气喷漆设备尤其危险，因为喷漆是在非常高的压力下喷射出来的，可以穿透皮肤
或造成严重的眼睛伤害。喷涂不允许接触到脸或无保护的皮肤。 
Airless spray-painting equipment is particularly hazardous because the paint is ejected at a very high 
pressure and can penetrate the skin or cause serious eye injuries. Spray should not be allowed to 
come into contact with the face or unprotected skin.  
3.3 进行喷漆工作时，应穿上适当的保护衣物，例如连身衣服、手套、头罩、口罩（防护
面具）和护目镜。 
Suitable protective clothing such as a combination suit, gloves, cloth hood and eye protection should 
be worn during spraying. 
3.4 含有铅、汞或类似有毒化合物的油漆不应使用。 
Paints containing lead, mercury or similarly toxic compounds should not be used. 
3.5 喷漆时应根据油漆的性质戴上适当的防毒面具。在特殊情况下，可按需要戴上呼吸器。 
A suitable respirator should be worn according to the nature of the paint being sprayed. In 
exceptional circumstances, it may be necessary to use specialist breathing apparatus. 
3.6 若喷嘴堵塞，在清除堵塞之前，喷枪的扳手应锁住在关闭的位置。 
If a spray nozzle clogs, the trigger of the gun should be locked in a closed position before any 
attempt is made to clear the blockage.  
3.7 在移除堵塞的喷嘴或尝试任何其他拆卸之前，应该释放系统中的压力。 
Before a blocked spray nozzle is removed or any other dismantling is attempted, pressure should be 
relieved from the system.  
3.8 当通过可逆喷嘴吹气以清除堵塞时，身体的所有部位都应远离喷嘴口。 
When blowing through a reversible nozzle to remove a blockage, all parts of the body should be kept 
clear of the nozzle mouth.  
3.9 喷漆系统的压力不应超过软管的建议工作压力，应经常检查系统有无损坏。 
The pressure in the system should not exceed the recommended working pressure of the hose. The system 
should be regularly inspected for defects.  
3.10 作为对软管爆裂危险的额外预防措施，可以在喷枪和油漆容器之间的软管再套上一个
松软的套管(例如2-3 米的旧空气软管)。 
As an additional precaution against the hazards of a hose bursting, a loose sleeve (e.g. a length of 2 
to 3 meters may be slipped over that portion of the line adjacent to the gun and paint container. 
4.0 涂装作业人员在进行涂装作业时，严禁携带火种，应穿全棉工作服，携带防爆电筒。
在作业过程中入发现危及生命安全的隐患要立即停止作业并予以排除，如无法自行排
除，待隐患排除后方可继续作业。 
During painting operations, it is strictly prohibited for painting operators to carry kindling, and the 
operators shall wear cotton overalls, and carry at hand explosion-proof torches. In the operation process, 
potential dangers that pose threat to life safety shall be stopped immediately and eliminated. If not able to 
be eliminated by the operator himself, the operator shall wait until the potential danger is eliminated 
before continuing the operation. 
4.1 作业完毕后应将剩余的油漆、稀料等材料，面纱等杂物清理干净。 
Upon completion of the operation, materials such as the remaining paint and thinners, and miscellaneous 
items such as cotton veil shall be cleaned up. 
4.2 如在封闭处所进行涂装作业，必须遵守《进入封闭处所的安全规定》。 
For painting operations in enclosed spaces, Regulations on the Safety of Entry into Enclosed Spaces must 
be followed.

Reg. on the Safety of Weight Lifting Operations 
版本/修改：3.0/1.0 
Ver./Rev.: 3.0/1.0

SHIP-02-14 
 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司

生效日期：2019/4/10 
Effective Date: 2019/4/10 
第1/3页 
Page: 1/3 
 
第14 节 起重作业的安全规定 
Section 14 Regulations on the Safety of Weight Lifting Operations 
 
1.0 参加作业的人员必须穿戴工作服、工作鞋、安全帽、手套等防护用品。 
Operators must wear protective equipment such as overalls, work shoes, safety helmets, gloves and etc. 
2.0 操作员在开始使用前，检查起重设备的安全装置，如限位开关、制动等，同时检查所
使用起重葫芦、钢丝绳、吊钩等部件，并进行升降、停车试验。 
Prior to use, the operators shall check the safety devices of the weight handling equipment, such as limit 
switch, brake and etc., as well as parts such as hoist, steel wire, hooks and etc., and carry out 
lifting/lowering tests and stoppage tests. 
3.0 起重设备的控制装置应永久而清晰的标示其功能及操作方向，以箭头或其他简单方式
显示上升、下降、转向或移动等方向或位置。   
Controls of lifting equipment should be permanently and legibly marked with their function and their 
operating directions shown by arrows or other simple means, indicating the position or direction of 
movement for hoisting or lowering, slewing or luffing, etc. 
4.0 任何起重装置都不应该使用锁爪、安全附件或其它使其保护失效的装置。如果在特殊
情况下，为了将起重机降低到存放位置，需要对限位开关进行隔离，则应尽最大努力
确保其操作是完全安全的。 
No lifting device should be used with any locking pawl, safety attachment or device rendered inoperative. 
If, exceptionally, limit switches need to be isolated in order to lower a crane to its stowage position, the 
utmost care should be taken to ensure the operation is completed safely.  
5.0 使用前充分了解所起重的重量，严禁超负荷使用起重设备、装置及其属具。 
Before use, it is necessary to fully understand the weight for lifting, and it is strictly prohibited to 
overload the lifting equipment, installations and its accessories. 
6.0 操作起重设备的人员不应从事可能妨碍其主要工作的其他职责。他们应该在一个适当
的和受保护的位置，面对控制，并在可行的情况下，与整个操作的一个明确的观点。 
The person operating any lifting equipment should have no other duties that might interfere with their 
primary task. They should be in a proper and protected position, facing the controls and, so far as is 
practicable, with a clear view of the whole operation. 
7.0 必须由专人统一指挥，其他现场作业人员听从指挥不得随意呼喊。 
The operation must be commanded by a dedicated personnel, and other on-site operators shall obey the 
command, without shouting at will. 
8.0 当操作员无法看到负载要经过的整段路径时，应采取适当的预防措施，防止危险。通
常需要安排一名指挥员，专责向操作员发出指示。在进行作业之前操作员与指挥员应
事先进行沟通确认，所用讯号可以是手势、无线电或其他方式。 
Where the operator of the lifting equipment does not have a clear view of the whole of the path of travel 
of any load carried by that equipment, appropriate precautions should be taken to prevent danger. 
Generally this requirement should be met by the employment of a competent and properly trained 
signaller designated to give instructions to the operator. A signaller includes any person who gives 
directional instructions to an operator while they are moving a load, whether by manual signals, by radio 
or otherwise.  
9.0 起重作业的区域设置警戒区，防止人员意外进入。 
A warning zone shall be set up in the area of lifting operation to prevent personnel from accidentally 
entering. 
10.0 起重设备不得作为吊运人员的工具。

Lifting equipment shall not be used as a tool for lifting persons.   
11.0 吊运过程中注意随动的电缆避免被拉断，缆索、链条及索具不得打结。 
During the lifting process, attention shall be paid to the cable to avoid being broken, and cables, chains 
and riggings shall not knot. 
12.0 在起吊重物或大部件作业时轮机长、大副或大管轮必须到现场进行组织指挥，安排专
人看管主开关，必要时切断电源。 
When lifting heavy weights or large parts, the Chief Engineer, the Chief Officer or the Second Engineer 
must go to site for organizing and commanding, arrange dedicated personnel to look after the main switch, 
and cut off the power supply if necessary. 
13.0 严格控制起吊速度，钢丝应缓慢受力、垂直起吊，切勿突然受力和急顿、斜拉。吊运
作业要始终保持平稳，不能突然改变吊运方向和速度。 
The lifting speed must be controlled in a strict manner, and the steel wire shall be slowly stretched and 
vertically lifted. Sudden stress, abrupt stop and oblique drag are not allowed. The lifting operation shall 
always be stable, and the direction and speed of lifting can not be changed suddenly. 
14.0 船舶晃动、倾斜进行吊装作业时必须做好防护措施，所吊物体必须使用两条以上足够
长度的止荡索。 
In the event that lifting operation is carried out when the ship is shaking and tilting, protection measures 
must be taken, and two or more frapping lines with adequate length must be used for the objects to be 
lifted.  
15.0 水平或倾斜葫芦时必须将工件与葫芦挂钩绑扎牢固，防止脱钩事故。 
When the hoist is positioned in a horizontal or tilted state, the workpiece must be hooked and lashed with 
the hoist firmly, so as to prevent decoupling accident. 
16.0 两个或两个以上葫芦同时起吊一个物体时必须由专人指挥，各个葫芦的收放动作必须
同步、保持负荷量分布均匀。 
When two or more hoists are used to lift an object at the same time, the operation must be commanded by 
dedicated personnel, and the moves of each hoist must be synchronized, with the load evenly distributed. 
17.0 工作场所窄小、回转余地较小时，易发生碰撞、挤伤事故，参加作业的人员应站在安
全位置，应避免用手直接扶拉吊件，如必须用手扶拉时则必须采取防护措施，尤其是
在吊装定位时更应注意，严禁将手放于吊件下方。 
If the workplace is narrow, where there is not enough room to turn freely, collision and crushing accidents 
tend to occur, therefore the working personnel involved in the operation shall stand in a safe position, 
avoiding directly pulling lifting pieces by hand. If it is necessary to pull by hand, protective measures 
must be taken, with attention paid especially at lift positioning, where it is strictly prohibited to put hands 
below the pieces to be lifted. 
18.0 用拧入式吊环螺栓起吊机件时，应保证螺丝完好，螺栓要配一垫圈并拧至上紧垫圈为
止，螺纹内如有杂物应清除干净，特别是吊缸时，活塞起吊螺孔内常有积碳存在必须
清除干净，螺纹损伤或拧不到位禁止使用。 
When using a screw-in eyebolt to lift machine parts, the screws shall be intact, and fastened firmly against 
the washer;foreign objects in the thread shall be cleaned up, especially at overhaul; there are often carbon 
deposition existing in the piston lifting holes, which must be cleaned up, and if thread damage or failure 
to screw in place is present, then use is prohibited. 
19.0 若起重设备由外部人员操作，大副应指导并告知安全操作负荷限制。 
If the lifting equipment is operated by external personnel, the Chief Officer shall direct and inform safe 
operating load limits. 
20.0 若装卸货作业使用船上起重设备时，大副应在装卸计划和配载图内标明安全操作负荷

If shipboard lifting equipment are used for loading and unloading operations, the Chief Officer shall 
indicate the safe working load limit in the Loading/ Unloading Plan and the Stowage Plan. 
21.0 在任何起重设备中发现的任何缺陷，包括岸上机构提供的缺陷，应立即向船长或其他
负责人报告，并由其采取适当行动。 
Any defect found in any lifting equipment, including that provided by a shore authority, should be 
reported immediately to the master or to another responsible person who should take appropriate action. 
22.0 起重作业应考虑天气状况的影响，不论在船内或甲板外，在情况恶化到起重变得危险
之前，应暂停这些作业。 
Consideration should be given to the effects of weather conditions on all lifting operations, whether inside 
the ship or outside on deck, and such operations should be suspended before conditions deteriorate to the 
extent that lifting becomes dangerous.  
23.0 在尝试释放卡住的负载设备之前，应首先尽一切努力安全地卸下负载。应采取预防措
施防止其突然或意外的活动。与此操作没有直接关系的其他控制应当放在安全或者防
护的位置。 
Before any attempt is made to free equipment that has become jammed under load, every effort 
should first be made to take the load off safely. Precautions should be taken to guard against sudden 
or unexpected freeing. Others not directly engaged in the operation should keep in safe or protected 
positions.  
24.0 如果任何电动起重设备处于无人值守状态，则应将负载取下，并将控制装置置于“空
档”或“关闭”位置。在实际情况下，应该锁定或灭活控制装置，以防止意外重新启
动。工作结束后，应切断电源。 
If any powered lifting equipment is to be left unattended with the power on, loads should be taken off and 
controls put in a ‘NEUTRAL’ or ‘OFF’ position. Where practical, controls should be locked or otherwise 
inactivated to prevent accidental restarting. When work is completed, the power should be shut off.

Reg. on the Safety of Electrical Operations 
版本/修改：3.0/2.0 
Ver./Rev.: 3.0/2.0 
SHIP-02-15 
SHIP-02-15 
 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd 
生效日期：2019/06/20 
Effective Date: 2019/06/20 
第1/3页 
Page: 1/3 
 
第15 节 电气作业安全规定 
Section 15   Regulations on the Safety of Electrical Operations 
 
1.0 船舶电气设备的检修、保养、安装等作业应由本船电机员进行。未经轮机长的允许，
禁止其他人员进行电气作业。 
The overhaul, maintenance and installation of shipboard electrical equipment shall be carried out by the 
ship's Electrician Engineer. Without the permission of the Chief Engineer, other personnel are prohibited 
to carry out electrical work. 
2.0 进行电气保养、检修作业时，必须穿绝缘鞋。 
Insulation shoes must be worn during electrical maintenance and overhaul operations. 
3.0 检修、保养电气设备时均应断电作业，并在启动箱、配电板等处挂好“禁止合闸”、“禁
止启动”等警示牌，必须拿掉保险丝，作业完毕必须由挂牌人员亲自摘除警示牌，装
回保险丝，他人不得擅自移动警示牌和盲目装回保险丝。 
When carrying out overhaul and maintenance to electrical equipment, the power source shall be 
disconnected and warning signs such as "Switch In Prohibited”, "Start Prohibited", and etc. shall be 
displayed at start box, distribution board and etc., with the fuses removed; upon completion of the 
operation, the personnel who put on the warning signs must personally remove them, and put back the 
fuse, while others are not allowed to move the warning signs and blindly put back the fuse. 
4.0 主配电板前、后，分电板等处铺垫的绝缘橡胶要保持清洁完好，不得挪作他用,不得图
刷油漆。配电板、分电箱、控制箱内部均不允许存放任何物品。 
The insulation mat at the front and rear of the Main Switchboard, the distribution board and etc. shall be 
kept clean and intact, without being used for other purposes, and shall not be painted. No articles are 
allowed to be stored in the switchboard, the distribution box and the control box. 
5.0 在配电板、电源箱、插座箱等高电压部位均应标有红色“高压危险”的警告标志。配
电板附近应存放适用于扑救电器火灾的灭火器。 
A red “Danger, High Voltage” warning sign shall be displayed at parts with high voltage such as the 
switchboard, the power box, the socket box and etc. Fire extinguishers suitable for put out fire caused by 
electric appliances shall be placed in the vicinity of the switchboard. 
6.0 如可能电机员应尽量避免在带电的设备上或附近作业，除非为了船舶安全必须带电作
业或必要的测试，但应采取以下预防措施： 
Work on or near live equipment should be avoided if possible but when it is essential for the safety of the 
ship or for testing purposes, the following precautions should be taken:  
 配备一名能够胜任治疗触电休克的人全程协助。 
A second person, who should be competent in the treatment of electric shock, should be continually in 
attendance.  
 工作地点安全可靠，避免意外接触带电部件，应尽可能戴上绝缘手套。 
The working position adopted should be safe and secure to avoid accidental contact with the live parts. 
Insulated gloves should be worn where practicable.  
 应避免与甲板接触，特别是在甲板潮湿的情况下。如果鞋子受潮或有金属螺柱或铆
钉，则不能提供足够的绝缘。建议在任何时候都使用干燥的绝缘垫子。 
Contact with the deck, particularly if it is wet, should be avoided. Footwear may not give adequate 
insulation if it is damp or has metal studs or rivets. The use of a dry insulating mat at all times is 
recommended.  
 应避免用手直接接触裸露带电的金属，手到手的触电尤其危险。为了降低工作的手
触电后另外一只再次触电的风险，只要可行，一只手应放在裤兜里。

Contact with bare metal should be avoided. A hand-to-hand shock is especially dangerous. To 
minimise the risk of a second contact should the working hand accidentally touch a live part, one hand 
should be kept in a trouser pocket whenever practicable.  
 工作时不要带着腕表、金属手镯和戒指。它们更容易使身体导电。衣服或鞋子上的
金属配件也很危险。 
Wrist watches, metal identity bracelets and rings should be removed. They provide low-resistance 
contacts with the skin. Metal fittings on clothing or footwear are also dangerous.  
7.0 任何用作测试电压和/或电流的仪表（和相关的引线/探针）应保持尽量少金属裸露，
仪表两个探头的绝缘部分应处于良好状态。应小心探针不要使邻近的连接短路。当测
量大于250V 的电压时，探头应该和断开的电路碰上和移开。 
Any test meters (and their associated leads/probes) used should be rated for the voltage and/or current 
being tested with meter probes having only minimum amounts of metal exposed and insulation of both 
probes should be in good condition. Care should be taken that the probes do not short circuit adjacent 
connections. When measuring voltages that are greater than 250V, the probe should be attached and 
removed with the circuit dead.  
8.0 电机员要定期检查电动工具、移动式灯具、插头、插座、电线等，如有绝缘损坏、软
电缆护套破裂、零线脱离、插头、插座裂开有损安全使用的均应及时修理或换新。禁
止电气设备、电缆带电部分裸露和严重损坏继续使用。 
The Electrician Engineer shall check the electric tools, portable lamps, plugs, sockets, wires, and in case 
of insulation damage, soft cable sheath rupture, breakaway of null line, crack of plugs and sockets that 
may threaten safe use, repair or replacement must be carried out promptly. Continual use of partly 
exposed and severely damaged electrical parts of electrical installations and cables is prohibited.  
9.0 移动式灯具使用的低压电源必须与高压电源在电路上分开，即不得使用自耦式变压器。
移动式、手持电动工具、灯具必须有可靠的保护接地线，使用时应可靠接地。 
The low voltage power supply used for portable luminaries must be separated from the high voltage 
power supply circuit, that is to say, no self-coupling transformer shall be used. Portable, hand held electric 
tools and lamps must have reliable protective grounding wire, which shall be reliably grounded when in 
use. 
10.0 船舶任何场合均不得使用超出原设计容量的任何电器，不允许随意扩大保险丝容量。 
In any place on board the ship, it is prohibited for using any electrical appliances beyond the original 
design capacity, and it is not allowed to expand the capacity of the fuse. 
11.0 船舶需增设电器设备必须得到电机员同意，由电机员严格按电器设备安装标准安装，
严禁任何人私自装设电器、拉接电源线。 
If the ship is in need of additional electrical equipment, agreement must be obtained from the Electrician 
Engineer, and these equipment shall be installed by the Electrician Engineer in strict accordance with the 
installation standard of electrical equipment. It is strictly prohibited for anyone to privately install 
electrical appliances or connect electric power lines. 
12.0 按规定配置电水壶的房间必须使用自动断电电水壶。使用过程中人员不得离开，离开
房间时必须将插头拔掉，切断电源。 
Rooms equipped with electric kettles must use electric kettles with automatic power-off function. In the 
process of use, the person must not leave. When leaving the room, the person must pull out the plug and 
cut off the power supply. 
13.0 检修后的电机进行试验时，要仔细检查设备及拖带机械周围确认无障碍物、无人工作，
方能启动试验。对于遥控启动或控制电源距离较远的要先检查设备附近情况，确认控
制手柄、按钮置于停止位置，再行合闸送电，严禁简化操作程序。

machinery shall be carefully checked to confirm that no obstacles or persons nearby before starting the

14.0 接、拆岸电引线时必须两人以上参加，并指定专人负责看管岸上开关，统一联系信号，

15.0 电机员应经常检查各内外走廊、梯口、通道、应急出口的照明设备。防护罩、灯罩、

The Electrician Engineer shall regularly check the lighting equipment at internal and external corridors,

16.0 电瓶保养、配置电解液等作业时，电机员应按规定穿戴防护用具（戴好防护眼镜和乳

shall be required to wear personal protective equipment (wearing safety goggles, latex gloves, and 
aprons). This requirement is not applicable to maintenance free batteries. 
17.0 电瓶间内不准存放与电瓶保养无关的其它杂物，尤其是易燃易爆物品。电瓶、硫酸、

可能。

especially flammable and explosive materials. Batteries, sulfuric acid, electrolyte solution and so on shall 
be reliably secured, ensuring that collision with each other and possible overturning will not happen under 
circumstances such as shaking or vibration of the ship.  
18.0 电瓶间内通风应保持良好，在通风帽处标示红色的“KEPT OPEN EXCEPT FIRE ”。电

示标识。 
The battery room shall be kept well ventilated, and the ventilation cap shall be marked “KEPT OPEN 
EXCEPT FIRE” in red color. No smoking is allowed in the battery room, and hot work with naked flame 
is not allowed near the battery room, and the “Smoking and fire prohibited” warning sign shall be 
displayed at prominent places. 
19.0 船舶电机员负责对全船的安全用电进行监督和检查，发现违章和不安全因素应及时纠
正和排除。 
The Electrician Engineer onboard the ship is responsible for the supervision and inspection of the safe use 
of electricity onboard the entire ship, and shall promptly correct and eliminate if violation and unsafe 
factors are identified. 
20.0 电机员一人单独进行电气作业有困难时，轮机长应安排适当人员予以配合。 
When the Electrician Engineer has difficulty in conducting electrical work alone, the Chief Engineer shall 
arrange appropriate personnel to provide cooperation. 
21.0 易燃物品不应存放在配电板附件。 
Flammable materials should never be left or stored near switchboards.

第16 节 车床操作安全规定 
Section 16   Regulations on the Safety of Lathe Operations 
 
1.0 严禁违章和违规，确保人身安全。 
It is strictly prohibited to violate rules and regulations, so as to ensure personal safety. 
2.0 动用车床，必须经轮机长或大管轮同意。先熟悉车床的性能、各开关的作用和应急停
车的方法，然后才能作业。 
For use of lathe, approval must be obtained from the the Chief Engineer or the Second Engineer. 
Familiarization with the performance of the lathe, the functions of each switch and the method of 
emergency stop must be first achieved prior to operation. 
3.0 车床操作人员工作时，必须穿着工作服，袖口扎紧，车床操作人员应佩戴防护眼镜，
严禁戴手套。 
When at work, lathe operators must wear boiler suits with cuffs tied firmly, as well as safety goggles, but 
it is strictly prohibited to wear gloves. 
4.0 上紧卡盘的工具必须取下后才能启动运转。 
Tools for tightening the chuck must be removed before starting the lathe. 
5.0 车床运转时，不允许将手指伸入刀具和工件之间，测量时必须先停车并将刀具退到安
全位置。 
When the lathe is running, it is prohibited to put fingers between the tooling and the workpieces, and the 
lathe must be stopped with the tooling pulled back to the safe position before measurement. 
6.0 当需要用锉刀对工件进行磨光时，必须将刀架移到安全位置，禁止使用无把手锉刀或
手持砂布紧靠工件磨削毛刺。 
When it is necessary to polish the workpiece with a file, the file holder must be moved to a safe place, and 
it is prohibited to use a file without handle or to hold abrasive cloth by hand closely against the workpiece 
to grind burrs. 
7.0 在任何情况下，清除车、刨、钻产生的金属屑时不可用嘴吹，或用手去拨，应用毛刷
清扫。装夹刀具时，必须停车进行，刀杆伸出长度不准超出杆的高度，使用各种卡盘
时，必须上紧保险装置。 
Under no circumstances shall mouth be used to blow or hands be used to pull during cleaning metal 
scraps generated by lathing, planing or drilling; a cleaning brush shall be used instead. When fitting the 
tooling, the lathe must be stopped, with the cutter bar extended out for a length not exceeding the height 
of the bar; while a variety of chucks are used, safety devices must tighten firmly. 
8.0 加工偏心工件时，必须加平衡块，加工细长工件时，空心轴后端不得超出太长，并做
出危险标志。车床面上禁止放任何工件、工具，车床尾部要装有防护栏。 
For machining eccentric workpieces, balance blocks must be added; while for machining long slender 
workpieces, the rear end of the hollow shaft shall not extend out too long, and a dangerous warning sign 
shall be displayed. It is prohibited to place any workpiece or tool on the lathe surface, and guard rails 
shall be equipped at the end of the lathe. 
9.0 运转中如发现机床故障，应立即停车处理，停车时必须先将车刀退出工件。 
In case lathe failure is found during the operation, the lathe shall be stopped immediately, and the tooling 
must be withdrawn from the workpiece when stopping. 
10.0 三爪卡盘的车床不允许夹持不规则的工件。工件固定后应随手取下卡盘扳手，四爪卡
盘的车床在加工工件时，必须垫上铜皮或铁皮，校正工件时不允许用力敲打。 
Lathe fitted with three jaw chuck is not allowed to clamp irregular workpieces. Once the workpiece is 
fixed, the chuck wrench shall be removed conveniently. When machining workpiece, lathe fitted with

11.0 装夹重大机件时，应用吊车或其他人协助，严禁一人勉强装夹和卸下工件。 
When fitting large heavy workpieces, crane or assistance of other people shall be employed, and it is 
strictly prohibited for one single person to reluctantly fit and remove the workpiece. 
12.0 禁止用脚蹬、踢开关。禁止用动车的方法拆、装卡盘，工件未卡紧之前，只许用手攀
来校正工件，严禁开车转动。 
It is prohibited to pedal or kick the switch. It is prohibited to use the method of running the lathe to 
remove or fit the workpiece chuck. Before the workpiece is firmly clamped, calibration of the workpiece 
shall only be done by hand, and it is strictly prohibited to run the lathe to rotate the workpiece. 
13.0 在使用自动走刀时，必须将刀架进到与床座一样齐，以防刀架、床座碰到卡盘上造成
事故。 
When automatic tooling feed is used, the tooling holder must be fed to a position flush with the bed seat, 
so as to prevent tooling holder and bed seat from hitting the chuck, thus resulting in accidents. 
14.0 工件切断时用力不要过猛，车刀不能进深，要根据不同材料合理选择转速。 
When cutting off the workpiece, the force shall not be too fierce, and the lathe tooling shall not be fed too 
deep. The revolving speed shall be reasonably selected according to different materials.

第17 节 台钻和砂轮操作安全规定 
Section 17 Regulations on Bench Drill & Abrasive Wheels Operations 
 
1.0 台钻操作安全规定： 
Regulations on the safety of bench drill operation: 
1.1 操作者应在每次使用前检查机器，确保所有的安全防护装置和操作装置都在正确的位
置，钻头都处于良好的状态，工作区域照明充足，没有杂物。 
The operator should check a machine every time before use, and ensure that all safety guards and devices 
are in position and operative, the drill bits is in good condition, and that the work area is adequately lit 
and free from clutter.  
1.2 操作人员严禁戴手套操作，严禁用手清除切屑。为避免钻头绞住头发，不要把头低向 
钻孔处，工作时必须戴防护眼镜和工作帽。 
It is strictly prohibited for operators to wear gloves during operation, or to remove chips by hand. In order 
to prevent the drill bit from gripping hairs, operators shall not bend the head down to the drill hole, and 
must wear safety goggles and safety helmet during operation. 
1.3 操作时必须将工件牢固的夹紧在工作台上，尤其是轻体零件更需要牢牢地固定在工作
台上，并尽可能地固定在工作台的中心部分。 
During operation, the workpiece must be firmly clamped on the workbench, especially the light-weighted 
parts, and fixed to the central part of the workbench to the greatest extent practicable. 
1.4 钻头的装夹应精确而牢固。安装钻头前，仔细检查钻头、钻夹头、钻套配合表面有无
磕伤或拉痕，钻头刃口是否完好，以防切削时，钻头折断伤人。 
The fitting of drill bits shall be precise and firm. Prior to the fitting of a drill bit, carefully check if there is 
any collision mark or scratch on drill bit, drill clamp or drill sleeve surface, and whether the blade of the 
drill bit is intact, so as to prevent the drill bit from breaking during drilling, therefore causing injuries. 
1.5 当用手进给或钻小孔及不通孔时，不要猛压杠杆，机动进给时，要防止轴向力过大，
钻头折断伤人。 
When feeding by hand or drilling small holes and non-through holes, do not press lever fiercely, and 
when feeding automatically, attention shall be paid to prevent the axial force from being too large, so as to 
avoid injuries due to breaking of the drill bit. 
1.6 立钻在钻孔前要先紧固工作台，摇臂钻应先紧固摇臂，然后再开钻。 
Prior to drilling holes using a vertical drill, the workbench must firmly fastened, while the rocker arm 
shall be fastened first prior to drilling if using a radial drill.  
1.7 钻削时，产生的切屑较多，应及时清除。当切屑不断时不准用手拉扯，可采用退刀后
再断续进刀达到断屑的目的。 
During drilling, chips shall be cleared in time if there are too much chips generated. While the chip cannot 
be drilled down, it is not allowed to pull by hand. The drill bit can be drawn back and then fed again to 
cut off the chip.  
1.8 不要把任何工具、刀具及工件放在工作台或运动部件上，以防甩落伤人。 
Do not put any tools, cutters and workpieces on the workbench or moving parts, so as to avoid falling and 
causing injuries. 
1.9 停钻前，应从工件中退出钻头，更换钻头时应在主轴停止转动后进行。 
Before stopping drilling, the drill bit shall be drawn back from the workpiece, while replacement of the 
drill bit shall only be conducted after the spindle stops running. 
1.10 机床在运转中工件松动时，禁止用手扶持或运转中紧固，应立即停车紧固。 
When the workpiece becomes loosened during operation, it is prohibited to hold by hand or fasten during

1.11 当处于无人值守状态时，即使只是短暂地处于无人值守状态，也应切断电源并隔离电
源，并在恢复工作前对机器和任何安全防护装置进行重新检查。 
Whenever it is left unattended, even if only briefly, the power supply should be switched off and isolated, 
and the machinery and any safety guards should be re-checked before resuming work.  
2.0 砂轮操作安全规定： 
Regulations on the safety of abrasive wheel operation: 
2.1 只有胜任的人才能按照制造商的说明来选择、安装和使用砂轮。它们比较易碎，应小
心存放和处理。 
Abrasive wheels should be selected, mounted and used only by competent persons and in accordance with 
manufacturers’ instructions. They are relatively fragile and should be stored and handled with care. 
2.2 应遵循制造商的说明，选择正确的类型的车轮的工作。一般来说，软轮更适合硬材料，
硬轮更适合软材料。 
Manufacturers’ instructions should be followed on the selection of the correct type of wheel for the job in 
hand. Generally, soft wheels are more suitable for hard material and hard wheels for soft material.  
2.3 使用前要检查砂轮的防护装置是否合乎要求，托板位置是否得当，砂轮有无损伤，旋
转是否平衡，冷却水槽是否充满水等。禁止使用无防护罩、表面凹凸不平、有裂纹、
旋转不平衡、安装不牢固、无托架或托架位置不当的砂轮。 
Before use, check whether the protective device of the grinding wheel meets requirements, if the position 
of the splint is proper, if the wheel is damaged, if the rotation is balanced, if the cooling water tank is full 
of water and etc. It is prohibited to use a wheel that has no protective cover, uneven surface, cracks, 
unbalanced rotation, insecure installation, no bracket or improper bracket position.  
2.4 工件绝不能用布或钳子夹住。 
The work piece should never be held in a cloth or pliers.  
2.5 作业时必须着装利索，佩戴防护眼镜和安全帽。 
The operator must dress neatly and wear safety goggles and helmet during operation. 
2.6 作业中禁止站在砂轮的正面，磨削工作时不要用力过猛，工件与砂轮的接触面不可过
大。禁止使用砂轮的侧面磨大工件。 
During operation, it is prohibited to stand on the front of the grinding wheel, and when grinding, do not 
use too much force, while the contact surface between the workpiece and the grinding wheel must not be 
too large. It is prohibited to use the side of a grinding wheel to grind large workpieces. 
2.7 砂轮的防护罩、防护板和工件托架的调整必须在停车时进行。 
The adjustment of protective cover, protective plate and workpiece holding bracket of the grinding wheel 
must be carried out when the grinding wheel is stopped. 
2.8 在寒冷工作场所，用砂轮磨削工件应逐渐加大负荷，以防砂轮破碎。 
At cold work places, the workpiece shall be ground by gradually increasing the load of the grinding wheel, 
so as to prevent the grinding wheel from breaking. 
2.9 砂轮盘因磨损小于允许直径时，应及时更换。在更换砂轮盘时，必须选用合格的砂轮
盘。安装时砂轮与砂轮卡盘之间必须衬以柔性衬垫；砂轮、砂轮轴、衬垫和卡盘之间
清洁、无任何附着物；压紧螺母的松紧程度适宜。禁止使用压紧面不平整、主轴有变
形的砂轮。 
The wheel disc shall be promptly replaced when its diameter is less than the allowable diameter due to 
wear down. Qualified wheel disc must be selected at replacement of wheel disc. During installation, the 
crevice between the grinding wheel and the grinding wheel chuck must be lined with flexible gaskets; and 
the crevice between the grinding wheel, grinding wheel shaft, liner and chuck shall be clean and free of 
any debris; and the tightness of the compression nut shall be suitable. It is prohibited to use a wheel disc

2.10 发生砂轮破损事故后，必须检查砂轮防护罩是否损伤，砂轮卡盘有无变形或不平衡，
砂轮轴端螺纹和压紧螺母有无损坏，检查确认无问题后方可安装使用。

第18 节 厨房主要设备操作安全规定 
Section 18 Regulations on Operating Primary Equipment in the Galley 
 
1.0 蒸汽、电力两用饭锅 
Steam and electric dual-use rice cooker 
1.1 使用者在操作前必须熟悉操作程序。 
Operator must be familiar with the operation procedure before operation. 
1.2 汽旁通管上的旁通阀，在正常情况下应处在关闭状态，只有当减压阀损坏失灵时方可
启用作为进汽旁通通道及节流减压之用。 
The bypass valve on the steam bypass pipe shall be in closed state under normal circumstances, and shall 
only be enabled as a steam bypass channel and for throttling purposes when the pressure-reducing valve 
is damaged or failed. 
1.3 当因故不能使用蒸汽，需用电加热时，要在蒸汽加热夹层注入足够的淡水，注意水位
不能低于水位表上标出的最低水位。 
When steam cannot be used due to some reasons, and it is necessary to use electricity heating, adequate 
fresh water shall be added into the steam heating interlayer, with attention paid to that the water level 
shall not be less than the minimum water level marked on the water gauge. 
1.4 操作者应监视工作压力表上显示的蒸汽压力不得超过0.25MPa，若超过该值又不能自
动卸压时，应打开紧急排汽阀放汽卸压，并关闭蒸汽或断电源。 
The operator shall monitor the steam pressure displayed on the working pressure gauge, which shall not 
exceed 0.25 MPa; if the pressure exceeds this value and can not be released automatically, the emergency 
exhaust valve shall be opened to release the steam pressure, and shut off the steam or power source. 
1.5 因修船等原因停用蒸汽锅，启用时，必须认真检查各管路是否畅通，安全阀是否动作，
以防使用中因沉渣堵塞管路造成爆炸事故。 
When the steam cooker is resumed for use after period of lay-up due to reasons such as ship repair, it is 
necessary to carefully check whether the pipeline is unblocked and the safety valve is functional, so as to 
avoid explosion accident due to blocked pipeline by sediments. 
1.6 有蒸汽压力高压锅、蒸汽锅和锅炉应该关闭和释放压力后再打开锅盖。 
The steam supply to pressure cookers, steamers and boilers should be turned off and pressure 
released before their lids are opened.  
2.0 绞肉机 
Meat chopper 
2.1 操作前应将手擦干，认真检查电插头、电线等是否正常，有无影响运转的其它物件。
使用完毕后将其清洗干净，并进行试运转。 
Hands shall be dried before operation, and check if the electric plug and wire are normal, and if there is 
any other thing that affects the operation. After use, the chopper shall be cleaned and tested. 
2.2 严禁在机器运转状态进行清洗，更不能用手触摸绞肉机刀刃部分或清除其间杂物。 
It is strictly prohibited to clean the machine during running, or to touch the blades of the cutter or remove 
debris by hands. 
2.3 绞肉时要用捣肉木棒，严禁用手指按压。 
During chopping, meat ramming stick shall be used, and it is strictly prohibited to press with fingers. 
3.0 和面机 
Dough mixer 
3.1 操作前应将手擦干，先检查电源开关、电线等有无破损等不正常现象。 
Hands shall be dried before operation, and check if there is any abnormal phenomena such as damage to

the power switch, wires and etc. 
3.2 使用和面机前，先清洗干净，再放入面粉，然后加水，盖好盖后启动开车。如需要反
转时，必须先停车，然后再开反车，防止损坏。 
Before using the dough mixer, clean first, then add flour then water, close the cover and start the mixer. 
To reverse, the mixer must be stopped first, and then start the mixer in reverse direction to prevent

3.3 使用时，严禁在机器运转时把手伸到里面去。

3.4 凡是电器设备、线路有故障时，必须通知电气维修人员，炊事人员不得自行修理。 
Where electrical equipment and wiring are out of order, electrical maintenance personnel must be notified, 
and personnel in the galley shall not repair themselves. 
4.0 升降机Lift 
4.1 严禁任何人搭乘载货升降机上下； 
It is strictly prohibited to carry any person up and down in a cargo lift; 
4.2 升降机竖井严禁站人； 
It is strictly prohibited for any person to stand in the lift well; 
4.3 严禁超负荷运行   
Overloaded operation is prohibited;   
4.4 起动升降机前必须鸣放警铃。 
Siren must be sounded before starting the lift. 
5.0 伙食冷库 
Refrigerated Stores 
5.1 所有冷藏库门都应该安装有从两边开门的装置, 应该从里面可以发出报警。 
All refrigerated room doors should be fitted with a means of opening the door from both sides. It should 
be possible to sound an alarm from inside the room.  
5.2 应定期对警铃进行例行测试，并检查门闩及内松脱，至少每周一次。 
A routine testing of the alarm bell and checking of the door clasps and inside release should be carried out 
regularly, at least at weekly intervals.  
5.3 使用冷藏室的人员应熟悉其操作，即使在黑暗时，也能从里面打开和发出警报。 
Those using the refrigerated room should make themselves familiar with the operation, in darkness, of the 
inside release for the door and the location of the alarm button.  
5.4 任何进入冷藏室的人，如果有挂锁的话，都应该随身携带。应该通知另一个人。 
Anyone going into a refrigerated room should take the padlock, if any, inside with them. Another person 
should be informed. 
5.5 如怀疑有制冷剂泄漏，不应进入冷藏库或冷藏间。这方面的警告应该贴在门外。 
Cold stores or refrigerated rooms should not be entered if it is suspected that there has been a leakage of 
refrigerant. A warning notice to this effect should be posted outside the doors.  
5.6 所有的物品和箱子都应妥善堆放，防止航行时移动。 
All stores and crates should be stowed securely so that they do not shift or move in a seaway.  
5.7 进入肉类和鱼类储存室时，应准备好适当的个人保暖防护设备。 
For entry into meat and fish storage rooms, appropriate thermal personal protective equipment should be 
readily available.  
5.8 地下结冰和水渍应及时清除，防止滑倒伤人。 
Icing and water stain on the ground shall be promptly cleared to prevent slipping injuries.

第19 节 起落克令（吊杆）安全操作规定 
Section 19 Regulations on the Safety of Crane (Derrick) Operations 
 
1.0 操作者要将安全帽、防滑鞋、手套、工作服等按要求穿戴齐全方可进入操作。 
Operators should wear safety helmets, anti-slipping shoes, gloves, overalls etc. according to requirements 
before operation. 
2.0 当克令、吊杆需要进行操作时，操作者需通知机舱值班轮人员，值班人员根据电力负
荷情况，及时答复并保持充足的电力供给。 
When the operation of crane and derrick is necessary, the operator should inform the personnel on duty in 
the engine room, who shall, according to the generator load, timely respond and maintain sufficient power 
supply. 
3.0 操作人员操作前必须熟悉对克令、起货机设备的性能和操作规程。在不熟悉设备的情
况下，禁止盲目操作。 
Operators should be familiar with the performance and operating procedures of crane and cargo gear prior 
to operation. Do not operate blindly when you are not familiar with them. 
4.0 起落吊杆和起货机的操作一般由驾驶员、水手长或经验丰富的水手来实施。遇有厂家
维修人员进行维修操作时，船方操作人员应密切配合。 
The operation of derricks and cargo cranes are generally carried out by the deck officer, the Bosun or 
experienced Seaman. In case of repair operation carried out by factory maintenance personnel, the staff of 
the ship shall give close cooperation. 
5.0 操作前，操车者应对起吊设备的制动器、限位器、指示器、安全防护装置、照明、信
号装置和吊钩、吊环、钢丝绳、链条等进行检查，在起货机空载状态下对刹车、应急
停止装置进行效用试验。 
Before the operation, the operator shall check the cargo handling equipment’s brake, stopper, indicator, 
safety protection device, lighting, signal devices and hooks, rings, wire, chains etc., and carry out 
functional test of the brake and the emergency stop device of the cargo gear under empty load. 
6.0 船舶开航前必须落下克令吊臂、吊杆并进行绑扎加固；升起吊杆应在进港靠泊后进行；
移泊时所有吊杆、吊臂要放置于搁置架上，均不能伸出舷外。 
Before sailing, the crane arm and derrick boom should be lowered and secured; rise of derrick shall be 
carried out after berthing; during berth shifting, all derrick booms, derrick arms should be placed on the 
holder, and shall not extend outboard. 
7.0 克令、吊杆等起货设备因修理、保养暂时不能动用时，轮机长应通知大副,大副要及时
通知值班驾驶员。 
If cargo handling equipment such as cranes and derricks cannot be used for the time being due to repair or 
maintenance, the Chief Engineer should notify the Chief Officer, who shall then notify the Officer on the 
Watch in timely manner. 
8.0 起落克令吊臂、吊杆的操作至少两人配合完成，一人为指挥员另一人为操车手。参加
作业的人员要精神集中，听从指挥，协调工作，使用统一指挥手势和信号，互相在视
线范围内。严禁在无人指挥的情况下盲目操作。 
The operation of raising/lowering crane arm and derrick boom shall be carried out by at least two persons, 
one as the commander and the other one as the operator. All personnel involved shall concentrate their 
efforts, obey the command, coordinate with each other, use the unified command gestures and signals, 
and stay within each other’s line of sight. It is strictly prohibited to operate blindly without a commander. 
9.0 指挥员要查看现场周围情况并要大声呼喊警示他人，当确认吊杆、吊臂危及范围内无
人和无障碍物时，方可就位准备指挥动车。

The commander should patrol around the site and shout out loudly to warn others, and confirmed that 
there is no person or obstruction within the area endangered by the crane and the derrick, then he start the 
command. 
10.0 在调整和起落吊臂、吊杆时，必须处于无负载条件下进行，严禁附带吊运的货物进行
调整。 
During adjustment and lifting/lowering crane jibs and derrick booms, the operation must be carried out 
under empty load condition, and it is strictly prohibited to make adjustment with goods loaded. 
11.0 操车者看到指挥员的动车手势信号或听到指挥员的动车命令后，确认操作手柄的正确
方向并大声呼喊警告他人后，方可进行开车操作。 
Upon observing the gesture order or hearing the order to start operation from the commanding personnel, 
the operator shall shout loudly to warn others upon confirming the correct direction of the operating 
handle, after which shall be formally started. 
12.0 指挥者应站位合理，使操作者能清楚看到指挥者的动作。当现场任何人发出停车信号，
操车手都应立即停车。 
The commander’s standing position shall be reasonable, so that the operator can clearly see the gesture of 
the commander. The operator shall stop immediately whoever at site gives stop signal. 
13.0 在装卸货物期间，调整吊杆必须由船方人员操作，吊杆仰角应在30—75 度之间。不准
装卸工人自行调整。 
During loading or unloading, adjustment of derrick boom must be operated by the crew of the ship, and 
the elevation of the derrick boom shall be between 30.0 - 75.0 degrees. The stevedores are not allowed to 
adjust themselves. 
14.0 检修、保养起货设备时应切断电源，除挂上“禁止合闸”警示牌外还要通报有关人员。 
During repair and maintenance of the cargo handling equipment, power source shall be cut off, and in 
addition to display "Switch on Prohibited" warning sign, it is necessary to notify relevant personnel. 
15.0 操车者为起货机合闸送电或启动油泵前，必须确认所有的控制手柄处于零位；作业中
如突然发生断电应迅速把所有的控制手柄扳回零位。 
Prior to switch on the power source or start the oil pump, the operator must confirm that all control 
handles are placed in zero position; in case of sudden power blackout during operations, all control 
handles shall be quickly pulled back to zero position. 
16.0 在船舶横倾5 度以上或6 级以上大风或能见度受限情况下，不允许克令操作。 
In the event of ship list over 5 degree or strong wind with a wind scale of above 6.0 degree or in restricted 
visibility, operation of crane is not allowed. 
17.0 克令吊操作注意事项； 
Precautions of operating crane 
16.1 操作克令吊时一定要保持钢缆垂直，严禁斜拉货物或将货物悬在半空中。 
操作克令吊时要保持平稳匀速操作，严禁急速启动、停止和上升、下降操作。 
During operation of the crane, the steel cable must be kept vertical, and it is strictly prohibited to pull the 
cargo obliquely or suspend the cargo in the air. During operation of the crane, the operation must be 
carried out in a stable and steady manner, and it is strictly prohibited to start, stop, lift or lower abruptly.  
16.2 寒冷天气启动克令吊时，保持油泵空转约20 分钟，使驱动油升温（大约20℃左右），
方可进行克令操作。油温较低时，安全装置将使得吊臂不能进行俯仰和回转操作。 
When starting the crane in cold weather, the oil pump shall keep running idly for about 20 minutes, so as 
to warm the oil (to about 20℃), before starting operation of the crane. When the oil temperature is low, 
the safety device will make the jib unable to pitch or turn. 
16.3 克令吊使用完毕，吊臂放回搁置架上之前，必须将切换开关设在“旁通（BYPASS）”位

置。吊臂放回搁置架上之后，旁通限位开关必须调回到“正常（NORMAL）”位置，并将
钥匙取下（由值班驾驶员或水手长保管）。严禁克令吊在“旁通（BYPASS）”位置吊载

Prior to putting the jib back to its holder upon completion of the operation, the switch must be set to the 
“BYPASS” position. When the jib is put back to the holder, the bypass limit switch must be reset to the 
“NORMAL” position and the key shall be removed (and kept by the Officer on Watch or the Bosun). It is 
strictly prohibited to use the crane to lift cargoes at the "BYPASS" position. 
16.4 克令吊使用前要打开通风管盖和油冷机的通风管盖。使用完毕后，要关闭所有门窗、
通风管盖和油冷机的通风管盖。 
Prior to the use of crane, the ventilation pipe cover and the ventilation pipe cover of the oil cooler must be 
opened. After use, it is necessary to shut down all access door and window, ventilation pipe cover and 
ventilation pipe cover of the oil cooler. 
16.5 克令吊的外部保持良好的维护保养状态，对各润滑部位和注油点进行定期保养、加油，
使克令吊处于正常使用状态。 
The exterior of the crane must be kept in good maintenance condition, and regular maintenance and oiling 
shall be conducted to various lubrication parts and oiling points, so that the crane is kept in a functional 
condition. 
16.6 若发现克令吊异常或遇故障时，要及时通知轮机长或三管轮，进行检查或维修，待确
认故障消除后方可进行克令吊操作。严禁擅自变更、切除安全保护设定，严禁野蛮操
作和盲目操作。 
If the crane is found with abnormality or fault, the Chief Engineer or the Fourth Engineer shall be notified 
in time to carry out inspection or repair, and the crane shall only resume operation upon confirmation that 
all faults are eliminated. It is strictly prohibited to make unauthorized changes, remove safety protection 
settings, or operate in a barbaric and blind manner. 
18.0 使用双吊杆作业时，装卸作业中必须将吊杆边稳索、保险索、中稳索收紧，防止吊杆
摆动。吊货不要太高，两吊货索夹角不得超过120 度。严禁使用“超关”、“拖关”、“游
关”、“摔关”。 
When using double boom derrick for loading and unloading operations, cargo gear shroud, preventive 
guy and midship guy must be tightened, so as to prevent the derrick from swinging. Cargoes shall not be 
lifted too high, and the angle between the two cargo cables shall not exceed 120 degrees. Overloading, 
dragging, swinging and throwing are strictly prohibited. 
19.0 千斤索、吊货钢丝必须在卷筒上固定，其长度要保证当吊杆、吊臂作业到最高限位同
时钩头到舱底状态时的卷筒上的钢丝绳必须保持规定的安全圈数（最少4 圈），克令吊
还应保持在吊钩升至最高位置时有空槽约一圈。 
Topping lift and cargo wire must be fixed on the cable drum, and the length shall ensure that the jib and 
boom can reach the highest limit, while the wire rope on the reel must maintain a specified safe number 
of circles (at least 4 circles) when the hook reaches the bilge; and in addition, the crane shall also keep an 
empty slot for about one circle when the hook reaches the highest position.

第20 节 修船安全须知 
Section 20 Safety Instructions During Ship Repair 
 
1.0 总则 
General Principles 
1.1 为了保证修船期间的人员和船舶安全特制定本须知。 
In order to ensure the safety of personnel and the ship during ship repair, the following instructions are 
formulated. 
1.2 本须知适用于公司所管理船舶在船厂修理和有外来人员对船舶进行修理的期间。 
These instructions are applicable to the period when the ship managed by the company is under repair in a 
shipyard and by other contractor. 
1.3 船长对修船期间的安全负总责，对各部门修船期间的安全计划给予指导并负责检查各
部门的安全计划和实施情况。 
The Master shall be responsible for the overall safety during ship repair, and shall provide guidance to all 
departments for ship safety plan during repair, and is responsible for the inspection of each department’s 
safety plan and its implementation.  
1.4 大副、轮机长分别负责各自部门的安全计划和实施，并对其进行经常性的安全检查。 
The Chief Officer and the Chief Engineer are responsible for the safety plan and its implementation of 
their respective departments, as well as regular safety inspections. 
2.0 修船的特点 
Characteristics of ship repair 
2.1 登船的人员多而复杂。 
Personnel aboard are in large number and complex. 
2.2 部分船舶设备处于非正常状态。 
Certain shipboard equipment are in abnormal condition. 
2.3 多个工作面同时展开，船舶表面秩序和工作秩序相对较为混乱。 
Multiple tasks are carried out at the same time, and the appearance order and working order of the ship is 
relatively chaotic. 
2.4 热工作业较多，消防工作的任务较为突出。 
There may be many hot work ongoing, thus the fire-fighting work is more prominent. 
2.5 船员精神容易放松和懈怠。 
The crew’s spirits tend to relax and slack. 
3.0 安全措施 
Safety measures 
3.1 进厂修理首先要注意安全,主要的安全措施应从防火、防坠落、防触电、防滑和防冻等
方面来考虑，船长及时与船厂签订防火安全协议。 
Prior to repair in the dockyard, attention shall be paid to safety first, and considerations shall be given to 
main safety measures in the aspect of fire prevention, falling off prevention, slip prevention and 
anti-freezing. The Master shall sign fire-fighting safety agreement with the shipyard in time. 
3.2 防火：修船中有大量热工作业，因此易燃、易爆品应集中存放并有醒目标志。厂方的
动火通知单必须得到船方的签字认可后方可进行相关作业，并且船上应分部门指派专
职看火员不定期地对各个动火场所进行巡视。收工后值班人员应对各动火作业场所及
相邻处所进行定期的、连续的仔细检查（尤其是在动火后的4到6个小时内），以防死灰
复燃。在整个修船期中应注意消防器材的管理，确保随时可用。

第21 节 锁闭挂牌规定 
Section 21 Regulations on Lock Out / Tag Out  
1. 目的/PURPOSE 
1.1 防止机器和设备意外通电或启动，或释放储存的能量，以防止在服务和维护操作期间造成工
伤事故。 
To prevent the unexpected energization or startup of machines and equipment, or release of stored energy, 
in order to prevent workplace injuries during service and maintenance operations. 
1.2 该程序规定了对机器或设备进行维护或维修时，对能量隔离设备采取“锁闭/挂牌规定”（即
LOTO制度）的最低要求。 
This procedure establishes the minimum requirements for the“Lock Out / Tag Out (LOTO 
Regulations)” of energy isolating devices whenever maintenance or servicing is done on machines 
or equipment. 
1.3 为避免机器或设备意外通电或启动或存储能量释放可能导致人员受伤时，根据风险级别高低
，应使用锁闭或悬挂标牌的方式，确保机器或设备停止运行，与所有潜在危险能源隔离。在
船员进行任何维修或维护之前锁闭或悬挂标牌；在工作结束时，获得许可后才能开锁摘牌，
解除锁闭，恢复正常。 
The “Locked in or Tagged in”shall be used to ensure that the machine or equipment is stopped, 
isolated from all potentially hazardous energy sources may result in injury to personnel, depending 
on the level of risk. The lockout or tag out should be done before crew perform any servicing or 
maintenance where the unexpected energization or start-up of the machine or equipment or release of 
stored energy could cause injury. At the end of the work, obtain permission to unlock and remove the 
tag, then release the lock or tag, return to normal. 
1.4 要求所有可能受到能量意外影响的人员必须尽可能使用物理屏蔽装置保护自己。如果无条件使
用这种物理屏蔽装置那么必须进行充分的告示、沟通和确认。 
This requires all personnel who have the potential to be affected by unexpected energy exposure 
must be protected by means of a physical blocking device whenever possible. If a physical guarding 
device is not possible a means of notification/communication must be identified and implemented. 
2. 适用范围/SCOPE 
2.1 工作中会涉及的多种类型能量来源，包括：机械、液压、气动、化学、热能、电气、蒸汽、弹
力等。 
The company works involves variety of energy types including: Mechanical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic, 
Chemical, Thermal, electrical, steam, elastic, etc.  
2.2 安装、设置、调整、检查、改装、维护和/或维修机器或设备，包括润滑、清洁或拆解机器或
设备，以及进行调整，使工作人员可能面临设备的意外通电或启动或危险能量释放 
Installing, setting up, adjusting, inspecting, modifying, maintaining and/or servicing machines or 
equipment, including lubrication, cleaning or unjamming of machines or equipment, and making 
adjustments, where ship’s crew could be exposed to the unexpected energization or start-up of the 
equipment or release of hazardous energy. 
2.3 在正常操作期间执行的维修和维护活动，如果 
Servicing and maintenance activities performed during normal operations if: 
a. 工作人员需要拆除或绕过机器防护装置或其他安全装置，或 
A crew is required to remove or bypass machine guards or other safety devices, or 
b. 工作人员需要将其身体的任何部分置于操作点或机器或设备上执行工作的区域，或
放入与机器操作相关的危险区域。

with this procedure. All crew, upon observing a machine or piece of equipment which is tagged in, to

4.实施/PROCEDURE 
在维护或修理设备时，如果存在可能危及人员的意外启动或通电，则必须提前采取预防措施。
根据风险级别高低，或锁闭，或挂牌提醒。 
Precautions must be taken before servicing or repairing equipment under conditions in which 
unexpected start-up or energizing may endanger personnel. Depending on the level of risk, use locks 
to lock out, or hang up tags as a reminder.

4.1.1 定义Definitions 
a) 锁闭挂牌：通过锁闭挂牌来物理隔离能量。有锁闭则必有挂牌。 
LOCK OUT / TAG OUT (LOTO): The act of physical isolation of an energy source and

ATTACHED WITH TAGS. 
b) 悬挂标牌：根据既定程序在能量隔离设备上悬挂标牌，以指示在移走标牌之前，能量隔离设
备和被控制的设备可能无法运行。 
TAG IN / TAG OUT: The placement of a Tag In device on an energy-isolating device, in accordance 
with an established procedure, to indicate that the energy-isolating device and the equipment being 
controlled may not be operated until the Tag In device is removed. 
c) 标牌：公司特定的警告标牌，警告个人，在移除标签之前，可能无法操作其所连接

securely fastened to an  energy-isolating device ( Eg: Cable Tie, Strings)

has the ultimate responsibility for assuring total isolation of all energy sources and compliance to the 
procedures. 
e)授权工作人员：在机器或设备中标牌以进行维修或维护的任何驾驶员或轮机员。

4.1.2 步骤Procedure: 
工作人员必须事先做好准备，并取得船长/大副/轮机长的工作许可.。 
It is mandatory for the Personnel to prepared and obtain approval of Permit-to-Work process from the

a) 轮机长、大副确定哪些能源需要隔离。

Return operating control(s) to neutral or "off" position after verifying the isolation of the equipment.

B. 锁/标牌移除步骤（将设备恢复到服务状态） 
Sequence of Lock Out/Tag Out (Restoring Equipment to Service) 
当维修或保养完成并且机器或设备准备恢复到正常运行状态时，应采取以下步骤。 
When the servicing or maintenance is completed and the machine or equipment is ready to return to 
normal operating condition, the following steps shall be taken. 
1) 检查机器或设备以及机器周围的区域，以确保不必要的物品已被移除，并且机器或设备部件
在操作上完好无损。 
Check the machine or equipment and the immediate area around the machine to ensure that 
nonessential items have been removed and that the machine or equipment components are 
operationally intact. 
2) 检查工作区域，确保所有工作人员均处于安全位置或从该区域撤离 
Check the work area to ensure that all crew have been safely positioned or removed from the area. 
3) 验证控件是否处于空档。 
Verify that the controls are in neutral. 
4) 取下标牌并重新激活机器或设备。 
Remove the Tag and reenergize the machine or equipment. 
5) 请在标牌悬挂/标牌移除检查列表 填写第7 部分填写了必要的签名。 
Section 7 of Tag In / tag Out Check list is filled up necessary signatures appended. 
5 标牌的使用程序 
Procedure for Using of Tag 
标牌应用永久性墨水（笔）清楚地填充并放置在卡套内，以保护其免受工作场所环境条件的影响。 
Tags should be clearly filled up with permanent ink (pen) and placed inside card case so that it is protected 
from environmental condition of the work place. 
6. 记录的维护/Maintenance of Records 
本程序应使用锁闭挂牌/移除检检查表。此外，如果需要使用其他检查表，例如封闭空间/高空作业/
动火作业，则应在适用情况下与挂牌检查表一起使用。 
Lock Out / Tag Out Checklist shall be used for the purpose of this procedure. In addition where other check 
list are required to be used e.g enclosed space/working aloft/hot work, same shall be used along with Lock 
Out / Tag Out Checklist where applicable. 
检查清单的记录应由轮机长或大副保存。 
The record of the check list shall be maintained by Chief Engineer or Chief Officer 
清单的保留期为3年

每个悬挂的标牌必须由该悬挂的工作人员从能量隔离设备中移除 
Each tag device must be removed from the energy-isolating device by the crew who applied the device. 
备注 2  NOTE 2 
作业完成并移除标牌后。确保“标牌悬挂/标牌移除”箱中始终有足够的备用标牌可用 
Once the job is completed and the tags removed. Ensure that sufficient Spare Tags are always available

7.1 锁及标牌由悬挂人以外的其他人移除 
Take Out by other than who applied the Tag In/Lock In 
当悬挂标牌的授权人员无法移除标牌时，可以根据轮机长或大副的指示移除该标牌 
When the authorized crew who applied the tag in device is not available to take out, that device may be 
removed under the DIRECTIVES of the Chief Engineer or Chief Officer. 
步骤Steps: 
- 
必须验证该装置的工作人员是否在机器上工作。 
- 
It must be verified that the crew who had applied the device is not working on the machinery. 
- 
尽一切努力联系授权人员，通知他/她在设备中的锁和/或标牌已被移除。 
- 
All reasonable efforts to contact the authorized crew to inform him/her that his/her Lock/Tag in device 
has been removed. 
- 
必须确保授权人员在他/她恢复设备/机械工作之前知道设备中的标牌已被移除。 
- 
It must be ensured that the authorized crew knows that the tag in device has been removed before 
he/she resumes work on the equipment / machinery 
7.2 当临时移除标牌时/When the Tag has to be removed Temporarily 
在某些情况下，工作人员需要在维修或维护期间暂时恢复机器或设备赋能，以测试和/或重新定位
机器或设备。标牌可能会被暂时移除以执行这些任务。 
In some circumstances, crew need to temporarily restore energy to a machine or piece of equipment 
during servicing or maintenance to test and /or reposition the machine or piece of equipment. Tag may 
be Tagged Out temporarily in order to perform these tasks. 
步骤/Steps: 
- 
机器或设备必须清除工具和其他物品 
- 
The machine or equipment must be cleared of tools and materials. 
- 
填写标牌悬挂/标牌移除检查列表的第6部分和必要的签名 
- 
Section 6 of Lock out and Tag out Checklist S-04 (as amended) is filled up & necessary signatures 
appended 
- 
任何工作人员必须从机器或设备区域离开 
- 
Any Crew must be removed from the machine or equipment area. 
- 
然后可以移除所有标牌。 
- 
All Tags may then be removed. 
- 
经授权的工作人员随后可以继续为设备或机械赋能并进行测试或检查 
- 
Authorized Crew may then proceed to energize and test or inspection the equipment or machinery. 
在试验或检查后，所有系统必须重新实施释能和能量控制措施（参照第5 A.3.），以便 继续维修
和/或维护。 
After testing or inspecting, all systems must be de-energized and energy control measures reapplied ( as 
per para 5 A..3 onwards ) to continue the servicing and /or maintenance. 
8 
值班更换期间保持标牌保护的连续性 
Continuity of Tag In Protection Maintained During Change Of Watch 
在船员值班交接期间，对标牌设施的监护应得到有序交接 ，以确保其监护的连续性。这 
将有助于最大限度地减少机器或设备意外通电或启动或储存能量释放造成的危害。 
The continuity of Ship’s Crew protection should be provided for the orderly transfer of Tag In device 
protection between off-going and incoming crew. This will help to minimize exposure to hazards from 
the unexpected energization or start-up of the machine or equipment or the release of stored energy.

Training with regards to Lock Out / Tag out should be carried out at interval as per shipboard

During the scheduled training of the Ship`s crew, following points shall be emphasized: 
- 
标牌悬挂/标牌移除程序的目的 
- 
The purpose of Lock out / tag Out procedures 
- 
标牌本质上是附着在能量隔离设备上的警示牌，并且不像锁那样提供的那些设备提供物理约束

Tags are essentially warning devices affixed to energy isolating devices and do not

authorization and it is never to be bypassed or ignored, otherwise the purpose will be 
defeated.

标牌必须清晰易懂，所有船员都能理解

- 
标签必须牢固地连接到能量隔离设备上，以免在使用过程中意外或意外脱落 
- 
Tags must be securely attached to energy isolating devices so that they cannot be 
inadvertently or accidentally detached during use. 
- 
所有培训均应记录在案，包括参加培训的人员的日期和姓名

第22 节 高压水枪操作安全规定 
Section 22 Regulations on High Pressure Water Jet Equipment Operations 
高压水枪设备在诸多领域发挥着重要作用，但因其高压特性，操作不当极易引发安全
事故。为保障人员生命安全、避免设备损坏，特制定本操作安全规定。 
High-pressure water jet equipment plays an important role in many fields, but due to its high-pressure 
characteristics, improper operation can easily lead to safety accidents. In order to ensure the safety of 
personnel and avoid equipment damage, these operating safety regulations are specially formulated. 
1 
操作前准备Prepare for the operation 
1.1 人员要求Personnel Requirements 
1.1.1 
操作小组构成：高压水枪操作小组至少由三人组成，包括操枪者、操枪助手和操泵
者。各成员应明确自身职责，协同作业。 
Composition of the operation team: The high-pressure water jet operation team is composed of at 
least three people, including the operator, the operator assistant and the pump operator. Members 
should clarify their responsibilities and work together. 
1.1.2 
培训与授权：所有作业人员必须接受针对船上设备的岗前熟悉与培训，详细了解设
备的操作性能、局限性及使用注意事项，并记录在培训记录簿中。 
Training and authorization: All operators must be familiar with and trained on the equipment on 
board before work, and have a detailed understanding of the operation performance, limitations and 
precautions of the equipment, and record it in the training record book. 
1.1.3 
个人防护装备：作业人员务必穿戴齐全个人防护装备，包括脸部防护罩、安全帽、
雨衣、带铁头橡胶靴子、防水手套和听力保护器等，确保在作业过程中身体各部位
得到有效防护。 
Personal Protective Equipment: Operators must wear complete personal protective equipment, 
including face mask, safety helmet, raincoat, rubber boots with iron tips, waterproof gloves and 
hearing protectors, etc., to ensure that all parts of the body are effectively protected during operation. 
1.2 设备检查equipment inspection 
1.2.1 
日常检查：每天作业前，应对设备进行全面检查。检查所有软管和配件是否存在磨
损、裂缝、老化等缺陷，若有问题必须及时更换；查看喷枪扳机、保险装置是否正
常工作，保证扳机灵活、保险可靠；检查水泵润滑油量是否充足、油质是否良好，
严禁无水启动水泵；确认水箱水位正常，上下水通畅，水路无破损、松动、漏水现
象，同时检查软管有无弯折，避免卷入运转设备。 
Routine inspection: A comprehensive inspection of the equipment shall be carried out before 
operation every day. Check all hoses and accessories for wear, cracks, aging and other defects, if 
there is a problem must be replaced in time; Check whether the jet trigger and safety device work 
normally to ensure that the trigger is flexible and reliable; Check whether the amount of lubricating 
oil in the pump is sufficient, whether the oil quality is good, and it is strictly prohibited to start the 
pump without water; Confirm that the water level of the water tank is normal, the water is smooth,

avoid getting involved in the operating equipment. 
1.2.2 
电气检查：检查电源是否符合设备铭牌要求，连接应由专业人员进行，确保接地良
好，并安装漏电保护开关。定期检测电动机引接线与机壳的绝缘。检查电源线是否
有破损、裂缝，避免使用存在安全隐患的电缆线。 
Electrical inspection: Check whether the power supply meets the requirements of the equipment 
nameplate, the connection should be carried out by professionals, ensure good grounding, and install 
the leakage protection switch. Periodically check the insulation between the motor lead wire and the 
housing. Check whether the power cable is damaged or cracked, and do not use the cable with 
potential safety risks. 
2 
操作过程规范Operating procedure specification 
2.1 连接设备connecting device 
2.1.1 
电源连接：连接高压水枪电源前，作业人员应确保工作服干燥，并安排专人陪同。
选择合适的插座，保证电源插头与插座匹配，连接牢固，防止松动引发触电风险。 
Power connection: Before connecting the power supply of the high-pressure water jet, the operator 
should ensure that the work clothes are dry, and arrange a special person to accompany. Select the 
appropriate socket, ensure that the power plug matches the socket, the connection is firm, and prevent 
the risk of electric shock caused by loosening. 
2.1.2 
水路连接：将进水管正确连接到设备的进水口，确保密封良好，防止漏水。连接高
压出水管时，使用合适的工具拧紧接头，防止高压水泄漏。 
Water connection: Correctly connect the water inlet pipe to the water inlet of the equipment, ensure 
that the seal is good, to prevent water leakage. When connecting high-pressure water pipes, use 
proper tools to tighten the connectors to prevent high-pressure water leakage. 
2.1.3 
喷枪连接：将喷枪与高压管牢固连接，并安装合适的枪头。安装过程中注意检查枪
头是否堵塞，确保喷射畅通。 
Spray jet connection: firmly connect the spray jet to the high-pressure pipe, and install a suitable jet 
head. Pay attention to check whether the jet head is blocked during installation to ensure smooth 
injection. 
2.1.4 
高压水枪作业前，完成本手册操作检查表 Operational Check List ，每天作业前，
都应当填写和完成此检查表。 
Before high-pressure water jet operations, complete the Operational Check List of this manual. This 
check list should be filled in and completed before operations every day. 
2.2 操作规范Operation Specifications 
2.2.1 
压力控制：严禁超压操作，设备开机前压力设定必须为零，启动后缓慢调整至合适
压力，避免压力骤升。泵操作者在升压和降压时应缓慢调节，密切关注操枪者的状
态，确保其能适应水枪反冲力的变化。

Pressure control: Overpressure operation is strictly prohibited. The pressure setting of the equipment 
must be zero before starting, and slowly adjusted to the appropriate pressure after starting to avoid 
sudden pressure rise. The pump operator should adjust slowly when boosting and reducing pressure, 
pay close attention to the state of the operator, and ensure that it can adapt to the change of the recoil 
force of the water jet. 
2.2.2 
操枪姿势：操枪者应保持稳定的站立姿势，双手正确握持喷枪，一只手握紧喷枪手
柄，另一只手握住水管，严禁单手持枪或食指放在扳机上。移动水枪时，应一手拿
枪托，一手拿枪杆，避免水枪晃动失控。 
Jet handling posture: Jet operators should maintain a stable standing posture; hold the spray jet 
correctly with both hands, with one hand holding the handle of the spray jet and the other hand 
holding the water pipe. It is strictly forbidden to hold the jet with one hand or put the index finger on 
the trigger. When moving the water jet, you should hold the stock in one hand and the barrel in the 
other hand to avoid the water jet shaking out of control. 
2.2.3 
喷射方向：绝对禁止将水枪对准他人、电气设备、牲畜或易燃物，防止造成人身伤
害、设备损坏或火灾事故。操作过程中，应根据作业需求准确控制喷射方向，避免
误喷。 
Spray direction: It is strictly prohibited to point the water jet at other people, electrical equipment, 
livestock, or combustible materials to prevent personal injury, equipment damage, or fire accidents. 
During the operation, the injection direction should be accurately controlled according to the 
operation requirements to avoid miss praying. 
2.2.4 
避免打闹：作业现场严禁打闹嬉戏，防止因注意力不集中导致水枪失控，引发安全
事故。 
Avoid fighting: It is strictly forbidden to play in the work site to prevent the water jet from getting 
out of control due to lack of attention and causing safety accidents. 
2.3 特殊情况处理Handling Special Cases 
2.3.1 
设备故障：若在操作过程中设备出现泄漏、异常声音、震动等故障，操泵者应立即
关闭电源停止作业，现场人员迅速撤离至安全区域。在故障未排除前，严禁擅自启
动设备。 
Equipment failure: If the equipment leaks, abnormal sound, vibration and other faults occur during 
operation, the pump operator should immediately turn off the power to stop operation, and the on-site 
personnel should evacuate to the safe area. Do not start the device before the fault is rectified. 
2.3.2 
人员受伤：如发生人员受伤情况，应立即停止作业，第一时间对伤者进行急救处理，
并及时联系医疗救援。同时，保护好事故现场，以便后续调查分析。 
Personnel injury: In case of personnel injury, the operation should be stopped immediately, the first

潜水作业须知 
Instruction for diving operation 
 
1. 目的和范围 purpose and scope  
控制潜水作业中的风险，保障潜水作业的安全。本须知适用于公司所管理的所有船舶。  
Control the risks involved during diving operation and ensure safety. This regulation applies to all ship 
under the management of company. 
2. 术语和定义：Terms and Definitions 
潜水作业是指船舶由于水下检验、水下修理或需要潜水员协助而进行的水下作业。 
Diving operation means all the underwater operations for the purpose of underwater survey, underwater 
repair or those conducted with assistance offered by divers.  
3. 职责：Responsibilities 
3.1 公司机务主管负责安排有资质的专业潜水公司进行潜水作业，并获得主管当局的同意； 
The company’s technical superintendent arranges diving operations conducted by qualified professional 
diving companies with consent of the authorities concerned. 
3.2 船长负责签署“潜水作业许可证”；并保留风险评估和潜水作业许可证；  
The master signs “ diving operation permit” and keep the risk assessment and the permit in file. 
4. 管理要求Management requirement  
4.1 只有在完成作业风险评估，并对识别的风险采取适当控制措施后，才能开始潜水作业。 
会议应由船上管理团队、其他与作业有关的船员和潜水队的所有成员共同参与。  
Diving operation shall be commenced only after the risk assessment is made and control measures are 
taken against all identified risks. The meeting shall be attended by the management team of the vessel, 
the crew members to be involved in the diving operation, and the members of the dicing team. 
4.2 会议应讨论以下各项会议议程（并不限于这些内容），就各有关事项达成一致，并完
成“潜水作业许可证”：  
The following topics ( not only limited to those ), shall be discussed on the meeting with an agreement 
made, “diving operation permit” completed. 
 
天气、海况； Weather, sea conditions. 
 
水深、水质、水流、水温；Water depth, water quality, current, water temperature. 
 
潜水队、船上甲板部以及轮机部之间的通信联络安排；  
Communications among the diving team, the deck and the engine department.

Section 01 Responsibilities of the Crew Position 
 
1  船长 
The Master 
船长是船舶的领导人，受公司委托管理船舶，全面负责船舶安全和行政管理，对船舶
安全管理、防污染负有全面责任, 全体船员必须服从船长的领导。 
The Master is the leader of the ship, authorized by the company to manage the ship, fully responsible for 
the ship safety and administration management, with full responsibilities to the ship safety management 
and pollution prevention, and all crew must obey the guidance of the Master. 
1.1 管理体系在船舶的运行 
Management system in the ship operation 
1.1.1 负责贯彻执行公司的安全和环境保护方针； 
Responsible for implementing the company’s safety and environmental protection policy; 
1.1.2 负责发布实施管理体系的命令和须知，激励船员遵守该方针； 
Responsible for giving orders and instruction as to the execution of management system, and encourage 
the crew to follow the policy; 
1.1.3 负责验证、评估管理体系在本船的运行情况，使各种安全操作和防污染管理保持有效，
及时发现不符合规定情况，落实纠正措施； 
Responsible for the operating conditions of the verification and evaluation of the management system in 
the ship, ensure all kinds of safety operations and pollution prevention management are effective. Find 
non-conformities timely and execute corrective measures;  
1.1.4 负责按程序定期对管理体系进行复查并保持记录，报告体系的不足，提出改进意见； 
Responsible for performing periodic review and take record of the management system according to the 
procedure, report the deficiency of the system and give suggestions; 
1.1.5 承担船舶保安职责，带领全体船员贯彻执行船舶保安计划，并评审船舶保安计划在本
船的实际运行情况，及时发现船舶保安不符合规定情况，及时进行纠正； 
Responsible for the ship security responsibilities, guide all crew to execute the Ship Security Plan, and 
assess the actual operation condition of the Ship Security Plan on the ship, and find the 
non-conformities as to ship security regulations timely. If any problem is found, amend it timely. 
1.1.6 组织船舶安全会活动； 
Organize the ship’s safety activities;  
1.1.7 负责本船现场操作风险评估的培训、组织、实施、监督、评价和改进，并向公司报告。 
Responsible for the training, organizing, implementing, supervision, evaluation and improvement of the 
on-site operation risk assessment on the ship, and report to the company. 
1.2 航行安全 
Navigation safety 
1.2.1 根据航次任务，介绍航线情况和航次货运任务，通知各部门负责人做好开航前准备。 
Introduce the conditions of navigation route and voyage transport task according to the voyage 
assignment, and inform all department heads to prepare before the navigation. 
1.2.2 查阅航海警告、气象预报、航路指南等有关的航海资料，对二副提出航线设计要求，
审核、批准二副制定的航线计划。 
Check the navigation information such as navigation warning, weather forecast, sailing direction and so 
on. Give the requirements on route design to the Second Officer. Check and approval the passage plan 
established by the Second Officer.
