1.2.3 检查开航前的各方面的准备情况，保证船舶处于适航状态。 
Check all kinds of preparation conditions before sailing, ensure the ship is of seaworthiness condition.  
1.2.4 在航行中监督船员值班和工作情况，密切注意天气变化，确保航行安全；按规定在特
殊情况下到驾驶台值守，必要时直接指挥航行；任何时候当值驾驶员呼叫船长时，应
尽快到驾驶台。 
During navigation, supervise the duty and working condition of crew. Pay close attention to the change 
of weather to ensure navigation safety. Take duties in the bridge under special conditions according to 
the regulations, conduct the navigation directly if necessary. Whenever the officer of the watch is calling 
the Master, go to the bridge as soon as possible. 
1.2.5 船舶抵、离港前指示大副、轮机长安排安全检查；监督相关人员按照驾驶台有关检查
表进行检查并记录。 
Before the ship arrival or departure at the port, order the Chief Officer and the Chief Engineer to arrange 
safety inspection; supervise the relevant personnel to check equipment in the bridge and record into the 
checklist.  
1.2.6 航行和锚泊期间，每晚把船长指示明确写入“船长夜航命令簿”。 
Write down the orders in the “The Master Night Order Book” during navigation and anchoring every 
night. 
1.2.7 遇雾航、狭窄水道、恶劣天气、进出港（靠离码头）及锚地时，应在驾驶台指挥航行
和操纵；有引水员引航时，与引水员交换信息，监督引水员的操作，发现错误及时提
醒或纠正。 
The captain should conduct and manoeuvre the ship in heavy fog and narrow channel, or while entering 
/ leaving the port (berthing and leaving the wharf) and anchorage. When the pilot come on board, he 
should exchange information with the pilot and monitor his operation, remind or correct him timely if 
any mistake is found. 
1.2.8 三副值班期间，应经常进行检查指导，应能够随时赶到驾驶台指挥。 
When the Third Officer is on duty, the Master should perform inspection and guidance, and be able to 
come the bridge to conduct at any times; 
1.3 货运管理 
Cargo Management  
1.3.1 认真领会航次命令，按要求指示大副安排及时备好货舱，做好装货准备。 
Should carefully understand the voyage instructions, instruct the Chief Officer to arrange preparation of 
the cargo holds timely according to the requirement, and get ready for loading cargo. 
1.3.2 审核、批准大副编制的货物配载图和装卸计划，保证达到规定的最大装载量，弯矩、
剪力和稳性等参数处于安全范围内。 
Review and approve the cargo stowage plan as well as loading and discharge plan established by the 
Chief Officer, to reach the maximum cargo intake as required, with readings of bending moment, shear 
force and stability within the safety range.  
1.3.3 根据航次命令指示轮机长合理计划、申请燃、润料的补充。 
Instruct the Chief Engineer to reasonably plan and apply for the refilling fuel oil and lubricating oil 
according to the voyage instructions. 
1.3.4 装卸货期间监督货物装卸情况。 
Monitor the status of cargo loading and discharging during the process; 
1.3.5 在航行期间，督促大副做好货物的保管工作。 
Supervise the Chief Officer to tend careful the cargo during navigation. 
1.3.6 船舶抵离港前，获取并查阅港口相关资料；按规定向有关方面提交各种报告、文件。

Before arriving and leaving the port, check the port information; submit all kinds of reports and 
documents to the concerned parties according to the requirement. 
1.3.7 在港按规定办理进出港手续，及时提交备妥通知书和其他相关通知。  
Complete the formalities of arrival and departure port according to the requirement, Submit timely 
notice of readiness and other relevant notice 
1.3.8 认真审核提单、舱单、大副收据、事实记录和其他相关货运单证，按公司指示签署各
类单证。 
Review carefully the bill of lading and cargo manifest, mate receipts, statement of fact and other 
relevant transportation documents, and sign all kinds of receipts according to the instruction of the 
company. 
1.3.9 期租期间，在保证船舶、人员、货物的安全和公司利益不受损害的前提下，向承租人
提供优质的服务。 
During the chartering periods, provide quality service to the Charterer, under ensure the ship, personnel, 
cargo safety and the prerequisite of causing no harms the interest of company. 
1.4 船舶的维护保养： 
Ship Maintenance  
1.4.1 督促、检查各部门日常维修保养工作,保持良好船舶状况。 
Supervise and inspect the routine maintenance of all departments, the condition and appearance of the 
ship should be kept in a good condition.  
1.4.2 审批各部门制订的年度和月度维修保养计划和完成情况。 
Check and approve the annual and monthly maintenance plan, and the condition of progress arranged by 
all departments. 
1.4.3 监督各部门定期安全自查和抵港前的PSC 自查，发现问题及时纠正。 
Supervise the periodic safety self-inspection and pre-arrival PSC self-inspection of all the departments. 
If any problem is found, should be corrected timely. 
1.4.4 按规定向公司报告船舶和设备缺陷，申请岸基支持，保持船舶处于良好状态。 
Report the deficiency of the ship and equipment to the company according to the regulations, apply for 
the shore-based support to keep the ship in good condition. 
1.4.5 审核、整理各部门修船清单，汇总后报公司审批。 
Check and verify the repairing list of all the departments. Summarize them and report to the company 
for approval. 
1.4.6 修船期间，督促各部门做好修理项目的监修和验收；配合船舶证书的更新工作；修船
结束后，妥善保存新的证书、检验报告、修船完工单、坞修完工记录、测厚记录、救
生消防用品检查检验记录等。 
During ship repairs, supervise all departments to perform monitor, examination and verification work of 
the repair projects. Co-operate with the update work of ship’s certificate. After the ship repairs, keep the 
new certificate, inspection reports, ship repairs work done receipt, shipyard repairs work done record, 
thickness measurement record, lifesaving and firefighting items inspection and testing record in good 
care. 
1.5 船员管理 
Crew Management  
 
1.5.1 检查和督促全体船员各尽其责，遵守公司的规章制度和劳动纪律。 
Inspect and motivate all the crew to work up to their full duties, follow the regulations and labor 
discipline of the company. 
1.5.2 监督轮机长、大副交接班。 
Supervise the work handover of the Chief Engineer and the Chief Officer.

Crew Onboard Training

Perform all kinds of emergency drills according to the plan.

Document Management

Responsible for keeping ship official seal, important documents, ship’s certificates and crew competent 
certificates. Always inspect whether all kinds of certificates are in expiry dates, and notify the next 
Master during handover. 
1.7.2 审核并向公司提交规定的各种报表和报告。 
Verify and submit all kinds of lists and reports to the company according to the regulations. 
1.7.3 负责船舶通讯的控制和邮件、传真和电话的使用，监督、检查船舶通信设备的管理。 
Responsible for the control on ship communication and approve the use of email, faxes and phone calls, 
monitor and inspect the management of communication equipment. 
1.7.4 审阅并签署油类记录簿、垃圾记录簿、航海日志、电台日志（GMDSS LOG）等船舶记
录簿，督促和检查记录的符合性和准确性。 
Review and sign the ship record books, such as oil Record Book, Garbage Record Book, Deck Log 
Book, GMDSS Logbook and so on. Supervise and inspect the conformity and accurateness of the 
records. 
1.7.5 负责保管船长处的船舶技术资料、完工图纸资料等，船长交接班前，对技术资料、图

工图纸资料等交接情况。

Emergency Response 
按照公司的应急计划，当船舶发生应急情况时，作为全船的总指挥，采取一切有效措
施确保船员生命安全，保护船舶和货物，避免或减少海洋污染。

ensure the crew’s life safety, protect the ship and cargo, prevent or minimize the marine pollution 
according to the Contingency Plan.

Ship hygiene, food management and account report. 
1.9.1 对船舶伙食及卫生工作负有领导、监督职责。 
Responsible for guiding and monitoring the food and hygiene on the ship.  
1.9.2 对船舶环境卫生进行检查、监督。 
Inspect and monitor the ship’s housekeeping.  
1.9.3 保管船舶现金，向公司财务报告船帐。 
Keeping ship’s cash, report the ship’s account to the company’s finance department.

1.10.2 负责保持船级社的各种检验和有关船舶证书的有效。 
Responsible for maintaining the validity of all kinds of survey reports and the relevant ship’s 
certificates by the classification society. 
1.10.3 负责安全管理体系的内、外审核检验。 
Responsible for the internal and external audit verification of the safety management system. 
2   大副 
Chief Officer  
大副是船长的主要助手之一，全面负责甲板部的工作。在船长因故不能履行其职责时，
替代执行船长职责。 
The Chief Officer is one of the main deputy of the Master, fully responsible for the work of the Deck 
Department. If the Master is incapacitated, he is to assume command. He assumes command 
automatically if the Master is absent from the vessel.

2.1.1 负责管理体系在甲板部有效运行，执行船长有关命令，检查和督促本部门船员的工作。

execute the relevant orders from the Master, inspect and supervise the work of the crew in the 
department. 
2.1.2 保管本部门各种文件和相关资料，保持和监控部门内的相关记录。

Third Engineer 
在轮机长和大管轮的领导下做好如下工作：

Engine log book;

The Third Engineer is in charge of auxiliary engines（Generator）and its auxiliary equipment; 
10.3 负责燃油的加装、调驳、测量、净化以及相关设备的管理工作；填写相关体系报表，

of the relevant equipment. Fill in the forms about those operation, and responsible for getting and keep 
the samples of fuel oil. He should calculate the voyage consuming quantity of fuel oil and lubricating oil 
at the end of a voyage, then report to the Chief Engineer;

Responsible for the prepare of emergency list for shipboard oil spillage, to be reviewed by the Chief 
Engineer and approved by the Master;

Responsible for the oil spill prevention material area. Make a periodic inventory of these material, and 
report the inventory results to the Master so as to update the relevant information in the SOPEP. If 
shortage is found, submit application submission for a supply timely; 
10.6 负责造水机、空压机的操作和维修保养； 
Responsible for the operation and maintenance of the fresh water generator and air compressor; 
10.7 负责应急发电机、应急空压机、油舱、柜速闭阀等应急等安全设备的管理维护和试

tank, quick closing valves and other safety equipment;

Responsible for the management of the F.O tank, auxiliary engine lubricating oil tank and the respective 
system;

Fourth Engineer

处理装置、辅助锅炉与废气锅炉、空调、汽笛及其附属设备和系统等的维修保养工作。

第02 节 船员值班规则 
Section 02 Crew on Duty Regulations 
 
1.0 值班安排 
On duty arrangement 
不论航行或停泊，船舶实行不间断轮值制度。晚餐时，安排人员接替值班，时间不超
过半小时。 
The ship runs a continual work shift system no matter during navigation or berthing. In time of dinner, 
other personnel are arranged to take the shift for no longer than half hour. 
1.1 航行中 
During navigation 
1.1.1 驾驶台、机舱每班均为四小时。 
Each shift lasts for four hours for the bridge and engine room. 
1) 大副、大管轮值04:00—08:00，16:00—20:00 班。 
 Chief Officer, Second Engineer 04:00—08:00, 16:00—20:00 shift. 
2) 二副、二管轮值00:00—04:00，12:00—16:00 班。 
Second Officer, Third Engineer 00:00—04:00, 12:00—16:00 shift. 
3) 三副、三管轮值08:00—12:00，20:00—24:00 班。 
Third Officer, Fourth Engineer 08:00—12:00, 20:00—24:00 shift. 
1.1.2 驾驶员值班时，一般情况下要有一名值班水手同时值班。 
When the deck officer is on duty, one seaman is on duty together with him under generally. 
在海区宽阔、天气良好、通航密度少，不影响安全的原则下，经船长同意，可以使用
自动舵，在此情况下，每天08:00—16:00，每班可有一名值班水手参加驾驶台及其附
近的保养工作，保证在召唤时能立即到驾驶台。 
When the ship is in open sea, with fine weather and low traffic density, auto pilot can be used when it 
would not affect the safety principle and approval from the Master is granted. Under this circumstance, 
during 08:00-16:00 every day, one duty seaman can engage in the maintenance work at or nearby the 
bridge, to ensure that he can arrive at the bridge immediately once he is being called.  
但夜间航行至少有一名值班水手同时值班。 
However, during night navigation, at least one seaman must be on duty at the same time. 
1.1.3 轮机员值班时，根据船舶设备情况每班应有一名值班机工同值，必要时可增派机工协
助值班。 
When the engineer is on duty, each shift should have one motorman on duty at the same time subject to 
the condition of the ship equipment. If necessary, additional motormen can be arranged to assist the 
duties. 
1.1.4 执行无人机舱值班安排时，请参照船舶手册第六章第14 节的规定。 
Under arrangement to the unmanned engine room, see the regulations laid out in section 14, chapter 6 of 
the Ship Manual. 
1.2 锚泊时 
During anchoring 
1.2.1 甲板部由大副、二副、三副轮值，经船长同意，也可由实习三副代大副值班，但大副
仍应在船上负责；未配备实习三副的船上，二副和三副轮值，每班不超过六小时。每
班至少有一名值班水手。 
Chief Officer, Second Officer, Third Officer are responsible for the shift of deck department in turns. If 
approval of the Master is granted, third apprentice officer can also take the shift for the Chief Officer, but 
the Chief Officer should still bear responsibility on the ship; when there is no third apprentice officer on

1.3 港内停泊时 
During berthing in port 
在船人员不得少于全体船员的二分之一，高级船员不得少于全部高级船员的二分之一，
以适应日常生产管理、安全、防火等紧急应变的需要。遇有港口国、船旗国或其他外
部检查时，高级船员应保持在船。 
Onboard personnel should not less than 50% of the total crew, senior crews should not less than 50% of 
the total senior crews, so as to maintain routine production management, safety, firefighting and other 
emergency needs. In time of external inspection from port state, flag state or other authorities, senior 
crews should stay on the ship. 
1.4 白班作息时间安排 
Daily work/rest schedule 
早餐     07:00-07:30    午餐12:00-12:30    晚餐 17:30-18:00 
Breakfast   07:00-07:30      Lunch 12:00-12:30      Dinner 17:30-18:00 
白班工作时间    上午 08:00-12:00    下午  13:00-17:00 
Day shift:           A.M 08:00-12:00        P.M 13:00-17:00 
休息时间        上午 10:00-10:15     下午 15:00-15:15 
Rest time:          A.M 10:00-10:15         P.M 15:00-15:15 
严格遵守作息时间表，晚上10 点以后停止一切娱乐活动，避免影响他人休息。 
The crew shall strictly follow the schedule and stop all entertainment activities after 10 pm to avoid 
disturbing others. 
1.5 船上工作安排表及船员值班（工作）/休息时间记录表 
Shipboard Work Arrangement List and Records of Hours of Work/Rest of Crew 
1.5.1 轮机长、大副根据船舶实际情况制定本部门的船上工作安排表，报船长签字审批，船
长的工作安排由船长自己制定。工作安排有较大变动时，需重新制定并审批。船上工
作安排表应在船员容易进入的地点张贴。 
 
Chief Engineer and Chief Officer organise the shipboard work arrangement list of the department 
according to the actual situation, to be reviewed and approved by the Master. The work arrangement of 
the Master is organised by himself. If there is a big change to the work arrangement, it needs to be 
re-planned and reviewed once again. Shipboard work arrangement list should be posted at the location 
where the crews can easily access. 
1.5.2 最短休息时间不少于： 
The minimum resting hours should not under: 
1) 在任何24 小时时段内不得少于10 小时； 
Less than 10 hours within 24 hours; 
2) 在任何7 天时间内不得少于77 小时。 
Less than 77 hours within 7 days;  
3) 休息时间最多可分为两段，其中一段至少要有6 小时，且相连的两段休息时间的间
隔不得超过14 小时。 
Hours of rest may be divided into no more than two periods, one of which shall be at least six hours

in length, and the interval between consecutive periods of rest shall not exceed 14 hours. 
1.5.3 在紧急或在其他超常工作情况下不必要保持1 段规定的关于休息时间的要求。紧急集
合演习、消防和救生艇演习，以及法律、法规和国际文件规定的演习，应以对休息时
间的干扰最小且不导致船员疲劳的形式进行。 
Under emergency situation or other extraordinary, no need to follow the regulation about one rest period. 
Musters, fire-fighting and lifeboat drills, and drills prescribed by national laws and regulations and by 
international instruments, shall be conducted in a manner that minimizes the disturbance of rest periods 
and does not induce fatigue. 
紧急或其他超常情况不包括如靠离泊、装卸货、燃油加装等船舶日常操作，对于这些
日常操作，船舶领导应根据具体情况合理安排值班人员的工作时间。 
Emergency situation or other extraordinary do not include routine operation such as departure, berthing, 
loading, discharging, bunkering and so on. As to these routine operation, the ship leader should 
reasonably arrange the working hours of the duty personnel according to the actual situation. 
1.5.4 船旗国主管机关可以允许对上文1.5.2 2)和3)中规定的休息时间有例外，但在任何7
天内的休息时间不得少于70 小时。 
Flag state authorities can make adjustment to the resting hours regulated in 1.5.2 and 1.5.3 above as an 
exception, but the resting hours should not less than 70 hours within any 7 days. 
1) 对1.5.2 2)规定的每周休息时间的例外，不应超过连续两个星期。在船上连续两次
例外时间的间隔不应少于该例外持续时间的两倍。 
As to the regulation 1.5.2 2), for exceptional adjustment of weekly resting hours, should not exceed 
two weeks continuously. The interval between two exceptional adjustments should not exceed 2 
times of the duration of the exceptional adjustment. 
2) 对1.5.2 1)规定的休息时间可以分成为不超过3 个时间段，其中之一至少为6 个小
时，而另外两个时间段均不应少于1 个小时。 
The hours of rest provided for in paragraph 1.5.2 1) may be divided into no more than three periods, 
one of which shall be at least 6 hours in length and neither of the other two periods shall be less than 
one hour in length. 
3) 连续休息时间段间隔不得超过14 个小时。例外在任何7 天时间内不得超过两个24
小时时间段。    
The intervals between consecutive periods of rest shall not exceed 14 hours. Exceptions shall not 
extend beyond two 24-hour periods in any 7-day period. 
1.5.5 以上规定不得妨碍船长出于船舶、船上人员或货物的紧急安全需要，或出于帮助海上
遇险的其他船舶或人员的目的而要求船员从事任何时间工作的权利。因此，船长可暂
停休息时间，并要求海员从事任何必要的工作，直到正常情况恢复为止。 
Nothing in this section shall be deemed to impair the right of the master of a ship to require a seafarer to 
perform any hours of work necessary for the immediate safety of the ship, persons on board or cargo, or 
for the purpose of giving assistance to other ships or persons in distress at sea. Accordingly, the master 
may suspend the schedule of hours of rest and require a seafarer to perform any hours of work necessary 
until the normal situation has been restored. 
在情况恢复正常后，船长应尽快确保在计划休息期间工作的任何海员获得充分的休息
时间。紧急情况、演习及其它异常工作情况同时应记入航海日志、轮机日志等相关文
件。 
As soon as practicable after the normal situation has been restored, the master shall ensure that any 
seafarers who have performed work in a scheduled rest period are provided with an adequate period of 
rest. Emergency situation, drills and other unforeseen situations should be recorded in the deck log book, 
engine log book and other relevant documents.

船长在大风浪、能见度不良等特殊航行情况下，亲自到驾驶台值守时，工作时间应以

1.5.7 船员值班（工作）/休息时间记录表通过SMIS 填写并保存记录。每月将记录打印交船
员本人保存，该页需船长或授权人（部门长）签字盖章，需船员本人确认并签字。 
The Records of Hours of Work/Rest of Crew shall be filled and recorded by SMIS, the copy of the 
record should be printed out and sent to the concerned crew each month for keeping, which should be 
stamped and signed by the master or the person authorized by the master and by the crew. and the crew 
shall confirm and sign at the end of each month. 
 
2.0 甲板部值班人员值班职责 
Obligations of deck department duty personnel  
2.1 航行中 
During navigation 
2.1.1 航行中值班驾驶员的职责  
The obligations of duty deck officers during navigation 
1) 认真执行《船舶手册》第五章航行制度的相关规定，以及公司颁发的与航行工作有
关的各种通知和指示。 
Execute the relevant regulations as in Chapter 5 Navigation Regulations of the Ship Manual seriously, 
and all kinds of notice and instruction concerning navigation promulgated by the company. 
2) 严格遵守国际海上避碰规则,STCW 公约中所述的基本原则。对来往船只、渔船、浮
标及各种漂浮物做到安全避让。不做与驾驶值班无关的工作。任何情况下，都应使
用一切有效手段保持正规了望，以便对局面和碰撞危险做出充分的估计。 
Strictly comply with the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea (COLREGS) and 
the basic principles to be observed in keeping a navigation watch of the International Convention on 
Standards of Training, Certification and Watch-keeping for Seafarers, STCW Convention. Give way 
to passing ships, fishing boats, buoys and all kinds of floating objects for safety. Do not do work 
unrelated to the navigation duties. In all events, make use of all effective means to maintain standard 
lookout, so as to make sufficient estimation on the situation and risk of collision. 
3) 充分利用各种航海仪器、天体、陆标等正确测定、核对船位，并检验GPS 的有效性，
在近岸及狭水道航行时，应使用陆标、雷达等多种定位办法测定、核对船位，缩短
定位间隔。在任何情况定位的次数应满足安全航行的需要。如船长认为必要应按其
指示随时定位。 
Make full use of all navigation instruments, celestial body, landmark and so on for correct determine 
and check the ship position, and check the validity of GPS. When navigation near the coast and in 
narrow channel, different kinds of positioning measures and measurements such as landmark, radar 
and so on should be used to verify the ship position, and shorten the fixed position intervals. In all

4) 细心观察航行经过的岸形和各种物标，尤其当这些物标首次出现时，应根据有关的
航海图书资料仔细核对，如有疑问，立即报告船长。 
Attentive in details when observing the coastal contours and all kinds of objects along the navigation. 
Especially when the objects first appear, should compare careful with the relevant nautical 
publications. In case of any questions, report to the Master immediately. 
5) 航行中，每班进行一次标准磁罗经误差的测定，如果可能，在大角度转向之后应进
行测定；经常比对标准磁罗经和电罗经的读数；罗经复示仪应与主罗经同步。如发
现误差过大或反常，应立即报告船长。 
During navigation, each shift should perform a testing on the deviation of standard magnetic compass 
once. If possible, the testing should be performed after a turn of large angle. Always compare the 
readings of the standard magnetic compass and gyro compass; the magnetic compass repeater log 
should synchronize with main gyro compass. If the instrumental error is too large or abnormal, report 
to the Master immediately. 
6) 航行中应定期核对ECDIS 输入数据与外围设备数据的一致性，例如航向、航速、
船舶回转速度等； 
During the navigation, verify the compliance of ECDIS input data and the peripheral equipment’s 
data periodically, such as course bearing, ship’s speed, rotation speed and so on. 
7) 时刻注意各种情况的发生和变化。例如气象突变，船位偏差过大，发现海上遇难信
号以及各种可疑信号或可疑物等，均应立即报告船长。 
Always pay attention to the occurrence and change of all kinds of conditions, such as a sudden 
change of weather, big deviation as to the ship position, receive a distress signal at the sea, seeing all 
kinds of suspicious signals or items. In these cases, report to the Master immediately. 
8) 掌握每天气象报告的内容，经常注意风力、风向、气压的变化。当能见度不良等危
害性气象来临前，应尽可能测定船位，并应严格遵守“1972 年国际海上避碰规则”
第19 条和35 条规定。 
Read the weather report every day, always pay attention to the change in wind speed, wind direction 
and air pressure. Before the arrival of low visibility or other kinds of dangerous weather, measure the 
position of the ship, and strictly follow the Article 29 and 35 of the International Regulations for 
Preventing Collisions at Sea (COLREGS) 1972. 
9) 严格执行船长布置的航路、航向、罗经差、风流压差及各种航行指示。除了有碰撞
等海损威胁，救助落水者或发生意外危险时可采取各种有效措施外，未经船长准许，
不得改变航向和主机转速。 
Strictly execute all passage plan, course, compass errors, leeway angle and all kinds of navigation 
instruction approved by the Master. In time of sea damage such as collision, rescue overboard 
personnel or occurrence of accidents, all effective measures should be taken. However, in other 
conditions, do not change navigation direction and main engine rotation speed without the permission 
of the Master. 
10) 经常检查舵工操舵的准确性。进行海图作业应限于极短时间并应布置值班水手注意
了望。尽量减少海图室停留时间。 
Always check the accuracy of steering of the helmsman. Time of performing charts operation should 
be limited and arrange duty seaman to pay attention to lookout. Chart room visits are kept to 
minimum. 
11) 夜间或在能见度不良的情况下航行时，应督促值班水手及时开启航行灯并经常检查
其是否正常,一切有碍航行了望的灯光应予遮蔽。

During navigation during night or poor visibility, supervise the duty seaman to turn on the navigation

13) 当发生火警、人落水或船舶进水等紧急情况时，应立即采取有效的安全措施，并立
即发出警报、迅速报告船长，做好详细记录。 
In emergency situations such as fire, man overboard or ship flooding, effective safety measures

14) 在大风浪中转向，应按船长指示事先通知各部门做好安全预防工作。 
During altering course in time of heavy weather, should notice previously all departments to do 
safety precaution according to master’s instruction. 
15) 夜间航行，应布置接班的值班水手在接班前巡回检查全船一周，特别要注意防火，
并将检查情况记入航海日志。 
During navigation at night, should arrange the duty A.B to perform safety patrol inspection to the 
whole ship before their takeover shift, and pay special attention to prevent fire and record the 
inspection result into the Deck Logbook. 
16) 按大副布置处理好货舱通风等工作。遇气象突变，尤其在大风浪来袭前，应派值班
水手封闭各货舱通风口；注意舱内和甲板货物有无松动移位现象。 
Should vent to cargo holds according to the arrangement of the Chief Officer. In case of sudden 
change in the weather, especially heavy weather, duty seaman should be sent to close all cargo hold 
ventilators; pay attention to the cargo in the hold and on the deck, inspect whether the cargo is 
loosened or shifted to other locations. 
在条件允许的情况下，指导实习生利用各种航海仪器和天体、物标测定船位。 
Guide the apprentice to use the navigation instruments, celestial body and optical marking to measure 
the position of the ship under permissive condition. 
17) 任何情况下，如无船长或其他驾驶员替代，不得离开驾驶台。如有要事，应用电话
或派值班水手报告船长处理，以确保航行安全。 
In any events, the Officer of Watch should be leave the bridge unless the Master or other deck 
officers are available to replace the position. If there is matter that has to be handled, telephone the 
Master or send the duty seaman to report to the Master for further action, in order to ensure the 
navigation safety. 
18) 如情况需要，船长随时可以接过指挥权亲自操船。在此情况下，值班驾驶员仍应认
真了望，测定船位，执行船长布置的工作。船长如需驾驶员恢复操纵，应郑重交待
清楚。   
If necessary, the Master can takeover the rights of command and manoeuver the ship himself in any 
times. In this way, the Officer of Watch should perform lookout, determine the ship position, and 
execute work arranged by the Master. Whenever he hands over the conning and control of ship back 
to the Officer of Watch, he should expressly and formally inform the Officer of Watch. 
19) 进出港时，布置值班水手备妥有关的旗号、灯号及调头信号等以便随时可用；注意
观察各种联系信号，及时报告船长并按指示处理。 
When entering or leaving the port, notice the duty seaman to prepare the relevant flags, lights, signals 
and so on in hand; pay attention and observe any contact signals, report to the Master timely and

20) 督促水手长做好引航员上下船的准备工作并亲自接送引航员。引航员领航时，不可
疏忽了望。发现情况及时报告船长。 
Supervise the boatswain to perform preparation work for the pilot embarking and disembarking the 
ship, and pick up the pilot officer on site. When the pilot officer is piloting, pay attention to lookout. 
Report to the master timely if any abnormal conditions are found. 
21) 在运河、内河或港区内航行时，应熟悉并遵守港章及有关的规定。 
Should be familiar with and follow the port’s regulations and other relevant regulations in time of 
navigation in the canals, inland rivers or harbour district. 
22) 在驾驶台控制航行时，如发生报警或设备故障时，应立即报告船长和轮机长，以便
迅速派人进行检修。 
During navigation in UMS mode, in case of alarm or equipment failure, should report to the Master 
and Chief Engineer immediately so that personnel can be sent off for inspection and repair quickly.  
23) 每天大副晚餐时，由三副接替值班，时间不超过半小时。 
When the Chief Officer have dinner every day, the Third Officer should replace the position for duty, 
but no longer than 30 minutes. 
24) 值班驾驶员必须明确自己的工作仅限于航行职责，值班期间不允许使用手机。 
The O.O.W. must confine his activities to navigational duties only. Use of mobile phones by bridge 
team members is not permitted during watch keeping.  
2.1.2 航行中值班驾驶员交接事项  
Items to be noted in time of work shift of duty deck officers during navigation  
1) 接班驾驶员至少应提前十五分钟到达驾驶台，阅读船长命令簿并签名，查阅海图、
核对船位、检查助航仪器、确认号灯号型、了解相关航行信息、观察周围环境，按
规定认真交接。如船舶即将或已经转向或避让，必须等待完成后方可交接。 
The takeover Officer of Watch should arrive the bridge at least fifteen minutes in advance, read and 
sign the master order book, check charts and the ship position, inspect the nav.-aid instruments, 
confirm the lights and shapes, know more about the relevant navigation information, observe the 
surrounding situation and perform the work shift seriously according to the regulations. The 
Hand-over must be postponed when the vessel is about to be, or is already, engaged in a collision 
avoidance manoeuvre or an alteration of course, which must be completed prior hand over. 
2) 即将交班的值班驾驶员必须确保接班的驾驶员有能力履行他们的职责。接班驾驶员
必须确保在夜晚期间接班前，自己的视力已完全调整到夜视状态。 
The outgoing Officer of the Watch must ensure that all members of the incoming bridge team are 
capable of performing their duties. The incoming officer must ensure that his eyesight is fully 
adjusted to night vision before taking over the watch during hours of darkness.   
3) 船长的指示以及应提醒下一班注意的有关事项。 
The instruction of the Master and remind the next shift as to relevant matters that should be paid 
attention to. 
4) 电、磁罗经航向及其误差和风流压差。 
Course of the gyro and magnetic compass, the instrumental error and leeway angle.  
5) 海图上的船位及其求得的方法。 
The position of the ship on the charts and how it is obtained.  
6) ECDIS 航行环境设定和调整偏航距离、等深线、碍航物距离等各报警参数。 
ECDIS navigation environmental settings and adjust alert readings such as cross track distance, 
bathymetric contour, obstruction clearance and so on. 
7) 主机转速，实测航速及计程仪航速。

Main engine RPM, actual ship speed and speed readings on the Speed log.  
8) 已见的或即将在望的岸形、物标等海面情况。 
Sea condition such as coastal contour in sight or to be in sight, object marks and so on. 
9) 周围船舶动态及其变化情况；本船已经采取或准备采取的避让措施。 
Surrounding ships’ motion and their change in conditions; the ship have already or prepared to

10) 周围（尤其是即将航经的）礁、滩、沉船等水下障碍物。 
Surrounding (especially those will be in the way) reefs, rapids, and underwater obstacles such as

Weather change, hydrological weather condition such as wind and water current, weather report 
newly received. In case of bad weather, exercise or prepare to exercise the relevant measures. 
12) 航行灯、操舵仪及雷达、AIS、GPS、ECDIS 等各种航海仪器的工作情况。 
Working condition of navigation lights, steering pilot and radar, all kinds of navigation instrument 
such as AIS, GPS, ECDIS and so on. 
13) VHF 及使用频道，对外联系的确认，被要求的下一个报告点和预计时间。 
VHF and the channel, confirmation of the external communication, the next reporting point as 
required and estimated time. 
14) 货舱通风、甲板货及防火等的安全检查情况；当值的和下一班瞭头水手姓名。 
Safety inspection conditions of cargo hold ventilation, deck’s cargo and firefighting; name of the duty 
seaman and those in the next shift in the lookout on the forecastle. 
15) 进出港各项准备工作情况（如引航员梯、旗号、灯号等）。 
Conditions of all kinds of preparation work before entering or leaving the port (such as pilot ladder, 
flags and lights). 
16) 船舶吃水，船舶横倾、纵倾、水的密度及船体下沉而可能对龙骨下富余水深的影
响。 
Ship draft, list, trim, water density and hull sinkage may influence the under keel clearance. 
17) 新收到的航行警告及改正情况。 
Navigation warning newly received and the condition of rectification. 
18) 甲板、机舱正在进行中的重要维修保养工作。 
Important maintenance work in progress on the deck and in the engine room. 
2.1.3 航行中值班水手职责： 
The obligations of duty seaman during navigation: 
1) 认真操舵或监视自动舵的运转情况；经常核对电、磁罗经的航向，如有异常立即报
告值班驾驶员。空舵水手认真了望，经常检查航行灯是否正常，执行值班驾驶员指
派的工作。如需暂离驾驶台，应征得值班驾驶员同意。 
Pilot seriously or monitor the operating conditions of autopilot. Always verify the navigation 
direction of the gyro and magnetic compass. In case of abnormal conditions, report to the duty deck 
officer immediately. Air rudder seaman should lookout seriously, always inspect whether the 
navigation lights are functioning, and execute the work arranged by the duty deck officer. If leaving 
the bridge temporarily, permission from the duty deck officer must be obtained. 
2) 操舵水手对于船长，驾驶员或引航员发出的舵令必须先复诵，执行后还应再复告一
次，如未听清或不懂应立即询问清楚后再执行。发现舵效失常应立即报告。 
As to the steering orders given by the Master, deck officer or pilot officer, the steering seaman should 
repeat once in oral speaking. After execution of the orders, it should be repeated once more. If the

3) 夜间航行，接班前进行生活区公共场所安全巡视，巡回检查全船一周，检查防火、
甲板、舱口、通风口、水密门等，将检查情况报告值班驾驶员。

When entering or leaving the port, the seaman without steering should pay attention to lookout, and 
whether the execution of engine room orders and steering orders is correct or not. Turn on and off the 
signals quickly and accurately, hang all kinds of signals, fly and lower the flags according to the 
instruction of the Master and the duty deck officer. 
5) 交舵水手应在舵把定时交接，如正在避让或转向，必须等到避让清楚或转向完毕后
方可交舵。交接完后，接舵水手应向船长、驾驶员或引航员报告操舵航向。 
The handing over seaman should perform work shift at the steering handle. If the ship is in the 
process of avoid collision or turning direction, wait until the completion of operation for the shift. 
After the completion of the shift, the takeover seaman should report the navigation direction of 
steering to the Master, deck officer or pilot officer. 
2.1.4 航行中值班水手交接事项 
Items to be noted in time of work shift of duty seaman during navigation 
1) 电、磁罗经航向。 
The course bearing of gyro and magnetic compass. 
2) 操舵仪的工作情况。 
The working condition of steering pilot. 
3) 海面情况及瞭头人员姓名。 
The condition of sea surface and the name of personnel working at the lookout on the forecastle. 
4) 货舱通风情况；甲板货及防火等的安全检查情况。 
Conditions of cargo air circulation; safety inspection condition of deck’s cargo, firefighting and so 
on. 
5) 航行灯及悬挂中的旗号、号灯、号型。 
Navigation lights, and flags, lights, shapes hanged. 
6) 进出港前的各项准备工作情况，如引航员梯、照明等。 
Conditions of all kinds of preparation work before entering or leaving a port, such as pilot ladder and 
lights. 
7) 值班驾驶员交待的工作。 
Work given by the duty deck officer. 
2.2 系泊中 
During mooring 
2.2.1 系泊中值班驾驶员职责 
Obligations of duty deck officer during mooring 
1) 认真执行公司的有关安全生产的规定和船长或大副的指示，检查督促全体值班人员
工作情况，搞好安全生产。 
Execute company’s regulations as to production safety and the instruction of the Master or Chief 
Officer seriously. Inspect and supervise the working performances of all duty personnel and aware of 
production safety.

2) 根据《船舶保安计划》的要求做好梯口值班工作，用英文做好附录“人员上下船登
记表”的记录。若港口当局有特殊要求和专用表格，需一并记录。 
Perform gangway duty work as required by the “Ship Security Plan”，Record the form of " Record of 
embarkation and disembarkation from the ship " of the appendix of the ship security plan in English. 
If the port authority has special requirements and special forms, the forms should be recorded 
together. 
3) 按照大副的积载计划和“大副装卸货物命令簿”的要求，经常巡视并下货舱督促检
查装卸情况，随时掌握装卸进度，认真记录作业时间及舱口和工班数，发现有未按
计划及要求进行作业时，应向装卸负责人提出并即汇报大副处理。 
According to the stowage plan of the Chief Officer and the requirements of the “Chief Officer 
Loading and Discharging Order Book”, always patrol and enter the cargo to supervise and inspect the

Record the operation time as well as numbers of hatches and shifts. If it is found that the operation is 
not performed in accordance with the plan and requirements, communicate to the supervisor for 
loading and discharging, and report to the Chief Officer for further action. 
4) 保持通讯畅通，密切与港方联系；加强协作配合，解决装卸中出现的问题，尽量保
持船体平衡，督促做好货物的铺垫、码垛和隔票工作。 
Maintain a smooth communication with the port, strengthen the co-operation, handle the problems 
occur during loading and discharging, keep up the hull balance, supervise the dunnage, stowage and 
separation operation. 
5) 督促看舱，及时布置具体的看舱重点，执行保安巡逻，防止发生货损和偷盗，尤其
对贵重货物更应特别注意，必要时应亲自监督。 
Supervise the cargo watch, arrange the key locations of cargo watch timely, perform security patrol, 
prevent cargo damages and theft. Pay special attention to valuable cargos, monitor them in person if 
necessary. 
6) 严禁工人在舱内吸烟和违章作业。如果发生由于违章操作以致损坏设备、属具，应
及时要求港方签证，以便索赔。 
Workers are forbidden to smoke and perform work against regulation in the cargo. If there are 
damages to the equipment and accessories due to work against regulation, request the port to confirm 
the incident timely for further compensation demand. 
7) 掌握当天气象报告，注意天气变化，密切同装卸负责人联系，及时开关舱，防止雨
湿货损。 
Read the weather report, pay attention to the weather change, maintain a good communication with 
the supervisors of loading and discharging. Open and close the cargo timely to prevent cargo 
damages from rainy weather. 
8) 装卸货中，及时调整吊杆，经常注意装卸设备及属具、索具等是否正常，发现问题
及时处理。 
During loading and discharging, adjust the derricks timely, always pay attention on whether the 
loading and discharging equipment, accessories, riggings and so on are functioning. If any problem is 
found, handle it timely. 
9) 装卸危险品时，应切实做好监装监卸工作。 
When loading and discharging dangerous cargo, monitoring work on loading and discharging should 
be done in due diligence. 
10) 装卸期间应注意吃水差，每天早晨以及装、卸完毕查看水尺记入航海日志；抵离

2.2.3 系泊中值班水手职责 
Obligations of duty seaman during mooring 
1) 及时调整舷梯及安全网，保证舷梯安全稳妥， 保持舷梯整洁，照明充足；注意上
下船人员安全。 
Adjust the pilot ladder and safety net, ensure the pilot ladder is safe and stable, keep it clean and tidy 
with sufficient lights, pay attention to the safety of personnel boarding and disembarking. 
2) 根据《船舶保安计划》的要求协助值班驾驶员做好梯口值班工作，对登轮人员进行
身份识别、用英文登记、发放识别卡，向船长报告登轮人员的身份，必要时有专人
陪同到船长办公室，若港口当局有特殊要求和专用表格，需一并记录。 
Assist deck officer to perform gangway duty work as required by the “Ship Security Plan”. Perform 
identity inspection, record in English and issue of identity card to the boarding personnel, and report 
to the Master as to the identity of the boarding personnel. If necessary, assign personnel to 
accompany him to the Master’s office. If the port authority has special requirements and special 
forms, the forms should be recorded together. 
3) 根据潮汐和装卸情况，及时调整系缆、挡水板、防鼠档及碰垫等。 
Adjust the mooring ropes, dash plate, rat guard and fender according to the condition of tide, loading 
and discharging. 
4) 经常注意本船四周情况，尤其是船艉推进器的安全；制止与本船作业无关的船驳傍
靠。 
Always pay attention to the surrounding of the ship, especially for the safety of propeller; prohibit 
barges which have no relationship with the ship operation to berth alongside the ship.   
5) 凡有船驳靠（离）船旁时，负责系解缆、放好（收起）碰垫、绳梯、照明灯等。 
Whenever there are barges going alongside (leaving) the ship, tighten and loosen the mooring ropes, 
put (take away) the fender, rope ladder, lights and so on in the right position.

properly, and adjust the derrick.

舶属具受损时，应立即报告值班驾驶员。 
Always pay attention to the loading and discharging equipment, including the accessories and so on, 
inspect whether these are in normal functions; operations against rules are prohibited. If any 
problems are found or the ship accessories are damaged, report to the duty deck officer immediately.

员或船舶领导。 
Perform patrol inspection on firefighting and security seriously, on the alert especially at night. When 
pollution is found in the surrounding water area, report to the ship leader. In case of fire, accidents 
and other dangerous situation, report to the duty deck officer or the ship leader immediately.  
11) 认真执行大副和值班驾驶员布置的其它工作。 
Complete other work arranged by the Chief Officer and the deck officer on duty seriously. 
12) 开航前一小时，值班一水应到驾驶台做准备工作： 
One hour before the navigation, duty able seaman should go to the bridge for preparation work:   
 清洁驾驶台。 
Clean the bridge. 
 解除罗经罩等。 
Remove the cover of the compass. 
 准备信号旗。 
Prepare the signal flag. 
 随同值班驾驶员试验主机、舵机及驾驶台设备测试。 
Test the main engine, steering gear and bridge equipment with the duty deck officer. 
 驾驶员交待的其它工作。 
Other work given by the deck officer. 
13) 离泊前应做好下列工作： 
The following work should be done before unberthing: 
 收进舷外挡水板、安全网、绳梯并绞起舷梯。 
Put away the overboard dash plate, safety net and rope ladder and heave the accommodation 
ladder. 
 准备好引水梯、安全绳、救生圈及照明灯。 
Prepare pilot ladder, life line, life buoy and lights.

2.3 锚泊中 
During anchoring 
2.3.1 锚泊中值班驾驶员的职责 
Obligations of duty deck officer during anchoring 
1) 经常利用各种物标核对船位是否正常。 
Always determine and plot the ship’s position by using all kinds of navigation marking.  
2) 注意周围锚泊船的情况，经常核对其方位、距离有无变化，尤其是位于上风（或上
流）方向锚泊船的动态，以防他船走锚危及本船安全。 
Observe the situations of the surrounding anchored ships, always verify whether there is a change in 
the bearing and distance of those ships, especially for the motion of windward (or upstream) 
anchored ships, in case those ships may have dragged the anchors and threaten the safety of the ship. 
3) 注意来泊船的锚位及其旋回是否与本船有足够的安全距离，如若过近，应鸣笛通知
对方或报告船长处理。 
Observe the anchoring position, turning and safety distance of the coming anchor vessel, If the 
distance is too short, sounding the whistle to warn her and report to the Master. 
4) 如过往船只或附近起锚船距本船太近，应严密注视其动态。若判断对本船有威胁时，
应发出信号警告对方。一旦被碰撞，应将对方的动态和时间，以及本轮采取的措施
和受损情况等详细记录并画出示意图。 
If the passing ships or heaving anchor ships in the vicinity are too near to own ship, pay full attention 
to their motions. If those ships are threatening the safety of own ship, sound a signal to warn them. 
Once collision, make a detailed record as to the motion of those ships, the time, the measures taken 
by own ship, conditions of damages and so on, and draw a diagram showing the incident. 
5) 不论本船或他船走锚，或者过往船舶距离过近而出现危险局面时，应根据不同情况
采取各种本船所能采取的措施以避免或减少损失。这些措施包括立即报告船长、派
值班水手去船艏松链或加抛另一锚、使用碰垫、通知机舱备车等。 
In case of collision or close quarter’s situation caused by own ship or other ship’s anchor dragged, or 
the passing ships is too near, should be taken all measures to prevent or minimize damages according 
to different situation. These measures include immediate report to the Master, send duty seaman to

2.3.2 锚泊中值班驾驶员交接事项 
Items to be noted in time of work shift of duty deck officers during anchoring 
1) 锚位及锚链情况。 
The condition of anchor position and chain cables. 
2) 涨落潮和转头时间。 
Time of ebb and flood, the time of turning. 
3) 周围锚泊船的距离，方位及其动态。 
The distance, bearing and motion of the ship in the vicinity. 
4) 信号、号灯的显示情况。 
The display light or shape signals. 
5) 天气情况以及恶劣天气（如能见度不良，大风浪等）应提醒注意的问题。

(such as poor visibility and heavy weather). 
6) 有关装卸货的注意事项。 
Precautions as to loading and discharging cargo operation. 
7) 对于傍靠船驳有关安全方面的注意事项。 
Precautions as to the safety of lying alongside of the barge. 
8) 船长布置的有关工作。 
Relevant works arranged by the Master. 
2.3.3 锚泊中值班水手职责 
Obligations of duty seaman during anchoring 
1) 注意过往船只和周围锚泊船的信号和动态。 
Pay attention to the signals and motions of the passing ships and anchoring ship in the vicinity. 
2) 按驾驶员指示悬挂或开关各种旗号、号灯和灯光并经常检查是否正常。 
Display the correct light or shape signal, and usual check if there are in good conditions. 
3) 经常巡视甲板，查看锚链，锚机和锚装置等是否正常。锚泊在急流区或遇大风浪天
气，至少每小时巡视查看一次。 
Always patrol on the deck to inspect whether the chain cables, windlass and anchor device are good 
condition. When anchoring in strong stream or heavy weather, patrol at least once every hour. 
4) 能见度不良时，按章打开甲板上和生活区外部照明灯，注意船舶周围的动静。

3.0 轮机部值班人员值班职责 
Performing the engineering watch  
3.1 航行中 
 
During navigation 
3.1.1 值班轮机员的职责 
Duties of engineer of watch 
1) 值班轮机员应确保值班安排的实施，带领机舱普通船员，安全和有效的协助操作推
进器和辅助设备。 
The officer in charge of the engineering watch shall ensure that the established watchkeeping 
arrangements are maintained and that under direction, engine-room ratings, if forming part of the 
engineering watch, assist in the safe and efficient operation of the propulsion machinery and auxiliary 
equipment.  
2) 值班轮机员是轮机长的代表，持续负责机舱的各项操作，即使是轮机长在机舱，除
非轮机长明确告知值班轮机员承担了值班的责任。 
The officer in charge of the engineering watch shall continue to be responsible for machinery-space 
operations, despite the presence of the chief engineer officer in the machinery spaces, until 
specifically informed that the chief engineer officer has assumed that responsibility and this is 
mutually understood.  
3) 根据驾驶台命令正确操纵主机，认真填写轮机日志、副机日志（如有值班机工，指
导其填写副机日志）车钟记录簿，不得任意涂改； 
Operate the engine correctly according to the order given by the bridge, fill in the engine log book, 
auxiliary engine log book (if there is duty motorman, guide him to write the auxiliary engine log 
book) and bell record book. Do not tamper with the documents. 
4) 值班轮机员不能随意离开值班岗位，如需离开，应安排能胜任的替代人来代行值班
职责； 
The duty engineer shall not leave the machinery spaces. If there is a need to leave, he should arrange 
a capable personnel to replace the position and carry out the responsibilities; 
5) 对所有机械设备加强巡回检查，使机舱的机电设备都在监视之下，包括舵机间、空
调系统、伙食冰机系统等属于机舱延伸空间的机电设备； 
Strengthen patrol inspection, so that the machinery and electrical equipment of the engine room is 
under monitoring, including the machinery and electrical equipment in the steering gear room, air 
conditioning and provision plant system which belongs to extensional area of the engine room; 
6) 值班轮机员在进行或指导其他值班人员进行操作时，应能考虑到可能出现的潜在危
害或不利因素，并能提前得到警示和采取预防措施，避免对人身、设备或船舶造成
危害和出现紧迫局面； 
When the duty engineer is performing operations or giving guidance to other duty personnel to 
perform operations, all potential risk or unfavourable factors must be taken into account, stay alerted 
and take some precautions to prevent personal injury, damages to equipment or the ship and the 
occurrence of danger situations; 
7) 如果主机故障必须停车进行检修时，应征得驾驶台同意并立即报告轮机长；如情况
危急，将造成严重的机损或人身事故时，可先停车同时报告驾驶台和轮机长，并将
详细情况记入轮机日志； 
If the main engine is out of order and needs to be cut off for remedy, permission from the deck officer 
should be obtained, and report to the chief engineer immediately. If it is in a dangerous situation

10) 根据大副的通知，移注排灌压载水或调驳淡水，供应或停供所需要的水、电、气、

Perform in ballasting/deballasting/transferring operations or transfer fresh water according to the 
notice of the chief officer. Provide or cut supply for the water, electricity, gas and stream. Follow the 
relevant regulations of pollution prevention seriously.  
11) 当要求备车航行时，值班轮机员应确保足够的电力储备供舵机和其他需要，备用
设备处于随时可以投入使用状态，并能按驾驶台的车钟指令立即操纵主机； 
When the engine-room is put in a stand-by condition, the officer in charge of the engineering watch 
shall ensure that all machinery and equipment which may be used during manoeuvring is in a state of 
immediate readiness and that an adequate reserve of power is available for steering gear and other 
requirements. 
12) 值班轮机员应熟知各种应变措施，在发生停车、停电、设备故障、舵机失灵、火
灾、机舱进水、碰撞、搁浅等任何涉及到机舱空间的紧迫局面时，能采取适当措施
把损失减小到最低限度； 
The duty engineer should familiar with all emergency measures, and able to take appropriate actions 
to minimize the damages in case of engine cut off, power failure, equipment failure, steering gear 
failure, fire, flooding in the engine room, collision, stranding, or other cause. 
13) 下班前应确保值班期间曾发生的主机和副机发生的相关事件得到合理的记录； 
Before going off duty, the officer in charge of the engineering watch shall ensure that all events 
related to the main and auxiliary machinery which have occurred during the engineering watch are 
suitably recorded; 
14) 三管轮值班时，轮机长应经常下机舱检查指导，04:00-08:00 值班人员进晚餐时由
08:00-12:00 值班人员下机舱接替，时间不超过30 分钟； 
When the Fourth engineer is on duty, the chief engineer should always enter the engine room to 
inspect and provide guidance. When the duty personnel is having dinner during the 04:00-08:00 shift, 
the personnel of 08:00-12:00 shift should enter the engine room and replace the position for no longer 
than 30 minutes; 
15) 有实习人员跟班时，应严格要求，认真指导，并对他们的任何操作负责； 
When there is apprentice in the shift, strictly demand and guide them, and be responsible to any 
operations handled by them; 
16) 下班前做好交班工作，并负责做好相关场所的清洁工作； 
Complete work shift before off duty, and finish cleaning work of the relevant areas;

3.1.2 值班机工的职责 
Obligations of the duty motorman 
1) 在值班轮机员的领导下，严格遵守各项值班制度，完成值班工作。 
Strictly follow the duty regulation and complete the duty under direction of the duty engineer. 
2) 协助轮机员管理机舱的机电设备，按说明书要求及时调整各运行参数、加油、补水，
按值班轮机员的要求执行各项作业和操作，确保设备的正常运转； 
Assist the engineer in managing the machinery and electrical equipment, adjust all operational 
parameter, bunker and refill water timely according to the instruction, perform all kinds of work and 
operation required by the duty engineer, ensure the equipment is functioning; 
3) 在值班轮机员的指导下，负责副机日志的填写和相关的记录； 
Responsible for writing the auxiliary engine log book and relevant records under the guide of the 
duty engineer. 
4) 加强巡回检查，密切监视机电设备的运行参数和运行状况，如发现任何不正常现象
或机械故障而不能执行处理时，及时报告轮机员； 
Strengthen patrol inspection, monitor the operational parameter and conditions of the machinery and 
electrical equipment. If any abnormal conditions or mechanical fault is found, yet unable to handle 
the issue, report to the engineer timely.  
5) 按值班轮机员的要求或协助其进行舱底水的处理、压载水操作； 
Assist in performing bilge disposal and ballast water operation as required by the duty engineer.  
6) 值班机工不得随意离开机舱，值班机工04:00-08:00 班进晚餐时，应由08:00-12:00
班值班机工替换，时间不超过30 分钟； 
Duty motorman should not leave the engine room. When the motorman is having dinner during the 
04:00-08:00 shift, the motorman of 08:00-12:00 shift should replace the position for no longer than 
30 minutes; 
7) 下班前做好交班工作，并做好相关场所的清洁工作； 
Finish the work handover before going off duty, and complete the cleaning job of relevant areas; 
8) 执行值班轮机员临时布置的工作。 
Complete the temporary work arranged by the duty engineer. 
3.2 停泊期间 
During berthing 
3.2.1 停泊期间轮机员轮流值安全班，根据值班安排，每天上午08:00 交接班；轮机员值班
期间须履行下列职责： 
Safety watch shall be performed for engineers during berthing, according to the watch arrangements, 
handing/taking over duties at 08:00 A.M every day. The duty engineer should carry out the following 
responsibilities: 
1) 指导并检查值班机工的工作，确保机电设备的正常运转； 
Guide and inspect the work of the duty motorman, ensure the machinery and electrical equipments 
are in good condition; 
2) 处理值班机工遇到的疑难问题，指导值班机工进行所需要的各项操作和作业； 
Solve the problems met by the duty motorman, guide them to perform all kinds of necessary 
operation and work; 
3) 及时供应日常工作、生活所需要的水、电、气、汽； 
Support the water, electricity, air and stream necessary for daily work and living timely;  
4) 根据大副的书面指令协助主管轮机员进行压载水作业；

3.3 轮机部值班人员交接注意事项： 
Notes of handing over the watch : 
3.3.1 值班人应于交班前30 分钟通知接班人员，并做好交班准备工作； 
The duty personnel should inform the incoming personnel 30 minutes in advance, and get ready all 
works for handing over; 
3.3.2 接班人员提前15 分钟到达机舱，认真巡查所有机电设备，发现问题及时向交班人员
提出，其中主要问题应记入轮机日志，双方如有争议报告轮机长处理； 
The incoming personnel should arrive the engine room 15 minutes in advance and perform inspection on 
all machinery and electrical equipment. If problem is found, report to the personnel in charge of the 
engineering watch timely, and major problems should be recorded in the Engine Log Book. In case of 
dispute, report to the Chief Engineer for further action; 
3.3.3 交班人员应对接班人员的值班能力进行考察，如果发现接班人员上岗前饮酒、身体不
适等或交班人员认为其不能胜任值班工作时，报轮机长处理； 
The personnel in charge of the engineering watch should observe the capability of the relieving 
personnel. If the takeover shift is found to have drank wine, feeling unwell or not able to take the shift, 
report to the chief engineer for further action; 
3.3.4 交班人员应向接班人员介绍： 
The relieving officer shall be informed by the officer in charge of the engineering watch as to: 
1) 当日的常规命令，任何与船舶操作、维修功能、修理船舶机械或控制设备有关的特
别命令; 
The standing orders of the day, any special orders relating to the ship operations, maintenance 
functions, repairs to the ship’s machinery or control equipment; 
2) 实施机器和系统工作的性质、所涉及的人员和潜在危险; 
The nature of all work being performed on machinery and systems on board ship, personnel involved 
and potential hazards; 
3) 船底、压载舱、污油舱、污水舱、备用舱的水或残余物的液位、状况和用途，以及
使用或处置其内容物的特殊要求; 
The level and condition, where applicable, of water or residue in bilges, ballast tanks, slop tanks, 
sewage tanks, reserve tanks and special requirements for the use or disposal of the contents thereof; 
4) 与卫生系统处置有关的任何特殊要求; 
Any special requirements relating to sanitary system disposals; 
5) 便携式灭火设备、固定式灭火设施和火灾探测系统的情况和准备状态; 
The condition and state of readiness of portable fire-extinguishing equipment and fixed 
fire-extinguishing installations and fire-detection systems; 
6) 指派从事修理人员的工作内容、工作位置和工作进展，以及其他指派人员和所需人
员的情况; 
Authorized repair personnel on board engaged in engineering activities, their work locations and 
repair functions and other authorized persons on board and the required crew; 
7) 任何适用于船舶排出物的港口规定、消防规定和目前的执行情况，特别是在异常恶
劣天气的情况下; 
Any port regulations pertaining to ship effluents, fire-fighting requirements and ship readiness, particularly 
during potential bad weather conditions; 
8) 在发生紧急情况或需要援助时，船舶与岸上人员(包括港口当局)之间有效的联系方
法; 
The lines of communication available between the ship and shore personnel, including port authorities, in 
the event of an emergency arising or assistance being required;

The procedures for notifying the appropriate authority of environmental pollution resulting from

3.3.5 接班人员在承担值班的责任前，须确信上文所述已充分知晓;并： 
Relieving officers, before assuming charge of the engineering watch, shall satisfy themselves that they 
are fully informed by the officer being relieved, as outlined above; and: 
1) 熟悉现有和潜在的电源、热源和照明及其分布; 
Be familiar with existing and potential sources of power, heat and lighting and their distribution; 
2) 了解船舶燃料、润滑油和所有供水的可用性和状况;和 
Know the availability and condition of ship’s fuel, lubricants and all water supplies; and 
3) 尽可能使船舶和船舶机械作好准备，以便应付必要可能的待命或紧急情况。 
Be ready to prepare the ship and its machinery, as far as is possible, for stand-by or emergency 
conditions as required. 
4.0 工作休息时间要求的背离和潜在的值班不符合情况: 
Deviation from work/rest requirements and Potential non-compliance on duty: 
4.1 公司不定期抽查船队船舶的工作休息时间，远程检查船舶的现场工作情况，船舶主管
也可以通过船长反馈和登轮检查等形式，检查船舶是否有涉及不符合休息时间的情况,
检查船舶是否有值班方面的不符情况。 
The company will occasionally check the <Records of Hours of Work/Rest of Crew> of ship or remotely 
inspection the onboard works. The ship superintendents can also check the non-conformity which 
involving work/rest time or duty of watch by feedback from the master and onboard inspection. 
4.2 海务部根据船舶反馈的工作休息时间记录，以及船队船舶在工作休息时间和值班方面
的不符合情况，整理分析，查明原因及潜在违反休息时间的因素，采取相应的措施以
消除背离和不符合情况的出现。 
The Marine Department response to analysis these data through the <Records of Hours of Work/Rest 
of Crew> from ships and the non-conformity of work/rest time or duty of ships in the fleet, identify the 
root cause and any potential weaknesses in complying with rest hours, take action to reduce the deviations 
and non-compliance. 
4.3 推荐船长通过以下方式更有效的管理休息工作时间： 
Some ways rest and work hours can be affectively managed: 
 提前做好工作规划，从而消除潜在违规行为的可能性。 
Forward planning of work-rest hours using Work-Rest Hour software ahead of the actual jobs whereby 
eliminating the possibility of potential violations 
 选择经过培训且具有工作经验的船员。 
Selecting crew with right training and experience for the job 
 对于船上任何的关于休息时间，违反及预防措施等问题，船上与基岸人员良好的沟
通联系。 
Good communication between ship and shore teams with respect to rest hours, any violations and 
preventive measures on-board. 
 船岸要建立起一个开放的沟通联络环境，清楚的告知船员当疲劳导致工作质量下降
时，应告知上级，且确保此报告不会有任何的责备。

4.4 关于疲劳 
Regarding to the fatigue 
4.4.1 公司应确保在船上配备充足的船员以确保能遵守休息时段的规定。 
The Company shall ensure that sufficient seafarers are provided on board the vessel to ensure that the 
requirements of the regulations with regard to rest periods can be complied with. 
4.4.2 公司要求船长和船员在开展难度较大或存在潜在危险性的作业之前要充分休息, 船
长必须时刻注意疲劳对他本人和其他人员的影响。 
The Company requires that prior to the commencement of a difficult or potentially hazardous operation 
Masters and crew are well rested. The Master must be constantly conscious of the effects of fatigue on 
himself and the ship`s complement. 
4.4.3 疲劳能严重影响个人的判断能力特别是在从事挑战性工作期间（例如，引航，靠泊，
平仓等）疲劳也可增加反应时间。 
Fatigue can seriously impair judgment particularly during challenging work periods (ex. Pilotage, 
Berthing, Topping off Cargo etc.) Fatigue also has the potential to increase reaction time. 
4.5 船长的特权 
The Master`s Overriding Authority 
4.5.1 如果船长对船员包括他自己由于疲劳问题继续开展工作有任何疑问，他应停止作业直
到船员得到充足的休息，直到能继续工作。这包括延迟离港，抵港或若需要可停止的
货物操作。 
If the Master has any doubts about the ability of the ship`s staff including himself to continue with the 
operation in hand due to fatigue, he should stop operations until such time as he is satisfied that sufficient 
staff are rested to allow continuance. This will include delaying the departure from port / arrival into port 
or stopping cargo operations if necessary. 
4.5.2 本款之任何规定不得妨碍船长出于船舶，船上人员或货物的紧急安全需要，或出于帮
助海上遇险的其他船舶或人员的目的而要求一名海员从事任何时间工作的权利。 
Nothing in this section shall be deemed to impair the right of the Master of a ship to require a seafarer to 
perform any hours of work necessary for the immediate safety of the ship, persons onboard or cargo, or for 
the purpose of giving assistance to other ships or persons in distress at sea.

第03 节 船员交接制度 
Section 03 Regulations for Crewmember Hand over and Take over 
 
1.0 船员公休、病假或在原船变动职务，应执行本规定进行工作交接。 
When on job leave，medical leave or have a change in position on board, should follow the regulations 
before leaving vessel. 
2.0 交班船员接到通知后，应按要求认真做好交接准备，抓紧完成正在进行的工作，集中
并整理好各种主管的物品、记录，管理级船员及操作级船员交班前一周，将在船服务
期间对所管主要设备的情况、以及发生的问题和处理方法等，写成书面的报告。管理
级船员的交接班报告和必要的文件，提前通过船员部转发接班人员；操作级船员的交
班报告应首先递交给部门长审核签署并作为交接班报告的附件保存在船。 
At notice of transfer, sign-off crew should make preparation for duty handover, expedite the job on the 
hand, and sort stores, records, work shift should be done carefully, make the best use of the time to 
finish incomplete tasks, organize and pay attention to the management of items and records. One week 
before the work shift of management level crew and operational level crew, the conditions of main 
equipment managed, problem occurred, the handling measures and so on, should be written as a report. 
This report and necessary documents of management level crew members wants be forwarded to taking 
over crew via crew department in advance. Work shift report of operational crew should be submitted 
for approval and signed by the department head. It will be kept by the ship as an attachment to the work 
shift report. 
3.0 接班船员到船后，应立即向部门长报到，轮机长、大副向船长报到，按指示抓紧接班，
不得借口拒绝或拖延接班。 
After the taking over shift board the ship, the joiner report for duty to the department head immediately. 
Chief engineer and chief officer should report duty to the Master and make the best use of the time for 
work shift. Do not give excuses or postpone work shift. 
4.0 交接时，交班船员应耐心细致；接班船员要虚心询问。属于设备问题和遗留工作的，
交班船员一定要交待清楚；接班船员不应因本身的业务能力而过多地拖延交接时间；
如双方发生争议时，应报告直接领导处理。 
During work shift, the handing over shift should be attentive to details; the taking over shift should be 
open-minded to ask questions. As to problems on equipment and incomplete work, the handing over 
shift should explain clearly; the taking over shift should not postpone the time of work shift under the 
reason of personal ability; if argument occurs, please report to the supervisor. 
5.0 交班船员中凡涉及事故处理、各种海、机、货损报告以及保险索赔等手续的，当事者
和有关负责人等均应亲自办理完毕，不得移交给接班船员代办。同时，应向接班船员
详细说明情况。 
If the handing over shift is involved in accident handling, report on general average and damage of 
machinery and cargo, procedures such as demand of insurance compensation and so on, these should be 
handled and completed by the personnel and supervisor concerned. It is forbidden to shift these tasks to 
the takeover shift. Also, the handing over shift should explain to the takeover shift in details. 
6.0 若有同职实习人员为其正职代管或分管部分工作时，当实习人员离职前应将这部分工
作交回正职船员；正职船员交接时应同时对实习人员代管或分管的工作部分进行交
接。不能因有同职实习人员而不认真交接班。否则，对因此而影响工作或产生后果者，
由正职船员承担责任。 
If there is an apprentice of the same position is administrating part of the works on behalf the crew or 
under assignment, other apprentice who is leaving the position should shift the work to the full-time

7.0 为了便于船上工作的衔接，管理级和操作级船员，需要留有至少半天的船上交接班时
间。如有需要，经海机务主管批准后，管理级船员交接班可以重叠一天。 
In order to facilitate the connection of work on board, When the management level and operation level 
crew changes, at least half a day's on-board handover & takeover time shall be arranged. If necessary, 
the overlapping time of management level crew handover & takeover can be arranged for one day, after 
approval by the technical or marine superintendent. 
8.0 由于特殊情况，不能实现当面交接的,船长应进行充分的风险评估，做好交接班安排。 
If the face to face handover cannot be realized due to special circumstances, the master shall carried out 
a sufficient risk assessment and make crew change arrangements in advance. 
8.1 如提前知晓不能当面交接时，交班船员应提前整理交班资料，以便接班人快速熟悉本
职工作、熟悉航行安全信息和船舶操作。 
If it is known in advance that the work shift cannot be done at site face to face, the hand over crew 
should sort out the handover documents in advance so that the takeover crew can quickly familiar with 
their own duty and responsibility, navigational safety information, and ship operations. 
8.2 不能实现当面交接时,应由直接领导人或由其指定的人员代为交接。在此情况下，高
级船员的，也须按照相应职务的交接班报告表进行交接班，由直接领导人签字，并注
明详细情况。 
If the work shift is not done at site face to face under special circumstance, the work shift should be 
done by the chief or designated personnel on behalf. Under this condition, senior crew must also 
perform work shift according to the respective position’s work shift report, signed by the direct 
supervisor and indicate the details.  
9.0 凡因在原船变动职务而不认真执行本制度或者拖延办理交接手续，从而发生事故造成
损失者，公司将追究其责任。If the crew do not follow this system or postpone the work shift 
procedure due to a transfer order on the original ship, leading to an accident and causing damages, the 
company will investigate and affix the responsibility for the accident. 
10.0 交接工作分实物交接和情况介绍两部分进行。 
Work shift is divided into physical object shift and operation shift 
10.1 实物交接实际情况进行清点。如果实物短缺，一般物品应在交接记录中注明；重要物
品或者虽为一般但数量甚多者，应报告直接领导处理。船舶领导认为有必要时，应报
告公司。                                                             
During physical object shift, inventory should be counted and checked. If an item is missing, in case of 
minor items, it should be indicated in the work shift record; for important items or minor items of a large 
quantity, it should be reported to the supervisor directly. If necessary, the supervisor can report to the 
company. 
10.2 介绍情况时，交班船员应积极主动，不厌其烦；接班人员要仔细认真，做好记录。必
要时，由交班人员对设备进行操作演示。 
Handing over shift should be active and patient when explaining the conditions; takeover shift should be 
careful, serious, and keep a good record. If necessary, the handing over shift should perform an 
operation demonstration. 
情况介绍应包括下列内容： 
The explanation of the conditions should include the following:

The technical conditions and loading ability of the crane (loading & discharging) equipment,

The functions, technical conditions, application procedure and instrumental error of the navi-aid

The distribution and technical conditions of the life-saving appliance, fire-fighting equipment and

 图纸、说明书、航海日志和全部备用钥匙及通用钥匙；

Maintenance plan and the execution condition; 
 计划修理和在修理中需要解决的主要工程项目； 
Key construction projects with repair plan and repair in progress that have to be resolved; 
 本部门在安全生产上所发生的问题。 
Problems occur on safety in the department.

Familiar with bridge equipment

11.2 新接班的水手，当其将成为驾驶台团队一员前必须在船长指定的驾驶员指导下熟悉驾
驶台设备的位置及操作，确认熟悉后签署熟悉驾驶员设备检查表B。 
The seaman joining the vessel before joining the bridge team should familiar with the location and 
operation of bridge equipment under directed by officer designated by master, and complete the Bridge 
Equipment Knowledge Checklist B.

 After the work shift of senior crew, complete the work shift report of the respective position, and report

第04 节 船舶禁毒、麻醉药品和酒类管理规定 
Section 04 Drug, Narcotics and Alcohol Management Regulations 
 
1. 目的 
Purpose 
为保持船舶的稳定，使船员远离毒品危害，有效控制麻醉药品的使用和限制饮酒，减
少因毒品、麻醉药品和酒类原因造成的人员伤害及避免因此而发生事故，特制定本规
定。 
This regulation is formulated in order to maintain the stability of the ship, we strive to keep the crews 
away from the threat of drugs, exercise effectively control on the use of narcotics and limit the intake of 
alcohol, so that the casualties and accidents caused by the problem of drugs, narcotics and alcohol can be 
avoided. 
 酒精和毒品控制规定 
Alcohol and drug control regulations 
 严禁毒品 
Drug is prohibited 
船舶严禁毒品的买卖、持有、分发和使用。 
The ship prohibits the business, possession, distribution and application of drugs. 
 严格控制医用麻醉品的持有和使用。 
Strict control on the possession and application of narcotics 
对医用麻醉品建立严格的库存登记和使用登记制度，并限量使用。 
There is a strict inventory registration and usage registration system on the use of narcotics, with 
limited usage as required. 
 控制酒类分发和饮用 
Control on alcohol distribution and drinking 
严禁酗酒；限量分发；限制饮酒时间和用量。 
Excessive drinking is prohibited. The distribution is limited. The time and volume of alcohol intake 
is limited. 
 测试 
Testing 
提供船舶酒精和毒品的测试工具；规定进行定期和不定期的酒精和药物测试。  
Instruments for ship alcohol/drug test are provided; regular and irregular tests will be performed as 
required. 
2. 船舶禁毒工作 
Anti-drug ship work  
船舶禁毒工件必须贯彻预防为主的方针，加强对船员的思想教育，严格管理，健全制
度。 
The guiding principle of anti-drug ship work is prevention, such as ideological education to the crew, 
strict management and a sound system. 
主要措施包括： 
The main measures include: 
2.1 深入开展禁毒教育。 
Promote anti-drug education. 
讲明毒品上船和走私毒品的严重危害性，经常教育船员遵纪守法，自觉遵守禁毒的有
关规定。 
Explain the severe threat of drug possession and trafficking, always educate the crew to act in accordance 
with the law and follow the relevant anti-drug regulations.

2.2 严格执行梯口值班登记制度，验明来访人员的身份，严防无关人员登船，发现可疑迹
象，要严密监视并报告船长，对可疑物品要进行开包检查，严防毒品偷带上船。 
Strictly perform gangway on duty registration system, to examine the identity of visitors and prevent 
irrelevant parties from boarding. If suspicious signs are found, please monitor closely and report this to 
the Master. Unpack suspicious articles for inspection and prevent the smuggling of drugs. 
2.3 严格执行离港检查制度，划分区域，明确责任，分区包干，责任到人。凡可能藏毒的
部位，均要查到、查清。检查人和检查结果应记录在案，以备查考。 
Strictly perform the departure inspection system, divide the ship into different zones, do inspection 
separately, and clearly define the responsibility to the respective designated personnel. All areas that 
could possibly hide the drugs should be inspected. The name of inspectors and the results of inspection 
should be recorded for reference.    
2.4 停靠世界毒品主要产地和走私毒品严重的地区和港口，要加强值班巡逻。 
When berthing at the areas and ports that is the major areas of global drug production and drug trafficking, 
patrol shifts should be reinforced. 
船舶公共部位及有关舱室，在不影响安全和作业的前提下，应加封上锁（可结合船舶
保安计划的规定一并实施）。 
The public area and concerned cabins should be sealed and locked (it can be executed along with the 
regulations laid out by the Ship Safety Plan) without influencing the safety and operations. 
2.5 装卸货时应根据所在港口的情况，进行监装、监卸，以防夹带毒品上船。 
During loading and unloading, loading and unloading should be monitored to prevent drug smuggling on 
the ship according to the condition of the port of call. 
装卸货完毕检查后，要及时封舱并加锁道门。 
After inspection for loading and unloading, close the cargo timely and have an additional lock on the 
door. 
2.6 凡挂靠美国港口的船舶，必须按照与美国海关签订的《共同反毒协议》规定执行。 
Ships berthed at the US ports must be executed according to the regulations laid out in the “Anti-drug 
Co-operation” which is signed by China and American customs.  
2.7 严禁船员为国内外亲友及其他人员私自捎带任何不明内容的物品出入境。 
The crew is forbidden to take any items of unknown content to entry or exit the country for their families 
or other parties living in or out of the country privately. 
2.8 禁船员吸食、注射毒品。 
The crew is forbidden to eat or inject drug. 
2.9 加强调查研究，发现有走私毒品可疑的人员和迹象时，应严加控制。船长应立即报告
公司船员部。 
Inspection should be strengthened. If suspicious personnel or signs of drug trafficking is found, control 
should be exercised and the Master must report to the Crew Department immediately. 
2.10 一旦船舶发现毒品，应按下列办法妥善处置： 
Once drug is found on the ship, it should be handled properly as followed:  
2.10.1 在国内港口发现毒品时，要首先保护好现场，并立即报告公司船员部，同时报告当
地公安机关处理。 
If drug is found in the domestic port, preserve the scene undisturbed, report to the Crew Department 
and public security organs immediately. 
2.10.2 船舶在公海航行或抵港前发现毒品，必须立即报告公司船员部，并按公司船员部的
指示处理。船舶应采取下列措施： 
If drug is found on the ship while navigation in the open sea or before arrival to the port, report to the

 对毒品现场进行拍照； 
Take photos on the drug scene; 
 如能封闭时应封闭现场；如不能封闭则由船长确定将毒品移至安全地点加锁保管，

 妥善收集毒品的包装物及在匿藏地点发现的可疑物； 
Collect the drug package and suspicious matters found in the hiding location properly; 
 将发现毒品的情况记录在案； 
Record the conditions of how the drug was discovered; 
 按公司船员部的指示处理。

2.12 停靠国外港口期间，在船上自查发现毒品，船长立即报告公司船员部，按公司的指示

When drug is found during self-inspection on the ship while berthing at a foreign port, the Master should

provide necessary evidence to the follow-up handling work.  
2.13 在国外港口被当局检查发现毒品后，船长立即报告公司船员部，并积极配合港口当局

When drug is found by the local authorities at a foreign port, the Master should report to the Crew 
Department immediately, and be co-operative to the inspection and handling work of the local authorities 
at the port. During the negotiation, the conditions should be reported to the designated personnel and 
Crew Department timely.

3. 麻醉药品的管理 
Narcotics medicine management 
3.1 麻醉药品应由大副保管，并建立专用的采购、库存登记、使用记录簿。 
Narcotics medicine must be kept by the Chief Officer. A specific purchase, inventory registration and 
usage record book should be created. 
3.2 使用麻醉药品时必须经船长签字同意才能使用。 
The application of narcotics medicine needs approval by the Master in writing. 
3.3 一次处方量的麻醉药品不得超过极限量。如确实需要极限量使用时,必须经 公司船员
部确认，但连续使用不超过七天； 
One dose of narcotics medicine should not exceed the ultimate capacity. If the ultimate capacity must be 
applied, please obtain confirmation from the Crew Department, and the continuous application should not 
exceed seven days. 
3.4 麻醉药品针剂、注射剂不得超过二日常用量； 
Narcotics medicine injection and parenteral injection should not exceed the dose of two days. 
3.5 如麻醉药品无瓶签或瓶签模糊不清时,不可使用； 
If there is no label or the label is not clear, do not use the narcotics medicine. 
3.6 麻醉药品处方应单独保存。 
Narcotics medicine should be kept individually.

Drug test: 
4.1 药物测试器材包括，快速药物测试设备和用于随机在船上进行尿液药物测试的尿液样
本收集套件。  
The drug test equipment including to: a rapid drug test device, Urine Specimen Collection Kits For 
random urine drug tests carried out on board. 
4.2 药物测试器材的使用方法应该按照产品说明书指定的方式。 
Drug testing equipment should be used in the specified procedures of the product manual. 
4.3 应该认识到毒品的测试是一种威慑作用。 
It should consider that the testing procedure act should be as a deterrent. 
4.4 测试的频率应足以阻止毒品滥用，药物测试包括不事先宣布的测试，不定期测试，专
业机构执行的毒品测试。 
The frequency with which these tests are administered should be sufficient to deter such abuse. 
Including to the unannounced drug test，Irregular test，Drug test by an independent agency.

两名高级船员见证（可以包括大副）。 
An unannounced drug test should be carried out once every year at least. The Chief Officer will be 
responsible to conduct the test, and the Master will monitor the process, and witnessed by at least two 
Officers (can include C/O).

drugs or suspected drug intoxication 
 接到公司的指示 
When receive instruction from the company

Unless an incident is the cause of testing, the specimen may be discarded if found negative. 
4.6 如果检测结果为违禁物质阳性，应采取行动如下： 
If the test is positive for any prohibited substance, the following action as below： 
4.6.1 船员必须在标签上签名，然后贴在收集杯的盖子上，并将标本冷藏。 
The crew member must sign a label which is then affixed over the lid of the collection cup, and 
specimen refrigerated. 
4.6.2 阳性结果应经第二次尿药检查确认。 
A positive result should be confirmed with a second urine drug test. 
4.6.3 测试船员应留在船上医院在工作人员的直接观察90 分钟，直到第二份尿液样本产生
并测试。 
The test crew member will remain in the medical center under the direct observation of the staff for up 
to 90 minutes until a second urine specimen in produced, and test again. 
4.6.4 如果两次检测都呈阳性，必须立即联系管理公司船员部，按照管理公司指示行动。 
If two tests are positive, the master should report to the crew department of company immediately, and 
take action according to the company. 
4.7 
药物尿检呈阳性的管理。 
Management of drug positive in urine test . 
4.7.1 收集待保存的分离尿样。 
Collection of split urine sample to be maintained. 
4.7.2 应联系公司，以批准进行额外测试。 
The Company is to be contacted for approval for the additional testing to be performed. 
4.7.3 密封原始样本。 
Original sample to be sealed. 
4.7.4 应在船员面前将至少两盎司（约60ml）的尿液放入密封杯中，并在样本上标注他们
的全名、姓和日期，以及取样 的时间／日期。 
At least two ounces (about 60ml) of urine is to be placed in a sealed cup in front of crew with their full 
name, last name and date of birth labeled on the sample and time / date when the sample was taken.    
4.7.5 这个密封的杯子将放在一个密封的样本收集袋中，袋子上面标有取样的时间和日期以
及船员的全名。 
A sealed cup will be placed in a sealed specimen collection bag labeled with the time and date the 
sample was taken, and full name of the crew.  
4.7.6 样本将被送到下一个可停靠港，该港应有能够进行药物尿液测试的实验室。 
The specimen is to be sent to the next available port where there is a laboratory with capability to do 
drug urine test. 
4.7.7 移交样本时，应在监护表格上签名。 
The custody to be signed on the form when the specimen is handed over.    
4.7.8 测试结果将通过电子邮件发送给船舶。 
The test result will be emailed to the vessel.

4.9 应该认识到毒品的测试是一种威慑作用。

4.10 如果是由于事故进行的测试，在丢弃样本前请咨询岸基公司。

4.11 尿液检测的废弃物，按照医疗废弃物处理。 
Urine testing waste should be treated as medical waste.  
5.0 酒类的管理 
Management of alcohol 
5.1 船舶所有酒类饮品必须由专人保管，并做好酒类发放和饮用记录。 
All alcohol drinks on ship should be kept by the designated personnel and keep records of alcohol 
distribution and consumption. 
5.2 船舶应严格控制酒类的消耗，每人每周不能超过14 个酒精单位，一个酒精单位被定义
为10 毫升（或8 克）纯酒精。 
The ship should keep control of the alcohol consumption. Each person should not exceed 14 alcohol units 
every week. One alcohol unit is defined as 10 ml (or 8g) of pure alcohol.  
5.3  为保障随时应对应急情况，船员不得因酒精影响正常的生产生活。要求船长、高级船
员和其他海员执行指定的安全、保安和海洋环境职责作业时，其血液酒精浓度(BAC)不
得超过0.05%，或呼吸中的酒精含量不超过0.25 毫克/升，或导致酒精浓度达到此水平
的酒精量。 
To ensure prompt response to emergency conditions, the crews should not let alcohol affect their normal 
productivity. A limit of not greater than 0.05% blood alcohol level (BAC) or 0.25 mg/l alcohol in the 
breath or a quantity of alcohol leading to such alcohol concentration for masters, officers and other 
seafarers while performing designated safety, security and marine environmental duties 
6 
值班人员上岗前四小时内一律不准饮酒。 
Crew on duty should not drink alcohol four hours before the duty. 
7 
船上严禁酗酒；如果经常每周喝14 个单位的酒，那么最好均匀地分开在3 天或更长的
时间里喝；酒醉人员不得上下舷梯引水梯。 
Drink abuse is prohibited on the ship, if crew member regularly drinks as much as 14 units per week, it 
is best to spread her drinking evenly over 3 or more days. Drunken persons are not allowed to embark or 
disembark from the accommodation ladder or pilot ladder. 
8 
酒精测试： 
Alcohol test: 
8.1 
酒精测试仪的使用应该参考产品说明的指导。  
The alcohol meter must be used in accordance with the instructions as provided by its manufacturer. 
8.2 不事先宣布的测试，每月至少进行一次，该测试由大副负责，船长监督。 
An unannounced drug test should be carried out once a month at least. The Chief Officer will be 
responsible to run the test and the Master will monitor the process. 
8.3 不定期的测试 
Irregular test 
 当发生事故时进行强制测试 
Compulsory test in case of accidents 
 船长认为有必要时 
When the Master believes to be necessary

第05 节  船员在船工作考核办法 
Section 05 Crew’s Ship Work Performance Appraisal Measures 
 
1.0 考核内容与考核方式 
Content and mode of the appraisal  
1.1 考核内容见本办法所附的考核表。 
As to the content of the appraisal, see the Appraisal Form attached. 
1.2 考核方式为分项评价，量化结果。考核结果公司船员部汇总，并作为船员晋升、选派
和调整的依据。 
The appraisal is processed through evaluation by different categories and quantification of performance. 
The results of appraisal will be summarized by the Marine Department as a basis of the promotion, 
selection and adjustment of the crew. 
2.0 考核职责与考核程序 
The obligations and procedures of the appraisal 
2.1 实行逐级考核、各负其责的考核程序。 
The appraisal procedure is developed as a layered structure.   
2.2 由船员部组织船管部、海务部等相关人员组成公司考核小组，每季度对船长、轮机长
的工作进行考核，填写《船长、轮机长考核表》。 
The Crew Department should organize the personals concerned in the Fleet Department and Marine 
Department to form an assessment team, to evaluate the work of the Master and Chief Engineer every 
quarter, and fill in the “The Master / Chief Engineer appraisal Form”. 
2.3 每季度的最后一周，大副和轮机长分别对甲板部和轮机部人员进行考核，并填写《船
员考核表》报船长审核。 
By the last week of each quarter, the Chief Engineer and Chief Officer should undergo appraisal on the 
crew of the Deck Department and Machinery Department separately, and fill out the “Assessment form for 
crew” for the review of the Master. 
2.4 每季度的最后一周，船长对轮机长、大副进行考核，并填写《船员考核表》。 
By the last week of each quarter, the Master should undergo appraisal on the Chief Engineer and Chief 
Officer, and fill out the “Assessment form for crew”.  
2.5 考核完成后由船长统一报送公司船员部备存，船舶不保存此考核结果。 
After the appraisal finishes, the appraisal results will be jointly sent to the Marine Department for keeping, 
and the ship will not keep them.  
在船员解雇、休假、提升及其他特殊情况下需进行额外考核。 
Extra assessments have to be made in cases of crew dismiss, vacation, promotion and other special 
circumstances. 
2.6 船长、轮机长休假前要求写出述职报告，反映船舶工作、个人工作体会及船员管理情
况，述职报告在SMIS 中存档，需要时船员部可安排到公司进行述职。 
Before taking vacation, the captain and chief engineer are required to write a job report reflecting the 
ship's work, personal work experience, and crew management. The job report should be archived in SMIS, 
and if necessary, the crew department can arrange for a job report to be conducted at the company. 
 
2.7 干部船员和普通船员在每次考核结束时，应被告知在船期间的考核情况，如果一个干
部船员或者普通船员被发现低于期望的标准，那么为这些船员进行特定培训和沟通是
有必要的，相关记录应由双方签字。 
At every end of appraisal of the officer or rating should be informed of the assessment during the period 
of the ship. In case an officer/ rating is found to be below expected standards, it is equally important for

04_11.text:
第六节 船员在船期间的健康管理 
Section 06 Health Management of Crew Members On Board 
1 
目的 Purpose 
保障船员在船期间身心健康，有效预防和控制疾病，建立安全健康的工作与生活环
境。 
To ensure the physical and mental health of crew members during their stay on board, effectively 
prevent and control diseases, and establish a safe and healthy working and living environment. 
2 
适用范围 Scope 
适用于公司管理的所有船舶及船员。 
Applicable to all ships and crew members managed by the company. 
3 
管理职责Management Responsibilities 
3.1 
船长 Master： 
3.1.1 全面负责船员健康管理的实施，确保符合国际公约（如 MLC 2006）及船旗国法规。 
Fully responsible for the implementation of the crew health management , ensuring compliance with 
international conventions (such as MLC 2006) and flag state regulations. 
3.1.2 接收并处理船员健康异常或疾病报告，情况严重或需岸基支持时及时报告公司。
Receive and handle reports of abnormal crew health or illness, and report to the company in a timely 
manner when the situation is serious or shore-based support is needed. 
3.1.3 监督船舶药品的管理，确保库存充足且在有效期内。 
Supervise the management of medicines on board ships to ensure that stocks are adequate and within 
their expiration dates. 
3.1.4 休假前，在船长述职报告中对船员整体健康状况及存在的相关情况进行评估。 
Before taking leave, assess the overall health status of the crew and any related issues in the captain's 
performance report. 
4 
身体健康/心理健康管理 Physical Health and Mental Health Management 
4.1 
身心健康监控 Physical and mental health monitoring 
4.1.1 船员 Crew Members： 
4.1.1.1 主动关注自身身心健康状况。 
Take the initiative to pay attention to their own physical and mental health. 

船员在船期间的健康管理 
Health Management of Crew Members On Board 
版本/修改：3.0/0.0 
 
Ver./Rev.:   3.0/0.0 
SHIP-03-06 
SHIP-03-06 
 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                        生效日期：2025/07/21                 第2/3页

4.1.1.2 及时、如实报告个人健康异常或工作环境中存在的健康隐患。 
Report personal health abnormalities or health hazards in the work environment in a timely and 
truthful manner. 
4.1.2 班前会状态确认 Tool Box Meeting Status Check: 现场监督层（水手长 / 机工长）在每
日班前会上确认船员身体状态。发现异常（如疲劳、不适）时，应立即暂停其作业，
并报告部门长。 
Tool Box Meeting Status Check: On-site supervisors (Bsun/Fitter) shall confirm the physical status of 
the crew members under their jurisdiction at the daily Tool Box meeting. If abnormalities (such as 
fatigue, discomfort) are found, their work shall be suspended immediately and reported to the 
department head. 
4.1.3 月度健康巡检 Monthly Health Check：部门长每月需对本部门船员进行健康观察与问
询，发现任何异常情况，及时跟进处理，必要时向船长 / 公司报告。 
Monthly Health Check: Department heads must conduct monthly health observations and interviews 
with crew members in their departments. Any abnormalities discovered must be followed up on 
promptly and, if necessary, reported to the captain/company. 
4.1.4 船舶领导（船长、部门长）及船员需关注同事情绪与行为变化。发现持续萎靡不振、
焦虑、抑郁或其他显著心理困扰迹象时，应及时报告船长 / 公司。 
Ship leaders (captains, department heads) and crew members shall pay attention to changes in 
colleagues' emotions and behaviors. If signs of persistent listlessness, anxiety, depression or other 
significant psychological distress are found, they shall report to the captain/company in a timely 
manner. 
4.2 
预防措施 Preventive Measures 
4.2.1 身体健康预防措施Physical health Preventive Measures 
4.2.1.1 定期对生活区（特别是厨房、餐厅、卫生间、淋浴间）及卫生设施进行清洁消毒。
Regularly clean and disinfect living areas (especially kitchens, mess rooms, toilets, showers) and 
sanitary facilities. 
4.2.1.2 提供营养均衡的膳食，确保饮用水安全卫生。 
Provide nutritionally balanced meals and ensure safe and hygienic drinking water. 
4.2.1.3 合理遵循工作和休息时间安排。 
Reasonably follow the work and rest time arrangements. 

船员在船期间的健康管理 
Health Management of Crew Members On Board 
版本/修改：3.0/0.0

4.2.1.4 倡导船员时常进行体育锻炼。 
Promote physical activity among crew members from time to time. 
4.2.1.5 作业中必须规范使用个人防护装备（PPE）。 
Personal protective equipment (PPE) must be used standardized during operations. 
4.2.2 心理疾病预防措施Mental illness prevention measures: 
4.2.2.1 定期组织集体活动（如节日庆祝、娱乐比赛、聚餐），增强团队凝聚力。 
Onboard Cultural Activities: Regularly organize collective activities (such as holiday celebrations, 
entertainment competitions, dinners) to enhance team cohesion. 
4.2.2.2 确保船员住舱清洁、舒适、通风良好。 
Ensure crew cabins are clean, comfortable and well-ventilated. 
4.2.2.3 提供并维护娱乐设施（如书籍、影音设备、棋牌等）, 保持公共空间（娱乐室、餐厅）
整洁、氛围友好。 
Provide and maintain entertainment facilities (such as books, audio-visual equipment, chess and cards, 
etc.), Keep public spaces (such as entertainment room, mess room) clean and friendly. 
4.2.2.4 定期开展心理健康知识普及和培训。 
Regularly conduct mental health education and training. 
4.2.2.5 严禁任何形式的霸凌、骚扰和歧视行为，营造相互尊重、和谐的工作环境。 
Strictly prohibit any form of bullying, harassment and discrimination, and create a work environment 
of mutual respect and harmony. 
4.2.2.6 确保船员了解并能够运用船舶或个人通讯工具，与岸基专业心理咨询服务公司取得
联系并获取支持。 
Ensure that crew members understand and are able to use shipboard or personal communication 
devices to contact and obtain support from shore-based professional counseling services.
