04_14.chapter: 第三节 船舶档案和技术资料管理办法
04_14.text:
第三节 船舶档案和技术资料管理办法 
Section 03 Ship Documents and Technical Information Management Measures 
 
1.0 本办法规定了船舶档案和技术资料管理办法，适用于公司所有船舶。 
This measure laid out the regulations on ship documents and technical information management, which is 
applicable on all ships of the company. 
2.0 档案管理 
Document management 
2.1 船舶档案包括下列文件 
Ship documents include 
2.1.1 各种证书： 船舶法定证书，船级证书，检验证书，设备证书，文件证书等； 
All categories of certificates: statutory certificate, the classification certificate, survey certificate, 
equipment certificates, document certificates and so on; 
2.1.2 安全管理体系手册及与之相关的资料（公约、法规等）； 
Safety management system manuals and relevant information (conventions and regulations); 
2.1.3 各类通函、通电、来往邮件等； 
All categories of circular, notice and correspondences; 
2.1.4 规章制度（包括公司下发和本船制定的规章制度）； 
Rules and regulations (including rules and regulations laid down by the company and the ship); 
2.1.5 船舶的年度维修保养计划和修船计划； 
Annual planned maintenance system and ship repair plans; 
2.1.6 船舶各种维修保养记录、总结、各项报告； 
All records, reports and final reports of the maintenance and repair; 
2.1.7 备件、属具、物料等的计划、申购单、报销等单据； 
Plans, purchase orders, voucher or other kinds of documents in relation to spare parts, appliance, store 
and so on; 
2.1.8 各种日志：航海日志、轮机日志、电台日志等； 
All categories of log books: deck log books, engine log books, GMDSS books and so on; 
2.1.9 其他有关文件和船内联系报表、单据。 
Other relevant documents as to internal communication in the ship, such as reports and voucher. 
2.2 各项文件应按其内容性质分类立卷，各卷均建有目录并附在卷首，注明入卷文件的题
目、编号、时间及内容摘要等。 
All documents are set to different folders by categories according to the content, each folder is served 
with a content on the first page, which give clear an indication of title, number, time and summary. 
2.3 不论发出文件的底稿或收入文件，均由船长审阅签署并注明日期，在处理完毕后各自
存档和按要求把文件或文件的复印件转交给大副、轮机长。 
All documents sent or received should be viewed and signed by the Master with date indicated. After the 
transaction, the documents should be filed, and the originals or the copy of the documents should be 
passed to the Chief officer and chief engineer. 
2.4 妥善存放、保管所有证书。为办理进港手续代理须将证书带下船时，尽量递交副本，
如果必须是正本时，必须列出清单代理签字后才可将证书交代理带走。 
All certificates should be kept in proper care. Agents responsible for formalities for entering port should 
submit duplicates of the certificates. If original certificates must be submitted, please make a list for the 
agents to sign before taking them for the formalities. 
2.5 船舶证书在更新后，旧的证书须存档保留一个特检期（五年）。

第2/2页 
Page: 2/2 
 
After the renewal of Ship Certificate, the previous certificate should be kept until the next special survey 
(five years). 
2.6 除特殊情况外，档案不得外借，如因特殊原因借出档案，必须取得船长的同意，保管
人员必须取得借条并负责收回。 
Document lending is prohibited apart from exceptional case. For any borrowed use of documents under 
specific reasons, approval from the Master must be obtained. 
2.7 所有保密文件均需设立专卷，由船长或指定专人保管，移交时按卷内文件逐件清点并
签署。 
All confidential documents must be filed in a special folder and kept by the Master or an appointed staff. 
During the work shift, documents in the folder should be checked and signed item by item. 
2.8 船舶档案分别由各责任人保管。 
Ship documents are kept by the responsible person. 
3.0 技术资料管理 
Technical information management 
3.1 船舶技术资料包括: 
Ship technical information including: 
3.1.1 航海图书资料； 
Nautical publications; 
3.1.2 船舶机器设备资料簿； 
Ship machinery equipment data book; 
3.1.3 船舶图纸和设备说明书； 
Ship drawing and equipment instructions; 
3.1.4 各种报告：检验报告；试验报告；化验报告； 
All categories of reports: Survey Report; Test Report; Report of Analysis; 
3.1.5 检修及测量记录。 
Overhaul and measurement record. 
3.2 技术资料的保管由船长、轮机长、和大副总负责，二副具体负责航海图书资料的申请、
改正和管理。 
The Master, the chief engineer and the chief officer are jointly responsible to handle the technology 
information with due diligence. The second officer is responsible for the application, correction and 
management of the nautical publications. 
3.3 随船技术资料应保持完整和清洁，不得擅自外借。 
Technical information of the ship should be kept complete and clean. Unauthorized lending to other 
people is prohibited. 
3.4 船长处的船舶资料除船长外，不得借阅给他人。 如因特殊原因须借出船舶技术资料，
必须取得船长的同意。  
The ship technical information of the Master can only be viewed by the Master. For any borrowed use of 
ship technical information to other people under specific reasons, approval from the Master must be 
obtained.

第01 节 航行制度和航次计划 
Section 01 Navigation Regulation and Voyage Plan 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose & Scope 
1.1 本章旨在指导船舶海上航行，保证有效的驾驶台组织，明确驾驶台团队成员的值班要
求，指导机舱值班配员，设计和实施航次计划，保证船舶航行安全，防止环境污染。 
This Charter in order to guide ship navigation, establish an effective bridge organization, clarify the duties 
of bridge team members, guide the engine room duty arrangement, planning and conduct of voyage plans, 
which aims to ensure the ship`s safety during voyage and prevent environmental pollution. 
1.2 本节适用于公司有关部门和公司所管理的船舶。 
This section applies to the departments concerned and all ships managed by the company. 
1.3 本章及公司其它任何指示都不解除船长、驾驶员、或普通船员法律规定给他们的责任。 
Nothing in this charter or any other Company instruction shall relieve Masters, Officers, or Crew of their 
responsibilities under the law. 
1.4 作为本航行制度各节的程序和指导的补充，船舶应完全遵守所有适合的国际、国内和
地方法规。 
Vessel shall comply fully with all applicable International, National and Local laws in addition to the 
procedures and guidelines of this charter in Navigation Regulations. 
1.5 人命、船舶安全、保护海洋环境和船舶货物应优先于其它所有事项。 
The safety of life, the ship, protection of the marine environment and the cargo shall take precedence over 
all other matters. 
2.0 职责 
Duty 
2.1 船长在航行安全上的权力与责任 
Master`s authority and responsibility in navigation safety 
船长们主要负责船舶安全和有效的航行。他们必须确保理解了本章的内容并遵守其程
序。任何背离都应报告给指定人员。 
Masters are primarily responsible for the safe and effective navigation of the vessel. They must ensure that 
the contents of this charter are understood and that the procedures are followed. Any deviation shall be 
reported to the Designated Person Ashore (DPA). 
2.2 船长的绝对权力 
Master Overriding Authority 
船长有绝对的权力和责任在安全和防污染方面做出决定。特别是在恶劣天气、通航密
集水域或能见度不良时。运用船长的职业判断力，为安全航行的必要而做出的任何决
定不应受船东或租家的约束。 
The Master has the overriding authority and responsibility to make decisions with respect to safety and 
pollution prevention. The Master should not be constrained by a ship owner or a Charterer from taking any 
decision which in his professional judgment is necessary for safe navigation, in particular in severe 
weather, heavy traffic areas or restricted visibility. 
2.3 指挥的接管 
Succussing of Command 
2.3.1 无论什么原因，如果船长不能胜任履行其职责，大副应临时接管船舶指挥。他有全部
的权力来发布船长平时发布的任何命令或指示，并且应对所采取的行动对船长和公司
负责。 
If the Master is incapacitated to carry out his duties for whatever reason, the chief officer shall temporarily 
assume command of the ship. He has the full authority to issue any orders or instructions that the Master

would normally issue and will be held accountable to the Master and the Company for any actions taken. 
2.3.2 在不太可能的情况下，值班驾驶员（OOW）有完全的理由相信船长受酒精或其它危
险药物的影响，而且不能指挥船舶，那么船上的大副应该： 
In the unlikely event the Officer of the Watch (OOW) has clear grounds to believe that the Master is under 
the influence of alcohol or any other dangerous drug, and is incapable of commanding the vessel, then the 
Chief Officer on board shall: 
1) 接替船长并临时指挥船舶 
Relieve the Master and temporarily take command of the vessel; 
2) 立即通知DPA并 
Immediately notify the DPA and 
3) 在甲板航海日志中记录事件的详情 
Enter the details of the incident in the Deck Log Book. 
2.4 驾驶员值班  
Officer on Watch (OOW)  
2.4.1 
值班驾驶员是船长的代表，他的首要职责任何时候都是船舶的安全航行。他必须任
何时候都遵守国际海上避碰规则(COLREGS)，STCW公约中所述的基本原则。 
The Officer of the watch is the Master's representative and his prime responsibility at all times is safe 
navigation of the ship. He must at all times comply with the International Regulations for Preventing 
Collisions at Sea (COLREGS) and the Basic Principles to be Observed in Keeping a Navigational Watch 
of the International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watch-keeping for Seafarers, 
STCW Convention. 
2.4.2 
尽管船长出现在驾驶台值班驾驶员继续对船舶安全航行负责直到船长专门通知他，
船长已接班负责。同样，当船长移交指挥和控制船舶给值班驾驶员时，船长应特别地和
正式地通知值班驾驶员。 
The Officer of the Watch continues to be responsible for the safe navigation of the vessel despite the 
presence of the Master on the bridge until the Master informs him specifically that he has assumed 
responsibility. Similarly, the Master shall expressly and formally inform the O.O.W whenever he hands 
over the conning and control of ship back to officer of watch. 
2.4.3 
值班驾驶员应完全的和自由地使用所有导航设备并最大限度的使用。 
The O.O.W. has complete and unrestricted use of all navigational equipment’s and should make maximum 
use of it. 
2.4.4 
在海上，值班驾驶员应保持他的值班并在任何情况下都不应离开驾驶台，直到完全
替代。 
At sea, the O.O.W. shall maintain his watch and under no circumstances should he leave the bridge until 
properly relieved. 
2.4.5 
值班驾驶员的职责和交接班制度，和船舶手册第三章的船员管理一致。 
The regulations of the O.O.W and handover are consistent with the Chapter III Crew Management of Ship 
Manual. 
3.0 驾驶台值班原则 
Principle of Bridge Watch 
3.1 驾驶台的值班条件 
Bridge Watch Conditions 
3.1.1 驾驶台配员需求的变化，取决于地点、船舶密集程度和气象条件。引航员不应被考虑
为船舶值班人员的补充。然而在引航期间他是驾驶台团队的一部分。 
Bridge manning requirements vary substantially depending upon location, traffic density and weather 
conditions. The Pilot is not considered part of the vessel’s complement. However he is part of bridge team

船长有责任设置合适的驾驶台值班并确保正规瞭望。船长应确保所有参与值班的驾
驶员及普通船员已适当的训练、熟悉了驾驶台的设备、得到了充足的休息。 
The Master has a responsibility to set the proper Bridge Watch and to ensure a proper look-out. Master has 
to ensure that all officers and crew members are properly trained, familiarized with bridge equipment’s, 
well rested. 
3.1.3 
指挥权的任何改变都必须记录在甲板航海日志里 
Any change of conning must be logged in the Deck Logbook. 
3.1.4 
在航时，根据当时的环境和情况判断,驾驶台值班应由船长指示并决定。 
When underway, Bridge Watches shall be set at the Master's direction and discretion according to 
prevailing circumstances and conditions. 
3.1.5 
在决定值班组成时应确保保持了良好的瞭望，应考虑以下： 
When determining the watch composition to ensure that a good look-out is maintained, the following shall 
be taken into account: 
1) 能见度、海况和天气状况 
The visibility, state of sea and state of the weather; 
2) 船舶密集程度及附近船舶的动态 
The traffic density and activities in the vicinity of the vessel; 
3) 在通航分道制附近航行时必要的谨慎 
 The attention necessary when navigating in the vicinity of traffic separation schemes; 
4) 当航行在海盗区附近时 
 Navigation when in the proximity of piracy areas; 
5) 由于船舶工作引起的给值班人员的额外工作量。 
Additional workloads on the watch keepers created as a result of the ship’s functions; 
6) 任何应召被指定作为值班人员的适于值班情况 
The fitness for duty of any crew members on call who are assigned as members of the watch; 
7) 船舶高级船员及普通船员的知识、信心和专业才能 
Knowledge, confidence and professional competence of the ship’s officers and crew; 
8) 每名航行值班驾驶员的经验及他对船舶设备、程序和操纵能力的熟悉情况 
 The experience of each officer of the navigational watch and his familiarity with the ship’s 
equipment, procedures and manoeuvring capability; 
9) 任何时间在船上发生的行动，包括无线电通讯和可利用的应召到驾驶台的立即协助。 
Activities taking place on-board at any time, including radio communication and availability of 
immediate assistance to be summoned to the bridge; 
10) 驾驶台仪器、控制和警报的操作状况 
Operational status of bridge instruments, controls and alarms; 
11) 舵、推进器控制和船舶操纵特性 
Rudder and propeller control and ship manoeuvring characteristics; 
12) 船舶尺度和指挥位置的视野。 
The size of the ship and field of vision from the conning position; 
13) 驾驶台结构在某种程度上可能制约值班人员由视觉或听觉察觉任何外界的进展情
况。 
The configuration of the bridge to the extent that this may inhibit the watch members from detecting any 
external development by sight or hearing; 
14) 船旗国的要求 
Flag State Requirements

3.2 驾驶台配员的评估 
Reassessment of Bridge Manning 
3.2.1 
由于多种原因需要改变驾驶台的值班安排，例如雷达故障、持续的能见度降低或坏
天气、拥挤的交通情况、海盗活动、战争等等，疲劳程度和工作量也是其决定性因素。 
Such changes may be necessary due to a variety of reasons and examples are breakdown of a radar/s, 
continuous periods of reduced visibility or bad weather, heavy traffic conditions, pirate activity, hostilities 
etc. Fatigue levels and workload are other deciding factors. 
3.2.2 
驾驶台的人员配置水平，尤其是长时间航行，例如长时间引航时，必须由船长根据
情况安排考虑。额外的驾驶台当班对当班人员而言，可能需要更充足时间的休息。在
这期间，船长必须使用休息时间计算表来合理计划驾驶台当班的充足完备性。 
The manning level on the bridge for the lengthy period, such as long pilotage etc. must be considered on 
the case to case basis by the Master. Additional bridge watches may require adequate rest period for 
watch-keepers. The Master must use the rest hour calculation table to plan the adequacy of the bridge 
watches maintained during such period. 
3.3 驾驶台和机舱值班等级 
 Bridge Watch Levels 
3.3.1 
推荐运用不同值班等级： 
Recommendations for application of different watch levels: 
3.3.2 
船长根据当时环境对制定配员等级总是拥有最终的权力和责任，  
While the Master will always have final authority and responsibility to control the manning level as 
per the prevailing circumstances,  
3.3.3 
机舱值班等级和驾驶台值班等级一致，轮机长根据船长的建议和当时环境对制定 
配员等级拥有最终的权力和责任， 
The engine watch levels are consistent with that of the bridge watch, the chief engineer always has 
the final power and responsibility to establish the staffing level according to the captain's suggestions 
and the prevailing circumstances. 
3.3.4 
建议采用下面的指导： 
It is recommended that guidance be taken from the following: 
等级 1 
Level 1 
远离航行危险的开阔水域和不拥挤的沿岸航线，能见度良好 
Open seas and uncongested coastal routes which are free of navigational hazards, in clear visibility. 
等级 2 
Level 2 
1) 能见度降低了的开阔水域 
Open seas in reduced visibility. 
2) 船舶密度增加了的水道 
Waterways with increased traffic density. 
3) 航行在邻近航行危险或浅水附近时 
When transiting areas in close proximity of navigational hazards or shallow waters 
4) 恐怖主义或海盗威胁流行的高风险水域 
High-risk areas where the threat of terrorism or piracy is prevalent. 
5) 在任何遇险或紧急通讯进行期间 
During any distress or emergency communication proceedings.

3.4 驾驶台值班等级的组成 
Bridge Watch Level Composition 
3.4.1 驾驶台值班等级I 
Bridge Watch I 
1）这个等级值班应有一名值班驾驶员和一名值班水手在驾驶台值班。 
This watch needs one Officer of Watch and one AB on the Bridge. 
2）在许可条件下水手可以从事有限的工作，但需保证在情况变化时立即召唤到驾驶台。 
The AB can be arranged to perform limited work under permit conditions, but the AB can immediately 
available to be summoned to the bridge when any change in the situation so requires. 
3）此外，在夜间航行时，一名AB应在驾驶台进行操舵（如需）和瞭望。 
Additionally, one AB shall be on Bridge during night time for helm and look-out duties 
3.4.2 驾驶台值班等级II 
Bridge Watch II 
1) 这个等级值班要求一名驾驶员、一名操舵人员以及一名专职瞭望人员。 
This watch requires one officer, one helmsman and a full-time lookout. 
2) 在许可条件下舵工可以从事有限的工作，但需保证在情况变化时立即召唤到驾驶
台。 
The helmsman can be arranged to perform limited work under permit conditions, but he can 
immediately available to be summoned to the bridge when any change in the situation so requires. 
3) 船长可以根据情况选择是否到驾驶台进行值班。 
The captain can choose whether to go to the bridge for duty according to the situation. 
3.4.3 驾驶台值班等级III 
Bridge Watch III 
1) 这个等级的值班要求船长、一名驾驶员、一名操舵人员和一名专职瞭望人员。 
This watch requires captain , one officers，one helmsman and a full-time lookout. 
2) 特殊情况下，船长可以根据情况临时加派一名驾驶员协助航行值班。

Under special circumstances, the captain may temporarily assign an additional officer to assist in the 
sailing watch according to the situation. 
这个等级的值班是最关键的、苛刻的，需要对优先事项给予最严格的关注。 
This watch level is the most critical and demanding and calls for the most rigorous attention to priorities. 
3.5 机舱值班等级的组成 
Engine room Watch Level Composition 
3.5.1 机舱值班等级I 
Engine Watch I 
1）这个等级值班可以实行无人机舱值班,  
This watch can be implemented Unattended machinery spaces. 
2）这个等级的值班要求一名轮机员和一名机工值班。 
This watch requires one engineer and one oiler to be on watch. 
3.5.2 机舱值班等级II 
Engine Watch II 
1) 这个等级值班要求轮机长、一名轮机员和一名机工在机舱值班。 
This watch requires Chief Engineer，one engineer and one oiler to be on duty in the 
engine room. 
2) 在无需备车航行的情况下，轮机长可以根据情况实行无人机舱值班；当需要备车航
行时，按备车值班要求实施。 
The Chief Engineer can carry out unmanned engine room watch according to the situation when there 
is no need for standby main engine for navigation; When a standby main engine is required for 
navigation, it will be implemented according to the requirements of standby main engine duty. 
3.5.3 机舱值班等级III 
Engine room Watch III

3.7 船长上驾驶台 
MASTER’S PRESENCE ON BRIDGE 
3.7.1 
船长对船舶的安全航行负有全面的责任并必须证实所有航迹和航向都保持船舶远
离了航行危险。如果船舶航迹不可避免在浅滩、无关的礁石或其它航行危险附近经过，
船长必须留在驾驶台直到任何安全航行的危险被安全的驶过并让清。 
The Master is overall responsible for the safe navigation of the vessel and must approve all tracks and 
courses to keep the vessel clear of dangers to navigation. If the vessel’s track unavoidably passes in the 
vicinity of shoals, outlying rocks or other navigation hazards, the Master must remain on the bridge until 
any threat to safe navigation is well past and clear. 
3.7.2 
任何时候当船长判断船舶接近潜在危险地点和特别情况，他必须在驾驶台： 
The Master must be on the bridge whenever he judges the vessel to be approaching a potentially 
dangerous situation and specifically when: 
1) 进入和离开港口，进坞和出坞 
Entering and leaving port, docking, and undocking 
2) 移泊船舶去靠码头或移泊位 
Shifting vessel alongside berth or berth-to-berth movements 
3) 在受限水域和狭窄航道 
In restricted waters and narrow channels 
4) 在高船舶密集区 
In areas of high traffic density 
5) 在能见度受限水域 
In areas of restricted visibility 
3.7.3 
船长应在航线设计中指出，航线中要求他上驾驶台的部分/航程。 
The Master shall indicate in the passage plan the sections / legs of the passage where his presence is 
required on the bridge. 
3.7.4 
在长时间的引航或类似情况期间，或如果船长疲劳，他可决定由大副接班。在这种
情况下的整体任务是应确保： 
During prolonged pilotage or similar circumstances, or if master is tired, he may at his discretion, be 
relieved by the Chief Officer. The overall objective under such circumstances is to ensure that: 
1) 驾驶台有足够的人力资源 
Adequate manpower resources are available on the bridge. 
2) 处理航行的局面，团队是称职的和经验丰富的 
The team is suitably qualified and experienced to handle the navigational situation. 
3）值班驾驶员清除地理解了责任并没有不明确事项存在 
Duties are clearly understood for watch officers and no ambiguity exists 
4）团队不是疲劳的而且得到很好的休息 
The team is not fatigued and well rested 
3.7.5 
船长必须让值班驾驶员明白任何时候在哪里能联系到他。值班驾驶员必须连续执行
他的船舶航行的职责而且必须提醒船长如果任何有关船位方面的危险局面的发展或紧
迫局面。 
The Master must keep the Officer-on-Watch informed as to where he can be contacted at any time. The 
OOW must continue to carry out his duties in the navigation of the vessel and must alert the Master if any 
dangerous situation is developing with respect to the position of the vessel or a close quarter situation. 
3.7.6 
船长仅仅出现在驾驶台，并不解除值班驾驶员的船舶航行和避碰的责任，除非值班
驾驶员被特别地告知船长已接管了船舶指挥权。 
Masters mere presence on the bridge does not relieve the Officer-on-Watch of his duties in the navigation

3.8 瞭望 
LOOK-OUT 
3.8.1 
为了充分评估局面和碰撞，搁浅和其他有碍航行的危险，任何时候都必须对船舶周
围保持良好的瞭望。此外，其瞭望职责还包括发觉遇险的船舶或飞机，海难人员，存
船和残骸。 
A good look-out all-round the ship must be maintained at all times for the purpose of fully appraising the 
situation and the risk of collision, stranding and other dangers to navigation. Additionally, the duties of the 
look-out shall include the detection of ships or aircraft in distress, shipwrecked person, wrecks, and debris. 
3.8.2 
保持瞭望，应遵守如下： 
In maintaining a look-out, the following shall be observed: 
3.8.3 
瞭望人员必须能够全神贯注保持正规瞭望而且不应分派可能影响瞭望的其它职责。
瞭望人员和舵工的职责通常是分开的，舵工在操舵时不能被认为是瞭望人员。 
The look-out must be able to give full attention to the keeping of a proper look-out and no other duties 
shall be undertaken or assigned which could interfere with this task. The duties of the lookout and 
helmsman are normally separate and the helmsman shall not be considered to be the look-out while 
steering, 
3.8.4 
实习生和任何其它没有适任证书的普通船员不应是驾驶台团队人员（不能担任瞭望
职务）。 
Cadets and any other ratings without appropriate certification should not be part of the Bridge Team (not 
serve a lookouts) 
3.8.5 
在能见度不良等情况下，引航/通过拥挤水域，驾驶台团队组成应通过增加额外驾
驶员/瞭望人员而适当加强。 
The composition of the bridge team should be suitably strengthened by an additional navigating 
officer/look-out in situations such while under pilotage/transiting congested waters in poor visibility etc. 
3.9 单一的瞭望人员 
SOLE LOOKOUT 
3.9.1 
仅仅在白天时间满足确定条件时，STCW允许值班驾驶员可以是单一的瞭望人员。 
STCW permits the OOW to be the sole look-out during daylight hours only subject to certain conditions. 
3.9.2 
对局面进行了评估而且这样做是安全的。 
That the situation has been assessed and it is safe to do so. 
3.9.3 
充分考虑了例如：天气、能见度、船舶密度、邻近的航行危险及航行在分道通航制
附近所要求的关注等相关因素当值班驾驶员是单一的瞭望人员： 
Full account has been taken of all relevant factors such as weather, visibility, traffic density, proximity of 
navigational hazards and attention required when navigating in the proximity of traffic separation schemes. 
Whenever the OOW is the sole look-out: 
1) 当局面的任何变化要求时，被召唤的协助人员必须能马上到达驾驶台 
Assistance must be immediately available to be summoned to the bridge when any change in the situation 
so requires. 
2) 在夜晚时间、能见度受限或拥挤水域，OOW一定不能当作单一的瞭望人员。

4.0 航次计划概述 
General of Voyage Planning 
航次计划应始终遵守下列IMO公约的要求 
The requirements of following IMO conventions shall always be complied with: 
 SOLAS规则第五章第34条 
SOLAS REGULATION 34 
开航前，船长应确保预定的航次已考虑了本组织的指导及建议所涉及的该区域合适的
海图和航海出版物。（参考已被本组织 893（21）号决议采纳的航次计划指导） 
Prior to proceeding to sea, the master shall ensure that the intended voyage has been planned using the 
appropriate nautical charts and nautical publications for the area concerned, taking into account the 
guidelines and recommended by the Organization. (Refer to the Guidelines for Voyage Planning adopted 
by the Organization by resolution A. 893(21)) 
 IX/1 所定义的操作船舶的船东、租船人或者公司应不妨碍或限制船长根据其职业判断
力在安全航行和保护海洋环境方面所做出的或执行的任何决定。 
"The owner, the charterer or the company, as defined in regulation IX/1, operating the ship or any other 
person shall not prevent or restrict the master of the ship from taking or executing any decision which, in 
the master’s professional judgement, is necessary for safe navigation and protection of the marine 
environment." 
 并且, 对预定的航次应在考虑所有相关信息的基础上提前做出计划，在航次开始前应核
实已设计好的航线(STCW’95, A-VIII/2 Rule-3) 
And, the intended voyage shall be planned in advance, taking into consideration all pertinent information, 
and any course laid down shall be checked before the voyage commences. (STCW’95, A-VIII/2 Rule-3) 
 燃料、淡水、滑油、化学品、消耗品及备件、工具、补给和其它需求，轮机长应与船
长磋商一致对预定的航次所需提前做出决定(STCW’95, A-VIII/2 Rule-4) 
The chief engineer officer shall, in consultation with the master, determine in advance the needs of the 
intended voyage, taking into consideration the requirements for fuel, water, lubricants, chemicals, 
expendable and other spare parts, tools, supplies and any other requirements. (STCW’95, A-VIII/2 Rule-4) 
4.1 航线的设计原则 
Principles of the Passage Planning 
4.1.1 航线设计有四个明确的阶段并借此构建安全航次。 
There are four distinct stages in the planning and achievement of a safe passage: 
1) 评估 
Appraisal 
2) 规划 
Planning 
3) 执行 
Execution 
4) 监控 
Monitoring 
以上各阶段都应遵守，在草拟具体设计前必须对得到的航次信息进行审核，设计必须
先存在然后才能决定策划其执行。一旦设计及其执行的方式确定下来，接下来就要对
计划的实施进行跟踪。航线复查能验证航次计划的适用性、有效性、符合性，不断改
进和完善航次计划。 
The order of stages shall be followed an appraisal of information available must be made before detailed

plans can be drawn up and a plan must be in existence before tactics for its execution can be decided upon. 
Once the plan and the manner in which it is to be executed have been decided, monitoring must be carried 
out to ensure that the plan is followed. The route review can verify the applicability, effectiveness, and 
compliance of the passage plan, to continuously improve and perfect the passage plan. 
4.1.2 以下因素应在航线设计中考虑 
Following factors shall be considered in planning passage: 
1) 包括PSSA(特别敏感海域)的海上环境 
The marine environment including PSSA (particular sensitive sea areas) 
2) 沿着航线海图上的水文资料是否足够并可靠 
The adequacy and reliability of charted hydrographic data along the route; 
3) 沿着航线用于定位的航标、岸标、灯标及雷达显著目标的可利用性及可靠性。 
The availability and reliability of navigation aids, coastal marks, lights, and radar conspicuous targets 
for fixing the ship along the route; 
4) 诸如吃水、货物类别等由船舶引起的任何航线限制 
Any routing constraints imposed by the ship e.g. draught, type of cargo; 
5) 通航密集区 
Areas of high traffic density; 
6) 天气预报及预期的潮流、潮水、风、涌及能见度的情况 
Weather forecasts and expected current, tidal, wind, swell and visibility conditions; 
7) 可能出现陆地设施的区域 
Areas where onshore set could occur; 
8) 船舶操作可能需要额外的海域，如：洗舱 
Ship operations that may require additional sea room e.g. tank cleaning 
9) 例如船舶定线制及船位报告之类的规定 
Regulations such as ships’ routing schemes and ship reporting systems; 
10) 船上推进和操纵系统的可靠度 
Reliability of the propulsion and steering systems on board. 
5.0 航行安全的要素和定义   
Key elements of the voyage plan and its definition 
5.1 静态UKC：在船舶对水速度为 0 时船底与海床之间的垂向间距。是早年航海使用纸质
海图水深信息估算富余水深的方法。 
Static UKC: It is vertical space between ship’s bottom and seabed with ship’s speed through the water = 0 
knots. It is a method of estimating the under-keel clearance by using the water depth information of paper 
charts in the early years. 
5.2 动态UKC：在船舶对水速度大于 0 时船底与海床之间的垂向间距，它是在考虑包括船
舶下沉、风浪涌天气影响、转向倾等动态因素影响后的UKC剩余量。 
Dynamic UKC: It is vertical space between ship’s bottom and seabed with ship’s speed through the 
water > 0 knots. It’s the residual UKC after accounting for dynamic factors. Dynamic factors include squat, 
motion due to wind, wave and swell, heel experienced in a turn etc. 
5.3 开阔/深海水域：由船长来判断该区域是大洋区域还是封闭水域。根据经验，距离陆地
50 海里以上、水深超过50 米的区域将被视为开阔/深海水域。船舶应远离局部浅水区
域，并尽可能停留在水深超过50 米以上的水域。 
Open / Deep Sea: The Master would be the one to judge if the area is an Ocean area or Confined Waters. 
As a thumb rule, areas which are more than 50 nautical Miles from land and with a depth in excess of 50m 
would be considered as Open / Deep Sea. Vessel shall keep clear of localized shallow areas and as far as 
possible stay in depths over 50 m.

5.4 水深受限水域(港外)：水深受限水域是指除开阔水域以外的任何区域，通常距陆地线20
海里以内(这是近岸浅水区，不包括航道和码头)，在这些水域中，船舶在考虑到可能存
在的动态因素后，最小UKC 应为最深静态吃水的20%。 
Confined Waters (Outside port Limit): Confined waters shall mean any water other than open sea, 
generally closer than 20 miles to the grounding line. (This is the coastal shallow water outside port limit 
excluding Channels, Fairways and alongside a terminal) In these waters, the vessel shall maintain a 
minimum dynamic UKC of 20% of the current deepest static draft, after taking into account applicable 
dynamic factors. 
5.5 港内水域（在航）：指一般属于港务局管辖并积极管理的水域，包括航道、河流。在
这些水域中，船舶在考虑到可能存在的动态因素后，最小UKC 应为最深静态吃水的10% 
Waters within Port limit (While Underway): This shall mean those areas that are generally within the 
jurisdiction of a port authority, and actively managed, including dredging which includes Waterways, 
Rivers, Channels, Fairways. 
In these waters, the vessel shall maintain a minimum dynamic UKC of 10% of the current deepest static 
draft, after taking into account applicable dynamic factors. 
5.6 通航密集水域，指交通繁忙水域、渔船密集区、水产养殖区及附近，其他通航密度高
的水域，以及以下情况的操纵受限水域。 
Heavy traffic areas include the high density traffic area、fishing vessels concentration area、mariculture 
area, and other high navigational intensity areas, and the following restricted waters with limited 
manoeuvring room. other high density traffic areas; 
操纵受限水域包括但不限于： 
Restricted waters with limited manoeuvring room include but are not limited to: 
1) 港口的到达和离开 
Port arrival and departure 
2) 锚地的到达和离开 
Anchorages arrival and departure 
3) 船到船操纵的作业（包括驳船到大船的并靠作业时，接收物料/供应等） 
Ship to ship manoeuvring operations (which includes barge to ship alongside operations, picking up 
stores/supply etc.) 
4) 靠泊和拖轮操纵作业 
Mooring and tug handling operations 
5) 引水登船和离船 
Pilot boarding and disembarkation 
6) 分道通航制 
Traffic Separation Scheme 
7) 高船舶聚集区，穿越航道和港外锚地 
High traffic density area, fairway, and roadstead transit 
8) 穿越渔区和养殖区 
Transit fishing vessels concentration area、mariculture area, and other high density traffic areas; 
 
  说明：通航密集水域航行注意事项，包括操纵受限水域，可以参考本章第10节。 
The navigation precautions of heavy traffic areas and restricted waters with limited manoeuvring room 
can be reference SHIP-05-10. 
5.7 分道通航和狭水道应遵守《1972 年国际海上避碰规则》的规定。 
Traffic separation schemes and narrow channel should strictly abide by the provisions of "International 
Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea".

5.8 CATZOC ：电子海图精度  
Category of Zone of Confidence  
5.8.1 
电子海图精度的值，用以表示海图范围内，海图数据在位置准确度、深度精度和海
底信息覆盖范围的最低标准。置信值取决于测量的位置精度和深度精度。 
Category Zone of Confidence (CATZOC) values are assigned to geographical areas to indicate whether 
data meets a minimum set of criteria for position, depth accuracy and seafloor coverage. The Zone of 
Confidence (ZOC) value is dependent on the positional and depth accuracy of the survey.  
5.8.2 
ZOC分类反映了一个图纸的标准而不只是简单的水域调查标准。ZOC每一个分类中
深度和位置的准确度也显示了最终测深中遇到的误差，不仅仅是勘探过程，也包括在
图纸发型过程中发生的误差和变化。因此，ZOC是航海图纸中用以检查测深数据准确
度的一个系统。这一系统允许的海道测量机构的对五类（ZOC A1，A2，B，C，和D），
也包括未被评估的第六类（U）数据的解读和验证。分类的评估标准基于三大因素（位
置准确度，深度的准确度，以及海底层的覆盖情况）。 
The ZOC categories reflect a charting standard and not just a hydrographic survey standard. Depth and 
position accuracies specified for each ZOC category refer to the errors of the final depicted soundings and 
include not only survey errors but also other errors introduced in the chart production process. 
Consequently, the ZOC is a system used to portray the quality of bathymetric data contained in 
Navigational Charts. A ZOC system allows a hydrographic authority to encode depth position data against 
five categories (ZOC A1, A2, B, C, and D) with a sixth category (U) for data that has not been assessed. 
The assignment of category is based on three factors (position accuracy, depth accuracy and sea floor 
coverage). 
5.8.3 
详细的说明可参考航海员手册。 
Other explanations refer to the Master's Handbook 
5.9  下沉量 SQUAT  
下沉量一般表明船舶垂向位置在航行和停泊之间差异。 
Squat is the name generally applied to the difference between the vertical position of the vessel 
moving and stopped. 
5.10 
施舵点 WHEEL OVER POSITION 
1) 施舵点应根据船舶操纵数据确定， 
Wheel over positions should be determined from the ship’s manoeuvring data.  
首先船长要根据船舶操纵特征和可利用的空间确定旋回需要的半径。 
First the Master of the vessel has to decide the radius of turn required, depending on the 
manoeuvring characteristics of the vessel & available sea room. 
2) 应选择适当的视觉及雷达标绘判断船舶到达施舵点的时机。对于大的航向改变,最好
的提示包括可用平行于新航向的平行避险线或视觉方位线，而对于小的改变，正横
的方位往往更好。即使在引水引航时，施舵点也应标示在海图上，这样值班驾驶员
将意识到其紧迫性和重要性，这也是船舶驾驶员监督引水的一部分。 
Suitable visual & radar cues should be chosen to determine when the ship is at the wheel over 
position. The best cues for large alterations of course consist of Parallel Indexes or visual bearings 
parallel to the new track, whereas for small alterations a near beam bearing is often better. Even when 
the pilot has the con the wheel over position should be shown on the chart so that the OOW wi.ll be 
aware of its imminence & importance. It is also part of the ship’s officer’s monitoring of the pilot. 
3) 驾驶员应根据不同水域的操纵性能，应用施舵点和旋回参数，合理施舵，使船舶走
在计划航线上。 
The OOW should put into the wheel over position and parameter of turn and intelligent use steering 
combined with the ship's maneuverability, let the vessel sailing on ship route.

5.11 
空高&净空高度  
Air Draft & Overhead Clearance 
5.11.1 在很多情况下，船舶可能需要从大桥、架空电缆下通过或工作在龙门起重机下。 
On many occasions, vessels would need to pass under bridges, overhead cables or working under 
gantry. 
5.11.2 净空高度用来计算船舶通过上方物标时的顶净空。净空高度是船舶的最高点与任何
桥梁、电缆或其他架空障碍物的最低点之间的差值。 
The overhead clearance is calculated for each overhead object the mariner plans to pass under with the 
vessel. The overhead clearance is the difference between the highest point of the ship and the lowest 
point of any bridge, cable, or other overhead obstruction. 
5.11.3 潮高和潮涌应预留余量。如果桥梁的最大间隙仅在中心线，则应考虑到船舶的转向
性能和漂移角度。 
Allowance should be made for tidal height and swell. In case of bridges with a maximum clearance in 
the center line only, allowance should be made for the ship’s steering performance and drift angle. 
5.11.4 许多悬挂式桥梁在狭窄的部分上有最高点。在这种情况下，船只必须以最高点（通
常是主桅杆）通过，位于这一狭窄的间隙。因此，船员将需要评估船舶的转向性能。
Many bridges of the suspension type have the highest point in a narrow section. In such cases the ship 
is required to pass with the highest point (normally the main mast) positioned in this narrow gap. The 
crew will, therefore, need to assess the ship’s steering performance. 
5.11.5  净空高度&垂直间隙政策 
Policy of Air Draft & Overhead Clearance 
5.11.5.1 船长要确保船舶在航行的各个阶段，在高架结构下通过时有足够的高空间隙。 
The Master is to ensure that the vessel has adequate overhead clearance at all stages of the voyage 
while transiting under overhead structures. 
5.11.5.2 安全净空高度一般可以从海图、航路指南和地方当局获得，如果无法获得，公司政
策如下： 
在综合考虑上述多种不利因素的影响下，通过大桥时最低垂直间隙不得小于1米，
通过电缆时最低垂直间隙不得小于2米。 
Safe clearances can generally be obtained from charts, sailing directions, and local authorities or, if 
this is not possible, the company policy is as follows. 
The minimum vertical clearance shall not be less than 1 meter when passing through a bridge and 2 
meters when passing through a power cable, taking into account the effects of the various adverse 
factors mentioned above. 
5.11.5.3 龙骨到桅杆的高度可以从船舶的图纸中获得；但应考虑到任何架设在上面的天线，
而这些天线没有包括在图纸中。 
The keel-to-mast height is available from the vessel's drawings; but account should be taken of any 
antennas that have been erected on top, and which have not been included in the drawing. 
5.11.5.4 净空高度应在航行开始前计算，以确保船舶在整个航程中符合上述要求。计算中使
用的船舶吃水是指与船尾桅杆位置相对应的框架处的吃水。应该认识到，对于尾倾
的船舶，船尾垂直方向的吃水将大于船尾桅杆位置的吃水。这意味着，如果使用船
尾垂直方向的吃水来计算船尾桅杆的净空，那么该船实际上会比计算的净空要小。 
Air draft shall be calculated prior commencement of voyage to ensure vessel meets the above 
requirement throughout the passage. The vessel's draft that is used in the calculation is to be the 
draft at the frame that corresponds to the position of the aft mast. It should be recognized that for a 
vessel trimmed by the stern, the draft at the aft perpendicular will be greater than that at location of 
the aft mast. This implies that if the draft at the aft perpendicular was used in the calculation of

在可行的情况下，船舶在运输过程中应保持直立，以避免在计算吃水和架空净空时出现错误。 
Where practicable vessels should be upright during the transit to avoid errors in the calculation of 
the draft and the overhead clearance. 
5.11.5.5 在计算垂直净空时，不应考虑下沉量。 
Squat should not be considered while calculating vertical clearance. 
5.11.5.6 计算垂直间隙时，应使用提供的垂直间隙计算表。 
Overhead Clearance calculation sheet as provided shall be used for the calculation of overhead

6.0 航次计划的编制 
Establishment of the Passage Plan 
6.1 在船长的指导下，二副负责完成航次计划的编制。 
Under the guidance of the master, the second officer is responsible for completing the development of the 
passage plan. 
6.2 完整的航次计划应包括如下四部分： 
A complete passage plan consists of the following 4 parts: 
第一部分：航次概要（PART I: Brief Information of the Voyage）； 
第二部分：离港信息（PART II : Information of Departure）； 
第三部分：海上航行信息（PARTIII: Information of Sea Passage）； 
第四部分：靠泊信息（PARTIV: Information of Berthing）. 
6.3 二副应及时将填妥的航次计划交由船长审核签批，船长应在航前会上向驾驶员、轮机
长介绍航次计划并付诸实施，所有驾驶员应在对航次计划的内容完全了解后签字。 
The second officer should promptly submit the completed passage plan to the master for approval. The 
master shall introduce and implement the passage plan to the OOW and chief engineer at the pre-departure 
meeting, all OOW should fully understanding the passage plan and sign.  
6.4 制定完成的每一份航次计划“Passage Plan”均须保留在驾驶台。 
Every completed “Passage Plan” should be kept at the bridge. 
6.5 如果在航行期间，改变下一港口或者其他原因需要大幅度偏离原航线，应该偏离行动
前制定出修改的航线。航次计划的修改应该是正式文件，航次计划表中应有该改变的
记录。 
If the ship changes in sailing route, duo the next port changed, or deviated her ship route in any other 
reasons. The amended plan wants be made before take deviate action. The amendment to the passage plan 
should be officially documented and specific changes recorded on the passage plan form。 
7.0 航线设计 
Route Planning 
7.1 船舶富余水深的确定原则 
Principle for determining under-keel clearance 
7.1.1 富余水深要求适用于航行、锚泊、在港的所有营运状态。在考虑富余水深和设定安全
水深时，要注意以下因素 : 船舶颠簸、摇摆而产生的船舶吃水的变化；海图水深的精
度；气象、海况情况；海水比重、底质、海底障碍物；船舶航行时的船体下沉。 
The under-keel clearance is suitable for sailing、anchoring and berthing at all times while the ship is in 
service. When determining under-keel clearance and setting the safety depth, the following factors 
should be considered: the change of draft during heel and rolling; the accuracy of the chart depth; 
meteorological and sea conditions; density of seawater, bottom sediment, underwater obstructions; hull 
sinking when sailing. 
 

333

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd   Effective Date: 2024/06/05          Page: 19/27 
 
7.1.2 富余水深的方针： 
The policy of under-keel clearance: 
● 外海航道不小于船舶静态最大吃水的20%； 
Open-sea channel is not less than 20% of the static maximum draft of the ship; 
● 港内航道及遮蔽性良好的狭水道不小于船舶静态最大吃水的10%； 
In-port channel and well sheltered narrow channel is not less than 10% of the static maximum draft 
of the ship; 
● 港池内不小于0.6 米； 
Basin is not less than 0.6 meter; 
● 某个特定水域和/或港口对富余水深有特殊要求时，遵守其规定。 
The special regulation shall be applied, if there is a special regulation on under-keel clearance for 
certain water and/or port. 
7.1.3 进一步评估计算。为确保安全，需要进一步详细计算是否可以通过时，根据行业规范，
精确的计算船体下沉量、海浪、海图水深精度等船舶状态、环境因素、航行因素的影
响，船长评估影响UKC 的其他因素，再预留额外水深后，当确定海图水深大于等于安
全水深时，就可以安全通行。 
Further assessment and calculations, In order to ensure safety, it is necessary to further 
calculate in detail as to whether it is possible to pass. According to the industrial regulations, 
accurate calculation of the Squat, Sea/Waves, CATZOC, and other Factors effects of the 
ship's state, environmental factors, and navigational factors. The ship master should evaluate 
the scale of the impact on a case-by-case and decide on the value of “other factors”. When 
the charted depth is verified to be deeper than or equal to the safe depth, it is safe to pass 
through. 
7.1.4 船长应结合“富余水深核算表SHIP-05-01-02”，进行风险评估，并采取有效的措施。 
The shipmaster shall conduct risk assessment and take effective measures in conjunction with the "Rich 
Water Depth Accounting Sheet SHIP-05-01-02". 
7.1.5 “富余水深核算表”适用于计算水深小于两倍静态吃水的水域的动态富余水深。二副
应将富余水深的校核结果、拟采取的降速或候潮等措施填入相应的转向点备注栏中。
如航经水域存在多个浅点，则应选择最浅点进行核算，各航段的浅点应分别计算。  
The “under-keel clearance calculation form” is suitable for the dynamic rich water depth calculation where 
the water depth is less than twice of static draught. the second officer should fill the review result, 
measures planned such as slowing down speed, or waiting for tide in the relevant turning point remarks in 
passage plan. If there are more than one shallow spots, calculate separately. Also, the shallow spot of each 
leg should be calculated separately  
7.2 船长应综合考虑本船的实际状况和外部条件，预先制定相应的保证船舶安全的措施；在
港方给出最小富余水深或最大许可航吃水的情况下，应根据航道（泊位、锚位）水深及
潮汐计算出允许的通过时间。 
The master should consider the actual ship and external condition to plan measures for safe of the ship in 
advance; if the port provides the minimum under-keel clearance or maximum allowable draft, calculate the 
allowable passage time according to the channel (or berth/anchor position) water depth and tide. 
7.3 二副应在离港前，根据船舶吃水、预计航速、下沉量、富余水深要求等编制船舶航经水
域所需最小海图水深一览表，并张贴在海图室显而易见处，此表也应标识出电子海图的
水深设置； 
Before the departure, the second officer should make a form of the minimum water depth sea chart depth of 
the sailing area according to ship draft, planned speed, ship squat and under-keel clearance, and post it at 
visible places in the chart room, This form should also remark the depth settings of the ECDIS;

7.4 应将空载和重载状态下的“船体下沉量（SQUAT）表”张贴在驾驶台显而易见处以便随
时查取。 
Post the ship “SQUAT form” for both no load and heavy load at visible places at the bridge for convenience 
reference. 
船体下沉量计算公式： 
Ship squat calculation equation: 
 浅水、狭窄水域航行: S=Cb×(V2/50) 
Sailing in shallow or narrow water areas: S=Cb×(V2/50) 
 开敞水域航行：S=Cb×(V2/100) 
Sailing in open water areas: S=Cb×(V2/100) 
Cb 即方型系数=型排水体积VOL/(对应的水线长L×中横剖面处的水线宽B×吃水d) 
Cb = square coefficient=molded volume VOL/( waterline length L×midship section waterline breadth 
B×draft d) 
V 即船速, Velocity of the ship 
7.5 航线设计要以确保船舶安全为基本原则，在此基础上尽量缩短船舶的航行时间。 
Route plan should first ensure the safety of the ship, on this basis, shorten the sailing time as much as 
possible. 
7.6 通过查阅航路设计图、世界大洋航路、航路指南、潮流表、潮汐表以及推荐航法等相关
资料，充分考虑船舶稳性、强度、吃水、富余水深、通航密度、能见度、航经海区的季
节气候、风浪和可能遭遇的恶劣天气、设备的工作状况、可供使用的避风处所等因素后
确定船舶航线。如条件许可，应尽可能采用传统航线。 
By referring to sailing route plan chart, ocean passage for the world, sailing directions, tidal current table 
and recommended navigation, etc., taking full consideration of factors such as stability, strength, draft, 
under-keel clearance, traffic density, visibility, climate of the water area, wind and encounter possibly 
severe condition of the weather or equipment, and possible shelters, to determine the the sailing route of 
the ship. Where possible, traditional routes should be used wherever possible. 
7.7 航线设计应包括航行的整个过程（出发港泊位到引水站与目的港引水站到泊位的转向点
也要列明）。 
Route plan should cover the entire voyage, including the turning point of sailing from berth to pilot station 
at the port of departure, as well as that from pilot station to berth at the port of destination. 
7.8 如果离港时仍不知下一港口及泊位，航线计划可由出发港泊位开始分段拟定，待有确定
的港口和泊位后，及时修改和补充最后一段的航线计划，以满足“BERTH TO BERTH”
的要求。 
If the next port and berth is still unknown on departure, route plan should be made by section starting from 
berth of the port of departure, timely change and supplement route plan of the last leg when the port of 
destination and berth is confirmed, to meet the “berth to berth” requirement. 
7.9 绘制航线应先在总图上画出全段航线，再在航行用图上画出分段航线，不可将前后两张
海图叠画航线;航线衔接点应以经纬度或显著目标的方位、距离进行校对。每张海图的航
线两端必须标明衔接海图的图号，并按使用的先后次序在背面编写序号。 
The whole navigation route should be drawn on the general chart, with detailed route by section on the 
navigational chart. Should not stack two charts together and extend the the course line. Route junction 
point should be checked with latitude and longitude or azimuth and distance of significant target. Both 
ends of the route on the sea chart must be marked with the chart number of linked charts, and write the 
serial number on the back in the correct order. 
7.10 特别注意航线附近的浅点、浅水区域、碍航物。 
Pay special attention to shallow points, shallow water area and obstructions near the sailing route.

8 航次计划的报告 
Passage plan Report 
8.1 船舶开航前船长负责把本航次的航次计划（Passage Plan）用电子邮件或传真发送给公司

The master is responsible for sending the Passage Plan via email or fax to the marine department of the

8.2 当船舶更改航线计划时，应及时电告公司海务部，并陈述更改原因。

reason for change.

Instruction for Passage plan 
9.1 使用英文填写； 
Complete in English; 
9.2 在开航前完成计划的第一、二、三部分并及时报公司海务部；当得到下一港的泊位信息
和靠泊计划后，应立即完成第四部分,并把本航次完整的航次计划再次发送至公司海务

Complete the first three parts of the plan before departure, and report to marine department of the

Instructions for Voyage Outline 
9.3.1 如船舶装运了危险货物，则应把货物种类、联合国编号（UN NO.）及装载位置填入

If the ship carries dangerous cargo, fill in cargo type, UN NO. and stowage location in the corresponding 
column; if not, fill in the word “N/A” in the corresponding column of PART I. 
9.3.2 如船舶需进行更换压载水的操作，应把拟更换压载水的海域名称和范围（在航线附近，

9.4 离港信息及靠泊信息的相关栏目的填写 
Instructions for departure and berthing information 
9.4.1 航道和（或）泊位的最小水深 
Minimum water depth of channel and/or berth 
在航道和（或）泊位的最小海图水深与港方提供数字不一致时，以港方数字为准。 
If the minimum water depth of channel and/or berth is different from that provided by the port, subject to 
the number from the port. 
9.4.2 龙骨下富余水深（Under keel clearance）一栏的填写 
When filling in Under keel clearance: 
龙骨下富余水深= 航道（泊位/锚位）水深+进出港时的潮高- 船舶静态最大吃水- 下沉
量 
Under keel clearance = water depth of channel/berth/anchor position + height of the tide when entry/exit 
the port – static max. draft of the ship - ship squat 
9.4.3 将富余水深与最大吃水的比值填入“Ratio of Min.UKC to Max. Draft”一栏中。 
Fill in the ratio between under keel clearance and max. draft in “Ratio of Min.UKC to Max. Draft”.预计
最大船速（Estimated Max. Speed）栏 
When filling in Estimated Max. Speed: 
船长应综合考虑港口的特殊规定、流向及流速、浅水效应、航道水深、下沉量等对船
速产生影响的诸多因素后确定本船进出港期间的预计最大航速。 
The master should take into account various factors such as special regulations of the port, current 
direction and velocity, shallow water effect, water depth of the channel, ship squat, etc. that affects the 
ship speed, and determine the maximum speed for entry and departure. 
9.4.4 应将完成第四部分的日期填入靠泊信息的报告日期栏中（Report Date）,无需对航次概

活污水、垃圾、废气对环境造成污染的措施；

Contents to be filled in “Remark” column in the “Information of Way Point”: 
为达到提醒的目的，备注栏中应仅填入如下内容及船长指示填入的内容，在没有特别

shall be filled in “Remark” column. If there is no such matter that requires special attention, the “Remark”

Under keel clearance calculation and measures to be taken when passing through shallow water area.

Route validation 
船长需检查安全设置，检查航次计划和富余水深计算，检查图书资料的配备，检查海图
作业，并通过电子海图的航线检查功能审核航线数据，确认航次计划满足安全航行、防
污染、能效等管理要求后，确认可以执行。 
The master should check the safety settings of the passage plan, check the passage plan documents and the

11 执行 
Exaction 
11.1 一旦航线设计完成，驾驶台团队人员应与船长一道开会并讨论执行设计所使用的策略。
当时间或环境不允许核对和讨论整个设计时，团队人员可只讨论马上要执行的部分，完
成核对程序在随后的第一时间内进行。 
Once the passage has been planned, the Bridge team will meet and discuss the tactics to be used in the 
execution of the plan with the Master, An entry to this effect is to be made into the Deck Logbook. Where 
time or circumstances do not permit verification and discussion of the entire plan, the team may discuss 
the immediate stage of the plan and complete the verification process at the first opportunity thereafter. 
11.2 需考虑的因素应包括： 
The factors to be taken into account will include: 
1)船舶航行设备的可靠性和现状； 
The reliability and condition of the vessel's navigational equipment; 
2) 预计抵达重要地点时的潮高和潮流； 
Estimated times of arrival at critical points for the tidal heights and flow; 
3) 气象条件，特别是已知的地区时常发生能见度不良的时期。 
Meteorological conditions, particularly in areas known to be affected by frequent periods of restricted 
visibility; 
4) 白天还是夜间通过危险地点；在定位精度上可能有一些影响；以及 
Daytime versus night-time passing of danger points, and any effect this may have upon position fixing 
accuracy, and 
5) 交通状况，特别是夜晚 
Traffic conditions, especially at night 
12 验证和监控 
Verification and Monitoring 
12.1 紧密和连续的跟踪船舶沿预定设计的航迹行进是安全实施航线的本质。如果值班驾驶
员任何时候对船位或航线的执行方式有任何怀疑，他应立即叫船长，如果需要还应为船
舶安全采取的适当行动。 
The close and continuous monitoring of the ship's progress along the pre-planned track is essential for the 
safe conduct of the passage. If the Officer on the watch is ever in any doubt as to the position of the ship 
or the manner in which the passage is proceeding, he should immediately call the Master and, if necessary, 
take appropriate action for the safety of the ship. 
12.2 开航前、进入限制或危险水域前，以及在航线的其它时间应有规律以频繁的时间间隔
对船舶航行设备的性能技能核实。船上安装的所有船位跟踪设备的优势应发挥，记住以
下各点： 
The performance of navigational equipment should be checked prior to sailing, prior to entering restricted 
or hazardous waters and at regular and frequent intervals at other times throughout the passage. Advantage 
should be taken of all the navigational equipment with which the ship is fitted for position monitoring, 
bearing in mind the following points: 
1) 应结合各种技术，进行船位验证，包括雷达图像叠、位置线LOP、雷达/目视定位、
平行避险线和天体导航等等。 
A combination of techniques should be used, including：Radar overlays(), line of position()LOP,

radar/visual fixes, parallel indexing and celestial navigation, etc. 
2) 单纯地依赖单一的定位系统给出的船位是危险的。 
It is dangerous to rely solely on the output from a single positioning system; 
3) 在相互校验时，使用的数据应基于不同的系统 
When cross-checking, use systems which are based on different data. 
4) 测深仪提供一种在标绘深度的位置上有价值的测深核对 
The echo sounder provides a valuable check of depth at the plotted position; 
5) 浮标不能用于定位，但在岸标视觉辨别困难时也可作为指导利用；在这些情况下船
位应首先利用其它独立的方法确定。 
Buoys should not be used for position fixing but may be used for guidance when shore marks are 
difficult to distinguish visually; in these circumstances their positions should first be ascertained by 
other independent means; 
6) 使用仪器的功能及正确的读数方法应核实 
The functioning and correct reading of the instruments used should be checked; 
7) 一定要采取措施消除电子定位系统显示船位的系统误差及预知的精确度。 
Account must be taken of any system errors and the predicted accuracy of positions displayed by 
electronic position fixing systems; 
8) 每段航程定位的频度应提前决定。 
Decision in advance, as to the frequency with which the position is to be fixed, should be made for 
each section of the passage. 
9) 一人开始值班时推算出一个班结束时的船位是一个良好的实践，接下来核实航向、
测深、危险物和禁止进入区域周围的水深、施舵点等等。证实一切正常。 
At the start of one’s watch it is good practice to project where vessel will be at the end of watch and 
to then carefully check course(s), sounding depths, surrounding dangers and no-go areas, wheel over 
positions, etc. and confirm all is in order). 
13  记录 
Record 
船长需组织驾驶员记录有关航行的活动和事件，记录涉及货运租船的事项，以及重要
的时间节点，确保该记录足以恢复的对航行安全有重要影响的活动和事件，该航次的
一份完整记录。该记录以航海日志为主。 
The master should organize the officers to record navigational activities and incidents in voyager, record 
the events related to cargo shipping and ship chartering, record the important timings, which must contain 
sufficient detail to restore a complete record of the voyage. The content of record is mostly recorded in the 
ship`s logbook. 
14  航线复查 
Route Review 
船长需组织驾驶员进行航路验证和复查，以便将发现的任何危险或有用的信息纳入以
后的航次计划中。可通过电子海图的航迹和历史回放功能分海域的进行。 
The master should organize the officers to validate and review the ship routing, so that any hazards or 
useful information discovered can be incorporated into future passage plans. It can be carried out in each 
sea area through the track and history playback function of ECDIS. 
15  航次风险评估  
Voyage Risk Assessment 
总有危险伴随着每个航次，船长有责任评估这些危险并依此做出规划。 
这些危险举例如下： 
There is always a risk attached to every voyage and it is the responsibility of the Master to assess the same

定谨慎的决策，应做较详细的评估。如果可能出现风力增大、走锚风险，应纳入风
险评估，如果预先指定制定锚地不合适是也应准备替代锚地。 
A detailed risk assessment of the anchoring operation should be carried out to formulate an effective 
plan and to make prudent decisions when facing emergencies. If you expect wind force to increase, 
the possibilities of anchor dragging must be part of the risk assessment. An alternative anchorage 
should also be prepared if the initial selected anchoring position is unavailable. 
7）经过海盗高风险区等 
Passing the heavy risk area of pirate, etc.

不可接受就应采取合适的措施来降低风险到可以接受的水平。 
The Risk assessment prepared by vessel to be sent to Marine Department for review to establish that 
risk is acceptable. If the Risk is not acceptable appropriate measures shall be taken to reduce Risk to 
acceptable level.

such as robbery, assassination, smuggling or missing person, report to the company 
immediately and follow the company instructions.

damage, cargo damage, work-related injury, and serious illness of the crew, etc., and 
proceed according to related procedures.

department and person responsible, enhance monitoring the ship and record it in the log.

Weather: Blue, Overcast, Cloudy, Rain, Fog, Snow. 
i.  风向/风力：风向用英文缩写代码，风力用蒲氏风级表。 
Wind direction and force: direction is represented by English abbr. and force is measured through 
Beaufort Wind Scale. 
j. 浪级：浪级，涌级均用高度单位米表示，一般二者只用其一（浪、涌方向不同时，可
两项全报）。 

358

船舶动态报告实施细则                      版本/修改：   3.0/6.0                          SHIP-05-02 
Implementation Details of Ship Status Report     Version/Revision: 3.0/6.0                           SHIP-05-02 
 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2025/12/10         第17/18页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2025/12/10           Page: 17/18 
Wave: Wave and swell are measured in meters, usually adopt one of the two (if wave and surge are 
of different directions, report them both). 
k. 锚地：用锚地名称或用经纬度表示。 
Anchorage: represented by anchorage name or latitude/longitude. 
l. 锚链节数：P-左锚，S-右锚，例如：P05 表示左锚5 节。 
Shackles of Anchor Chains: P- port anchor, S- starboard anchor, eg.: P05 stands for 5 shackles in 
port anchor. 
m. 特殊情况：用文字表示。 
Special Circumstances: described in text. 
n. 航行总时间：以小时为单位，保留一位小数。 
Total Sailing Time: measured in hour, with one decimal. 
o. 船舶航行里程：以海里为单位，保留整数。 
Ship Mileage: measured in n mile, integer. 
p. 船舶预抵报的抵港地点：以目的港检疫锚地或引水站为准。 
Estimated Time of Arrival: according to quarantine anchorage or pilot station of the destination 
port. 
q. 货载、油、水采用公制吨为单位。货载，淡水存量保留整数，燃油数量保留一位小
数。 
Cargo, fuel and water are measured in metric ton. Cargo and fresh water are integers; fuel is 
described with one decimal. 
r. 吃水用四位数表示，前两位表示米，后两位表示厘米。 
Draft is described in four-digits, first two represents meter, the latter represents centimeter. 
s. 舱容和货物体积用立方米表示。 
Capacity and cargo volume are measured in m3. 
t. 燃油：燃油存量、消耗量、加油量如涉及高硫燃油和低硫燃油，则须分别列明。燃油
以公制吨为单位，保留一位小数。存油量应为包括死油数量在内的全部船存燃油。 
Fuel: fuel ROB, fuel consumption and refill should be clarified if high-sulfur or low-sulfur fuel is 
involved. Fuel is measured in metric ton, with one decimal. Fuel ROB refers to all fuel remain on 
board including dead oil. 
u. 离港报中“定速航行”以“COSP”表示。抵港报中“结束海上航行”以“EOSP”表
示。 
In departure report, “Commence of sea passage” is represented as “COSP”. In arrival report, “End 
of sea passage” is represented as “EOSP”. 
v. 计划/剩余航程以DTG 表示。 
Planned/Remaining Voyage is represented as DTG. 
w. ETA= 预计抵达时间，ETD= 预计离港时间，ETB= 预计靠泊时间，ETCL=           
预计装毕时间，ETCD=预计卸毕时间，ETS=预计续航时间，ETT=预计通过运河或海
峡时间。 
ETA=estimated time of arrival, ETD=estimated time of departure, ETB=estimated time of berthing, 
ETCL=estimated time of completion of loading, ETCD=estimated time of completion of 
discharging, ETS=estimated time of sailing, ETT=estimated time of Transit canal or channel 
7. 
其他说明Others 

359

船舶动态报告实施细则                      版本/修改：   3.0/6.0                          SHIP-05-02 
Implementation Details of Ship Status Report     Version/Revision: 3.0/6.0                           SHIP-05-02 
 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2025/12/10         第18/18页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2025/12/10           Page: 18/18 
7.1 
所有的船舶动态报告都需抄送值班室。All the Ship Status Report should be copied to 
WINCC.  
7.2 
当有物料备件供应时，预计抵离港时间需及时发送供应部，要求午报和预抵港报抄
送供应部。 
Before ship’s store and spare suppling, the ETA and ETD should be reported to the Purchasing 
Department, Request copy the Noon Report and Estimate Arrival Report to Purchasing Department. 
7.3 
船舶抵离港时间的计算，按照航次指令的要求进行计算，如果航次指令没有明确表
示起算时间则依据以下顺序进行计算： 
在锚地，以抛下第一锚的时间为抵港时间，收起最后一锚的时间为离港时间； 
如船舶直接进出港，以船舶抵达引水站、港界、港口锚地时间最早者为抵港时间; 
船舶靠泊时间以第一根缆绳上岸时间为准，离泊时间以解完最后一根缆绳为准。 
The arrival and departure time of the ship is calculated according to the requirements of voyage 
instructions. If no clear starting time is defined, calculate based on the following order: at anchorage, 
time of the first anchor drop is arrival time, the last weighing anchor time is departure time; if the ship 
enters/exit the port directly, the earliest among time arriving at pilot station, port boundary or anchorage 
is regarded as arrival time, berthing time is started as the first cable ashore, and departure time is when 
the last cable is casted off. 
7.4 
航次结束时间以该航次所有货物全部卸下的时刻为准，该时刻同时为下一航次的开
始时间。 
Voyage is considered completed when all the cargo is discharged, meanwhile, the time also represents 
the beginning of the next voyage. 
7.5 
在确保航行安全的前提下，所有的动态报文均应严格按照报告格式及时准确地发送
至公司。 
On the premise that the ship is sailing safely, all movement reports should be sent to company in the 
required format and accurately.

04_15_10.text:
航行制度                            版本/修改：3.0/1.0                 SHIP-05-03 
Navigation Regulations                       Version/Revision: 3.0/1.0                     SHIP-05-03 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                 生效日期：2022/03/06               第1/4页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd     Effective Date: 2022/03/06                   Page: 1/4 
第03 节 驾机联系制度 
Section 03  Bridge and engine room Communication Regulation 
 
1.0 开航前 
Before Sailing 
1.1 船长应提前24 小时将预计开航时间通知轮机长(如停靠时间少于24 小时，应在抵港后
立即通知轮机长预离时间)。轮机长应向船长报告开航准备情况, 如主要机电动力设备
的技术状态、燃、润油料和炉水的实际存量等。开航时间如有变化，船长应及时通知
更正。 
The master should inform the chief engineer of the estimated sailing time 24 hours in advance (if the 
docking time is less than 24 hours, the estimated departure time should be notified to the C/E immediately 
upon arrival). The C/E should report to the captain conditions of the sailing preparation, such as the 
technical status of the main electromechanical equipment, the actual stock of fuel, lubrication oil and 
boiler water. If the departure time changes, the master should promptly notify to make correction. 
1.2 机舱按船长通知的时间备妥主机。 
The engine room prepares the main engine according to the time notified by the master. 
1.3 开航前一小时，值班驾驶员会同值班轮机员核对船钟、车钟，试验并核对舵机及其传
动装置以及舵角指示器等。分别将情况记入航海日志、轮机日志。 
The deck officer on duty will check the clock and engine telegraph, test and examine the steering gear, 
transmission device and the rudder indicator together with the engineer on duty one hour before sailing. 
Keep the situation recorded in the deck logbook and engine logbook. 
1.4 值班驾驶员还应试验汽(电)笛、信号灯及航行灯；水手长应派人试验绞缆机。发现有
不正常情况，应立即通知机舱派人修复。 
Deck officer on duty should also check the Steam (electric) whistle, signal lights and navigation lights; 
the BSN should have someone test the winches. If there is any abnormality, notify the engine department 
immediately for repairs. 
1.5 主机盘车、冲车前，值班轮机员应先通知值班驾驶员，值班驾驶员在确认船尾无障碍
物后用电话通知机舱，方可进行。如主机经过检修须要试车也应遵守此规定。 
The engineer on duty may turn and blow the main engine after no obstruction on the stern confirmed by 
the deck officer on duty, If the main engine needs to be tested after maintenance, this requirement also 
applies. 
2.0 航行中 
During Voyage 
2.1 每班下班之前，值班轮机员应将主机平均转数和海水温度告知值班驾驶员记入航海日
志。 
Before duty shifts, the engineer on duty should inform the deck officer on duty of the average revolutions 
of the main engine and the sea water temperature for entering it in thedeck logbook. 
2.2 每日正午，驾驶台和机舱核对时钟并互换《中午报告》。 
Everyday at noon, bridge and engine room should check the clock with each other and exchange “noon 
report”. 
2.3 船舶进出港口或在狭窄水道、危险水域需要备车航行，驾驶台应提前一小时通知机舱
准备（若因遇雾或暴雨等突发情况，值班轮机员接到通知后应尽快备妥主机）。 
The main engine should been standby when the ship is entering/exiting the port, sailing in a narrow 
waterway or dangerous sea area, the bridge should inform the engine room of preparing main engine an 
hour in advance (in case of fog, heavy rain or other emergencies, the engineer on duty should get the main 

361

航行制度                            版本/修改：3.0/1.0                 SHIP-05-03 
Navigation Regulations                       Version/Revision: 3.0/1.0                     SHIP-05-03 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                 生效日期：2022/03/06               第2/4页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd     Effective Date: 2022/03/06                   Page: 2/4 
engine ready as soon as possible). 
2.4 如因等引航员、候潮、等泊位等各种原因需要短时间抛锚时，值班驾驶员应将情况及
时通知值班轮机员。 
If temporary anchor dropping is demanded due to waiting for pilots, tide, berth or other reasons, the deck 
officer on duty should notify the engineer in time. 
2.5 船舶备车航行时，主机一般按“港内车速”运转。驾驶台如因操纵或紧急避让需要加
速时，可将车钟再摇一次，机舱应尽快开足车速。 
When the ship sails with standby engine, the main engine normally runs at “harbour speed”. If the bridge 
needs to increase the speed due to operation or emergency, ring the telegraph again so that the engine 
room can reach full speed as soon as possible. 
2.6 船长决定定速航行时，值班驾驶员应先用电话通知值班轮机员，然后重复一下车钟。 
When the master decides on constant speed navigation, the deck officer on duty should first notify the 
engineer by telephone and repeat the telegraph. 
2.7 将有风暴来临时，船长应及时通知轮机长做好各种准备。为防止主机飞车须要减速时，
值班轮机员应先征得值班驾驶员的同意后方可减速。 
When storm coming, the master should inform the C/E of getting ready in time. If slowing down the 
speed is required in order to prevent the main engine from over speed, the engineer should first get 
consent from the deck officer before the slowdown. 
2.8 如因抢避台风或海上救助等紧急情况须要超过常速航行时，船长应与轮机长协商研究，
轮机长应在安全条件下开足主机最大转数。 
If the ship needs to sail over speed due to typhoons, maritime rescue or other emergencies, the master 
should consult with the C/E, C/E should operate the main engine to maximum revolution on the premise 
that the ship is safe. 
2.9 当机械发生故障不能执行航行指令时，值班轮机员应迅速通知驾驶台值班驾驶员；值
班驾驶员要速报船长；如须停车，一般应先征得船长同意，但是事态危急，不停车将
会导致威胁主机或人身安全时，值班轮机员可以立即停车并同时通知轮机长、驾驶台。
在采取这个措施时必须十分慎重，以免发生更加严重的恶性事故。值班驾驶员和值班
轮机员应将故障发生和排除的时间及情况记入航海日志和轮机日志。 
In case of mechanical failure, where navigation instructions can not be executed, the engineer on duty 
should notify the deck officer on duty at the bridge; the deck officer should report to the master 
immediately; if engine needs to be stopped, generally consent from the master is required; however, if the 
situation is critical, further delay may pose threat to the main engine or crew, the engineer on duty can 
immediately shut down the engine and at the same time inform the C/E and bridge. This measure must be 
taken very carefully and seriously to avoid more serious vicious incident. Deck officer and engineer on 
duty should record the time and condition of the occurrence and elimination of the malfunction into the 
deck logbook and engine logbook. 
3.0 停泊中 
Mooring 
3.1 抵港后，船长应将预计的本船动态告知轮机长，以便安排工作。其后，动态若有变化
均应及时联系。 
Upon arrival, the master should inform the C/E of the expected status in order to make arrangements. 
After that, any status change should be timely updated. 
3.2 机舱若需要检修动力或系泊设备，轮机长应事先将工作内容和所需要时间报告船长，
取得同意后才可进行。 
If the engine room needs to examine and repair the power or mooring equipment, the C/E should report 
the work and time required to the master beforehand. 
3.3 如需使用本船装卸设备，值班驾驶员应将开工的舱口和工班数提前通知当值轮机员，

362

航行制度                            版本/修改：3.0/1.0                 SHIP-05-03 
Navigation Regulations                       Version/Revision: 3.0/1.0                     SHIP-05-03 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                 生效日期：2022/03/06               第3/4页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd     Effective Date: 2022/03/06                   Page: 3/4 
以保证安全供电。装卸特种危险品或使用重吊之前，大副应通知轮机长派人检查起货
机，在装卸过程或重吊使用过程中轮机长还应派人值守，以保证安全运转。 
If cargo handling equipment from the ship is required, the deck officer on duty should inform the engineer 
on duty of the hatchway number and shifts in advance for ensuring safe electricity supply. Before loading 
and unloading special dangerous goods or using heavy lift, C/O should inform the C/E of having the 
cargo crane examined. During the loading and unloading process or using heavy lift, the C/E should send 
someone on duty to ensure safe operation. 
3.4 每次加装燃油前，轮机长应将计划添装的油舱及各舱添装量通知并征得大副同意(航行
中也应告知使用计划)，以便计算稳性、水尺和调整吃水差。 
Before each fuel bunkering, the C/E should inform C/O of the oil tanks to be filled, and the amount of 
fuel for each tank, and obtain the consent from the C/O (report the using plan when sailing) in order to 
calculate the stability, draft and adjust the trim. 
3.5 当轮机部装运桶装滑油或重大备件时，轮机长(或值班轮机员)应联系大副(或值班驾驶
员) 派水手操纵起货机并商定存放地点。水手长应指导绑扎加固，具体绑扎加固工作
由轮机部负责。 
When the engine department load the bottled lub. oil or heavy spare parts, the C/E (or engineer on duty) 
should request the C/O (or the deck officer on duty) to arrange sailors to operate the cargo crane and 
discuss on the storage location. The BSN should guide the banding and reinforcement, while specific 
operations is done by the engine department. 
3.6 使用甲板空气前，大副应督促木匠、水手长或值班水手先检查所有空气管系和阀门是
否已关闭，然后通知机舱供气。供汽时先使管系中的残水放尽。停用后，及时通知机
舱关闭气阀。甲板各阀由甲板部人员操作，轮机部平时应派人检查是否处于正常状态。 
Before using deck air, C/O should urge carpenter, BSN or A.B on duty to verify all air piping and valves 
are closed and then inform the engine room of gas supply. First, get rid of the remaining water in the 
pipeline before supply. When done using, notify the engine room to close the valve in time. Valves on 
deck are operated by staff from the deck department, the engine department is responsible for status 
check. 
3.7 严寒季节，由甲板部负责将甲板上的管路海、淡水系统残水放出，防止管路冻裂。 
In cold seasons, the deck department is responsible for getting the residual sea/fresh water out of the 
system on deck to prevent the pipeline from being cold cracked. 
4.0 其它 
Others 
4.1 轮机长根据航次任务及早将燃、润油的准确现存数量和补添计划提交船长审核，船长
如要修改，应与轮机长商洽尽可能取得一致意见，但船长有最终决定权并对此负责。
航次任务若有变更，船长应及早告知轮机长并共同估算和修改补添计划。 
The C/E should submit the accurate stock of fuel/lubrication oil and supplement plan according to 
navigation to the master for review, if the captain wants to make changes, it’s advisable to discuss with 
the C/E to reach an agreement, however, the master can make the final decision and is responsible for it. 
If there is change in the voyage task, the master should inform the C/E as soon as possible and estimate 
and revise the supplement plan together. 
4.2 船长和轮机长共同研究商定的主机各种车速转数，除非另有指示，值班驾驶员和值班
轮机员均应严格执行。 
The revolution of main engine discussed and decided jointly by the master and the C/E should be 
executed strictly by all deck officers and engineers, unless otherwise instructed. 
4.3 机舱除可直接使用专用炉水舱的水以外，如需动用其它水柜，必须事先征得大副同意。
木匠负责各淡水仓的调换使用并有责任保持在使用中的水柜具有足够的存水量，以免
水泵抽空或损坏。 

363

04_15_11.text:
航行制度                            版本/修改：3.0/1.0                 SHIP-05-03 
Navigation Regulations                       Version/Revision: 3.0/1.0                     SHIP-05-03 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                 生效日期：2022/03/06               第4/4页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd     Effective Date: 2022/03/06                   Page: 4/4 
If the engine room needs water from other water tanks other than the special purpose water tank, consent 
from the C/O is required. The carpenter is responsible for the replacement of the fresh water tank and for 
keeping the water tank in use with sufficient water storage to prevent the water pump from pumping out 
or being damaged. 
4.4 各燃油舱之间的移驳应事先征得大副同意。 
The transfer between fuel tanks should be approved by the C/O beforehand. 
4.5 排、灌压载水或淡水须凭大副的书面通知，由木匠负责测量并注意与机舱值班人员联
系。完毕后，木匠应及时通知机舱停泵。机舱值班人员应将舱别和启、停压载泵时间
记入轮机日志。 
Discharge/refill of ballast or fresh water shall be notified in writing by the C/O, the carpenter is 
responsible for measuring and communicating with the staff on duty in the engine room. Upon 
completion, the carpenter should promptly notify the engine room to stop the pump. Staff on duty in the 
engine room should record the tank number, pump starting and stopping time in the engine logbook.. 
4.6 大副对起货机、锚机、绞缆机的正确使用负有责任，并指导水手长、木匠及水手做好
固定部分(墙脚、底盘、罩壳等)的清洁和油漆保养工作，对锚机、绞缆机及时加油润
滑， (齿轮箱内部及电动机轴承由轮机部负责加油)。 
The C/O is responsible for the proper use of the crane, windlass and winch, and guides the BSN, 
carpenter and ratings on cleaning and paint maintenance work of fixed part (the foot of a wall, chassis, 
shell, etc.), ensure the windlass and winch are lubricated in time (engine department is responsible for the 
inside of gearbox and bearing of the electric motor). 
4.7 抵港前，轮机部应派人检查锚机、绞缆机和起货机，使其保持良好技术状态。各种甲
板机械的操纵(控制)箱离港不用时，水手长应派人检查并予盖严或用帆布罩罩妥。 
Before arriving at the port, the engine department should have the crane, windlass and winch checked and 
maintained good technical conditions. When the control box of various deck machinery is not in use, 
BSN should send someone to examine and cover it with canvas. 
4.8 轮机部如因检修、试验等各种原因须要暂停供电或局部停电，必须事先报告船长(或值
班驾驶员)，并告知停止和恢复供电的大约时间。航行中，电罗经和操舵系统如非特殊
情况不应停止供电。 
If the engine department needs to suspend power supply or partial power failure for maintenance, testing 
and other reasons, the master (or the deck officer on duty) must be notified in advance, and be informed 
about the approximate time to stop and restore the power supply. On voyage, the compass and steering 
system shall not cease power supply unless otherwise specified. 
4.9 水手长负责管理装卸用的移动式照明灯具，离港后即应检查试验，如有损坏交电机员
修理；甲板上的各种电源插座，由水手长负责派人检查并予盖紧保持水密，座盖如有
损坏或短缺，通知电机员修理并保持完好。 
The BSN is responsible for the management of mobile lighting fixtures for loading andunloding, checking 
the devices after departure, delivering it to the electrician engineer if there is any damage; BSN should 
have all the power outlets checked and covered to keep watertight, if the cover is damaged or short in 
number, notify the electrician engineer to repair and remain intact.

航行制度                              版本/修改：3.0/7.0                SHIP-05-04 
Navigation Regulations                         Version/Revision: 3.0/7.0                  SHIP-05-04 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2026/06/26             第1/8页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2026/06/26                 Page: 1/8 
第04节 船舶进出港安全制度 
Section 04 Ship Arrival & Departure Safety Regulations 
 
1 
离港前的准备工作 
Preparations Before Departure 
1.1 
船长应查看《Voyage passage plan》和参阅“进港指南”、“航路指南”、潮汐表、
航行警告、临时通告、代理电函等资料，了解、掌握下述： 
The master should refer to the “Voyage passage plan”, “Guide to port entry”, “Sailing direction”, 
tide table, navigation warning, temporary notice, agency letter, etc. to understand the following 
situation: 
 港口的“通讯联系制度”及港口相关方的VHF 频道； 
“Communication Regulations” of the port and VHF channel of the port and related parties; 
 港口的“船位报告制度”及报告点、报告内容； 
“Position Report Regulations” of the port and content of the report; 
 港口的“分道通航制度”和有关航行法规（如航速规定等）； 
“Traffic Separation Scheme” of the port and related navigation rules (e.g. speed limits, etc.). 
 港口、锚地的潮汐、潮流； 
Tides and currents in the port and anchorage; 
 拖轮艘数、功率等安排。 
Number and power of tug boats. 
1.2 
船长应认真仔细审阅海图，了解和掌握出港航道或锚地的航法及下述内容： 
The master should review the chart carefully, understand and familiar with the outbound lane, 
sailing regulations in the anchorage, as well as the following content: 
 海图已改正到最新，航行航警内容已标注在海图上； 
The chart is updated to the latest, with navigation warnings already marked; 
 保证ECDIS 有合适的比例ENC, 数据被安装并更新； 
Ensure that ECDIS is equipped with the appropriate proportional ENCs, and the data is 
installed and updated; 
 危险障航物、养殖区、航道水深、灯塔、灯标、导标、流向、流速； 
Dangerous obstructions, mariculture area, water depth, lighthouse, beacon light, navigation 
mark, current direction, current speed; 
 查核海图上的计划航线；对本船适航深度做出适当醒目的等深线，对重要转
向点标出可利用的目标的方位距离，对危险区设立和标绘出方位或距离避险
线。 
Review the planned route on the chart; highlight depth contour of seaworthiness depth of the 
ship, mark available target azimuth distance for important turning points, mark distance hedge 
line or highlight the area for dangerous area. 
 进、出港航道或锚地的导航目标、定位物标、风、流、水深、底质等情况。
Navigation target, location mark, wind, current, water depth of the inbound, outbound lane or 
anchorage; 
 在无大比例尺港图或港口资料匮乏的情况下，提前向代理等索取详尽的锚地、
航道、泊位、浅点及碍航物等资料，必要时寻求公司的支持。 
In the absence of harbor chart or lack of port information, ask in advance to agencies for 

365

航行制度                              版本/修改：3.0/7.0                SHIP-05-04 
Navigation Regulations                         Version/Revision: 3.0/7.0                  SHIP-05-04 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2026/06/26             第2/8页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2026/06/26                 Page: 2/8 
detailed materials about anchorage, lane, berth, shallow point and obstructions, request help 
from the company if necessary. 
1.3 
船长应认真研读代理发船的指示和港口要求，并将相关信息和执行措施落实到人。
The master should carefully study the instructions and port guidance from the agent, 
and implement relevant information and arrange the safety duty to the personnel 
1.4 
船长应及时召开有轮机长参加的驾驶员离港会议，船长要负责将航行计划通知每
一位驾驶员，使他们了解整个航线的情况，部署离港准备工作。 
The master should timely call on a deck officers departure meeting with C/E present. The master is 
responsible for notifying all deck officers of the navigation plan, to make them understand the 
whole navigation route, arrange the preparation for departure. 
1.5 
离港前24 小时船长通知轮机长、大副离港时间，离港前各部门部署有关人员对有
关设备等进行全面检查或试验，发现问题及时解决并做好记录。 
The master should notify C/E and C/O the departure time 24h in advance. Before departure, each 
department should arrange related personnel to fully test and examine related devices. Solve and 
record in time if there is any problem. 
1.6 
大副安排水手长做好货物、移动物件、属具等的绑扎加固工作，并封好货舱、固
定好吊货索具，收妥并加固舷梯（解缆后系泊缆绳应收入舱内或绑扎遮盖）。 
C/O arranges the BSN to complete the colligation and reinforce work of cargo, moving objects, 
attachments, etc., and seal the cargo hold, fix the cargo rigging, put away and reinforce the gangway 
(mooring cable should be put away in store or bound and covered after unmooring). 
1.7 
轮机长安排轮机部人员做好开航前的准备工作，对可移动的物品进行绑扎。 
C/E arranges the engine department for preparations before departure, colligate the moving objects. 
1.8 
三副依据“离港消防/救生设备检查表”对消防、救生设备进行检查，相关人员签
字确认。 
3/O should check the firefighting and lifesaving equipment according to the “Departure Fire 
Fighting/Lifesaving Equipment Checklist”, and should be signed by related personnel. 
1.9 
船长根据《船舶保安计划》的要求，组织各部门实施离港前的检查。 
Master organizes each department to review the ship conditions before departure according to the 
“Ship Safety Plan”. 
1.10 
值班驾驶员依据“驾驶台离港准备工作检查表”，确认准备工作已完成，签字确
认。 
Deck officer on duty should check the preparations according to “Departure Preparation Checklist 
for Bridge”， and sign to confirm. 
1.11 
离港前1 小时通知机舱备车，轮机长会同轮机员进行备车，按照“轮机部离港前
检查表”对机舱设备进行检查试验，签字确认;值班驾驶员依据“驾驶台设备测试
检查表”对驾驶台设备进行测试，签字确认。 
The engine room should be informed one hour before departure of standby engine, C/E and 
engineers will have the engine standby, examine and test the equipment in the engine room 
according to “Engine Department Checklist before Departure”, and sign to confirm; deck officer 
on duty should check the bridge according to “Bridge Equipment Test Checklist” and sigh to 
confirm. 
1.12 
机舱备车工作完成后，通知驾驶台，会同值班驾驶员和对车钟、船钟，进行主机
冲车和正、倒车试验，检查和试验主机应急操作及安全保护功能。进行舵机试验
和核对舵角，检查驾驶台和机舱控制室及舵机间通讯设备，确保处于良好状态。
将以上各项试验情况记入轮机日志中。

航行制度                              版本/修改：3.0/7.0                SHIP-05-04 
Navigation Regulations                         Version/Revision: 3.0/7.0                  SHIP-05-04 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2026/06/26             第3/8页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2026/06/26                 Page: 3/8 
After engine standby, inform the bridge and check the telegraph and ship's clock together with the 
deck officer on duty, check and test the main engine emergency operation and safety protection 
functions. Test the steering gear, check the rudder angle, check the communication device at the 
bridge, engine control room and the steering room, to ensure good condition. All the above 
examination results should be recorded in the engine logbook. 
1.13 
按国际惯例悬挂国旗、所在国国旗、船名旗、信号旗或号型，晚间开启规定号灯。 
According to international tradition, national flags of ship registry and port state, ship’s name 
flags, signal flags and shapes should be hung, lights stated should be turned on at night. 
1.14 
离港前12 小时内，轮机长协同驾驶员、轮机员和电机员，按“离港前12 小时舵
机系统检查试验表”进行检查试验。 
In 12 hours before departure, C/E, together with deck officer, engineer and electrician engineer, 
carry out test according to “Steering Engine System 12H Before Departure Checklist”. 
2 
抵港前的准备工作 
Preparations Before Arrival 
2.1 
船长按照离港前的准备工作中1.1-1.3 的要求做好抵港前的准备工作。 
The master gets the preparation for arrival, which is mentioned in section 1.1 - 1.3 in “Preparations 
Before Departure”. 
2.2 
船长及时召开有轮机长参加的驾驶员抵港会议，部署抵港注意事项，充分做好到
港准备; 
The master should timely call on an arrival meeting with C/E present to arrange for arrival, and 
make better preparations; 
2.3 
大副在抵港前应指派有关人员对系泊设备、吊货设备、应急设备、通讯设备、舵
机、舷梯及引水员登离船装置等进行全面检查或试验，备妥缆绳，及引水员登乘
设备，夜间备有足够的照明。 
C/O should assign related personnel to check or test the mooring equipment, cargo lifting 
equipment, emergency equipment and steering gear thoroughly, get the mooring cable and 
embarkation facilities for pilots ready, and ensure adequate lighting at night.  
2.4 
轮机长、电机员会同值班轮机员对机电设备进行检查，根据“轮机部抵港前检查
表”逐项检查并填写，签字确认。 
C/E, electrician engineer and engineer on duty should check the electromechanical equipment 
according to the “Engine Department Checklist before Arrival”, fill in the condition and sign to 
confirm. 
2.5 
值班驾驶员按船长命令及时备好车舵，并依据“驾驶台抵港准备工作检查表”对
各指示器，显示器、仪表、船钟、助航设备、对讲机等进行逐项检查并填写，签
字确认。 
Deck officer on duty should get the main engine and the rudder ready according to the master's 
order, and check the indicators, monitor, instrument, telegraph, nav-aids and intercom according to 
the “Arrival Preparation Checklist for Bridge”, fill in and sign to confirm. 
2.6 
对讲机使用中与他船发生干扰，应更换频道或在下达命令时冠以船名。 
If there is interference with other ship when using the intercom, change the channel or add the ship's 
name while give orders. 
2.7 
值班驾驶员按照船长的命令通知机舱主机换用轻油（如必要），在主机燃油换妥
后进行主机停车和正、倒车试验，及应急操作实验，检查驾驶台与机舱集控室及
舵机房的通讯。
