航行制度                              版本/修改：3.0/7.0                SHIP-05-04 
Navigation Regulations                         Version/Revision: 3.0/7.0                  SHIP-05-04 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2026/06/26             第4/8页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2026/06/26                 Page: 4/8 
Deck officer on duty inform of the main engine to change into diesel oil (if necessary) according to 
the master's order. After the oil is replaced, test the main engine for stop, ahead, astern and 
emergency operation test, check the communication among the bridge, engine room and steering 
room. 
2.8 
船长需确保本船始终满足富余水深的要求。 
The master should ensure that the ship always comply with the requirements of under-keel 
clearance. 
2.9 
船长应在确保船舶安全的前提下，根据风浪、流速及流向、水深、回旋水域、装
载状态、通航密度等环境状况，确定进行主机停车和正、倒车试验等操作的时机
和水域，并应在进入港界或港外锚地前完成上述操作。 
The master should determine the opportunity and water area for main engine stop, ahead and astern 
test, on the premise that the ship is safe, and according to environmental conditions such as wind, 
wave, current, water depth, loaden, etc., and complete the above testing before entering the harbor 
limit or roadstead. 
2.10 
大副按船长指示备妥锚，抛锚时必须避开海底电缆及水下障碍物、大副还必须先
确认在锚的下方无船驳，并严格执行船长命令。深水抛锚应按操作规程执行，防
止丢锚失链。 
C/O prepares the anchor instructed by the master, avoid submarine cable and underwater obstructs 
when drop the anchor. The C/O should also confirm in advance there is no boats below the anchor 
and follow the master's instruction strictly. Follow the operation regulations when dropping the 
anchor in deep sea area to prevent the anchor and chains from missing. 
2.11 
二副应及时接收所到港口及附近的航行警告、气象预报，并将必要的航行安全信
息及时标注与海图，例如：养殖区、碍航物、演习区等。 
2/O should receive the navigation warnings and weather forecast on the port of arrival and nearby 
area, and remark the necessary navigation information on the chart, for example: mariculture 
area/obstructions/exercise area, etc. 
2.12 
驾驶员备好递交引水员的信息表,如果是直升机接送引水,通知大副布置有关器材
和人员; 
Deck officer prepares the information form for the pilot; if helicopter is used for pilot, inform the 
C/O of arranging related facilities and personnel; 
2.13 
按国际惯例悬挂国旗、所在国国旗、船名旗、信号旗或号型，晚间开启规定号灯。 
According to international tradition, national flags of ship registry and port state, ship’s name 
flags , signal flags and shapes should be hunged, lights stated should be turned on at night. 
3 
进、出港制度 
Arrival and Departure Regulations 
3.1 
大副、木匠在船艏负责锚机、缆机,根据船长命令进行解、系缆作业，二副、水手
长在船尾根据船长的命令进行解、系缆作业。听从驾驶台的统一指挥。 
C/O and carpenter are responsible for the windlass and winch at the bow, mooring or unmooring 
according to the instructions of the master. 2/O and BSN are responsible for mooring or unmooring 
at the stern. 
3.2 
船长应指派驾驶员接送引水，并按《引航须知》中的要求安排引水上船，以确保
引水员安全。 
The master should assign the deck officer to meet the pilot and arrange for the pilot getting on board 
according to the requirements in “Pilotage Notice”, to ensure the safety of the pilot. 

368

航行制度                              版本/修改：3.0/7.0                SHIP-05-04 
Navigation Regulations                         Version/Revision: 3.0/7.0                  SHIP-05-04 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2026/06/26             第5/8页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2026/06/26                 Page: 5/8 
3.3 
引水员登船后，交换引水员信息卡内的信息。船长应向他介绍本船船舶规范、水
尺、货载、操纵性能、主机转速及本船特点。船长应向引水介绍系泊布置，如系
泊缆绳、系泊设备、顶推位置，以及引水梯安排、带缆人员安排等。 
After the pilot is on board, exchange information pilot card. The master should introduce the ship’s 
particulars, draft, cargo, operation performance, main engine revolution speed and characters of the 
ship. The master shall introduce the mooring arrangement to the pilot, such as mooring ropes, 
mooring equipment, tug pushing positions, as well as the pilotage ladder arrangement and the 
mooring team arrangement. 
3.4 
引水员引航时，船长不可放弃操船责任；船长有权纠正引水员的错误指令。 
During pilotage, the master shall not quit handling the ship; the master has the right to correct 
wrong instructions of the pilot. 
3.5 
引水员引航时，值班驾驶员应配合并密切注意命令的执行情况，发现错误及时提
醒船长、引水员和值班水手；负责操车钟并记录“车钟记录簿”。 
During pilotage, deck officer on duty should assist and watch closely execution of the instructions, 
remind the master, pilot and A.B in time of mistakes occurred; the deck officer is also responsible 
for operating the telegraph and maintain the “Telegraph Record Book”. 
3.6 
港内航行要使用安全航速，不得超过港口规定的航速；勤测船位，使船保持在计
划航线上，船位的控制要充分考虑风流的影响，避让措施要及时、明确，留有充
分余地。 
The ship should be sailing in the harbor at safe speed, and shall not exceed the speed limit of the 
port. Measure the ship location regularly to keep the ship on planned route. Impact from the wind 
should be considered when controlling the ship position, avoidance measures should be timely and 
clear, with enough leeway. 
3.7 
机舱值班轮机员在集控室准确、及时地执行驾驶台的车钟命令，并记入“车钟记
录簿”，监控机电设备的运行情况，加强巡视，并在舵机房安排专人值守。及时
处理发现的问题，维护机电设备工作在良好状态。 
Engineer on duty in the engine control room accurately and timely execute the telegraph 
instructions from the bridge, and record it in the “Telegraph Record Book”, monitor the 
electromechanical equipment, enhance patrol, and assign personnel specially on duty. Solve 
problems occurred timely and maintain the electromechanical equipment in a good condition. 
3.8 
进出港时船长可增派当值人员。 
The master can arrange additional person on duty on arrival or departure. 
3.9 
进出港口时若主机临时故障需减速或停车，必须立即报告驾驶台，由船长根据航
道、港区情况，果断决策并告诉机舱，避免引起其它事故。 
If the main engine needs to slow down or stop due to temporary malfunction, report to the bridge 
immediately, the master should make decisions decisively according to the channel and port 
circumstances, and inform the engine room, to avoid other accidents. 
3.10 
进出港口时或在引航过程中，一旦发生险情或事故，应保持冷静头脑，设法使船
舶摆脱危险，减少损失，同时要认真记录，慎重填写航海日志。 
When entering or exiting a port or pilotage, in case of accidents or dangerous situations, keep calm 
and try to get the ship out of danger and reduce damage, keep record and fill in the deck logbook 
carefully. 
3.11 
出港时，VHF 应在指定频道守听并加强与港口的控制台、导航雷达站、海上交通
指挥中心等有关方面的联系，并听从其指挥；还应与有关船舶协调避让措施，保
证安全航行。 

369

航行制度                              版本/修改：3.0/7.0                SHIP-05-04 
Navigation Regulations                         Version/Revision: 3.0/7.0                  SHIP-05-04 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2026/06/26             第6/8页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2026/06/26                 Page: 6/8 
On departure, standby the VHF on specified channel and maintain good communication with the 
control console, navigation radar station, maritime traffic control center and other related authorities 
of the port, follow their instructions; coordinate with other ships for avoidance measures to ensure 
safe navigation. 
3.12 
把引水员姓名、登轮位置和拖轮的船名记入“航海日志”。 
Enter the name of the pilot, on board location and tugboat's name in the deck logbook. 
3.13 
进出港遇有下列情况之一时，应即向港口当局报告并提出要求： 
In the light of the following circumstances on arrival and departure, report to the port and send 
request: 
 泊位不符合安全靠离条件。 
Berth fails to comply with the safety conditions. 
 能见度低于本港的安全引航标准。 
Visibility is lower than that required by the pilot safety standard. 
 风大流急而无足够拖轮。 
Strong wind, rushing current, without enough tugboats. 
 船舶主要设备故障致使安全无保证。 
Malfunction of major device that threatens the ship safety. 
 引水员明显不称职。 
Incompetence of the pilot. 
 引水员在执行任务前酗酒。 
Pilot drank alcohol before the task. 
 其它危及安全情况。 
Other situations that may cause safety problems. 
4 
风险评估 
Risk Evaluation 
4.1 
在进行风险评估时，应考虑到下列风险： 
The following risks should be taken into consideration during risk evaluation: 
 “驾驶台离港准备工作检查表”和“驾驶台抵港准备工作检查表”中列明的 
相关项目风险； 
Related risks listed in “Departure Preparation Checklist for Bridge” and “Arrival 
Preparation Checklist for Bridge”; 
 一旦作业过程中有紧急情况发生，救助器材和施救方案的及时性和有效性； 
In case of emergency during operations, timeliness and effectiveness of the first-aid facilities 
and emergency plan; 
 操作过程中其他可合理预见到的风险； 
Other risks that can be reasonably foreseen during operation; 
 操作现场的特殊情况，例如天气、海况、照明、时间限制、空间限制、周边
可能存在的其他危险和限制条件等； 
Special circumstances on spot, such as weather, sea condition, lighting, time limits, space 
limits, other dangers and limits from nearby area; 
 参与操作人员的特殊情况，例如人员数量、经验、技能、体能等状态； 
Special circumstances of the operator, such as lack of quantity, experience, skill or physical 
fitness; 
 参与操作人员使用电子产品，非注意盲视危害等； 
Use of electronics by operator involved, Inattentional blindness hazards, and so on.

4.2 
对操作过程中的可预见风险与特殊情况进行综合评估后，根据风险的可能性和危
害程度，确定风险级别，评估已采取的防范措施的充分性，如果不充分，应进一
步采取额外措施，将风险级别降低到可容忍程度，方可进行相关作业。 
After evaluating the foreseeable risks and special circumstances during operation, determine risk 
levels according to the possibilities and damages of the risks, and evaluate whether the preventative 
measures are adequate. If not, take extra measures to lower the risk level so that relevant operations 
can be carried out. 
4.3 
如果在操作过程中采取了额外措施，作业完成后，相关负责人应对所采取的防范
措施进行有效性评估，并提出改进建议。 
If extra measures are taken during operation, upon completion, the responsible person should 
evaluate the effectiveness of the measure adopted, and put forward improvement suggestions.

04_15_13.text:
航行制度                                 版本/修改：3.0/4.0                    SHIP-05-05 
Navigation Regulations                             Version/Rev.: 3.0/4.0                        SHIP-05-05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                生效日期：2023/08/21               第1/14 页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.            Effective Date: 2023/08/21                   Page: 1/14 
第05 节 航海仪器及航海图书资料管理制度 
Section 5 Management Regulations of Navigation Instruments, Nautical Publications and Materials 
 
1. 航海仪器的管理 
Management of Navigation Instruments 
1.1 航海仪器是保障船舶安全航行的重要仪器，驾驶员必须按操作规程操作。航海仪器主
要分为普航仪器、助航仪器和通导设备，由驾驶员操作使用，二副管理、维护。应经
常校核仪器误差并做好记录。 
Navigation instruments are important for ensuring safe navigation, the deck officer must follow the 
operating procedures. Navigation instruments consist of general navigation instrument, navigational aids, 
and navigation equipment, which are operated by the deck officer, and managed and maintained by 
second officer. The instruments should be checked for errors and be recorded. 
1.2 无关人员未经允许不得擅自动用航海仪器。见习人员学习使用时，应有值班驾驶员在
场指导。检修人员修理时，二副要在场陪同。 
Navigation instruments shall not be used by irrelevant personnel without authorization. When used by 
trainees, deck officer on duty should be present to provide guidance. Second officer should be present 
when the instrument is under maintenance. 
1.3 二副是管理航海仪器的负责人，并做好下述工作： 
Second officer is responsible for the management of navigation instruments, and the following work: 
 每年的一、四、七、十月份对船舶通导设备进行检查并将检查情况记入《船舶通导
设备检查表》。 
Examine the ship navigation equipment and keep record in the “Ship Navigation Equipment 
Checklist” every year in Jan., April, July and October. 
 每年一月检查船上普航仪器的状况并记入《普航仪器登记表》。 
Check the general navigation instruments every January and keep the record in “General Navigation 
Instrument Checklist”. 
 对普航仪器进行检查、维护（尤其是要检查磁罗经的照明灯、反光镜以及消除气泡）。
如出现普航仪器缺少、损坏的情况，及时向船管部门进行补充、申领或修理，并对
《普航仪器登记表》中的相关内容进行改正。 
Check and maintain the general navigation instruments (especially the light of the magnetic compass, 
reflector, and elimination of bubbles). If the instrument is missing or damaged, report to the fleet 
management department for supply or maintenance, and update the relevant information in the 
“General Navigation Instrument Checklist”. 
 按说明书要求进行养护检查，并将操作程序张贴在仪器附近的醒目位置。 
Keep maintenance and inspection according to the instrument instructions, and post the operation 
procedures at a clearly visible position near the instrument. 
 向接班驾驶员介绍仪器性能、特点、技术现状、使用方法、操作规程、误差情况以
及驾驶台其他设备。 
Introduce the instrument performance, characters, technical status, usage method, operating procedure, 
errors and other facilities at the bridge to the successor. 
 开航前，应对仪器进行检查试验，发现不正常现象应予消除，并报告船长。 
Check and test the instruments before departure, if there is abnormality, eliminate immediately and 
report to the master. 
 保管各种航海仪器说明书和图纸(存放在驾驶台)。 

373

航行制度                                 版本/修改：3.0/4.0                    SHIP-05-05 
Navigation Regulations                             Version/Rev.: 3.0/4.0                        SHIP-05-05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                生效日期：2023/08/21               第2/14 页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.            Effective Date: 2023/08/21                   Page: 2/14 
All the instructions and drawings for navigation instruments and charts should be kept (at the bridge). 
 航海仪器说明书和图纸应保持完整清晰，如有短缺应申报公司相关部门补齐。如果
仪器经过修理，局部线路或零部件有所改动，应在图纸上如实地标明或修改，在说
明书的相应部位予以注明，使之符合仪器现状。 
Instructions for the navigation instruments and charts should remain complete and clear, report to 
relevant departments of the company for supplement if any of them is missing. If local wiring or parts 
have been changed due to repair or maintenance, the change should be marked on the drawings, as 
well as on the instruction, to fit the actual status of the instrument. 
1.4 用独立的供电线路和电源控制，不得接入照明电路，也不得与其它电气设备直接并联。
如因条件限制而必须并联时，应加装转换开关或分路断合装置。 
Adopt independent power supply and power control, avoid accessing the lighting circuit, avoid paralleling 
with other electrical equipment directly. If paralleling cannot be avoided due to conditional constraints, 
change-over switch or shunt breaking device should be installed. 
1.5 不是连续使用的仪器（例如标准磁罗经、电罗经复示器、要有防潮防尘的护罩，不用
时应予罩盖。 
Instruments that do not run continuously (such as the standard magnetic compass and gyro repeater) 
should be covered with shield for moisture proof and dustproof, cover the instrument when not in use. 
1.6 手持使用的仪器，均应有稳固的专用箱盒存放。望远镜、六分仪和方位仪的望远镜头
应用清洁干燥的鹿皮或镜头纸定期擦拭，到港后应锁存在柜内并适当放置干燥剂。 
There should be dedicated steady box reserved for handheld instrument. Telephoto lens of the binoculars, 
sextant and azimuth instrument should be wiped with clean and dry deerskin or lens tissue regularly. In 
port, should be locked in the cabinet with desiccant. 
1.7 磁罗经附近不准放堆铁质物品。凡有电波辐射的仪器或天线距离磁罗经不少于1.5 米。 
Iron objects are not allowed to be placed near the magnetic compass. Any instrument or antenna with 
electric wave radiation should be kept at least 1.5m away from the magnetic compass. 
1.8 除船舶进厂修理或检修外，一般不停止电罗经运转。 
Normally the gyrocompass always keeps running unless the ship is under inspection or maintenance in 
shipyard. 
1.9 用助航仪器前，应先检查仪器的所有控钮是否处于停用时的正确位置，与之相关联的
设备是否处于正常状态；使用完毕，应将各控钮和电源开关置于正确停用位置；抵港
完车后，二副要再次全面检查并套上护罩。 
Before using navigational aids, check all buttons of the instrument to see whether they are at the correct 
status, and whether the instrument connected is under good condition. After using, the control button and 
power switch should be placed in the correct stop position; after arriving at the port, second officer should 
conduct overall inspection again and cover the instrument with shield. 
1.10 ARPA 雷达速度信号应使用计程仪的速度信号。 
Adopt the speed signal from the log as the ARPA radar speed signal. 
1.11 舶进厂修理，二副应据仪器的技术状况做出合理的修理计划。 
When the ship is under maintenance in shipyard, second officer should make reasonable maintenance 
plan according to the technical status of the instrument. 
1.12 航行中要经常核对仪器的误差并记录。如仪器误差过大，应及时找出原因，校正误差。
在误差校正前，应停止使用该仪器。 

374

航行制度                                 版本/修改：3.0/4.0                    SHIP-05-05 
Navigation Regulations                             Version/Rev.: 3.0/4.0                        SHIP-05-05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                生效日期：2023/08/21               第3/14 页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.            Effective Date: 2023/08/21                   Page: 3/14 
The instrument error should be checked and recorded frequently during sailing. If the instrument error is 
too large, find out the reason in time and the correct the error. Stop using the instrument until the error is 
corrected. 
1.13 罗经自差的校测和记录 
Compass deviation adjustment and record 
1.13.1 磁罗经自差的校测每年一次，由船长负责。 
Compass deviation adjustment is conducted once a year by the master. 
1.13.2 各轮必须备有磁罗经自差记录簿和标准磁罗经自差曲线表。自差曲线表应张贴在海
图室内。船长应经常审阅签署记录簿并督促驾驶员正确记录。 
Each ship should be equipped with “Magnetic Compass Deviation Record” and standard magnetic 
compass self-deviation curve table. The deviation curve table should be posted in the chart room. The 
master should review and sign the record book and urge the deck officer to keep correct record. 
1.13.3 自差表上应记载测定的日期、地点、当时的天气及海面情况和测定方法以及磁棒及
软铁球（棒）位置。该自差表有效期为一年。 
Date, location, weather and sea condition, measuring method, as well as the location of the magnetic 
bar and quadrantal sphere (bar) should be kept in the deviation table. The self-deviation table is valid 
for a year. 
1.13.4 下列各种情况均应校测标准磁罗经的自差，剩余自差值不得大于5 度： 
Deviation of the standard magnetic compass should be tested and adjusted under the following 
circumstances, the remaining deviation should be no larger than 5 degrees: 
 每次修船完毕后。 
Every time when ship repair is completed. 
 船体或上层建筑经过大面积改装后。 
After the hull or superstructure is reconstructed in large scale. 
 标准磁罗经甲板或驾驶台附近增加或除去较大的铁质物品后。 
Large iron objects are settled or removed from around the standard magnetic compass deck or 
bridge. 
1.13.5 航行中，条件许可情况下，每班应进行一次标准磁罗经误差的测定，如果可能，在
大角度转向之后应进行测定；每班应经常比对标准磁罗经和电罗经的读数。 
During sailing, if the conditions permit, error of the standard magnetic compass should be measured 
every watch, if possible, measure the error after large angle steering; every watch should compare the 
readings from magnetic compass with that from the gyro-compass. 
1.13.6 每次观测情况均应记入《磁罗经自差记录簿》。 如发现磁罗经不稳定或者自差变化
过大，报告船长并复测确认，查明原因，消除影响的根源，然后重测并重制自差表，
经船长签署后使用新表，原自差表应保留到下一次校正测定。若误差超出允许限度，
本船不能校正时，应报告公司海务部。 
Each measuring result should be recorded in “Magnetic Compass Deviation Record”. If the magnetic 
compass is unstable or the deviation various significantly, report to the master and double-check to 
determine the reason in order to eliminate the root of the problem. Then retest and make a new 
deviation table, which will be effective with the approval of the master. The original deviation table 
should be kept until the next adjustment and measurement. If the error exceeds the allowable limit, 
own ship cannot be adjusted, should report to the company Marine Department. 
1.13.7 电罗经主体周围必须保持清洁、干燥、通风、无细碎杂物。开航前应核对各复示器
（包括舵机房的复示器）使之与主罗经同步跟踪，首向一致。 

375

04_15_14.text:
航行制度                                 版本/修改：3.0/4.0                    SHIP-05-05 
Navigation Regulations                             Version/Rev.: 3.0/4.0                        SHIP-05-05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                生效日期：2023/08/21               第4/14 页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.            Effective Date: 2023/08/21                   Page: 4/14 
Surroundings of the gyro-compass should remain dry, clean, ventilated and with no debris. Before 
departure, should check the repeaters (including those in the steering gear room) to remain 
synchronous with the main compass, with same heading. 
1.13.8 航行中每班至少应核对操舵复示器与主罗经读数一次。 
During sailing, each watch should at least check the readings from the steering repeater with that from 
the main compass once. 
1.14 天文钟(如有)和船钟的管理 
Management of the Astronomical Clock (if any) and Ship’s Clock 
1.14.1 如船舶配备机械或石英天文钟，二副要按时进行校对记入《天文钟误差记录簿》。 
If the ship is equipped with mechanical or quartz astronomical clock, second officer is responsible for 
checking and keeping the record in the “Astronomical Clock Error Record” in time. 
1.14.2 天文钟应放置在专用柜内。周围不应放置带有磁性的物品。 
The astronomical clock should be placed in dedicated cabinet, with no magnetic objects around. 
1.14.3 天文钟专用柜必须有玻璃盖板。柜内应有照明灯，以便夜间观看时间。 
The dedicated cabinet for astronomical clock must be covered with glass plate, with headlamp in the 
cabinet, to ensure visible at night. 
1.14.4 专用柜内应用软质物品衬垫固定，以防天文钟受震、滑动。除天文钟误差记录簿外，
其他物品均不得放在专用柜内。 
Soft material should be placed in the dedicated cabinet for safety reasons to prevent the astronomical 
clock from shock and slide. No other objects except the “Astronomical Clock Error Record” shall be 
placed in the dedicated cabinet. 
1.14.5 绝对禁止拨动天文钟指针。若积差过大，可利用在港期间使钟停摆等待准确报时再
启动的方法纠正。 
Adjustment of the pointer is absolutely prohibited. If the error is too significant, for correction, stop 
the clock during the stay in port and wait for accurate announcement of the time, then re-start the 
clock again. 
1.14.6 发现天文钟日差过大应即报告船长，若出现不规则的快慢变化，应即报告公司船管
部及时检查修理。正常情况下，每隔四年对天文钟进行一次清洗、加油并校正。 
If the daily error of the astronomical clock is too significant, report to the master; if the clock runs fast 
or slow irregularly, report to the fleet management department of the company for timely inspection 
and maintenance. In normally condition, astronomical clock should be cleaned, oiling, and corrected 
every four years. 
1.14.7 送修天文钟由二副亲自搬运。事前应使发条走松或走完，（石英钟应取下电池），
运输时应将平衡环夹紧，用软质物品衬垫，用手托抱，平置轻放，防止受震或翻倒。 
Second officer is responsible for handling the astronomical clock for maintenance. Waiting for the 
spring to be slack (for quartz clock, remove the batteries), secure the gimbals during transport, padded 
with soft material and held with both hands. Gently and flatly put down the clock to prevent from 
shock or overturn. 
1.14.8 二副负责全船公共场所的船钟定时上弦（或更换电池）和校正。发现船钟故障或快
慢变化过大，应及时申请清洗、加油或者修理、更换。 
Second officer is responsible for winding (or changing battery) and correction for all the clocks in 
public area of the ship. If the clock is broken or runs slow or fast significantly, apply for cleaning, 
oiling or replacement in time. 
1.14.9 船员住室的船钟由个人上弦（或更换电池）和校正，需要检修时，交由二副办理。 

376

航行制度                                 版本/修改：3.0/4.0                    SHIP-05-05 
Navigation Regulations                             Version/Rev.: 3.0/4.0                        SHIP-05-05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                生效日期：2023/08/21               第5/14 页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.            Effective Date: 2023/08/21                   Page: 5/14 
Crew member is responsible for winding (or changing battery) and correction clocks in crew 
accommodation. If inspection and maintenance is required, hand over to second officer. 
 
2. 航海图书资料的管理 
Nautical Publications andCharts Management 
2.1 船舶应配备的图书 
Nautical Publications and Documents Required to be Carried Onboard Ships 
2.1.1 航海图书资料包括各种海图、灯标表、航路指南、航海表、潮汐表、国际避碰
规则、国际信号规则以及其他各种航海技术图表和资料等。 
Nautical publications and charts include all the charts, list of light, sailing directions, nautical 
table, tide table, international regulations for preventing collisions, international code of signals, 
and all the other nautical technical charts and materials. 
2.1.2 船舶图书应根据IMO规定按营运航区的范围和相应船旗国要求配齐航海图书资
料。 
The nautical publications should be carried according to the IMO regulations, according to the 
scope of the navigation area and the requirements of the corresponding flag state. 
2.1.3 一些海事管理机构强制性的要求船舶在途经其水域时使用当地出版的海图或要
求的配备的额外图书，船长应与当地代理确认，并遵守相应的规章。 
Some Maritime Administrations may require the compulsory use of locally published charts or 
additional publications required while transiting their waters. Masters are required to verify with 
local agents and comply with the concerned regulations accordingly. 
2.1.4 请参考附录1 航海图书基本配备清单进行相应配备。 
Please refer to Appendix 1 Basic List of Nautical Publications to be carried on board for the 
corresponding carriage. 
 
2.2 二副应及时将航海图书资料的最新版本登入书籍、海图、航海书籍的登记表中。 
Second officer should keep record of the latest version of the nautical publications and charts in the 
publications, charts or nautical publications registration form. 
2.3 航海图书资料应放在海图室内的固定位置，不得携走。 
Nautical publications and charts should be kept in a fixed position in the chart-room, and may not be 
carried away. 
2.4 船舶接到航次任务，船长要迅速通知二副核查本航次所需航海资料，及时将所用航海资料
改正到最新，如资料缺少，应迅速通知公司海务部门安排或自购。 
Upon receiving voyage task, the master should inform second officer immediately to check the nautical 
publicatins and charts necessary for the voyage and update to the latest. In case of lack marine department 
shall be promptly informed to make arrangements or direct purchase. 
2.5 在收到新的图书资料（包括航海通告）后，船长应及时通知海务部门。 
Upon receiving new nautical publications or charts (including Notice to Mariners), the master should 
inform the marine department in time. 
2.6 海图应按图号顺序妥善放置。本航次所用的海图画完航线后，可按使用的先后次序用铅笔
另编使用顺序号，依次放在便于取用的柜屉内，航次结束后，将使用顺序号擦去，以便下
次另编，但航迹应保留到下次使用该图。

Charts should be placed in proper order. If the sailing route of the voyage is done, may mark the sequence 
number with pencil and place them in a convenient drawer. After the voyage, erase the sequence number 
in order to reuse next time. However, the sailing tracks should be remained till the next time. 
2.7 船长、驾驶员均应认真阅读所接收的航行警告。 
Master, deck officers should read all the navigation warnings received carefully. 
2.8 严禁使用过期及未改正至最新的航海资料。二副要保证本航次的图书资料完整、有效并改
正到最新。有关英版海图及航海资料的改正方法请参阅THE MARINER’S HANDBOOK
（NP100）。 
Use of the outdated and not updated nautical materials are strongly prohibited. Second officer is 
responsible to ensure the publications and materials for the current voyage are complete, effective and 
updated. To learn more about the correction of the English version chart and nautical materials, please 
refer to THE MARINER’S HANDBOOK (NP100). 
 
3. 航海图书资料的改正和更新 
Correction and Update of Nautical Publications and Charts 
3.1 海图改正：在收到航海通告后，二副应； 
Chart correction: upon receiving the Notice to Mariners, the second officer should: 
3.1.1 立即完成本航次所用海图的改正； 
Immediately complete the correction of the voyage chart; 
3.1.2 立即将作废海图撤除，标记“作废”字样后移出海图室，并将作废海图号在NP133A、
海图登记表中删除； 
Invalid charts should be withdrawn immediately, marked with “Superseded” and removed from the 
chart-room. The superseded chart number should be deleted from NP133A and the chart registration 
form. 
3.1.3 尽快将海图的小改正号登记至NP133A 中； 
Register the small correction number of the chart in NP133A as soon as possible; 
3.1.4 不得将未实际改正的小改正号登至海图上的小改正栏中； 
Small correction number which has not been actually corrected is not allowed to register in the small 
correction column on the sea chart; 
3.1.5 将已改正的最后一个小改正号及年份登入海图登记表中。 
Fill in the last corrected small correction number and the year in the sea chart registration form. 
3.2 “英版航海图书总目录”（NP131）的改正：根据英版航海通告第I 部分中的有关海图
图书的新版、改版、作废等信息，使用红色改正笔对“英版航海图书总目录”（NP131）
进行相应的改正。 
Correction of “Catalogue of ADMIRALTY Charts and Publications” (NP131): according to information 
about new version, revision, superseded of the charts and publications, in Part I of the Admiralty Notice 
to Mariners, correct the “Catalogue of ADMIRALTY Charts and Publications” (NP131) with red pen 
accordingly. 
3.2.1 删除已经作废的海图信息时，除在“英版航海图书总目录”相应页码和图幅上删除其
相应图号及内容、图框外，还应删除索引（Part9）中的相应内容； 
When deleting the superseded charts information, besides deleting the chart number, content and frame 
from the corresponding page of the “Catalogue of ADMIRALTY Charts and Publications”, also delete 
the relevant content from the index (Part 9).

航行制度                                 版本/修改：3.0/4.0                    SHIP-05-05 
Navigation Regulations                             Version/Rev.: 3.0/4.0                        SHIP-05-05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                生效日期：2023/08/21               第7/14 页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.            Effective Date: 2023/08/21                   Page: 7/14 
3.2.2 增加新图信息时，应先在“英版航海图书总目录”相应页码的空白处增加新图图号及
版本信息后，在其相应图幅内标注新图的图框和图号，同时在索引（Part9）中增加相
应的内容； 
When adding new charts information, insert the new chart number and version number in the margin on 
the corresponding page in “Catalogue of ADMIRALTY Charts and Publications”, mark the new chart 
number and frame on the corresponding chart, and add the corresponding content in the index (Part 9). 
3.2.3 在图书资料改版时，首先将“英版航海图书总目录”相应页码上原有的出版日期、版
本划掉后，加入新的出版日期及版本信息，同时在相应的索引中进行修改。 
In the case of revision of publications and charts first cross out the original publication date and version 
from the relevant page in “Catalogue of ADMIRALTY Charts and Publications”, then insert with the 
new publication date and version information, meanwhile, update the information in the corresponding 
index. 
3.3 临时通告（T）和预告（P） 
Temporary and Preliminary Notices 
3.3.1 设立专用文件夹保存临时通告和预告，分25 个区域分别剪贴。区域名称详见“航海
通告年度摘要”NP247(1)第二部分中的地理索引； 
Set up dedicated folders for Temporary and Preliminary Notices, clip and paste separately by 25 areas. 
Area name can be referred from “Annual Summary of Admiralty Notices to Mariners” NP247 (1), 
Section 2 geographic index. 
3.3.2 每年初出版的“航海通告年度摘要”的第二部分中汇总了该摘要出版前的有效临时通
告和预告，因此在收到新的“航海通告年度摘要”后，可将文件夹中早于该摘要出版
日期的临时通告和预告撤除； 
Section 2 of the “Annual Summary of Admiralty Notices to Mariners” published each year summarizes 
all the valid temporary and preliminary notices before its publication. Therefore, upon receiving the new 
“Annual Summary of Admiralty Notices to Mariners”, remove temporary and preliminary notices 
before the publication date from the folder; 
3.3.3 在日常工作中，专用文件夹和最新版的“航海通告年度摘要”应结合使用； 
In daily work, the dedicated folders should be used combined with the latest “Annual Summary of 
Admiralty Notices to Mariners”. 
3.3.4 临时通告和预告用铅笔改正，改正完毕后在海图左下角小改正处另起一行用铅笔登
记。如有有效期的，则应在海图改正处标明。 
Temporary and preliminary notice should be corrected with pencil. With the correction done, make 
remarks on the bottom left corner of the sea chart with pencil. Term of validity should be marked 
alongside the correction if applicable. 
3.4 航行警告 
Navigation Warnings 
3.4.1 设立专用文件夹保存航行警告，分航区（NAVAREA）分别剪贴。航区名称详见无线
电信号表第5 册（NP285）“海上安全信息”（MSI）中有关航行警告的章节； 
Set up dedicated folder for keeping navigation warnings, clip and paste separately according to 
NAVAREAs. Area name can be referred from chapters in “Maritime Safety Information” about 
navigational warning in “Admiralty List of Radio Signals: Volume 5” (NP285); 
3.4.2 用铅笔将航行警告标注在相应的海图上； 
Navigational warnings should be marked with pencil on the relevant chart;

4. 电子航海出版物 
Electronic Navigational Publications 
4.1 电子航海出版物的管理要求同纸质航海出版物一样，也应充足并保持更新，但没必要
重复。 
The management requirements for electronic nautical publications are the same as paper 
nautical publications. They should be adequate and kept updated, but there is no need to 
overlap. 
4.2 适用电子航海出版物要求的船舶，需采用区分于主用户系统的方法进行存贮或保管，
以便于在短时间内可供值班高级船员（OOW）使用。电子航海出版物需受到保护并免
遭病毒侵害。 
Ships that apply the requirements of electronic nautical publications shall be saved or kept as an 
additional back-up by a method separated from the main user system so that they can be made available 
to the officer on watch (OOW) within a short period of time. The nautical publication is protected from 
virus. 
4.3 电子海图的使用和更新参考本章第18 节《电子海图显示信息系统的使用须知》的要求。 
The use and update of electronic charts refer to the requirements in Section 18 of this chapter 
"Instructions for the Use of Electronic Chart Display Information Systems".

第06 节 海图作业规则 
Section 06 Charting operation Rules 
 
1.0 总则 
General 
1.1 驾驶员的海图作业要清晰正规，使用统一的航海名词、代号，以便准确掌握船位，保
证船舶航行安全。 
The OOW charting operations to be clear and formal, use the unified nautical terms, code, in order to 
accurately grasp the position, to ensure the ship navigation safety. 
1.2 船长应对驾驶员的海图作业进行检查指导；驾驶员应认真作业，发现问题及时报告船
长。 
The captain should check and guide the OOW chart operations. The OOW should conscientiously 
operation, report the problems found to the captain in time. 
1.3 海图作业的基本要求： 
The basic requirements for chart operations: 
1.3.1 要熟悉航区情况。 
Be familiar with the navigation area situation. 
1.3.2 熟练掌握各种航海仪器的性能特点和使用方法，经常核对并准确掌握其误差数据。 
Familiar with the performance characteristics of various navigation instruments and using methods, 
often check and accurately grasp the error data. 
1.3.3 测定船位要做到准、快、及时，接近海岸、岛、礁、通过海峡或接近港口时的重要船
位用多种定位方法反复核对。 
Determination of the ship to be accurate, fast, timely, close to the coast, islands, reefs, the important 
positions through the strait or near the port, should use a variety of positioning methods to cross check. 
1.3.4 应使用距离避险线在海图上标明计划航线附近的浅点、礁石等碍航物，并同时标注碍
航物距计划航线的正横距离。 
Distance off line should be used to indicate on the chart the shallow spots, reefs and other obstructions 
near the planned route, and at the same time mark the abeam distance off of the obstruction in planned 
route. 
1.3.5 在狭窄水道（包括分道通航水域）中航行时，应尽量使用距离避险线和方位避险线，
应将避险物标至计划航线的正横距离或避险方位在海图上标明。 
When navigating in a narrow channel (including traffic separation scheme), distance avoidance lines 
and azimuth avoidance lines should be used as far as possible. Should mark the avoiding object to the 
planned route's abeam distance or avoidance azimuth on the charts. 
1.3.6 航经海岸、岛、礁、海峡或接近港口时要及时换用最新改正过的大比例尺海图,并认
真查阅图上说明及注意事项。 
When navigating coasts, islands, reefs, straits or near seaports, it is necessary to promptly change the 
newly revised large scale charts, and conscientiously refer to the explanations and cautions on the 
charts. 
1.3.7 换续海图时，必须将上一张海图上的最后一个船位正确地移位到下一张海图上，并利用
经纬度和显著目标的方位、距离相互仔细核对，不同版海图交替使用时尤应注意。 
When change to next chart, must correctly shift the last ship position on the previous chart to the next 
chart and, carefully checked against each other using the latitude and longitude and the bearing and 
range of the notable target. Pay special attention when the different editions of charts are used 
interchangeably. 
1.3.8 海图作业时，不得有两张海图同时在海图桌上展开，以免用错比例尺。

航行制度                         版本/修改：3.0/0.0                   SHIP-05-06 
Navigation Regulations                    Version/Rev.: 3.0/0.0                    SHIP-05-06 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2018/04/01             第2/2页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2018/04/01                 Page: 2/2 
During the charting operation, no two charts shall be simultaneously unfolded on the chart table, to 
prevent the use of wrong scale. 
1.3.9 测天定位时不准拼凑船位，当出现误差三角形时，应认真分析,找出原因，再行处理。 
When doing celestial positioning, combine positioning is not allowed. When there is error triangle, 
should be carefully analyzed to find out the reasons, and then deal with. 
1.3.10 接班驾驶员应对计划航线、实际航迹、航向、上一班的交班船位仔细查对核实，防
止因错误而发生危险。 
The takeover OOW should carefully check and verify the planned route, actual track, course and the 
handover ship position of previous watch, to prevent the danger from being wrong. 
1.3.11 本航次进行的海图作业，必须保留到下一次开始使用该张海图时方可擦去，以备查
考。如发生海事，应将当时进行作业的海图妥善保存，以供海事调查之用。如营运
需用，可另购（领）新图。 
This chart operation of this voyage, must be retained until the next time start to use the chart can be 
erased, to prepare for checking and inspection. In the case of a maritime incident, the chart used for 
operation at that time should be properly kept, for the purpose of maritime investigation. If the 
operation needs, can purchase (apply) new map. 
2.0 观测船位 
Observe position 
2.1 为了保证安全航行，必须充分利用各种方法测定船位，在船舶转向前必须测定船位。 
In order to ensure navigation safe, must full use of various methods to determine the ship position. A 
position must be determined before turning the ship. 
2.2 大洋航行时，利用GPS 每小时定位一次，当条件允许时，应进行测天定位。  
When ocean navigation, use the GPS fix a position once per hour, when conditions permit, the celestial 
position fixing should be carried out. 
2.3 当沿岸航行或在港内有比较显著的物标可取得比较准确的陆标船位时应利用此机会对
GPS 船位的准确性进行核对，并将比对结果记入《GPS 记录簿》。 
When coastal navigation or in the harbor, more significant landmarks to obtain more accurate land mark 
position, should be used to check the GPS ship's position accuracy, and the results of the comparison into 
the "GPS log book." 
2.4 沿岸航行时，应使用多种方法定位，至少每30 分钟定位一次；在狭水道、接近危险地
区或航速15 节以上时，应适当缩短定位的间隔时间或按船长要求随时测定船位。 
When coastal navigation, a variety of methods should use to fix position, at least every 30 minutes to fix a 
position; in the narrow channel, near dangerous areas or speed more than 15 knots, the position fixing 
interval should be shortened appropriately or according to the captain requirement to fix the ship's 
position at any time. 
2.5 当长时间大洋航行结束初见陆标或浮标时，应及时测定GPS 和雷达陆标船位或方位陆
标船位并仔细进行核对，直到确认船位、物标无误。 
When a long time ocean voyage ended, see the first landmarks or buoys, should fix a GPS position and 
radar landmarks position or azimuth landmarks position, and carefully checked, until the confirmation of 
the ship position, the landmarks are correct. 
2.6 接近浅滩、礁石或水深变化显著的水域，应连续等间距测深，取得系统数据，以便和
观测船位互相核对。 
Close to the shoals, reefs or waters with significant changes in depth of water, should continuous equally 
interval sounding, to obtain system data for reconciliation with the observed ship position. 
2.7 应坚持先避让后定位的原则。 
Should adhere to “give way first, fix position latter” principle.

第07 节  夜航须知 
Section 07 Night navigation instruction 
 
1.0 船长的夜航职责 
Captain night navigation responsibilities 
1.1 夜间航行(或锚泊)，船长应监督并指导三副的夜航值班。 
During the night navigation (or anchoring), the captain shall oversee and direct the third officer night 
navigation watch. 
1.2 任何时候当值班驾驶员唤醒时，应尽快到达驾驶台。 
Whenever wakes up by OOW, should reach the bridge as soon as possible. 
1.3 航行和锚泊时，船长在每天就寝前应将有关要求、注意事项或其他重要指示详细、明
确地写入《船长夜航命令簿》。船长临时更改船长夜航命令内容，应告知当班驾驶员，
并在更改处签字，船长应检查并督促值班驾驶员严格执行船长夜航命令。 
During navigation and anchoring, every day before bedtime, the master shall write the Master Night 
Order Book about the relevant requirements, precautions or other important instructions. When master 
temporarily change the content, should notify the OOW, and sign at the changes. The master shall inspect 
and urge OOW to strictly enforce master’s night order. 
1.4 船长应根据实际需要在《船长夜航命令簿》中发布夜航命令，通常包括下列内容： 
The captain shall be according to actual needs, issue a night order in "Master’s Night Order Book", 
usually including the following contents: 
 保持正规瞭望，以及对瞭望的特殊要求；避让的要求及注意事项。 
Maintain a proper lookout, and special expectations of lookout; avoidance action requirements and 
precaution. 
 谨慎驾驶，注意操舵，校对航向，注意助航仪器、航行灯、信号灯的情况； 
Carefully navigation, pay attention to the steering, verify the course, pay attention to navigation 
equipment, navigation lights, signal lights situation; 
 注意气象变化及应采取的措施； 
Pay attention to weather changes and measures to be taken; 
 观察到预定的航标、陆地、水深或应见但未见时的措施； 
Observed expected aids to navigation, land, water depth or measures for not seeing the expected. 
 有任何疑问时的措施； 
Action to be taken When there is any doubt; 
 对货物管理的特殊指示； 
Special instructions for cargo management; 
 其他必要的指示； 
Other necessary instructions 
2.0 值班驾驶员的夜航职责 
OOW night navigation duty 
值班驾驶员夜航时，除了航行值班的一般要求外，尤其应重视下述夜航职责： 
When OOW night navigation, in addition to the general requirements for navigation watch, particular 
attention should be given to the following night navigation duties: 
2.1 按规定提前15 分钟到驾驶台等候接班，并进行下述： 
According to the provisions, arrive the bridge 15 minutes before, and proceed as follows: 
 来到两翼甲板，检查号灯显示情况，察看海面情况，适应夜视。 
Come to the two bridge wings, check the signal lights showing condition, look at the sea conditions, to

第08 节 船舶锚泊注意事项 
Section 08 Anchored Operation Precaution 
 
1. 进、出锚地计划的制定及注意事项 
Establishment of the in, out anchorage plan and precautions 
1.1 船长应根据地形、水深、底质、锚地抓力、气象、风流、碍航物、遮蔽性、船舶密度及
船舶的装载状态选择适宜的锚位，并制定出进、出锚地计划和抛（起）锚方案。 
The master shall select the appropriate anchorage based on the land configuration， water depth, the nature 
of ground, holding ground condition , the weather, the wind and current, the obstructions, the degree of 
shelter afforded, the density of the ship and other ship loading conditions, and draw up in, out anchorage 
plan and let go (heave up) anchor method. 
1.2  为防止走锚造成事故船舶应： 
To prevent an accident in the event that the anchor drags，the ship shall： 
 与其它船舶保持安全距离Keep a safe distance from other ships 
 与浅滩/其他设施保持安全距离Keep a safe distance from shallows/other facilities 
 如果走锚时使用主机/舵机/来恢复操纵能力，在评估可能需要的区域时，应考虑以下
项目： 
The following items shall be considered when assessing the area which may be needed while 
restoring manoeuvre ability by using the main engine/rudder if the anchor drags. 
1) 回旋圆的半径  A radius of swinging circle 
半径为最小所需锚链长度+船舶总长的圆圈 
A circle with a radius of minimum required length of anchor chain + the ship’s LOA 
2) 在风压作用下走锚的速度The speed of dragging anchor under wind pressure force 
这大约是3 到4 节的速度。This is approximately 3 to 4 knots. 
3) 起锚所需时间Required time to weigh anchor 
一般情况下，一根锚链的收回速度约为9 米/分钟  
An anchor cable will be retrieved at a rate of about 9m/min 
捞起1 节锚链大约需要3 分钟。To retrieve 1 shackle takes about 3minutes. 
可能不能连续不断地绞进锚链，从而延长了起锚的操作时间。 
In general, it may not be possible to heave in a taught cable continuously, thus prolonging the 
operation of weighing anchor. 
4) 主机准备使用所需时间。Required time to prepare the main engine for use. 
如果预测要拖锚，要事先让主机处于待机状态。 
To have the main engine on standby beforehand, if dragging anchor is predicted. 
5) 当船舶被风吹到下风处后，恢复机动性时，达到足够的推进速度所需的时间。 
The required time to attain sufficient propelling speed when restoring manoeuvrability after the 
vessel has been forced to leeward with the wind on the beam. 
1.3 制定进、出锚地计划的原则 
Develop the in, out anchorage plan principles 
1.3.1 一般在锚地边缘抛锚，便于进、出，尤其是重载散装船。 
Generally anchored at the edge of an anchorage, to facilitate easy in and out, especially laden bulk 
carriers. 
1.3.2 严禁近距离穿越他船船艏，特别是在风流较强的情况下。 
It is forbidden to cross the other ship’s bow at close range, especially in strong wind and current 
condition.

1.3.3 尽量不从两锚泊船之间穿过。 
Try not to pass between two anchored ships. 
1.3.4 根据风流及本船的装载状态提前调整好本船进出锚地的船艏向。 
According to the wind, current and the ship loading condition, to adjust the ship‘s heading to in and out 
anchorage in advance. 
1.3.5 根据锚地水深、天气和锚地抓力计算出链长度，出链长度一般建议如下： 
良好天气：锚链长度=3d+90 米（d=水深，米） 
恶劣天气：锚链长度=4d+145 米（d=水深，米） 
According to the anchorage water depth, expected weather and anchorage grip to calculate the chain out 
length, the chain out length is generally recommended as follows: 
Fine weather: L=3d+90m (d=Depth of water in meters) 
Rough weather: L=4d+145m (d=Depth of water in meters) 
1.3.6 如条件许可，应尽量选择平流或流速较小时进出锚地。 
If the conditions permit, try to choose a slack water or small flow rate period to in and out anchorage. 
1.3.7 原则上，超大型船舶不宜采用进抛法。 
In principle, very large ships should not use the running moor method. 
1.4 注意事项： 
Precaution: 
1.3.1 船长应根据港口和锚地情况提前到驾驶台进行指挥。 
The master shall according to the port and anchorage condition, command at the bridge in advance. 
1.3.2 进入锚地时，提前控制好船舶余速。对超大型船舶而言，重载抛锚时的速度应控制在
0.5 节以下。 
When entering the anchorage, control the ship residual speed in advance. For very large vessels, the speed 
in full loaded condition should be controlled below 0.5 knots. 
1.3.3 值班驾驶员应按照进出锚地安全检查表进行检查并记录。 
OOW should be in accordance with the Anchoring Checklist to check and record. 
1.3.4 按港口要求及时报告船舶动态。 
According to the port requirements, timely report the ship movement. 
1.3.5 在距岸较近、易受风浪侵袭、流速较强的锚地锚泊，或在锚地进行装卸货作业，以及
船长认为必要时，应保持主机处于随时可用状态。 
When close to the shore, vulnerable to invasion by wind wave, anchored strong flow rate anchorage, or 
loading and discharge operation at anchorages, and if the master deemed necessary, should maintain the 
main engine on standby status. 
1.3.6 起锚进港要根据当时的情况计算适当的起锚时间，避免因起锚过早或过晚在引航员登
轮点漂航等候或为了抢时间在锚地里穿越。 
When heave up anchor and proceed to port, should base on the actual situation, calculate the appropriate 
heave up anchor time, to avoid heave up anchor too early or too late, to drift at the pilot boarding point or 
to pass through the anchorage at save time. 
1.3.7 抛、起锚期间，大副应保持与驾驶台的通讯畅通，及时将锚链的方向、受力情况、长
度等报告至驾驶台。 
During letting go, heaving up anchor, the chief officer should maintain smooth communication with the 
bridge, report the direction of the chain, the force situation, length, etc. to the bridge in a timely manner. 
1.3.8 船长、大副应对所有驾驶员进行锚泊设备操作方面的培训。 
The master, chief officer should train all OOW in the operation of anchoring equipment.

Anchor operation precaution 
2.1 备锚操作 
Prepare anchor operation 
2.1.1 
操作人员应佩戴必要的PPE（人员防护装备），包括防护眼镜、头盔等。  
Operators should wear necessary PPE (personal protective equipment), including protective glasses and 
helmets.

备锚前，大副应亲自或指派专人对锚设备，特别是止链器、刹车机构、离合器等部
位进行检查。 
Before prepare anchor, the chief officer should personally or assigned person to conduct inspection on the 
anchor equipment, in particular chain stopper, brake, clutch and other parts. 
2.1.3 大副提前向船长了解所选择锚位的水深及底质以防止误操作。 
The chief officer should in advance learn from the captain the depth and bottom sediment of the selected 
anchor position, to prevent mis-operation. 
2.1.4 无风流时两舷锚应交换使用，有风流时宜使用上风流一舷的锚。 
When no wind and current, anchor of two sides should be used alternatively. With wind and current, 
should use the windward side anchor. 
2.1.5 备锚：海面平静船体不激烈摇摆时，使用锚机送锚至水面附近后用刹车刹紧（脱开离
合器）；海面不平静船舶摇摆时可用锚机把锚冠松出且保留锚杆末端在锚链筒内并用刹
车刹紧（脱开离合器）； 
Prepare anchor: when calm sea, ship is not rolling, use the windlass to walk back anchor above the water, 
brake on (disengaging clutch). When not calm sea, ship is rolling, use the windlass to walk back anchor 
crown, retained the shank end inside the hawsepipe, brake on (disengaging clutch). 
2.2 抛锚 
Drop anchoring 
水深小于25 米的抛锚操作听到抛锚命令（大型船舶谨慎使用），即：  
The anchoring operation, water depth less than 25 meters. When hear the let go anchor order, should: 
2.2.1 速松开刹车带使锚自由落下。 
Brake off, allows the anchor to drop freely. 
2.2.2 出链到两节甲板开始首次刹牢，而后视锚链方向、张力再反复松、刹锚链，直至抓牢。 
Pay out until two shackles cable on deck, start to apply brake, depend on the anchor chain direction, 
tension, repeatedly loose and brake anchor cable, until brought up. 
2.3 深水抛锚 
Deep water anchoring 
水深超过25 米适应采用深水抛锚。 
Water depth more than 25 meters, use the deep water anchoring. 
2.3.1 水深25-50 米的抛锚操作 
Water depth between 25-50 meters anchoring operation 
用锚机送链放锚距海底5-10 米时，脱开离合器，缓松刹车把锚抛出。 
Use windlass to walk back anchor 5-10 meters from the seabed, disengage the clutch, brake off slowly to 
drop the anchor. 
2.3.2 水深超过50 米的抛锚操作 
Water depth more than 50 meters anchoring operation 
抵达抛锚位置时控制船舶基本不动，用锚机松锚链，待锚触底后，在继续松链时适当
用倒车使船缓慢后退，用锚机将锚链松至要抛出锚链的长度后再用刹车刹牢并脱开锚
机。松链时不宜过快，防止锚链堆积在海底，导致锚链绞缠。

Maximum anchoring depth 
驾驶台须张贴通告说明锚机牵引力和考虑锚和锚链重量的最大锚泊深度。 
A notice must be posted on the bridge stating windlass hauling capacity and maximum anchoring depth

为计算最大的锚泊深度，三方面的资料是必需的： 
Information on three factors is required for calculating the maximum anchoring depth:   
 锚重——从船舶数据里获得； 
The weight of the Anchor – obtained from vessel data;  
  锚链的重量——从船舶数据里获得； 
Weight of the anchor cable - obtained from vessel data; 
 锚机的牵引力——从制造商的数据里获得。 
Hauling capacity of the windlass – available from the maker’s data.  
建议扣减20%的锚机牵引力作为余量以抵消老化和磨损。 
It is suggested that a 20 percent allowance be deducted from the hauling capacity of the windlass to allow 
for age and friction.   
在起锚中，锚机最大的负荷在锚即将离底时产生。这时锚和锚链的总重量必须不超过

Whilst weighing anchor, the maximum load on the windlass will occurs when the anchor just leave the 
bottom. The combined weight of anchor and cable at this stage must never exceed the hauling capacity 
of the windlass. The maximum anchoring depth of each ship shall be calculated and posted near the 
echo-sounder.   
千万不要锚泊在超过锚机牵引力水深的地方！Do not anchor in depths beyond windlass hauling 
capacity!  
2.4 大风浪锚泊heavy weather at anchor 
2.4.1 
通常情况下，在遮蔽水域风力达到25m/s（蒲氏风级10 级）、无浪、水流5 节
及以上，开阔水域风力达到最大11m/s（蒲氏风级6 级）、浪高2 米（有义波高）、
水流3 节情况下锚泊即视为大风浪锚泊。 
Under normal circumstances, anchoring in sheltered waters with a wind speed of 25m/s (Beaufort scale 
10), no waves, and a current of 5 knots or more, and in open waters with a maximum wind speed of 
11m/s (Beaufort scale 6), a wave height of 2 meters (meaningful wave height), and a current of 3 knots 
is considered anchoring in heavy weather. 
2.4.2 大风浪锚泊操作，容易导致设备损坏、断链、丟锚，应特别谨慎。原则上应在主机备
妥、车舵配合情况下方可进行锚泊作业（包括抛、起锚、松链）。 
The operation of anchoring in heavy weather can easily lead to equipment damage, chain breakage, and 
anchor loss, and special caution should be exercised. In principle, anchoring operations (including let go 
anchor, weigh anchor, and walk out chain) should be carried out only when the main engine is ready and 
the main engine and rudder is coordinated. 
2.4.3 为了避免已受力的锚链受突风、大浪的冲击导致锚设备过载（特别是油马达负荷突变，
内压过高）受损破裂及意外伤人，大风浪中锚泊操作应注意： 
In order to avoid overloading of anchor equipment (especially sudden changes in oil motor load and 
high internal pressure), damage, rupture, and accidental injury to personnel caused by sudden winds and

2.4.3.1 驾驶台瞭望人员及船艏工作人员应保持连续观察涌浪、海浪规律性变化，预判大浪来

The bridge lookout personnel and bow staff should keep continuously observing the regular changes of

operation, brake on, drop the chain stopper, and continue the operation after the large waves have passed. 
2.4.3.2 起锚操作中，应通过车、舵配合，船艏工作人员连续观测锚链，确保锚链接近垂直（不

should continuously observe the anchor chain to ensure that the anchor chain is close to vertical 
(without stress) before weigh the anchor. In order to avoid sudden force impact on the anchor oil motor, 
it is necessary to be prepared to use the brake to control the anchor chain at any time. 
2.4.3.3 松链操作前，应操纵车、舵，使锚链垂直或接近垂直，随后通过刹车松链，或者通过

Before lower down the chain operation, the main engine and rudder should be manipulated to make the 
anchor chain vertical or close to vertical, and then lower down the chain by braking, or walk out the 
chain by anchor machine (WALK OUT) and braking in conjunction. Lower down the chain with the 
brake by controlling the speed of lower down the chain and increasing the frequency of braking as much 
as possible. 
2.4.4 如果到达锚地时天气恶劣，船长可以避免抛锚。在这种情况下，船长应立即通知办公
室、船东、租船人和其他有关方面他的意图。 
In case of weather being heavy on arriving at anchorage, Master’s may avoid anchoring. In such case 
the Master shall immediately notify the office, owners, Charterers, and other concerned parties of his 
intentions. 
2.5 应急抛锚Emergency Anchoring 
2.5.1 幸运的是，在紧急情况下必须抛锚的情况很少。在大多数情况下，如果部署时的漂流
速度超过半节，那么船舶的锚就不可能阻止一艘大船。由于锚的保持力与船舶的大小
不成正比，船舶越大，紧急抛锚对阻止船舶运动的效果就越差。尽管如此，在紧急情
况下，应该考虑使用一切可用的手段，包括使用锚。 
It is fortunately rare to have to anchor a ship in an emergency. In most circumstances, it is unlikely that 
the ship's anchors would be capable of stopping a large vessel if the rate of drift at the time of 
deployment is in excess of about half a knot. As anchor-holding power is not proportional to vessel size, 
the larger the vessel, the less effective emergency anchoring is likely to be in arresting the vessel's 
motion. Despite this, in an emergency, every available means, including the use of the anchors, should 
be considered for use.  
2.5.2 可能影响到紧急抛锚成功的因素包括： 
The factors likely to impact on the success of emergency anchoring include: 
▪ 船舶大小Size of the vessel 
▪ 对地速度Speed over the ground 
▪ 海床的陡峭程度和靠近浅滩的地方 Steepness of the seabed and proximity of shoals 
▪ 海床的性质和锚的预期保持力

Precautions during anchoring

Anchor watch

In case of weather being severe or if there are forecasts available of heavy weather, the Master shall look 
into possibilities of picking up anchor as early as possible and proceed to sea or sheltered waters. In such 
case he shall notify the office, owners, Charterers, and all other concerned parties of the same. 
Master’s decision should not be influenced by perceived commercial pressures such as 
▪ Consumption of additional bunkers for picking up and steaming 
▪ Concerns that leaving an anchorage may affect vessel’s Notice of readiness or her berthing schedule. 
▪ Desire not to interrupt staff rest periods 
3.1.8 
在预测天气迅速恶化的情况下，船长必须及时决定是否： 
In the event that rapidly deteriorating weather is forecast, the Master must make timely    decisions 
whether to: 
▪ 对于空载船舶，在天气恶化之前，进行重压载。 
For the ship in ballast, heavy ballasting should be carried out before the weather deteriorates. 
▪ 抛出另外一只锚deploy an extra anchor 
▪ 松出更多的锚链 pay out more anchor cable 
▪ 起锚离开锚地weigh anchor and depart the anchorage

3.1.9 如遇风力突然增强，船舶出现偏荡过大等情况时，值班人员应及时报告船长。 
In the event of a sudden increase of wind force, the ship appears excessive yawing situation, the OOW 
should promptly report the captain. 
3.1.10 当使用车舵减轻锚链受力时，大副必须到船头查看锚链方向，报告和协助驾驶台操

When using the engine and rudder to relieve the stress on the anchor chain, the chief officer must 
approach the bow to see the direction of the anchor chain, report and assist the bridge to steer the 
rudder. 
3.1.11 发现本船走锚时，值班驾驶员应立即采取报告船长、通知机舱备车、尽快抛下另一

3.3  走锚Dragging anchor 
涉及抛锚船舶的事故通常发生在走锚时，船舶在没有保持力的情况下漂移，导致碰撞
和/或搁浅或擦底的情况。 
应考虑以下因素： 
Accidents involving ships at anchor usually occur when the anchor drags and the vessel drifts without 
holding power, leading to collisions and/or groundings or stranding’s. The following considerations 
should be taken into account: 
▪ 尽管船在漂流，但要意识到走锚需要一些时间。因此，警惕的驾驶台值班是必不可少的。 
It can take some time to realize the anchor is dragging, despite the ship drifting. 
A vigilant bridge watch is, therefore, essential. 
▪ 需要一些时间来起锚，并将船舶恢复到完全可操纵的状态，尽管这段时间船舶可能在
漂流。应急计划必须到位，以确保快速反应时间。 
It takes some time to weigh the anchor and restore the ship to full manoeuverable condition, even though 
the ship may be drifting for that period. Contingency plans must be in place to ensure rapid response 
times. 
▪ 在检测到拖曳开始到完全控制船舶的可操作性这段时间内，船舶可能会危险地靠近其
它船舶，或撞上另一艘船舶或结构，或进入浅滩水域。 
During the period beginning with the detection of dragging to the time full control is achieved over the 
ship’s manoeuverability, the vessel may run dangerously close aboard, or into another ship or structure, 
or into shoal water.  
  
3.4 走锚后采取的应急措施及其效果 
Emergency measures taken and their effectiveness after dragging anchor 
3.4.1 一旦船锚开始拖动，应立即采取应对措施。这些措施包括称量锚的重量，以恢复可操
作的状态，然后重新抛锚，在漂流安全的地区寻求庇护，或返回公海。 
Once an anchor starts to drag, immediate counter-measures should be taken. These include weighing the 
anchor in order to restore a maneuvoerable condition and then re-anchoring, seeking sheltering in an area 
where drifting is safe, or returning to the open sea. 
3.4.2 如果船舶周围有空间，也没有其他船只停泊，可能有时间通过顶风航行和起锚来恢复
控制状态。 
Should there be space around the ship with no other vessels lying at anchor, there may be time to restore a 
controlled condition by stemming the wind and weighing anchor.

3.4.2.1 放出额外的锚链和使用第二的锚 
Veering an Additional Cable and Use of the Second Anchor 
一旦船舶开始被压向下风，惯性就会增加，需要更多的动力来克服它。在走锚的早期
阶段，当横摇运动变得明显时，在船舶以越来越快的速度被压向下风之前，放出更多
的锚链或部署第二个锚可能是有益的。然而，增加更多的锚链预计不会显著增加锚设
备的抓力。在第一个锚上增加锚链不被看作是阻止船舶被压和漂向下风的有效手段。 
Once a ship starts to be pressed to leeward, inertia increases and more power is required to overcome it. At 
the very early stage of dragging, when the horsing motion becomes apparent, and before the ship is 
pressed to leeward with increasing speed, it may be beneficial to veer more cable, or to deploy a second 
anchor. Nevertheless, the addition of more cable is not expected to increase significantly the holding 
power of the system. Adding cable to the first anchor is not seen as an effective means of stopping a ship 
from being pressed and drifting to leeward.

为了保持船首迎风，结合大舵角，主机所需功率大致如下: 
In order to maintain a ship’s head into the wind, in conjunction with large rudder angles, the required 
power of the main engine is approximately as follows:  
 
舵：满舵 
Steering： Hard Over

车钟Engine Order 
20m/sec 
Slow Ahead

30m/sec

在恶劣的天气下，由于船舶的横摇、纵摇和偏荡等，可能需要不同的发动机设置， 
但要始终牢记需要避免螺旋桨空转。 
In rough weather with the vessel rolling, pitching, and yawing, etc., different engine settings may be 
needed, always bearing in mind the need to avoid propeller racing. 
 
3.5 锚泊期间对主机的维修保养Maintenance on main engine while at anchor 
3.5.1 除紧急维护工作外，未经事先批准，不得在船舶锚泊时进行固定主推进系统的维护工
作。 
Other than in an emergency maintenance work that immobilizes the main propulsion system should not 
be carried out when the ship is at anchor without prior approval. 
3.5.2 只有在地方当局允许的情况下，船舶才能在锚泊时进行维护工作。船长应在开始维护
工作之前向海岸管理部门索取必要的信息。 
Vessels may perform maintenance work while the ship is at anchor only if permitted by the local 
authorities. Masters shall request the necessary information from the shore authorities before 
commencing the maintenance work. 
3.5.3 当轮机长认为有必要进行维修工作时，必须遵循以下指示: 
When the Chief Engineer deems that maintenance work is necessary, the following instructions must be

▪ 通知主管机务The Fleet superintendent is to be informed.

3.6 锚地装卸货注意事项： 
Anchorage loading and unloading precaution: 
3.3.1 在过驳船靠泊本船前，协商确定双方的联系方式、靠泊方式、靠泊位置等。 
Before the barge berthed alongside, the two sides should discuss and confirm the contact method, 
getting alongside method and location, etc. 
3.3.2 在过驳船靠泊本船前及靠泊期间,值班驾驶员或由船长指定的人员应对过驳船的防碰设
备的状况进行观察，发现其防碰设备缺损，应及时要求对方采取补救措施，防止对本
船船体造成损坏。 
Before the barge berthed alongside and during alongside, OOW or the person designated by the master 
shall conduct an outward appearance inspection on the condition of the collision prevention equipment 
of the barge, if found that the collision prevention equipment is defective, should promptly request the 
other party to take remedial action measures, to prevent the hull damage to own ship. 
3.3.3 过驳船靠、离本船过程中，值班驾驶员或由船长指定的人员负责指挥。 
When the barge berthing and unberthing process, OOW or designated by the master is responsible for 
command. 
3.3.4 值班驾驶员除协助大副装卸货外，还应遵守锚泊值班的的要求。值班水手每小时至少
一次去船首检查锚链和锚机、锚装置的情况。 
OOW should in addition to assist chief officer in loading and unloading, should follow the instructions 
of the anchor watch. Duty sailors at least once per hour go to the bow and check the anchor cable, 
windlass, anchor installations conditions. If necessary, the captain may decide the OOW to keep watch 
at the bridge. 
3.3.5 值班人员对过驳船的系泊状况进行定期检查，提醒对方及时收、松缆绳。 
The watchkeeping personnel should regular check the mooring condition of the barge, to remind the 
other party to timely tighten and loosen the cable. 
3.3.6 应确保本船与过驳船之间的连接通道安全、牢固。上、下人员必须穿着救生衣、防滑
工作鞋，佩戴安全帽、手套等个人防护用具。 
The connecting access between the ship and the barge should be safe and secured. Embarking and 
dis-embarking personnel must wear life jackets, non-slip work shoes, safety helmets, gloves and other 
personal protective equipment. 
3.3.7 船长应充分意识到因多艘过驳船靠泊本船造成船舶受风、受流面积的增加所带来的风
险。在本船遭受大风或强流侵袭前，应要求过驳船驶离本船。 
The master should be fully aware of the risks posed by the increased wind and current affecting area of 
the ship due to the vessel being berthed by the barges. Before the ship was hit by strong winds or strong 
currents, should be required the barges to leave own ship. 
3.3.8 遵守港口当局有关过驳作业的规定，在气象、海况等影响作业安全时，应停止作业。 
Comply with the port authorities on the provisions of the barge operation. When the weather, sea

3.7 其他安全注意事项 
Other safety precautions 
3.4.1 锚泊期间，船长应每天就寝前在船长命令簿中写明注意事项和要求。 
During anchoring, before going to bed every day captain shall state precautions and requirements in the 
master's order book. 
3.4.2 在封闭式锚地锚泊时留船人数不得少于1/2，在开敞式锚地锚泊时留船人数不得少于
2/3。船长和大副、轮机长和大管轮、水手长和木匠不能同时离船。驾驶员、轮机员在
任何状况下留船人数不得少于1/2，并要认真遵守港口的有关特殊规定。 
The number of people staying onboard in enclosed anchorage should not be less than 1/2, the number of 
people staying onboard in open anchorage should not be less than 2/3. Captain and chief officer, chief 
engineer and second engineer, boson and carpenter cannot disembark at the same time. The number of 
officer and engineers, under no circumstances, shall not be less than 1/2, and shall obey the relevant 
special provisions of the port. 
3.4.3 如果等待靠泊或锚地装卸货时间较长，应每周活动一次主机并将锚绞起重抛或换抛另
一锚（条件允许）。离港时要注意驳船浮吊清爽后再起锚。 
If waiting for berthing or anchor loading and unloading for a long time, the main engine should be run 
once a week and the anchor should be heaved up and re-drop or use another anchor (if conditions 
permitting). When leaving port, should pay attention to clear all barge first and then heave up the 
anchor. 
3.4.4 在狭窄河道中锚泊时，船长更应注意涨落潮时间、流速、水深、底质等因素，要备车
锚泊，必要时应动用主机配合转头，以防船尾搁浅。 
When anchoring in a narrow river course, the captain should pay more attention to factors such as the 
time of change tide, velocity of flow, water depth, ground nature, etc., should standby engine during 
anchoring. If necessary, should the main engine cooperate with the steering, to prevent the stern 
aground. 
4. 风险评估 
Risk Assessment 
4.1 在进行风险评估时，应考虑到下列因素： 
In conducting a risk assessment, the following factors should be considered: 
 操作现场的天气、海况、照明情况； 
Circumstances of the operation site, such as weather, sea conditions, lighting; 
操作现场的空间限制、周边可能存在的其他危险和限制条件； 
Circumstances of the operation site, space constraints, other hazards and restrictions that may exist 
around; 
 参与操作人员的特殊情况，例如人员数量、经验、技能、体能等状态； 
Participate in the special circumstances of the operator, such as the number of personnel, experience, 
skills, fitness and other condition; 
 锚机、锚链状况； 
The windlass function, cable chain condition； 
 锚链是否有缠绕打结的可能； 
Chain twine a knot； 
 驾驶台和船首信息沟通不畅； 
The impaired communication bridge and anchoring party; 
 体系文件未涵盖的其他操作；

4.2 对操作过程中的可预见风险和特殊情况进行综合评估后，根据风险的可能性和危害程
度，确定风险级别，评估已采取的防范措施的充分性，如果不充分，应进一步采取额

After the comprehensive assessment of the foreseeable risks and special situations during the operation, 
the risk level is determined according to the possibility of the risks and the degree of harm, and the 
adequacy of the preventive measures taken is evaluated. If insufficient, further measures should be taken, 
reduce the level of risk to a level that is tolerable before conducting relevant operation. 
4.3 如果在操作过程中采取了额外措施，作业完成后，相关负责人应对所采取的防范措施
进行有效性评估，并提出改进建议。 
If additional measures are taken during the operation, after the operation, the relevant person in charge 
should make the effectiveness of assessment for the preventive measures taken, and make 
recommendations for improvement.

第09 节  船舶系泊作业与操纵 
Section 09 Ship mooring operations and maneuvering 
 
1.0 系泊准备 
Mooring preparations 
1.1 船舶在进港前，认真检查、试验主机、副机、舵机、锚机、绞缆机，按规范及安全要
求，备妥所需索具。 
Before entering the port, the ship shall conscientiously inspect and test the main engine, auxiliary engines, 
steering gear, windlass and winch. The mooring equipment shall be prepared in accordance with the code 
and safety requirements. 
1.2 各部门按进港靠泊的有关规定、船长及部门长的要求进行各自的准备工作。 
All departments according to the relevant provisions of the port berthing, the captain and departmental 
head requirements to conduct the preparation works. 
1.3 驾驶台、机舱值班人员密切配合，按《驾驶、轮机部门联系制度》做好备车、对车钟、
对时、对舵、冲车、试验汽笛、检查号型号灯等工作。 
The bridge, engine room duty personnel should be closely cooperating. According to the “Deck and 
engine department communication system”, prepare the main engine, telegraph check, time check, rudder 
check, the blow through main engine, test whistle, inspection signal shapes and lights. 
1.4 熟悉港区涨（落）潮的流向、流速及转流的时间，掌握港内的风向风力，结合本船载
货情况和受风面积考虑风流对船舶的推移及其对船舶操纵的影响。 
Familiar with the tidal flow direction, flow rate and tide direction changing time of the port area, master 
the wind direction and speed of the port, and consider the influence of wind and current on the ship and 
its influence on the ship maneuver combine with the ship's cargo condition and the wind receiving area. 
1.5 了解码头情况（如码头长度、方向、前后有无船舶，船闸的有关资料、码头有无障碍
物，岸吊等），引航员上船后要及时核实和了解码头及船闸的有关情况。 
Understand the terminal condition (such as the length and direction of the terminal, the presence of the 
ship at fwd and aft, the relevant information of the ship locks, the presence of obstructions at the terminal, 
and the shore crane, etc.), after pilot boarding, shall promptly verify and understand the relevant 
conditions of the terminal and lock. 
1.6 熟悉航道、调头区、禁止抛锚区、港口有关规定和港口信号使用等。 
Familiar with waterway, turn around area, anchoring prohibit area, the relevant provisions of the port and 
the use of port signals. 
1.7 船长应主动与引航员商讨本次靠泊的操作程序及有关事项，统一方案后船长通报给大
副、二副和轮机长。操作中必须严格按船长指令行动。 
The captain shall take the initiative to discuss with pilots about the berthing operating procedures and 
related issues. After unified the plan, the captain shall inform the chief officer, second officer and chief 
engineer. Operation must be strictly in accordance with the captain command action. 
2.0 系泊操纵 
Mooring operation 
2.1 在有流的港口，除风流反向外，一般采取顶流靠泊。在静水港，一般采取顶风靠泊。 
In port with current, except reversed wind direction, generally face the current to berth. In the calm water 
port, generally face the wind to berth. 
2.2 在操纵过程中，主要应掌握停车淌航（摆好船位），控制余速和掌握靠拢角度三个环节。 
In the process of operation, mainly should control the drifting (placed a good position), control the 
remaining speed and grasp the berthing angle, three important points. 
2.3 掌握本船的操纵特性（旋回圈、冲程、转数等），注意车的偏转效应（如右旋单车船进

405

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd       Effective Date: 2023/08/21                  Page: 2/7 
车时船尾向右转，倒车时船尾向左转），船速越慢，车的偏转效应越明显。 
Grasp the maneuvering characteristics of own ship (turning circle, stopping distance, revolutions, etc.), 
pay attention to transverse thrust effect (such as right-handed propeller, going ahead, stern to starboard, 
going astern, stern to port). When the ship speed is slow, the above effect is more obvious. 
2.4 大副在船首指挥，要注意障碍物、航速、船与周围障碍物的距离，需抛锚时，先确认
锚下无障碍物，并注意有情况及时向驾驶台报告。 
Chief officer command in the bow, pay attention to obstacles, speed, the distance between the ship and the 
surrounding obstacles. When needed to be anchored, first confirmed that no obstructions under the anchor, 
and pay attention to the situation and promptly report to the bridge. 
2.5 二副在船尾指挥，及时报告驾驶台船尾距码头及（或）后船距离，船尾是否清爽，并
注意有情况及时向驾驶台报告。 
Second officer command at the aft, report to the bridge in time the distance between with the terminal and 
(or) the aft ship, whether the stern is clear, and pay attention to any situation reports to the bridge in time. 
2.6 三副在驾驶台按船长或引水命令操纵车钟、汽笛、记录船舶动态，协助船长验证各项
命令，如车、舵令并注意水手操舵。 
The third officer follow the master or pilot order to operates the telegraph and whistle at the bridge, 
record the ship movements, assist the master in verifying the orders, such as engine and steering orders, 
and paying attention to the sailors' helms. 
2.7 当船贴近码头后，大副、二副互相配合，注意缆绳松紧，将所系的缆绳调整到使船均
匀贴紧码头，要掌握水手的素质，合理分工，正确指挥。 
When the ship close to the terminal, the chief officer, the second officer complement each other, pay 
attention to the tension of ropes, adjust the ropes to make ship evenly alongside the pier. Grasp the quality 
of sailors, reasonable division of labor, correct commanding. 
2.8 根据船舶的吨位，装载情况，风流等因素来决定系缆的根数。在大风急流时应停止使
用自动张力绞缆机的自动张力装置。 
According to the tonnage of ships, loading conditions, wind, current and other factors to determine the 
number of mooring lines. The automatic tension device system shall not be used when the wind and 
current is strong. 
2.9 为防止船舶在泊位上发生搁浅事故，要求船舶抵达港口或泊位时，在靠泊后第一时间
对泊位水深进行实际测量并将测量结果反馈公司海务部，各轮根据在港时间及相应的
潮汐资料判断是否有搁浅可能，如存在搁浅风险，应该及时通知相关各方（公司航运、
租家及管理公司），以便及时采取相应的应对措施和方案。 
In order to prevent the vessel from grounding accident at the berth, the vessel is required to make the 
actual measurement of berth depth immediately after berthing at the port or berth and feedback the 
measurement result to the Marine department. All vessels should judge whether there is a possibility of 
grounding according to the port time and corresponding tidal data. If there is a risk of grounding, relevant 
parties (company shipping, charterer and management companies) should be promptly notified, so that 
appropriate response measures and plans can be taken promptly. 
3.0 解系缆作业安全注意事项： 
Mooring and unmooring operations safety precautions: 
3.1 作业人员穿工作服、防滑工作鞋，戴安全帽、工作手套等防护用品。钢丝缆作业时必
须戴皮手套。 
Operation personnel should wear overalls, non-slip work shoes, wearing safety helmets, protective gloves 
and other protective equipment. Leather gloves must be worn when handle the steel wire. 
3.2 作业人员要严肃认真，精神集中，严格执行操作命令。 
Operation personnel should be serious and focused, strict implementation of operational orders.

3.3 作业前水手长应将缆绳、撇缆、制缆索等整理好，扭结的缆绳须打开理顺,制缆索要牢
固适用。撇缆头应用绳子、橡胶制作，切勿添加金属重物；撇缆头的安全替代品可使
用一个高能见度的充沙小软袋，重量不超过0.5 公斤。 
Before work, bosun should arrange the mooring rope, heaving line and stopper, and the kinked cables 
shall be opened and straightened, the stopper shall be securely applied. Monkey fist should be made by 
rope or rubber, must not contain added weighting material ；Safe alternatives include a small 
high-visibility soft pouch filled with sand, weight not more than 0.5 kg. 
3.4 解系缆作业必须按照船长的命令进行。船头、船尾分别由大副、二副负责现场指挥和
安全监督。 
Mooring and unmooring operations must be carried out in accordance with the master's order. The bow, 
the stern, on-site in charge and safety supervision by the chief officer, second officer respectively. 
3.5 解系缆作业时，要合理站位，严禁跨于缆绳上和站在缆绳拉伸的方向、弯曲的内侧。 
Mooring and unmooring operations, to stand at a reasonable position. It is strictly prohibited across the 
ropes and stand on the rope moving direction, curved inside. 
3.6 操车手要正确执行命令，平稳操车，同时注意缆绳的松紧程度和机械运转情况，随时
调整车速。操车前应大声呼喊警示他人，如有意外或现场任何人发出停车信号后都应
立即停车。 
Winch controller should correctly execute the command, winch controller smoothly, pay attention to the 
tightness of the rope and mechanical operation condition, adjust the speed at any time. Before controlling 
the winch, controller should shout loudly warning others, in case of accident or any person on the scene 
give a stopping signal, should stop immediately. 
3.7 松放缆绳时要先绕在缆桩上，使其缓慢松出。 缆绳收绞时应缠绕滚筒至少四圈，操作
者双手托握缆绳自由端，距离绞缆滚筒或带缆桩应在一米以上，如打滑可适当增加圈
数或稍等片刻再绞，切勿强行绞紧。 
When loosen the rope, firstly round the bollard, make it slowly loose. Winding ropes should be wrapped 
around the drum at least four laps, the operator holding the free end of the cable with both hands, should 
be stand at distant from the drum or bollard more than one meter, if slipping, may increase the number of 
laps or wait for a moment, should not be tighten by force. 
3.8 缆绳绞收过程中，一般应两根缆绳一同绞进，分别挽桩，同时注意两根缆绳受力均匀。
大吨位重载船要避免单根缆绳受力过大，不允许只绞进单根缆绳，以防断缆。 
Winding process of ropes, generally two ropes should be heave up together, fast on the bollard 
respectively, pay attention two ropes should take the stress evenly. Large-tonnage full loaded vessels 
should avoid too much force take by a single rope, not allowed to heave up a single rope, to prevent rope 
breaking. 
3.9 缆绳上桩前先用制缆索将缆绳临时定位，然后才能挽桩。缆绳挽桩前应先慢车松至制
缆索吃力后再从绞缆滚筒上松缆挽桩，切不可开快车或突然从滚筒上解除，以防止缆
索突然受力崩断伤人。 
The ropes should be temporarily positioned with a stopper, before piling on the bollard. Beforepiling on 
the bollard, should slack the rope slowly, to let the stopper take weight, then take the ropes from the drum 
to pile on the bollard. Must not slack the rope fast or suddenly lift the rope from the drum, to prevent a 
sudden take weight by the rope, break and people injury. 
3.10 缆绳要先绕过前面一根缆桩，然后迅速挽成 “8”字型。钢丝缆须防止扭结弹跳伤人，
挽缆不少于五道，最后应在“8”字型交会处最上面的三道钢丝缆上用较细的绳索打压
缆结缚住。 合成纤维缆不得和钢丝缆同系一个缆桩上，挽缆时缆绳不得压叠以防弹出
伤人。 
Ropes to pass the front bollard, and then quickly pile into "8" figure. Steel wire rope to prevent kinking

bounce injury, pile no less than five, finally, should press the rope tie with the thinner rope on the top

3.11 任何情况下都不允许以绞缆机、锚机的滚筒当作缆桩使用；不允许以双缆桩的单桩进

3.12 当同时使用钢丝缆和合成纤维缆绳时，不宜在同一方向上混合使用不同材质的缆绳，
以避免因为缆绳不同的延展性造成受力不均。 
When using both steel ropes and synthetic fiber ropes, it is not advisable to mix ropes of different 
materials in the same direction, to avoid uneven loading due to different ductility of ropes. 
3.13 锚机、缆机停止使用后，应把操作手柄锁定（装有锁定叉或其他装置），以防止发生意
外运转而造成事故。 
After the windlass, winch stop using, the operating handle should be locked (equipped with locking fork 
or other device), to prevent accident operation caused accidents. 
4.0 系、靠泊值班 
Mooring and unmooring watch 
4.1 船舶领导及部门长严格执行公司的有关安全生产的规定，检查督促全体值班人员做好
系泊值班工作。 
The ship's leadership and departmental head strictly implement the company's rules on work safety, 
inspect and urge all duty personnel to work on mooring duty. 
4.2 值班人员要明确系泊值班职责，不得擅离职守，维持船上正常的工作秩序，保障人员、
船舶及货物的安全。值班人员应按时按“防火巡视路线图”进行防火检查，并记入航
海日志。 
Duty personnel should be clearly his mooring duty, shall not leave their duties, to maintain the normal 
working order on board, to protect the safety of personnel, ships and cargo. Duty personnel should follow 
"fire patrol road map" on time for fire prevention inspection, and recorded in the deck logbook. 
4.3 在大风、急流、暴风雨及台风警报等情况下，船长及值班驾驶员应及早采取加缆/防磨
等措施，空载以防风为主，重载以防流为主。 
In the case of strong wind, strong current, storms and typhoon warnings, the captain and the OOW should 
take measures such as adding ropes and chafe protection as early as possible. For ballast condition, 
mainly aimed to deal with the wind effect, mainly aimed to deal with the current effect in laden condition. 
4.4 轮机部进行影响主机、副机、舵机、锚机等影响船舶动力和锚泊作业的维修工作时，
应先取得船长同意并申请港口当局批准。 
The engine department when carrying out maintenance work on main engine, auxiliary engine, steering 
gear and windlass, etc., which may affect the ship propulsion and anchoring operation, should obtain the 
consent of the master, and apply for the approval from the port authorities. 
4.5 当风大流急危及船舶安全时，全船应立即总动员，船长立即上驾驶台，轮机长立即下
机舱紧急备车。 
When the strong wind, strong current endanger the safety of the ship, the whole ship should immediately 
mobilize. The captain should immediately present at the bridge, the chief engineer immediately present in 
the engine room to emergency prepare main engine. 
4.6 根据港口潮汐情况，及时调整舷梯，检查安全网，确保上下人员的安全。 
According to the tide of the port, adjust the gangway in time, check the safety net, to ensure the safety of

embarking and disembarking personnel. 
4.7 在使用中的舷梯或跳板梯附近额外放置一个带自亮灯浮和可浮救生索的救生圈，并确
保此救生圈随时可用。 
A lifebuoy equipped with a self-igniting light and a buoyant lifeline should be placed near the accommodation 
ladder or gangway which is using and can be used at all time. 
4.8 根据风流潮汐和装卸情况，及时调整系缆使之受力均匀。检查防鼠挡悬挂情况，使之
符合规定要求，按时收听有关气象，在大风前应采取加缆等安全措施。 
According to the wind, current, tidal flow and loading condition, timely adjustment of the mooring ropes 
so that stress evenly. Check the rat guard hanging situation, so as to meet the requirements, listen to the 
weather on time, before the strong wind take adding ropes and other safety measures. 
4.9 在有他船系靠本船前后时，应在首尾守望，必要时采取有效安全措施。两船并靠时，
双方都应无横倾，吊杆和舷外突出物都应收进。备妥大型靠把，派人带缆等。港作船、
交通艇等来靠时，都应有人守候，防止碰损我轮。一旦发生事故，应迅速报告船长，
并按规定填写航海日志以备交涉。 
If there is a ship berthing fwd or aft of own ship, should watch at both fwd or aft, if necessary, take 
effective safety measures. When the two ships alongside, both ship should have no heel, and the boom 
and overboard protrusions should be retracted. Prepare the large fender, send someone to assist in 
mooring. When the port operation boats, transport launch coming alongside, should someone to standby, 
to prevent damage own ship. In the event of an accident, should promptly report to the captain, and record 
in the deck logbook as per regulations, prepare for negotiation. 
4.10 在主机盘车、冲车、试车前检查推进器周围是否有障碍物，并检查舷梯及缆绳的受力
情况。 
In the main engine turning by gear, blow through by air, test running, check whether there are obstacles 
around, and check the gangway and mooring rope stress condition. 
4.11 按时正确升降国旗，开关号灯及照明灯，悬挂号旗、号型。 
Correctly hoist the national flag on time, switch on/off signal lights and lighting, hoist up signal flags, 
shape. 
4.12 甲板值班人员必须着洁净工作服、工作鞋，佩戴安全帽及值班胸卡。舷梯口任何时候
都要有人值守，并做好上下人员的登记工作。 
Deck duty personnel must wear clean overalls, safety shoes, wear safety helmets and duty badge. The 
gangway should have someone on duty at all times, and should be properly registered. 
4.13 有自动张力绞缆机的船舶在大风、急流之前应停止使用自动张力装置。 
Vessels with automatic tensioned winches should stop using automatic tensioning devices before strong 
winds and strong currents. 
4.14 码头或系浮筒的船舶，未经船长和港口有关当局同意，不得检修系泊设备。 
Vessels berthed at quay or moored with buoy, without the consent of the captain and the relevant port 
authorities, shall not carry out maintenance on moorings equipment. 
4.15 浮筒系泊值班时还应注意： 
Moored with buoy watch should also pay attention to: 
 当转流、转风、系于本船前后或并靠的船舶有靠离、调整系缆、锚链的行动后，适
时调整本船各系缆，使之受力均衡。 
When change current, change winds, after vessels at fwd, aft or alongside of own ship berthing or 
unberth, adjust her mooring lines, mooring chains operation, adjust own ship mooring lines in a timely 
manner so as to stress evenly. 
 船长在风力有增强可能或大潮汛急流来临之前，督促值班人员加强检查，尤其在浮
筒联线与流向不一致时更应特别注意。

Before the wind is likely to intensify or the spring flood tide is approaching, the master should urge 
the duty personnel to step up inspection. In particular, special attention should be paid to the 
inconsistency between buoy connection and flow direction. 
4.16 锚链系泊浮筒时（尾不带缆绳），另一只锚备妥以便应急抛锚使用。值班人员每班至少
查看一次系泊情况，当遇风暴袭击时，应适当松长浮筒锚链，以达到缓冲作用。如偏
荡较大，可将另一锚抛下，作为立锚以减少偏荡，大风过后要及时绞起，防止绞缠。 
When buoy mooring by anchor chain (the end without a rope), the other anchor should be ready for 
emergency anchoring use. Duty personnel should at least once a watch to check the mooring situation, in 
case of storm attack, should extend the buoy anchor chain to appropriate length, to achieve the cushioning 
effect. When there is too much yawing, another anchor can be dropped, as an apeak to reduce the yawing. 
After the strong wind, must promptly heave up, to prevent fouling. 
4.17 系、靠泊值班人员应配备对讲机。当系泊于栈桥式码头时，船长对各种不利条件应做
到心中有数，当各种不利条件相当集中时，应予以特别注意并做出迅速反应。不利条
件中危害性最大者乃是急流与富余水深小两者同时存在。当感到势态严重时，应及早
采取一切可能采取的措施，包括事先抛锚，增加系缆、备车舵及侧推器、全船动员，
争取岸上支援，请拖轮协助等。在危急情况下，若船首顶流而部分系缆开始破断又无
拖轮支援或其马力不够，则可松解尾缆，以首迎流而减少推开的流压，同时用车、舵、
锚等配合操纵，万一断缆漂泊，可用车舵锚稳住船舶或重新靠拢码头。 
Mooring and unmooring duty personnel should be equipped with walkie-talkie. When mooring at pier, the 
captain should be aware of a wide range of adverse conditions, should pay special attention and react 
promptly when various adverse conditions are fairly concentrated. The most dangerous of the unfavorable 
conditions are the simultaneous existence of the strong current and the insufficient water depth. When the 
situation is serious, all possible measures should be taken as early as possible. These include drop anchor 
in advance, adding mooring lines, standby engine, steering and side thrusters, mobilization of the entire 
vessel, request shore support, tug assistance, etc. In critical situations, if the bow face the current, and 
some of the mooring line started to break, without the tug assistance or with insufficient horsepower, can 
loose the stern lines, use the bow to face the current to reduce the push off pressure. In the meantime, use 
the engine, rudder and anchor, etc., with the manipulation. In case of rope breaking and drifting off, can 
use the engine, rudder and anchor to steady the ship or move back to the berth. 
4.18 值班驾驶员应将气象预报，系缆情况和采取的有关系泊安全措施详细地交接，系泊值
班也包括机舱的值班人员，遇大风，强流等特殊情况时，值班驾驶员应及时报告船长，
机舱值班人员要按船长的指示做好备车等工作。 
The OOW should handover the weather forecast, the mooring situation and the relevant mooring safety 
measures taken in detail. The mooring duty also includes the engine room duty personnel. In case of 
special circumstances such as strong wind and strong current, the OOW should promptly report Captain, 
engine room duty personnel should prepare the main engine and other work according to the captain's 
order. 
4.19 船长与值班人员应熟知船舶一旦发生断缆等情况时的应急措施： 
The captain and duty personnel should be familiar with emergency measures in the case of rope breakage 
and other circumstances: 
● 加缆、适当地松缆、使船身与流平行 
add ropes, loose rope properly, so that the ship parallel with the flow 
● 备车、舵、锚、侧推器（如有），用汽笛或VHF 发出警告 
Prepare main engine, rudder, anchor, thrusters (if any), use whistle or VHF to warn 
● 在条件允许时抛锚或抛尾锚 
When conditions permit, drop anchor or stern anchor
