第10 节  通航密集水域航行注意事项 
Section 11 Heavy Traffic Areas Navigation Precautions 
 
1.0 前言 
Preface 
1.1 通航密集水域，指交通繁忙水域、渔船密集区、水产养殖区及附近等通航密度高的水
域，以及操纵受限水域； 
Heavy traffic areas include the high density traffic area、fishing vessels concentration area、mariculture 
area, and other high navigational density areas, and restricted waters with limited manoeuvring; 
1.2 通航密集水域航行，应严格遵守《国际避碰规则》，狭水道、定线制和分道通航水域
等仍需遵守避碰规则的行动要求，也需遵守当地有关航行安全和报告的规定。 
Navigation in heavy traffic areas, crewmembers should strictly comply with the provisions of 
“International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea (COLREGS) ", comply with the conduct of 
vessels in narrow channel/ship routing and traffic separation scheme areas, also should comply with local 
regulations on navigational safety and reporting.  
1.3 船长负责密集水域航行要求的实施和监督，并根据实际情况指导或亲自指挥航行。  
The master is responsible for the implementation and supervision of navigation requirements in heavy 
traffic areas, The master shall personally direct command or navigate the ship according to the actual 
situation. 
1.4 驾驶员应遵守避碰规则的要求，及时叫船长。 
Strictly follow the COLREGS, the OOW should call master in time. 
2.0 要求  
Provision  
2.1 船长应事先根据最新海图/航行通告等资料，及水文气象等信息,对通航状况进行全面
评估，制定航行安全措施。船长需认真审阅甚至亲自拟定航线，如有必要，绕开密集
渔区。 
The master shall in advance according to the latest chart, navigational bulletin, port information, tide table 
and other information, conduct a comprehensive analysis and study on the topography, water depth, route 
signs, hydrological weather and ship movement conditions of the waterway, carefully review or even 
draw up passage plan by himself. If necessary, deviation from the fishing boats concentration area might 
be considered. 
2.2 船长应保证驾驶台和机舱有足够的值班人员，必要时，增派有经验的水手加强值班。 
The captain should ensure that there are sufficient duty personnel on the bridge and engine room, if 
necessary, send more experienced crew members to strengthen the duty. 
2.3 值班驾驶员应了解该海区的情况及熟悉航线计划， 
The OOW should understand the sea area condition and familiar with the passage plan. 
2.4 船长和高级船员需熟悉本船的操纵性能、主机转速及本船特点。 
    The Master and officers should be familiar with the ship maneuvering performance, main engine 
revolution speed and characters of the ship. 
2.5 在进入通航密集水域前，值班驾驶员应全面检查助航仪器，保证驾驶台设备在最佳工
况，根据《海图作业规则》《航次计划的设计和报告》，在海图和助航设备上标注和显
示必要的安全信息。 
Before entering the heavy traffic area, the OOW should comprehensively inspect the 
navigation aids to ensure that all the bridge equipment is in the good working condition, the 
necessary safety information should be remarked and displayed on the nautical charts and 
navigation aids in accordance with the "Charting Operation Rules" and "Design and Report

第11 节  狭水道航行注意事项 
Section 11 Narrow channel navigation precautions 
 
1.0 总则 
General 
1.1 船长负责布置和检查进入狭水道前的准备工作；进入狭水道后船长应根据实际情况亲
自指挥或指导航行；并对船舶安全负责。 
The master is responsible for arranging and checking preparations before entering the narrow channel. the 
master shall personally direct command or navigate the ship according to the actual situation after 
entering the Narrow channel , and shall be responsible for the safety of the ship. 
1.2 值班驾驶员按船长指示做好准备工作并协助船长安全航行。 
OOW according to the captain instructions to prepare and assist the captain safe navigation. 
1.3 航行中应严格遵守《国际避碰规则》有关狭水道航行的规定并尽可能选择靠水道右侧
的航线。 
Navigation should strictly abide by the provisions of the "International Regulations for Preventing 
Collisions at Sea" on the navigation of the narrow channel and, if possible, choose starboard side of the 
channel. 
1.4 遵守当地有关航行安全和报告的规定。 
Comply with local regulations on navigational safety and reporting. 
2.0 准备工作 
Preparation works 
2.1 船长应事先根据最新海图、航行通告、港章、潮汐表等资料对该水道的地形、水深、
航路标志、水文气象和船舶的通航状况等进行全面分析研究，认真审阅甚至亲自拟定
航线，或者在进入通航密集区时选择最佳的切入点和切入方向，并将危险区域用铅笔
标成阴影区。并应掌握： 
The master shall in advance according to the latest chart, navigational bulletin, port information, tide table 
and other information, conduct a comprehensive analysis and study on the topography, water depth, route 
signs, hydrological weather and ship movement conditions of the waterway, carefully review or even 
draw up passage plan by himself, or choose the best entry point and entry direction when entering a busy 
traffic area, and mark the danger area with a pencil shaded area. And should grasp: 
 各段航线的航向、航程和经过时应采用的风、流压差及采用的导标、导航方法，尽
可能多选几个导航物标。 
The course, distance and winds current pressure difference when passing and the use of navigational 
marks, navigation methods, should be selected a few navigation landmarks. 
 各助航标志的意义、性质、结构及其周围的情况。 
The meanings, nature, structure and surroundings of all the navigational marks. 
 各航段的宽度、水深及在避让时可偏离航线的最大范围。 
The width of each legs, the depth of water and the maximum range that can deviate from the route 
while taking avoidance action. 
 各转向点的转向依据，并按本船的旋回要素，决定转向施舵点的位置。 
The foundation of every way point, the turning reference, and according to the own ship manoeuvring 
characteristics, determined the wheel over point. 
 对于各紧要地段，应做到不用海图、不用仪器定位，能安全地进行目视导航。 
For all the important sections, it is necessary to “do not have charts, no instrument positioning”, can 
safely visual navigation. 
 可供安全锚泊的地段（必要时）。

3.0 保持船位 
Hold the ship position 
在狭水道航行应随时掌握船位，确保本船走在计划航线上。 
Navigation in the narrow channel should keep abreast the ship’s position, to ensure that the ship on the 
planned route. 
3.1 船长可根据实际情况指示驾驶员选用适合的定位方法及定位间隔。 
The master may instruct the OOW to select the appropriate positioning method and positioning interval 
according to the actual situation. 
3.2 在采用导航方法控制船位时，不应勿视定位，船长应亲自掌握此期间的定位间隔。 
The positin fixing should not be underestimated when controlling the ship’s position with use of 
navigation methods, the captain should personally grasp the positioning interval during this period. 
4.0 操纵与避让 
Manoeuvring and avoidance action 
4.1 船长应根据当时的环境适当控制船速。 
The captain shall have appropriate control of the ship speed in accordance with the prevailing 
circumstances. 
4.2 特别注意浅水效应、岸壁效应对船舶操纵的影响。克服偏转的措施必须迅 速果断。
在进入浅水区或其它可能影响船舶操纵性能的区域前，船长或驾驶员应提醒操舵水手
应保持的特殊戒备。 
Pay special attention to shallow water effect, bank effect on the handling of the ship. Measures to 
overcome the deflection must be prompt and decisive. the master or OOW should remind the helmsman 
of maintaining the special precautions before entering shallow waters or other areas that may affect the 
maneuverability of the ship. 
4.3 远离近海养殖区，以避免在不知其确切范围的情况下误入养殖区。一旦误入要立即停
车，稳住船舶，弄清情况后方可采取下一步行动。 
Stay away from offshore fish farm, to avoid strayed entering fish farm areas deal to not knowing their 
exact limits. Once strayed, should stop immediately, stabilize the ship, clear the situation before taking 
the next step. 
4.4 两船对驶时，应以缓速行驶，当船首相平时相互排斥使船首外偏时，不宜用大舵角制
止，必要时可适当加车增加舵效，迅速通过。 
When two ships are meeting, they should run at a slow speed. When the bow parallel, mutually exclusive 
to make the bow shift outward, it is not appropriate to cease with a large rudder angle. If necessary, 
increase rudder effect by speed up, passing quickly.

English version of Section 17 of “Annually Summary of Notices to mariners” and the compile of fixed 
sailing scheme “Ship’s Routing” issued by the IMO. All ships should amend and add information 
according to the weekly ADMIRALTY Notices to Mariners. Before approaching the separate sea lane, 
look up the above information, charts, sailing directions and so on. 
4.0 分道通航制的基本要点是：应在分道内顺着船舶总流向行驶；如必须穿越时尽可能与
总流向成直角穿过。 
The key point of traffic separation is: the ship should proceed in the appropriate traffic lane in the 
general direction of traffic flow for that lane; if obliged to cross the traffic lanes, shall cross on a heading 
as nearly as practicable at right angles to the general direction of traffic flow. 
5.0 沿岸通航区（Coast zone）内由于小船和轮渡穿梭频繁，通常不宜作船舶的过境航行。 
Since there is frequent transport of small boats and ferries in the coast zone, it is not suitable to be used 
as a transit route.  
6.0 除非为了避免紧迫危险，通常不应驶入分隔带。但如遇机器故障等紧急情况需要在分
隔带内抛锚者，并不被认为违反规定。 
Unless for preventing immediate danger, do not enter the traffic separation zone. If the ships have to 
drop the anchor at the traffic separation zone due to emergency conditions such as machinery 
breakdown, it will not be considered as a breach of regulation. 
7.0 掌握准确的船位是保证正确执行分道通航的关键。在未进入前即应测定船位并在进入
之后随时掌握正确的船位和计算风流压差，如有偏移应即修正航向；如已越出分道应
根据情况尽快驶回。 
Identifying the accurate ship position is the key of ensuring accurate execution of the traffic separation. 
Ship position should be measured before the entrance, identify the accurate ship position and measure 
the drift angle after the entrance. If there is deviation, correct the navigation heading immediately. If the 
ship has gone out of the lane, return as soon as possible according to the condition. 
8.0 在分道两端及交叉地段，船舶汇集且航向不一，应特别谨慎，严格遵守国际海上避碰
规则或地区性特殊规则，加强了望，根据情况使用安全航速和采取避碰措施。对违反
分道通航制的船舶仍应按规则予以避让。 
At the two ends of the lanes and intersections, the ships are concentrated together with different 
navigation directions. Pay utmost attention, strictly follow the International Regulations for Preventing

collision avoidance measures. When facing other ships which violates the traffic separation scheme,

9.0 按规定守听甚高频无线电话。当有向本船发提醒信号时应即核对船位、航向，并返回
分道。 
Watch-keep on very high frequency radio telephone according to the regulations. When receiving 
remind signal, immediately verify the ship position and navigation direction, then return to the lane. 
10.0 风险评估 
Risk Assessment 
10.1 在进行风险评估时，应考虑到下列风险： 
During risk assessment, consider the following risk: 
 “分道通航检查表”中列明的相关风险； 
Relevant risk listed in the “Traffic Separation Checklist”; 
 操作过程中其他可合理预见到的风险； 
Other risks that can be reasonably foresee during the operation procedures; 
 操作现场的特殊情况，例如天气、海况、照明、时间限制、空间限制、周边可能
存在的其他危险和限制条件等； 
Special conditions of the operation site, such as weather, sea state, lights, time limitation, area 
limitation, other dangerous and limitation factors exist in the surrounding; 
 参与操作人员的特殊情况，例如人员数量、经验、技能、体能等状态； 
Special conditions of the operation personnel, such as the number of personnel, experience, 
technique, body strength and so on; 
 其他特殊情况，例如相关联的其他操作、上级的特殊要求等； 
Other special conditions such as other relevant operations, special requirements of the senior and so 
on; 
 体系文件未涵盖的其他操作。 
Other operation not included in the SMS documents. 
10.2 对操作过程中的可预见风险与特殊情况进行综合评估后，根据风险的可能性和危害程
度，确定风险级别，评估已采取的防范措施的充分性，如果不充分，应进一步采取额
外措施，将风险级别降低到可容忍程度，方可进行相关作业。 
Perform overall assessment to foreseeable risk and special conditions in the operation procedures. 
According to the possibility and hazard rating of the risk, confirm the risk level and evaluate the 
sufficiency of the preventive measures taken. If it is not sufficient, take additional measures to lower the 
risk level to a tolerable level before the relevant operation. 
现场操作执行者还需要对所面临的特殊情况进一步识别风险及其危害性，并采取额外
的防范措施。 
The onsite operation executor should distinguish the risk and its threat to the special conditions faced, 
and take extra precautionary measures. 
10.3 如果在操作过程中采取了额外措施，作业完成后，相关负责人应对所采取的防范措施
进行有效性评估，并提出改进建议。 
If additional measures are taken during the operation procedures, after the operation finishes the 
concerned supervisor should perform effectiveness assessment on these preventive measures and make 
suggestions for further improvement.

第13 节 船舶雾航安全须知 
Section 13 Safety Manual for Navigation in Fog 
 
1.0 总则 
General Principle 
1.1 船舶在雾、霾、雪、暴风雨、沙瀑或其他类似原因而使能见度受到限制或在其附近航
行时（以下简称雾航），应严格遵守《国际海上避碰规则》中的有关条款以及各港港章
及内河航行等有关规定。 
When navigating in or near fog, mist, falling snow, heavy rainstorm, sandstorm or other similar causes 
which leads to restricted visibility (or “navigation in fog” for short), strictly follow the relevant provision 
laid out in the “International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea” and all regulations of the port 
and inland water navigation. 
1.2 雾航的起始时间、船位及各项雾航安全措施应记入航海日志。 
The start time, ship position and all safety measures as to navigation in fog should be recorded in the 
Deck Log Book. 
2.0 雾航准备 
Preparation for navigation in fog 
2.1 二副应及时获取天气预报、气象传真、航海警告、雾航警报，并将这些资料及时呈送
船长。 
Second Officer should acquire information of weather forecast, weather facsimile, navigation warning 
and fog navigation warning, and send these information to the Master timely. 
2.2 船在进入多雾水域前及雾袭来前，船长应对雾情资料、航区特点、潮流情况、通航密
度、定位方法、结合本船性能，悉心研究，订出雾航安全措施。 
Before the ship enters foggy water area and the arrival of the fog, the Master should study fog information, 
characteristics of navigating zone, tide conditions, density of navigation traffic, fixing method and ship’s 
characteristics; and establish safety measures for navigation in fog. 
2.3 雾航前，船长和驾驶员应对各种航行仪器、雾号、航行灯号进行检查以确保雾航中正
常使用。 
Before navigation in fog, the Master and deck officer should inspect all navigation equipment, fog signals 
and navigation signals to ensure these can function normally during the navigation in fog. 
2.4 雾航前，船长应督促责任者检查排水和水密设备，使之处于良好状态。 
Before the navigation in fog, the Master should urge the responsible person to inspect the drainage and 
watertight equipment and make sure they are in good conditions.  
2.5 备妥必要的堵漏器材。 
Prepare leaking stoppage equipment. 
2.6 雾季中，船舶遇雾的几率大增，轮机长应按船长要求备足供主机变速的燃油。雾航中，
轮机长应服从船长的备车、用车要求。 
During fog season, the percentage of navigation in fog increases. The Chief Engineer should prepare 
sufficient amount of fuel oil for main engine maneuvering as per master request. During navigation in fog, 
the Chief Engineer should follow the requirements of the Master in getting the engine ready and running. 
2.7 值班驾驶员在雾袭来以前，应抓紧时机测定船位，并观察海面周围情况，以利避让。 
Before the arrival of fog, the on-duty deck officer should take the time to fix the ship position and observe 
the sea surrounding conditions, in order to give way to other ship.  
3.0 雾中航行 
Navigation in fog 
3.1 为确保船舶雾航安全，当视线恶劣、渔船密集、避让困难、航道复杂、定位困难及船

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.       Effective Date: 2018/04/01                Page 2/5 
长对航行安全无把握时，在条件许可的情况下，船长有权择地锚泊或滞航，切勿盲目
航行。 
To ensure safety for navigation in fog, when there is low visibility, high density of fish boats 
concentration, difficulties in giving ways or fixing position, complex sea-lane, or the Master have no 
confidence to navigation safety, the Master have rights to choose anchoring or heaving to the ship. Blind 
navigation is prohibited. 
3.2 驾驶人员应通过正规了望，悉心观察，从灯光，水线、目标等的变化中判断是否视线
正在恶化，是否正在进入雾区。 
Deck officer should perform standard lookout and observe in details, such as the change of lightings, 
water line, target and so on, to determine whether the visibility is worsened and whether the ship is 
entering the fog zone. 
3.3 当能见度小于５海里时，即认为是能见度不良，应处于雾航的戒备状态，并做好一切
雾航准备，值班驾驶员即报告船长，通知机舱，开启雷达，按规定施放雾号，并注意
守听VHF，加强瞭望等。 
When the visibility is less than 5 miles, it can be viewed as restricted visibility. The ship should remain 
state of alert, prepare ready for navigation in fog. The on-duty deck officer should report to the Master 
immediately, and inform the engine room, turn on the radar, sound the fog signal as per regulations, 
watch-keeping on the VHF and strengthen the lookout.  
3.4 当能见度小于３海里时，即认为是能见度严重不良，值班驾驶员即叫船长上驾驶台，
不得以任何理由迟叫或不叫，通知机舱备车，不论白天、夜间必须开启航行灯。 
When the visibility is less than 3 sea miles, it can be viewed as serious restricted visibility. On-duty deck 
officer mustcall the Master coming to the bridge immediately. Do not give any excuse for not calling the 
Master or calling him late. Inform the engine room to get the engine ready. Navigation lights should be 
turned on no matter at day time or at night time. 
3.5 船长获悉能见度严重不良后，必须立即上驾驶台，值班驾驶员应将船位、四周环境和
已采取的措施报告船长，船长应核实雾航安全措施的实施情况。雾航中船长必须坚持
在驾驶台值守，必要时直接指挥。值班驾驶员仍要认真了望，勤测船位，协助船长谨
慎驾驶。 
When the Master identifies the issue of serious restricted visibility, he must go to the bridge immediately. 
The on-duty deck officer should report the ship position, surrounding environment and the measures 
taken to the Master, and the Master should verify the execution conditions of safety measures for 
navigation in fog. During navigation in fog, the Master must stay on the bridge to take duties, and give 
direct command if necessary. On-duty deck officer should perform lookout seriously, frequently fix the 
ship position and assist the Master to steer with due care. 
3.6 机舱被通知备车航行时，值班轮机员应即报告轮机长，轮机长应下机舱（自动化船舶
可在驾驶台）检查核实做好随时机动操纵的一切准备。 
When the engine room is informed to get the engine ready for navigation, the on-duty the engineers must 
report to the Chief Engineer immediately. The Chief Engineer should enter the engine room (for 
automated ship, go to the bridge instead) to perform inspection and verification on all preparation for 
maneuvering at any times. 
3.7 雾中航行必须使用适合当时环境、条件和本船特点的安全航速。在条件和环境许可的
情况下，该航速应能确保来船在二海里以外安全通过或面临紧迫危险前的一半距离内
将船停住。 
When navigation in fog, maintain safe speed according to prevailing circumstances conditions and the 
ship characteristics. If the conditions and circumstances permit, the speed should be set at a stage that the 
coming ship can pass through safely at two miles away, or be able to stop the ship at half way while 
facing immediate danger.

3.8 雾中航行全船应保持肃静、禁止无谓交谈，以免扰乱驾驶员的听觉。 
Keep quiet and stop meaningless chatting during navigation in fog, so as not to disturb the auditory sense 
of the deck officer. 
3.9 驾驶员在雾中航行必须充分利用雷达、AIS、视觉、听觉和VHF 等手段加强了望，驾驶
台两个边门必须常开，专职了望人员（空舵水手）必须在两翼甲板进行视觉和听觉了
望以察觉来船动向、音响。 
The deck officer should make full use of the radar, AIS, visual, auditory and VHF measures to strength 
lookout in time of navigation in fog. The side doors of the bridge should always keep opened. Lookout 
personnel (helmsman) should perform visual and auditory lookout at the both wings deck to observe the 
movement direction and sound of the surrounding ships. 
3.10 船舶在近岸、狭水道、港区、锚地以及船舶密集等复杂水域雾航时，必须派员了头。
了头人员应及时将所发现或听到的情况及疑点报告驾驶台。 
When the ship is navigating in fog near the shore, in narrow channel, port, anchorage and complex water 
area with concentration of ship, must assign personnel to perform lookout on the forecastle. The lookout 
personnel should report all conditions found or heard and doubt to the bridge timely. 
3.11 雾中航行始终保持一部VHF 守听CH16 频道，设有同步录音装置的船舶应予启动,另一
部VHF 可设为监听或通话频道。(在中国沿海航行时，有的船舶使用６频道或港口指定
频道，中国渔船的VHF 没有16 频道，要应引起重视）。 
When navigation in fog, one VHF should be used to watch-keep on CH16 channel. Ships with 
synchronous recording device should turn on the device, and the other VHF can be set as listening or 
communication channel. (When navigating along the shores of China, some ships use the CH6 channel or 
the channel assigned by the port. Pay extra attention that Chinese fishing boats VHF do not have CH16 
channel.) 
3.12 雾中航行，应视情况使用VHF16 频道在通话空隙中发布本船雾航警报。雾航警报用中、
英文交替发出，力求简明。内容为：船名、时间、船位、航向、航速，意向即可。 
When navigation in fog, use the VHF16 channel to broadcast fog navigation warning at the time interval 
between the messages depends on prevailing circumstances. The fog navigation warning should be in 
Chinese and English by turns, and be as simple and clear as possible. Content should include the ship 
name, time, ship position, direction, speed and purpose. 
3.13 雾中航行时严禁使用自动舵。 
Do not use automatic pilot during navigation in fog. 
4.0 避碰行动 
Collision avoidance action 
4.1 雾中航行，船长应亲自进行对危险来船的雷达连续观测和进行雷达标绘以判断来船动
向及最近会船距离。 
When navigation in fog, the Master should continue to observe the radar of the dangerous coming ship, 
and perform radar plotting to determine the direction of that coming ship and the distance from the 
nearest surrounding ship. 
4.2 船长、驾驶员均应熟悉本船雷达和避碰雷达的特性，通过变换距离,调整增益等以发现
微弱目标及区别假回波。 
The Master and deck officer should be familiar with the characteristics of ship radar and collision 
avoidance radar. Through changing distance, adjust transmission gain to find weak target and distinguish 
false echoes. 
4.3 雾中航行，两船相遇至有碰撞危险时，无直航船、让路船之分,两船均应及早采取避免
碰撞行动。 
When navigate in the fog, two ships approach each other and risk of collision exist, there is no 
stand-on ship or give-way ship, both should take early action to avoid collision.

4.4 雾中航行，除已断定不存在碰撞危险外，当听到他船的雾号显似在本船正横以前，或
者与正横以前的他船不能避免紧迫局面时,应将航速减低到仅能维持其航向的最小速
度，必要时应把船完全停住，而且必须极其谨慎地驾驶，直至脱离碰撞危险为止，切
忌盲目转向。 
During navigating in fog, except where it has been determined that a risk of collision does not exist, when 
hears apparently forward of her beam the fog signal of another vessel, or cannot avoid a close-quarters 
situation with another vessel forward of beam, shall reduce speed to the minimum at which can be kept on 
the course, if necessary take all way off and event navigate with extreme caution until danger of collision 
is over. Do not turn direction blindly. 
4.5 雾中航行、避让来船，在条件允许的情况下，应早让（一般距６海里时采取行动）、宽
让（最近会船距离应大于２海里）、大幅度让（用大舵角明显转向），切忌用小舵角避
让。采取避让行动后应继续观察避让效果，直到来船安全通过。 
When navigating in fog, give way to the other vessel, if circumstance permit, take early (take action at a 
distance of 6 miles) and keep well clear (2 miles distant from the surrounding ship) with a substantial 
action (obvious turning by a large rudder angle). Do not give way with a small rudder angle. After giving 
way, the effectiveness of the action shall be carefully checked until the other vessel is finally past and 
clear. 
4.6 一船仅凭雷达测到他船时，应判定是否正在形成紧迫局面和（或）存在着碰撞危险，
若是如此，应及早地采取避让行动，这种行动包括转向，则应尽可能避免： 
A vessel which detects by radar alone the presence of another vessel shall determine if a close-quarters 
situation is developing and/or risk of collision exists. If so, shall take avoiding action in ample time, 
provided that when such action consists of an alteration of course, so far as possible the following shall be 
avoided: 
 除对被追越船外，对正横前的船舶采取向左转向； 
an alteration of course to port for a vessel forward of the beam, other than for a vessel being overtaken 
 对正横后的船舶采取朝着它转向。 
An alteration of course towards a vessel abeam or abaft the beam. 
4.7 利用从AIS 得到的来船信息，帮助避让行动。 
Make use of the ship information acquired by the AIS, it can help when giving way to other ship. 
5.0 风险评估 
Risk Assessment 
5.1 在进行风险评估时，应考虑到下列风险： 
When performing risk assessment, consider the following risk: 
 “ 能见度不良检查表”中列明的相关风险； 
Relevant risk listed in the “Restricted Visibility Checklist”; 
 一旦作业过程中有紧急情况发生，应急器材、救助器材和应急方案、施救方案的及
时性和有效性； 
When emergency conditions occur during operation process, the promptness and effectiveness of 
emergency equipment, lifesaving equipment and the lifesaving plan; 
 操作过程中其他可合理预见到的风险； 
Other reasonable foreseeable risks in the operation process; 
 操作现场的特殊情况，例如天气、海况、照明、时间限制、空间限制、周边可能存
在的其他危险和限制条件等； 
Special conditions of the operation site, such as weather, sea conditions, lighting, time limitation, space 
limitation, other possible danger and limitation factors at the surrounding; 
 参与操作人员的特殊情况，例如人员数量、经验、技能、体能等状态； 
Special conditions of the operation personnel, such as the number of personnel, experience, technique,

 其他特殊情况，例如相关联的其他操作、上级的特殊要求等； 
Other special conditions, such as other relevant operations, special requests by the senior and so on; 
 体系文件未涵盖的其他操作； 
Other operation not included in the SMS documents; 
5.2 对操作过程中的可预见风险与特殊情况进行综合评估后，根据风险的可能性和危害程
度，确定风险级别，评估已采取的防范措施的充分性，如果不充分，应进一步采取额
外措施，将风险级别降低到可容忍程度，方可进行相关作业。 
Perform overall assessment to foreseeable risk and special conditions in the operation procedures. 
According to the possibility and hazard rating of the risk, confirm the risk level and evaluate the 
sufficiency of the preventive measures taken. If it is not sufficient, take additional measures to lower the 
risk level to a tolerable level before the relevant operation. 
5.3 如果在操作过程中采取了额外措施，作业完成后，相关负责人应对所采取的防范措施
进行有效性评估，并提出改进建议。 
If additional measures are taken during the operation procedures, after the operation finishes the 
concerned supervisor should perform effectiveness assessment on these preventive measures and make 
suggestions for further improvement.

第14 节 大风浪航行注意事项 
Section 14 Precautions of Heavy Weather Navigation 
 
1.0 进入大风浪区域前的准备 
Preparation before entering the heavy weather zone 
1.1 船长职责： 
Responsibilities of the Master: 
1.1.1 分析气象，采取调整航速、航向，漂航等措施避免进入大风浪区域。 
Analyze the weather, take measures such as adjusting the speed, direction, drifting and so on, so as to 
avoid entering the heavy weather zone. 
1.1.2 将本船即将遭遇大风浪的情况通报全船，告知所有船员，大风浪航行期间，未得到船
长许可不得出生活区。如必须出生活区，则应采取必要的防护措施。 
When the ship is going to face heavy weather, inform all crew. During the heavy weather navigation, do 
not leave the living zone unless the permission of the Master is granted. If it is necessary to leave the 
living zone, take necessary preventive measures.  
1.1.3 督促各职人员在进入大风浪航行前按照“进入大风浪前检查表”的要求逐一进行检查，
在核实无误后签署检查表。 
Supervise all crew to inspect one by one according to the requirements laid out in the “Heavy Weather 
Preparation Checklist” before entering the heavy weather zone. After verification, sign the checklist. 
1.1.4 空载航行时调整压载水，增大吃水，减少受风面积，提高操纵性能（压水要遵守装载
计算的要求）。 
When navigating with an empty load, adjust the ballast water to increase the draft, reduce the wind 
exposure area, and enhance the maneuverability (the ballast water operation should fulfil the 
requirements of the loading calculation). 
1.1.5 督促GMDSS 普操员(二副)检查日常通讯设备和应急设备，保障通讯畅通。 
Supervise the GMDSS operator (Second Officer) to inspect routine communication equipment and 
emergency equipment, to guarantee a smooth communication.  
1.2 轮机长职责： 
Responsibilities of the Chief Engineer： 
1.2.1 检查各机械主机、副机、舵机、锅炉、泵浦，使之处于良好状态。 
Inspect the main engine, auxiliary engine, steering gear, boiler and pump, and keep these machineries in 
good condition. 
1.2.2 督促大管轮做好机舱活动物品的加固。 
Supervise the Second Engineer to secure the movable items in the engine room. 
1.2.3 督促三管轮检查应急设备并使之处于良好状态。 
Supervise the Fourth Engineer to inspect the emergency equipment and keep them in good condition. 
1.3 大副职责： 
Responsibilities of the Chief Officer： 
1.3.1 领导甲板部的加固和检查工作。 
Lead the Deck Department in the reinforcement and inspection work. 
1.3.2 督促甲板部人员按照“进入大风浪前检查表”的要求进行检查。 
Supervise the Deck Department personnel to perform inspection according to the requirements laid out 
in the “Heavy Weather Preparation Checklist”. 
1.3.3 检查、督促水手长、木匠对下水道出水孔垃圾的清理及疏通工作，使其流水畅通。 
Inspect and supervise the cleaning and dredging work of drainage system and water way opening by the 
bosun and carpenter, so that the water can run smoothly.

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd         Effective Date: 2019/04/10               Page: 2/5 
1.3.4 认真执行压载水管理计划，并对船体强度进行计算。压载水舱必须压满，以减少水对
船壳和舱内结构的冲击。对规定的货舱注入压载水时，注入的压载水的高度接近到主
甲板即可（要留出舱口围空间以减缓压载水冲击舱盖），并打开舱盖的通风盖。 
Execute the ballast water management plan seriously, and perform calculation to the strength of ship 
hull. Ballast water should be full, so as to decrease the impact of water swift to the ship hull and inboard 
structure. When filling ballast water in the designated cargo hold, the height of ballast water close to the 
main deck is good enough (leave a space at the hatch coaming to decrease the impact of ballast water 
swift to the hatch cover), and open the ventilation cover at the hatch cover. 
1.3.5 如条件许可，督促木匠保持对各水舱、污水井的连续测深。 
If the conditions permit, supervise the carpenter to maintain continuous sounding to all water tanks and 
bilge well. 
1.4 GMDSS 普操员（二副）  
GMDSS Operator (Second Officer ) 
1.4.1 检查GMDSS 设备、助航仪器,确保工况良好。 
Inspect the GMDSS equipment and navigation-aid equipment, to ensure the working condition is fine. 
1.4.2 及时收取附近各台站的气象。 
Receive the weather report of all nearby station timely. 
1.4.3 保证通讯畅通 
Ensure a smooth communication 
1.5 大厨职责 
Responsibilities of the Chief Cook 
1.5.1 对厨房内可能移动的设施进行加固。 
Reinforce all movable facilities inside the galley. 
1.5.2 领导服务生固定厨房和仓库内的活动物品。 
Guide the steward to reinforce all movable items inside the galley and storehouse. 
1.5.3 将易碎品妥善放置避免打碎。 
Put the fragile articles at the appropriate locations to prevent them from broken. 
1.5.4 对某些容器加盖防溢。 
Add covers to some containers to prevent the liquid spilling. 
1.5.5 小心谨慎使用电锅、炉灶，避免烫伤。 
Use the electric pot and kitchen range carefully to avoid scalding. 
2.0 大风浪中操纵 
Maneuver in the heavy weather 
2.1 当风力达到8 级或涌浪高达５米（杂货船为风力6 级以上或涌浪高度3 米）以上时
即认为进入大风浪航行，应改为手操舵，值班驾驶员应将气象海况报告船长并通知
大副和值班轮机员。 
If the wind achieved force 8 or wave height surpasses 5m (for general cargo ship, if the wind achieved 
force 6 or wave height surpasses 3m), it should be regarded as heavy weather navigation. Change to hand 
steering, and on-duty deck officer should report the weather and sea conditions to the Master, and inform 
the Chief Officer and on-duty engineers. 
2.2 值班轮机员接到驾驶员的气象海况通知后应即报告轮机长，轮机长及时布置有关变
速的准备工作。 
When the deck officer informs the on-duty engineer as to weather and sea conditions from, the on-duty 
engineer should report to the Chief Engineer, so that the Chief Engineer can arrange the preparation work 
for maneuvering timely. 
2.3 在需对航向大角度调整以及对航速进行调整时，应由船长亲自完成。 
When a large adjustment to the course and an adjustment to the speed are required, they shall be

completed personally by the captain. 
2.4 船长操纵要领： 
The main points of maneuvering by the Master: 
2.4.1 顶浪航行时，视情适量减速，保持舵效；减少海浪的冲击。 
When navigating upwave, lower the speed properly according to the conditions and maintain steerage, 
in order to decrease the impact of wave swift. 
2.4.2 避免正面涌浪冲击，船首向与涌浪方向要有20-30 度夹角,避免船舶横风、横浪航行。 
To avoid direct impact from the wave swift, the angle between the stem and the direction of surge 
should be 20-30 degrees, so as to prevent the ship to navigate under beam wind and beam sea. 
2.4.3 避免单侧长期受涌浪冲击，间隔3 天时间使船舶左右舷交替受浪。  
To prevent one side to be lashed by the waves for a long time, the port side and starboard side should 
interchange every three days. 
2.4.4 及时接收、分析当地气象台的气象报告，依此决定是否绕航、改向或驶往港湾避风。 
Receive and analyze the weather report of the local weather station timely, so as to decide whether to 
deviate, change direction or proceed to the port shelter for typhoon prevention. 
2.4.5 及时向公司报告，并取得指示和指导。 
Report to the company timely for instruction and guidance. 
2.4.6 应避免在大风浪中调头。万不得已的情况下，在大风浪中转向调头时应注意如下事项： 
Avoid U-turn in the heavy weather. If it is unavoidable, pay attention to the following when U-turn in 
the heavy weather: 
 选择涌浪后的间隙时间。 
Select the time interval of surge. 
 根据艏艉受风影响的不同，应向船艏易偏转的这一侧转向。 
The wind exposure of the stem and the stern is different. Turn at the side which the stem can turn 
relatively easier. 
 适时加速，用舵角25 度左右为宜。 
Increase speed at the right time, and maintain a rudder angle of 25 degrees. 
 转向尽量选择在白天进行，易观察海面情况。 
Do it at the day time if possible, where the sea surface conditions can be easily observable. 
 选派经验丰富的水手操舵。 
Assign seaman with rich experience for steering. 
2.5 航行值班要保持视觉、听觉、VHF、雷达和AIS 了望。 
Pay attention to visual, auditory, VHF, radar and AIS lookout while on-duty. 
2.6 顺涌浪航行时船舶受到的涌浪冲击力较小，但容易造成尾淹，降低舵效，存在船舶
失控打横的危险。为防止尾部车叶、舵叶容易受损，要避免涌浪直接冲击车叶、舵
叶。 
When navigation following the sea, the impact of wave swift is relatively smaller, yet it may lead to 
flooding at the stern and lower the steerage, that the ship has the risk to lose control and heel. The 
propeller blades and rudder blades can be easily damaged, hence prevent the surge from lashing them 
directly.

Precautions of the Machinery Department: 
3.1 关闭机舱天窗及其它水密门窗 
Close the engine room skylight, other watertight doors and windows 
3.1.1 全面检查主机、副机、舵机、锅炉、水泵等设备，有故障及时处理，保持各设备完好
使用，并把检查情况报船长。 
Perform an overall inspection to the equipment such as main engine, auxiliary engine, steering gear,

Perform preparation work of machinery navigation.

When entering the heavy weather navigation, the Chief Engineer should be on duty at the engine room. 
If necessary, operate in person, and assign more motorman to take duties. 
3.3 重要设备或易发生故障的机械派专人值守。针对可能出现的情况制定应急反应计划，

Assign personnel to watch the important equipment or machinery that is easily breakdown. The

Decrease the speed according to the order of the Master and actual conditions. 
3.5 有情况立即报告船长。 
Report to the Master immediately if there are any issues. 
4.0 进入露天甲板作业注意事项 
Precautions when entering the outdoor deck 
非特殊情况，任何人不得到露天甲板，如须到露天甲板工作，必须经船长许可，并
采取必要的安全措施： 
No one is allowed to stay on the outdoor deck except for special conditions. If outdoor deck work is 
necessary, seek for permission from the Master, and take necessary safety measures： 
4.1 适当调整航向，尽可能减少作业人员受到风浪的威胁； 
Adjust the direction properly, so as to reduce the threat of heavy weather to the operation personnel； 
4.2 作业人员必须穿救生衣、工作鞋、戴安全帽，走安全通道； 
Operation personnel must wear life jackets, work shoes, and safety hats, and walk on the safety 
corridor； 
4.3 必要时，系安全绳，安排专人看顾，并保持与驾驶台通讯畅通。 
If necessary, tie a safety rope and assign personnel to attend, and maintain a smooth communication 
with the bridge. 
5.0 大风浪过后 
After the heavy weather 
船长要组织人员检查： 
The Master should organize personnel to inspect: 
5.1 涌浪冲击的主体部位（如船体结构、锚机、货舱及肋板、舱口围板及扶强材、顶边柜
内结构）及舱盖等。 
The main body parts (e.g. ship hull structure, windlass, cargo hold and frame, hatch coaming, stiffener 
and top side tank structure) and hatch covers lashed by the heavy waves. 
5.2 如情况许可，应对货物、物料间及各仓库的物品情况进行检查。 
If the conditions permit, perform inspection to the conditions of cargo and items inside the store room 
and all storage. 
5.3 对各油舱、淡水舱、压载舱进行检查、测量，并把检查结果及时报告船长。 
Perform inspection and sounding to all oil tank, fresh water tank and ballast water tank, and report the 
inspection results to the Master timely. 
5.4 如果发现问题及时报告公司。 
If faced with any problem, report to the company timely.

第15 节 船舶防台通则 
Section 15  Ship Typhoon Prevention General Rule 
 
1.0 防抗台原则 
Typhoon Prevention General Principle 
 
1.1 船舶防抗台要贯彻“以防为主，防抗结合，适时早避，留有余地”的方针，在船长指
挥下，根据本规则按部门组织实施。 
The policy of ship typhoon prevention emphasizes the importance of prevention, take measures of both 
typhoon prevention and resistance, seek shelter in advance, and make allowance for unexpected needs. 
This general principle should be executed according to the departments under the command of the 
Master. 
1.2 在台风季节，船长要坚持接收天气预报，尽早获取台风信息。 
During typhoon season, the Master should pay attention to weather forecast in order to receive typhoon 
information as soon as possible. 
1.3 船舶在港口防抗台应遵守港方安排，主动向当地代理联系。 
The ship should follow the arrangement of the port in typhoon prevention at the port, and contact the local 
agent. 
1.4 船长应主动向港方或代理了解港口防抗台规定和防抗台经验，并因地制宜制定本船措
施。 
The Master should ask the port or agent as to the regulations and experience of typhoon prevention, in 
order to adopt measures suiting the local conditions.  
1.5 船长应将本船动态、防抗台措施、当地气象实况及时报告公司海务部，以取得公司的
指导。船舶抗台时，应每隔4 小时向公司报告本船抗台动态。 
The Master should report to the Marine Department as to the ship condition, typhoon prevention 
measures and local weather conditions timely, in order to acquire guidance from the company. In time of 
typhoon, the ship should report the typhoon resistance conditions to the company every four hours. 
1.6 船长要亲自检查各部门的防抗台准备工作情况，做到人员到位、组织和技术措施落实。 
The Master should inspect the preparation work of typhoon prevention of all departments in person, so 
that every crew is well-prepared, with organizational and technical measures executed in due care. 
1.7 船舶在港内装卸货物期间确认台风将袭击本港时，应及早向公司海务部报告。 
When the ship confirms that the typhoon will arrive the local waters in time of loading and discharging at 
the port, report to the Marine Department as soon as possible. 
1.8 有关防台措施、现场观察资料及所遇到的重大问题，应认真记入航海日志。 
The typhoon prevention measures, on site observation information and the major issue found, should be 
recorded in the Deck Log Book seriously. 
2.0 锚泊防台 
Typhoon Prevention by Anchoraging 
2.1 锚泊防台应选择底质好，有足够水深（保持船舶富余水深20 米以上），并能遮蔽最大
施虐风向及长浪的锚位，并与附近船只及障碍物保持足够的安全距离，应避免在风口
和水流湍急处抛锚防台。 
Select a typhoon prevention anchorage with good bottom sediment, sufficient water depth (maintain an 
under keel clearance of over 20 m), then select an anchor position which can shelter the maximum wind 
load and waves. Keep a safety distance with surrounding ships and obstacles. Do not drop anchor at the 
wind gap or locations with strong currents.  
2.2 港方指定的防台锚位，如船长认为不能保障安全时，应及早向港方提出调整。 
If the Master determines that the typhoon prevention anchorage assigned by the port is not safe, he should 

430

04_15_28.text:
航行制度                        版本/修改：3.0/2.0                  SHIP-05-15 
Navigation Regulations                   Version/Rev.: 3.0 / 2.0                     SHIP-05-15 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                 生效日期：2024/06/05                第2/5 页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.     Effective Date: 2024/06/05                    Page: 2/5 
seek for adjustment from the port as soon as possible. 
2.3 锚泊抗台应尽量减少受风面积，尤应尽量减少首部的受风面积，略有首纵倾好。 
The wind area of typhoon prevention anchorage should be reduced, especially to the wind area of the bow, 
a little trim by the bow would be suggested. 
2.4 一般采用抛“一点锚”抗台。 
Generally, “one-point anchoring” is used for typhoon prevention. 
2.5 如抛“八字锚”抗台，一是要注意两锚连线应垂直于台风最大风力时的风向，以便在
风力最大时两锚基本同样受力;二是要注意两锚锚链夹角在20°-40°之间，而两锚之
间的距离一般应为预计在最大风力作用时，放出锚链长度的三分之一；三是要正确判
断本船在台风进路的那一侧，如在右半圆，左锚先抛，右锚链迎风逐渐放长，左半圆
则反之，防止由于抛锚操作不当，锚链绞缠。 
If open mooring is used for typhoon prevention, there are three important points. Firstly, the connecting 
line of the two anchors must be vertical to the wind direction of the maximum wind load of the typhoon, 
so that the stress of the two anchors are well-distributed. Secondly, the angle of the two anchors’ chain 
cables should be 20°-40°, the distance of two anchors should equal to one-third of the total length of the 
chain cable released during the maximum wind load. Thirdly, estimate accurately so that the ship is at the 
side where the typhoon arrives. If the ship is at the right semi-circle, drop the left anchor, and lengthen the 
right chain cable gradually while facing the wind. If the ship is at the left semi-circle, do the opposite. 
This is to avoid the improper handling of anchor dropping which would lead to cross hawse. 
2.6 锚抛妥后，锚机刹车带应旋紧，制链器应合上并用钢丝绳将锚链固定，防止锚链滑出。 
After dropping the anchor, tighten the windlass brake, the chain stopper should be down, and use the wire 
to secure the chain cable, to prevent the cable chain from slipping. 
2.7 无论“八字锚”、“一点锚”或单锚加止荡锚抗台，都要防止两链绞缠。 
No matter it is “open mooring”, “one-point anchoring” or single anchor with yaw-checking anchor, 
fouling hawse must be prevented during typhoon prevention. 
2.8 用雷达测定陆标监视本船锚位为主，GPS 监测锚位为辅。值班驾驶员应画出本船回旋
范围，对正横目标测其方位，对首尾目标测其距离，以求及早发现本船有无走锚。要
标出周围船舶位置，注意其变化，防止其走锚碰撞本船。 
Use the radar as the major tool to fix the landmark and watch the anchor location, whereas the GPS is 
used as a complement. On-duty deck officer should draw the swinging circle of the ship and measure the 
position of abeam targets, measure the distance of the targets from the stem and the stern, in order to 
inspect whether there is anchor dragging. Mark the surrounding ship locations, pay attention to their 
change, to prevent collision with own ship due to anchor dragging. 
2.9 当风力增至８级时，全船进入航行值班，备好主机，关注锚链受力情况，随时向驾驶
台报告。为防止锚链过度受力或减少偏荡，可适当微、慢速用车和用舵（单锚泊时用
车舵抑制偏荡，必须大副在船首观察链舷角接近零度才可慢速进车，否则极易断链）。 
When the wind achieve force 8, all crew should be on duty, with the engine ready. Pay more attention to 
the stress conditions of the chain cable, and prepare to report to the bridge at any times. To prevent the 
chain cable from overload or yaw, run the engine and steering gear in extreme slow or slow speed (under 
the single point anchorage, use the engine and steering gear to control yawing. It is necessary to have the 
Chief Officer to watch the bow bearing. Run the engine slowly only when it is close to zero degree, or 
else the chain will be easily broken). 
2.10 切忌在大风浪中绞锚，因会引起急速走锚。如必须绞锚时，应先备好车，车、舵、绞
锚要协调动作，必要时先动车后绞锚或边动车边绞锚。 
Do not heave the anchor in heavy weather, since it may lead to anchor dragging quickly. If it is necessary 
to heave the anchor, the engine should be ready, with matching action of the engines, steering gear and 
anchor heaving. If necessary, run the engine before anchor heaving, or to do both at the same time.

Navigation Regulations                   Version/Rev.: 3.0 / 2.0                     SHIP-05-15

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.     Effective Date: 2024/06/05                    Page: 3/5 
2.11 如走锚搁浅已不可避免时，应尽量避免船尾搁浅。 
When anchor dragging is unavoidable and that the ship has to strand, prevent stranding by the stern if 
possible. 
3.0 码头防台 
Berth Typhoon Prevention 
3.1 在码头防台时，船长应与港方约定联系方式和应急方案。 
In time of berth typhoon prevention, the Master should fix the way of contact and emergency plan with 
the port. 
3.2 应及早增加系缆，特别要增多抵抗最大施虐风向的系缆数。在导缆孔、导缆滚筒等处
加衬垫。要保持缆绳均匀受力。 
Add mooring ropes as soon as possible, especially at the direction of maximum wind, Add packing to the 
mooring hole, fairlead roller and so on. The mooring rope should be maintained under well-distributed 
stress. 
3.3 要检查码头的碰垫是否完好，有无异常突出的东西，防止损坏船壳，必要时应增加碰
垫或浮垫。 
Inspect whether the fenders at the berth is in good conditions and whether there is pointed objects on it, in 
order to prevent the ship hull from damages. If necessary, add more fenders or floating pads. 
3.4 两轮并靠防台，不能存在横倾，船与船之间要有足够的浮垫，并放好碰垫，伸出舷外
的设施必须及早收进固定好。 
When two ships being berthed shoulder to shoulder, heeling should be avoided. Sufficient floating pads 
and fenders should be put between two ships. All facilities outboard must be put inside and secured as 
soon as possible. 
3.5 风力增至８级时，全船进入靠离码头部署，各就各位，看管好系缆。 
When the wind archived force 8, all ship crew should standby at the mooring station and keep watch of 
the mooring ropes. 
4.0 系浮筒防台 
Typhoon Prevention by Securing to Buoy  
4.1 应系防台浮筒。 
Moor the typhoon prevention buoys. 
4.2 单头系浮筒防台: 
Single point mooring buoy for typhoon prevention. 
4.2.1 应用锚链系带。 
Use the cable chain to fasten. 
4.2.2 在台风来袭前应适当地放长锚链，再带二至三根尼龙缆，以缓冲锚链的受力。 
Before the arrival of typhoon, extend the cable chain to an appropriate length, then add two to three 
nylon lines, in order to buffer the stress endured by the chain cable. 
4.2.3 系缆与锚链应受力均匀。 
The mooring rope and chain cable should be maintained under well-distributed stress. 
4.2.4 锚机刹车带要旋紧，制链器应合上，再用钢丝绳把锚链固定牢。 
The windlass brake linings should be tightened, the chain stopper should be down, and use the wire to 
secure the chain cable. 
4.3 艏、艉系带浮筒抗台： 
Secure the stem and stern to the buoy for typhoon prevention: 
4.3.1 加足系缆，并在导缆孔、导缆滚筒等那些易磨擦的地方加衬垫物。 
Add sufficient number of mooring ropes, and add packing to the wearing parts such as mooring holes, 
fairlead rollers and so on. 

432

航行制度                        版本/修改：3.0/2.0                  SHIP-05-15 
Navigation Regulations                   Version/Rev.: 3.0 / 2.0                     SHIP-05-15 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                 生效日期：2024/06/05                第4/5 页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.     Effective Date: 2024/06/05                    Page: 4/5 
4.3.2 必要时请港方派拖轮在船边协助抗台。 
If necessary, ask the port to provide a tug boat to assist typhoon prevention. 
4.4 当风力增至８级时，全船进入航行值班，应派人看管系缆系链，随时向驾驶员报告，
主机应处于备车状态，直到台风危险解除为止。 
When the wind achieved force 8, all crew should be on duty. Assign personnel to keep watch of the 
mooring ropes and chain cables, be prepared to report to the deck officer at any times. Get the main 
engine standby, until the typhoon signal is cancelled. 
5.0 海上避台、抗台 
Typhoon Prevention and Resistance at the Sea 
5.1 要观测天气变化，做好各种记录。 
Observe the weather change and make all kinds of records. 
5.2 船长要主动向公司海务部报告本船动态。 
The Master report the ship conditions to the company Marine Department. 
5.3 船长应组织全体船员认真做好防抗台各项工作。 
The Master should organize all crew to complete all kinds of work as to typhoon prevention seriously. 
5.4 在海上采取防台风措施时，原则上船舶应与台风中心保持安全距离或远离八级风区，
并从台风尾部驶离。在采取防台风措施前，船长应向公司海务部报告船位、航速和防
台风措施，以取得岸基支持。 
When taking measures against typhoon at sea, in principle, the ship shall keep a safe distance from the 
center of typhoon or away from the 8-scale wind zone, and sail from the tail of typhoon. Before taking 
measures against typhoon, the Master shall report the company Marine Department of the ship's position, 
speed and prevention measures to get shore-based support. 
5.5 船长要组织船员对货载进行全面检查，尤其是松动舱的散装谷物的流动要给与高度重
视， 其他货物有必要时要进行加固。 
The Master should organize the crew to perform a comprehensive inspection to the cargo load, pay close 
attention especially to the flow of bulk grain inside the partly loaded cargo hold, and reinforce other 
cargos if necessary. 
5.6 对甲板属具、水密门窗、舱盖、疏水系统、舵机、通讯器材、厨房、物料间等进行全
面的检查，该加固的要加固。 
Perform a comprehensive inspection to the deck accessories, watertight doors and windows, hatch cover, 
drain system, steering gear, communication equipment, galley, store room and so on, secure as necessary. 
5.7 在海上台风降为低压后停止发布台风报告，仍应密切注意，有时风力会再增强，再次
成为台风。 
When the typhoon at sea has lowered into low pressure, typhoon reports have been stopped, continue to 
pay full attention. Sometimes the wind force will increase and turn into typhoon once again. 
5.8 大风浪中的船舶操纵，船长应亲自指挥。在北半球，要切记：船在台风危险半圆时，
应采取右舷首迎风脱离；在可航半圆时应采用右舷顺风脱离。采用上述避台方法还应
考虑到所在海区的地理情况，确保安全。 
The Master is responsible for direct conduct for maneuvering during the heavy waves. In the northern 
hemisphere, keep in mind that when the ship is inside the dangerous semi-circle area of the typhoon, the 
stbd side of the stem should face the wind for leaving. While inside the navigable semi-circle area of the 
typhoon, the ship should follow the wind with the stbd sides for leaving. When taking the above typhoon 
prevention measures, the geographic conditions of the local sea area should be taken into considerations 
for safety reasons. 
5.9 大风浪中航行时，应适时调整航向及航速，减轻巨浪冲击，并注意勿使船舶横摇周期
与波浪周期一致。 
When navigate at heavy sea, adjust the navigation direction and speed timely to ease the impact of the

heavy waves. Pay attention to avoid the rolling period of the ship is not synchronized with the wave 
period. 
5.10 在近岸航行时值班驾驶员应充分利用一切助航仪器，连续测定船位，计算风压差并绘
出实际航迹，要特别注意下风处之危险物。船长应检查驾驶员在风浪中之海图作业，
对航行情况及气象资料详细记载。 
When navigating near the shore, the on-duty deck officer should make full use of all navigation-aid 
instruments to fix the ship position continuously, and calculate the leeway and draw out the true track. 
Pay special attention to the danger object at the leeside. The Master should inspect the chart operation of 
the deck officer during the waves, and take record in detail as to the navigation conditions and weather 
information. 
6.0 通讯及气象报告 
Communication and Weather Forecast 
6.1 船舶防台通讯，按“船舶调度规程”执行。船舶通讯必须保证畅通、准确、及时。 
Ship typhoon prevention communication should be executed according to the “Ship’s Operational 
Regulation”. Ship communication must be clear, accurate and on time. 
6.2 在港船舶，必须坚持每天收听所在地区和邻近地区的气象报告。值班驾驶员要保持收
听甚高频电话(VHF)。 
For ship at the port, listen to the weather forecast at the local area and nearby area every day. The on-duty 
deck officer should continue to listen to very high frequency telephone (VHF).

第16 节 冰区航行注意事项 
Section 16  Ice Area Navigation Precautions 
 
1.0 注意收听冰况警告和报告，密切监视冰山动态，提高警惕及早避离。 
Pay attention to the warning and report of the ice conditions. Keep vigilant lookout on the iceberg. Be 
extremely cautious and keep distance as soon as possible. 
2.0 开航前应检查、充实船上的堵漏毯、木材、快干水泥、填塞物料等堵漏器材并备足粮
食、淡水及燃料等。 
Before departure, perform inspection and maintain a sufficient quantity of flood protection materials such 
as leaking stoppage blankets, timber, quick-drying cement, packing materials. Prepare sufficient food, 
fresh water, fuel oil and so on. 
3.0 航行中驾驶台值班人员应密切注意周围水域。风浪突然减弱、水天线有异常亮光（冰
光）和少量浮冰出现均意味着接近冰区。发现上述现象时必须马上报告船长。 
Bridge duty personnel during the navigation, should pay utmost attention to the surrounding water area. If 
the wind and wave are weakened suddenly, with abnormal lights (ice blinks) and small quantity of 
floating ice appearing in sight, it means the ice area is nearby. When the above conditions are found, 
report to the Master immediately. 
4.0 冰区航行时 
During ice navigation 
4.1 要充分认识到冰山露出水面以上的部分仅仅是其总体积的10%，遇到时必须远避。 
The part of the iceberg over the water level is only 10% of the whole volume. Keep distance when seeing 
an iceberg in sight. 
4.2 要注意冰对船速及操纵性能的影响。遇到来船应提前避让；狭水道航行时更应谨慎驾驶。 
Pay attention to the influence of ice to the ship speed and maneuverability. When meet an approaching 
ship, take action to avoid collision in advance. Pay utmost attention especially in time of narrow channel 
navigation. 
4.3 冰区航行，船壳、舵叶及车叶容易受损，必须谨慎驾驶，尽量避免倒车。空载或轻载时应
设法增加尾吃水，使推进器和舵叶全部浸入水中。 
During ice navigation, the ship hull, rudder blade and propeller blade can be easily damaged. So be 
extreme cautious during steering, and avoid running stern if possible. If the ship navigates with empty 
load or fractional load, increase the draft by all means, that the total body of the rudder blade and 
propeller blades should be under the water. 
4.4 在冰区航行时，要警惕碎冰堵塞海底阀或主、副机的冷却器而导致事故，尤其是轻载和空
载船，必须使用低水位的海底阀，并作好必要的预防措施。 
During ice navigation, be extremely cautious to the trash ice which may block up the sea chest and 
cooling unit for the main engine and auxiliary engine, and lead to accident occurrence.  Especially for 
ship with fractional load or empty load, low suction sea chest must be used, and take necessary preventive 
measures. 
4.5 应选择冰隙或簿冰处行驶，避免驶近又叠堆的厚冰层。加强瞭望，及时避开漂流大冰块。
无法避让时，应降低船速以缓和撞冰的冲击力量。如无法避免与冰层接触时，应以船首与
冰缘成直角接近，防止船头斜向冰层，造成船首船壳损坏或使船尾甩向冰缘，损坏螺旋桨
和舵。 
Always choose to navigate in ice gap or light brash ice. Do not approach heavy concentrations of ice. 
Strengthen lookout and keep distance from the drifting iceberg. If it is not possible to keep distance, lower 
the ship speed to ease the impact force of the collision. If collision is unavoidable, the stem should 
approach the ice margin as a right angle, and prevent the stem to approach vertically. Or else, the stem 

435

航行制度                        版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      SHIP-05-16 
Navigation Regulations                Version/Rev.: 3.0/0.0                        SHIP-05-16  
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2018/04/01            第2/2页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd       Effective Date: 2018/04/01                Page: 2/2 
ship hull will be damaged or the stern may be thrown forward to the ice edge, damaging the propeller 
blades and rudder. 
4.6 应尽量防止船身被冻结冰内，以防冰的压力对船壳造成严重损坏。船前部如被冰挟住不能
动时，可采用以下办法使船脱出: 
Prevent the ship hull from being frozen by the ice, since the pressure of ice would lead to serious damage 
to the ship hull. If the ship stem is blocked by the ice and cannot move, take the following measures to 
release the ship: 
 
全速前进，左右满舵使船左右摇摆，松动挟冰，然后倒车退出。倒车时应用正舵，
先开极慢倒车，待船尾冰块松动并推离后，再开快倒车，以免车叶猛烈击冰受损。 
Go forward in full speed, with full rudder on the port and stbd so that the ship is heeling port and 
stbd to loosen the ice, so that the ship can back away and withdraw herself from the ice. When 
backing the ship, steer by keeping rudder amidships, back the ship extremely slowly. When the ice is 
loosened and pushed away from the stern, back the ship quickly to prevent the propeller blades from 
damage in time of striking the ice vigorously. 
 
如上述方法无效，可调整油水，设法使船身反复左右倾斜或船尾升、降，以松动
挟冰，然后倒车退出。 
If the above methods are not effective, adjust the oil and water, so that the ship hull is repeatedly 
heeling port and stbd, or the ship stern raising and lowering. This can loosen the ice, and the ship can 
back away and withdraw herself from the ice. 
 
如冰况严重，航行确有困难，可联系附近港口，申请破冰船引航。破冰船引航时，
应保持一定距离，密切注意该船的速度变化，加强联系，遵守引航规则。 
If the ice condition is very serious, and it is difficult to continue the navigation, contact the nearby 
port and apply for the icebreaker to pilot. When the icebreaker is piloting, keep an appropriate 
distance, and pay utmost attention to the change of the speed of that ship. Keep good communication 
and follow the rules of piloting. 
4.7 尽量不在冰区抛锚（以防收不回锚），如果必须，应选择冰层最脆簿处抛锚，锚链长度不
超过水深的两倍为宜（如锚链过长，冰移时容易导致断链）。应常备主机并值航行班，必
要时立即起锚离去。 
Do not drop anchor in the ice zone (anchor may not be heaved successfully). If it is necessary, choose to 
drop anchor at the thinnest layer of ice, the length of the chain cable should not exceed two times of the 
water depth (if the chain cable is too long, it is easily broken by the ice movement). Main engine should 
always be kept running and ready for the navigation, that the anchor can be heaved and the ship can leave 
at any times immediately if necessary.

第17 节  引 航 须 知 
Section 17  Pilotage Instruction 
1.0 总则 
General Principles 
1978 年《海员培训、发证和值班标准国际公约》强调：尽管引航员有其职责和义务，他在
船上引航并不解除船长或负责值班的驾驶员对船舶安全所负的职责和义务。船长和引航员
应交换有关航行方法、当地情况和船舶性能等情况。船长和值班驾驶员应与引航员紧密合
作，并保证正确的船舶船位和动态。 
“International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers 1978” 
emphasizes that, despite the duties and obligations of a pilot, his presence on board does not relieve the master 
or officer in charge of the watch from their duties and obligations for the safety of the ship. The master and the 
pilot shall exchange information regarding navigation procedures, local conditions and the ship's 
characteristics. The master and officer of the watch shall co-operate closely with the pilot and maintain an 
accurate check of the ship's position and movement. 
2.0 注意事项 
Precautions 
2.1 值班驾驶员应及时将船舶抵达引航员登船点时间报告给引航站，并通知船长和机舱。 
On-duty deck officer should report the ship arrival at pilot boarding point time to the pilot station timely, and 
inform the Master and engine room. 
2.2 值班驾驶员应与引航员联系并确定由哪一舷登船；及时通知机舱备车；并通知水手长安放
好引水梯。引航员的登离船安排应遵守3.3 条的要求。 
On-duty deck officer should contact the pilot and confirm which side to be boarded. Inform the engine room 
to get the engine ready timely, and inform the bosun to put the pilot ladder. The pilot transfer arrangement 
should follow the requirements laid out in paragraph 3.3. 
2.3 船长到达驾驶台后应指派一名驾驶员接引航员至驾驶台。该驾驶员应携带对讲机与驾驶台
保持联系，夜间还需携带手电协助引航员通过光线不足区域。 
After the Master arrives at the bridge, he should assign one deck officer to pick up the pilot to the bridge. That 
deck officer should carry a walkie talkie and keep contact with the bridge. At night, the deck officer should 
carry a portable torch to assist the pilot to go through zones without sufficient lights. 
2.4 引航员到达驾驶台后，船长应主动、正确、详细地向引航员介绍本船的船舶规范、水尺、
货载、操纵性能、系泊布置、主机转数及本船特点，出示“引航卡”。并主动询问航道水深、
进出船舶动态、码头泊位水深、安全靠泊要求等必知的情况,。 
When the pilot arrives at the bridge, the Master should introduce the ship particular, draft, cargo load, 
maneuverability, mooring arrangements, revolutions of main engine and the characteristic of the ship in an 
initiative, accurate and detailed manner. Show the pilot card, and actively ask for necessary information such 
as the navigable channel depth, berthing and leaving of ships, water depth at the quay berth, safety berthing 
requirements and so on. 
2.5 同时应了解引航员所用的车钟口令、指挥信号、操作意图、方法和步骤，并向值班驾驶员
和舵工明确交待。 
Be familiar with the telegraph order, command signal, operational meaning, approaches and procedures used 
by the pilot, and explain to the on-duty deck officer and helmsman. 
2.6 有些船安装了轴功率/发动机功率限制（SHaPoLi/EPL）系统，该系统可能会在关键时刻对
船只的机动性产生意想不到的影响。对于复杂航行水域，环境多变情况下，功率限制系统
必须能够越控。船长需要提醒引水员启用功率限制系统和不启用情况下的最大输出功率，
以及转换时间，等等。如果船舶操纵性能受到影响，船长有权采取额外的控制措施，包括
额外的护航、拖带、潮汐时间限制等。

Some vessel was retrofitted the Shaft Power or Engine Power Limitation (SHaPoLi/EPL) systems, which 
might be unintended consequences impacting a vessel's manoeuvrability at critical times. When navigating 
through complex waters, and several environmental variables come into play, that system must have the ability 
to be overridden. the ship master should notify the pilot about: the vessel's maximum available power with 
EPL engaged and without EPL, the time required for overriding the EPL, etc. If the vessel's manoeuvrability is 
significantly compromised, the ship master reserves the right to apply additional control measures including 
additional escort and/or harbour towage, and tidal/timing restrictions.  
2.7 在引航过程中，船长不应离开驾驶台并全权负责船舶的安全。船长应要求值班驾驶员认真
协助了望，如发现问题，应立即通知引航员。 
During pilotage, the Master should not leave the bridge and bear full responsibility for the ship safety. The 
Master should require the on-duty deck officer to perform lookout seriously. If any problem is found, inform 
the pilot immediately. 
2.8 船长应认真监督、核查引航员的操作，如发现不当，及时提出建议；若引航员不接受，有
权加以制止，必要时中止其引领，改由自己操作或要求更换引航员。 
The Master should supervise and verify the operation of the pilot. If inappropriate judgement is found, make 
suggestion timely. If the pilot does not accept the suggestion, the Master possesses the rights to stop him. If 
necessary, the Master can suspend the pilotage and operate by himself or to request for a change of pilot. 
2.9 船长应当满足引航员工作的要求。船长暂离驾驶台应告知引航员，并指定驾驶员负责。 
The Master should fulfil the working requirement of the pilot. If the Master has to leave the bridge temporarily, 
he should inform the pilot, and assign a deck officer to be responsible for this. 
2.10 船长应当正确签署有关引航收费单证。 
The Master should sign the pilotage receipt accurately. 
2.11 引航员在船时，并不解除值班驾驶员对船舶安全所负的职责和义务，值班驾驶员应密切配
合引航员操纵船舶，认真了望，勤测船位，正确记录车钟以及驶过浮标时间等。 
The presence of pilot on board does not relieve the deck officer in charge of the watch from their duties and 
obligations for the safety of the ship. The on-duty deck officer should be co-operative with the pilot in 
maneuvering the ship, lookout and measure with due care, record the bell and the time of going pass the buoy 
accurately and so on. 
2.12 值班驾驶员应注意核查引航员口令及水手操舵的正确性。 
On-duty deck officer should pay attention and verify the accurateness of the command of pilot and steering of 
helmsman.  
3.0 引航员登离船布置 
Pilot Transfer Arrangement 
引航员登离船布置应使用符合IMO A.1045(27)号决议附件《引水员登乘装置的标准》要求
的引航梯，以确保引航员的安全。 
The pilot ladder used should fulfil the requirements of IMO Resolution A. 1045 (27) “PILOT TRANSFER 
ARRANGEMENTS”, so as to ensure the safety of the pilot. 
3.1 设置要求 
Set up requirement 
3.1.1 引水梯应放置在指定的地点。 
The pilot ladder should be placed in the required location. 
3.1.2 引水梯的上端应牢固地系固于船体固定结构上。 
The upper part of the pilot ladder should be secured at the fixed structure of the ship body firmly. 
3.1.3 应设置扶手支柱，并确保其稳固。 
Set up handrail and bracket, and make sure it is firm. 
3.1.4 应在舷内设置与引水梯相接的梯子。 
Put a ladder to join the pilot ladder inboard.

Auxiliary tools.

One heaving line.

Sufficient lights.

Bale sling.

Operation 
3.3.1 安放引水梯由一级水手以上职务的人员操作。 
Able seaman or personnel of upper rank is responsible for the operation of putting up the pilot ladder. 
3.3.2 引水梯应放置在下风舷或按引航员的要求放置。 
Pilot ladder should be put at the leeside or the location requested by the pilot. 
3.3.3 引航员登离之前，值班驾驶员应检查引水梯的设置是否符合要求以及属具是否齐全。 
Before the pilot boarding and leaving the ship, the on-duty deck officer should inspect whether the 
setting of the pilot ladder fulfils the requirements and whether the accessories are all in readiness. 
3.3.4 使用舷梯 
Usage of gangway  
舷梯用于引航员登离船时，应： 
When gangway is used for the pilot leaving the ship, the following should be kept in mind: 
 尽可能使其下端平台保持水平。 
The lower platform should be maintained horizontal if possible. 
 船舶有余速时，舷梯下端平台不宜过低，以免触及水面。 
When the ship is having residue speed, the lower platform should not be too lower, to prevent it 
from touching the water surface. 
 使整个舷梯有充足的照明并备有带自亮灯浮和可浮救生索的救生圈。 
The whole gangway should be sufficient lightings, and with a lifebuoy equipped with 
self-igniting light and buoyant lifeline. 
4.0 根据《SHIP-05-04 船舶进出港安全制度》，对引水组合梯和引水梯进行检查。 
The pilot combination ladder and pilot ladder should be inspected as per 《SHIP-05-04 Ship Arrival & 
Departure Safety Regulations》. 
5.0 直升机接送引航员时应按照《船舶手册》第六章中的“直升机作业安全须知”的规定

The pilot transfer by helicopter, should be carried out according to the regulations laid out in the Chapter

第18 节 电子海图显示与信息系统(ECDIS)的使用须知 
Section 18  Electronic Chart Display and Information System (ECDIS) Instruction  
 
 
1 
目的和适用范围 
Purpose and Scope 
本规定的目的是指导使用人员正确地使用和维护ECDIS系统，确保航行安全。 
This regulation provides guidance to the operation personnel to use and maintain the ECDIS accurately 
for navigation safety. 
2 
操作须知 
Operating Instruction 
 
2.1 
 主要的导航方式： 
Primary Means of Navigation: 
当船舶配备 ECDIS（在安全设备证书中输入单或双配置）时，主要导航方式应为 
ECDIS。 
When Vessels are fitted with ECDIS (in single or dual configuration entered in to the SEQ), the 
PRIMARY means of navigation shall be ECDIS. 
驾驶台上应有清晰的显示，指示主要的导航方式。 这应显示在ECDIS 设备上。 
There should be a clear display on bridge indicating the primary means of navigation. 
This shall be displayed on the ECDIS equipment. 
 
2.2 
ECDIS 适用要求  
Application requirements of ECDIS 
2.2.1 ECDIS 硬件必须符合IMO 的相关性能标准和IHO 相关细则的要求，达到功能特性的
最低要求，并取得相关组织的认证（型式认可证书），以及制造商提供的ECDIS 系
统认证证书；按照IHO的要求，ECDIS装船后必须运行ECDIS数据显示和性能检查。 
The hardware of ECDIS must fulfil the requirements of IMO Performance Standard and relevant 
regulations of the IHO, and meet the minimum requirements of functional characteristic. Obtain the 
certification (model approval certificate) of the relevant authority and ECDIS certificate from the 
manufacturer. According to the IHO's requirement, after ECDIS is installed on ship, run the ECDIS data 
display and function testing. 
软件升级、系统更新、更换硬件后，IHO建议运行数据显示和性能检查：IHO发布了
ECDIS数据显示和性能检查程序，根据ECDIS装载的软件版本，IHO设有两个独立的
测试程序，驾驶员需要将该测试程序装载到ECDIS中，需要的时候进行数据显示和性
能检查。 
After software system update and hardware replacement, IHO suggests to perform a data display and 
functional check: IHO issued the ECDIS data display and functional test procedures. According to the 
software edition installed in the ECDIS, IHO has two separated testing procedures. Deck officer have to 
install that testing procedure into ECDIS. If necessary, perform data display and functional inspection. 
2.2.2 使用官方ENC数据库(Electronic Navigation Chart)，有合适比例的ENC,数据被安装并
更新；本航次所需的ENC许可已经取得（或申请）并始终保持更新；除非该港口经确
认没有发布官方ENC,否则禁止船舶使用RNC(Raster Navigation Chart)。 
Use the official database ENC (Electronic Navigation Chart). There are ENC with suitable scale, data to 
be installed and updated. The necessary ENC permission (or application) is obtained and maintained 
update. Unless the port has confirmed there is no official ENC presented, or else the ship is prohibited 
from the use of RNC (Raster Navigation Chart). 
2.2.3 在ECDIS上绘制航次计划时，应注意ENC中的提示信息，在这个比例尺下，ENC 中
的某些区域可能无法提供所需的数据，该信息将会要求驾驶员去参照对应的大比例尺

海图。  
When drawing voyage plan on the ECDIS, pay attention to the message reminder in the ENC. Under 
this measuring scale, some areas in the ENC may not provide the necessary data. The message will 
require the deck officer to refer to a chart with larger scale. 
2.2.4 进行风险评估来决定所需纸质海图的组合(APC)，以支持没有被 ENC 包含到水域的 
RCDS 模式。 
Perform risk assessment to decide the appropriate portfolio of up-to-date paper charts (APC) to support 
RCDS mode for water area not yet included by the ENC. 
2.2.5 软件批准：IHO 证实的官方海图的海图供应商；船舶管理公司应该确保ECDIS软件
持续得到更新升级； 
Software permission: Chart supplier that offers official chart approved by the IHO; ship management 
company should maintain updates and upgrades for the ECDIS continuously; 
2.2.6 配备两套符合要求的ECDIS的船舶，目前多数国家允许其不必再配备纸质海图，但两
套ECDIS应有独立电源供应； 
Equipped with two sets of ECDIS which can meet the requirements on the ship. Currently, most 
countries allow the ship not to allocate approved portfolio of charts, yet two sets of ECDIS should have 
separate power supply; 
2.2.7 配备一套ECDIS和一套纸质海图船舶除满足公约的有关ECDIS要求外，所有纸海图的
配备使用均根据体系文件的原有规定执行，当纸海图作为备用时，不需要进行定位作
业；但纸质海图要做到随时可用。 
For ship with allocation of one set of ECDIS and one set of paper charts, apart from fulfilling the 
requirements of ECDIS laid out in the conventions, all paper charts should be used according to the 
original regulations of the system documents. The position fixing operation on paper charts will not be 
required when paper charts are used as back up, but the paper charts should be available at any time.  
2.3 
ECDIS 的使用 
Application of ECDIS 
2.3.1 船舶应为每一ECDIS设备制定设备操作方案和使用手册。 
The ship should develop a set of operation plan and manuals for each ECDIS equipment. 
2.3.2 各驾驶人员在休假交接班时，应认真交接ECDIS 系统的操作使用，以确保航行值班、
航线执行工作能顺利衔接，不因已接受了设备熟悉培训而忽略在换班时的细致交接。
值班交接班时，应检查ECDIS的工况，按照“SHIP-03-02-03 驾驶台航行交接检查表”
中与ECDIS相关项目认真进行交接班。 
When on vacation, deck officers should perform a serious handover for the ECDIS operation to ensure 
the navigation duties and navigation execution work can be shifted smoothly. Even the personnel are 
already aware of the equipment due to training, handover should be made with attention to details. 
When on duty, deck officers should perform a serious handover for checking the condition of ECDIS 
and confirming all items on “Checklist for Duty Shifting of Bridge Watch”. 
2.3.3 电子海图的订购与更新 
Purchase of ENC 
 船舶根据需要申请开通航行区域的电子海图，海图覆盖区域和有效期限应满足当
前航次安全航行的需求； 
The ship should apply the ENC to go through navigation area. The area coverage and availability 
period of the chart should fulfil the requirements of safe navigation for this voyage; 
 岸基主管部门监控船舶ECDIS 系统海图的配备，并根据船旗国、港口国、沿岸国
及航经区域的特殊规定，审核船舶申请的电子海图的合理性和适用性，以确保船

ECDIS Backup 
计划航线、标注在ENC中的海图注释包括航区警告、和其他相关注释，应备份到专

备用 ECDIS 应与主 ECDIS 完全同步，并检查已安装的电子海图以确保它们正确
更新。 
The backup ECDIS shall be fully synchronized with the primary ECDIS and the installed electronic

计划航线和相关的海图注释应同步显示在备份系统上，包括监控方法、显示设置和

航线、许可证和其他相关文件应在船上进行备份和记录，所有值班人员应熟悉使用

应每周执行切换到备用ECDIS 的练习，以确保系统和流程满足要求够且持续最新，
并做相应记录。 
Weekly practice of switching to ECDIS backup shall be carried out to ensure systems and process are 
adequate and up – to – date and the exercise is logged down.  
2.3.5 航次计划的制定 
Development of voyage plan 
2.3.5.1 使用 ECDIS 进行评估和航次计划之前的检查 
Checks Prior Using ECDIS for Appraisal and Passage Planning 
驾驶员应进行下列检查： 
The following checks should be carried out by the Navigating Officer: 
1) 不是所有海区都被 ENC 覆盖。电子海图覆盖的范围对航次必须足够而且所有相关

公司。 
 Not all sea areas are covered by ENC charts. The electronic chart coverage for the voyage must be 
adequate and all relevant charts must be fully corrected. For areas covered by ENC, it is mandatory

areas shall be available onboard and office shall be informed prior commencement of the passage. 
2) 核实沿岸国的地方要求，它们可能要求携带额外的出版物或当地海图。 
Check local requirements of coastal states that may require carriage of additional publications or local 
charts. 
3) 检查电子海图已更新到最新版本而且海图许可证已购买。 
Check that electronic charts have been updated to the most recent version and chart permit licenses 
have been bought. 
4) 船舶的操控参数（安全水深、安全等深线、速度、偏航范围、旋回要素、“前瞻距
离”等）应被输入。 
The vessel’s controlling operational parameters (Safe depth, safe contour, speed, XTD, turning data, 
‘look ahead’ distance etc.) should be entered. 
 
5) 无论如何，设计一个安全的航路需要经验、时间和足够熟悉 ECDIS 的一般原则，
驾驶员应知道下列几点： 
However, planning a safe route requires experience, time and adequate familiarity with the general 
principles of ECDIS and navigators should be aware of the following: 
a. 检查航线功能：驾驶员在规划航线后应使用检查航线功能，确保船舶在规划航线
上不会遇到航行危险。 这些危险主要与搁浅危险、穿越 TSS 线/边界和用户定义
的警报有关。 
Check Route Function: The navigating officer should make use of the check route function after 
passage planning to ensure that vessel will not encounter navigational hazards on the planned route. 
These hazards would be mainly pertaining to grounding dangers, crossing TSS line/ boundary and 
user defined alarms. 
但是，此功能因制造商而异，提醒使用电子海图显示系统的海员不要仅仅依靠自
动航行计划和监控检查和警报。 一些电子海图显示系统似乎只在大比例尺的电子
海图上执行航线检查功能，因此警报可能不会激活。 这可能不会在 ECDIS 显示
屏上清楚地显示出来。 驾驶员应始终使用其他/所有显示模式对整个计划航线进行
仔细的目视检查，以确认它以及任何偏离它的情况都没有危险。 
However, this functionality varies among the different makers, mariners using ECDIS are 
reminded not to rely solely on automated voyage planning and monitoring checks and alarms. 
Some ECDIS appear only to undertake route check functions on larger scale ENCs and 
therefore alarms might not activate. This may not be clearly indicated on the ECDIS display. 
Mariners should always undertake careful visual inspection of the entire planned route using 
the other/all display mode to confirm that it, and any deviations from it, is clear of dangers.   
b. 在沿海航道上，ENC 将包含许多与区域相关的注意事项。 这些可能会导致在航
线设计阶段生成大量警告，从而导致错过关键项目警报。 因此，仔细检查所有警
告/警报非常重要。 
On coastal passages, ENCs will be populated with many areas related cautions. These may result in 
numerous warnings being generated during the planning stage leading to miss out of critical item 
alert. It is important that all warnings/alarms are carefully checked. 
c. 需要完整的查看航线相关的ENC海图信息。相关查看方法取决于ECDIS的品牌和型
号，需参照相关设备的说明书。 
Information on an ENC along the route requires to be accessed in full. The procedure for the 
complete access to information will depend on the make/model of the ECDIS and is given in the 
manufacturer’s manual.

For certain sea area without officially authorized ENC data, change to RNC or approved nautical

j. 设定的航线必须在主系统和备用系统上存储，航线名称应按下述例式存储供将来

ECDIS setting 
注意：ECDIS 操作员必须根据船舶及其预定航程、航段或航行区域设置适当的安全

或使警报被忽略。 
CAUTION：It is imperative that the ECDIS operator sets safety settings and a watch vector (look ahead

2.3.6.1 安全水深/安全等深线参数设置 
Setting of Safety Depth/Contours parameters 
 安全水深：根据公司的 UKC 政策，这是船舶航行所需的最小安全水深。 
Safety Depth: This is the Minimum Safety Depth that vessel needs to stay in as per company’s UKC 
Policy. 
富余水深和安全水深应遵循富余水深的确定原则《SHIP-05-01 航行制度和航次计划》
7.1 项。 
The under-keel clearance and safety depth should follow the principle for determining under-keel 
clearance < SHIP-05-04 Navigation Regulation and Voyage Plan> item 7.1. 
安全水深计算公式如下: 
The safety depth should be calculated as follows:  
安全水深=静态最大吃水+（下沉量+CATZOC +涌浪影响+影响UKC 的其他因素）- 潮高 
Safety depth= Max. static draught + (Squat + CATZOC + Wave Response + Other Factors) - prevailing 
tide height.  
 安全等深线Safety Contour: 
在开始任何航次之前，海员必须根据船只的吃水和所需的富裕水深，并考虑到现有 
ENC 数据的质量和预期的操作条件，为安全等高线设定一个适当的值。 
Before commencing any voyage, the mariner must set an appropriate value for the safety contour based 
on the vessel’s draught and required under-keel clearance, taking into consideration the quality of the 
ENC data available and expected operating conditions. 
在大多数情况下，安全水深的值通常与安全等深线的值相同。 
安全水深的目的是在视觉上突出测深点，深度较深的测深点为灰色，深度较浅的测
深点为黑色。 
In most circumstances, the value for the safety depth is usually the same value as the safety contour. 
The purpose of the safety depth is to highlight soundings visually, either in gray for deeper depths or 
black for shallower depths. 
安全等深线在“安全”和“不安全”水域之间提供了一个可见的深度界限，并在显
示屏上突出显示，以便于识别。 
The safety contour provides a visible boundary between “safe” and “unsafe” water with respect to 
depth and is highlighted on the display to enable easy identification. 
以下规则规定了显示的安全等深线在航行中可能发生的变化。 
The following rules dictate how the displayed safety contour may change during a voyage. 
a) 如果操作者没有指定安全等深线，则默认为30m。 
If no safety contour is specified by the operator, the default is 30m. 
b) 如果操作员选择的安全等深线在ENC 中不可用，则 ECDIS 将默认为下一个更
深的等深线。 
If the safety contour selected by the operator is not available in the ENC, the ECDIS will default 
to the next deeper contour. 
c) 如果船舶移动到新海图时，之前使用的安全等深线不再可用，ECDIS 将选择下
一个更深的等深线 
If, when the ship moves onto a new chart, the safety contour previously in use is no longer 
available, ECDIS will select the next deeper contour 
d) 如果操作员指定的安全等深线或默认的 30m 等深线不在显示的 ENC 中，则显
示的安全等深线将默认为下一个更深的等深线 
If the safety contour specified by the operator, or the default 30m contour, is not in the displayed 
ENC, the safety contour shown will default to the next deeper contour

注意事项： 
在靠近浅水区的狭窄航道内航行时，可能会减少或关闭前视矢量，以尽量减少可

When navigating within narrow channels in close proximity to shallow waters, it may be tempting 
to reduce or turn off the look-ahead vector in order to minimize the number of safety contour

 浅水等深线和深水等深线 
Shallow contour and deep contours 
ECDIS 对正在显示的深度区域进行颜色编码。海员可以选择简单的双色阴影，也
可以选择更精致的四色阴影。为了支持四种颜色选项，除安全等深线外，所有
ECDIS 类型都允许用户设置浅水和深水等深线。 
ECDIS colour codes depth areas which are being displayed. the mariner is given the option of a 
simple two-color shading, and a more elaborate four-color option. to support the four-color options, 
all ECDIS types allow the user to set shallow and deep water contours in addition to the safety 
contour. 
除了低潮时露出的潮间带外，ECDIS 默认只显示两种深度色调: 
The ECDIS will default to only showing two depth shades in addition to the inter-tidal area which 
is exposed at low water: 
• 浅水/不安全水域                 0 米至安全等高线（30 米）之间 
Shallow / unsafe waters            Between 0 metres and the safety contour (30 metres) 
•  深水/安全水域                   深度超过安全等深线（30 米） 
Deep / safe waters                Deeper than the safety contour (30 metres) 
ECDIS 将使用这些值，直到航海者决定选择其他参数。如果更改了安全等深线
的值，两个深度阴影之间的边界也会相应更改。更改浅等深线或深等深线的值不
会对显示产生影响。 
These values will be used by the ECDIS until the mariner decides to select other parameters. If the 
value of the safety contour is changed, the boundary between the two depth shades will change 
accordingly. Changing the value of the shallow or deep contours will have no effect on the display. 
但是，如果关闭 "两个色调 "选项，ECDIS 将使用为浅水和深水等深线项设置的
值显示四个不同的色调。 
However, if the ‘Two shades’ option is switched off, the ECDIS should then display four different 
shades, using the values that are set for the shallow and deep contour options. 
不同的颜色(颜色编码)可以用来突出不同的深度。 
Different colours (Colour Coding) can be used to highlight the different depths.

等深线颜色可以是2 色或4 色显示

The use of four depth shades reduced the contrast difference between adjacent depth areas. This may

2.3.6.2 电子海图显示模式ECDIS display modes： 
ECDIS 操作员可以通过使用所有型号 ECDIS 都有的三种不同显示模式来控制显
示的海图详细程度。国际海事组织 ECDIS 性能标准中列出了每种模式所包含的海
图特征等级。 
The ECDIS operator is able to control the level of chart detail displayed by using the three different 
display modes that are available on all models of ECDIS. The classes of chart feature included in 
each mode are listed in the IMO ECDIS Performance Standards. 
三种显示模式为 
The three display modes are: 
“基本 ”显示 
这是在任何时候都必须显示的最低信息量。它不足以保证航行安全。有些 ECDIS 
不允许航海者将显示信息的级别降低到 "基本"显示。“基本”示屏是 "标准"显示
屏的子集。 
‘Base’ Display 
This is the minimum level of information which has to be displayed at all times. It is not intended to 
be sufficient for safe navigation. Some ECDIS do not allow the mariner to reduce the level of 
information shown to the ‘Base’ display. The ‘Base’ display is a subset of the ‘Standard’ display. 
“标准”显示 
这是 ECDIS 首次开启时应使用的显示模式，只需按下一个键即可返回该显示模
式。在正常情况下，这应被视为在任何时候都必须显示的最低限度信息，而且根
据航海者的需要，航海者可以在此基础上通过添加相关信息来修改显示内容，尤
其是在评估和航程规划期间。 
‘Standard’ Display 
This is the display mode that the ECDIS should use when it is first switched on, and it should be 
possible to return to this display mode by a single key press. Under normal circumstances, this 
should be considered to be the minimum information that must be displayed at all times and, 
depending upon the needs of the mariner, is the starting point from which the mariner can modify 
their display by adding relevant information, especially during appraisal and passage planning. 
其他 
该显示模式可显示 ENC 数据中的所有信息。使用该模式时，ECDIS 显示屏可能
会非常杂乱，尤其是在显示大量文字描述或洋红色信息符号的情况下。为了帮助

者通过在 "标准 "显示模式中添加特征类别来 "构建 "海图显示，要么允许从 "全

ensure the display can be configured safely. It is recommended that the voyage plan includes a list of the 
settings required for each phase of the voyage. 
在任何时候，ECDIS 上需要显示的详细程度取决于正在执行的航行任务。公司强烈建议在
航程规划过程中的某个阶段使用 "全部 "显示模式来直观地检查预定航线。一旦制定了详
细的航行计划，并使用航海信息层进行了适当的注释，就可以将显示的详细程度降低到更
接近于 "标准 "显示，以便在航行监控期间提供清晰的显示。 
The level of detail that needs to be displayed on ECDIS at any one time will depend on the navigational task 
being undertaken. It is strongly recommended by company that at some stage in the voyage planning process 
that ‘All’ display mode is used to visually inspect the intended route. Once a detailed voyage plan has been 
produced and suitably annotated using the mariner's information layer, it will be possible to reduce the level of 
detail shown much closer to the ‘Standard’ display so as to provide clarity of display during voyage 
monitoring. 
 
2.3.6.3 白天/晚上设置 Day/ Night Settings: 
与其他驾驶台设备的设计一样，ECDIS 可以使用不同的色调显示 ENC 数据。白
天的设置具有更高的对比度和亮度，以便在阳光直射下更清晰地显示特征。黄昏
设置的对比度和亮度会降低，夜间设置的对比度和亮度会进一步降低，以保持清
晰度和夜视效果。 
In common with the design of other bridge equipment, an ECDIS is able to display ENC data using 
different colour palettes. The daytime setting has a much higher contrast and brightness level to 
make the features stand out more clearly under direct sunlight. These levels are reduced for the dusk 
setting, and reduced further for the night time setting so as to preserve clarity and night vision. 
显示屏的设置应符合驾驶台的相应条件。有三种主要观察模式：白天、黄昏和夜
间。 
The display should be set up to meet the appropriate conditions on the bridge. There 
are three main viewing modes available: daytime, dusk, and night-time.  
注意 
使用夜间/黄昏设置时，背景颜色会发生变化，浅滩/其他危险可能无法显现。危险
可能不易察觉。在确定好方向之前，建议偶尔切换到日间设置。 
CAUTION - 
When using night/ dusk settings, background colours get altered and shoals/ other 
dangers may not be readily apparent. Until good orientation is achieved, it is 
advisable to switch to Day settings occasionally. 
在黄昏或夜间操作时，应考虑遵循以下建议，以优化显示的清晰度： 
When operating at dusk or at night, consider the following recommendations should to followed to

航行制度                         版本/修改：3.0/8.0                    SHIP-05-18 
Navigation Regulations                     Version/Rev.: 3.0/8.0                     SHIP-05-18

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.     Effective Date: 2023/08/21                Page 11 / 25 
 
optimize the clarity of the display: 
• 确保设置了安全等深线，而不是让 ECDIS 默认为 30 米。当大部分或整个屏幕
都在安全等深线范围内时，用户更容易忽略在安全等深线后的浅水区作业这一事
实。安全等深线后的特征，如浮标和深度等高线，可能会变得更加难以看清。 
Make sure the safety contour is set, rather than leave the ECDIS to default to 30m. It is easier to lose 
sight of the fact that the user is operating in shallow waters behind the safety contour when most of, 
or the entire, screen is within the safety contour limit. Features behind the safety contour, like buoys 
and depth contours, may become more difficult to see. 
• 确保显示屏设置为两个深度色调，而不是四个，以增加安全轮廓两侧的对比度
差异。 
Make sure the display is set to two depth shades, rather than four, to increase the contrast difference 
either side of the safety contour. 
• 如果 ECDIS 提供浅水模式功能，请确保打开该功能，以便更容易区分安全等深
线后的区域。 
Make sure the shallow water pattern is switched on if the ECDIS offers this feature, in order to make 
it easier to distinguish areas behind the safety contour. 
• 对浮标和信标使用简化符号，因为它们比传统符号更醒目，尤其是当它们被更
亮的雷达回波覆盖时。 
Use simplified symbols for buoys and beacons, as they stand out more clearly than the traditional 
symbols, especially when they are overlaid by brighter radar echoes. 
 
2.3.6.4 每周航海通告Weekly Notices to Mariners： 
《海员每周通告》包括一些 ENC 数据中没有的信息。应参考 ADMIRALTY 每
周航海通告的以下部分： 
The Weekly Notices to Mariners includes some information which is not available within the ENC 
data. The following sections of the ADMIRALTY Notices to Mariners Weekly should be consulted. 
- 第 I 部分（解释性说明、出版物清单）提供了 ENC 和 RNC 的重要信息，这
些信息包含在标题为 "ADMIRALTY AVCS 和 ECDIS 服务 "的部分中。 
Section I (Explanatory Notes, Publications List) gives important information on ENCs and RNCs 
included in the section titled “ADMIRALTY AVCS and ECDIS services.” 
- 第 II 部分（ADMIRALTY 海员通告 - 标准海图的更新）包括临时和初步海员
通告的信息，在没有 AIO 的情况下使用。 
Section II (ADMIRALTY Notices to Mariners – Updates to Standard Nautical Charts) includes 
information on Temporary and Preliminary Notices to Mariners for use where AIO is not available. 
- 第 III 部分（无线电导航警告的重印本）包含仍在生效的 NAVAREA I 警告的
详细信息，这些警告传达了紧急航行安全信息，但可能尚未包含在 ENC 数据中。
Section III (Reprints of Radio Navigation Warnings) contains details of NAVAREA I warnings still 
in force conveying urgent navigational safety information which may not yet be included in the ENC 
data. 
- 第 IV 节至第 VII 节包含内容通常不包含在 ENC 数据中的 ADMIRALTY 出
版物的更新信息。 
Section III (Reprints of Radio Navigation Warnings) contains details of NAVAREA I warnings still 
in force conveying urgent navigational safety information which may not yet be included in the ENC 
data. 
Sections IV to VII contain updating information for ADMIRALTY publications whose content is 
not usually included in the ENC data.
