2.3.6.5 电子海图预告： 
ENC Preliminary Notices (EPNM): 
电子海图航海预告包含特定于电子海图的附加信息，不能作为标准海事临时通告&预
告发布。 这些航海通告以与临时性航海通告&预告相同的方式显示，作为一个简单的
红色多边形（通常是矩形），带有红色阴影填充，表示受航海通告影响的区域。 每个
航海通告都分配有一个唯一的 EP NM 编号。 
ENC P (EP) NMs contains additional information that is specific to ENCs and cannot be published as a 
standard Admiralty T&P NM. These NMs are displayed in the same way as T&P NMs, as a simple red 
polygon (usually rectangular) with red hatched fill which indicates the area affected by the NM. Each NM 
is allocated a unique EP NM number. 
 ECDIS-“日期相关对象”的临时信息 
Temporary Information on ECDIS- ‘Date Dependent Objects’ 
为了管理临时通告和预告，引入了一个新的洋红色“d”符号，可以突出显示具有编
码非永久信息的 ENC 特征。 这是 S 57 图表的固有特征。 
To manage the temporary and preliminary information a new magenta ‘d’ symbol has introduced that 
can highlight ENC features having an encoded non-permanent information. It is an inherent feature of the 
S 57 Chart. 
 
这个“d”表示 - 日期相关的图表数据。 
在航线规划和监控期间，操作员必须启用日期相关功能并选择日
期或日期范围以显示所有日期相关的非永久性海图对象。 
This ‘d’ indicates - date dependent chart data. 
During route planning and monitoring the operator must enable the date dependent function and select 
a date or date range to display all date dependent nonpermanent chart objects. 
2.3.6.6  海事信息叠加 (AIO) 
Admiralty Information Overlay (AIO) 
AIO 是一种数字数据集，设计用于在 ECDIS 和其他海图显示系统中显示ENC，为导航
员提供更多信息。 
AIO is a digital data set that is designed to be displayed over ENCs in ECDIS and other chart display 
systems to provide additional information to the navigator.  
它包含全球现行的所有ADMIRALTY T&P NMs，并提供 ENC 特有的额外初步信息，
例如已纳入纸质海图但尚未纳入 ENC 的航行危险报告。后者作为 ENC初步 NMs (EP 
NMs) 出版。 
It contains all ADMIRALTY T&P NMs in force worldwide, and provides additional preliminary 
information that is specific to ENCs, such as reported navigational hazards that have been incorporated on 
paper charts but have not yet been included in ENCs. The latter are published as ENC Preliminary NMs 
(EP NMs). 
EP NM 的显示方式与 T&P NM 相同。每个NM 都有一个唯一的 EP NM 编号。 
EP NMs are displayed in the same way as T&P NMs. Each NM is allocated a unique EP NM number. 
可在 ECDIS 挑选报告中根据信息属性查看 NM 全文。 
The full text of the NM can be viewed in the ECDIS Pick Report against the information attribute. 
如果需要更多信息来解释 NM，则相关图片会显示 ENC数据与当前纸质海图信息叠加
的图像。 
Where additional information is needed to explain the NM an associated picture fi le displays an image 
showing the ENC data superimposed over the current paper chart information.

AIO 仅为有等比例 ADMIRALTY 纸质海图的地区提供 ENC 数据的叠加信息。如果
没有纸质海图，则会显示 "无叠加 "特征，即显示为一个灰色多边形和一个灰色阴影。
在这些区域航行时，航海者应确保查阅了所有适当的信息来源，例如任何可能存在的国
家或地方 T&P NM。 
AIO only provides this overlay information to the ENC data for those areas where there is an equivalent 
scale ADMIRALTY paper chart. Where one does not exist, this is indicated by the ‘No Overlay’ feature 
which is displayed as a grey polygon with a grey hatched fi ll. When navigating in these areas, mariners 
should ensure that all appropriate sources of information have been consulted, for example any national or 
local T&P NMs that may be available. 
在航程规划的评估阶段使用 AIO 可以帮助航海者确定是否有任何信息是预定航程所
需要的。制定计划并使用 ECDIS 航海注释功能在 ENC 上标注感有关的区域后，就可
以关闭叠加功能，只显示 ENC 数据和注释，以便在航程监控期间使用。 
Using the AIO during the appraisal phase of voyage planning will help a mariner determine if any of the 
information is required for the intended voyage. Having made the plan, and marked the areas of interest on 
the ENC using the ECDIS mariner’s notes function, the overlay can then be turned off leaving only the 
ENC data and the annotations on display ready for use during voyage monitoring. 
注意： 
目前可用的 ENC 数据并不包含所有必要的导航信息。 
为了满足 SOLAS 的要求，使用 ENC 的航海者必须继续使用相关的官方航海出版物。
ENC 数据本身不足以支持对预定航程的全面评估。 
Caution: 
Currently available ENC data do not contain all the necessary navigational information. 
In order to meet SOLAS requirements, mariners using ENCs must continue to use related official nautical 
publications. ENC data on its own is not sufficient to support a full appraisal of the intended voyage. 
2.3.6.7 可信度区域的分类  Category of Zone of Confidence (CATZOC) 
a.  可信度区域按照数据分类提供了六个不同的可信度区域。             
The attribute Category Zone of Confidence in data provides six different zones of confidence. 
b. 一个可信度区域表明特定的数据满足定义在以下表中的最低标准的位置和深度精
度，以及海底覆盖。 
The allocation of a ZOC indicates that particular data meets minimum criteria for position and depth 
accuracy and seafloor coverage defined in the table below.  
c. 航海人员要注意可信度区域的分类仅在用户选择了合适的电子海图显示层进行显
示时才可见。因此，在评估阶段，必须选择可信度区域层，并且必须评估每一个
航段的数据的准确性。 
Navigators are to take note that CATZOCs are only visible when user has selected the appropriate 
ENC layer for display. Hence, at the stage of appraisal, the CATZOC layer must be selected and the 
data accuracy must be assessed for each leg.  
d. 可能存在这样一种情况，航次中的一段航程将通过未评估区域。在执行或监控阶
段，将它切换到可信度区域层将是太晚了。 
There could be a situation, one of the leg of a passage will pass through unassessed area. It will be 
too late to switch the CATZOC layer during execution or monitoring stage.  
e.  驾驶人员需要使用 ECDIS 选择报告功能来询问任何进一步的信息。 有了这个，
驾驶员可以在航线计划阶段知道一个区域的最后勘测日期和勘测方式。 
Navigating Officers need to use ECDIS pick report function for interrogate any further information. 
With this, the Navigator can be able to know the last survey date of an area and means of survey at 
the stage of passage planning.

2.3.6.8 SCAMIN 设置 
SCAMIN setting 
a. SCAMIN–是电子海图属性分配的特征，他们将在ECDIS中规定显示的最小的比例
尺。 
SCAMIN – is an attribute allocated to features within ENC that defines the minimum (smallest) 
scale at which they will be displayed in an ECDIS.  
b. SCAMIN 是用来当减小电子海图的比例尺时，电子海图显示的信息量也被大量的
减少（见下面的图片例子） 
SCAMIN is used to significantly reduce the amount of information on the ECDIS display when 
reducing the viewing scale of an ENC. (See picture example below) 
 
c. 关闭 SCAMIN 以对通线进行评估、规划和审查，以确保看到所有信息。 
SCAMIN to be switched off for appraisal, planning and review of the passage to ensure all 
information seen. 
d.  开启 SCAMIN 以执行和监控航程，以减少显示过于拥挤的影响。 SCAMIN 可以
关闭，只是为了提高航道执行期间的态势感知，以查看重要的导航信息。 
SCAMIN to be switched on for execution and monitoring of voyage in order to reduce the effects of 
an overcrowded display. The SCAMIN can be switched off just to improve situational awareness 
during passage execution as to view essential navigational information.  
e. 当值班驾驶员在执行航路时，缩小比例尺来改善态势感知，一旦态势感知确立，
值班驾驶员应立即复位到海图编制的比例尺。

f.   防搁浅设置

a) 前瞻距离设置 
Look Ahead Range Setting

Look Ahead function (also known as Watch Vector, anti-grounding setting or guard zone) - It is the 
Ahead window for the input of advance time for alarm / warning generation. This would need to be 
determined by the Master and is dependent on the ship’s speed, traffic situation, geographical 
limitations, and manoeuvrability.

2.3.7 航行监控 
Monitor of navigation 
2.3.7.1 航行中应连续监控系统工作状态，正确使用信息（雷达、AIS 等）叠加功能，根
据航行环境设定和调整偏航距离、等深线、碍航物距离等各报警参数，设置信息
显示方式、各警报音量，合理使用ECDIS 系统提供的航迹控制功能。信息显示方
式最低应为“标准模式”，各警报音量不能关闭。在系统故障、停电等异常情况发生
后，如系统恢复使用，应对各种参数重新检查和设定。 
Monitor the system working conditions continuously during navigation. Use the information (radar, 
AIS and so on) overlying function accurately. Set and adjust the alarm parameter such as deviation 
distance, water-depth line, obstruction clearance, set information display mode, the volume of all 
alarm according to the prevailing navigation circumstance. Use the navigation track control 
functions provided by the ECDIS reasonably. The “standard display should be the essential in object 
category display and the volume of all alarm should not be closed completely.  When the system is 
recovered after the occurrence abnormal conditions such as system breakdown, power failure and so 
on, inspect and define setting of all parameters once again. 
2.3.7.2 航行前检查显示器是否已正确设置，否则可能无法显示重要信息。 ENC 的图层
通常有三种默认设置，即 Base、Standard 和 Other。 ENC 通常应处于other访问
模式。 
Check that the display has been set-up properly prior to sailing, otherwise important information 
may not be displayed. There are generally three default settings of the layers of an ENC i.e. Base, 
Standard and Other. The ENCs should normally be in other access mode. In case the text 
information clutters the other chart information, the text layer may be disabled. 
2.3.7.3 白天/夜晚设置：应设置显示器适合驾驶台的环境。有 3 种主要的观察模式可得到：
白天、黄昏和夜晚。 
Day/ Night Settings: The display should be set up to meet the appropriate conditions on the bridge. 
There are three main viewing modes available: daytime, dusk and night-time. 
2.3.7.4 注意 - 使用夜间/黄昏设置时，背景颜色会发生变化，浅滩/其他危险可能不会很明
显。 在获得良好定位之前，建议偶尔切换到白天模式。 
CAUTION- When using night/ dusk settings, background colour get altered and shoals/ other 
dangers may not be readily apparent. Until good orientation is achieved, it is advisable to switch to 
Day settings occasionally. 
2.3.7.5 始终尽可能以最佳规模使用 ENC，以避免关键信息被自动过滤并随后不显示。

Use of radar to check the accuracy of the charted position 
2.3.7.11 如果使用 ARPA 叠加，ARPA 没有捕获的目标将不会显示在 ECDIS 上。同样没

因此，ECDIS 不应被用作主要的避碰手段。 
Therefore, ECDIS should not be used as primary means of collision avoidance. 
2.3.7.12 使用单一的定位方法，尤其是在 ECDIS 中自动定位的方法，可能会导致过度依赖。

over – reliance.

2.3.7.13 驾驶人员不能过分信赖和依赖ECDIS 系统： 
Deck officer should not over trust and rely ECDIS; 
 应熟悉相关航路资料，了解单凭ECDIS系统对预设航线进行检查和航行监控是并

Be aware of the relevant information of the navigation route. Inspection and monitor of the default 
navigation route by ECDIS alone is not sufficient;  
 航行中应使用不同手段确认船位标绘在海图上以监控航行； 
By cross-checking of the ship’s position by all appropriate means and plot the positions on 
appropriate chart during navigation for monitoring navigation; 
 航行中应定期核对ECDIS 输入数据与外围设备数据的一致性，例如航向、航速、
船舶回转速度等； 
Perform periodic verification on the ECDIS data and other equipment’s data during navigation. 
Make sure they are in compliance, such as heading, speed, rotating speed and so on; 
 应充分认识到ECDIS系统的局限性，例如：由于ECDIS系统信息更新存在一定的

系统还无法显示临告和预告； 
Be aware of the limitation of ECDIS, for example: since there is time intervals between the update 
of ECDIS information, the latest navigation information may not display on the system completely; 
as to temporary navigation safety information issued by the VHF, NAVTEX and EGC, these are 
not indicated on the electronic chart; ECDIS for some ships are not able to display temporary and 
preliminary navigation safety information; 
 在近岸航行和进出港口时，船舶附近常有较为完善的浮标、叠标等陆地导航设施，
驾驶人员应充分利用这些设施航行与避险，并与ECDIS系统比对，以核查ECDIS
系统的工作状况； 
When navigation near the shore, berthing and leaving the port, there are often better on-shore 
navigation aid such as buoys, range marks and so on. Deck officer should make full use these 
facilities in navigation and avoid danger, and look up on the ECDIS to verify its working 
conditions; 
 充分考虑硬件故障、电脑病毒、传感器故障、停电、海图安装错误等原因可能带
来的风险，在航行中一旦发现此类故障影响ECDIS 使用，应立即使用纸海图或
另一台ECDIS以确保航行安全。 
Possible risks brought by hardware breakdown, computer virus, sensor breakdown, power failure 
and chart installation error should be taken into consideration. When such fault is found to 
influence the ECDIS application, use an approved nautical chart or another set of ECDIS to ensure 
safe navigation.

2.4 
ECDIS 系统维护 
Maintenance of ECDIS 
2.4.1 船舶根据制造商提供的更新方式，及时对ECDIS 系统ENC 数据进行更新， 更新中
发现任何问题，应及时向岸基反馈寻求指导。 
Depends on the update approach provided by the manufacturer, the ship should update the ECDIS 
system and ENC data timely. If any problem is found during the update, seek guidance from the 
shore-based timely. 
2.4.2 每次开机后，应根据制造商说明书对ECDIS 系统进行性能测试；如长期不使用ECDIS 
设备，应定期通电防潮。 
Every time after switching on the equipment, perform functional testing to the ECDIS according to the 
manufacturer’s instructions. If the ECDIS is not being in use for a long period of time, it should be 
powered on periodically in order to protect it from moisture.  
2.4.3 每次抵、离港前，应对ECDIS 系统进行功能测试。 
Every time before berthing or leaving the port, perform function testing to the ECDIS. 
2.4.4 ECDIS 系统维护记录，维护维修、检查试验、更新操作、开通新海区、订购新海图
等操作均应及时记录。 
Keep a proper record on ECDIS maintenance, such as maintenance, inspection testing, update operation, 
go through a new sea area, purchase of new charts, should be recorded in time. 
2.5 
ECDIS 系统管理制度 
Management system of ECDIS 
2.5.1 船舶应妥善保管所有ECDIS 系统安装用技术资料，主管人员要按顺序登记和保存基
础数据盘、更新数据（包括数据包或数据光盘）和更新许可证等，将相关信息和更新
情况保存或登记在NP133C中。 
The ship should keep all technical information of ECDIS installation properly. The concerned personnel 
should register and keep the foundational data disk, update data (including data folder or data CD-rom), 
update license and so on. Relevant information and update conditions should be kept or registered in the 
NP133C. 
2.5.2 二副负责船舶ECDIS 系统日常的管理、维护、保养、更新、升级、培训和风险管理，
按照NP133C的要求进行记录。应注意制造商发布的信息，对其可能宣布存在的问题
和缺陷及时进行修正，对ECDIS工作时的缺陷和不足应及时报告公司。 
Second Officer is responsible for the routine management, maintenance, update and upgrade, training, 
cyber risk management of ECDIS, and record in the NP133C. Pay attention to the information issued by 
the manufacturer, make timely corrections to the problems and defects that they may announce. Any 
defects or deficiencies noted in ECDIS performance should be immediately reported to the company. 
2.5.3 由岸基管理人员负责对ECDIS 系统进行维护，确保系统安全清洁。 
Shore-based personnel is responsible for the maintenance of ECDIS to ensure the system is safe and clean. 
2.5.4 ECDIS 系统作为涉及航行安全的关键设备，除主管人员进行数据更新操作外，不得接入
任何存储介质和设备，不得用于其他用途。 
 ECDIS is a key equipment which involves navigation safety. Except for operation such as data 
update by the concerned personnel, do not connect any storage medium or equipment to use the data for 
other uses.

2.5.6 未经船长许可，任何人不得进行系统文件操作。 
Do not operate system documents without permission of the Master. 
2.5.7 二副负责ECDIS LOGBOOK数据记录的导出和保存，时间间隔不超过90天，或参考设
备的说明书要求，船长监控。 
Second Officer is responsible for the export and keeping of ECDIS logbook data record. The time interval 
should not exceed 90 days, or refer to the requirements of the equipment. The Master is responsible for 
monitoring. 
2.5.8 传感器故障 
Sensor Failure 
2.5.9 输入ECDIS的任何传感器仅在其相对于船舶设置的准确度方面有用 
Any sensor fed into the ECDIS is only as useful to the degree of accuracy to which it has been set up in 
relation to the vessel. 
下表详细说明了 ECDIS 的任何强制性传感器输入故障期间所需的影响和操作。 
Below table details the effects and the actions required during failure of any of the mandatory sensor input 
to ECDIS. 
如果 ECDIS 的任何传感器输入出现故障，值班驾驶员应立即通知船长，进行风险评估
和实施安全航行应急措施，包括修改航次计划，根据需要在驾驶台增派值班人员。 公
司应获知通过 ECDIS 制造商协助排除故障的详细信息 
Master shall be promptly notified by the OOW in case of failure of any sensor input to the ECDIS, risk 
assessment carried out and contingency measures implemented for safe navigation, including amendment of 
the voyage plan, posting additional watch keepers on bridge, as may be required. Company shall be 
informed with details for assisting in troubleshooting through ECDIS makers.

3. 
在ECDIS 完全失灵情况下的行动    
When the ECDIS breakdowns completely

Officer on Watch (OOW) should immediately perform the following:

两套ECDIS 
Two sets of ECDIS

第19 节 CAPE 型散货船操纵注意事项 
Section 19 Cape Size Vessel Manoeuvring Precautions 
 
1.0 CAPE 型船舶的操纵特点 
CAPE size ships operating characteristics 
1.1 惯性大。其表现在:   
large inertia. Its performance in: 
 冲程长，余速消失慢。 
Long advance, remaining speed diminish slow. 
 车、舵应变性差。 
Poor response on engine and rudder. 
1.2 线型尺度大。其特点为： 
Larger linear scale. Its features are: 
 瞭望盲区增大。 
Lookout blind area increases. 
 水线上、下受力作用面积大。 
above, below water line, action of force with a large area. 
 限制水域影响增大。 
Restricted water area influence increases. 
1.3 方型系数大。其特点为：船旋回性好，旋回直径相对较小。 
Large block coefficient. Its characteristics are: ship good turning ability, the turning diameter is relatively 
small. 
1.4 追从性差，用舵后不能立即转向。 
Poor follow-up, cannot immediately turn with the helm. 
1.5 旋回中速度下降明显 
Significantly speed decreased during the turn 
2.0 CAPE 型船舶操纵注意事项 
CAPE size ship handling precautions 
2.1 航速控制 
Speed control 
2.1.1 在航道和港内时操纵要保证安全航速又要能维持舵效。航行中要不断调整车速来适当
控制船速，要随时注意舵角和操舵人员的反应。因受顺流时舵效差故尽量选顶流操作。
当船首无法把定时，即进车或短时间加大进车，大舵角纠正首偏航。 
Manipulation in waterways and in-harbor, to ensure safe speed and maintain rudder effect. During the 
navigation, to continue adjust the revolution to properly control the speed, always pay attention to the 
rudder angle and the response of the helmsman. When proceed with the current, will have a poor rudder 
effect, try to choose counter current operation. When the bow cannot be steady, ahead engine, or increase 
ahead engine for a short time, large rudder angle to correct the bow deviation. 
2.1.2 进港或赴锚地应早减速，缓慢接近锚地。宜在距锚地15 海里便变速航行，在10-5 海
里降为慢速；当距锚地5 海里处停车，然后改微速、停车适时交替，保持舵效驶至预
定地点。 
Entering port or going to the anchorage should slow down early, slowly approach to the anchorage. It is 
advisable to navigate at maneuvering speed when 15 nautical miles from the anchorage and slow speed 
when 10-5 nautical miles. When 5 nautical miles away from the anchorage stop the engine, then alter the 
slight speed and stop at appropriate time to maintain the rudder effect to the predetermined place. 
2.2 紧急制动

Emergency stop 
2.2.1 船速较低时,CAPE 型船舶可采用紧急倒车把船停住，但要注意急倒车存在无法控制其
方向的缺点。 
When the ship speed is low, CAPE size ships can be stopped by emergency astern engine, but beware of 
the shortcoming of the emergency astern engine is lost direction control. 
2.2.2 船速较高时，如环境、水域许可，利用船舶旋回下降速度明显原理，先采取大舵角转
向来大幅度降速，然后再急倒车，此法可大大缩短冲程。 
When the ship speed is high, if the environment, water area permit, use the ship turning will obvious 
decline speed principle. Firstly, take a large rudder angle turning to substantially slow down, and then 
emergency astern engine, this method can greatly reduce the advance. 
 具体操作如下： 
Operation detail is as follows: 
船舶全速前进，操左（右）满舵，船转向到离原航向50°－60°时，操右（左）
满舵，当船航向返回接近原航向时，（此时航速几乎降至慢速），再操左（右）满
舵，当船稳在原航向附近时，令主机快倒车，致使船完全停住。 
Ship full speed ahead, order rudder hard port (starboard), when the ship deviated 50 ° -60 ° from the 
original course, order rudder hard starboard (port), when the course close to the original course, (this 
moment ship speed nearly reduced to slow speed), order rudder hard port (starboard) again, when the 
course steady on the original course, order main engine full astern, to fully stop the vessel. 
2.3 风流影响 
Wind and current influence 
2.3.1 风对操船的影响CAPE 型船舶空载时受风的影响很大。当风舷角处于正横或稍后或是
船尾来风时难操纵，当风向接近首尾线或首来风时船相对较好操纵，因此，大风浪中
航行要依涌浪方向，不断调整风舷角来维持船舶保向性。 
Wind influence on the ship handling, CAPE size ship in ballast condition will be greatly affected by the 
wind. It is difficult to handling when the wind is from abeam, or slightly after abeam, or from stern; it is 
relative easy to control when the wind is from fwd and aft line or from bow. Therefore, when navigate in 
heavy weather, should follow the swell direction, frequently adjust the relative wind direction, to maintain 
the ship's heading. 
2.3.2 流对操船影响潮流和水流对吃水大的船舶尤其是满载的CAPE 型船舶的操纵影响很
大，要重视产生的非常明显的流压差或流致飘移速度。 
Current influence on the ship handling, tidal current and water flow have a great influence on the 
handling of deep draft ships, especially laden CAPE size ships. Attention should be paid to the very 
obvious flow pressure difference or drifting speed caused by the flow. 
 在港内或河道操纵时,事先了解水流特点，及早防止流压。把船摆在上风上流。风流
合力作用时，要依风大顶风，流大顶流原则来操纵。 
When operating in a port or a river, familiar with the characteristics of water flow in advance, to 
prevent the flow pressure. Put the ship in the windward. When the ship is affected by the wind and 
current together, according to “strong wind deal with the wind, strong current deal with the current”, 
principle to handle. 
 流中抛锚时，一定要首对着流，不能像万吨船那样，先抛锚，再靠锚抓力和流的作
用使船调头。 
When anchoring in the stream, firstly must face the stream. Cannot as a 10,000 tons ship practice, 
drop anchor first, turn around by the anchor holding power and current effect. 
 流中船舶掉头，靠离码头，要借助流的帮助。顶流舵效好，能在较短距离内比顺流
转过更大角度。故靠离码头、进出狭水道多选用顶流操作。 
Ship turn around in the stream, terminal berthing, need the help from the current. Good rudder effect

when counter current, can be rotated larger angle in a shorter distance. Therefore, the terminal 
berthing and unberthing, in and out the narrow channel will select counter current operation. 
2.4 浅水对操纵性的影响CAPE 型船舶进入浅水区后，船体下沉和纵倾增大以及由于舵附近
的涡流使船尾伴流及虚质量明显增大，当水深是吃水的2.5 倍左右时，开始出现浅水影
响。 
Shallow water influence on the ship handling, after the CAPE size ship enters the shallow water area, the 
hull sinks and trim increases, and the stern wake and virtual mass increase obviously due to the vortex 
near the rudder. When the water depth is about 2.5 times of the draft, shallow water effect began to 
appear. 
2.4.1 驶入浅水的异常现象 
Enter into shallow water anomalies 
 首兴波形状发生变化，扩散波从原来的左右的开角40 度逐渐像伞一样展开，开
角逐渐变宽。 
Bow wave shape changes, the wave spread from the original about 40 degrees gradually open like an 
umbrella, angle gradually widened. 
 船体下沉，纵倾产生变化 。 
Hull sinking, trim changes. 
 舵效变差。 
The rudder effect becomes worse. 
 船体震动加剧。 
Hull vibration intensified. 
2.4.2 浅水对操纵的影响 
The effect of shallow water on the ship handling 
 舵力下降，舵效差。 
Rudder force decreased, the rudder efficiency is poor. 
 旋回性下降，旋回直径变大。 
Turning ability decline, turning diameter becomes larger. 
 航向稳定性提高，但CAPE 型船舶驶入浅水区，当水深/吃水比为2 时，航向稳定
性反而下降，待水深/吃水比继续减少，航向稳定性又开始提高，这种现象应引起注
意。 
The heading stability is improved. However, the CAPE size ship enters the shallow water area, when 
the water depth / draft ratio is 2, the heading stability will decline, when the water depth / draft ratio 
continues decreased, the heading stability begins to increase again. This phenomenon should be pay 
attention. 
 浅水中船舶冲程会减小。 
In shallow water ship advance will decrease. 
2.4.3 船舶航经浅水区应采取的措施： 
Measures to be taken for the ship passing shallow waters area: 
 尽量调整为平吃水。 
Try to adjust to an even draft. 
 可考虑机舱使用高位海底阀。 
Consider engine room use the high sea suction valve. 
 精确计算潮汐，要考虑到潮汐资料的误差量和气压变化引起的水位增减量。过浅时
机宜选择在高潮前一小时。 
Accurate calculation of tides, taking into account the amount of tidal data error and changes in sea 
level caused by pressure changes. Time to pass shallow water should better choose an hour before the 
high water.

 留有足够的富余水深，并考虑到海图水深的测量精度。. 
Reserve sufficient under keel clearance, and taking into account the measurement accuracy of chart 
depth. 
 航行期间保持测深仪开机。启动和停止测深仪时，应在记录纸上清楚地标记日期时
间。必要时，在经过转向点或浅点时也做标记。如果测深仪具有浅水警报功能，则
此警报应设定在适合的安全水深，当船舶接近浅水时发出警告。 
Keep the echo sounder on during navigation. When starting and stopping the echo sounder, the date 
and time should be clearly marked on the chart. If necessary, mark after turning point or shallow point. 
If the sounder has a shallow water alarm function, the alarm should be set at a suitable safe water 
depth, an alarm is sound when the vessel approaches shallow water. 
 适当减速以减少船体下沉量。 
Appropriate reduce speed to reduce the amount of hull sinking. 
2.5 锚泊操纵CAPE 型船舶在锚地抛锚，如操纵不当易发生断链，丢锚，损坏锚机，应引起
注意。 
Anchoring handling, CAPE size ship anchored at the anchorage, if improper handling, easily to happen 
chain broken, anchor lost, windlass damaged, should be pay attention. 
2.5.1 锚地选择 
Anchorage Selection 
 要考虑水深，底质，水流，回旋余地，障航物，避风条件，尤其要防止船在涌浪中
摇摆，垂荡而墩底，必须留有足够的富余水深（低潮时的水深应大于1.5 倍吃水再
加上2/3 的最大浪高）。 
It is necessary to consider water depth, sediment, current, maneuvering space, obstacle object, 
sheltering conditions, especially to prevent the ship from swaying in the swell and touch bottom due to 
pitching, must reserve sufficient under keel clearance (water depth at low tide should be greater than 
1.5 times the draft plus 2/3 of the maximum wave height). 
 深水区域抛锚时，锚地最大水深不得超过一舷锚链总长的1/4。 
When anchored in deep water area, the maximum water depth of the anchorage shall not exceed 1/4 of 
the total length of the anchor chain on one side. 
2.5.2 进入锚地 
Enter the anchorage 
 应事先做好锚地导航计划，确定进入锚地的航向，转向点，抛锚点等。 
The anchorage planning should be done in advance, to determine the enter anchorage heading, turning 
point and anchoring point, etc. 
 大型船舶转向迟钝行动呆笨，应避免在锚泊船之间穿梭迂回。 
Large ships steering dullness, react slow, should avoid hang round between the anchored ships. 
 避免速度太快，一般距锚位点2 浬时，速度2 节左右为宜，基本上是停车淌航。 
To avoid speed too fast, usually when 2 miles away from the anchor point, the speed of about 2 knots 
is appropriate, basically is stop engine and drift to. 
 进入航向宜顺着抛锚船的首向 (即顶着风流) 接近，一般在指定锚位点较远的距离
上一个航向对准逐渐接近。这样做的优点是横向偏移小，船位、速度易控，不必进
行较大、较多的机动。 
The approach course should be close to the anchored ship’s heading (against the wind and current). 
Generally, the heading aligned with the designated anchor point from a distance and gradually 
approaches. The advantages of this method are small lateral offset, the ship position and speed are 
easy to control, not need to have powerful and frequent engine movement. 
 要控制抛锚时的余速越小越接近零越好，观察倒车水花的习惯做法在流速大时不太

确切，可利用GPS 测定的速度作为参考。  
To control the residual speed when drop anchor, the smaller, closer to zero is better. When the current 
is strong, it is not practical to observe the reversing flow. The GPS speed can be used as a reference. 
 掌握好流向，快到锚位点之前，应及早摆好船位，要为顶流抛锚创造条件，否则到
抛锚点就很难调整。 
Grasp the current direction, just before the anchoring point, should set the ship position as early as 
possible, to create conditions for counter current drop anchor, otherwise it will be difficult to adjust at 
anchoring point. 
 注意流压的影响，保持距他船的安全距离。 
Pay attention to the current pressure influence, keep the safe distance with other ships. 
2.5.3 抛锚方法 
Drop anchor method 
 要确认完全停船后才能抛锚，然后利用风流或微倒车将链慢慢送出。 
Make sure ship completely stopped before anchoring, then exploit the wind and current or slightly 
astern engine sent out cable slowly. 
 在空载强风弱流条件下，宜船艏迎风抛锚；在重载强流时，宜船艏顶流抛锚，且首尾
线与流的交角越小越好，流舷角最大不能超过30 度。初出链不要太多，一般首次抛
出锚链长度为1.5—2 倍水深，刹牢。在风流作用下或车舵配合下逐渐分段将链松出。
如水深超过25 米，应按深水抛锚方式抛锚。 
In ballast condition, strong wind and weak current situation, preferred to have bow against the wind 
drop anchor; in full loaded condition, strong current situation, preferred to have bow against the 
current drop anchor, and have a small intersection angle between the fore-and-aft line and the current, 
the maximum intersection angle should not larger than 30 degrees. Do not sent out too much chain at 
the beginning, in general first sent out chain length is 1.5-2 times the water depth, brake on. Under 
the effect of the wind and current or the engine and rudder, gradually sent out chain by sections. If 
the water depth exceeds 25 meters, should follow the deep water anchoring method to drop anchor. 
 
2.6 大风浪中船舶操纵 
Ship handling in the storm waves 
船舶越大，涌浪对船体局部的撞击力越大，如船舶局部受力超过许用应力，则导致船体
变形，因此需采取减轻船舶摇摆和缓和波浪冲击的措施，以等待海况变好或尽早驶离大
风浪海区。 
The larger the ship, the greater the impact of the surge on the local hull. If the local stress of the ship 
exceeds the allowable stress limit, the hull will be deformed. Therefore, measures to reduce the ship's sway 
and reduce the wave impact should be taken, to await the better sea state conditions or leave stormy sea 
area as soon as possible. 
2.6.1 改向 
Change course 
当纵向顶浪航行纵摇严重时，可慢慢改变航向，改变船浪相遇交角，使船舶摇摆最小，
甲板上浪最少，拍底及打空车现象有好转的最佳状态。一般船艏与波浪之间的夹角20°
左右较好。为避免一舷艏长时间受涌浪冲击变形，可考虑采取左右舷艏等间隔时间交
替方法。 
If the ship pitch seriously with navigation against directly wave, the course can be slowly adjusted, to 
change the intersection angle between ship and wave, so as to minimize the swaying of the ship, 
minimize the waves on the deck, the beat the bottom and race phenomenon will be ceased. General 
intersection angle between bow and waves is better about 20 °. In order to avoid long time surge impact 
deformation on one side, consider to conduct port and starboard sides equal time intervals as an alternate

2.6.2 变速 
Adjust speed 
 船舶顶浪航行时如艏大量上浪，或艏底被浪击严重拍底，或艏侧被浪猛烈冲击，或
船体被涌浪抛起时，应适当减速，使船速与波速产生差异直至感到情况好转，甚至
减速到维持舵效的速度。 
When the ship against wave navigation, if bow has many seas on deck, or the ship bottom is severely 
beaten by waves, or the ship side is severely punched by the waves. or the hull is thrown up by the 
swell, the speed should be slowed down properly, to make the difference between the ship speed and 
the wave speed until condition is better, even slowed down to minimum speed to maintain rudder 
effect. 
 大风浪中航行，往往是改向、减速同时采用。 
Strong wind and waves navigation, often change course, reduce speed at the same time. 
2.6.3 滞航 
Heave to 
为使船舶留在原地附近又减轻波浪对船艏的冲击，采用以保持舵效的最小速度，航向
随着风向改变不断调整，进行滞航操纵，滞航中即要经常不断调整方向、航速又要保
证有足够的舵效，以防船被打横。 
In order to keep the ship state at nearby and to reduce the impact of waves on the bow, the minimum 
speed to maintain the rudder effect is adopted. The course changes continuously as the wind direction 
changes, conduct heave to operation. During heaving to, should continuously adjust the course and speed, 
also to ensure sufficient rudder effect, to prevent the ship horizontal attacked. 
2.6.4 漂航 
Drifting 
当船舶主机或舵损坏或风浪过大无法保向时，被迫采取漂航。漂航适用船体老旧的船，
但必须保持船舶水密和足够的稳性。 
When the ship's main engine or rudder damaged or storms are too strong to be maintain the heading, 
forced to drift. Drifting apply to hull aged vessels, but the vessel must be watertight and have enough 
stability. 
2.6.5 顺浪航行 
Navigation with the wave 
CAPE 型船舶船体长大，不利于顶浪航行时应改为顺浪航行较安全。但要注意，船长
与波长相近，船速又与波速接近时，应果断地改变航速，并选择船首与波浪适当的受
浪角（一般20°左右），以减轻尾淹、打横的现象。 
CAPE size ship hulls long and big, when not conducive to navigate against the wave, should change to 
navigate with the wave which is safer. However, it should pay attention that when the ship length is close 
to the wavelength, the ship speed is close to the wave speed, should change the speed decisively, and 
choose the appropriate intersection angle between the bow and the waves (about 20 °), to reduce the 
phenomenon of stern flooding and horizontal attack. 
2.6.6 大风浪中调头 
Turning around in storm waves 
 CAPE 型船舶在大风浪调头应特别注意重载时船体的强度。 
CAPE size ships should pay special attention to the strength of the hull in heavy storm conditions. 
 调头时应掌握: 
When turning around should grasp: 
 利用波浪运动的规律，即3—4 个大浪后必接2—8 个小浪，使船舶在转向中较为

Make use of the pattern of wave motion, after 3-4 large waves, 2-8 small waves will be followed,

 调头开始时慢速中舵（15－20°），掉头过程中视较平静海面到来前，适时快车
满舵，迅速完成调头。 
When turning around slow speed, medium rudder (15-20 °), during the turn, depends on the 
situation, before the calm sea state, appropriate time give full speed and rudder, quickly completed 
the turn. 
 从顶浪转向顺浪时，转向应在较平静海面到来之前开始，以求较平静海面来临时
正好转到横浪。此后再配合主机突进，用满舵，加速完成后半圈的掉转。从顺浪
转向顶浪比较危险。要先降速减小惯性冲力,等待时机，以求后半段掉转在较平静
海面进行。后半段旋转应尽可能迅速，可视情采用主机突进措施以增加舵效来加
快掉转。由于判断失误，在旋转过程中遇大浪来临而处于困难境地时，切勿强行
掉转，可选择与波浪的适当相位，等待时机，再次掉头，此时切忌急速回舵或操
反舵，防止过大横倾。 
When shifting from against wave to follow wave, the change course should begin before the calm 
sea state, in hope that the calm sea meets the abeam wave. Then with the main engine suddenly full 
ahead, full rudder, accelerate to complete the latter half turn. Shifting from follow waves to against 
waves is more dangerous. To reduce inertia momentum first, waiting for the timing, in order to 
have latter half turn conduct at the relative calm sea. The latter half turn should be as fast as 
possible, depends on the situations, use the main suddenly full ahead measures to increase the 
rudder effect, to accelebrate the turn. Due to misjudgment, in case of big waves come during turn, 
in difficult situations, do not force turn back, can choose the appropriate phase with the wave, 
waiting for the opportunity, once again turn around. This moment should not rush back rudder or 
hard-over, to prevent excessive listing. 
2.7 当风力超过8 级，船长应向船员发布无关人员禁止到主甲板的命令，木匠测水或赴主甲
板抢修工作的人员必须经过船长许可，并穿妥救生衣腰系安全绳，至少2 人一组且其中
一人担当安全员。当船舶进入大风浪区前，船长应指示大副按规定在甲板上设置固定的
安全绳。 
When the wind exceeds force 8, the captain shall issue to the crew an order prohibiting unauthorized 
access to the main deck. Carpenters take sounding or personnel to main deck for emergency repairs must 
be permitted by the captain and wear lifejackets and safety belt. At least 2 persons in a group, one serves 
as a safety guard. Before the ship enters into a strong stormy area, the captain shall instruct the chief 
officer to set a fixed safety rope on the deck as per regulation required.

 第20 节 防范商渔船碰撞安全须知 
Section 20 Safety Guidelines for Preventing Collisions Between Commercial Vessels and Fishing Boats 
1 
目的  Purpose 
本须知旨在为船舶提供防范商渔船碰撞的安全操作事项，确保船舶航行安全。 
This guidance note aims to provide safe operation for vessels to prevent collision between merchant 
vessels and fishing vessels，ensure safe navigation of vessels. 
2 
适用范围Scope of application 
本须知适用于公司安全管理体系内所有船舶在渔区或邻近渔区航行时的操作，在
执行本须知时还应执行狭水道、雾航、大风浪航行等适用的操作要求。 
The instructions are applicable to the operations of all vessels in the company's safety management 
system when navigating in or near the fishing area, and the applicable operational requirements 
such as narrow waterway, fog navigation and heavy weather navigation should also be 
implemented. 
3 
职责Responsibilities 
3.1 
海务部负责收集中国沿海水域渔船密集区域信息，向各轮发布防商渔船碰撞预警信
息，监督船上培训的落实情况和船舶驾驶员的安全操纵。 
The Marine Department shall be responsible for collecting information in the densely populated 
areas of fishing boats in China's coastal waters, issuing warning information on preventing 
of collision between merchant vessels and fishing vessels to each vessel, and supervising the 
implementation of training on board and the safe operation of the ship's deck officer. 
3.2 
船长负责为航行值班配备充足的值班人员，对驾驶员进行商渔船避碰操作技能的指
导，督促驾驶台值班人员严格遵守安全航行规定，必要时亲自指挥和操作船舶。 
The captain shall be responsible for providing sufficient on-duty personnel for the navigation 
watch, guiding the deck officer on collision avoidance operation skills of between merchant 
vessels and fishing vessels, urging the bridge watchkeeper to strictly abide by safe navigation 
regulations, and directing and operating the ship personally when necessary. 
3.3 
驾驶员知晓本须知的相关内容和要求，并严格遵守。 
Deck officers are aware of the relevant contents and requirements of the instructions and shall 
strictly abide by them. 
4

长）对本须知的熟悉和相关要求的执行情况，必要时可组织驾驶人员测试和考试。
The person in charge of the Marine Department shall check the implementation of the training 
on the ship and the familiarity of the ship's deck officer (including the master) with the 
instructions and the implementation of the relevant requirements during each inspection visit to 
the ship, and may organize tests and examinations for the deck officer when necessary. 
5.2 
进入渔船集中作业水域之前  
Before entering the waters where fishing vessels are concentrated 
5.2.1 二副应按《航行制度和航行计划》的要求，合理制定航行计划、拟定计划航线，计
划航线应使用适用的推荐公共航路，尽可能避开渔船集中作业水域，减少与渔船相
遇的机会。 
The second officer shall, in accordance with the requirements of the Navigation Regulation and 
Voyage Plan, make a reasonable voyage plan and draw up the planned route. The planned 
route shall use the applicable recommended public navigation route, avoid the waters where 
fishing boats are concentrated as far as possible, and reduce the chance of encounter with fishing 
vessels. 
5.2.2 船长严格审核航行计划，指导二副和驾驶人员拟定渔区航行安全注意事项及相应行
动对策。 
The captain shall strictly review the voyage plan and instruct the second officer and the deck 
officer to formulate navigation safety precautions and corresponding countermeasures in the fishing 
area. 
5.2.3 开航前，二副负责对雷达、电子海图、AIS、VDR、VHF、航行灯和声号等设备进行
检查和测试，确保正常可用。 
Before sailing, the second officer shall be responsible for checking and testing the radar, ECDIS, 
AIS, VDR, VHF, navigation lights and sound signs and other equipment to ensure normal 
availability. 
5.2.4 船长应合理安排驾驶台航行值班人员，中国沿海水域航行时，任何时候驾驶台应保
持2 名及以上航行值班和了望人员。 
The captain shall reasonably arrange navigation keeping on the bridge. During navigation in 
China's coastal waters, there shall be at least 2 navigation watchmen and lookout men on 
the bridge at any time. 
5.2.5 二副详细注明渔区航行安全注意事项及相应行动对策。 
The second officer shall specify in detail the navigation safety precautions and corresponding 
countermeasures in the fishing area.

5.3 
经过或邻近渔船集中作业水域航行期间 
During navigation in or near the waters where fishing vessels operate intensively 
5.3.1 驾驶人员谨记：加强了望，安全航速，有效避让，安全第一，不要冒险！宁可绕行，
尽可能避免冒险进入渔船密集区域航行！ 
Deck officer shall remember: strengthen the lookout, safe speed, effective avoidance, safety

5.3.2 船长应合理安排值班人员，根据周围渔船密集程度和航行值班强度增加必要的航行
值班人员，并针对夜间渔区航行的特殊戒备要求制定和签发夜航命令。 
The master shall arrange the personnel on watch reasonably, increase the necessary personnel 
on watch according to the density of the surrounding fishing vessels and the intensity of the 
navigation watch, and formulate and issue the night navigation order according to the special 
alert requirements of the navigation in the fishing area at night. 
5.3.3 航行值班人员应加强瞭望，杜绝疲劳驾驶。 
The navigation watchman should strengthen the lookout and prevent the tired navigating. 
5.3.4 航行值班人员应保持航行灯显示、AIS 信息正确且工作正常，雾航时即使雷达上没
有发现渔船，也应按章鸣放雾号。 
The navigation watchman should keep the navigation light display and AIS information correct 
and working normally. In fog navigation, even if no fishing vessel is found on the radar, 
the fog signal should be sounded according to the regulations. 
5.3.5 任何时候船舶均以适合当时环境和情况的安全航速行驶，在接近渔船密集区时，应
提前通知机舱备车，必要时减速航行。 
At all times, the ship should travel at a safe speed suitable for the current environment and 
conditions. When approaching a crowded area with fishing vessels, the ship should inform the 
engine room in advance to standby engine and slow down the navigation if necessary. 
5.3.6 开启两台雷达，加强远近距离配合观测。 
Open two radars to strengthen the near and far coordinated observation. 
5.3.7 在渔船密集区域，应当预先通过雷达观察等手段，找出渔船相对稀少之处，谨慎操
纵船舶从该水域通过。 
In areas densely populated by fishing vessels, radar observation and other means should be 
used in advance to find out where fishing vessels are relatively rare, and ships should be carefully 
steered through the waters. 
5.3.8 必要时航行值班人员应毫不犹豫及早呼叫船长上驾驶台指挥。 
When necessary, the navigation officer on watch shall not hesitate to call the captain to command 
on the bridge as soon as possible.

5.4 
特别注意的事项Matters needing special attention 
5.4.1 中国沿海水域夜间航行时，船长应每晚签发《夜航命令》，就夜间航行应采取的特
别警戒措施提出要求，当班驾驶人员应认真阅读、签认和有效执行。 
When sailing in China's coastal waters at night, the captain shall issue the Night Sailing Order 
every night, making requirements for special alert measures to be taken during night sailing, 
which shall be carefully read, signed and effectively implemented by the deck officer on duty. 
5.4.2 夜间23 时至次日凌晨4 时是商渔船碰撞事故高发时段，应予以特别关注。 
Special attention should be paid to the high incidence between merchant vessels and fishing 
vessels collisions between 23:00 at night and 4am the next day. 
5.4.3 对渔船不遵守《1972 年国际海上避碰规则》和其他航行规定的情况要有充分的思
想准备，加强瞭望，避让渔船尽可能采取早让、宽让，特别是休渔期结束后一段时
间。 
In case fishing vessels do not comply with the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions 
at Sea (1972) and other navigation regulations, it is necessary to be fully prepared, strengthen 
lookout, and avoid letting fishing vessels off as early as possible, especially for a period after 
the end of the fishing moratorium. 
5.4.4 应特别注意部分渔船夜间锚泊时可能未按要求值班、显示号灯和开启AIS。 
Special attention should be paid to the fact that some fishing vessels may not be on duty, 
display signal lights and turn on AIS as required when anchoring at night. 
5.4.5 夜间应特别注意大量渔网网位仪对AIS、雷达和电子海图的使用干扰。 
Special attention should be paid at night to the use of AIS, radar and ECDIS interfered with 
by a large number of fishing net position meters. 
5.4.6 若观测到渔船船速在3 节左右时，通常该渔船正在捕鱼作业中，操作能力受限，需
要及早协调避让,最好保持1 海里以上距离通过。 
When the speed of a fishing vessel is observed to be around 3 knots, it is usually in fishing 
operation and its operating capacity is limited. Therefore, it is necessary to coordinate and 
avoid collision as soon as possible, and it is better to keep a distance of more than 1 nautical 
mile. 
5.4.7 每年9 月16 日东海伏季休渔结束后，是东海海域渔船密度最高时节。 
After the end of the summer fishing moratorium in the East China Sea on September 16 every 
year, the density of fishing vessels in the East China Sea is the highest. 
5.4.8 开渔初期、台风影响前后和冬季寒潮南下前后，渔船会密集进出港，此时渔船往往
成群结队朝一个方向航行，商船应及早制定避让方案，并充分注意到渔船不愿让商
船穿插其间的情况，尽可能避免从某一渔船船队中间穿越。进出港船舶服从港口
VTS 指挥，避免与渔船流在狭水道会遇。 
At the beginning of the fishing season, before and after the typhoon and before and after the 
cold wave southward in winter, fishing vessels will come and leave the port in large numbers.

At this time, fishing vessels tend to sail in one direction in groups.Inbound and outbound vessels 
obey port VTS command to avoid encountering fishing vessels in narrow channels. 
5.4.9 休渔期并非意味着不允许任何渔船出海捕鱼，此时不仅存在正常可捕鱼船舶，还可
能存在跨区域偷捕行为船，这些渔船为逃避监管往往会关掉AIS，甚至夜间不开号
灯。 
The fishing moratorium does not mean that no fishing vessels are allowed to go out to sea 
for fishing. At this time, there are not only normal fishing vessels, but also cross-regional 
illegal fishing boats. 
5.4.10 部分港口航道存在木质渔船，值班驾驶员航行时不能只看电子海图AIS 目标，疏忽
视觉了望和雷达观测。 
There are wooden fishing boats in some ports and channels. The navigation watchman should 
not only look at the AIS targets on the ECDIS and neglect the visual observation and radar 
observation. 
5.4.11 进出港航行期间，通航密度大，渔船无序，必要时提前安排了头以消除船货形成盲
区带来的安全隐患。 
During the voyage in and out of port, the navigation density is large and the fishing boats 
are disorderly. If necessary, the head is arranged in advance to eliminate the hidden danger 
caused by the blind area formed by the cargo. 
5.4.12 夜间渔船密集时，要特别注意灯光诱捕船刺眼的强光灯对附近船舶灯光射程的削弱
作用，注意识别埋没于其间的其他船舶，防止对突然发现的商、渔船措手不及。 
At night, when fishing boats are crowded, special attention should be paid to the weakening 
effect of the glare lights of the light trapping ship on the range of nearby ships, and attention 
should be paid to the identification of other ships buried in the meantime, so as to prevent 
the sudden discovery of businesses and fishing vessels from being taken by surprise. 
5.5 
避让行动Collision avoidance action 
5.5.1 严格遵守《1972 年国际海上避碰规则》的规定是良好船艺，但良好船艺的最终目
标是避免事故的发生！ 
Strict compliance with the "1972 International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea" 
is good ship manning, but the ultimate goal of good ship manning is to avoid accidents! 
5.5.2 驾驶人员可尝试提前通过VHF16 频道呼叫，协调渔船避让行动，但数次呼叫尝试
无应答，可能意味着该渔船未在VHF16 频道守听。 
The navigation watchman can try to call through VHF16 in advance to coordinate the collision 
avoidance action of the fishing vessel. However, no response after several call attempts may 
mean that the fishing vessel is not listening on VHF16. 
5.5.3 发现需紧急避让的渔船，可用探照灯闪烁至少5 次，或用连续声号引起渔船注意。
When spotting a fishing vessel in need of emergency avoidance, flash the searchlight at least 
5 times or use a continuous horn to attract the attention of the fishing vessel.

5.5.4 避让时合理使用声光信号，近距离内避让渔船禁止使用自动舵。 
Reasonable use of sound and light signals when avoiding collision. Automatic rudder is prohibited 
for fishing vessels avoiding collision in close range. 
5.5.5 紧急避让时，除用舵避让外，应同时考虑减速停车避让。 
In emergency avoidance, in addition to rudder avoidance, decelerate and stop should be considered 
at the same time. 
5.5.6 避让行动要充分考虑周围环境，以免造成与其他船舶的紧迫局面。 
The collision avoidance action should take full account of the surrounding environment, so as 
not to cause an urgent situation with other ships. 
5.5.7 一旦误入渔网或穿过渔网时，应立即停车淌航，以免渔网缠入螺旋桨，穿过后需确
认无渔具挂连。 
Once entering the fishing net or passing through the fishing net, stop and start sailing immediately 
to avoid entangling the fishing net into the propeller. After passing through, make sure that 
no fishing gear is connected. 
5.5.8 避让过程中密切观察避让效果和态势变化，防范渔船为保护渔具而采取一些过激措
施而与商船发生碰撞。 
In the process of avoiding confrontation, observe the effect of avoiding confrontation and the 
situation change closely to prevent the collision between the fishing vessel and the merchant 
vessel by taking some drastic measures to protect the fishing gear. 
5.5.9 必须核查避让行动的有效性，确认已无碰撞危险或驶过让清，警惕渔船近距离不协
调行动而发生碰撞。 
The effectiveness of collision avoidance action must be verified to confirm that there is no danger 
of collision or clearance, and to be alert for collisions caused by uncoordinated actions of fishing 
vessels at close range. 
5.6 
应急救助Emergency Rescue 
5.6.1 在碰撞无可避免时，应尽可能保护渔船，尽可能避免本船船首与渔船正面撞击。
When the collision is unavoidable, the fishing vessel should be protected as far as possible 
to avoid the frontal collision between the bow of the ship and the fishing vessel. 
5.6.2 发生碰撞事故后应立即停船，采取正确的即时行动，应将人命救助置于首位，全力
开展现场救助。 
After the collision accident, the ship should stop immediately and take correct immediate action. 
The rescue of human life should be given priority and on-site rescue should be carried out 
with all efforts. 
5.6.3 立即呼叫周边船舶参与救助。 
Immediately call the surrounding ships to participate in the rescue. 
5.6.4 通过一切有效途径，立即向就近的主管机关报告现场情况，包含事故发生位置、遇
险船舶名称、人员伤亡情况、船舶受损情况、天气海况和救助需求等。

第01节 直升机/船舶作业安全须知 
     Section 01 Safety Instructions for Helicopter / Ship Operation 
 
1.0 船舶遇险或船员（旅客）危重伤病时，往往需要求助于直升飞机。直升机不仅可以为
遇险船舶提供救援或转运伤病员，而且还可以直接对遇险人员实施救助。然而航海人
员和航空人员因工作环境工作性质等差异，相互之间缺乏了解，有时甚至连对方最基
本的技术特点都不清楚，因而在直升机与船舶之间进行救助作业时，容易出现问题。
这样不仅降低了救助效率，而且还可能由此酿成机毁人亡的事故，使损失的规模进一
步扩大。此外船舶或人员遇险时，海面状况往往非常恶劣，风疾浪高，船舶剧烈摇荡，
航速航向不稳定，从而加大操作难度。 
When ship or crew (tourists) in danger, normally helicopters are required. Helicopters could not only 
provide rescue for ships in distress and transfer the sick and wounded, but also implement first-aid to 
people in distress. However, due to different working environment and job nature, personnel who work at 
sea and aviation personnel have little knowledge about each other, not even the fundamental features of 
the other’s job. Therefore, problems are easily occurring during salvage operations between helicopters 
and ships, which not only reduce the salvage efficiency, but also lead to helicopter crash and casualties as 
well as further expand the scale of losses. In addition, when ships or persons are in distress, the sea 
conditions are normally very harsh, with wind hash and swells high. When the ship is swaying violently, 
speed and direction are not stable, which increase the difficulty of the operation. 
2.0 有些港口使用直升机进行接送引航员的工作，操作方法参见3.0。 
Some ports are using helicopters for transferring pilots. Operation measures see 3.0. 
3.0 直升机/船舶操作须知如下： 
Helicopter / ship operation instructions are as follows: 
3.1 在直升机抵达前船长应制定操作方案并组织实施； 
Before the arrival of the helicopter, the master should formulate the operation plan and organize the 
implementation; 
3.2 清除降落或吊运点周围的障碍物； 
Clear the obstacles around the landing or lifting spot; 
3.3 如可能应在该处画一大的白色H 字样； 
If possible, a white “H” should be painted at this spot; 
3.4 对于大型船舶降落或吊运点应布置在船舶的下风一侧； 
For large-scale ships, landing or lifting spot should be positioned at the downwind of the ship; 
3.5 吊杆/克令升至最高或放平； 
Suspender /crane should be rise to the highest level; 
3.6 系牢松动的设备和天线； 
Fasten the loosen facilities and antennas; 
3.7 备妥消防设备和救生设备；参考:Guide to Helicopter/Ship Operations, Fifth Edition. 
Fire -fighting and lifesaving equipment should be ready，ref. Guide to Helicopter/Ship Operations, 
Fifth Edition. 
3.8 以三角旗或风袋，为直升机驾驶员显示风向； 
Show the wind direction for the helicopter pilot with triangular flag or wind bag; 
3.9 夜间，降落或吊运点要配备良好照明，船舶周围设施应该照明（但不对空照射）； 
Good illumination is required at the landing or lifting spot during night time, and facilities around the ship 
should be illuminated (no illumination to the sky). 
4.0 及时与直升机取得通信联系，并通报如下细节： 
Get in touch with the helicopter in time with details listed below:

4.1 船位、航向、航速、风力、风向（与艏艉线的相对方向）； 
 
Ship position, course, speed, wind force, wind direction (relative direction with bow and stern line); 
4.2 浪、涌的方向和高度、海面视距（雨、雪情况）、气温； 
Direction and height of wave and swell， visibility of sea level (rain and snow condition), temperature; 
4.3 船身前后、左右摇摆情况、船甲板（集装箱顶部）干湿情况； 
The pitching, rolling condition of the ship, dry and wet condition of ship deck (container roof); 
4.4 降落或吊运点位置。 
Landing or lifting position. 
4.5 锚泊船起锚航行，直升机靠拢时要求船舶保向保速，船舶驾驶员应根据飞机驾驶员的
要求，及时调整航向和航速。 
Vessel underway after picked up her anchor, when the helicopter getting close, and request the ship 
maintain the course and speed, ship officer of the watch should make timely adjustment on the course and 
speed, in according to the helicopter pilot’s requirements. 
4.6 降落或吊运点设协助员一名，穿戴鲜艳服装和帽子，携带无线电对讲机保持与驾驶台
通信联系； 
One coordinator should be deployed at landing or lifting spot. The coordinator should be wearing bright 
clothing and hats, carrying walkie talkies to maintain communication with the bridge; 
4.7 直升机在船舶甲板上空悬停执行运送人员或物料，协助员（吊钩操作者）应帮助人员
或物料稳定和正确摘/挂钩。拇指向上的手势表示吊升；拇指向下的手势表示勿吊升。 
The helicopter hovers over the deck to transfer people or materials. The assistant (lifting-hook operator) 
should help the people or materials steady and correct picking / hooking. Thumb up gesture indicates 
lifting while thumb down refers to no lifting. 
4.8 直升机降落船舶甲板时，现场的指挥人员应站在着陆点的上风显著位置，能够看到飞
机驾驶员，以便给出相应的信号。飞机降稳后，甲板人员迅速上前协助人员上下飞机
或装卸物料。在作业区外的人员应听从现场驾驶员的指挥。 
When the helicopter lands on the deck, on-site commanders should stand in a notable position windward 
side of the landing spot, where they could see the helicopter pilot and give corresponding signals. After 
steady landing, people on deck should rush forward to assist personnel getting on/off the helicopter or 
loading/unloading materials. Personnel outside the work area should follow the direction of the on-site 
officer. 
5.0 直升机救助落水人员常见的救生装置是救生吊带，落水者可以按照下列步骤接受救助： 
Rescue slings are common lifesaving device for the helicopter to recover persons from water. The person 
in water can receive assistance in accordance with the following procedures: 
5.1 将救生吊带套在腋下； 
Putting a rescue sling in your armpit; 
5.2 准备完毕后发出吊升信号； 
Sending the lifting signal after getting ready; 
5.3 两臂弯曲双手在胸前紧握； 
Bending both arms with hands clasped in front of the chest; 
5.4 接近直升机舱门时机组人员会协助将身体转至背对舱门并帮助进入飞机； 
When approaching the cabin door, flight crew will assist the rescued personnel by turning his/her body 
back to the door and into the helicopter; 
5.5 接到指令后方可脱去救生吊带； 
Take off the rescue sling after receiving instructions; 
5.6 在某些场合，落水者由于体力消耗过大，可能已经失去活动能力，这时直升机驾驶员
会使用双起吊的方法，由机组人员帮助落水者登上飞机。

In some cases, person in water may not be able to move because of the excessive physical exertion. The 
helicopter pilot should use the double lifting method, and the flight crew will help the person in water to 
board the helicopter. 
6.0 其他注意事项如下： 
Other matters need attention as follows: 
6.1 甲板人员在直升机降落和飞离前，应远离作业区，防止直升机旋翼产生的风压对人员
造成伤害； 
Personnel on deck should stay away from work zone before the landing and launching of the helicopter, 
prevent the potential injury from the wind pressure generated by the helicopter rotor; 
6.2 防止直升机升吊设备产生的静电伤人，抓握前必须先令其接触水面或甲板面放电； 
Lifting equipment should contact with water surface or deck surface before be grabbed by people in 
preventing static electricity harm; 
6.3 所有货物都应及时从飞机旁运走，并保证货堆远离直升机下冲气流的影响； 
All cargoes should be carried away in time and stay away from the influence of downrush; 
6.4 被吊人员均应穿救生衣，伤病员也不例外，除非救生衣加重伤病； 
Unless the life jacket may aggravate the wound, otherwise all lifted personnel should wear life jackets, 
including the sick and wounded. 
7.0 风险评估 
Risk Assessment 
7.1 在进行风险评估时，应考虑到下列风险： 
 
The following risks should be considered during risk assessment: 
 上述“直升机/船舶作业安全须知” 与“ 直升机/船舶作业检查表”中列明的相关
风险； 
All the relevant risk listed in Safety Instructions for Helicopter / Ship Operation and Checklist for 
Helicopter / Ship Operation; 
 一旦作业过程中有紧急情况发生，救助器材和施救方案的及时性和有效性； 
Timeliness and effectiveness of the rescue equipment and plan in case of emergency during the 
operation; 
 操作过程中其他可合理预见到的风险； 
Other reasonably foreseeable risks during operation; 
 操作现场的特殊情况，例如天气、海况、照明、时间限制、空间限制、周边可能存
在的其他危险和限制条件等； 
Special circumstances during operation, such as the weather, sea conditions, illumination, time 
limitation, space limitation, other possible dangers and restrictions, etc. 
 参与操作人员的特殊情况，例如人员数量、经验、技能、体能等状态； 
Special circumstances of operating personnel, such as number of personnel, experience, skills, physical 
fitness, etc. 
 其他特殊情况，例如相关联的其他操作、上级的特殊要求等； 
Other special circumstances, such as other relevant operations, special requests from the superior, etc. 
 体系文件未涵盖的其他操作。 
Other operation not covered in the system document. 
7.2 对操作过程中的可预见风险与特殊情况进行综合评估后，根据风险的可能性和危害程
度，确定风险级别，评估已采取的防范措施的充分性，如果不充分，应进一步采取额
外措施，将风险级别降低到可容忍程度，方可进行相关作业。现场操作执行者还需要
对所面临的特殊情况进一步识别风险及其危害性，并采取额外的防范措施。 
After the comprehensive assessment of the foreseeable risk and special circumstances during operation,

measures should be evaluated to see whether they are adequate. If not, extra measures should be taken for

第02 节 电梯安全操作规定 
Section 02 Elevator Safety Operation Regulation 
 
1 
本规定适用于船舶载人电梯。 
This regulation applies to the manned elevator on the ship. 
2 
搭乘电梯时,在开启门厅进入轿厢之前,首先注意轿厢是否停在该层,平层准确度如何,照
明是否良好。 
 When taking the elevator, before entering, attention should be paid about whether the car is parking in the 
layer, whether the leveling accuracy and lighting are good. 
3 
 轿厢的运载能力不得超过电梯的额定载重量；严禁作为载货梯使用。 
The carrying capacity of the car shall not exceed the rated load of the elevator; it is strictly prohibited to 
be used as a cargo ladder. 
4 
电梯行驶时不得突然换向。应先将轿厢停止,再换向运行。 
Reversing for a running elevator is prohibited. If necessary, car should stop first, and then reverse the 
direction. 
5 
紧急停止按钮只在当电梯其他正常使用的按钮失灵或紧急情况下才能使用，不得作为
常用按钮开关使用；严禁在轿门开启的情况下运行电梯。 
Emergency stop button should only be used when the other normal buttons failed or in emergency 
situation, should not be used as a normal on / off button. It is forbidden to operate the elevator when the 
car door is open. 
6 
在等候电梯时,人员不得站在轿厢和井道厅门之间。 
People are not allowed to stand between the car and the hoistway door when waiting for the elevator. 
7 
电梯运行时如发生停电,对于手柄开关控制的电梯,应将手柄回至零位。用应急电话通知
外面有关人员。 
When power failure happens during the elevator operation, if the elevator is controlled by the handle 
switch, the handle should be returned to zero. And then inform relevant personnel outside with emergency 
phone. 
8 
船横摇超过10 度禁止使用电梯。船舶厂修期间不得使用电梯。 
If the ship is rolling over 10 degrees, elevators are prohibited to use. Elevator should not be used when 
the ship is at the shipyard for repairing. 
9 
船长和大副、轮机长和大管轮不能同时乘坐电梯。 
The captain and the chief officer, the chief engineer and the second engineer should not take the elevator 
at the same time. 
10 电梯出现下列故障时,应由主管人员进行修理后方能使用: 
 When the following malfunction of the elevator happens, it can only be used again after repaired by the 
personnel in charge:  
10.1 厅、轿门关闭后,未能正常行驶,或厅、轿门没有关闭好而能起动时； 
The elevator could not function well after the door closed; or the elevator starts moving with the door 
unclosed; 
10.2 对设有需揿按起动钮(或手柄开关)控制的电梯,当厅、轿门关闭后,在未指令轿厢起动而
自行行驶时； 
For those elevators controlled by pressing start buttons (or handle switch on / off), after the door closed, 
the elevator starts running automatically without commanding the car start. 
10.3 运行速度有明显变化时；

The running speed changes significantly. 
10.4 运行中发生与指令相违背的错误动作时； 
Incorrect actions against instructions happen during operation.  
10.5 内选、平层、换速、召唤和指层信号失灵失控时； 
Signals for inner-selecting, leveling, speed-changing, calling and floor-indicating failed and out of 
control.  
10.6 有异常噪声及较大振动和冲击时； 
Abnormal noise, great vibration and impact happen. 
10.7 轿停位置不能正对厅门位置时； 
The car parking position is not facing the position of the hall door. 
10.8 乘员在接触到电梯任何金属部分，有触电感觉时； 
Passengers feel electric shock when touching metal portion of the elevator. 
10.9 当电器部件因过热散发出焦味时。 
Electric appliance has a sporadic smell due to overheating. 
11 发生紧急事故时应采取的措施: 
Measures during emergency: 
11.1 电梯因某种原因失去控制或发生超速而无法掌握时,虽然断开安全开关亦不能制止,搭
乘人员应保持镇静,切勿企图跳出轿厢。可等待各项安全装置自动发生作用,将轿厢予以
停止。 
If the elevator for some reason loses control or running over speed and out of control, even disconnected 
the safety switch, could not stop. Passengers should keep calm, never attempt to jump out of the car. They 
should wait for various safety devices take effect automatically and stop the elevator. 
11.2 如果电梯在行驶中途突然发生停车,而停在井道内不能开门出去的地方,应通知检修人
员将轿厢移动至井道门处。当电梯因安全钳起作用或其他原因轿厢不能移动时,则可把
轿顶安全窗开启而退出,在井道内部开门而出,但在退出轿厢之前必须将安全开关断开。 
If the running elevator comes to a sudden stop, at a position inside the elevator hoistway where the door 
could not open to escape, passengers should inform the maintenance personnel to move the car to the 
hoistway door. If the car could not move due to the effect of safety tongs or other reasons, passengers 
could open the emergency exit on the car ceiling and come out, then open the hoistway door and escape. 
Before escape from the car, needed to ensure the safety switch is off. 
11.3 如果轿厢因故超越行程或突然停止而必须在机房内用手转动曳引机使轿厢作短程升降
时,则必须先将电动机的电源开关断开。同时在转动曳引机时应设法使制动器张开。 
If the malfunction elevator ran beyond the limit or suddenly stopped, must use the manual operation 
tractor in the engine room to rise or lower the car for a short distance. The power switch of the 
electromotor should be cut off in the first place, and meanwhile, the brake should be opened while turning 
the tractor.  
12 电梯的维护保养 
Elevator maintenance 
12.1 电机员应定期对电梯的机械、电器设备进行检查维护。按照电梯保养检查表的内容和
周期进行检查，并填报“电梯保养检查表”。 
Regular inspection and maintenance on elevator mechanical and electrical equipment should be carried 
out by the electrical engineer. In accordance with the content and cycle to carry out inspection, and fill in 
the “Checklist List for Elevator Maintenance” 
12.2 机务总管应安排对电梯的年度检验。 
Technical superintendent should arrange the annual inspection on the elevator. 
12.3 在船舶进行船舶特检和期间检验时，机务总管应申请专业工程师(该专业工程师是经电

梯制造商批准或认可的合格服务人员，特殊情况下由具备电梯特种设备检验资质的机
构承担)，对电梯进行全面维护、检验，并出具电梯使用许可证。 
During the ship special survey and periodical survey, the superintendent should hire professional 
engineers（This professional engineer is a qualified service person approved or recognized by the lift 
manufacturer, Under special circumstances, such tasks shall be undertaken by an organization qualified 
for elevator special equipment inspection）. to carry out over-all maintenance and inspection on the 
elevator, and issue an elevator operating permit. 
13 电梯检修时应注意下列事项: 
The following matters should pay attention during the elevator maintenance 
13.1 进行检修时,操车者应精力集中,严格听从检修人员的指令。 
During maintenance, car operator should concentrate and strictly obey the instructions from the 
maintenance personnel. 
13.2 在轿厢内应将操纵盘上的电源开关断开。 
Power switch on the operating panel inside the car should be off. 
13.3 在机房内应将电源总开关断开。 
Disconnect the main power switch in the engine room 
13.4 在轿顶时, 将安全钳联动开关和轿顶检修箱的急停开关断开。 
When the maintenance personnel is on the car top, switch connected to the safety tongs and the car top 
maintenance box emergency stop should be off. 
13.5 在底坑时, 将限速器张紧装置的安全开关和底坑检修按钮箱的急停开关断开。 
When the maintenance personnel is at the elevator pit, the safety switch on the governor tension device 
and the elevator pit maintenance box emergency stop should be off. 
13.6 检修时不许人员搭乘和载货,并悬挂“检修停用”的牌子。 
During maintenance, no passengers or cargoes are allowed to use the elevator. “Out of service during 
maintenance” sign should be hanging.

第03 节 船舶防冻须知 
Section 03 Ship Anti-freezing Instruction 
 
1.0 船舶遇到寒冷（室外气温4°C 并将继续下降）天气前，各部门应按照负责区域和所管
辖范围，做好防冻准备。船长应予以监督和督促。 
When facing with cold weather (with the outdoor temperature 4 degree and continues to decline), all 
departments should make certain anti-freezing preparations in their own responsible areas. The master 
should be in charge of supervision. 
2.0 露天的消防水管、压载水管、淡水管等在使用后应立即放尽管内残水，特别注意放残
管、阀件因管径较细，极易很快冻结。室外淡水管必须包扎防冻, 蒸汽管、废气管应
包扎绝热材料；通到甲板上的蒸汽管的气阀要保持畅通。 
After using the outdoor fire pipes, ballast pipes, fresh water pipes, should immediately drain out the 
residue water inside the pipes. Special attention should be paid to those drain pipes and valves with 
relatively small pipe diameters, easily get frozen. Outdoor fresh water pipes must be wrapped up for 
anti-freezing, steam pipes and exhaust pipes should wrap with insulation material; on deck steam pipes air 
valve should be kept unblocked. 
3.0 露天的消防栓均应保持关闭，以备随时可用。 
Outdoor fire hydrants should keep closed, and be available at any time. 
4.0 在寒冷地区使用液压甲板机械应提前加热和运转暖机，待油温正常后方可使用。在港
期间，必要时可保持空转，禁止在冷油状态下使用。 
In cold area, hydraulic deck machinery should be pre-heated and warm-up running in advance, can only 
be used after the oil temperature is normal. When at port, if needed, the machinery may stay idling. 
Operation with oil cold should be prohibited. 
5.0 舵机房的门、窗应保持关闭，并打开加热器以保持室内温度。 
The door and window of the steering gear room should be closed, and the heater should be switch on to 
keep the indoor temperature. 
6.0 不进行装卸作业的货舱应及时关妥，空舱应停止舱内通风，以防双层底压舱水及水柜
冻结。 
Cargo holds with no loading or discharging operations should be closed in time, ventilation should stop in 
empty holds, to prevent the freezing of the double-bottom ballast tanks and water tanks. 
7.0 各压载水舱及淡水舱不应太满，防止冰冻时使钢板胀裂。 
Ballast tanks and fresh water tanks should not be too full, to prevent steel plates bursted by the frozen of 
water. 
8.0 液体磁罗经必须保持适当的酒精成分（55％蒸馏水，45％酒精）。严寒时，室外液体磁
罗经应开启照明灯以加温防冻。 
Liquid magnetic compass should preserve with certain amount of alcohol composition (distilled water 
55%, alcohol 45%). When the temperature is extremely low, illuminating lamp on the outdoor liquid 
magnetic compass should be on to heat up for anti-freezing. 
9.0 防止空气驱动式的汽笛冰冻。用毕后应将废气放完，并将气阀关闭。冬季气温降低到
零度以下时，保持驾驶台汽笛加温控制开关处于开启状态，保证首部、尾部汽笛的加
温可靠。开航前应检查试验。 
Prevent the air-driven whistle from freezing. After using the whistle, release the reside air and close the 
air valve. During winter time with temperature below zero, keep the bridge whistle thermostat switch on, 
to guarantee the reliable heating for both fwd and aft whistle. Pre-departure should check and test. 
10.0 救生艇、应急消防泵原动机、应急发电机的冷却水加入防冻液，冷却水箱不应太满，
并用隔热材料包扎。

The antifreeze should be added to lifeboat, emergency fire pump priming pump, emergency generator 
cooling water. The cooling water tank should not be too full, and wrapped with thermal insulation 
material. 
11.0 抵达寒冷地区前（外界气温低于零下10°C），对使用的油舱进行加温，不使用的油舱
把加温管内的凝水用压缩空气吹出。 
Before arriving the cold area (outdoor temperature below -10°C), the oil tanks in use should be heated up. 
For oil tanks not in use, should use the compressed air to blow-off the condensed water inside the heating 
pipes.  
12.0 结冰时，甲板、舷梯等处应做好防滑工作。 
When ice on deck, slipping preventing works should be done on the deck and gangway. 
13.0 甲板上的缆索应妥为收藏或加以遮盖绑牢，旗绳亦应放松。 
Cables on deck should be well collected or fastened with covering, flag halyard should be loosen.

第04 节 主副机安全运行管理规定 
Section 04 Main and Auxiliary Engine Safety Operation Instruction 
 
1.0 主机应由值班轮机员或轮机长负责操纵，禁止其他人员操纵。 
ME should be operated by the duty engineer or chief engineer. Other people are prohibited to operate. 
2.0 主机启动前要确认人员到位，各辅助设备均处于备好状况。按操纵规程和联系信号进
行操作，冲车时人员应离开气缸一定距离，以防燃气从示功阀或安全阀冲出伤人。 
Before the ME starts, needed to confirm personnel are in position, all auxiliary equipment are in 
well-prepared status. Operation should in accordance with the operation procedures and communication 
signals. During the running test, the personnel should stay a certain distance with the cylinder, in 
preventing injuries by the combustion gas sudden rush out from indicator valve or safety valve. 
3.0 主机冲车、试车前，应通知值班驾驶员并经同意后才能进行。轮机长应亲临现场监督、
指导，发现问题应亲自指挥处理。将冲车、试车的时间和状态记入《轮机日志》。 
Before running test of ME, should inform duty officer and consent must be obtained before operation. 
The chief engineer should be on-site supervision, guidance, personally command handling if any problem 
found. Time and status of running test should be recorded into the “Engine Logbook”. 
4.0 运行中加油、擦拭、用手探摸检查时，要注意防止被油泵、气阀等驱动装置挤压或高
温烫伤。尤其是船摇摆时更要注意。 
When refueling, wiping or inspection by hand are involved during the engine running, attention should be 
paid in preventing crushing by driving devices (such as oil pump and pressure valve) or scald by high 
temperature. More attention should be paid while the ship is rolling. 
5.0 启动副机应由主管或当班轮机员和当班机工两人进行。除紧急情况外，不准值班机工
独立启动。严禁不懂操纵规程的其他人员启动副机。 
The starting of the auxiliary engine should be carried out by one engineer in charge or duty engineer 
together with one duty motorman. Unless emergency, the starting should not be done by the motorman 
alone. Other personnel who do not understand the operation procedure are strictly prohibited to start the 
auxiliary engine. 
6.0 副机启动前，应对油、水位、机器周围有无障碍物进行检查，并应进行预润滑和盘车
检查，确认一切正常后，方可启动。 
Before the AE starts, inspections should be carried out for the oil and water level as well as obstacles 
around the engine, and conduct pre-lube and gear turning inspection. After confirm all condition normal, 
the AE can be started. 
7.0 副机盘车时要将撬杠插牢用力均匀，盘车时应将示功阀打开避免盘车吃力和撬杠回弹
伤人。盘车后应随手将撬杠取下安放稳妥，禁止撬杠未取下前进行冲车，防止造成人
身伤亡事故。 
When turning the AE, pry bars should be firmly in position by even forces. Indicator valve should be 
opened to for effort-saving and in preventing injuries by the rebounding of pry bars. After turning, pry 
bars should readily be removed and placed in position. To prevent personal injury accident, running 
before the pry bars removed should be strictly prohibited.  
8.0 副机冲车时，所有人员要避开示功阀及危及人身安全的部件防止灼伤等伤害。 
During the AE running, all personnel should stay away from the indicator valve and other parts that may 
endanger safety in preventing injuries like scalding and so on. 
9.0 主、副机运行中应注意检查转动部分有无零件松动。发现问题及时采取相应的安全措
施，予以紧固，防止零件脱落飞出伤人。进行加油等工作时应注意防止烫、挤伤。 
During the running of ME/AE, attentions should be paid to the moving parts whether parts are loosening 
off. If so, corresponding safety measures should be adopted in time, re-tighten, to prevent personal injury

船舶操作                     版本/修改：3.0/0.0                         SHIP-06-04 
Ship Operation                Edition/Revision：3.0/0.0                     SHIP-06-04

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2018/04/01                 Page: 2/2 
by the flying parts. During refueling, attention should be paid to prevent scalding and crushing injuries. 
10.0 主、副机各部位照明应保持足够的亮度。在尾轴等有旋转部件处工作时应有可靠的防
护措施。严禁对正在转动的部件进行修理等工作。 
Lighting on ME/AE should keep enough brightness in each part. Reliable protection measures should be 
made when working at the tail shaft and other moving parts. It is strictly prohibited to repair the parts that 
are running. 
11.0 主、副机应根据说明书规定，严格按操作规程操纵。当运行中的主、副机突然发生故
障造成停车、停电时，轮机长和轮机员、电机员应立即赶到机舱，以便从速排除故障。
在紧急情况下，参加抢修的人员要统一听从轮机长指挥，任何人不得擅自行动。 
Operation of the ME/AE should be strictly in accordance with the operation instruction. If the ME/AE 
suddenly broke down and end up with engine stop, power failure, the chief engineer and engineers, 
electrical engineer should immediately rush to the engine room, in order to solve the malfunction as soon 
as possible. During the emergency, the personal participated in the emergency repair should unify obey 
the order by the chief engineer, no one should act without authorization. 
12.0 值班轮机员应严格按照轮机长命令，保持规定的主机转速。当值班轮机员对于主、副
机运行情况或操作管理上产生疑虑时，应毫不迟疑地报告轮机长。 
Duty engineer should strictly obey the order by the chief engineer, keep the specified ME running speed. 
When the duty engineer has any doubts on the ME/AE running status or operation management, he 
should report to the chief engineer without hesitation. 
13.0 除非紧急情况，值班轮机员接到驾驶台要求主机加减转速时，应请示轮机长方可操作，
并记入轮机日志。 
Unless emergency situation, when duty engineer received a request to accelerate/decelerate the ME 
running speed from the bridge, he should consult the chief engineer before operating, and recorded into 
the “Engine Logbook”. 
14.0 测试主机示功图和副机爆压时，测试人员要带好手套和防护眼镜，防止燃气冲出伤人。 
When testing the ME indicator diagram and AE blasting pressure, the testing personnel should wear 
gloves and protective glasses in preventing injuries by the rushing of fuel gas. 
15.0 对于无人值班的船舶，在遭遇恶劣天气或狭水道航行时，应暂停无人值班。带有轴带
发电机的船舶应退掉轴带发电机，使用副机工作。 
For UMS ships, when facing with bad weather or navigating through a narrow channel, should suspense 
the UMS. Ships with shaft generator should disengage the shaft generator and use AE instead. 
16.0 主、副机安全保护系统应根据说明书规定，定期进行功能试验，并记入《轮机日志》，
填报“设备报警和安全保护装置试验记录”。 
The safety protections system on ME/AE should according to the instruction manual, run function tests at 
regular intervals, and recorded in “Engine Logbook”, and fill in the “Equipment Alarm and Safety 
Protection Device Test Record.” 
17.0 船舶进厂修理前，应提前将主、副机燃油系统转换为轻柴油，为长期停用或修理作业
做好准备。 
Before entering the shipyard for repairing, the fuel system on ME/AE should be converting to MDO in 
advance, in preparation for the long-term shut-down and repairing operation.

船舶操作                        版本/修改：3.0/0.0                       SHIP-06-05 
Ship Operation                   Edition/Revision：3.0/0.0                   SHIP-06-05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2018/04/01               1/2页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd       Effective Date: 2018/04/01                   Page: 1/2 
第05 节 锅炉安全操作规定 
Section 05 Boiler Safety Operation Instruction 
 
1.0 锅炉要定期检查和试验高、低水位报警和过低水位停炉功能，以及进行安全阀检查试
验，并记录到《轮机日志》中。确保安全保护、报警装置处于正常状态。 
Boilers should be inspected at regular intervals, conduct high/low water level alarm test and water low 
low level cut-off functions, and also conduct safety valve inspection test, and recorded in the “Engine 
Logbook”. To ensure safety protection, alarm device in normal condition. 
2.0 锅炉点火时，应先进行预扫风，排净残留的油气后才能点火。当上次点火不成功时，
再次点火前仍要先扫风。每次扫风时间不得少于5 分钟。严禁擅自缩短预扫风时间或
直接点火。 
When ignite the boiler, pre-scavenging should be done, after all residue oil gas is cleared, the boiler can 
be ignited. If the previous ignition failed, pre-scavenging should be done again before the next ignition. 
The pre-scavenging time should not be less than 5 minutes. Either shortening the pre-scavenging time or 
ignite without pre-scavenging is strictly prohibited. 
3.0 点火时操作人员思想要集中，严格遵守操作步骤，注意合理站位避开风门检查孔，防
止回火伤人。 
When igniting, the operating personnel should be highly concentrate, strictly obey the operating 
instruction. They should keep a reasonable distance with the inspection hole at the ventilation door in 
preventing injuries caused by tempering. 
4.0 手动点火时，应先点火后开油门。如喷油后不能点燃，应立即关闭油门，进行扫风后，
重新点火给油，防止爆燃。 
During manual ignition, ignition should be done before opening the throttle. If ignition fails after oil 
injection, should immediately close the throttle, pre-scavenging inside. Then follow the ignition, injection 
procedure again to prevent explosion. 
5.0 锅炉使用过程中，应每班定期对锅炉水位计进行冲洗并校对水位，防止出现假水位。 
In the course of boiler using, every watch should regular wash the water level gauge and proofread the 
water level, in preventing false water level. 
6.0 锅炉供汽时，须先稍开阀门，进行暖管。操作蒸汽阀时要缓慢地进行。管路总阀装有
泄水阀时，应先将泄水阀打开排放残水后再缓慢打开各截止阀供汽，防止管路出现液
击。 
When using boiler to produce steam, the valve must be opened slightly to warm the pipe. Operate the 
steam valve slowly. When the main valve of the pipeline is equipped with the drain valve, the draining 
valve should firstly be opened to drain the residual water and then slowly open the stop valve to supply 
the steam, in preventing liquid hammer in pipeline. 
7.0 蒸汽管、阀要有隔热防护或明显的警示牌。在运行的锅炉周围进行检查或其它作业时，
要注意保持距离和采取措施，防止烫伤。锅炉环境周围要做到：无积油、破布、棉纱
和燃油滴漏现象。 
The steam pipe and valve should have heat insulation protection or obvious warning sign. When conduct 
inspection or other operation around the running boiler, attention should be paid to maintain distance and 
take measures to prevent scald. The surroundings of the boiler should be: no residue oil, rags, cotton 
yarns or fuel dripping.  
8.0 锅炉运行中应随时注意观察汽压、水位、给水等情况，发现不正常情况及时纠正。禁
止在汽压、水位不正常情况下工作。禁止在保护装置失灵或显示值不准的情况下使用。 
During boiler running, special attention should always be paid to the steam pressure, water level, water 
supply situation and so on. If any abnormal situation was discovered, it must be corrected in time. 

493

船舶操作                        版本/修改：3.0/0.0                       SHIP-06-05 
Ship Operation                   Edition/Revision：3.0/0.0                   SHIP-06-05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2018/04/01               2/2页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd       Effective Date: 2018/04/01                   Page: 2/2 
Operation when the steam pressure, water level abnormal should be prohibited. When the protective 
device is not working or display incorrect value, should prohibit the used. 
9.0 锅炉运行中发生灭火时，应立即关闭油门，找出原因、排除故障后重新扫风，才能再
次点火使用。 
When fire dies out during the boiler operation, the throttle should be closed in time. After the cause is 
found and the malfunction is eliminated, pre-scavenging, the boiler can be ignited once again. 
10.0 锅炉升汽和停炉时，要严格按照程序操作，防止急剧升温造成锅炉损坏。停炉后如有
压力应注意保持正常水位。停炉所需时间必须遵照规程，严禁缩短时间急剧冷却，以
免造成事故。 
When the boiler raises steam and stops running, should strictly follow the operation instruction in 
preventing of damage caused by steep temperature rise. If still pressurize after boiler stopped, should pay 
attention to maintain normal water level. The stopping time should be in accordance with the instructions, 
prohibited to shortened the cooldown time, in order to prevent the accidents. 
11.0 在拆卸锅炉的进入孔道、贴身角阀、旋塞龙头之类部件及各汽阀管道时，要确认没有
压力之后，方可作业。 
When dismantling boiler parts like manhole, close-fitting angle valve and cock faucet, and steam valve 
pipes, can only work after make sure no pressure exists. 
12.0 清扫或检查锅炉内部时，要进行连续的充分通风，并要确认无残留瓦斯、余热，炉内
温度不得超过摄氏45 度。同时遵守封闭处所作业安全须知。 
Continuous and adequate ventilation operation should be carried out when sweeping and inspecting the 
inside of the boiler. There should be no residue gas or waste heat remaining inside the boiler and the 
temperature not excess 45 degree. Meanwhile, should comply with the enclosed space operation safety 
instructions. 
13.0 清扫锅炉外部时，对脚手架、炉门、吊具等要事先检查，确保安全。 
When sweeping outside of the boiler, should pre-inspect the scaffold, boiler door and the slings, to ensure 
safety.  
14.0 检修、调整锅炉点火器时，禁止手持点火器观察发火情况等带电作业，以防高压触电。 
When repairing and adjusting the boiler igniter, it is prohibited to hold the igniter with hands to observe 
firing situation and other energized operation, to prevent electrical high-voltage shock.  
15.0 一旦锅炉出现水位难以判断现象，应立即停炉进行检查，查明原因和真实水位后再进
行操作；  
Once the water level of the boiler is difficult to judge, should immediately stop the boiler for further 
inspection. After finding out the cause and the real water level, operation can be resumed. 
16.0 一旦出现干烧，应立即停炉，自然通风冷却，严禁突然给水，发生锅炉变形或裂纹。 
Once dry burnt, the boiler should be stopped immediately and cool down by natural ventilation. 
Prohibited to sudden water supply which may cause the deformation and cracking of the boiler. 

494

船舶操作                      版本/修改：     3.0/2.0                       SHIP-06-06 
Ship Operation                 Edition/Revision：     3.0/2.0                       SHIP-06-06 
 
 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                       生效日期：2025/02/20        第1/15页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd     Effective Date: 2025/02/20        Page: 1/15 
第06 节 船舶应急设备管理规定 
Section 06 Regulations on the management of ship emergency equipment 
 
船舶应急设备主要包括：应急消防泵/消防泵，应急发电机原动机，应急发电机及配电
盘，救生艇艇机，应急空压机及应急空气瓶，油（舱）柜出口应急速闭阀，机舱舱底应急吸
入阀，机舱风机风门、通风通道防火挡板、烟囱百叶窗、机舱水密门和天窗，机舱安全逃生
通道，主机机旁应急操纵装置，应急舵操舵装置，机舱风油切断装置，消防、救生通用报警
系统，应急蓄电瓶，等等 
Ship emergency equipment mainly includes: Emergency Fire Pump/Fire Pump, Emergency Generator Prime 
Mover, Emergency Generator and Switchboard, Engine of Lifeboat, Emergency Air Compressor and 
Emergency Air Reservoir, Quick Closing Valve for Oil Tank, Engine Room Bilge Emergency Suction Valve, 
Fan Damper and Duct Fire Damper of Engine Room，Funnel Louvers, Watertight Doors and Skylights of 
Engine Room, Safe Escape Trunk in Engine room, Local Control Maneuvering System of Main Engine, 
Emergency Steering Gear, Vent/Oil Emergency Stop system for Engine room, General Alarm System of Fire 
Fighting and Life Saving, Emergency Battery，etc. 
 
1. 应急消防泵及消防泵Emergency Fire Pump and Fire Pump 
1.1 原动机驱动（柴油机）：柴油、机油、冷却水位保持正常，分别使用各种启动方式能
立即启动机器并达到额定转速。 
Prime mover (diesel engine) driving: maintain the diesel oil, engine oil, and cooling water to be at 
normal level and sufficient, in order to start diesel engine immediately by various start methods and 
achieve rated RPM. 
1.2 电动机驱动：能在所有远控按钮和泵旁处进行启动，电压、电流指示正常。 
Electric motor driving: motor can be started remotely and locally, voltage and current meters indicating 
normal. 
1.3 水泵试验状态Water Pump Test： 
1.3.1 水泵海底门阀门和水泵进出口阀门保持常开状态。 
Sea chest, inlet and outlet valves of water pump to be normally open; 
1.3.2 水泵间无油水，墙壁、地板、斜梯保持干净，水泵外部无漏泄、锈蚀。 
The pump room to be free of oil and water, and its wall, floor, and inclined ladder /stairway to be 
clean, no leakage or corrosion found at exterior of water pump. 
1.3.3 出水试验，要求在最高位置且两股水柱射程不少于12 米水柱或消防栓处压力不低
于0.28MPa，试验时间不少于20 分钟。 
Conduct discharging test at the highest position where two water jets not less than 12 m, or at a fire 
hydrant with a pressure not less than 0.28 MPa. Test duration not less than 20 minutes. 
1.4 每周进行例行检查，每月进行启动、运转效用（出水）试验；并将每月启动、运转效
用（出水）试验情况记入《轮机日志》和《船舶应急设备检查、试验记录簿》中 
Carry out routine inspection weekly，Conduct start test and running effectiveness (discharging) test 

495

船舶操作                      版本/修改：     3.0/2.0                       SHIP-06-06 
Ship Operation                 Edition/Revision：     3.0/2.0                       SHIP-06-06 
 
 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                       生效日期：2025/02/20        第2/15页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd     Effective Date: 2025/02/20        Page: 2/15 
monthly. Conduct start test and running effectiveness (discharging) test monthly and record in Engine 
Logbook and Ship Emergency Equipment Inspection and Test Record Book 
1.5 依据年度保养计划对其保养维护，并将保养维护情况记入《轮机日志》和《船舶应急
设备维护、修理、保养记录簿》 
According to the annual maintenance plan, the maintenance and maintenance shall be recorded in the 
"Engine Logbook" and the "Ship Emergency Equipment Maintenance, Repair and Maintenance Record 
Book" . 
2. 应急发电机原动机Emergency Generator Prime Mover 
2.1 原动机（柴油机）：柴油、机油和冷却水位保持正常、充足，油柜速闭阀工作正常
Prime mover (diesel engine): maintain the diesel oil, engine oil, and cooling water to be at normal level 
and sufficient. Quick closing valve for oil tank works normal. 
2.2 使用自动、气动或手动(液压)启动方式能快速启动机器并达到额定转速，并能保证在
30 分钟内连续启动三次，柴油机工作状况保持正常状态。 
Start the diesel engine immediately by means of automatic, manual (hydraulic) or pneumatic and achieve 
rated RPM. Ensure three consecutive starts within 30 minutes and the diesel engine work normal.  
2.3 保证低温启动性能（在零度以下温度时有冷机启动能力）。 
Ensure the diesel engine started at low temperature(can be cold started at a temperature below 0 ℃). 
2.4 油柜保持充满状态，油柜油料持续供油至少18 小时。 
Oil tank to be topped up at appropriate level and sufficient to continuously supply oil at least for 18 
hours. 
2.5 原动机外部无漏油、漏水和污损现象。 
No oil and water leakage, foul, or damage found at exterior of prime mover. 
2.6 检查启动电瓶、空气压力及风口自动锁闭系统工作状况。 
Inspect the condition of start batteries, air pressure and self-closing system of air vent.

found.

Battery start: inspect the charge unit, battery and start switch in good condition

5.1 原动机（柴油机或汽油机）：柴（气）油、机油、冷却水位保持正常、充足。 
Prime mover (diesel engine or gasoline engine): maintain the diesel oil (or gasoline), engine oil and 
cooling water at normal level and sufficient. 
5.2 使用电动或手动启动方式能立即启动机器并达到额定转速。 
Start the machine immediately by means of electric or manual and achieve rated RPM. 
5.3 能正常向空气瓶充气，各压力表指示正常。 
Air receiver can be charged normally, all pressure gauges indicating normal. 
5.4 油箱保持充满状态，并有备用外部油料。 
Maintain oil in tank to be full, and there is oil reserved for back-up use. 
5.5 每两周进行充气效能试验，记录充气压力和充满气瓶所需时间。 
Conduct charging effectiveness test of air reservoir every two weeks. Record the charging pressure and 
total charging time till the receiver full.  
5.6 空气瓶保持充满状态，压力表指示正确。

6.1 每个月定期保养控制站的连接索（或空气管路、气瓶、阀件、空气压力）等，保持装置
操作灵活，外观完好，处于随时可用状态；

cylinders, valves, air pressure). All devices should have sound appearance and easy to operate which ready 
to be used at any time. 
6.2 每三个月应进行遥控关闭效能试验，所有油柜速闭阀能有效关闭并复位，将试验情况记
入《轮机日志》和《船舶应急设备检查、试验记录簿》中； 
Conduct remote closing effectiveness test of quick closing valve quarterly. All quick closing valves can be 
closed in position and reset ，the result should be recorded in Engine Logbook and Ship Emergency 
Equipment Inspection and Test Record Book.

reset after the test.

Stuffing inside the valve should be added or changed timely, to prevent leakage. 
6.6 保持阀号清晰，并与相应的柜号保持一致。

corresponding oil tank

9. 机舱安全逃生通道Safe Escape Trunk in Engine room

常。

hinges, and also can be opened/closed in position, having a good performance.

oil, water and filth found.
