按照“顺序测试”或“常规测试开关”对应急发电机跳电测试，并没有真正达到SOLAS规定的对应
急发电机在船舶跳电时需要运行的相关电路、继电器和控制电路板进行测试的操作性要求。
The emergency generator power blackout test according to the "Sequence Test" or "Routine Test 
Switch(RTS)" does not really meet the operational requirements of SOLAS for the relevant circuits, relays 
and control circuit boards that the emergency generator needs to run when the ship is powered off. Update 
Company Safety Management Procedure (SMS) for emergency generator test procedures to include periodic 
‘Controlled blackout tests’ (i.e. not using sequence test) to ensure the actual circuit paths required by SOLAS 
is Chapter II-1, Reg 42.3.1.2 / 43.3.1.2, can be accomplished a safe and practical manner, while assuring 
functionality of the system.  
确保为测试模拟停电测试而安装在船上的任何设备，如“顺序测试”选择器和/或“常规测试开
关”（RTS），其设计和接线方式应使用用于满足SOLAS 第II-1 章第42.3.1.2 / 43.3.1.2 章要求
的实际电路路径，以便完全测试系统.  
Ensure that any device such a “Sequential test” selector and/or “Routine Test Switch” (RTS), fitted to the ship 
for the purposes of testing the simulation blackout test are designed and wired in such a way as to use the 
actual circuit paths used to meet the requirements SOLAS is Chapter II-1, Reg 42.3.1.2 / 43.3.1.2, so as to 
test the system completely  
对应急发电机跳电测试，应采用从主配电板的联络开关处进行，在机舱集控室的主配电板上
脱扣联络开关，然后确认应急发电机在规定的时间内自动启动和电源并网是否成功。 
For the emergency generator blackout test, it should be carried out from the circuit breaker of the main 
distribution board, and the circuit breaker is tripped on the main distribution board of the centralized control 
room of the engine room, and then the emergency generator is automatically started within the specified time 
and the power supply is successfully connected to the bus  
此种方式的效能试验，每年至少进行1次。The efficacy test of this method should be carried out at 
least once a year

BB) 测试流程 
1．将应急发电机控制箱上的应急发电机启动模式转换开关选为遥控或者自动 
Select the emergency generator start mode transfer switch on the emergency generator control box as Remote 
control or Automatic  
2．应急配电板工作模式选择开关选为自动。 
The emergency switchboard working mode selector switch is selected as Auto.  
3．从机舱集控室主配电板处断开与应急配电板的联络开关，应急配电板处联络开关会自动断

Disconnect the circuit breaker with the emergency distribution board from the main distribution board of the

If the main distribution board resumes the power supply to the emergency distribution board (the circuit 
breaker between the main distribution board and the emergency distribution board in the Engine Control Room 
closes and resumes power supply), the main switch of the emergency generator at the emergency distribution 
board will automatically open, the circuit breaker at the emergency distribution board will be automatically 
closed, and the main distribution board will resume power supply to the emergency distribution board

确保测试区域良好通风，防止发电机运行时的废气和热量积聚。同时，确保所有操作人员都
远离发电机的高温部分和移动部件，避免因操作不当造成人身伤害。 
Ensure that the test area is well ventilated to prevent exhaust gases and heat build-up while the generator is 
running. At the same time, ensure that all operators are away from the hot parts and moving parts of the 
generator to avoid personal injury due to improper operation.  
使用专用的防护装备，如耳罩、护目镜、防护服等，尤其是在监控负载测试时，防止因噪

定期对应急发电机进行保养和全面检查，包括但不限于检查绕组绝缘情况、接线情况以及整

Conduct regular maintenance and comprehensive inspections of emergency generators, including but not 
limited to checking the winding insulation, wiring, and the stability of the overall unit

确保所有操作人员都经过充分的培训，熟悉应急发电机的操作程序和测试流程。这一点对于

Ensure that all operators are adequately trained and familiar with the operating procedures and testing 
procedures of emergency generators. This is essential to ensure the safety and validity of the test  
每次操作后都要记录操作过程和结果，及时发现并报告任何异常情况，以便进行必要的保养
维护，保持设备的持续可靠性。

总之，正确的测试流程不仅能够验证应急发电机的功能，还能显著提高设备的安全性和可靠
性。通过这些综合措施，可以确保应急发电机在需要时提供稳定的应急电源，保障关键设备

Overall, the right testing process not only verifies the functionality of an emergency generator, but also

第07 节 船舶通信设备管理规定 
Section 07 Regulation for Ship Communication Equipment Management 
 
1.0 船舶通信设备的管理 
Ship Communication Equipment Management 
船舶通信设备是完成信息传递、保证航行安全、实施海上救助的重要工具。它包括单
边带发射机、接收机、数字选择性呼叫设备、甚高频无线电话、船舶地球站、增强群
呼接收机、航行警告接收机、卫星紧急无线电示位标、双向无线电话、SVDR/VDR。 
Ship communication equipment is an important tool to complete information transmission, ensure 
navigation safety and implement rescue at sea. Ship communication includes single sideband transmitter, 
receiver, equipment, digital selective calling equipment, VHF radio telephone, ship earth station, 
enhanced group call receiver, navigation warning receiver, satellite EPIRB, two-way radio telephone and 
SVDR/VDR. 
2.0 本规则适用范围 
Scope of this instruction 
适用于公司所属管理的船舶。 
Applies to all ships under company management. 
3.0 无线电通信人员职责 
Responsibilities of radio communication personnel 
无线电通信人员是指船舶GMDSS 无线电员或普通操作员。 
A radio communication personnel refers to GMDSS radio officer or a general operator. 
3.1 普通操作员负责管理、使用、维护GMDSS 设备。 
The general operator is responsible for the management, use and maintenance of GMDSS equipment. 
3.2 未配无线电员的船舶，由持有GMDSS 普通操作员证书的二副负责管理、使用、维护
GMDSS 设备，电机员协助二副做好修理工作。 
For ships not equipped with a radio officer, a second officer with the GMDSS general operator certificate 
shall be responsible for the management, use and maintenance of the GMDSS equipment, the electrical 
engineer shall assist the second officer in the repair work 
3.3 弃船时，普通操作员（二副）应销毁秘密以上等级的文件资料，携带无线电日志和电
台执照，按船长命令离船。 
When abandon ship, general operator (second officer) should destroy all materials with secret-level and 
above, and take the GMDSS RADIO LOG BOOK and Radio Station License, disembark ship as per 
master’s order. 
3.4 保守通信秘密，不向他人透漏通信内容。 
Communication contents should be kept as secret and not be exposed to other people. 
3.5 普通操作员（二副）保管电台文件、资料、统计报表、修理账单和申请购物单，并在
交接班时交接清楚。 
General operator (second officer) should keep the radio station documents, data, statistical reports, repair 
bills and apply order list, and pass clearly during handover. 
3.6 无论船舶航行或在港，船长和普通操作员（大副、二副、三副）在各自的值班时间内
以不超过2 小时的时间间隔去查看GMDSS 设备和接收的报文。 
No matter the ship is sailing or in port, the master and general operator (chief officer, second officer, third 
officer) in his watch, should check the GMDSS equipment and message received at intervals of not more 
than 2 hours. 
3.7 船舶售出或退役时，电台执照和最后一本无线电通信日志（写明退役时通信设备、备
件、物料、资料、工具等交接情况）由普通操作员（二副）带回交公司。

When the ship is being sold or scrapped, Radio Station License and the last GMDSS RADIO LOG 
BOOK (with the handing over status of communication equipment, spare parts, materials, data and tools) 
should be brought by the general operator (second officer) back to the company. 
4.0 工作制度 
Working System 
4.1 船舶通信工作由普通操作员（二副）负责。二副不在时，由普通操作员（三副）替代。
普通操作员在操作前要详细阅读说明书，特别是说明书中的该设备的操作部分和注意
事项要熟记，切忌盲目地操作。 
The general operator (Second Officer) should be responsible for the ship communication work. When the 
second officer is absent, the general operator (third officer) take replacement. Before operation, the 
general operator should read the instruction manual carefully, and memorize the operating section and 
notices. Operating blindly should be prohibited. 
4.2 经常检查设备的运转情况，按规定做好设备的测试工作，并做好记录。 
The equipment operating condition should be inspected frequently. Tests for the equipment should be 
done according to the rules and make records. 
4.3 通信应按先急后缓、先船后岸的原则，并做到迅速、准确。 
Communications should be based on the principle of ‘urgent first’ ‘shore comes after the ship’, and should 
be rapid and accurate. 
4.4 选择合理的通信路由，收发电文不得擅自涂改。 
Choose the reasonable communication route, unauthorized scribbles on the message are strictly 
prohibited. 
4.5 对遇险、紧急或特殊通信，要及时准确处理，详细记录到《电台日志》并及时报告船
长。普通操作员要熟练掌握各种设备的遇险通信。 
Timely and accurate handling of distress, urgency or special communication should be carried out in time. 
Details should be recorded into the GMDSS RADIO LOG BOOK and reported to the master in time. 
General operators should be familiar with the distress communication for all kinds of equipment. 
4.6 正确操作，保持设备良好，保持设备的清洁，设备附近禁止放置水杯、水壶、烟灰缸
等杂物，以防设备进水和灰尘，造成损坏。 
Operate the equipment correctly; keep the equipment in good conditions; keep the equipment clean; cups, 
kettles, ashtrays and other debris are prohibited to place near the equipment in preventing damage caused 
by water and dust inside the equipment.  
4.7 公休时应详细交接的事项： 
Matters should be handed over when sign-off: 
4.7.1 如实填《二副交接班报告表》。 
Second officer’s Handing-over Report Form should be filled in accordance with the truth. 
4.7.2 各种设备(包括天线)。 
All sorts of equipment (antenna included) 
4.7.3 各种设备交接时的状况。 
Status of equipment while handing-over 
4.7.4 各种设备的使用说明书、资料及备品交接清楚。 
Instruction books, data and spare parts of all sorts of equipment should be handed over clearly. 
4.7.5 GMDSS 设备的应急电源(蓄电池)的状况和保养记录交接清楚。 
Status and maintenance record of the emergency power supply (rechargeable battery) of the GMDSS 
equipment should be handed over clearly. 
4.7.6 GMDSS 设备的主电源开关的位置要交接清楚。 
Position of the main switch on the GMDSS equipment should be handed over clearly.

5.0 通信纪律 
Communication Disciplines 
5.1 未经船长许可任何人不得私自使用通信设备对外联络。 
 
Without permission by the master, no one should privately communicate with the outside by using the 
communication equipment.  
5.2 不准主动与无关电台联络。 
 
It is not allowed to communicate with the unrelated radio station. 
5.3 不准冒用、伪造电台呼号和使用核定以外的识别码。 
 
It is not allowed to falsely use, forge the call sign and use the identification codes other than the approved 
ones. 
5.4 不准私编密语、密码和机上进行私人谈话。 
 
No private code or password is allowed for private conversation. 
5.5 不准擅自发送遇险、紧急信号及脱险报告。 
 
It is not allowed to send unauthorized distress, urgency signal or end of distress report. 
5.6 不准私自涂改《电台日志》和来往电报。 
 
It is not allowed to draw unauthorized scribbles on the GMDSS RADIO LOG BOOK and message 
received. 
5.7 不准擅自使用通信设备收听语言广播。 
 
It is not allowed to listen to broadcasting radio by using communication equipment without permission.

Other documents and files about the flag state and port state control inspection requirement.  
7.0 设备检查、测试、记录的内容及要求 
Contents and requirements of equipment inspection, test and record 
7.1 通信设备清洁无锈无腐蚀，处所环境良好、干燥。 
The communication equipment is clean, rust free and corrosion free, and the environment is good and dry. 
7.2 通信设备各旋钮、按键、开关完整牢固，指位正确，灵活正常。各插头、插座、按插
件、电脑终端等接线完整，工作正常。 
All the knobs, keys and switches of the communication equipment are complete and firm with finger 
position correct and flexible. Each plug, socket, plug-in, computer terminals are functioning well with 
wiring complete. 
7.3 应急无线电示位标每一个月试验一次，电池和释放器处于有效之内, 将检查结果记入
《电台日志》。 
EPIRB should be tested once every one month. The battery and release unit should all be within validity 
date. The test result should be recorded into the GMDSS RADIO LOG BOOK. 
7.4 雷达应答器每月试验一次，电池处于有效期内，将检查结果记入《电台日志》。 
SART should be tested once every month. The battery should be within validity date. The test result 
should be recorded into the GMDSS RADIO LOG BOOK. 
7.5 MF/HF DSC 和VHF DSC 设备每天自测一次，每周发射测试一次，将试验结果记入《电
台日志》（GMDSS RADIO LOG BOOK）。 
Self-tests for MF/HF DSC and VHF DSC equipment should be carried out daily, and transmission test 
carry out weekly. The test result should be recorded into the GMDSS RADIO LOG BOOK. 
7.6 双向无线电话每月试验一次（利用所配可充电电池），要保证随时可进入工作状态，将
试验结果记入《电台日志》（GMDSS RADIO LOG BOOK）。所配锂电池处于有效期内，
包装保持完好。 
The two-way radio telephone should be tested monthly (using the rechargeable battery) to make sure the 
equipment is ready for using at any time. The test result should be recorded into the GMDSS RADIO 
LOG BOOK. The equipped Lithium battery should be within validity date with the outer packing intact. 
7.7 天线、馈线、拉索、卸、导滑轮磨损不能超过1/3。 
The worn part on the antenna, the feeder, stay cable, unload and guide pulley should not exceed 1/3. 
7.8 卫星船站天线完好，其天线窗入口处应关闭良好。 
The antenna of satellite ship earth station is in good condition, and the entrance point of the antenna 
should be soundly closed. 
7.9 蓄电池组应每天通过充电器电压表检查记录电池带载和无载电压。维护保养参考《船
舶手册》第八章第11 节船舶电池管理和保养规定，每周检查一次，保持电解液高出极
板10—15mm，酸性电解液比重应为1.23—1.28g/cm3(常温下)，碱性电瓶电压应不低
于26V。将检查结果记入《电台日志》（GMDSS RADIO LOG BOOK）。 
The battery bank ON LOAD and OFF LOAD voltages should be inspected and recorded daily by a 
voltmeter on the charger. The battery bank should be inspected for maintenance once a week according to 
Section 11 Ship’s Battery Management and Maintenance Regulation in Chapter 08. The electrolyte

船舶操作                                  版本/修改： 3.0/4.0                     SHIP-06-07

solution level should be 10—15mm higher than the polar plate. Acid electrolyte solution should has the 
density of 1.23—1.28g/cm3 (at normal temperature). Alkaline battery should have the voltage not less 
than 26V. The inspection result should be recorded into the GMDSS RADIO LOG BOOK. 
7.10 每月应对GMDSS 设备、卫通船站等设备天线和天线的绝缘子进行清洁、维护, 并检
查各设备接地是否良好。 
Antenna and insulations of the GMDSS equipment and satellite ship earth should station be cleaned and 
maintained monthly, and inspect whether properly grounded. 
7.11 进行检修时要注意： 
When repairing, the following should be paid attention to: 
 使用或检修设备前,要确认其电源开关的位置,以备紧急时切断电源。 
Before using or repairing, to certain the location of the main switch, so that the power supply 
could be cut off during emergency. 
 检修电路时,要注意绝缘,必要情况下使用绝缘防护用具。 
Insulation protections should be made during circuit inspection. Insulation protection appliances 
should be adopted if necessary. 
 需带电检修设备时,应有两人在场,使用的工具要有可靠的绝缘,工作台用绝缘橡
胶铺垫。 
When repairing energized equipment, there should be at least two people on site. The tools should 
have reliable insulation protections. Insulation rubbers should be paved on the surface of the 
working bench. 
 测量高压时,应在断电后先将储存高压的器件对地放电,待接妥测试夹后再通电
读数,取夹时也必须断电、放电后再取下测试夹。 
When measuring high voltage, the high voltage device should be discharged to ground after the 
power off. After the test clip is sound-connecting, the device can be energized and figures can be 
read. Power must be switched off before taking off the test clip. 
 检修和操作电台设备时,应尽可能减少高频电磁波对人体辐射的伤害 
During inspection and repairing of radio equipment, measures should be made to reduce the 
radiating damage caused by high-frequency electromagnetic field as much as possible. 
 雷雨天气时,二副应检查天线接地是否良好,必要情况下关掉电源，以防雷击。 
During thunderstorm weather, second officer checks the condition of grounding of antenna. If 
necessary, should turn off the switch in preventing lightning stroke. 
 要定期检查室外天线, 尤其是风雨天气过后, 避免天线出现故障。 
Outdoor antenna should be inspected regularly, especially after stormy weather, to prevent 
antenna breakdown. 
 高处作业时，作业人员要执行《高空作业的安全规定》。 
When working aloft, the operating personnel should obey the Working aloft Safety Operation 
Instruction. 
8.0 GMDSS 的使用及日常维护注意事项 
The use and daily maintenance of GMDSS 
8.1 船用MF/HF 单边带电台 
MF/HFSSB Station 
8.1.1 尽量避免天气潮湿时长时间使用该设备，因天气潮湿，天线阻抗下降过多，参数变化
过大，极易导致天线调谐部分失谐;如果失谐严重，会使反射功率加大使内部元件发
热，最终导致元件损坏。

船舶操作                                  版本/修改： 3.0/4.0                     SHIP-06-07 
Ship Operation                              Version/Revision：3.0/4.0                 SHIP-06-07 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2025/03/28             第6/9页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2023/03/28                 Page: 6/9 
The long-time use of this equipment in wet weather should be avoided. The humidity may cause the 
excessive decrease in antenna impedance and parametric variation, which could easily lead to partial 
mismatch of antenna tuning. If the mismatch is severe, it will cause inner components overheating due 
to the increase of reflected power, and eventually lead to the damage of components. 
8.1.2 使用中要密切关注冷却风扇的运转状况,发现异常立即停止使用。 
Close attention should be paid during the operation of the cooling fan, and if anything abnormal was 
found, the operation should be terminated immediately. 
8.1.3 使用中要密切注意设备面板的相关数据指示,尤其应当避免在设备正处于调谐状态时
使用。 
Close attention should be paid to the relevant data indicating the equipment panel in use. Using while 
the device is in a state of tuning should be avoided in particular.  
8.1.4 注意根据通信距离等情况恰当选择工作波段和发射功率。 
Attention should be paid to the selection of wavelength bands and transmitting power according to the 
communication distance. 
8.1.5 确保设备接地良好，检查接地铜板连接良好，检查天线转换开关位置是否正确。 
The grounding of equipment should be sound. Inspections should be carried out on whether the copper 
earth plate is well-connected and the antenna change over switch is in correct position. 
8.1.6 其他未尽事宜，参照设备使用说明书。 
Other matters not mentioned, please refer to the equipment instruction. 
8.2 NAVTEX 接收机： 
NAVTEX Receiver 
8.2.1 定期进行自检。 
Self-inspection should be taken regularly. 
8.2.2 注意接收天线及其接口的定期检查。 
Regular inspection to the antenna and the connector should be paid attention to. 
8.2.3 确保机身接地良好。 
The receiver should have sound grounding. 
8.2.4 为了避免接收本船舶不需要的岸台信文，要采用“海域编程功能”，有选择的接收 
NAVTEX 信息。 
To avoid receiving unnecessary messages from the coast station, Sea Area Programming Function 
should be adopted for selective receiving of NAVTEX messages. 
8.2.5 防止外部物体进入机械部分，避免用利器触及热敏打印头部分，尤其是在安装打印纸
过程中更应注意。 
To prevent external objects from entering into the mechanical part, edged tools are forbidden to get in 
touch with the Thermal Printing Head, especially in the process of installing printing paper. 
8.3 EPIRB  
8.3.1 每一个月参照说明书对设备进行一次短测试（或普通测试），并应避免误报警。这类 
测试每年不要超过12 次。每一个月参照说明书要求进行现场目视检查，特别需要检
查设备外部是否清楚标有EPIRB ID 号和其他船舶信息（如船名、呼号、MMSI 等）。
长测试（或扩展测试）需要参照说明书要求间隔进行。短测试（或普通测试）和长测
试（或扩展测试）应该在每小时的前 5 分钟内进行，以尽量减少对紧急频道的干扰。 
Short self-test (or normal self-test) should be carried out every one month according to the instruction 
manual, false alarm should be avoided. This test should be not more than 12 times per year. Visual 
inspection should be carried out every one month according to the instruction manual, especially to 
check that the EPIRB ID and other information (include name, call sign and MMSI of the ship) is 
clearly marked on the outside of the equipment. Long self-test (or extended self-test) should be carried 

515

船舶操作                                  版本/修改： 3.0/4.0                     SHIP-06-07

out at intervals according to the instruction manual. Short self-test (or normal self-test) and Long 
self-test (or extended self-test) should be performed during the first 5 minutes of the hour to minimise 
disturbance on the emergency channel. 
8.3.2 EPIRB 每年在船上或送经认可的实验站由授权的无线电检验机构进行校验。电池和5 
年期EPIRB 岸基维护协议到期前应送认可的岸基维修站由授权的无线电检验机构进
行电池更换、保养维修和更新EPIRB 岸基维护协议。 
Verifying tests for the EPIRB should be carried out annually by authorized radio inspection agency, 
which could take place either on board or at the experimental station approved. The EPIRB should be 
sent to the shore-based maintenance station approved to replace the battery，maintenance and update the 
EPIRB SBM before the battery or the SBM expire. 
8.3.3 静水压力释放器要注意有效期，及时申领更换，做好有效期标识，并记录。 
The validity period of the hydrostatic release unit should be paid attention to, and timely replacement 
applies should be done. Period of validity should be marked on the unit and recorded. 
8.3.4 EPIRB 只能在非常紧急的情况下使用，千万不可误报警。 
EPIRB can only be used in very urgent situations, and under no circumstance is false alarm allowed. 
8.4 SART 
8.4.1 每月试验一次，并记录到《电台日志》中。 
SART should be tested once a month with the result recorded in the GMDSS RADIO LOG BOOK. 
8.4.2 注意电池的有效期。                                                                   
Battery life should be noticed. 
8.4.3 每年应进行年度测试，由岸基认可授权的无线电检验机构进行。 
SART is subject to annual testing and carried out by authorized radio inspection agency. 
8.5 MF/HF DSC，VHF DSC： 
8.5.1 每天自测一次，记入《电台日志》； 
Self-inspection should be carried out with the result recorded in the GMDSS RADIO LOG BOOK. 
8.5.2 每周与他台进行一次试验,并将试验结果记入《电台日志》,如远航，在接近岸台工作
范围时，立即进行测试。 
Weekly test with the other stations should be carried out with result recorded into the GMDSS RADIO 
LOG BOOK. During voyage, when approaching the working range of the shore station, tests should be 
carried out immediately. 
8.6 双向无线电话: 
Duplex radiophone 
8.6.1 使用可充电电池要每月试验一次，并做好相应记录。 
The rechargeable battery in use should be inspected once a month and make certain records. 
8.6.2 确保锂电池在有效期内。 
The lithium battery should be within its validity. 
8.6.3 确保锂电池外包装完好无损，有效期清晰可辨。 
The outer packing of the lithium battery should be intact with the validity date discernible. 
8.6.4 除紧急情况时，一般情况下不要使用。 
The radiophone should not be used unless emergency. 
9.0 GMDSS 操作注意事项 
GMDSS Operation precautions 
9.1 操作前详细阅读说明书，特别是操作部分和注意事项要熟记，操作员要互相交流，切
忌盲目操作。 
Read the instructions carefully before operation, operation section and precaution should be specially 
memorized. Operators should often communicate with others and should never operate blindly. 

516

船舶操作                                  版本/修改： 3.0/4.0                     SHIP-06-07 
Ship Operation                              Version/Revision：3.0/4.0                 SHIP-06-07 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2025/03/28             第8/9页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2023/03/28                 Page: 8/9 
9.2 按照航区更换航警区洋区选择一般设置为自动更换(ALL OCEAN),如果信号差再手动
更换。 
According to different navigating zones to switching the NAVAREA to receive navigation warning. 
Generally, set as auto (ALL OCEAN), if weak signal, switch by manual. 
9.3 当环境温度或机器温度过高时，有时出现不能通信现象，应关机冷却后，再开机进行
工作。 
When the environmental temperature or machine temperature is too high, communication fail may 
sometimes occur. Should shut off the equipment, restart after cooled down. 
9.4 收发信息需人工删除的，应定期删除无用信息，以免影响正常使用。 
Useless information inside the messages sent/received should be deleted periodically so that the normal 
function of the equipment would not be affected. 
9.5 软驱工作时，禁止取出软盘。 
Floppy disk drives are prohibited to be taken out during operating.  
9.6 认真保存好设备的安装盘，并交接清楚，如果没有安装盘，应及时申领补充。 
The installation disk of the equipment should be well preserved and handed over properly. If the disk is 
missing, should apply for re-issue in time. 
9.7 电源电压或频率剧烈变化时，应关闭电源。 
If the power voltage or frequency has been changed drastically, should immediately shut off the power. 
9.8 尽量避免冷启动。 
Try to avoid cold boot. 
9.9 正确消除报警（如JRC 机型按CTRL+A）。 
Cancel the alarm correctly (for JRC type, press CTRL+A). 
10.0 SVDR/VDR 操作注意事项及操作程序 
SVDR/VDR operation precaution and procedures  
10.1 船舶航行数据记录仪（VDR 或SVDR）是以安全并可恢复的方式，实时记录并保存船舶
一段时间内的船舶位置、动态、物理状况、语音命令和操纵手段等有关信息的仪器。其
最终记录信息数据是主管机关及有关方面调查、处理事故的客观证据。 
The Ship Voyage Data Recorder（VDR/SVDR）is an instrument, use the safe and restorable method, 
real-time record and preserve ship relevant information, such as ship position, movement, physical 
condition, voice order, control means for a period. The final record of information and data is the 
objective evidence for the administration and relevant parties to investigate and deal with the accidents. 
10.2 船舶航行和锚泊时要保持VDR 或SVDR 的正常运行，实时记录驾驶台所有语音和船舶
航行信息，值班驾驶员要注意VDR 或SVDR 报警监控面板，发现报警信息要按照设备
说明书采取相应措施。 
During navigation and anchoring, the VDR/SVDR should be in normal operation. All voice and ship 
navigating information at the bridge should be real-time recorded. The officer of the watch should pay 
attention to the alarm monitoring panel of VDR or SVDR. If any alarm message is shown on the panel, 
should take corresponding measures according to the equipment instruction manual. 
10.3 船舶发生水上意外事故之后的2 小时内，如未弃船，船长或指定人员必须按设备说明书
将VDR（SVDR）记录的数据备份到设备主机的闪存中，数据备份完毕后，将闪存从主
机内取出由船长保管。 
Within two hours after the marine accident, if the ship was not abandoned, the master or designated 
personnel should backup the VDR（SVDR）recorded data into the flash memory according to the 
equipment instruction manual. The flash memory should be taken out from the main unit after all data is 
backed up, and preserved by the master. 
10.4 船舶VDR 或SVDR 数据存储装置（固定在罗经甲板）只能由海事部门或其授权单位提

取内部数据。 
The internal data inside the VDR/SVDR data storage device (fixed at the compass deck) should be 
extracted by the marine department or other departments authorized by the marine department. 
10.5 船长要组织船舶驾驶员培训，如何在出现事故后正确备份VDR 或SVDR 数据方法，操
作程序要张贴在设备旁边。 
The master should organize training for ship officers on how to back-up the VDR/SVDR data correctly 
after accident. The operation procedure should be posted beside the equipment. 
10.6 各轮按照设备说明书制定相应的操作程序，加入到船舶安全操作规程中，并在设备附近
张贴。 
All ships should formulate correspond operation procedures according to the equipment instruction manual. 
The procedure should be added into the Ship Safety Operation Instruction, and posted near the equipment. 
10.7 作为分析驾驶台团队绩效的有效工具，船长可以根据公司要求，在船舶航经通航密集水
域后，在船上下载和回放VDR 数据，船长必须参考并遵守制造商的程序说明。 
As an effective tool to analyses the performance of the bridge team, The ship's master can download and 
playback VDR data on board after the ship has passed through heavy traffic areas, as requested by the 
company. and the Master must refer and conform to the manufacturer`s instructions for procedures.

第08 节 航行设备安全操作规定 
Section 08 Regulation for Navigation Equipment Operation 
 
1 
船舶航行设备的管理 
Ship navigation equipment management 
1.1 
航海设备包括但不限于：全球定位系统接收机、电罗经、磁罗经、测深仪、雷达、
电子海图设备、手操舵/自动舵、航向记录仪、计程仪、望远镜、航行灯、信号旗、
视觉信号设备、声响信号设备、驾驶台值班报警系统（BNWAS）、闭路电视监控系
统（CCTV）、航行数据记录仪（VDR）、其他监控和探测系统的控制台，等等。 
The navigation equipment in this chapter includes but is not limited to: GPS, gyro compass, magnetic 
compass, echo sounder, RADAR, ECDIS, hand steering/autopilot, heading recorder, log, binoculars, 
navigation light, flag signal, visual signal equipment, sound signal equipment, bridge watch alarm 
system (BNWAS), closed-circuit television monitoring system (CCTV), and other consoles for other 
detection and monitoring systems, etc.  
1.2 
本规定的目的是指导和监控船舶航海设备的操作使用、维护与保养工作，保证航海
设备安全，保证设备可靠运行。 
The purpose of these regulations is to guide and monitor the operation, maintenance and inspection of 
navigation equipment, to ensure the safety and reliable operation of navigation equipment. 
2 
本规定适用范围 
Scope of this instruction 
适用于公司所属管理的船舶。 
Applies to all ships under company management. 
3 
职责 
Responsibilities of navigation equipment management 
3.1 
船长负责督促相关责任船员按本章规定要求对航海设备进行管理、检查和维护，需
向公司报告设备的异常情况。船长负责组织磁罗经的定期校核。 
The Master supervise the relevant responsible crew members to manage, maintain and inspect 
navigation equipment according to the requirements of this procedure, and report to the company any 
defects of navigational equipment. The Master is responsible for organizing the deviation calibration 
and regular error corrected of magnetic compass. 
3.2 
二副负责所有航海设备的日常管理与维护。 
Second officer is responsible for the usual management and maintenance of all navigation equipment. 
3.3 
电子电气员/电机员负责所有航海设备电器部份的检修、雷达天线电动机和传动部
件的维护。 
ETO/Electrical Engineer responsible for the maintenance of electrical parts of all navigation 
equipment, radar antenna motor and transmission parts. 
3.4 
二副负责保管操作文件、资料、报表、修理记录等，并在交接班时交接清楚。 
Second Officer should keep the operation documents, data, reports, repair recorder, and keep clearly 
during handover. 
3.5 
无论船舶航行、锚泊或在港，船长和驾驶员在各自的值班时间内应经常检查设备工
况。 
No matter the ship is sailing, anchor or in port, the master and duty officer should always check the 
condition of navigation equipment in his watch. 
3.6 
电子电气员/电机员负责硬件设备故障的检查和处置。任何系统故障信号和报警，
应第一时间查找原因，无法恢复的，应报公司寻求支持。 

519

船舶操作                           版本/修改： 3.0/4.0                     SHIP-06-08 
Ship Operation                    Edition/Revision：3.0/4.0                    SHIP-06-08

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.     Effective Date: 2026/02/10               Page: 2/6 
ETO/Electrical Engineer is responsible for the fault checking and disposal the hardware equipment 
failures. Any system failures signal and alarm should be check the cause in time, and if it cannot be 
recovered, should be reported to the company for support. 
4 
工作制度和程序 
Working System and Procedure 
4.1 
根据设备使用说明书进行维护保养，根据法规要求进行检验和测试。 
Carry out maintenance according to the equipment instruction manual, and carry out inspection and 
testing according to the requirements of related regulations. 
4.2 
航行期间，二副每天中午或其他方便的固定时间对驾驶台设备进行检查，并填写《驾
驶台设备日常检查测试表》（SHIP-06-08-01），以确保设备的功能，并在任何时
候都可以使用。 
When the ship is underway, the Second officer will check and test the bridge navigation equipment 
daily at noon or at another convenient and fill out the form of " Bridge Equipment Daily Check 
&Test Form " (SHIP-06-08-01) to ensure that the equipment is functional and ready for use at all 
times. 
 
该表格检查项目页可以过塑，检查时使用马克笔做标记；检查完毕后可以擦除重复
使用。 
This form's inspection item page can be laminated. When conducting inspections, a marker pen can 
be used to make marks; after the inspection is completed, the marks can be erased for reuse. 
 
4.3 
经船员检修未能排除的故障，应报机务主管安排修理。 
Failures that cannot be eliminated after the crew's overhaul shall be reported to the maintenance 
supervisor to arrange for repair. 
4.4 
船长和驾驶员应意识到设备误差及局限性的存在。 
The master and deck officers should be aware of the existence of equipment errors and limitations. 
4.5 
设备应正确接地和避免雷击。 
The equipment should be grounded correctly and avoid lightning strikes. 
4.6 
电气设备应定期除尘除湿，注意装卸扬尘货物后应进行设备内部除尘，潮湿天气每 
3 天、干冷天气每周应对电子设备通电半小时，以防湿气积聚在机内。 
That electrical equipment should be regularly dust-removed and dehumidified. After loading and 
unloading dusty goods, the internal dust of the equipment should be clear. The electronic equipment 
should be energized for half an hour every 3 days in wet weather and in dry and cold weather to 
prevent moisture from accumulating in the machine. 
4.7 
必须始终考虑关键的航行设备在关键时刻发生故障的可能性。没有设备是“绝对正
确的”，需要使用者做好交叉检查和验证。 
The possibility of the failure of navigation equipment at crucial and critical times must always be 
considered. No equipment is “absolute right” within itself. Cross-checks and validations that require 
the use of navigation equipment 
4.8 
遵从网络风险管理要求，如拷贝和更新设备，需使用专用的U 盘用。 
Compliance with cyber security requirements. when copying and updating equipment, want use a 
dedicated USB flash drive. 
5 
雷达的正确使用和维护 
Correct use and maintenance of radar 
5.1 
正确使用雷达Correct use of radar 
5.1.1 
在使用雷达前，应至少提前3 分钟预热； 
The radar should be pre-heated 3 minutes before using; 
5.1.2 
正确调试雷达，使之处于良好工作状态； 

520

船舶操作                           版本/修改： 3.0/4.0                     SHIP-06-08 
Ship Operation                    Edition/Revision：3.0/4.0                    SHIP-06-08 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                 生效日期：2026/02/10            第3/6页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.     Effective Date: 2026/02/10               Page: 3/6 
The radar should be tuned correctly, and stay in sound working condition. 
5.1.3 
正确选择显示方式，一般在导航定位时选North-up ，避碰时选Course-up 或
Head-up； 
The display mode should be selected correctly. Generally speaking, North-up mode should be 
adopted during navigational positioning, while Course-up/Head-up during collision prevention.  
5.1.4 
正确选择距离标尺，采用“远近距离档交替扫描的方式”，以确保“既能获得碰撞
危险的早期警报，又不丢失近距离范围内的小物标”； 
Range scale should be selected correctly, adapt the long/short range alternating scanning, which 
could both ensure the “early-warning on risk of collision, and won’t lose the small objects in a close 
range. 
5.1.5 
熟悉并掌握雷达性能、效率与局限性，对小船、浮冰和其他漂浮物有探测不到的可
能性予以充分的估计，保持高度戒备； 
Be familiar with radar performance, efficiency and limitation; stay highly alert and give a full 
estimation on the possibility of missing small boats, floating ice and other floating objects. 
5.1.6 
充分估计海况、天气及其他干扰源对雷达探测的影响，并熟悉消除各种干扰的方法
和措施； 
Give a sufficient estimation on the influence of sea state, weather and other interference may have on 
radar detection; be familiar with methods and measures of eliminating all sorts of influence. 
5.1.7 
熟悉和掌握排除雷达存在的各种误差，尤其是方位误差可能导致的严重后果； 
Be familiar and well grasp the elimination methods for all the existing errors of the radar, especially 
bearing errors that might lead to catastrophic consequences.  
5.1.8 
注意识别因本船大桅、烟囱等反射形成的假回波以及可能被遮蔽的物标（可采取较
大幅度改变本船航向的方法来识别）； 
Pay extra attention to the false echoes that formed by the reflection of the main mast and chimneys 
from own ship, as well as objects that could be shaded and neglected (could identify these echoes by 
changing the ship course drastically).  
5.1.9 
对探测到的物标进行雷达标绘或进行与其相当的系统观察； 
Conduct radar plotting or using equivalent system observation for detected objects. 
5.1.10 保持连续的、不间断的、有规律的观测，对当时局面以及碰撞危险予以充分的估计；
Maintain Continuous, un-interrupted, orderly observation, adequate evaluation on the existing 
situation and the risk of collision. 
5.1.11 合理设定CPA 和碰撞报警。 
CPA and collision alarm should be set reasonably. 
5.1.12 合理设置增益、调谐、抑制和脉冲宽度，避免物标被屏蔽，使物标清晰饱满。合理
使用尾迹、轨迹、历史航迹点、矢量长度、运动方式、距标圈、电子方位线，通过
显示方式和偏心显示，利用真运动、相对运动、相对尾迹、真尾迹、等的应用，提
高瞭望效果和避让行动监控。 
Reasonably set the GAIN, TUNE, Clutter Suppression and Pulse length to make the targets display 
fine, clearly and effectively, and avoid the targets being shielded. Reasonably use the trails, track, 
history point, vector length, movement mode, VRM, EBL, display Mode and eccentricity display, 
using true/relative motion, true/relative trails display mode, etc. to improve the lookout effect and the 
monitoring of avoidance actions. 
5.2 
雷达维修保养的安全注意事项 
The radar maintenance safety precautions 
5.2.1 
日常维护保养需参考说明书的要求。 
Daily maintenance need refer to requirements of instruction manua

船舶操作                           版本/修改： 3.0/4.0                     SHIP-06-08 
Ship Operation                    Edition/Revision：3.0/4.0                    SHIP-06-08

5.2.2 
使用或检修设备前，要确认其电源开关的位置，以备紧急时切断电源。 
Before using or repairing, to certain the location of the main switch, so that the power supply could 
be cut off during emergency. 
5.2.3 
检修电路时，要注意绝缘，必要情况下使用绝缘防护用具。 
Insulation protections should be made during circuit inspection. Insulation protection appliances 
should be adopted if necessary. 
5.2.4 
需带电检修设备时，应有两人在场，使用的工具要有可靠的绝缘，工作台用绝缘橡
胶铺垫。 
When repairing energized equipment, there should be at least two people on site. The tools should 
have reliable insulation protections. Insulation rubbers should be paved on the surface of the working 
bench. 
5.2.5 
检修或维护雷达天线时，应关闭天线电动机供电电源的总开关或拔掉该电路的保险
丝，并在显示器操作面板上悬挂醒目的“严禁合闸”警示牌，以防他人启动天线伤
及维修人员。 
Shut off the main switch on the power source of the antenna motor, or pull the fuse of the circuit out 
during the inspection or repairing of the radar antenna. A distinguishing warning board of “NO 
SWITCHING ON” should be hanging on the operation panel of the monitor, so that others will not 
start the antenna and hurt the repairing personnel. 
5.2.6 
测量高压时，应在断电后先将储存高压的器件对地放电,待接妥测试夹后再通电读
数,取夹时也必须断电、放电后再取下测试夹。 
When measuring high voltage, the high voltage device should be discharged to ground after the 
power off. After the test clip is sound-connecting, the device can be energized and figures can be read. 
Power must be switched off before taking off the test clip. 
5.2.7 
检修雷达时，应尽量避免或减少微波辐射造成对人体的直射伤害。During inspection 
and repairing of the radar, measures should be made to reduce the radiating damage caused by 
high-frequency electromagnetic field as much as possible. 
5.2.8 
雷雨天气时，二副应检查天线接地是否良好，必要情况下关掉电源，以防雷击。 
During thunderstorm weather, second officer checks the condition of grounding of antenna. If 
necessary, should turn off the switch in preventing lightning stroke. 
5.2.9 
要定期检查天线（雷达天线都在室外），尤其是风雨天气过后，避免天线出现故障。
Antenna should be inspected regularly (all radar antennas are located outdoor, especially after stormy 
weather, to prevent antenna breakdown. 
5.2.10 高处作业时，作业人员要执行《高空作业安全规定》。 
When working aloft, the operating personnel should obey the Working aloft Safety Operation 
Instruction. 
5.2.11 避免雷达受潮，几天不用时，要开机处于STANDBY 状态预热。 
Turn the radar on and put it in the STANDBY state to warm up for avoiding dampness in the radar if 
radar did be used for several days. 
6 
驾驶台航行值班报警系统（BNWAS）Bridge Navigation Watch Alarm System (BNWAS) 
6.1 
BNWAS 是一个定时器警报系统，它强制值班驾驶员(OOW)以周期性的时间间隔重置
系统，以确保值班驾驶员保持完全警觉。 
BNWAS is a timer alarm system that forces the OOW to reset the system at periodic time intervals to 
ensure that he remains fully alert. 
6.2 
以下几点对于BNWAS 很重要： 
Following points are important with respect to BNWAS: 
6.2.1 船长确保BNWAS 在船舶航行、锚泊以及其它要求保持驾驶员在驾驶台值班的任何时

other condition which requires the deck officer must be on duty on the bridge, and never switched off. 
Switch off/on timings at berth on arrival and departure should be logged in the Deck log book. 
6.2.2 设置密码或设置钥匙由船长亲自保管，不得交其他驾驶员代管或代为设置，并列入
船长交接项目。开航时船长忘记开启该设备时当值驾驶员有责任提示船长。只有船

The password and/or key for set up should be kept by Master himself, it is not allowed to transfer to 
deck officer or ask deck officer to set up BNWAS, the password and/or the key should be the items 
being transferred by Masters, deck officer is responsible to remind Master in the event that BNWAS

6.2.3 休眠时间不得超过10 分钟；当经过被认为对安全航行有危险的区域时，这一间隔

6.2.5 如果BNWAS 系统装有运动传感器作为复位功能，则应至少每天检查一次，以确保其

If the BNWAS system is fitted with motion sensors to serve as the reset function, then this should be 
checked at least once a day to ensure it is operating correctly, and same to be recorded. 
6.2.6 OOW 还可以使用紧急呼叫按钮来寻求帮助。 
An emergency call button is also available to the OOW to call for assistance. 
6.2.7 不允许在BNWAS 上使用AUTO 模式（即，每当船舶航向或航迹控制系统被激活时，
BNWAS 会自动启用，而当该系统未激活时，BNWAS 会被禁用） 
Use of AUTO mode on BNWAS is not allowed (i.e. BNWAS automatically brought into operation 
whenever the ships heading or track control system is activated and inhibited when this system is not 
activated)

6.4 
船舶航行正常，当驾驶室内一级视觉报警应尽快按复位键尽快消除报警;当触发第
二级或第三级警报时，船长、驾驶员房间报警后应立即上驾驶室处理报警情况, 当

If the ship sailing properly, when the first-level visible alarm happened in bridge, press the reset 
button to eliminate the alarm as soon as possible. When the second-level or third-level is triggered, 
and if there is any alarm shown in cabin of Master and Deck Officer, Master and Deck Officer should 
go to the bridge immediately to deal with the alarm. When the duty officer needs help, he can send an 
emergency call to the designated personnel. 
6.5 
每个月对BNWAS 进行全面测试，检测各级报警器是否正常，并做好记录，第二、
三级报警区域只有声光报警，如需复位必须到驾驶台进行RESET 复位操作。 
Fully test BNWAS every month, all alarms should be inspected and recorded. There is only sound 
and light alarm for area of second and third level alarm, reset operation for alarm should be carried 
out in bridge, if needed. 
6.6 
应每月对BNWAS 设备进行一次电源故障测试。检测通过应急电源启动。 
BNWAS to be tested on monthly basis for power failure. Activation by emergency power in case of 
power failure to be checked. 
7 
航海设备使用记录 
Record of navigation equipment 
7.1 
OOW 值班时，将航行设备的工况填写在值班检查表上，设备异常应在航海日志上
进行说明，船长每天对检查表和航海日志的记录进行检查审阅； 
The OOW is required to fill in the appropriate section of navigation condition in checklist of duty， 
abnormalities of navigation equipment should be write in the logbook, and the captain shall check 
and review the checklist and logbook every day. 
7.2 
二副负责连续跟踪设备工况，以便清楚地记录和监测航行设备的性能和效率。 
The second officer is responsible for continuously tracking equipment operating conditions in order 
to clearly record and monitor the performance and efficiency of navigation equipment. 
7.3 
二副保存好设备的维护、检修、检验记录，检验证书的正本交给船长。 
The second officer keeps the recorder of equipment maintenance, overhaul, and inspection, the 
original inspection certificate should deliver to the captain.

第09 节 船舶加驳油操作规定 
Section 09 Bunkering Operation Instruction 
 
1 
目的 
Purpose 
避免船舶在加驳油操作和使用过程中造成海洋、大气污染。 
The purpose of this instruction is to avoid marine and atmospheric pollution during bunkering operation 
and consumption. 
2 
适用范围 
Scope of application 
2.1 本规定适用于公司所管理的船舶。 
This instruction applies to all ships managed by company. 
2.2 船舶进行的燃、润滑油的加装和调驳作业。 
Bunkering and transferring operation of fuel oil and lubricating oil by the ship. 
3 
职责 
Responsibility 
3.1 轮机长是加驳油操作的总负责人。燃油主管人是二管轮，滑油是大管轮。任何加装燃、
润滑油的文件、单据、油样等应交由轮机长本人签署。轮机长在整个加油过程中全程
监督和指导，不得离船；轮机长必须提前对加油工作做出明确分工，并做出人员部署
表，其内容应包括：测量人员、开关油舱阀门人员、联络人员、巡回检查人员等。 
The Chief Engineer is responsible for bunkering operations. The fuel oil in-charge is the third engineer, 
the lubricating oil in-charge is second engineer. Any fuel, lubricating oil bunkering documents, receipt, 
oil samples should sign by chief engineer himself. Chief engineer supervision and guidance throughout 
the entire process of bunkering, shall not leave the ship; chief engineer must make a clear division of 
jobs before bunkering, and make a crew deploy list, which should include: sounding personnel, valve 
on/off operator, communicating personnel, patrolling inspection personnel and so on. 
3.2 轮机部成员必须听从轮机长的安排，做好燃、润滑油加装工作。无特殊情况，在加装
燃、润滑油时均不得离船。 
The engine department crew must follow the arrangement of the chief engineer, prepare for the fuel and 
lubricating oil bunkering work. No special circumstances, crews are not allowed to leave the ship during 
fuel, lubricating oil bunkering operation. 
3.3 船长应将加油港口的有关防污染方面的规定和加油的要求，提前通知轮机长，并安排
值班人员悬挂号灯、号旗。在船舶加油的过程中，船长要统筹安排全船的工作，应安
排甲板部人员在加油现场加强值班，防止油污染事故的发生。除工作需要外，在燃油
加装过程中，船长不得离船。 
The master shall notify the chief engineer in advance of the bunkering port's requirements on pollution 
prevention and bunkering requirements, and arrange for the duty personnel to hoist the light signal and 
flag. In the process of bunkering, the captain must arrange the work of the whole vessel, should arrange 
deck department crew to strengthen the bunkering site duty, to prevent oil pollution accidents. Except 
the work needs, the captain shall not leave the ship during the bunkering operation 
3.4 二管轮主管燃油的加装和调驳工作；大管轮主管滑油的加装和调驳工作。在轮机长的
领导下，提前制定加装计划，并全面负责加油过程中各项具体工作的实施。 
The third engineer is in charge of the bunkering and transferring operation of lubricating oil; second 
engineer is in charge of the bunkering and transferring operation of fuel oil. Under the leadership of the 
chief engineer, prepare the bunkering plan in advance, and overall responsibility for the implementation 
of various specific tasks in the process of bunkering.

04_16_11.text:
船舶操作                                  版本/修改： 3.0/4.0                      SHIP-06-09

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2026/02/10               Page: 2/18 
4 
程序 
Procedure 
4.1 加油前的准备工作： 
Preparations before bunkering: 
4.1.1 二管轮/大管轮应根据船舶的燃/润滑油存量和航次安排，提前做出加装计划，提交轮
机长批准（制定加装计划时，应考虑抵港吃水差情况，计算加油量按舱容的85％计
算，油舱的最大加装量不得超过舱容的90%）； 
Third engineer / second engineer should prepare bunkering plan in advance according to the ship's fuel 
/ lubricant inventory and voyage arrangements, submitted to the chief engineer for approval (in the 
bunkering plan, should consider the arrival draft different condition, calculation bunkering quantity, 
according to 85% of tank capacity, the maximum bunkering of oil tank shall not exceed 90% of tank 
capacity); 
4.1.2 加装燃油前，二管轮应尽可能地将同一规格的燃油并舱，尽量避免两种产地不同的
燃油混合。准确测量各油舱的存油量，并报告轮机长，轮机长和二管轮应提前与大
副商定需加油的油舱分配和加装数量； 
Before bunkering fuel oil, the third engineer if possible, should transfer the same specification fuel oil 
into one fuel tank, and avoid mix two fuel form different origin. Accurately measure the amount of oil 
stored in each tank, and report to the chief engineer. Chief engineer and the third engineer should 
discuss with chief officer in advance, the allocation of tank and quantity for the bunkering; 
4.1.3 加装燃油前，二管轮要提前检查加油舷管路上各种阀门、滤器的情况，确保其处于
正确的状况。同时还应检查另外一舷加油管上的盲板和阀门是否被关闭； 
Prior to bunkering, the third engineer to check the condition of various valves, filters of fuel oil 
pipeline, to ensure that they are in the correct condition. At the same time, should also check the other 
side of the hose on blind flange and the valve is closed; 
4.1.4 轮机长要提前通知值班驾驶员作好安全防护措施。白天悬挂信号旗，夜间应开桅顶
信号灯； 
Chief engineer should inform the OOW in advance to make safety precautions. Hoist signal flag 
during the daytime and switch on the signal mast light at night; 
4.1.5 轮机长通知大副安排木匠堵塞甲板的流水孔。二管轮开启受油舱的透气孔、堵好集
油槽放残孔。油舱透气管下无集油容器的，应放置集油器具。 
The Chief Engineer informed the chief officer to arrange the carpenter to plug the deck scupper. Third 
engineer open the vents of oil tank, plug the saveall nut. If the oil tank vent tube without oil container, 
oil collector should be placed. 
4.1.6 二管轮/大管轮应根据燃/润滑油加装计划，制定出各油舱的加装量和测深量的表格，
并向负责测油的人员详细说明，使他们熟悉加油系统的测深管（或测深指示器）、空
气管、透气管、溢油柜的位置和加油计划的详细过程。 
Third engineer / second engineer should follow the fuel / lubricating oil bunkering plan, make the 
bunkering quantity and sounding level form for each oil tank, and elaborated to the personnel in charge 
of measuring oil, to familiarize them with bunkering system, sounding tube (or sounding indicator), air 
tube, vent tube, overflow tank position and bunkering plan detailed procedures. 
4.1.7 加油前，轮机长主持召开由全体参加加油操作的人员参加的内部培训会议，学习《船
舶加驳油操作规定》、《加/驳油操作程序》等，明确人员职责填写《加油信息表》。
应在加油现场悬挂“加/驳油操作程序”、“加油信息表”和“禁止吸烟”告示牌，备
妥消防和防污染器材。培训项目和内容由轮机长负责记入“加驳油船员培训记录表”
备查。 
Before bunkering, chief Engineer chaired an internal training session attended by all the participants in 

526

船舶操作                                  版本/修改： 3.0/4.0                      SHIP-06-09 
Ship Operation                              Version/Rev.：3.0/4.0                     SHIP-06-09

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2026/02/10               Page: 3/18 
the bunkering operation, to learn the “Bunkering Operation Instruction”, “Bunkering / transferring oil 
Operations procedure”, clear define personnel responsibility fill in, “Bunkering information form”. 
On-site hanging "No smoking" signs, prepare fire-fighting and pollution prevention equipment. The 
training items and contents are charged by the chief engineer to record into the “Bunkering / 
transferring oil crew training Record Form” for future inspection. 
4.1.8 轮机长详细记录加油前会议的情况。 
Chief Engineer recorded in detail the condition of the pre-bunkering meeting. 
4.1.9 轮机长应与供油商核对供油规格、数量,供油商的代表须提供一份经签署和认证的声
明，证明所供应的燃油符合相关法规要求; 交付给船舶的燃油交付凭单中应包含按
照组织可接受的标准所规定的闪点信息，*或声明闪点已测量并达到或高于70℃；
以及MSDS 资料（加装燃油和散装滑油均应索取MSDS，并与加油单据一同存档、
备查）。应特别注意所供燃油的含硫量要符合《MARPOL 73/78》公约生效的最新要
求，并能满足航次计划内公约和区域性法规对SOx 释放控制的要求；和供油方共同
测量供油船各个油舱的存量和温度，核对流量计或油尺；并注意用试水膏检查供油
船上的油中是否含水。 
The chief engineer should check the oil supply specifications and quantities with the oil supplier, the 
oil fuel supplier's representative will be required to provide a signed and certified declaration that the 
oil fuel supplied is in conformity with the relevant regulation, and A bunker delivery note for the oil 
fuel delivered to the ship shall contain either the flash point specified in accordance with standards 
acceptable to the Organization,* or a statement that the flashpoint has been measured at or above 70℃; 
and request MSDS (bunkering fuel oil and lubricating oil in bulk should request MSDS, and keep with 
the bunkering documents for future inspection). Special attention should be paid to the sulfur content 
of the fuel supplied, to meet the latest requirements of the "MARPOL 73/78" Convention, and to meet 
the SOx emission control requirements of conventions and regional regulations in the voyage plan; 
join checking on the quantity and temperature of every tanks of the oil supplying vessel with the 
supplier, verify the flowmeter or sounding tape, and use the water finding paste to check any water in 
the oil from the oil supplying vessel. 
4.1.10 轮机长应与供油方事先商定： 
The Chief Engineer should discuss and confirm with the oil supplier in advance: 
 最大的加油速度 
maximum pump rate 
 加油的先后顺序。 
Sequence of bunkering. 
 加油过程中供油泵的起、停联系信号，喊停责任权、责任方。 
In the process of bunkering, the communication signal of starting and stopping of the oil pump, 
responsibility, responsible party for stopping signal. 
4.1.11 在双方确认后，轮机长在供油方提交的确认书上签字。 
After confirmation by both parties, the Chief Engineer signs on the confirmation form submitted by 
the oil supplier. 
4.2 加油中 
During bunkering 
4.2.1 供油方在接装供油管时，负责巡视的人员要督促其接装紧密牢固，以防渗漏。 
When the oil supplier connects the hose, the person in charge of the patrolling inspection shall 
supervise the installation of the oil supply hose tightly and firmly, to prevent the leakage. 
4.2.2 在二管轮/大管轮检查确认加油舱管路的阀门已正确开启后，由负责联络的人员通知
供油船开始供油，在供油初期，应通知供油方以较低的供油速度供油。 

527

船舶操作                                  版本/修改： 3.0/4.0                      SHIP-06-09 
Ship Operation                              Version/Rev.：3.0/4.0                     SHIP-06-09 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2026/02/10          第4/18页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2026/02/10               Page: 4/18 
After the third engineer / second engineer checks and confirms that the valve of the bunkering line to 
the oil receiving tank has been opened correctly, the person responsible for communication informs the 
supplying vessel to start pumping. In the early period of bunkering, should inform the supplier to use 
the lower pumping speed to supply oil. 
4.2.3 开始加装后几分钟内，负责测量的人员即应测量受油舱，同时检查该油舱的透气管
的情况，确认油已经加入指定的油舱后，通过负责联络的人员通知供油方以正常速
度供油。 
Within a few minutes after the start of bunkering, the person in charge of sounding shall measure the 
receiving tank and inspect the vent pipe condition of the tank, to confirm that the oil has been added to 
the designated tank, and notify the oil supplier through the person responsible for communication to 
supply at normal speed. 
4.2.4 在整个加油过程中，要勤测量，要注意由于加油引起的船舶倾斜对测量所造成的影
响，注意可能造成油面首先封住透气管而引起跑油现象的发生，注意装油速度是否
合适，必要时与供油方联系调整。 
Throughout the bunkering process, to measure frequently, pay attention to the ship heeling caused by 
bunkering will affect the measurement result, pay attention to the oil surface may firstly block the vent 
tube and caused the fuel oil overflow, pay attention to loading speed whether appropriate, if necessary, 
contact the oil supplier to adjust. 
4.2.5 当受油舱的油量已经达到总舱容的75%时，应打开下一受油舱的进口阀，减缓该舱
的受油速度逐渐加至所计划的加装量；最后一个受油舱的油量接近80%时，应通知
供油方降低供油速度。在加装过程中，要考虑测深管中油位的变化滞后于油舱中的
实际油位（特别是在环境温度较低时），油舱中的最大油量不得超过总舱容的90%。 
When the volume of oil in the receiving tank has reached 75% of the total tank capacity, the inlet valve 
of the next oil receiving tank should be opened to slow down the rate of adding oil in the receiving 
tank, and gradually increased to the planned bunkering volume; when the amount of oil in the last 
receiving tank is close to 80%, inform the supplier to reduce the speed of oil supply. During bunkering, 
consider that the change in oil level in the sounding pipe lags behind the actual oil level in the tank 
(especially at low ambient temperatures), and that the maximum amount of oil in the tank must not 
exceed 90% of the total tank capacity. 
4.2.6 转换加油舱时，应全开下一个油舱的进口阀后，再逐渐关闭正在加油的油舱的进口
阀，次序不得颠倒。 
When changing the fuel receiving tank, the inlet valve of the next receiving tank should be fully 
opened, and then gradually closed the inlet valve of the receiving tank bunkering, the order cannot be 
reversed. 
4.2.7 在寒冷的天气加装燃油时，应提前对受油舱进行加温，防止燃油加进油舱后，流动
性降低，造成测量困难或测量不准确，甚至导致跑油。 
In the cold weather when bunkering, the oil receiving tank should be warmed in advance, to prevent 
the fuel after entering the tank, mobility decreased, resulting in measurement difficulties or inaccurate 
measurements, and even lead to oil overflow. 
4.2.8 加油开始后，一旦发生溢油事故，立即按照《船上油污应急计划》的步骤和《船舶
溢油应变部署表》中人员职责，迅速采取措施，控制溢油的扩散，回收清除溢油； 
After the start of bunkering, once an oil spill accident occurs, promptly take measures to control the 
spread of oil spill and recover the oil spill according to the procedures of "Shipboard Oil Pollution 
Emergency Plan" and the responsibilities of personnel in "Ship Oil Spill Response Plan"; 
4.2.9 油样的采集: 
Oil sample collection: 

528

04_16_12.text:

Ship Operation                              Version/Rev.：3.0/4.0                     SHIP-06-09

 轮机长对加油油样的采集负责，安排专人监督采集油样； 
The chief engineer is responsible for the collection of bunkering oil samples, arranges special 
supervisors to collect the oil samples; 
 加油之前与加油船协商好油样的采集地点； 
Discuss with the oil supplier on the sample collection point before bunkering; 
 如果船上存有带有油样采集装置的专用接头，尽量在船上采集油样； 
If there is a special connector for oil sampling device on board, prefer to collect oil sample on board; 
 在加油过程中全程采集油样，确保所采油样具有代表性；. 
During the bunkering process, collect the oil samples throughout the process, to ensure that the samples 
taken are representative. 
 所采油样瓶的标签要经双方现场签字认可加封。轮机长应拒绝接受加油船直接提供的
油样； 
The label of the oil sample bottle shall be signed and sealed by both parties on site. The chief engineer 
should refuse to accept the oil sample directly supplied by the oil supplier; 
 妥善保存好油样以备发生纠纷后交验。 
Retain the oil sample properly to prepare for lab test after the dispute. 
4.3 加油完毕后 
After bunkering 
4.3.1 待本船的受油舱中的油位稳定并确认加油管已扫净残油，打开验油阀确认无残油滴
漏且征得轮机长的同意后，方能拆除加油管，关闭加油总管的截止阀。 
When the oil level in the oil receiving tank is stable and confirm that no residual oil remaining in the 
connecting hose, open the inspection valve and confirm that there is no residual oil dripping and 
leakage, and with the consent of the chief engineer, the connecting hose can be removed, close the oil 
main shut off valve. 
4.3.2 关闭、封好所有的阀门和盲板，清除集油槽中和滴落在甲板上的油迹。 
Close and seal all the valves and blinds flange, clear the traces in the saveall and on the deck. 
4.3.3 二管轮要准确测量本船各油舱的油位，并用试水膏检测是否含水，经过温度等因素
的修正后，计算出实际的受油量。与供油方一起测量供油驳船上所有的油舱，核对
无误后，轮机长在加油收据上签字。 
Third engineer to accurately measure the oil level of each oil tank, and use water finding paste to test 
whether contain the water, after corrected by temperature and other factors, calculate the actual amount 
of oil received. With the fuel supplier, to measure all oil tanks of the oil barge, after verify correct, the 
chief engineer signed on the oil receipt. 
4.3.4 如双方对受油数量发生争议时，轮机长应与供油商交涉并报告船长，船长应立即报
告租船人或经营人，并注意搜集相关证据，包括当时的气象状况、供油船油舱测深
表的修订情况、供油船所有油舱初/末次测量记录等，在得到相应指示后，按照租船
人或经营人的指令，在加油单据上注明实际受油量，并注明存在争议。 
In the event of a dispute over the quantity of oil received by both parties, the chief engineer shall make 
negotiation with the oil supplier and report to the master. The master shall promptly report to the 
charterer or operator, and pay attention to collecting relevant evidence, including prevailing weather 
conditions, revision condition of the oil supplying vessel sounding table, initial / final measurement 
records of all oil tanks of oil supplying vessel, etc. Upon receiving corresponding instructions, 
according to the instructions of the charterer or operator, indicate the actual amount of oil on the 
bunkering documents, and indicate that there is controversy. 
4.3.5 如轮机长发现所添加的燃、润油数量、质量和服务等有争议或有问题时，及时填报
《船舶添加燃润油反馈表》报公司船管部。

If the Chief Engineer discovers any controversial or problematic issues concerning the bunkering

4.3.6 轮机长将加装的时间、地点、和数量等情况详细记录在《油类记录簿》和《轮机日
志》上；并与接收单数量相符。应特别注意进行燃油加油记录时，应按照规定记入
品种、数量、含硫量等。 
The Chief Engineer records in detail the time, location and quantity of bunkering, etc., in the “Oil 
Record Book” and the “Engine logbook”; and complies with the quantity on the receipts. Special 
attention should be paid when filling fuel bunkering records, should be credited in accordance with the 
provisions of the species, quantity, sulfur content. 
4.3.7 轮机长通知大副和当班驾驶员，加油工作结束，降下信号旗或关闭信号灯，同时打
开甲板流水孔等。 
The chief engineer informed the chief officer and OOW that the bunkering work had finished, lowered 
down the signal flag or turned off the signal light, and open the deck scupper at the same time. 
5

Bunkering documents and the precautions 
5.1 船舶应以加油单据的形式对供船燃油细节加以记录,至少包括: 
The ship shall record the details of the fuel supplied to the ship in the form of a bunker note, at least 
including:

Name of oil receiving vessel and IMO number 
 港口; 
Port 
 加油开始的日期; 
the date of bunkering begins 
 供油商的名称, 地址, 电话号码 
The name, address and phone number of the oil supplier 
 产品名称 
Product name 
 数量 – 公吨 
Quantity - metric tons 
 15 OC 时密度KG/M3 
15 OC Density KG / M3 
 硫份  %M/M  
sulfur content % M / M 
 闪点  ℃ 
Flash Point ℃ (ISO 2719) 
 一份由供油商代表签署和证明的声明(DECLARATION), 证明所供应燃油符合
MARPOL 附则 VI 第14.1 条或14.4 条以及18.3 条的适用规定。 
A DECLARATION signed and certified by a representative of the oil supplier, certifying that the 
fuel supplied meets the applicable requirements of regulation 14.1 or 14.4 and 18.3 of MARPOL 
Annex VI.  
5.2 加油单据应在船至少保存3 年。 
Bunkering documents shall be kept on board for at least 3 years. 
5.3 加油单据应附有一份所供燃油的代表油样，由供油商代表和船长或负责加油操作的高级
船员在加油后密封和签字，由船舶负责保存至燃油基本用完，但保存时间无论如何不能

Bunkering documents should be accompanied by a representative of the oil for the fuel sample, sealed 
and signed by the representative of the oil supplier and the master or engineer responsible for the 
bunkering operations after bunkering, the ship is responsible for the preservation of fuel until the fuel 
basically consumed onboard. But preservation time, regardless of any situation, cannot be less than 12 
months after bunkering. 
6 
燃油管理 
Fuel Oil Management 
6.1 轮机长负责监督二管轮定期测量燃油存量，应在船舶每次抵港、离港和加油后分别测
量和计算一次。对于多于15 个航行天的航次在航行中要根据气象状况每7 天测量全
船所有燃油舱柜的实际存量，测量结果记录到《燃、润油测量记录表》，并及时对《轮
机日志》上的存油数量进行核对对，油舱中的实际存油要与《轮机日志》上的油量相
吻合，如果出现差值时，要及时进行《轮机日志》存油的更正，并将更正的结果记录
于《轮机日志》上。严禁留有帐外油。 
The Chief Engineer is responsible for overseeing the third engineer to do the regular measurement of 
fuel inventory, and shall be measured and calculated once each arrival, departure and after bunkering. 
For voyages of more than 15 days at sea, the actual stock of all fuel tanks in the whole vessel shall be 
measured every 7 days according to the meteorological conditions during the voyage. The measurement 
results shall be recorded in the “Fuel and lubricating Oil Sounding Record form”, and timely verify with 
the "Engine logbook". The actual remaining oil quantity in the oil tanks, should coincide with "Engine 
logbook" figure, if there is any difference, it is necessary to make timely correction on "Engine logbook 
" figure, and the corrected result recorded in the "Engine logbook". It is forbidden to have the pocket oil. 
6.2 对于正常使用燃油流量表的船舶每班要记录流量表的读数，根据流量表的读数核算燃
油消耗量（同时要考虑到回油表的数值之差）；对于流量表故障及没有流量表的船舶
要利用日用柜或沉淀柜作为测量容器来测算燃油的消耗量。 
For the ship normally use the fuel oil flow meter, every watch should record the flow meter readings, 
according to flow meter readings to calculate the fuel consumption (taking into account the difference 
between the return oil meter); for flow meter failure ship and without flow meter ship, use the service 
tank or settling tank as a measuring container to measure the fuel consumption. 
6.3 备用燃油量是根据季节、航程和航途的海况情况综合考虑，一般为主机全速航行3-5
昼夜所需的燃油消耗量。 
The amount of spare fuel is based on the season, voyage and sea conditions en-route are generally 
considered. In general, it is the fuel oil required by the main engine running with full speed for 3-5 days 
and nights. 
6.4 对于个别艏部油舱不能加热的船舶，轮机长要根据航次安排合理使用和调驳燃油； 
In the case of a ship which is not capable of heating of individual fore peak oil tanks, the chief engineer 
chief shall reasonably use and transfer the fuel oil according to the voyage schedule; 
6.5 上述所有涉及燃油存量的报告中，均应包括死油； 
All of the above reports concerning fuel stocks should include the dead oil; 
6.6 加强燃油的管理和净化分离，尽量减小分油量。根据燃油特性参数，控制好净油温度
和排渣时间，以便有效地分离机械杂质和水分； 
Strengthen the management and purification of oil fuel, to minimize oil separated quantity. According to 
the fuel characteristics parameters, control the oil temperature and slagging time, in order to effectively 
separate mechanical impurities and moisture; 
6.7 加强燃油系统过滤装置的检查和保养，确保过滤装置发挥有效的作用。 
Enhance the inspection and maintenance of the fuel oil system filtering unit, to ensure that the filter unit

functions effectively. 
6.8 燃油的使用应根据设备的要求，查阅设备的粘温图，控制燃油进机粘度在合理范围内。 
The use of fuel should be based on the requirements of equipment, check with the equipment 
viscosity-temperature diagram, control the engine fuel oil viscosity within a reasonable range. 
7 
燃、润油调驳程序 
Fuel, lubricating oil transferring procedures 
7.1 燃、润油责任人根据使用的需要或轮机长的要求进行燃、润油的调驳，事先应争得大
副的同意。 
Fuel, lubricating oil responsible person according to the needs of the use or chief engineer's 
requirements for fuel, lubricating oil transfer, should obtain the consent of the chief officer in advance. 
7.2 调驳前责任人需填写《燃、润油调驳计划》，并经轮机长批准。 
The transferring responsible person should fill in the "Fuel, lubricating oil transferring plan", and 
approved by the chief engineer. 
7.3 指定测油人员和甲板巡视人员。 
Specified oil measuring personnel and deck patrolling inspection personnel. 
7.4 调驳前对照《调驳油检查表》逐项检查，并如实填写检查表。 
Before the transfer, follow all items in the "Oil transferring checklist", and truthfully fill in the checklist. 
7.5 调驳期间，要加强各职人员相互之间的联系，正确操作以防止发生油污染。 
During the transfer, should strengthen the mutual contact among all the duty personnel, correct operation 
to prevent oil pollution. 
7.6 调驳完毕，检查各舱的容量，确定调出与调入的油量相符。 
After transfer, check the capacity of each tank, to determine the amount of oil transferred in and out are 
matching. 
7.7 关闭相关的阀门。 
Close the relevant valve. 
7.8 燃油的调驳和测量应详细记入《轮机日志》。 
Fuel oil transferring and measurement shall be recorded in detail in the "Engine Logbook". 
8 
燃油加装管路、驳运管路测试程序 
Fuel bunkering pipe、 transfer Pipe Test Procedure 
根据美国联邦法典(CFR33)第156.170 条规定以及石油公司国际海事论坛（OCIMF）
船舶检查问卷第6.21 款规定，船舶需对船舶燃油加装管路、驳运管路进行压力测试，
本测试由轮机长总负责，二管轮执行具体的测试工作。 
According to Article 156.170 of the United States Code of Federal Regulation (CFR33) and Section 6.21 
of the Ship Inspection Questionnaire of the Oil Companies International Marine Forum (OCIMF), ships 
are required to carry out hydrostatic pressure tests on ship fuel bunkering pipe / transfer pipe, which are 
the general responsibility of the Chief Engineer, and the 3/E perform specific test work. 
8.1 燃油加装管路、驳运管路压力测试程序 
Fuel bunkering pipe / transfer pipe pressure test procedure 
 船舶每5 年进行2 次1.5 倍最大允许工作压力的静水压力试验，则加油管和／或
驳油管可在每年进行一次不小于100％最大允许工作压力的压力试验。 1.5 倍最
大允许工作压力的试验可在进坞时进行。 
The vessel conducts hydrostatic pressure tests of 1.5 times the maximum allowable working 
pressure twice every 5 years, then the fuel bunkering pipe and/or fuel transfer pipe can be subjected 
to a pressure test of not less than 100% of the maximum allowable working pressure once a year. A 
test of 1.5 times the maximum permissible working pressure can be performed at the time of 
docking.

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2026/02/10               Page: 9/18 
 所谓的“燃油加装管系” 是指燃油驳运泵与甲板加油接头之间的管系，通常的
管走向为左右舷甲板加油接头加油总管加油支管控制阀各个油舱，需要进行
压力试验的管系是甲板加油接头与加油支管控制阀之间的管路，也包括燃油驳运
泵出口阀与加油支管之间的一段管路（油舱之间调驳管路） 。 
The so-called "fuel oil bunkering pipeline system" refers to the pipeline system between the fuel oil 
transfer pump and the refueling connector on the deck. The general pipeline route is the port and 
starboard deck refueling connector, refueling main pipe, refueling branch control valve, and each 
oil tank. The pipeline to be pressure tested is the pipeline between the deck refueling connector and 
the refueling branch control valve, and also includes a section of pipeline between the outlet valve 
of the fuel oil transfer pump and the refueling branch (the transfer pipeline between oil tanks). 
 进行压力试验时，将加油管系中充满燃油或类似液体，然后关闭与加油管系相接
的阀件或用盲板封死，然后用专用加压泵加压至1.5 倍最大允许工作压力。 
When conducting pressure testing, firstly fill the bunkering piping with fuel oil or similar liquid, 
then close all the valves connected to bunkering piping or sealed by blind plates and use the 
designated pump to pressurize to 1.5 times the Maximum Allowable Working Pressure (MAWP).  
 船上进行年度试验时可采用上述方法，试验压力为100％最大允许工作压力；
也可采用使用船上燃油驳运泵获取压力的方法，操作前应确认燃油驳运泵的安全
阀起跳压力高于最大允许工作压力。 
The foresaid method can be adopted for annual testing on board with the testing pressure as 100% 
MAWP. Shipping companies can also use transfer pumps to make testing pressure. Ensure that the 
pressure of the safety valve of the transfer pump was adjusted greater than MAWP before 
operation. 
 1.5 倍最大允许工作压力试验可在进坞时由船厂协助进行，并出具相应的检查试
验报告；年度试验可在船舶营运期间进行并出具相应的检查试验报告，试验介质
不得使用空气和惰性气体，只能使用燃油或类似液体。 
The 1.5 times MAWP test is to be carried out combined with the drydock survey, with the 
assistance of the shipyard. The shipyard prepares the report, which is the same as that of ordinary 
pressure tests. As with the annual test, it is to be carried out by crews on board during navigation at 
sea, generally, and the report should be prepared by the master. The testing medium should not be 
air, but fuel oil or similar liquid. 
 试验完成后，应留存相关试验检查报告，并将试验压力和日期标识在管路上。试
验程序和过程注意做好安全和防污染措施，试验完成后及时恢复系统到正常状
态。 
After the test is completed, the relevant test inspection report should be retained, and the test 
pressure and date should be marked on the pipeline. The test procedures and processes pay 
attention to safety and anti-pollution measures, and restore the system to normal state in time after 
the test is completed. 
8.2 压力测试需要注意要点如下： 
The following points to note in pressure testing: 
 参与人员接受必要的安全培训和技能训练，对试压流程熟悉明白。 
Participants receive necessary safety training and skills training, and are familiar with the pressure 
test process. 
 试压涉及管路和区域进行明显标识并做相应警示。 
Pressure test involves the pipeline and area to be clearly marked and warned accordingly. 
 采用清洁的淡水或常输液体作为试压介质。 闪点低于50°C 的可燃液体不可作
为试压介质。 

533

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2026/02/10               Page: 10/18 
Use clean fresh water or liquid as pressure test medium. Flammable liquids with flash points below 
50 °C cannot be used as pressure testing media. 
 在试验前，若可行，应使用压缩空气低压吹扫管路，以排出杂质和残液。注入液
体时要将管路内的气体排尽。 
Before the test, if feasible, the pipeline should be purged with compressed air at low pressure to 
discharge impurities and residual liquid. When injecting liquid, exhaust the gas in the line. 
 试压时环境温度应高于5°C。 若低于5°C 时要进行防冻措施，对试压温度进
行测量 ， 防止材料温度与脆性转变温度接近。 
The ambient temperature should be higher than 5°C during pressure test. If it is lower than 5 °C, 
antifreeze measures should be taken to measure the test pressure temperature to prevent the 
material temperature from approaching the brittle transition temperature. 
 试验时要缓慢升压，达到要求时进行稳压，稳压时间不少于10 分钟。 稳压后将
试验压力降到最大工作压力进行停压，停压时间为30 分钟。当压力稳定后，压力
不下降且无渗漏可判断为合格。 
The pressure should be slowly boosted during the test, and the voltage should be stabilized when 
the requirements are met, and the stabilization time is not less than 10 minutes. After stabilizing, 
the test pressure is reduced to the maximum working pressure for a stop pressure of 30 minutes. 
When the pressure is stable, the pressure does not drop and there is no leakage can be judged as 
qualified. 
 试验完成后，及时拆除盲板，排出介质，恢复系统，正确记录和标识。 
After the test is completed, remove the blind plate in time, discharge the medium, restore the 
system, and correctly record and mark. 
9 
风险评估 
Risk Assessment 
9.1 在进行风险评估时，应考虑到下列风险： 
When conducting the risk assessment, should take into account the following risks: 
 “加油检查表”中列明的相关风险； 
Relevant risks specified in the "Bunkering checklist"; 
 一旦作业过程中有紧急情况发生，救助器材和施救方案的及时性和有效性； 
Once the emergency occurs in the operation process, the timely and effective rescue equipment and 
rescue programs； 
 操作过程中其他可合理预见到的风险； 
Other reasonably foreseeable risks in the operation; 
 操作现场的特殊情况，例如天气、海况、照明、时间限制、空间限制、周边可能存
在的其他危险和限制条件等； 
Special circumstances of the operation site, such as weather, sea conditions, lighting, time constraints, 
space constraints, other hazards and restrictions that may exist around; 
 参与操作人员的特殊情况，例如人员数量、经验、技能、体能等状态； 
Participate in the special circumstances of the operator, such as the number of personnel, experience, 
skills, fitness and other condition; 
 其他特殊情况，例如相关联的其他操作、上级的特殊要求等； 
Other special circumstances, such as the associated other operations, superior special requirements; 
 体系文件未涵盖的其他操作。 
Other operation not covered by the system documentation. 
9.2 对操作过程中的可预见风险与特殊情况进行综合评估后，根据风险的可能性和危害程
度，确定风险级别，评估已采取的防范措施的充分性，如果不充分，应进一步采取额

After the comprehensive assessment of the foreseeable risks and special situations during the operation, 
the risk level is determined according to the possibility of the risks and the degree of harm, and the

1) 确认加油站附近已备妥灭火器、消防水龙、盛油桶、、木屑、破布、消油剂等器材及

第10 节 压载水操作管理规定 
Section 10 Ballast Water Management Regulations 
1 
目的 
Purpose 
1.1 
压载水对于控制船舶的纵倾、横倾、吃水、稳定性和应力是必不可少的。但是，如
果操作不当，可能对人员、环境、船舶和货物造成危害。  
Ballast water is essential to control trim, list, draught, stability and stresses of the ship. However, if 
improper management may create hazards to human, environment, ship and cargo’s safety and 
environment. Ensure the correctness of treatment ballast water or ballast water exchange operation 
when discharging and filling, ensure the safety of the ship. 
1.2 
压舱水可能含有水生生物或病原体，排入港口国的水域，可能导致有害水生生物和
病原体的形成，可能对当地人类、动植物生命和海洋环境构成威胁。 
The ballast water may contain aquatic organisms or pathogens, Subsequent discharge of ballast water 
or sediment into the waters of Port States may result in the establishment of harmful aquatic organisms 
and pathogens which may pose threats to indigenous human, animal and plant life, and the marine 
environment.  Prevent pollution of the ship's cargo or the marine environment. 
1.3 
本规定的作用是协助遵守海事组织的准则，以最大限度地降低从船舶压载水和相关
沉积物中移植有害水生生物和病原体的风险，同时维护船舶安全。 
The function of those regulations is to assist in complying with IMO guidelines intended to reduce the 
risk of transplanting harmful aquatic organisms and pathogens from ships’ ballast water and associated 
sediments, while maintaining ship safety.   
2 
定义 
Definition 
“压载水操做管理”是指包括计划、注入处理、排放、检测、测量、记录、及更换
压载水作业在内的整个控制过程。 
Ballast Water Management refers to the entire control process including plan, filling treatment, 
discharge, testing, sounding, recording, and ballast water exchange operation. 
3 
范围 
Scope 
本程序适用于公司所管理船舶的压载水操作及相关作业。 
This procedure applies to ballast water operations and related operations of ships managed by the 
Company. 
4 
职责 
Responsibilities 
4.1 
船长对压载水操作管理有监督责任。 
The master has supervisory responsibility for ballast water operation and management. 
4.2 
大副负责压载水管理和具体操作。应组织压载水操作人员的培训，并记录到《压载
水管理计划》内的培训记录表中。 
Chief Officer is responsible for ballast water management and specific operations. Ballast water

配木匠，由大副应亲自操作或培训有能力的人员负责。 
Carpenter according to the order of the Chief Officer, specific responsible for the ballast water 
measurement, recording, discharging and filling operation. If the ship is not manned with a Carpenter, 
the Chief Officer should operate by himself or train a competent person to be responsible for that. 
4.4 
值班驾驶员在值班期间按船长或大副的指示管理压载水。 
OOW, during the watch, manages ballast water as directed by the master or Chief Officer. 
4.5 
轮机长是压载及处理系统设备的总负责人。三管轮根据大副的指令负责准备压载系
统的设备、阀门，并进行检修和维护。 
The Chief Engineer is the person in charge of ballast and treatment system equipment. Fourth Engineer 
according to the order of the Chief Officer, responsible for preparing the equipment and valves of the 
ballast system, and conducting overhaul and maintenance. 
5 
压载水管理要求 
Ballast Water Management requirement 
5.1 
进行压载作业，应遵守所在港口及相关公约的有关规定。 
Local regulations and the relevant conventions must be complied with as to Ballast water operation. 
5.2 
在进行压载水操作前，大副应书面形式通知木匠和轮机长。由轮机长指示三管轮或
当值轮机员执行压载水的操作指令，海上进行压载水作业应经船长同意。 
Before carrying out ballast water operations, the Chief Officer must issue correct written orders for 
each operation to the carpenter and the chief engineer, the chief engineer instructs the Fourth engineer 
or duty engineer to perform ballast water operations order，Master must be advised prior during ballast 
operations at sea.  
5.3 
压载水中含有油污或污染物时，其排放作业应遵守有关防污染的规定。 
When ballast water containing oil or pollutants, the discharge operations should comply with the 
relevant provisions of pollution prevention. 
5.4 
船舶的纵向强度和横向稳定性在每一步压载水操作中都应在装载计算机算出，并应
在整个操作过程中保持在允许和安全的范围内。 
Vessels longitudinal strength and transverse stability should be worked out for each step of the ballast 
operation on the loading computer and should be within permissible and safe limits during the entire 
ballast operations. 
5.5 
经批准的纵倾和稳性手册(装货手册)和压载水管理计划是最佳压载操作顺序和程序，
进行压载水操作应参照此计划。 
Approved Trim and Stability Booklet (Loading Manual) and Ballast Water Management Plan should 
be referred to for optimum ballast operational sequences and procedures. 
5.6 
船长和高级船员必须遵守压载水管理计划，其中包括国际海事组织(IMO)“防止外来
水生物和病原体通过排放压载水和沉淀物浸入的指南”。 
Masters and Officers must be guided by the Ballast Water Management Plan which includes IMO 
"Guidelines for Preventing the Introduction of Unwanted Aquatic Organisms and Pathogens from 
Ship's Ballast Water and Sediment Discharges".

5.7 
在天气允许的情况下，应每天至少对压载舱进行两次测量，并做好压载测量记录。 
Where the weather allows, ballast tanks should be measured at least twice a day, and recorded ballast 
measurements. 
5.8 
大副应每日检查压载水舱的测量记录并记入“航海日志”。 
The chief officer shall daily inspect the ballast tank sounding records and record in the "Deck logbook". 
5.9 
压载情况发现异常时，应立即报告大副并查明原因, 采取措施，以免发生事故。 
When the ballast condition is abnormal, should immediately report to the chief officer， find out the 
reason and take proper measures to avoid accidents. 
5.10 
停泊期间，值班驾驶员可根据船长或大副的指示或情况需要注入、排出或调整压舱
水。During berthing, the OOW may according to the instructions of the master or chief officer or the 
circumstances needed to fill, discharge or adjust the ballast water. 
5.11 
由于压载作业而发生污染事故时应按当地港口的有关规定（在港口时）或报告程序
向有关方面报告。 
Pollution accidents due to ballasting operations, should be reported to the relevant authorities in 
accordance with the relevant port regulations (when in port) or reporting procedures. 
5.12 
任何压载水操作，均应记入压载水记录簿、航海日志和轮机日志。 
Any ballast water operation shall be recorded in the Ballast Water Record Book, Deck Logbook and 
Engine Logbook. 
5.12.1 
IMO 在2023 年7 月7 日正式通过MEPC.369(80)号决议，该决议对BWM 公约附
录II（压载水记录簿格式）进行了修订，并要求对压载水作业进行更详细和标准化
的报告。该修正案于2025 年2 月1 日生效。根据该决议的要求，公司制定了新版
压载水记录簿，并从2025 年2 月1 日起正式使用。 
On 7 July 2023, the IMO officially adopted MEPC.369(80), a resolution revising Appendix II of the 
BWM Convention regarding the format of the Ballast Water Record Book (BWRB). This amendment, 
aimed at ensuring more detailed and standardized reporting of ballast water operations, will take effect 
on 1 February 2025. According to the requirements of this resolution, the company has developed a 
new version of the ballast water record book and has been officially using it since February 1st, 2025. 
5.12.2 
公司管理的新加坡旗船舶和巴拿马旗船舶在进行压载水操作时需要在公司新版压
载水记录簿中进行记录，而利比里亚旗船舶需要在利比里亚出版的压载水记录簿中
（RLM-124）进行记载。 
When conducting ballast water operations, ships flagged in Singapore and Panama under the company's 
management need to be recorded in the company's new version of the Ballast Water Record Book, 
while ships flagged in Liberia need to be recorded in the Ballast Water Record Book published by 
Liberia (RLM-124). 
6 
压载水管理系统的操作原则 
Operating Principles for Ballast Water management system 
6.1 
安装了符合D-2 要求的压载水处理设备的船舶，所有压载水的压载和排放，需要通
过压载水处理装置。 
The ship has been fitted with ballast water treatment equipment that meets the requirements of D-2, 
and all ballast water ballasted and discharged should be passed through the ballast water treatment 
system.

6.2 
如果压载水处理系统故障无法运行，应根据压载水管理计划启动应急程序。 
Once the BWMS fails, ship crew should take the Contingency Procedure in according to the BWMP. 
6.2.1 
船长应立即报告公司，然后与港口当局沟通，考虑可能采取的应急措施，以便在电
力故障、海水浑浊、包括已安装的压载水管理系统在内的压载水系统故障等紧急情
况下运行船舶压载水。此类应急措施应采取国际海事组织通告BWM.2/第62 号通
告"关于BMM 公约下的应急措施的指导"。 
The Master should immediately report to the company, and communicate with the port State to consider 
possible contingency measures to be taken in order to operate ship’s ballast water in case of emergency 
such as failure of electric power, sea water more turbid, and malfunction of ballast system including 
the installed BWMS and so on. Such contingency measures shall take IMO circular, BWM.2/Circ.62 
“Guidance on contingency measures under the BWM Convention” into account. 
6.2.2 
一旦BWMS 发生故障，机舱人员应查阅《故障排除手册》，分析故障原因，并正
确响应解决。 
Once the BWMS fails, crew should look up Trouble Shooting, analysis of the cause of failure, and 
respond correctly to solve. 
6.2.3 
如果系统完全不能运行，可采用压载水交换法、岸基BWTS 设施或移动式设施。 
If the system is completely incapable of running, Ballast exchange method, Shore- based BWTS 
facility or Mobile facilities may be used. 
6.3 
按照应急程序使用D-1 方式置换压载水时，应该严格执行船舶建造完工压载水管理
手册和装载手册要求，保证船体强度在操作的每环节中都在许可范围内。 
When ballast water is exchanged using the D-1 method in accordance with Contingency Procedure, 
the final ballast water management plan and final loading manual should be strictly implemented to 
ensure that the hull strength is within permissible limits in every step of the operation. 
6.4 
在任何情况下，船舶都应尽最大努力尽快纠正压载水管理系统的故障，并依据公司
规定向港口国控制当局和船旗国提交维修报告。 
In any case, the ship is required to do its best to correct malfunction of the Ballast Water Management 
system as soon as possible and submit its repair plan to the port State control authorities and the flag 
State in accordance with company regulations. 
6.5 
当系统遇到故障和/或故障时，应记录在压载水记录簿中。 
When systems encounter failure and/or malfunctions, these are to be recorded in the Ballast Water 
Record Book. 
7 
操作程序 
Operation Procedures 
7.1 
加装压载水  
Loading of ballast water 
7.1.1 
在开始压载水操作之前，尽可能检查舱通风口是否畅通，人孔盖是否安全。 
Before loading ballast water, check tank air vents for free air flow and manhole covers are secured, as 
far as possible. 
7.1.2 
在装入压载水时需尽最大的努力，确保打入清洁压载水，并且沉淀物吸入是最小的。
When loading ballast every effort is to be made to ensure only clean ballast is being taken onboard 
and the intake of sediment is minimized.

7.1.3 
单舱压水时速度不应过快以避免压力过大，如果需要快速压水，可同时两个或两个
以上水舱同时进行以避免水压对舱壁的冲击。 
The speed of single-tank ballasting should not be too fast to avoid excessive pressure. If fast ballasting 
is required, two or more water tanks may be simultaneously operated to avoid the water pressure impact 
on the bulkhead. 
7.1.4 
作业期间要勤测量， 避免水舱压满后溢流至泊位。 
During the operation, sounding frequently, to avoid ballast tank full and overflow to the berth. 
7.1.5 
机舱要保持压载水泵浦、管理、阀门清洁，无污油和污垢。确认压载水系统与机舱
污水系统是分离的。 
Engine room should maintain ballast pump, management, valve cleaning, no oil and dirt. Confirm that 
ballast water system and engine room bilge system are separated. 
7.1.6 
使用压载水处理系统装入压载水前（如适用）,还应： 
When loading ballast water with the ballast water treatment (if applicable), should: 
1) 根据船上所安装使用的压载水处理装置的操作说明进行设备使用前检查确认；
Before loading, check and confirm before using the equipment according to the operating 
instructions of the ballast water treatment equipment installed on board; 
2) 根据压载水处理装置的耗电功率做好电力准备，有必要时提前启动发电机并网；
Prepare the power according to the power consumption of the ballast water treatment device, if 
necessary, start the generator grid connection in advance; 
3) 压载中，监控系统各参数在正常范围内，管系无泄漏，压载舱室正确，并做好相
应记录; 
In ballast operation, the parameters of the monitoring system are within the normal range, the 
piping has no leakage, the ballast tank is correct, and the corresponding records are made. 
4) 压载结束后，根据压载水处理装置的操作说明做好系统放残保养,调整电力储备；
After the ballast operation is finished, drain the system and adjust the reserve power according to 
the operating instructions of the ballast water treatment device. 
7.2 
压载水的更换（如适用） 
Ballast Water Exchange（if applicable） 
7.2.1 
压载水更换水域的要求： 
Ballast Water exchange sea area requirements: 
1) 只要可行，压载水更换应在距最近陆地200 海里以上，水深不小于200 米的水域
进行； 
Whenever practicable, ballast water exchange should be carried out in waters more than 200 
nautical miles from the nearest land, at the depth of water not less than 200 meters; 
2) 如船舶无法按照上述要求进行压载水换装，则应尽量远离最近陆地，但在任何情
况下，压载水换装应在距最近陆地50 海里以上，水深不小于200 米的水域进行；
If the ship fails to comply with the above requirements for ballast water exchange, it should be as 
far as possible from the nearest land, but in any case, the ballast water exchange should be carried 
out in the waters more than 50 nautical miles from the nearest land, at the depth of water not less 
than 200 meters;
