货运操作                           版本/修改：3.0/0.0                  SHIP-07-02 
Shipping Operation                          Version/Rev.: 3.0/0.0                  SHIP-07-02 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                 生效日期：2018/04/01        第9/10页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd     Effective Date: 2018/04/01            Page: 9/10 
除有害气体。 
Since oxygen accelerates oxidation and self-heating, ventilation to the dry mineral concentrates is 
normally prohibited, unless the temperature of the cargo rises or temporary ventilation is necessary to 
eliminate the toxic gases.  
7.2.4 装妥后平舱并压紧货物或用塑料布苫盖表面，以限制氧化过程。 
After loading, trim and press the cargo or cover the surface with plastic cloth, in order to restrict the 
oxidation. 
7.2.5 每天至少测量货温（货物表面及表面下层处）二次，发现货温升高，可通风散热。 
Measure the temperature of cargo (cargo surface and below the surface layer) at least twice a day; once 
temperature of cargo is found rising, ventilation might be conducted to cool them down.  
7.2.6 下舱或卸货前要进行充分通风或事先开舱，应注意氧化产生的二氧化硫，比空气重，
货物表面可能缺氧，注意人身安全。 
Before entering into the cargo holds or discharging, sufficient ventilation shall be done or hatch covers 
shall be opened in advance. It is important to notice that the sulfur dioxide generated through oxidation 
is heavier than air; therefore the oxygen near the surface of the cargo might be deficit so that people’s 
safety shall be attended to. 
7.2.7 干精矿一旦发热燃烧用CO2可灭火，但降温效果不明显，再次开舱时会重燃，危险性
更大。发现舱内局部有火苗，可用少量水雾灭火降温，单冒烟处，可用掩埋法灭火。 
Carbon dioxide can be used to put off fire once the dry mineral concentrate combust, but with no 
obvious effect on cooling down the temperature; once the hold is re-opened, danger might become 
severer. Once fire is discovered locally inside the cargo hold, small amount of spray can be used to 
extinguish fire and cool down heat; simple smoking shall be eliminated through method of burying. 
7.2.8 装货过程中应防止杂质，特别是可燃物如木屑、纸、草等混入。 
Impurities especially flammable substances such as wood fillings, paper, grass etc. shall be prevented 
during loading. 
8.0 湿精矿特性 
Nature of wet mineral concentrates 
8.1 主要由水浮选法产生的含硫化物的矿粉，粒度约为200-400 目，含有相当水分，它外
形似干矿，但船舶在海上航行，遇大风浪，船体横摇和振动，舱内货物表面会形成泥
水层流动，使船舶倾侧，严重的会倾覆，即使风平浪静，由于主副机的振动，也可能
造成相同的后果。 
Mineral powder processed by water floating that contain sulfide, with granularity of around 200-400, 
contain relative large amount of moisture. They appear like dry minerals, but once the ship encounters 
wind and waves during voyage and rolls and vibrates, the cargoes inside the holds would form a muddy 
water layer and flows to tilt and more severely even capsize the ship. The vibration of the main engine 
might also lead to same consequence. 
8.2 非专用船运输湿精矿，要根据其含水量，结合航线、季节特点，本船状况采取安全措
施，防止货物移动，具体装运管理措施如下： 
If wet mineral concentrates is to be shipped by vessels not specially constructed, relevant safety measures 
shall be taken according to the MC of the cargo, combining characteristics of the voyage and season. In 
order to prevent the cargo from moving, detailed management measures on carriage are as follows: 
8.2.1 装前检查货舱壁和舱盖水密；货舱彻底清扫，不应残留任何化工品或可燃物质；污水
沟井清除垃圾，盖子适当衬垫，防止阻塞，保持管系畅通，必要时配备潜水泵，以便
随时将矿粉表面分离出来的泥水排掉。 
Examine the bulkhead and watertight condition of the hatch covers before loading; thoroughly clean the 
cargo holds, without any chemicals or flammable substances; clean the waste in the bilge well, apply

Shipping Operation                          Version/Rev.: 3.0/0.0                  SHIP-07-02

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd     Effective Date: 2018/04/01            Page: 10/10 
dunnage to the cover, prevent clogging and keep the pipe system clear; submersible pump might be 
equipped when necessary in order to discharge the muddy water separated from the surface of the 
mineral powder. 
8.2.2 湿精矿属重货，装货后船舶重心低，遇风浪横摇周期短且剧烈，货物易移动，装货完
后要进行平舱。 
Wet mineral concentrates is heavy cargo, which cause a low height of center of gravity; once the ship 
suffers severe and short periods of rolling under wind and waves, the cargo is liable to move. Trimming 
shall be carried out after loading.  
8.2.3 装货过程中要保持船舶正浮，如货堆上面不加压时，货堆应积载成截面圆锥形。 
Keep the ship upright during loading; and if no pressure applied above the stockpile, it shall be stowed 
in shape of section of cones. 
8.2.4 航行中经常注意货物状况，事先做好防止移动、排水及其它安全措施，若天气情况恶
劣，应考虑避风或绕航等，避免有较大的横向波浪或恶浪冲击船体，保证安全航行。 
Cargo condition shall be constantly paid attention during voyage, and safety measures such as 
anti-movement and drainage shall be prepared in advance. When encounters with tough weather, taking 
shelter or deviation might be considered, in order to avoid heavy transverse waves or severe waves 
hitting hull and guarantee the safety of voyage. 
8.2.5 经验认为，开航后十小时内是货堆易发生变化的危险期，如货堆表面干燥、开裂，表
明货堆已稳定。 
Experiences show that 10 hours since the ship sails is regarded critical period when stockpile might 
suffer changes; dry cargo surface with cracks indicates a stability of the stockpile.   
8.2.6 须注意湿精矿的移动性不仅与含水量有关，还与粒度与成份有关。 
It shall be noticed that the movability of wet mineral concentrates is not only related to MC, but also 
depends on granularity and components. 
8.2.7 与装运一般重货一样，装运精矿粉也应考虑船体结构强度及舱底板负荷。 
Same as loading normal heavy cargo, the loading of mineral concentrates also involves consideration of 
strength of hull structure and the load of bilge plate.

货运操作                       版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
Shipping Operation                      Version/Rev.: 3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2018/04/01          第1/10页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2018/04/01              Page: 1/10 
第03 节  粮谷运输注意事项 
Section 03 Notes for carriage of grain  
 
1.0 袋装大米、玉米、花生、芝麻等粮油作物 
Bagged grain and oil products such as rice, maize, peanut, sesame etc. 
运输袋装粮油作物易发生的货运质量事故，主要有汗湿、霉变、生虫等事故。冬季装
运袋装粮油作物从温暖海区向寒冷海区航行，在货舱里面会发生汗水。汗水滴落到货
物上面就会造成局部汗湿和发霉变质。 
Frequently happened shipping quality accidents of bagged grain and oil products mainly include sweating, 
molding, and unripe bugs, etc. During winter, when bagged grain and oil products sail from warm sea 
areas to cold sea areas, the cargo holds suffers with sweating; and when sweat drops on the cargo, local 
sweating and molding is likely to happen to the cargo.   
1.1 装运袋装粮油作物的必要条件 
Requirements on shipping bagged grain and oil products 
1.1.1 船舱要清洁、干燥、无异味、无害虫，舱盖要水密。装货前需申请验舱，取得合格证
书。 
Cargo holds should be clean, dry, smell-free, bugs-free, and hatch covers should be watertight. Apply 
for cargo hold inspection before loading and obtain the certificate. 
1.1.2 货物在装前（或装后）应取得熏舱证书。 
Fumigation certificate is to be obtained before (after) loading. 
1.1.3 严禁与异味货、潮湿货、脏货以及毒品等同装一舱，防止串味、水湿和污染货物。 
Loading into same holds with cargo with peculiar smell, wet cargo, dirty cargo, and drugs is strictly 
prohibited, in order to prevent cargo from being tainted by other order, wetted, and contaminated. 
1.1.4 装货时应注意包装外表情况，避免将湿包、污包和破包装入舱内。途中适时通风。 
Pay attention to the packing while loading, and prevent the wet/dirty/broken bags from being loaded 
into holds. Ventilate properly during voyage. 
1.2 积载准备和衬垫方法 
Preparation to stowage and means for dunnaging 
1.2.1 首先要把货舱打扫干净，达到验舱标准。二层甲板上的排水孔要畅通无阻，污水沟（井）
要清洁干净，装货前要检查舱口围上四角的流水孔是否畅通。 
The cargo holds are to be cleaned at first, and meet the standards of cargo inspection. The discharge 
opening on the tween deck is to be cleared, and bilge (well) cleaned; drain holes on the four corners of 
hatch coaming is to be inspected to ensure their being unblocked.  
1.2.2 其次要进行合理衬垫，以保证袋装粮油作物的质量完好。 
Second, conduct appropriate dunnage in order to ensure the sound quality of bags of the grain and oil 
products. 
1.2.3 舱底要用方木、木板衬垫，上铺塑料布或草席，污水沟盖板缝隙要用板条塞注，以防
货物被污染或袋破。 
Wooden blocks and planks shall be applied tank top as dunnage, above where plastic cloth or grass mat 
shall be used. Gaps of the bilge covers shall be inserted with pieces of lath, in order to avoid cargo 
contamination or packing damage. 
1.2.4 要用塑料布或草席等隔开船体金属部分防止货袋直接与金属部分接触。 
Use plastic cloth or grass mate to segregate the metal parts of the ship and the cargo bags, avoiding 
direct contact between bags and metal parts. 
1.2.5 船侧护板及钢制隔壁都要用塑料布或草席衬垫，要注意衬垫不能有碍通风。舱内有突

643

货运操作                       版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
Shipping Operation                      Version/Rev.: 3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2018/04/01          第2/10页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2018/04/01              Page: 2/10 
起物件也应用草席等衬垫平整，防止货袋与该突起物接触发生破袋和汗湿。 
The ship’s side plates and steel separation boards shall be applied with plastic cloth or grass mat, which 
shall not hinder ventilation. Any projected items shall also be covered by grass mat, in order to avoid the 
contact between the cargo bags and projected items, which might cause packing damage and sweat. 
1.2.6 上甲板下面的货堆上面可用塑料布或草席覆盖，覆盖时要有适当的搭边以达到完整覆
盖，防止汗水滴落造成局部水湿或发霉变质。特别对舱口围和通风筒下面的货堆要覆
盖好，保证货物不受汗湿。 
Plastic cloth or grass mate can be applied above the stockpile under the upper deck; extra margin of the 
grass mat shall be prepared for wholly cover the stockpile, to avoid local wet or moldy caused by drops 
of sweat. Stockpile under the hatch coaming and ventilation pipes shall be especially well covered, to 
guarantee the cargoes are sweat free. 
1.3 积载方法与舱内熏蒸 
Stowage plan and fumigation of cargo holds 
1.3.1 袋装粮油作物在舱内堆积后，因呼吸作用会发热，装货期间在堆装时要留出纵向、横
向的通风道，进行辅助通风散热。 
The stocking of the bagged grain or oil crops inside the cargo holds might release heat caused by 
cellular respiration; therefore transverse and longitudinal ventilation shall be reserved in helping with 
ventilation and heat-relieving.  
1.3.2 在装货后要进行熏蒸，现在常用的熏蒸药品为溴甲烷气体和磷化铝片剂或粉末。 
Fumigation shall be carried out after loading. Commonly used fumigants nowadays are methyl bromide 
and aluminum phosphide tablets or powder. 
1.3.3 溴甲烷是熏蒸袋装粮油作物的有效制剂。它有强烈的杀菌力，同时还有良好的杀虫效
果。溴甲烷的分子量为94.94，在0℃时相对密度（水=1）为1.732，沸点3.6℃。溴
甲烷在常温下是气体，但低浓度时无臭味，相对密度（空气=1）为3.27，有渗透到货
堆之间的作用，最适合于粮谷和食品的熏蒸。溴甲烷是不燃性气体，易流动和凝缩成
液体，一般用高压瓶存放，便于保管。熏蒸时要封闭船舱，用胶管连接气体瓶把气体
放到舱内，对舱内容积有效用药量为：1 磅／1000 立方英尺（0.48 千克／30 立方米），
气体注入后货舱封闭必须达到24 小时以上。 
Methyl bromide is an effective fumigant for bagged grain and oil crops. It shows impressive ability as 
bactericide and insecticide. The molecular weight of methyl bromide is 94.94, with relative density at 
0℃ (water=1) is 1.732 and boiling point 3.6℃. Methyl bromide appears gas under normal temperature, 
odorless under low concentration, and has a relative density (air=1) of 3.27. It can permeate into the 
space among stockpiles, therefore suitable for fumigation of grains and food. Methyl bromide is 
inflammable gas, and is liable to flow and condense to liquid; therefore normally it’s stored inside the 
high-pressure bottles to be better kept. Close the cargo holds during fumigation, connect the gas bottle 
with rubber tube and release the gas into cargo holds; effective amount of fumigant is: 1 pound/1000 
cubic feet (0.48kg/20 cubic meters). After infusing the gas, close the hatch covers for at least 24 hours. 
1.3.4 磷化铝属于危险品，在危规中的分类为3.3 类（遇水放出易燃气体的物质）及6.1 类
（有毒物质），联合国编号为1397，利用磷化铝片剂或粉末释放出的磷化氢气体达到
对粮食作物熏蒸的目的，磷化铝片剂或粉末的分解时间约为5-7 天。 
Aluminum phosphide is hazardous good, and classed as 3.3 (substances that release flammable gas in 
contact with water) and 6.1 (toxic substances) in IMDG Code with UN no. 1397. The hydrogen 
phosphide gas released by aluminum phosphide tablets or powder meets the purpose of fumigation to 
grain crops, with a decomposition period of 5-7 days. 
1.3.5 无论采用何种熏蒸方式，船长均应在开始熏蒸作业前从熏蒸作业机构处获得熏蒸注意
事项。 

644

04_19_8.text:
货运操作                       版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
Shipping Operation                      Version/Rev.: 3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2018/04/01          第3/10页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2018/04/01              Page: 3/10 
Master shall obtain precautions of fumigation from the fumigation organization before the operation, 
regardless which fumigation method is chosen. 
1.3.6 会同熏蒸作业人员完成货舱熏蒸检查表的填写并签字，如有不适用项目，则应在□中
划“-”； 
Fill in the fumigation inspection form with the fumigation practitioner and sign; if items that are not 
applicable, fill “-” in the □. 
1.3.7 必须采取戴防毒面具、手套等安全防护措施后方可进行货舱内气体浓度的测定。 
Protective items such as breathing mask and gloves have to be equipped before taking t gas 
concentration measurement inside the cargo holds. 
1.3.8 航行中管理的主要工作是控制货舱通风，要严格按照熏蒸注意事项中的要求进行通风
换气，保证船舶抵港前货舱达到卸货要求。 
Main job related to voyage management is to control the ventilation of the cargo holds; ventilation 
required by in the notes for fumigation shall be strictly followed, in order for the cargo holds to meet 
discharging requirements upon arrival. 
1.3.9 船长在抵达卸港前，须将熏蒸情况详细报至租家及代理。卸货前对货舱进行气体测定，
确认无毒后，方可卸货。 
Before arrival at the port, Master shall report the details related to fumigation to the charterer and agent. 
Conduct gas test to the cargo holds before discharging, and discharging can only be conducted under 
confirmation of non-toxic gases.  
 袋装粮油作物的通风方法是采用热气自然上升法，把舱内高温高湿的气体放散出
去。 
Method of natural rising of hot gas is used as way of ventilation of bagged grain and oil crops to 
release gases with high temperature and humid inside the cargo holds. 
 利用自然通风设备的船舶，应在航行途中把通风筒口转向下风，天气良好时，可
打开货舱口，使货舱内热气自然上升进行缓慢的通风，力争舱内外空气温湿度平
衡，把船体出汗控制在最小限度之内。 
Ships that use natural ventilation shall shift the ventilation pipe to downwind direction during 
voyage; hatch covers might be opened while weather is fine to conduct slow ventilation using 
natural rising of the hold gases in the cargo holds, in which way the temperature and humidity of the 
air both inside and outside the cargo holds can reach balance, and control the sweating of the hull to 
a minimum limit. 
 有机械通风装置的船舶，利用排气风扇运转排气，并视天气条件配合进行通风换
气。 
Ships that equipped with machinery ventilation shall use the exhaust fan to release gases, and 
ventilate according to weather condition. 
1.3.10 值班驾驶员应经常注意天气的状况，注意舱内温湿度变化，以采取合理的通风方法
达到预期的目的。 
The OOW shall pay frequent attention to weather condition, notice the change on temperature inside 
the cargo holds, in order to take proper ventilation method to meet the purpose. 
1.3.11 如在航行中遇到大风浪连续几天封闭舱口，风浪过后，如迅即打开舱口通风会促进
船体出汗，应视天气条件逐渐打开舱口散发高温高湿气体。湿度在运输和保管粮油
作物过程中起着重要因素，大米要求含水量在15％以下，大麦在13％以下，叶粒在
11％以下，叶粉在13％以下，玉蜀黍在13％以下，运输比较安全。 
If the ship encounters constant days of heavy weather and remains the hatch covers closed, opening 
the hatch covers immediately after wind and waves accelerate sweating of the hull; therefore the hatch 
covers shall be opened gradually to release gases with high temperature and humidity based on the 

645

货运操作                       版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
Shipping Operation                      Version/Rev.: 3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2018/04/01          第4/10页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2018/04/01              Page: 4/10 
weather condition. Humidity plays important role in shipping and storing the grain and oil crops; for 
safety carriage, rice requires moisture content of less than 15%, while barley below 13%, leaf seed 
under 11%, leaf meal not exceeding 13%, and maize less than 13%.  
2.0 散装粮谷 
Grains in bulk 
2.1 装货前的准备： 
Pre-loading preparations: 
2.1.1 货舱用海水冲洗后再用淡水漂洗。 
Cargo holds shall be washed by seawater first and then fresh water. 
2.1.2 货舱要清洁、无锈皮，无残货，干燥、无异味、无害虫。 
Cargo holds shall be cleaned, rust-free, cargo loss free, and shall be dry, smell free, and insect free. 
2.1.3 污水井要干净，抽排污水系统正常。 
Bilge well shall be clean, with pumping and discharging bilge water system functioning well. 
2.1.4 舱盖要水密。抵港前作水密试验。 
Hatch covers shall be watertight. Watertight test must be conducted before arrival. 
2.1.5 作好配载图和装货计划。 
Prepare the right stowage plan and loading plan.  
2.1.6 验舱时配合好验舱人员，顺利取得货舱合格证书。 
Cooperate with the cargo holds inspector while inspecting the cargo holds, and obtain the certificate 
successfully.  
2.2 散粮船舶完整稳性要求： 
Requirements on intact stability of bulk carrier for grains: 
2.2.1 由于谷物移动而产生的船舶横倾角应不大于12 度； 
The listing angle of the ship caused by movement of grains shall not exceed 12 degrees; 
2.2.2 在静稳性曲线图上，到达倾侧力臂曲线与复原力臂曲线的纵坐标最大差值的横倾角或
40 度角或“进水角”时，取其小者。该两曲线之间的净面积或剩余面积，在一切装
载情况下应不小于0.075 米· 弧度，或4.298 米· 度； 
In the statical stability diagram, the net or residual area between the heeling arm curve and the righting 
arm curve up to the angle of heel of maximum difference between the ordinates of the two curves, or 40 
degrees or the angle of flooding, whichever is the least, shall in all conditions of loading be not less than 
0.075 meter-radians, or 4.298 meter-degrees; 
2.2.3 经修正各舱内自由液面影响后的初稳性高度,应不小于0.3 米。 
The initial metacentric height, after correction for the free surface effects of liquids in tanks, shall be not 
less than 0.30 m. 
3.0 种籽饼的安全运输措施 
Safety carriage measures for seed cake 
3.1 种籽饼的特性： 
Characteristics of seed cake: 
3.1.1 种籽饼是含油植物种籽经机械压榨或通过溶剂萃取方法提取油料后剩余的残渣。一般
称油饼（OIL CAKE），它主要用于饲料或肥料。 
Seed cake is the residue remaining after oil has been expelled mechanically or extracted through solvent 
from oil-bearing seed. It normally is referred to oil cakes, and mainly be used as forage or fertilizer. 
3.1.2 最普通的种籽饼取自椰子（椰子壳）、棉子、花生、亚麻仁、玉米（玉米切片）、尼日
尔草籽、棕榈仁、油菜籽、米糠、大豆及葵花籽等，制成饼、片、球等形状交付运输。 
The most common seed cake is taken from coconut (coconut shell), cottonseed, peanuts, linseed, maize 
(maize slice), Niger seed, palm kernel, rape seed, rice bran, soya bean, sunflower seed etc, and made 

646

货运操作                       版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
Shipping Operation                      Version/Rev.: 3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2018/04/01          第5/10页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2018/04/01              Page: 5/10 
into shapes of cakes, slices, and pellets etc. for carriage. 
3.1.3 由于种籽饼内含油和水，所以会自行缓慢地发热分解，并在遇潮或遇含有一定比例未
经氧化的油类时会自燃。在长期储运过程中也容易发热自燃，所以“国际危规”列为
3.2 类，属自燃物品。 
Since the seed cake contains oil and water, it may self-heat slowly and, if wet or containing an excessive 
proportion of unoxidized oil, ignite spontaneously. It is liable to self-heat and combust during long 
period of carriage and storage, therefore it is classed as Class 3.2 in “IMDG Code” which belongs to 
combustible items.  
3.1.4 葵花籽饼较其他种籽饼更易氧化发热自燃，是最不稳定的。因此，装运葵花籽饼应予
以高度重视注意货物装船时的质量，选择好舱位，远离热源，适当通风，加强管理。 
The sunflower seed cake is more liable to be oxidized and combust compared to other seed cakes, and is 
most unstable. Therefore, the quality of sunflower seed cakes shall be paid close attention to while 
loading; and cargo holds shall be well chosen, which are far away from heat source, ventilated properly, 
with strengthened management. 
3.1.5 由于种籽饼提取方法不同，其油、水的含量也不同，故联合国编号分为： 
Due to different method of extracting seed cakes, and the difference on oil and moisture content, UN 
numbers them as follows:  
 UN No. 1386 
 用机械压榨的种籽饼，含油量在10％以上或所含油、水合计在20％以上的； 
The seed cakes expelled by machines contain more than 10% of oil, or more than 20% of 
combination of oil and moisture. 
 经溶剂萃取和压榨的种籽饼，含油量不高于10％。当含水量高于10％时，则
油、水合计不超过20％。 
The seed cakes that are extracted from solvent and pressed contain oil less than 10%. When 
moisture content exceeds 10%, the combination of oil and moisture is less than 20%. 
  UN No. 2217 
 经溶剂萃取的种籽饼，含油量不高于1.5％，含水量不高于11％。 
   The seed cakes that are extracted from solvent contain oil less than 1.5%, and moisture less than 
11%. 
3.1.6 UN No.1386 项下的种仔饼不管袋装或散装，在运输上要求比UN No.2217 严格的多，
因为前一种含油、水量较后一种大。 
The carriage of the seed cakes under UN No. 1386, no matter bagged or in bulk, requires more strict 
cautions than that of the UN No. 2217, for the former ones contain more oil and moisture content. 
3.1.7 种籽饼的自燃原因，主要是它的理化性质所决定的。但外界的因素如: 温度、湿度及
其混入的易氧化杂质也是导致发热自燃的重要条件，特别是远洋运输具有载量大、不
易通风，航线长，外界气温变化大，很容易诱发自燃。 
The reason for self-ignition lies in its physicochemical properties. However external factors such as 
temperature, humidity, and mixed impurities that are liable to oxidize are also contributed to 
self-heating and combustion, especially under the conditions of ocean shipping such as large carriage, 
difficult ventilation, long voyage, severe changes on outside temperature etc. 
3.2 种籽饼的安全运输措施： 
Safe carriage measures of seed cakes 
3.2.1 船舶具备适货条件： 
Ship’s cargo worthiness: 
 船舱清洁干净，通风设备可以有效使用，取得有效的验舱证书。 
The cargo holds shall be cleaned, effectively use the ventilation system, and obtain valid cargo 

647

货运操作                       版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
Shipping Operation                      Version/Rev.: 3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2018/04/01          第6/10页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2018/04/01              Page: 6/10 
inspection certificates. 
 检查舱内各种水管，有泄漏要及时修复，法兰处最好用橡皮包住，以防密封不好
而引起货损。 
Inspect all water pipes inside the cargo holds, repair if leakage is found; flange shall be wrapped up 
with rubber, to prevent cargo damage caused by poor sealing. 
 舱内的电线护罩、电缆等电气设备全面检查合格，取掉货舱内的保险丝，通风筒
装上防止火星的网罩。备妥安全灯，排除各种不安全因素。 
The wire shield, electrical equipment such as cable shall be inspected and confirmed qualified; take 
off the fuse wire inside the cargo holds, and equip the ventilation pipe with net that prevent sparkles. 
Prepare the safety lights, and rule out insecure factors. 
 具备有效的CO2灭火系统, 对CO2管系、CO2站等，进行认真检查，保证处于良好
的使用状态，驾驶员必须会熟练地使用。 
Equip with effective CO2 fire-extinguishing system, and earnestly inspect the CO2 pipe system and 
CO2 station, to guarantee their good working condition; the officer shall utilize the system smoothly. 
 机舱舱壁绝热达不到A-60 标准的船舶必须按要求进行隔离积载。 
Ships with bulkhead thermal insulation of the engine room under A-60 standards shall carry out 
segregation stowage according to requirements. 
 作业期间，按要求显示信号，非经批准，严禁电焊等热工作业。 
During operation, display signs according to requirements; forbid the hot work such as electric 
welding unless permitted. 
 装卸过程中或其他任何时候货舱内，严禁吸烟及使用明火灯具，特别对于用溶剂
萃取的种籽饼 。 
During loading/discharging or any other occasions, smoking and using open flame lights is strictly 
prohibited inside the cargo holds, especially where the seed cakes extracted through solvent are 
stored. 
 保证污水沟、井畅通，应随时排放；用麻袋封好污水井盖板，防止航行中船舶摇
摆致使种子粉渗入，堵塞污水井。      
Keep the bilge (well) clear and ready to discharge anytime; seal the bilge well covers with gunny 
bags to prevent the seed powder permeating into the well due to ship’s rolling and clog it.                   
3.2.2 把住货物质量关： 
Guard the quality of the cargo: 
 种籽饼的含油量和含水量必须符合海运要求； 
The oil and moisture content of the seed cakes must meet the carriage requirements; 
 货物要保持干燥，不得雨天装船，当外界湿度较大的阴天，也应停止装载。 
The cargo should be kept dry; loading during rain is prohibited, and loading shall be suspended 
during cloudy day with a high humidity.  
 溶剂萃取的种籽饼，应是基本无易燃的溶剂。 
The solvent that used to extract seed cakes should be solvent that is normally incombustible.  
 取得发货人保证，出厂后至装船前应有二个月的氧化期。 
Acquire guarantee letter from the shipper, in which 2 months of oxidation period after produced and 
before loading is indicated.  
 严格检查发货人送交的分析样品，应取样均匀，保证货物质量的全面性。 
Strictly inspect the analyzing sample delivered by the shipper; the sample shall be taken uniformly to 
represent the overall quality of the cargo. 
 每票种籽饼的品质检验应以发货港检验机构出证为准，其中要注明出厂日期，榨
油方法，油、水及杂质的含量。

Shipping Operation                      Version/Rev.: 3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2018/04/01          第7/10页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2018/04/01              Page: 7/10 
Quality inspection of each bill of seed cakes shall be based on the certificates issued by inspection 
organization of shipping port, in which production date, method for oil expression, and content of oil, 
water and impurities shall be marked. 
 符合上述规定的，方可安排装船；不符合的，一律拒装。拒装的原因应及时报告
公司有关部门。 
Loading is to arranged only after above requirements are met, otherwise loading is to be rejected. 
Reasons for rejection shall be report to the relevant departments of the company. 
3.2.3 装卸货和运输中的注意事项及措施： 
Matters that needed attention during loading/discharging and shipping, and measures： 
 一般船舶燃油舱在货舱的下面，尽可能缩短燃油加温时间和次数，加温至油能驳
动即停止加温。一般控制在50℃以下为宜。 
Normally the fuel oil tank is equipped under the cargo holds, therefore the time and frequency of 
heating of the fuel oil shall be shortened, and heating must be suspended once the temperature 
reaches the starting point. Normally it is to be controlled under 50℃. 
 装卸前必须联系港方，共同研订安全操作规程和有效的防火灭火措施，特别是在
卸货前已发现舱内货物自燃，应联系港方安排专业消防人员监卸，以防火势扩大。 
Port side must be contacted before loading, for jointly making safety operation principles and 
fire-control/fire-extinguishing measures, especially the self-ignition is found inside the cargo holds 
before discharging, in which situation the port side must be informed to arrange fire-fighting 
professionals to attend on-site and prevent the fire from expanding. 
 船舶在装卸及航行期间应注意防火；加快装卸速度，尽量缩短在航在港时间，以
减少货物在船载存时间。 
Ship shall pay attention to fire prevention during loading/discharging and voyage; 
loading/discharging operation shall be accelerated, and to shorten as much as possible the time for 
the ship to be at port and for cargoes to be inside the cargo holds. 
 开好安全会，制定安全措施。 
Hold safety meeting and make safety measures. 
 严格按照“国际危规”的要求，做好对种籽饼的验收和配载工作。 
Well conduct the inspection and stowage operation of the seed cakes strictly according to 
requirements in IMDG Code. 
 种籽饼本身含有油分，并且有气味，所以不能和清洁货物、食品、新鲜水果装在
一起。种籽饼具有吸臭性，不能和生皮、松香水等气味货装在一起。种籽饼具有
吸潮性，潮湿的种籽饼危险性大。其他危险货物不能装在种籽饼上。 
The seed cakes contain oil and smell; therefore they cannot be stored together with cleaning cargo, 
food, and fresh fruits. They are odor absorptive, thus cannot be loaded together with smelled cargo 
such as peltry and rosin water. The seed cakes are also moisture absorptive, and oppose danger while 
wetted. Other hazard goods cannot be loaded above the seed cakes. 
 在装货过程中，货物温度如果超过当地最高气温5℃已应停止装货，并采取降温措
施。 
Loading must be suspended when the temperature of the cargo exceeds the local highest temperature 
by 5℃, and cooling measures shall be taken. 
 对结块、发霉及严重变色或有虫害的种籽饼，以及含水量、含油量超过标准的应
予拒装。 
Reject the seed cakes that are caked, molded, severely discolored, and suffered from insects, and 
those contain water and oil exceeding standards. 
 散装种籽饼，靠机舱壁自然“流堆”的货物高度不应超过5 米。袋装种籽饼，在

649

货运操作                       版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
Shipping Operation                      Version/Rev.: 3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-03 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2018/04/01          第8/10页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2018/04/01              Page: 8/10 
距离机舱壁2 米以内处不能配装，以利于机舱壁的散热。 
For seed cakes in bulk, the “flow pile” against the engine room bulkhead shall not exceed 5 meters. 
Seed cakes in bags shall not be loaded within 2 meters to the engine room bulkhead, in order to help 
with the heat releasing of the bulkhead. 
 装货时应在每个货舱的不同位置和不同深度安放温度计，每日定时测量并记录货
物温度变化情况。从货舱的货物表面往下深约三米处，是自燃的危险“地带”，应
特别掌握此区域的温升变化，以便随时掌握情况及早采取措施。 
Set thermometers at different locations with different depth inside the cargo holds while loading, and 
measure and record the changes of temperature every day. Areas around 3 meters under cargo 
surfaces is regarded as dangerous zone of spontaneous combustion, where special attention is needed 
on the temperature change, to control the situation at anytime and take measures immediately. 
 要放温度计时应与港方取得联系，并密切配合，防止在装货过程中拉线被损坏。 
Communicate and cooperate with port side when setting the thermometers, in order to prevent the 
wires to be damaged during loading. 
 每日定时测温记录应作为船方内部记录，抵卸货港时不能给收货人看；除非引起
纠纷可以此作为凭据。 
The record of temperature measurement shall be kept inside the ship, and cannot be shown to the 
consignee at the discharging port; unless it is needed as evidence for disputes. 
 在气温寒冷的条件下装货，舱内温度和货物温度都比较低，航行中不宜再开舱凉
晒，以免气温较高的区域热气进入舱内产生大量汗水造成货物潮湿；在气温较高
的条件下装货，舱内温度和货物温度都较高，这时就要注意通风降温，航行中应
根据外界温度的变化，适时开舱通风，以散发舱内热气，避免产生大量汗水，造
成货损。 
While loading under cold weather, with lower temperature both inside the cargo holds and of cargoes, 
hatch covers are not recommended to be open during voyage, in order to prevent the cargo from 
getting wet due to the heat from areas with higher temperature entering into cargo holds and causing 
large amount of sweat; while loading under hot weather, with higher temperature both inside the 
cargo holds and of cargoes, proper ventilation is recommended according to the changes of 
temperature outside, in order to release the heat inside the cargo holds and prevent the cargo from 
damage due to large amount of sweat.  
 在天气晴朗时，日出或日落前后一小时进行开舱凉晒或机械抽风为宜，而长时间
的机械通风将冷潮空气打入舱内会使舱内产生大量雾气而易造成货损。 
Upon fine weather, cooling and machinery ventilation 1 hour before or after sunrise or sunset is 
proper, and one must pay attention that machinery ventilation for a long time might bring cold and 
humid air into cargo holds and generate fog, which further leads to cargo damage. 
 当舱内种子饼温度升高后，绝不能采用在甲板上洒水的方法降温。因甲板温度降
低后，舱内会出现更多的汗水，使表层的种籽饼湿度增大，反而增加了发热的可
能性，并且会影响货物质量。 
After the temperature of the seed cakes inside the cargo holds rise, cooling by watering the deck is 
prohibited. The drop of the deck temperature will cause more sweat inside the cargo holds and 
adding more humidity to the surface of the seed cakes, which provide more possibilities of 
self-heating, as well as influence the cargo quality. 
 种籽饼的发热现象多是局部的，即使温度升高到燃点，在舱内也不会大面积起火，
若发现冒烟，可把焦化冒烟及温度过高的种籽饼清除出来抛入海中。 
Heating of the seed cakes mostly happens locally, and even the temperature rises to ignition point, 
large area of fire may not happen inside the cargo holds; if smoke is detected, seed cakes that are

coked, smoke, and with high temperature can be picked out and thrown into the sea. 
 严重发热或有自燃可能的种籽饼如果己密封了货舱，并且注满了CO2或其他惰性
气体，不要胡乱采取不适当的措施。 
If the cargo holds where the seed cakes that are severely self-heated or have tendency to self-ignite 
are stored have been sealed, and has been filled with CO2 and other inert gases, no improper 
measures shall be taken. 
 航行中，如货物温度达到30℃应选择干燥的天气适时进行通风，条件允许时可开
舱通风。如温度继续上升，按每日升温率计算，到达卸港时的货物温度，如可能
达到80℃ 则应采取以下措施： 
During voyage, ventilation shall be conducted at proper time during dry weather if the temperature 
of the cargo reaches 30℃, and if condition permits hatch covers can be opened for ventilation. If the 
temperature continues to increase, following measures is to be taken if the temperature of the cargo 
may reach 80℃, calculated according to daily temperature increasing rate: 
 当货温达到55℃时，应封闭货舱，停止通风。对机榨法生产的种籽饼，可以充入
CO2，严密监测货物温度。充入CO2时应考虑以下几点： 
When the cargo temperature reaches 55℃, the hatch covers shall be closed and ventilation stopped. 
The seed cakes produced by machinery expression, CO2 can be filled in, with cargo temperature 
closely paid attention to. The followings should be considered while filling in CO2: 
① 
CO2的施放量 
Quantity of CO2 released: 
船舶大型CO2灭火设备的说明书或张贴的示意图中已标出各舱室灭火时所需施放
CO2的瓶数，此乃是根据该舱空舱容积而定的，当货舱装有大量货物时，如按此量
施放，则会浪费大量CO2，甚至丧失了施救其他舱室或维持长时间灭火的能力，
此外，当大量CO2一下子拥进舱室，使舱内气压剧增，有可能破坏了舱室的密封
性达不到灭火的目的，在装有货物的舱室，CO2的施放量可参考下列公式： 
Quantity of CO2 bottles needed in each cabin is marked in the instructions or posted diagram of 
large capacity CO2 fire-extinguishing equipment, which is decided according to the capacity of 
empty cabin; while the cargo holds are loaded with large amount of cargo, CO2 released according 
to this quantity will face great waste, or even lose the ability to fight fire in a long period of time for 
saving other cargo holds. In addition, when a large amount of CO2 enter into the cargo hold all of a 
sudden, the pressure inside the cargo hold might increase sharply, which might destroy the tightness 
of the cargo hold and does not reach fire-extinguishing purpose. In cargo holds stowed with cargo,

 施放CO2前对该舱室应加以密封，否则CO2泄漏而使灭火失败。在每次追加前
还应再次检查与修补漏气之处。对密封十分良好的舱室，若施放CO2过快，舱
内原有空气一时无法排出，舱内压力剧增，可能会破坏密封，甚至胀破了舱盖
板，据此，平时对舱盖、人孔盖、通风筒挡板、水密门等要加强维修养护，防
止CO2外逸。对过于密封的舱室，则可在该舱高处先留一个随时可闭的洞口，
以便快速施放CO2时让高处的空气挤出后再盖上。 
Tightly sealed the hatch covers of the hold before releasing the CO2, otherwise the leakage of 
the CO2 will fail the fire extinguishment. For holds with good tightness condition, releasing 
CO2 over may cause difficulty for the original air inside to discharged, which leads to the sharp 
increase of pressure inside and break the tightness or even swelling break the hatch covers. 
Therefore, maintenance to the hatch covers, manholes, ventilation pipe dampers, watertight 
doors etc. shall be strengthened to prevent releasing of the CO2. For holds that overly tightly 
sealed, a hole that can be closed at any time shall be remained at a high place of the cabin, in 
order to squeeze the air at top outside while quickly releasing CO2 before its being closed. 
 对于使用有机溶剂萃取的种籽饼，在未见明火之前决不能使用CO2，以避免因
产生静电而将溶剂蒸气点燃的可能性。只能选择温度较低的天气或时间进行开
舱通风。如果采用以上措施后温度仍然上升很快，最好在货物中间位置挖一条
散热坑道，同时考虑挂靠附近港口求助。 
For seed cakes that are extracted from organic solvent, using CO2 before open flame is detected 
is strictly prohibited, in order to prevent the solvent vapor from being ignited by static 
electricity generated. Ventilation shall be arranged only when temperature is rather low. If the 
above measure is taken and the temperature still increase fast, the heat releasing tunnel shall be 
dug in the middle of the cargo and ask for help from port side while calling at the port.  
 如果采取以上措施温度仍然上升，以致自燃起火，唯一办法是注入海水灭火。
但采取此法灭火时应特别谨慎，这时应考虑舱内注入海水后种籽饼的膨胀和船
舶总排水量的增加。 
If the above measures are taken and the temperature still increases and cause combustion, the 
only method is to infuse with seawater to extinguish fire. However this method shall be taken 
with special caution, and consider of the swelling of the seed cakes and the increase of 
displacement of the ship after infusing the seawater.

青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2019/06/20           第1/5页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.        Effective Date: 2019/06/20              Page 1/5 
第04 节  煤炭装运安全措施 
Section 04 Coal Shipment Safety Measures 
 
1.0 装卸、运输的操作 
Operation of cargo loading, unloading and transport 
1.1 煤的特性与特点: 
Characteristic of Coal: 
1.1.1 煤可能产生可燃气体甲烷, 甲烷含量在5%至16%之间的甲烷/空气混合气体即为爆炸
性气体，其能被火花或明火点燃。甲烷比空气轻，会积存于货物处所或封闭处所的上
方。 
Coals may emit methane, a flammable gas. A methane/air mixture containing between 4% and 16% 
methane constitutes an explosive atmosphere which can be ignited by sparks or naked flame, e.g., 
electrical or frictional sparks. Methane is lighter than air and may, therefore, accumulate in the upper 
region of the cargo space or other enclosed spaces  
1.1.2 煤可能发生氧化，导致货物处所内缺氧及二氧化碳或一氧化碳浓度增高。一氧化碳在
空气中的燃烧极限为12%-75%（体积比）。吸入会中毒，其与血红蛋白的亲和力比氧
高200 倍。 
Coals may be subject to oxidation, leading to depletion of oxygen and an increase in carbon dioxide or 
carbon monoxide concentrations in the cargo space. Carbon monoxide has flammable limits in air of 
12% to 75% by volume. It is toxic by inhalation with an affinity for blood haemoglobin over 200 times 
that of oxygen. 
1.1.3 某些煤易于自热并在货物处所内引起自燃，可能产生一氧化碳等易燃有毒气体。  
Some coals may heat spontaneously and the spontaneous heating may lead to spontaneous combustion 
in the cargo space. Flammable and toxic gases, including carbon monoxide, may be produced. 
1.1.4 某些煤可能与水发生反应，并产生具有腐蚀性的酸液。可以产生氢气等易燃和有毒气
体。氢气在空气中的燃烧极限为4%-75%（体积比）。 
Some coals may be liable to react with water and produce acids which may cause corrosion. Flammable 
and toxic gases, including hydrogen, may be produced. Hydrogen has flammable limits in air of 4% to 
75% by volume. 
1.2 装货前： 
Before cargo loading: 
1.2.1 船长根据航次指令，查核装卸港、合同装载量和港口吃水限制等，并按照《散货船装
卸安全操作规则》BLUK CODE 及其附件的要求，审核大副拟定的装卸顺序及配载图，
并报告公司海务部。组织船员学习IMSBC 规则和本节内容，制定应急反应程序，并
保留学习记录。 
The Master should inspect and verify the loading and unloading port, contracted loading capacity and 
the draught limitation of the port, examine and approve the loading and unloading sequence and 
stowage chart of the Chief Officer according to the “Code of Practice for the Safe Loading and 
Unloading of Bulk Carriers” (BLU CODE), then report to the Marine Department. Organize the crew to 
learn the IMSBC regulation and the content of this section, develop emergency reaction procedure, 
and keep a learning record. 
1.2.2 船长应按照《国际海运固体散装货物规则》（IMSBC CODE）向货物托运人或其代理
索取“Cargo Declaration”, 了解煤种、特性、燃点、岸上堆存时间、煤堆温湿度、开
采季节等信息和推荐的安全运输程序。同时船长还应特别注意煤的水分含量、含硫量
及尺寸，是否可能释放甲烷或自热等信息。 
The Master should seek the “Cargo Declaration” from the shipper or the agent according to the

Shipping Operation                            Version/Rev.:3.0/1.0                         SHIP-07-04

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.        Effective Date: 2019/06/20              Page 2/5 
“International Maritime Solid Bulk Cargoes Code” (IMSBC Code), in order to know more about the 
type of coal, characteristic, ignition point, storage time on the shore, temperature and humidity of the 
coal, mining season and recommended shipment safety procedure. At the same time, the Master should 
pay special attention to the water moisture, sulphur content and size of the coal, whether it may emit 
methane or lead to self-heating. 
1.2.3 船舶须装备相应的仪器设备，以便不进入货舱便可测得舱内甲烷、氧气、一氧化碳的
浓度。这些仪器设备须定期维修和校准。船上有关人员必须会熟练使用该仪器。另外
船舶还应备有可用的测量舱底污水pH 值的用品和可测量货物处所煤温的温度计。这
些仪器设备和使用说明书由大副保管。 
The ship should allocate relevant instrument and equipment, so that methane, oxygen and carbon 
dioxide concentration level can be measured without entering the cargo hold. These instrument and 
equipment must go through periodic maintenance and adjustment. Concerned personnel should be able 
to use these instruments skillfully. Also, the ship should provide tools to measure the pH value of cargo 
space bilge and the coal temperature of the cargo hold. The instrument, equipment and application 
manuals are kept by the Chief Officer. 
1.2.4 禁止煤温已达55℃以上的自热煤装船。 
The self-heating coals shall only be accepted for loading when the temperature of the cargo is not higher 
than 55℃. 
1.2.5 检查船上货舱管系、消防系统，保证使其处于良好的备用状态，有关人员必须会熟练
使用这些设备。 
Inspect the cargo piping and firefighting system, to ensure they are in good condition for usage. 
Concerned personnel should be able to use these instruments skillfully. 
1.2.6 装船前应消除货舱内残存的垃圾杂质，清扫货舱，保证货舱和污水沟清洁、干燥、畅
通。 
All cargo spaces and bilge wells should be clean and dry. Any residue of waste material or previous 
cargo should be removed before loading. 
1.2.7 货舱区域的电缆和电气设备应为防爆型，否则应完全关闭货舱区域的一切电源。 
All electrical cables and components situated in cargo spaces should be safe for use in an explosive 
atmosphere or positively isolated. Or else, all power in the cargo spaces should be turned off. 
1.3 装货时: 
During cargo loading: 
1.3.1 如果舱容许可，在靠近机舱舱壁处，采用斜坡式装载，以减少机舱对煤的传热增温。
航行时主机尽量使用边柜内燃油，双层底油柜驳油时尽可能不加温或少加温，驳妥后
即停止加温。 
If the cargo volume permits, slopping storage can help to reduce the heat passage and warming process 
of the coal. During navigation, the main engine should use the fuel oil inside the side tank if possible. 
During oil transfer for the double bottom tank, do not warm up or only warm up a little. Stop warming 
up once the transfer is over. 
1.3.2 煤炭易散发以甲烷为主的易燃气体，该气体在装货过程中，容易进入桅房、油漆物料
间、起货机间、配电室等处所，所以要注意在装货期间或装完后一段时间内，对以上
处所进行通风。 
Coals may emit methane, a flammable gas. It may enter enclosed working spaces such as mast rooms, 
painting store room, cargo crane room, power distribution room and so on. Such spaces shall be 
adequately ventilated during or after loading. 
1.4 航行中 
During navigation

1.4.1 开航当时对货物的通风和保管，要严格按照《国际海运固体散装货物规则》（IMSBC 
CODE）的规定进行。 
Ventilation and keeping of cargo during navigation should be performed strictly according to the 
“International Maritime Solid Bulk Cargoes Code” (IMSBC Code). 
1.4.2 除非另有规定，在装完货离港后24 小时之内，各货舱必须进行表面通风。如果离港
24 小时之后测得甲烷含量处于较低水平，则须关闭通风并监测舱内气体。否则应保
持表面通风，直至甲烷含量降低到较低水平。 
Unless expressly provided otherwise, surface ventilation shall be conducted in all cargo spaces carrying 
this cargo for the first 24 hours after departure from the loading port. During this period, the atmosphere 
in the cargo spaces shall be monitored once from one sample point per cargo space and for the purpose 
of the gas monitoring, the ventilation shall be stopped for an appropriate period prior to the gas 
monitoring.  
1.4.3 航行中一般不可给货舱通风，可根据不同季节、地区特点、外界气温，采取甲板喷水
降温措施。在舱盖密封条件好时也可采用舱盖喷水降温。 
Do not ventilate the cargo hold during navigation. Take measures to cool down the deck by water, 
depend on different seasons and zones, as well as outdoor temperature. 
1.4.4 航行中应每天测量货舱处所的甲烷、氧气和一氧化碳的浓度和温度并记录在煤炭货物
气体和温度测量记录中。 
Measure the concentration and temperature of methane, oxygen and carbon dioxide in the cargo hold 
every day during the navigation. Record it in the Coal Cargo Hold Gas & Temperature Monitoring 
Record. 
1.4.5 航行中应每天检测货舱污水的pH 值并记录在煤炭货物气体和温度测量记录中。如检
测的pH 值表明存在腐蚀危险，则船长应及时采取措施将货舱污水排出，保持所有货
舱舱底干燥以防止酸性物质存在于舱底和污水系统中。 
Regular hold bilge testing shall be carried out during voyage every day and record the results in the 
Coal Cargo Hold Gas & Temp Monitoring Record. If the pH monitoring indicates that a corrosion risk 
exists, the Master should take measures timely that the bilges shall be frequently pumped out in order to 
avoid possible accumulation of acids on tanktops and in the bilge system. 
1.4.6 如果货舱内的一氧化碳含量达到50ppm，或连续三天稳定上升，则可能正在发生自热，
船长应将详细情况报告公司。 
When the carbon monoxide level in any cargo space reaches 50 ppm or exhibits a steady rise over three 
consecutive days, a self-heating condition may be developing and the Master shall inform the company. 
1.4.7 如果从多方迹象判明煤温继续升高且有大量烟雾渗出, 即煤已开始自燃，则应进一步
封闭所有通向货舱的开口道门，最好在舱盖接连处及其四周用封舱胶布密封，舱盖表
面用水降温，并报告公司，考虑驶往最近港口施救。除非万不得已时, 不得用海水浇
灌灭火。 
When the coal temperature and carbon monoxide level is increasing steadily, a potential 
self-combustion may be developing. In such a case, the cargo space shall be completely closed and all 
ventilation ceased, the boundaries between the hatch cover and surroundings shall be sealed by seal 
adhesive tape. Water should be used for cooling the hatch cover surface. Report to the company and 
navigate to the nearest port for rescue. Sea water shall not be used for fighting coal cargo fires at sea. It 
can only be used as a last resort. 
1.4.8 船长和公司应注意到，货物托运人对于其所托运的货物的特性更加了解，当航行中发
现货物异常时，船长应及时与托运人联系以获得技术上的支持。 
The Master and the company should know that the shipper has a better understanding to the 
characteristics of the cargo. For this reason, when the cargo is found to be abnormal during the 
navigation, the Master shall report to the shipper for technical support.

1.4.9 如所装载的货物为自燃煤且需公司对货物的运输状况做出明确的判断时，船舶应参照
IMSBC CODE 有关装运自燃煤的特殊要求的相关规定向公司提供必要的资料。 
When the cargo is self-combustion coal, and clear decision on the shipment have to be made by the 
company, the ship should submit necessary information to the company according to the special 
requirements of self-combustion coal shipment laid out in the IMSBC Code. 
1.5 卸货时 
During cargo unloading 
1.5.1 开舱前，要进行充分的通风，开舱时要尽量避免产生火花，只有在确定完全安全后，
人员才能进入货舱。 
Cargo hold shall be adequately ventilated before opening. Avoid sparks in the process. Personnel can 
enter the cargo hold only after the confirmation of perfect safety. 
1.5.2 开舱后如发现部分煤炭自燃或有明火，应迅速将烧着的煤块用抓斗卸去。如果煤炭自
燃的范围很大难以控制时，应以倾注方式浇灌淡水加以扑灭。灌注淡水数量要足够将
舱内约二米深度的表面层湿透为止，否则只会产生助燃作用。 
If partial coal is found to be self-combustion or come up with open fire after opening of cargo hold, use 
the grab bucket to unload the burning coal quickly. If the range of self-combustion is too large for 
control, pour fresh water to extinguish the fire. The quantity of fresh water should be able to drench 
through two meters of the surface layer, or else it would only help to combust the fire. 
1.6 应急措施 
Emergency measures 
无论何时发现船上的煤炭有异常升温、可燃气体或有害气体浓度过高，船长都应参照
《国际海运固体散装货物规则》（IMSBC CODE）附录1 中煤炭运输的相关指南，尽快
采取措施并报告公司。 
When the temperature of coal increase abnormally, the concentration of flammable gas or toxic gas is too 
high, the Master should take measures and report to the company as soon as possible according to 
Attachment 1 of the “International Maritime Solid Bulk Cargoes Code” (IMSBC CODE). 
2.0 为防止爆炸, 应做到： 
To prevent explosion, the following should be executed: 
2.1 凡装有煤炭的货舱上的甲板区域内, 所有非防爆型电器设备均应切断电源。 
When entering the deck area on top of the coal cargo hold, all electrical equipment without explosion 
proof should be turned off. 
2.2 人员进入装有煤炭的舱室时，应戴上防毒面具隔绝式呼吸器, 必须两人以上操作，不
得穿着含有化纤成分的衣着，以防人体带电，进入舱室之前, 应先消除身体的静电，
如触摸接地的金属板、棒等。 
Personnel shall not enter the cargo space during voyage, unless they are wearing self-contained breathing 
apparatus. It should be operated by two or more crews. Do not wear clothing with chemical fiber, to 
prevent the body from electrified. Before entering the cabin, destaticizing the body by touching the metal 
plate or bar connected to the ground. 
2.3 煤炭在船期间，在货物区域和邻近处所内须禁止吸烟和使用明火，并在显著位置张贴
告示。除非货物处所已完全通风且甲烷含量经测量表明安全，否则不得进行热工、敲
铲和其他产生火源的作业。 
When the coal is on the ship, smoking and the use of naked flames shall not be permitted in the cargo 
areas and adjacent spaces and appropriate warning notices shall be posted in conspicuous places. Burning, 
cutting, chipping, welding or other sources of ignition shall not be permitted in the vicinity of cargo 
spaces or in other adjacent spaces, unless the space has been properly ventilated and the methane gas 
measurements indicate it is safe to do so.

3.0 多用气体探测仪的配备、使用和维护 
Allocation, usage and maintenance of gas detector 
3.1 每艘可能装载煤炭的船舶都应配备至少可探测氧气、甲烷和一氧化碳的便携式多种气
体探测仪，该仪器应通过有资格的机构的检验并取得相关认可证书，并按照仪器说明
书的要求定期检验。 
Portable instrument which is capable of measuring oxygen, methane and carbon monoxide concentrations 
shall be provided on board a ship carrying coal. This instrument should have gone through the inspection 
of qualified authority and obtain a relevant certificate. Periodic inspection should be performed according 
to the requirements of the instrument manual. 
3.2 每次使用前都要对探测仪进行测试，确保正常使用。 
Test the gas detector every time before use to ensure it is functioning normally. 
3.3 船长、大副和船上相关人员应对本船配备的仪器使用方法和测量时的注意事项进行培
训并记录，以达到可以正常熟练操作的要求。 
The Master, the Chief Officer and concerned personnel should undergo training as to the application 
method of the device allocated on the ship and precautions for measurement, in order to meet the 
requirements of normal and skilled operation. Take record accordingly. 
3.4 上述仪器由大副负责保管。 
The Chief Officer is responsible for keeping the above device. 
3.5 船长应监控该探测仪的相关检验证书的有效性，并负责按仪器说明书的要求向公司提
出对该仪器进行检验、维修和更换的申请。 
The Master should monitor the effectiveness of the relevant inspection certificate of that detecting 
instrument, and submit application of inspection, maintenance and replacement to the company according 
to the requirements of the instrument instruction. 
3.6 公司船舶管理部负责安排该仪器的配备、检验、维修和更换。 
The Fleet Department is responsible for the arrangement of allocation, inspection, maintenance and 
replacement of that device.

Relevant documents

第05 节 危险货物运输注意事项 
Section 05 Carriage of Dangerous Goods Precautions 
 
1 
装货前 
Before cargo loading 
1.1 
船长、大副应认真审查货单，对列明的危险货物或虽未列明，但在《国际海运危险
物品规则》中属于危险货物的物品，均必须通过代理从发货人处取得下述证书： 
The Master and the Chief Engineer should examine and approve the shipping order with  due care. 
For listed dangerous goods, or unlisted dangerous goods yet regards as  dangerous goods under the 
“International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code”, the following certificates must 
be 
acquired 
through the agent or shipper: 
1.1.1 
危险货物技术说明书（DANGEROUS GOODS SPECIFICATIONS）或相似资料，其内
容包括：Dangerous Goods Specifications or similar information, the content includes: 
1） 货物的名称 Proper Shipping Name 
2） 国际编号 UN number 
3） 国际危规类别 Class 
4） 理化性质（即状态、颜色、气味、比重、熔点、沸点、闪点、自燃点、分解
温度、燃点、 爆炸极限、中毒最大浓度、致死量及危险程度） 
Physicochemical property (i.e. state, color, smell, proportion, melting point, boiling point, 
point   of flammability, self-ignition point, decomposition temperature, ignition point, 
explosive limits, maximum toxic concentration, lethal quantity and hazard level) 
5） 包装方法（包装物的材质、形状、厚度、封口、内部衬垫物、外部加固情况
及单位重量等）      Packing method (the texture, shape, thickness, sealing, internal 
packing, external securing conditions, weight, etc. of the packing) 
6） 急救措施 Rescue measures 
7） 消防方法 Firefighting approach 
8） 撒漏处理方法 Methods to settle spillage 
9） 积载要求或积载注意事项 Stowage requirements or precautions 
10） 装卸及运输、储存注意事项  Loading, unloading, carriage and storage precautions 
1.1.2 
包装适用证书 
Certificate of Packing Suitability 
1.1.3 
包装检验证明书 
Inspection Certificate of Packing 
1.1.4 
对放射性物品除上述证书外，还应取得“放射性货物剂量检查证明书” 
As for radioactive cargo, apart from the above certificates, “Inspection Certificate of Radioactive  
Cargo Dosage” must also be obtained. 
1.2 
船长、大副应对照国际危规认真核对上述资料，查核所要载运的危险货物是本船  
《危险货物适装证书》中载明的危险货种，如有疑问要及时澄清。 
The Master and the Chief Officer should verify the above information with due care according 
to 
the IMDG code, that the dangerous goods for carriage is listed in the  “Certificate of Fitness for 
Loading Dangerous Goods”. If there is any doubt, clarify it  timely. 
1.3 
若发货人不能提供上述详细资料，可拒绝承运并报公司。 
If the shipper fails to provide the above information in details, the ship can refuse the    carriage 
and report to the company. 
1.4 
大副按照《国际海运危险货物规则》中的“积载隔离表”和“危险货物一览表”的

具体的隔离规定，并按后装先卸的原则绘制配载图；  
The Chief Officer should draw the stowage plan under the principle of “loaded later and  unload 
earlier” according to the separation regulations laid out in the “Stowage Separation  List” and 
“Dangerous Goods List” of the “International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code”. 
1.5 
在装载危险品前，船舶应对“危险货物装前检查表”的内容逐项进行检查、核实，
并在实际装载危险货物前将填妥的“危险货物装前检查表”及配载图报送公司海务
部； 
Before loading dangerous goods, inspect and verify one by one according to the “
Dangerous 
Goods Pre-loading Checklist”. Fill in the “Dangerous Goods Pre-loading Checklist ” 
and 
stowage plan to the Marine Department before actual loading. 
1.6 
大副配载时要做到： 
The Chief Officer should fulfil the following during stowage: 
1.6.1 
必须严格按照国际危规，结合本船设备条件及危险货物的种类、性质、包装、危险
程度选择适当的货位，认真仔细地制定出配载计划。 
Develop a detailed stowage plan seriously according to the International  Maritime Dangerous 
Goods Code, with consideration to the ship equipment, and types, properties,  packing, 
hazard 
level of the dangerous goods in deciding the  appropriate stowage location. 
1.6.2 
配载计划一定要严格按照国际危规“危险货物配装表”及危险货物明细表中提出
的积载隔离要求合理配装。 
The stowage plan must be arranged reasonably. Strictly follow the stowage  separation 
requirements laid out in the dangerous goods list and “Dangerous  Goods Stowage List” of the 
International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code. 
1.6.3 
性质相抵触或消防方法不同的危险货物不得同舱积载。 
Dangerous goods of contradictory nature or different fire prevention measures  should not be 
kept 
in the same cabin hold. 
1.6.4 
易燃、易爆危险货物的积载要与一切热源、火源、电源等保持足够的距离，爆炸
品与引爆器材分开积载。 
The stowage of flammable and explosive dangerous goods must be kept in a  sufficient distance 
with all heat source, ignition source, power source and so on. Explosive goods and blasting unit 
should be put separately. 
1.6.5 
能产生危险性气体的货物应堆装在通风良好的处所或上甲板。 
Cargo that can emit dangerous gas should be put on the deck or in location with good ventilation. 
1.6.6 
氧化剂应严禁与酸碱、易燃有机物及还原剂接触。 
Oxidizer should not be put together with acid-bases, flammable organic compound and  
deoxidizer. 
1.6.7 
有毒及放射性物品应远离居住区积载 ，严禁与食品及其原料、饲料同舱装运。 
Toxic and radioactive goods should be kept far away from the living area. Do not put them with 
fodder, food and its raw materials in the same cabin hold. 
1.6.8 
充分考虑到一般化工品、杂货与危险品的相容性。 
The compatibility of general chemicals, general cargo and dangerous goods is taken into  careful 
consideration. 
1.6.9 
在港序及积载位置安排方面，应尽量做到危险货物后装先卸。 
For the arrangement of port order and stowage location, dangerous goods should be loaded later 
and unloaded earlier if possible. 
1.6.10 尽量避免装有危险货物的货舱在中途加载。 
Avoid adding load to the cargo hold which contains dangerous goods.

2 
装货时 
During cargo loading 
2.1 
船舶在装载危险货物时，值班驾驶员和值班船员必须在现场落实各项安全措施，坚
守工作岗位，监督装卸。 
When the ship is carrying dangerous goods, on-duty deck officer and crew should execute all 
safety measures on site, take their duties seriously and monitor the loading and unloading. 
2.2 
大副应全面负责装货计划的实施，密切联系监装、装卸、理货、代理、货主等部门，
明确危险货物装载、铺垫及安全积载要求。 
The Chief Officer is fully responsible for the execution of loading plan, keep a close 
communication with supervisors, loading and unloading crew, tally personnel, agent and shipper. 
Clarify the requirements as to carriage of dangerous goods, dunnage and safety  stowage. 
2.3 
在装货现场备妥相应的消防器材，使其处于随时可用状态。  
Firefighting equipment should be well-prepared at the loading site, and ready to be used at any 
times. 
2.4 
在装载易燃、易爆、剧毒、腐蚀、放射等烈性危险货物时，当班驾驶员及值班水手
要检查把关，确保所有装卸机械应按额定负荷降低25％使用，在装载爆炸或烈性
易燃品时，禁止使用铁质等易产生火花的工具。 
When loading highly dangerous goods which is flammable, explosive, toxic, corrosive or 
radioactive, the on-duty deck officer and seaman should examine strictly to ensure a 25%  decrease 
in the load of all loading and unloading machinery. While handling explosive or  highly flammable 
goods, do not use iron tools which may spark. 
2.5 
在装载爆炸或烈性易燃品过程中，船长要通知各部门，不得检修和使用雷达、甚高
频，不得在甲板上进行能产生火花的检修工作和敲铲油漆，同时禁止船靠船加油、
加水作业。 
When loading explosive or highly flammable goods, the Master should inform all  departments. Do 
not perform maintenance, use radar and very high frequency (VHF). Maintenance, 
cutting, 
chipping, welding, painting or other sources of ignition shall not be permitted on the deck. Also, 
do not berth other ships for oil bunkering and water refilling. 
2.6 
在装载爆炸或烈性易燃品过程中，应禁止无关人员进入现场，在甲板上设立“严禁
烟火”警告牌。 
During the loading process of explosive or highly flammable goods, only concerned personnel are 
permitted to enter the site. Put up the warning sign “No Open Flames” on the  deck 
2.7 
装载危险品货物过程中，遇有闪电、雷击、雨雪天或附近发生火警时，当班驾驶员
应立即组织船员关舱、停止作业。 
In case of lightning, thunderstrike, rain, slow or fire at nearby area during the process of  loading 
dangerous goods, on-duty deck officer should organize the crew to close the cabin hold and stop 
operation. 
2.8 
在装载易燃、易爆危险品货物过程中，必须使用防爆安全照明设备，严禁使用其它
不安全的灯具。 
During the process of loading dangerous goods, explosive-proof safe lighting equipment  must 
be 
used. Do not use other lighting which is unsafe. 
2.9 
在装载危险货物时，按规定悬挂或显示号型、号灯。 
When the ship is carrying dangerous goods, hang or demonstrate signals and lights as  required. 
2.10 
当班人员要检查货物包装外表是否完好，标志是否清楚、正确，凡包装破损、潮湿、
渗漏、沾污的货物不准装船。 
On-duty personnel should inspect whether the packing surface is in good condition, whether the

sign is clear and accurate. Cargos with damage packing, high moisture, seepage and contaminated 
packaging are not allowed to be loaded. 
2.11 
当班驾驶员要认真做好“危险货物装卸情况记录”， 记录内容应包括：所装危险
货物的名称、特性、总件数或总重量、已装数量、装载进度、包装标志情况、装载
位置、铺垫隔衬情况、安全设备准备情况及大副布置的事项等。 
On-duty deck officer should complete the “Dangerous Goods Loading and Unloading  Conditions 
Record” seriously. The content should include: name of all dangerous goods,  characteristics, total 
quantity or weight, loaded quantity, loading speed, packing sign  conditions, 
stowage 
location, 
dunnage conditions, safety equipment preparation conditions,  arrangements of the Chief Officer 
and so on. 
2.12 
舶在装载过程中发生泄漏、落水或其他事故，船长应迅速报告港口主管部门和公司，
采取适当措施妥善处理，对撒漏货物、受污染的物品及甲板、舱室未彻底清理干净
之前不得续装。When leakage, falling into water or other accidents occur during the loading 
process, the Master should take appropriate measures to settle the problem, and report to the port’s 
management department and the company. Do not continue to load before cleaning the  seepage of 
cargo, contaminated items, deck and cabin hold. 
2.13 
物装船后，船长必须取得危险货物清单（舱单）及危险货物积载图。船长应及时地
将本船所载货物的名称、重量、件数、积载位置、国际编号、等报公司海务部。 
After cargo loading, the Master must obtain the dangerous cargo list (cargo list) and  stowage plan. 
The Master should report the name, weight, quantity, stowage location, international code of the 
cargo to the Marine Department. 
3 
航行中的管理 
Management during navigation 
3.1 
船长应根据所装货类的主要特性、海区水文、气象的具体条件和情况设计航线，制
定周密的航行计划措施并报公司海务部。 
The Master should decide the navigation route, develop a detailed navigation plan and measures 
according to the main characteristics of the cargo, hydrology of the sea area, weather factors and 
conditions. 
3.2 
根据危险货物技术说明书（DANGEROUS GOODS SPECIFICATIONS）中提供的有关货
物途中保管的程序和注意事项进行货物保管。 
Keep the goods according to the procedures and precautions of goods carriage laid out in the 
Dangerous Goods Specifications. 
3.3 
航行中大副要安排专人每天定时测量货舱、货物的温湿度及油水舱、货舱污水井并
记录。 
During navigation, the Chief Officer should assign personnel to perform regular measurement to the 
temperature and humidity of the cargo hold, cargo, and bilge well every day. Take record 
accordingly. 
3.4 
大风浪后，如进入货舱检查必须取得船长的批准，穿戴呼吸器及防护服，携带防爆
灯具，进入前进行充分的通风和测量有害气体含量。 
After heavy weather, obtain permission of the Master before entering the cargo hold for inspection. 
Wear respirator and protective clothing and carry an explosion-proof lamp. Before entering, make 
sure there is adequate ventilation and measure the concentration of toxic gas. 
3.5 
货舱底下的燃油舱如需加温，应先取得船长、大副的同意并且要注意油温控制在
50 度以下，或视货物的特性及积载情况相应地控制油温。 
If the fuel oil tank under the cargo hold has to warm up, permission from the Master and the Chief 
Officer must be obtained. Pay attention that the oil temperature should be controlled under 50

degrees, or other  appropriate temperature depends on the cargo characteristics and stowage 
conditions. 
4 
卸货时 
During cargo unloading 
4.1 
船舶在卸货前，船长、大副应向代理、装卸、理货等有关各方提供卸货单证，详细
交代货物的特性、积载位置、卸货注意事项等。 
Before unloading, the Master and the Chief Officer should provide landing order to the agent, 
departments related to loading, unloading and tally, in order to explain the goods’ characteristics, 
stowage location, precautions of unloading and so on. 
4.2 
大副应召开卸货前会议，针对所运货物的特性及卸港情况向有关人员明确交代卸货
要求和注意事项，并监督落实各项安全措施。 
The Chief Officer should hold a pre-unloading meeting, to explain the requirements and precautions 
of preloading with reference to the cargo characteristics and conditions of port of discharge to the 
concerned personnel. Supervise and execute all safety measures. 
4.3 
在卸货现场备妥相应的消防器材，使其处于随时可用状态。 
Prepare the relevant firefighting equipment at the unloading site, it should be ready to use at any 
times. 
4.4 
在卸载危险货物时，按规定悬挂或显示号型、号灯。 
When unloading dangerous goods, hang or demonstrate signals and lights as required. 
4.5 
在卸载易燃、易爆、剧毒、腐蚀、放射等烈性危险货物时，当班驾驶员及值班水手
要检查把关，确保所有装卸机械应按额定负荷降低25％使用，在装有爆炸或烈性
易燃品时，禁止使用铁质等易产生火花的工具。 
When unloading highly dangerous goods which is flammable, explosive, toxic, corrosive or 
radioactive,  the on-duty deck officer and seaman should examine strictly to ensure a 25% decrease 
in the load of all loading and unloading machinery. While handling explosive or highly flammable 
goods, do not use iron tools which may spark. 
4.6 
在卸载爆炸或烈性易燃品过程中，船长要通知各部门，不得检修和使用雷达、甚高
频，不得在甲板上进行能产生火花的检修工作和敲铲油漆，同时禁止船靠船加油、
加水作业。 
When unloading explosive or highly flammable goods, the Master should inform all departments. 
Do not  perform maintenance, use radar and very high frequency (VHF). Maintenance, cutting, 
chipping, welding, painting or other sources of ignition shall not be permitted on the deck. Also, 
do not berth other ships for oil bunkering and water refilling. 
4.7 
在卸载爆炸或烈性易燃品过程中，应禁止无关人员进入现场。在甲板上设立“严禁
烟火”警告牌。 
During the unloading process of explosive or highly flammable goods, only concerned personnel 
are permitted to enter the site. Put up the warning sign “No Open Flames” on the deck.  
4.8 
在卸载危险品货物过程中，遇有闪电、雷击、雨雪天或附近发生火警时，当班驾驶
员应立即组织船员关舱、停止作业。 
In case of lightning, thunderstrike, rain, slow or fire at nearby area during the process of unloading 
dangerous goods, on-duty deck officer should organize the crew to close the cabin hold and stop 
operation. 
4.9 
在卸载易燃、易爆危险品货物过程中，必须使用防爆安全照明设备，严禁使用其它
不安全的灯具。 
During the process of unloading dangerous goods, explosive-proof safe lighting equipment must be 
used. Do not use other lighting which is unsafe.

4.10 
当班驾驶员要认真做好“危险货物卸货情况记录”，记录内容应包括：应卸危险货
物的名称、特性、总件数或总重量、已卸数量、卸货进度、安全设备准备情况及大
副布置的事项等。 
On-duty deck officer should complete the “Dangerous Goods Loading and Unloading Conditions 
Record” seriously. The content should include: name of all dangerous goods, characteristics, total 
quantity or weight, loaded quantity, loading speed, packing sign conditions, stowage location, 
dunnage conditions, safety equipment preparation conditions, arrangements of the Chief Officer 
and so on. 
4.11 
在卸载包装破损的危险货时，应采取妥善的预防措施， 如发生泄漏、落水或其他
事故，船长应迅速报告港口主管部门和公司船管部，采取适当措施妥善处理，对撒
漏货物、受污染的物品及甲板、舱室未彻底清理干净之前不得继续作业。 
When leakage, falling into water or other accidents occur during the loading process, the Master 
should take appropriate measures to settle the problem, and report to the port’s management 
department and the Fleet Department. Do not continue to load before cleaning the seepage of cargo, 
contaminated items, deck and cabin hold. 
4.12 
卸货后，要进行彻底的清舱，残货、垫舱物料及洗舱水不能任意排放，应按规定处
理。 
After unloading, perform a complete hold cleaning. Residues of the previous cargo, dunnage and 
tank washing water must be discharged according to the regulations. 
4.13 
航次任务完成后，船长要保存好货运单证以便日后查询。 
After complete the voyage, the Master should keep the receipts for reference.  
5 
风险评估 
Risk Assessment 
5.1 
为确保安全，船长应督促大副对危险货物运输的任何潜在危险做出初步评估，向作
业人员讲解安全注意事项。 
To guarantee safety, the Master should supervise the Chief Officer to undergo an initial assessment 
to any possible danger caused by the dangerous goods and explain the safety precautions to the 
operation personnel. 
5.2 
在进行风险评估时，应考虑到下列风险： 
The following risks should be taken into consideration during risk assessment: 
5.2.1 
上述“危险货物运输注意事项” 与“危险货物装前检查表”中列明的相关风险；
All relevant risks listed in the above “Carriage of Dangerous Goods Precautions” and “Dangerous 
Goods Pre-loading Checklist”. 
5.2.2 
一旦作业过程中有紧急情况发生，救助器材和施救方案的及时性和有效性； 
When emergency conditions occur during operation process, the promptness and effectiveness of 
lifesaving equipment and the lifesaving plan; 
5.2.3 
操作过程中其他可合理预见到的风险； 
Other possible foreseeable risks in the operation process; 
5.2.4 
操作现场的特殊情况，例如天气、海况、照明、时间限制、空间限制、周边可能存
在的其他危险和限制条件等；

定义、总体要求  
Definitions and General Requirements

定义与分类  
Definitions and Classification 
1） 锂电池、钠离子电池新能源车辆包括纯电动汽车（BEV）和混合电动汽车

3556，钠离子电池车为UN 3558。 
Lithium and sodium-ion battery new energy vehicles include Battery Electric Vehicles 
(BEV) and Hybrid Electric Vehicles (HEV), with HEV posing higher risks. According to 
the IMDG Code, lithium battery vehicles are classified as UN 3556, 
sodium-ion 
battery

2） 其他类型电卡车分类和编号可参《国际海运危险货物规则》第2.9 章规定。
For classification and numbering of other types of electric trucks, refer to Chapter  2.9 
of 
the International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code. 
3） 新能源车辆与燃油车辆相比，主要风险在于存在较大的火灾风险。 
Compared to fuel-powered vehicles, the primary risk of new energy  vehicles lies in their 
significantly higher fire hazard.

Pre-loading Preparation

明确火灾、泄漏等场景的处置流程； 
Complete a special risk assessment before loading (refer to Section 4.06 in the Risk 
Assessment Manual), formulate a voyage emergency plan, and clarify the disposal 
procedures for scenarios such as fire and leakage; 
2） 要求货方提供车辆 MSDS（材料安全技术说明书）、电池合格证明、SOC 检
测报告，船长核对并留存；SOC 建议控制在30%～50%之间； 
Require the shipper to provide the vehicle's MSDS (Material Safety Data Sheet), battery

新能源车应装载于主甲板区域，远离热源、电缆、生活区、应急设备和应急集合站；

10

special

fire/explosion. The only way to cool the battery is to supply a large amount of water

第06 节 大件货物装卸作业的安全规定 
Section 06 Awkward Cargo Loading and Discharging Safety Regulation 
 
1.0 船长要高度重视装卸大件货物和使用船舶装卸设备的作业。 
The Master should attach great importance to the operation of awkward cargo loading and discharging 
and usage of cargo loading and discharging equipment. 
2.0 严格遵守“起重作业的安全规定”和“起落吊杆安全操作规定”。 
Strictly follow the “Jack-up Operation Safety Regulation” and “Lifting Derrick Operation Safety 
Regulation” . 
3.0 船长要亲自带领大副到现场勘察，事先做出安全防护措施和作业方案。 
The Master should take the Chief Officer to the site for inspection in person, in order to establish safety 
protection measures and operation plans. 
4.0 船长要及时督导大副对装卸设备进行严格的检查，保证设备性能良好。 
The Master should supervise the Chief Officer to perform strict inspection to the cargo loading and 
discharging equipment, in order to ensure the equipment are in good condition. 
5.0 使用船舶装卸设备装卸大件货物时，要由水手长或委派有经验的熟练人员操车，由大
副亲自指挥。电动起货机由电机员到现场协助；液压起货机由三管轮到现场协助。 
When the ship is loading and discharging awkward cargo by the concerned equipment, assign the 
boatswain or personnel with rich experience to operate the equipment, and the Chief Officer should 
conduct in person. Electrician is responsible to assist on site for the electric cargo winch, whereas the 
fourth engineer is responsible to assist on site for the hydraulic cargo winch. 
6.0 起吊大件前应先慢速度试吊，对刹车、应急停止进行效用检查，确认工作可靠后才能
吊运。 
When lifting the awkward cargo, perform testing by a slow speed, inspect the effectiveness of the brakes 
and emergency stoppage. Perform lifting only after the operation is confirmed to be reliable. 
7.0 在超大件货物装卸前大副应计算出其影响的船横倾角，并采取调整压载的办法，减小
其影响。货物起吊过程中要注意船舶横倾情况，货物起吊时船横倾角不应大于8 度，
并注意观察船的稳定状态。 
Before the loading and discharging of very awkward cargo, the Chief Officer should calculate its impact 
to the angle of heel, and adjust the ballast to lower its impact. Pay attention to the angle of heel during 
cargo lifting. The angle of heel should not exceed 8 degrees during cargo lifting. Pay attention and 
observe the stability of the ship. 
8.0 大件货物超高超长，起吊时必须利用稳绳协助。 
If the awkward cargo is too high and too long, a rope must be used to support the lifting. 
9.0 装卸大件货物时船体会发生倾斜，为防止舱内货物倒塌、舱口大梁和舱盖滑动，应事
先采取措施加以绑扎固定。 
When loading and discharging awkward cargo, the ship hull will start to heel. To prevent the cargo to 
collapse in the hold, and avoid the beam and hatch cover to slide, take measures to lash and secure them 
in advance. 
10.0 起吊大件时，要核准货物重量，严禁超负荷。认真核对吊货索具、钩头的安全工作负
荷。 
When lifting awkward cargo, verify the weight of the cargo. Overloading is prohibited. Verify the safety 
work load of the cargo rigging and hook seriously. 
11.0 由于各船重吊性能不同，操作方法各异，要严格按照各吊机的安全技术操作规程作业。 
Since the function of the heavy crane of different ships are different, the operation method is different as 
well. Strictly follow the technical operation safety procedures for each crane.

第07 节 货物及设备绑扎作业安全规定 
Section 07 Regulations on lashing safety of cargo and equipment 
1.0 职责 
Duties 
1.1 船长负责《系固手册》的保管，对货物和设备的绑扎进行监督。 
Master shall keep the “Cargo Securing Manual”, and supervise the lashing of the cargo and equipment. 
1.2 大副根据《系固手册》的要求，负责货物和设备的绑扎及开航前的工作检查。 
The Chief Officer is responsible for inspection on the lashing of cargo and equipment as well as 
preparations before sailing, according to requirements in“Cargo Securing Manual”. 
2.0 绑扎要求 
Lashing requirements 
船舶应尽可能按《系固手册》提供的方法进行绑扎，在不能采用其方法时，应采用等
效的绑扎措施并确保这样的措施是安全的。 
Ship shall conduct lashing with the methods provided in the “Cargo Securing Manual”，when such 
methods are not applicable, equally effective lashing shall be carried out and confirmed to be safe. 
3.0 控制方法 
Control method 
3.1 大副应熟悉系固手册的内容。 
The Chief Officer must be familiar with the content of the “Cargo Securing Manual”. 
3.2 大副应就绑扎计划向船长请示，并得到船长的同意。 
The Chief Officer shall report to the Master of the lashing plan and obtain permission from the Master. 
3.3 大副应亲自主持绑扎工作。 
The Chief Officer shall take charge of lashing in person.  
3.4 开航前，船长和大副应亲自或派专人检查货件及甲板设备的绑扎加固情况，符合要求
后方能开航。 
Before sailing, Master and Chief Officer should, in person or dispatch designated personnel, to inspect the 
lashing and securing of cargo and equipment on deck; sail only when requirements are met. 
3.5 海上航行时，大副应指派水手长经常检查货物的绑扎加固情况，若有松动则立即加固，
大副应将上述情况记入 “航海日志”。 
During voyage at sea, Chief Officer shall ask the boatswain to frequently check the lashing and securing 
condition of cargo; secure immediately if loosened, and Chief Officer shall record the situation into the 
“Deck Log Book”. 
3.6 大风浪来袭前，应特别注意并按《大风浪航行注意事项》中的要求进行检查和加固。 
Before heavy stormy waves, lashing and securing shall be carried out according to the requirements in the 
“Precautions of Heavy Weather Navigation”. 
3.7 大副保存相关记录。 
Chief Officer shall keep relevant record. 
4.0 相关文件： 
Relevant documents:

第08 节 货舱的隔票与忌装货 
Section 08 Bill separation of the cargo holds and the incompatible cargoes  
 
1.0 货舱的隔票 
Bill separation of cargo holds 
1.1 当在一种货物上加载另一种货物时，下层货物应尽量整平, 隔票材料具有足够强度。 
While one type of cargo is loaded on top of the other type of cargo, the bottom cargo shall be trimmed as flat 
as possible, and the separation material shall bear enough strength.  
1.2 在装货过程中，必须测量隔票物到主甲板舱口围或甲板的距离并做好记录,在卸货时可能
有效地确定隔票物的位置，防止在卸货过程中隔票被撕毁和损坏。 
During loading, the distance from bill separation material to the main deck hatch coaming or to the deck must 
be measured and recorded, which helps with effectively locating the separation material during discharging 
and prevent them being torn or damaged. 
1.3 为保证货物表面相对平坦，在配载时，将休止角度高的货物（粮食、油料及其产品）积载
在休止角低的货物（藕草或亚麻籽）下面。 
In order to guarantee the rather flatness of the cargo surface, the cargo with larger angle of repose (grains, oil 
and relevant oil products) shall be stowed below the cargo with smaller angle of repose (lotus grass or linseed) 
during loading. 
1.4 两票货物的隔票位置，尽可能安排在上下边柜之间垂直舱壁部分，避免航行期间货物下沉
后产生混票。 
The location of separation of two bills of cargo shall be arranged, at one’s best, at areas of vertical bulkhead 
between the upper and lower sideboards, in order to avoid bills getting mixed due to the sink of cargo during 
voyage.
