第09 节 船舶清洁货舱的规定 
Section 09  Regulations for Cleaning Cargo Holds 
 
1.0 目的 
Objective 
按照MARPOL 公约的规定、港方和区域性环保规定，正确处理船舶残余货物，排放
货舱洗舱水（包括冲洗甲板水），防止海洋污染。船舶应按照公司《船舶垃圾管理计划》
中的规定进行处理并记录，做好相关环保和防污染工作。 
In accordance with the provisions of the MARPOL Convention, port provisions and regional 
environmental regulations, the ship shall properly dispose the residual cargo and discharge cargo hold 
washing water (including deck flushing water) to prevent marine pollution. Ships shall dispose and 
record in accordance with the provisions of the Company's Ship Garbage Management Plan, and do a 
good job for relevant environmental protection and pollution prevention. 
2.0 适用范围 
Scope of Application 
公司管理的所有船舶 
All ships managed by company. 
3.0 职责 
Responsibility 
海务部、船管部负责监督船队实施本规定。 
Marine Department and Fleet Department are responsible for supervising the implementation of these 
provisions in the fleet. 
船长负责领导及监督本规定的执行。 
The master is responsible for leading and supervising the implementation of these provisions. 
大副负责统一指挥、部署和执行本规定。 
The C/O is responsible for unified command, deployment and implementation of these provisions. 
轮机长负责技术和设备支持。 
The C/E is responsible for technical and equipment support. 
4.0 货舱的清洁标准 
Cleaning standards of the cargo hold 
4.1 所有舱盖、舱口围、舱盖轨道、舱壁、横梁、肋骨结构上和其他舱内隐蔽处没有浮锈、
锈片、翘起的漆皮、污迹和以往货物残渣； 
No floating rust, rusty flakes, paint-shedding, splodges and cargo residues can be found on hatch covers, 
hatch coamings, hatch rails, bulk heads, beams, rib structures and other places in the cargo hold. 
4.2 污水井、槽必须清洁、干燥、畅通、无异味； 
Bilge wells and slots must be clean, dry, clear and free from extraneous odour. 
4.3 舱盖、人孔应水密，货舱通风筒应开关活络，挡板、防水装置应完好； 
Hatch covers, manholes shall be kept watertight. Cargo hold ventilator shall be movable; flaps, 
waterproofing devices shall be intact. 
4.4 下舱的梯子应清洁、安全、处于完好状态。 
Hold ladders shall be clean, safe and intact. 
5.0 备舱工作的安排 
Arrangement for Pre-loading Work 
5.1 船长在整个清舱工作中负有统一领导和监督的责任，直接对公司负责。 
The master is responsible for unified command and supervision throughout the cleaning work and is 
directly responsible to the company. 

683

货运操作                            版本/修改：3.0/2.0                  SHIP-07-09 
Shipping Operation                           Version/Rev.: 3.0/2.0                   SHIP-07-09 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2024/06/05              第2/5页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd       Effective Date: 2024/06/05                  Page: 2/5 
5.2 船长应按航次命令的要求会同轮机长及大副制定周密可行的清洗舱计划，对重点货舱、
重点部位、重点问题要做到心中有数，责任到人。轮机长要密切配合清舱工作, 轮机
部要确保扫洗舱设备的完好运转及相关管系的畅通。 
The master shall, in accordance with the voyage order, formulate a thorough and feasible cleaning plan 
with the C/E and C/O. The key cargo holds, key positions and key issues shall be well-known with clear 
responsibility arrangement. The C/E shall work closely with the clean-up work and engine department 
should ensure smooth operation of the cleaning equipment and the related piping system. 
5.3 如果货舱状况存在严重问题而船员无法解决，船长要及早向公司船管部报告以寻求支
持。 
If serious problems in cargo hold conditions are found and cannot be solved by crew, the master shall 
report to Fleet Department of the company as soon as possible for support. 
5.4 大副对清舱工作进行统一指挥和部署，按照船长的要求，制定具体清舱工作计划。 
The C/O is responsible for unified command and deployment of the cleaning work. Clear cleaning 
arrangement shall be made as per the master’s requirement. 
5.5 为减轻清舱工作难度，在港口规定及安全条件允许的前提下，大副要在卸货过程中组
织人员对残留在货舱上部舱壁、横梁、肋骨结构上的货物进行清理。卸货完毕时应要
求港方把舱底残余货物彻底卸净。 
In order to reduce the difficulty of cleaning, under the prerequisite of the port regulation and safety 
conditions, the C/O shall organize personnel to clean the cargoes remaining on the bulkheads, beams and 
ribs of the cargo hold during discharging. After cargo discharging, the Port Company should be required 
to completely discharge the cargo residues. 
5.6 甲板、轮机两部的部门领导应调整好本部门的工作。船长要监督清舱的情况。 
Officers of both Deck Department and Engine Department shall  
coordinate their own work. the 
master is responsible for supervision. 
6.0 具体工作的分工： 
Specific Arrangement 
6.1 大副根据清舱工作的实际情况，将参加清舱的人员统一编组，统一调配。 
Unified grouping and arrangement shall be made by the C/O as per the actual condition of the cleaning 
work. 
6.2 在大副的直接指挥下，电机员负责洗舱使用的潜水泵、小吊杆等相关设备的电路连接、
供电操作；三管轮负责气动小吊杆的检修以及供应洗舱用水、抽排洗舱污水的操作。 
Under the direct command of the C/O, the E/E is responsible for the circuit connection and power supply 
operation of submersible pumps and light derricks used in cleaning. The 4/E is responsible for the 
maintenance of pneumatic light derricks and the supply of washing water and drainage water pumping 
operation. 
6.3 当清舱任务时间紧、工作量大时，船长要统一安排，全力以赴地做好清舱工作，确保
及时备好货舱。 
When time is pressed with heavy workload, unified command shall be made by the master to ensure the 
timely preparation of the cargo holds. 
6.4 清舱完毕后，大副和水手长必须下到每一货舱内亲自进行检查，发现问题及时纠正，
确保货舱整体达标。船长应督促并支持大副的货舱验收工作。 
After the cleaning work, C/O and Bosun must go to every cargo hold for inspection in person, and correct 
all problems to ensure all cargo holds meet the requirements. the master shall supervise, urge and support 
the checking work of the C/O. 
6.5 在货舱交验前，大副和水手长要再一次下到各货舱仔细检查货舱及污水井状况，发现
问题及时纠正。 

684

货运操作                            版本/修改：3.0/2.0                  SHIP-07-09 
Shipping Operation                           Version/Rev.: 3.0/2.0                   SHIP-07-09 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2024/06/05              第3/5页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd       Effective Date: 2024/06/05                  Page: 3/5 
Prior to hold inspection, the C/O and Bosun must again go to every cargo hold and bilge well for 
inspection, and correct all the problems. 
6.6 验舱过程中，船长、大副要妥善接待、全程陪同验舱人员。如果货舱有问题，应立即
组织船员清理、纠正，力争现场解决或在其下船前解决。 
During the process of hold inspection, the master and the C/O must properly treat and accompany the 
inspection personnel. If any problems are found, the crew should be immediately organized to clean up 
and rectify the problem and try to resolve it on site or before the hold surveyor disembarkation. 
7.0 残余货物处理（包括冲洗甲板、货舱）措施 
Disposal Measures of Cargo Residues (including deck, cargo hold washing) 
7.1  船舶普通残余货物按MARPOL 附录V 规定的货物残留物类垃圾处理。 
Ordinary residues shall be disposed in accordance with the provisions of Appendix V of the MARPOL 
Convention. 
7.2 为减少残货数量，值班船员应督促卸货工人尽量卸清舱内的货物。 
In order to reduce the amount of residues, the OOW shall supervise and urge the stevedores to discharge 
the cargo as much as possible. 
7.3 船长应提前查询主管机关的规定和有关法律法规的要求，制定残余货物的处理方案，
确保不违反有关国际公约和地方港口规定。 
The master shall check the provisions of competent authorities and relevant laws and regulations in 
advance to formulate the disposal plan of the residues, and make sure the plan does not violate relevant 
international conventions and local port regulations. 
7.4 
4
根据货物性质严格按MARPOL 附录V 的规定，以适当的方式处理残余货物。必要时
可采取将其卸岸或申请驳船接收或暂放甲板上的适当位置保存，直到船舶抵达允许处
理的海域时再按规定进行处理。 
All cargo residues shall be disposed in an appropriate way according to the nature of the cargo and in 
strict accordance with the provisions of Appendix V of the MARPOL Convention. If necessary, they can 
be taken off-shore or apply for barge reception or temporary storage on deck at proper position until the 
ship arrives at the sea area where it is allowed, then dispose according to the provisions. 
7.5 若残余货物属于不得抛弃入海的有害物质或其中混有不得抛弃入海的有害物质，不得
抛弃入海。公海航行途中处理残余货物，冲洗货舱或甲板，只能在允许的海域进行，
且离岸不得少于12 海浬。 
If the residues belong to the harmful substances that can not be dumped into the sea or are mixed with 
harmful substances that can not be dumped into the sea, they may not be discharged into the sea. 
Disposals of residual cargo on the high seas voyage, flushing cargo holds or decks may only be carried 
out in permitted sea areas with a minimum of 12 sea miles offshore. 
7.6 开始及结束冲洗货舱或甲板的时间、船位、所抛弃残余货物的名称和大约数量,应记录
在《垃圾记录簿》相应的栏目内。 
The start and end time, ship position of hold or deck washing, name and approximate quantity of residues 
shall be recorded in Garbage Record Book. 
8.0 排放货舱洗舱水（包括冲甲板水）须知 
Instructions of Discharging Cargo Hold Washing Water (Including deck washing water) 
8.1 正常排水 
Normal discharging 
8.1.1 扫舱时，应把舱内残留货物清扫干净，吊出货舱妥善处理，并检查污水井，确认正常
后，方可进行冲洗作业，避免残余货物沉积在污水井和污水管道内，造成系统堵塞。
冲洗完毕，应再次收集货舱里的残余货物，并吊出货舱妥善处理。严禁采用将残余货
物冲进污水井，利用污水泵或喷射泵抽吸带走的违规做法。 

685

04_19_18.text:
货运操作                            版本/修改：3.0/2.0                  SHIP-07-09 
Shipping Operation                           Version/Rev.: 3.0/2.0                   SHIP-07-09 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2024/06/05              第4/5页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd       Effective Date: 2024/06/05                  Page: 4/5 
When hold cleaning, the residual cargo i shall be cleaned out of the cargo hold and be properly handled, 
and the bilge wells shall be checked to confirm normal before washing operations can be carried out to 
avoid the residual cargo deposit in the bilge wells or bilge pipes which may result in the blocking of the 
system. After washing, the residuals in the cargo hold shall be collected out of the cargo hold again for 
proper disposal. Illegal operations of pumping with bilge pump or injection pump after flushing the 
residuals into the bilge wells are prohibited. 
8.1.2 相关轮机员应留意污水泵或喷射泵的工作状况，根据大副指示和木匠提供的具体情
况，正确操作污水泵或喷射泵，并及时进行货舱转换。 
Relevant engineers should pay attention to the working condition of the bilge pump or injection pump, 
properly operate the bilge pump or injection pump and timely convert the cargo hold as per the 
instructions given by the C/O and the specific conditions provided by the carpenter. 
8.1.3 如货物具有腐蚀性，在彻底排空货舱污水后，进一步用海水冲洗货舱及污水井，同时
开启污水泵，以充分洗刷管系、阀门及污水泵，避免货舱污水系统腐蚀受损。如货物
对人员具有伤害性，应做好必要的防护措施。 
If the cargo is corrosive, after completely emptying the cargo hold, further flush the cargo hold and bilge 
well with seawater and turn on the bilge pump so as to fully clean the piping system, valves and bilge 
pumps and avoid corrosion damage to the cargo hold bilge system. If the cargo is harmful to person, 
necessary protective measures shall be made. 
8.1.4 货舱彻底洗净后，大副或其指定人员应监督船员检查和清洁污水井，并装妥货舱污水
井的过滤网。 
After complete cleaning of the cargo hold, the C/O or other designated persons shall supervise the crew 
to clean and check the bilge wells, and well install the filter screen of the bilge well. 
8.1.5 货舱污水系统出现故障时，相关轮机员应尽快查明原因并排除故障，必要时报告轮机
长；木匠向相关轮机员问明情况后，应将故障情况及时报告大副；大副要与轮机长保
持联系，必要时安排人员配合轮机部进行修理工作，必要时采取应急排水措施，避免
影响船期和装货计划。 
When the cargo hold bilge system fails, relevant engineers shall identify the cause as soon as possible 
and take measures, if necessary, report to the chief engineer; after asking relevant engineers and 
understand the situation, carpenter shall report the failure condition to the C/O; the C/O shall maintain 
contact with the chief engineer and, when necessary, arrange personnel to work with the engine 
department for repairs and take emergency draining measures to prevent the schedule and loading plan 
from being affected. 
8.2 应急排水措施 
Emergency drainage measures 
8.2.1 要注意正确使用船上配备的便携式潜水泵。在安放潜水泵时，切记用绳索来拉动潜水
泵，严禁直接用电源线来拖拉潜水泵。 
Care should be taken to properly use the portable submersible pump equipped on board. When placing 
the submersible pump, remember to use the rope but not the power cord to pull the submersible pump 
8.2.2 若无潜水泵，可打开双层底压载舱的人孔盖，使货舱污水自行流入，再利用机舱的压
载水泵把污水排出。 
If there is no submersible pump, manholes of the double bottom ballast tank shall be opened firstly and 
allow the inflow of the bilge, then discharge the bilge by the ballast pump of the engine room. 
9.0 货舱污水井清理的规定 
Provisions of the Cleaning of Bilge Wells 
为规范操作，防止航次结束污水井没有及时清理，导致污水井淤积严重排水困难。不
论船舶是否更换货种或是否需要冲洗货舱，每航次结束后必须将污水井内的残货彻底

清理干净，保证排水畅通。 
To regulate the operation and prevent the untimely cleaning at the end of voyage which may result in 
blocking of bilge wells and serious drainage difficulties, whether the ship is to change the type of cargo or 
whether it is necessary to wash the cargo hold, the residual cargo inside the bilge well must be thoroughly 
cleaned after each voyage to ensure the drainage is unobstructed. 
10.0 货舱污水排水系统的检查 
Inspection of bilge water drainage system 
每航次，大副和三管轮应检查货舱污水井排水系统，包括排水管路、操作阀、止回阀
的工况；每次厂修，择机安排污水排水井止回阀的拆检工程。 
The Chief Officer and Fourth Engineer shall inspect the bilge water drainage system every voyage, 
including the condition of drainage piles, operation vales, check valves, etc. Every time shipyard repairs, 
the overhaul of the bilge check vales should be arranged at the appropriate time.

第10 节 易流态化货物或动态分离货物（A 类货物）的特性及操作须知 
Section 10  Characteristics and Operating Instructions for Easily Fluidizable Cargo or 
Dynamically Separating Cargo (Class A Cargo) 
 
1 
本节适用于装运IMSBC CODE 中A 组的货物。针对VLOC 矿砂船，请见船级社
代表船旗国颁发的“适于装运易液化散装铁矿粉的专用船”声明证书。 
This section applies to the carriage of Group A cargoes specified in the IMSBC Code. For VLOCs 
engaged in ore transportation, refer to the Certificate of Special Vessel Suitable for Carrying 
Liquefiable Bulk Iron Ore Powder issued by the classification society on behalf of the flag State. 
2 
A 类货物的特性：Characteristics of Class A Goods: 
2.1 
易发生液化 / 动态分离 may liquefy or dynamic separation 
货物装船时看似处于相对干燥的粒状状态，但可能含有足够水分，在航行过程中
受压实和振动影响，变为流体或不稳定状态。The cargo may appear to be in a relatively dry 
granular state when loaded onto the vessel, but may contain sufficient moisture to become fluid or 
unstable during transit due to compaction and vibration. 
 
2.2 
易引发货物大幅移位，导致船舶倾覆It is easy to cause a cargo to shift sufficiently to 
capsize the vessel. 
货物移位分为滑动失稳和液化后果两类，严重时可造成船舶倾覆。Cargo shift can be 
divided into sliding failure or liquefaction consequence，which can cause the ship to capsize in 
severe cases. 
2.3 
部分 A 类货物存在自热危险Some group A cargoes may also heat spontaneously. 
除液化、移位风险外，部分货物还会发生自热，带来额外安全隐患。 
Besides the risks of liquefaction and shifting, some goods may also generate 
spontaneous heat, posing additional safety hazards. 
3 
A 类固体散货主要有：精矿粉、镍矿、氟石粉、煤泥等。 
The main types of Group A solid bulk cargoes are: mineral concentrates, nickel minerals, fluorspar 
power, and coal slime, etc. 
4 
操作须知Operational Instruction 
4.1 
基本定义Basic definition 
4.1.1 
流动水分点FMP（Flow Moisture Point）：系指使物质的代表性样品在规定的试验过
程中产生流态的含水百分比(按湿重计)； 
FMP (Flow Moisture Point): means the percentage moisture content (wet mass basis) at which a 
flow state develops under the prescribed method of test in a representative sample of the material; 
4.1.2 
适运水分限TML：是指易流态化固体散装货物安全运输最大含水率，通常按其流
动水分点的80-90％确定。 
Transportable Moisture Limit (TML) of a cargo which may liquefy means the maximum moisture 
content of the cargo which is considered safe for carriage in ships, and is calculated as 80-90％ 
of its flow moisture point. 
4.1.3 
含水率MC(Moisture Content)。 
水分含量指代表性样品中由水、冰或其他液体组成的部分，以该样品总湿质量的
百分比表示。 
Moisture content means that portion of a representative sample consisting of water, ice or other 
liquid expressed as a percentage of the total wet mass of that sample. 
4.2 
货物文件的核实 Verification of cargo documents 

688

货运操作                       版本/修改：3.0/2.0                      SHIP-07-10 
Shipping Operation                     Version/Rev.: 3.0/2.0                      SHIP-07-10 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2026/06/26          第2/13页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2026/06/26            Page: 2/13 
4.2.1 
装载前托运人应向船舶提供货物适运水份限和含水率证书（或检测报告）以及货
物其他与安全运输有关的重要信息，以便船舶能够采取必要的措施对货物进行妥
善积载和安全运输。如船舶未收到上述货物信息及相关文件、证书，应拒绝装运。 
Before loading, the shipper shall provide the ship with the certificate (or test report) of the 
Transportable Moisture Limit and moisture content of the cargo, as well as other important 
information relating to the safe transportation of the goods, so that the ship may take necessary 
measures to carry out the stowage and safe transportation of the goods. If the ship has not received 
the above-mentioned cargo information and relevant documents and certificates, the shipment shall 
be refused. 
4.2.2 
船长应核实托运人提供的货物单证和信息是否符合IMSBC CODE 第4 节的要求。
如果根据货物证书及信息确认货物含水率超过适运水分限，应拒绝装运。针对公
司建造的VLOC 矿砂船，根据船级社代表船旗国颁发的“适于装运易液化散装铁矿
粉的专用船”声明证书，货物含水率超过适运水分限制的散装铁矿粉也可以装运。 
The Master shall verify whether the cargo documents and information provided by the shipper 
comply with the requirements of Section 4 of IMSBC CODE. Shipment shall be refused if the 
moisture content of the goods is confirmed to be above the Transportable Moisture Limit according 
to the cargo certificate and information. For the VLOC ore carriers built by the company, 
bulk iron ore fines with a moisture content exceeding the transportable moisture limit 
can also be carried in accordance with the Certificate of Declaration for "Special Ships 
Suitable for Carrying Liquefiable Bulk Iron Ore Fines" issued by the classification 
society on behalf of the flag State. 
4.2.3 
适运水分限检测报告有效期6 个月，货物含水率检测报告有效期7 天。应注意，
即使货物含水率检测报告在有效期内，如果7 天的期间内曾有大雨天气，船长应
要求再次检测货物含水率。 
The transportable moisture limit test report is valid for 6 months, and the goods moisture content 
test report is valid for 7 days. It should be noted that, even if the moisture content report of the 
goods is within the validity period, if there has been heavy rain during the 7-day period, the master 
should request to test the moisture content of the goods again. 
4.2.4 
当货物含水率证明由托运人实验室提供，或显示的货物含水率非常接近适运水分
限时，船长应谨慎对待，在未确定货物安全适运之前，不能装运。 
When the moisture content of the goods is proved to be supplied by the shipper's laboratory, or if 
the moisture content of the goods is very close to the transportable moisture limit, the master shall 
take care not to ship until the safety and suitability of the goods are determined. 
4.3 
装船前准备Pre-loading preparation 
4.3.1 
船长应组织全体船员认真学习IMSBC CODE 对相关货物的要求，并进行相关操作
培训应急演习。船长和驾驶员要了解和掌握利用船上条件对货物含水率进行简易
测试的方法（参见附录）。The master shall organize the crew to study the IMSBC CODE's 
requirements on the cargo and conduct relevant operational training emergency drills. The Master 
and officer should know and master the method of simple testing of moisture content of cargo by 
means of on-board conditions (see Appendix). 
4.3.2 
装货前应检查货舱水密情况，保证货舱开关舱泵系和紧固设备功用正常；检查货
舱、压载舱压排水情况，保证压排管系畅通无阻，泵浦正常有效；配妥数量足够、
随时可用的潜水泵、滤器等移动排水设备。 
Before loading, the cargo hold watertight should be checked to ensure that the cargo hold switch 
hatch cover pump system and securing equipment function properly; Check the ballast and 
deballast of cargo hold and ballast tank to ensure the unimpeded flow of the ballast and deballast

04_19_19.text:
货运操作                       版本/修改：3.0/2.0                      SHIP-07-10 
Shipping Operation                     Version/Rev.: 3.0/2.0                      SHIP-07-10 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2026/06/26          第3/13页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd        Effective Date: 2026/06/26            Page: 3/13 
pipes and the pumping is normal and effective. Appropriate number of submersible pumps, filters 
and other mobile drainage equipment are available at any time. 
4.3.3 
确保货舱污水井畅通、污水排水系统工况良好。污水井盖要用麻布片封好，周围
用胶布贴好，在装货前要测试污水排水系统。使用麻布片时，应采取必要措施，
防止因密闭导致渗水性变差；对污水井的排污系统要有替代泵浦可用，船员能熟
练使用。 
Ensure that the sewage well of cargo hold is unobstructed and the sewage drainage system is in 
good working condition. Sewage well covers shall be sealed with linen sheet, surrounded with 
rubber cloth, and sewerage drainage system shall be tested before loading. When using linen sheets, 
necessary measures should be taken to prevent deterioration of water permeability due to 
airtightness; the sewerage system of the sewerage wells should be provided with alternative pumps 
available and the crew can use them proficiently. 
4.3.4 
船舶备妥称重器具、量杯、容器（货样袋、塑料桶或编织袋等）、铁锹、铁铲、
圆罐、标签、马克笔和照相机等器材，以便必要时对货物进行取样、测试。 
The ship is equipped with weighing instruments, measuring cups, containers (sample bags, plastic 
or woven bags, etc.), spades, shovels, round cans, labels, markers and cameras, etc., so as to 
sample and test the goods if necessary. 
4.3.5 
开始装货前，应对将装船的货物进行外观检查，对看上去受到沾染或者性质或水
分含量与大部分散货明显不同的部分应予分别采样和分析。通过测试，如对托运
人提供的检验数值有疑虑，应拒收货物并要求托运人对适运水分极限和水分含量
进行再次检验或者核对检测，如果还是对再次检验的数值有疑虑，可委托独立的
实验室对货物含水率重新检测。Before loading, the goods to be shipped shall be subject to 
visual inspection, and the parts which appear to be contaminated or whose nature or moisture 
content is obviously different from most bulk goods shall be sampled and analyzed separately. 
After testing, if there is any doubt about the inspection value provided by the shipper, the ship 
should refuse to accept the goods and ask the consignor to re-test or check the transportable 
moisture limit and moisture content of the goods. If there is any doubt about the value of the 
re-inspection, the ship may entrust an independent laboratory to re-test the moisture content of the 
goods. 
4.4 
货物装船Loading of goods 
4.4.1 
在同一货舱中，除罐装或类似包装方式的货物外，不得将含有液体的货物配装在
易流态化货物上部或与之相邻。 
In the same cargo hold, except for the goods in cans or similar packaging, the goods containing 
liquid shall not be loaded on the top of or adjacent to the fluidization goods. 
4.4.2 
在整个装货期间，监督装货工人将货物均衡装载货舱内，各舱货物装载时应采用
“五点平装”法，即：开始装每一舱时，应先装在货舱四个角落(“前、后、左、右”
四点)，然后装中间，每一轮次都应如此。避免将货物直接堆在大舱中间，这样对
货舱舱底局部强度不利，同时也不便于最后平舱。最好装成四周略高，中间稍低
的锅底型，并在锅底形的中间挖出一小坑，便于清除渗出的水份。 
During the whole period of loading, supervise the loading workers to load the cargo evenly in the 
cargo hold. When loading the cargo in each hold, the "five point flat loading" method shall be 
adopted, that is, when loading each hold, the cargo shall be loaded in four corners of the cargo hold 
first (four points of “front, back, left and right”), and then in the middle, each round shall be the 
same. Avoid stacking the cargo directly into the middle of the hold, which is not good for the local 
strength of the hold bilge and it is not convenient for the final trimming. It's better to pack it into a 
pot bottom shape with a little high around and a little low in the middle, and dig a small pit in the

4.4.3 
因此类货物通常密度较大，应注意货物在舱底均匀铺开以使重量平均分布，以避

4.4.4 
船舶应自始至终监督装船作业，妥善布置人员对货物含水率进行测试，全程监控

期和港口使用费的索赔。对货物情况和自行检测的过程，船长应进行拍照并保存
货物样品。 
The ship shall supervise the loading operations from beginning to end, properly assign personnel to 
test the moisture content of the cargo, monitor and assess the safety and availability of the cargo 
carried on this voyage. If the moisture content is obviously increased through observation or 
detection, or if the master has any doubt about the moisture content of the cargo (for example, free 
water is formed on the cargo surface or the cargo splashes on the cargo bulkhead after falling), he 
shall stop loading in time and notify the owner, charterer and other interested parties to seek further 
instructions. If the goods do not meet the conditions of shipment, which may affect the safety of 
the ship, the master shall resolutely refuse the loading, and submit the relevant statements and 
reports to the shipper in time, requesting the consignor to replace the goods, and filing a claim on 
the consignor for the sail schedule and the port toll at the same time. The master shall take photos 
of the goods and keep the samples of the goods during self inspection. 
4.4.5 
如发生拒装情况，应立即报告公司。 
In case of rejection, report immediately to the company. 
4.4.6 
装货过程中，应始终注意天气变化及准备装船货物的潮湿情况。遇到下雨或下雪
应立即关舱停装；同时要提醒码头方将货物苫好，以防货物被淋湿。 
In the course of loading, attention should always be paid to the weather changes and the wet 
condition of the goods to be ready for shipment. Close the hold and stop loading immediately in 
case of rain or snow; at the same time, the ship should remind the wharf side to cover the goods in 
case they get wet. 
4.4.7 
平舱Trimming 
1） 平舱可减少货物移动的风险。考虑到船舶特性及预定航程，若船长根据货物资
料、货物实际装船情况对船舶稳性存在任何担心，根据IMSBC CODE 第4、5 节
以及具体货物附录中的规定，有权要求对货物进行平舱。 
Trimming can reduce the risk of cargo movement. In view of the characteristics of the ship 
and the intended voyage, if the master has any concerns about the stability of the ship in light 
of the cargo information and the actual shipment condition of the cargo, he shall be entitled to 
require trimming of the cargo in accordance with the provisions of sections 4 and 5 of IMSBC 
CODE and in the Appendix to the specific cargo. 
2） 对于精矿粉，要求平舱后货物表面峰谷间高度差不超过5%船宽，而且货物从
舱口的边界均匀坡向舱壁，在航行途中不出现陡面坍塌现象。如果平舱效果不

应对装货过程和货舱内完货状态拍照以备查。 
Take photos of the loading process and the cargo condition in the cargo hold for inspection. 
4.4.9 
在装货结束后，船长或其委托检验员如收到任何要求他们确认货物是安全适运的

Upon completion of loading, the master or his commissioned surveyor shall refuse to sign any

4.4.10 作为平舱后的辅助措施，如可行，船舶可以采用在货堆中埋桶集水、设置纵向隔

As an auxiliary measure after trimming, if feasible, the ship may adopt the measures of burying the 
bucket in the cargo pile to collect water and setting up the longitudinal partition. 
4.5 
航行途中管理Management during navigation 
4.5.1 
船舶应从安全第一的角度出发合理选择航线，注意航行途中接收气象信息，船长
要及时分析未来天气海况变化和船舶货载实际情况，必要时对航线进行调整。 
The ship should choose the route reasonably from the angle of safety first, pay attention to 
receiving the weather information during the voyage, the master should analyze the future weather 
and sea situation and the actual situation of the ship's cargo load in time, and adjust the route if 
necessary. 
4.5.2 
船舶应根据所装载货物的特性和航行区域特点制定货舱定期巡查计划，并将定期
巡查情况记入《航海日志》。 
The ship shall, in accordance with the characteristics of the cargo carried and the characteristics of 
the area in which it is navigated, formulate the periodic inspection plan of the cargo hold and enter 
in the Deck Log Book for the periodic inspection. 
1） 开航后8 到16 小时内是货堆易发生变化的危险期。在此期间内，应视情对污
水井增加测量频次并做好记录，如航行条件许可时可派人下舱检查货物。如货
堆表面干燥，不久即开裂，则初步表明货堆已稳定，较安全； 
 hours after sailing is a dangerous time for cargo piles to change easily. During this period, 
the monitoring frequency of the sewage well should be increased according to the situation 
and the record should be made. If the conditions of navigation permit, personnel can be sent 
down to inspect the cargo. If the surface of the cargo is dry and cracking soon, it is a 
preliminary indication that the cargo is stable and safe. 
2） 一旦发现货物表面有水析出，及时使用各种工具将水（泥浆）清除，并报告公
司、海事管理机构及相关各方； 
In case of water precipitation on the surface of the goods, remove the water (mud) with 
various tools in time, and report to the company, the maritime administrative department and 
related parties; 
3） 注意观察船舶横倾和横摇状态，如果船舶出现异常的倾斜，即使是1-2 度的横
倾，也要立即对倾斜的原因进行检查。一旦确认倾斜由货物移动（流动）导致，
要立即采取改向、减速等安全措施减轻船舶震动与横摇，减缓货物向一舷侧的
移动速度，必要时尽快开往安全水域并及时报告公司、海事管理机构及相关各
方。 
Pay attention to the heeling and rolling of the ship. If the ship is in an abnormal incline, check

4.5.3 
经常检查货舱水密，防止货舱因水密不良进水，尤其在进入大风浪区域之前一定
要检查到位。 
Frequently check the water tightness of the cargo hold to prevent water from entering the cargo 
hold due to poor water tightness, especially before entering the area with heavy wind and waves 
4.5.4 
航行期间应根据天气情况，对货舱进行通风以便将水汽排出。 
Ventilation of cargo holds during navigation should be carried out in accordance with weather 
conditions in order to expel water vapor. 
4.5.5 
合理安排尽量集中使用油、水，减少油、水舱的自由液面对船舶稳性的影响。 
Reasonable arrangements should be made to use oil and water intensively as much as possible to 
reduce the influence of the free level of oil and water holds on the stability of the ship. 
4.5.6 
装运同时还具有化学危险性的固体散货时，应注意如果货物发生自燃、燃烧等情
况，采取灭火措施时不到万不得已不能对货物采用水冷却的方法，以免使货物发
生流动。如必须用水，应采用喷洒的方法，不能对货舱灌注。 
When carrying solid bulk cargo with chemical hazards, attention should be paid to the spontaneous 
combustion and burning of the cargo, the fire-extinguishing measures should not be taken to cool 
the cargo by water so as not to cause the goods to flow. If it is necessary to use water, spray should 
be applied instead of filling the cargo hold. 
4.6 
应急程序Emergency procedure 
4.6.1 
装载易流态化固体散货的船舶，如航行途中发现船体产生倾斜，应启动货物移动
应急处置方案，包括： 
If the ship is found to be prone to fluidization solid bulk cargo during navigation, the emergency 
disposal plan for the cargo movement shall be initiated，including: 
1） 立即通知船长、轮机长，评估船舶稳性与结构安全； 
Immediately notify the Master and Chief Engineer, assess the ship’s stability and 
structural safety 
2） 启动便携式排水设备与固定舱底水系统同时排水； 
Activate both portable drainage equipment and the fixed bilge system 
simultaneously to drain water 
3） 调整航向/航速，减少船舶横摇，降低自由液面影响； 
Adjust course/speed to reduce rolling and minimize free surface effect 
4） 必要时申请进入避难港，寻求岸基支持。并第一时间报告公司。 
If necessary, request entry to a port of refuge, seek shore based support, and report 
to the Company immediately 
5） 对应急设备进行定期检查与应急演练，确保船员熟悉应急操作流程。 
Conduct regular inspections and emergency drills for emergency equipment to 
ensure crew familiarity with emergency operating procedures 
 
4.6.2 
在应急处置中还应注意：Attention should also be paid to: 
1） 不能使用调整油水的方法来调平船舶，以免进一步恶化船舶稳性； 
It is not allowed to trim the ship by adjusting the oil and water, so as to avoid further

The master shall command the ship, adjust the course, reduce the rolling angle and avoid 
harmonic roll as much as possible to slow down the movement of the cargo to one side;

pounding on the hull, thus slowing down the speed of the cargo fluidization. When conditions

关于某些船舶装运A 类货水分超TML（简称“湿货”）的补充措施 
Supplementary Measures for Loading of Group A Cargo with Moisture Content 
Exceeding TML (Referred as “Wet Cargo”) on certain ships  
5.1 
General 总则 
5.1.1 
装载湿货的危险被认为有  
（1）稳性考量，即湿货在货舱中可能会造成自由液面或货物的移动，和 
（2）船体结构强度考量，湿货相较固体货物（非湿货）对货舱周边舱壁结构的作
用力会更大，因为固体货物有内部的内摩檫力而减少了这种对舱壁的作用力。  
The hazardous associated with Wet Cargo are identified as  
(1) stability concern when the cargo is liquified that creates free surface and/or shifts in 
cargo hold; and 
(2) hull strength concern that liquified cargo will exert more force onto the surrounding 
bulkhead structure than solid （un-liquified） cargo will, as the internal frication of solid 
cargo would help reduce such force.  
5.1.2 
只有经船旗国和船级社特殊批准的船舶才能承运湿货，此类特殊批准会在IMSBC 
证书或证明上注明，并含有装湿货时需要满足的条件。 
Only ships specially approved by the flag administration and the Class can carry Wet 
Cargo. Such special approval will be indicated in the IMSBC Certificate or 
Statement/Note including the imposed conditions.  
5.1.3 
在韦立船队目前只考虑一种湿货，即 Iron Ore Fines （铁精矿粉）。如要装载其他
湿货必须要有公司的同意，而公司会为此先向船旗国和船级社咨询。 
In Winning Fleet context, only one type of Wet Cargo, i.e., Iron Ore Fines, is 
considered. No other Wet Cargo is to be loaded unless it is approved by the Company 
after consulting with the Flag/Class. 
5.1.4 
船长需要查阅船级社审批的“水分大于TML 的A 类货的装载手册”以理解该船在装
湿货时所设置的限制。这类限制可能包括但不仅限于：

（非湿货）； 
Wet Cargo may be only allowed to be loaded in certain cargo holds, while the

The density of the Wet Cargo shall be within the design range as indicated in the 
“Loading Manual”. Wet Cargo with density lower than the lower limit, or higher 
than the higher limit, shall be rejected;  
5.1.5 
装载湿货时需要核算额外的稳性，即假设  
（1）湿货完全液化变成高密度的黏稠液体，和  
（2）湿货像粮食一样移动。 
When Wet Cargo is loaded, additional stability check shall be carried out, i.e., assuming 
(1) the Wet Cargo is totally liquefied that acts as a dense and viscous fluid, and 
 (2) the Wet Cargo shifts as grain.

这个额外的稳性核算和每个舱装湿货时的最大装载量的确认，以及上面提到的其

遵照装载仪的指示来配载。 
Such additional stability check and confirmation max Wet Cargo intake for each 
particular cargo hold, as well as the loading restrictions as above mentioned, are 
programmed in the loading computer. The Master shall use the Wet Cargo calculation 
function of the loading computer and follow the instructions accordingly.  
5.2 
湿货 / 表面出水的安全与排水补充措施 
Supplementary Safety and Drainage Measures for Wet Cargo / Surface Water 
5.2.1 
现有舱底水系统Existing Bilge System 
确认货舱固定舱底水系统的排水能力、覆盖范围，以及针对含湿货的操作限制（如

well as operational restrictions for wet cargo (e.g., requirements for handling oily 
water/cargo-contaminated water).

/h，30 米扬程，满足货舱排水要求； 
Equipment parameters: At least 2 sets of portable electric/pneumatic submersible

满足防污染公约要求），作为固定舱底水系统的补充手段。 
Operating procedure: Crew can connect the pump via hose to the cargo hold bilge 
and discharge accumulated water directly overboard (subject to MARPOL 
requirements), as a supplementary means to the fixed bilge system. 
5.2.3 
航行中监测与控制措施 Monitoring and Control Measures During Voyage  
1） 装货前：货物水分检测、舱底水系统有效性检查、排水路径确认； 
Before loading: Cargo moisture content testing, verification of bilge system 
effectiveness, confirmation of drainage path 
2）  航行中：每日对货舱进行目视检查，监测表面出水 / 货浆流动迹象，记录舱
底水位变化； 
During voyage: Daily visual inspection of cargo holds, monitoring for signs of 
surface water / slurry flow, recording bilge water level changes 
3）  排水控制：明确积水排放的触发条件、操作步骤、排放记录要求，以及防污
染措施（如油水分离器使用、舷外排放许可）。 
Drainage control: Define trigger conditions for water accumulation discharge, 
operation steps, discharge recording requirements, and pollution prevention 
measures (e.g., use of oily water separator, overboard discharge permission). 
5.2.4 
货舱污水井滤网管理专项措施  
Special Measures for Management of Cargo Hold Bilge Well Strainers 
为防止湿货装载后泥沙、矿渣、杂物堵塞污水井吸口，导致舱底水无法正常抽吸、
排水失效，需注意以下滤网管控措施： 
To prevent sand, slag, debris from clogging the bilge well suction after loading wet 
cargo, which may cause failure of normal bilge water suction and drainage, the 
following strainer control measures shall be observed: 
1） 滤网配置与安装要求 
Strainer Configuration and Installation Requirements 
 
各货舱污水井必须安装双层滤网 / 防堵滤网，滤网孔径符合本船装载矿砂
类型要求，防止细小 颗粒进入舱底水泵管路。 
Each cargo hold bilge well shall be fitted with double layer / anti clogging 
strainers, with mesh size suitable for the type of ore loaded, to prevent fine 
particles from entering the bilge pump piping 
 
滤网结构牢固、无破损、无变形，安装到位、密封可靠，不得随意拆除或
替代。

附件Appendix 1: 
 
货物含水率简易测试方法Simple test method for moisture content of cargo 
 
1 
罐测 Can test 
1.1 
取一圆筒或类似容器(0.5—1  升容量)，将货样盛到容器的一半。用一只手提起容
器，从高 度约0.2 m 处砸向一硬表面，如硬桌面。以1 至2 秒为间隔，重复 25 
次。观察货样表面是否 出现游离水分或流动状态。如果出现游离水分或流动 状
态，则证明货物含水率超过其流动 水分点FMP，应拒收货物并对货物含水率 进
行独立的实验室检测。 
Take a cylinder  or  similar  container  (0.5-1  liter  capacity)  and  fill  the  sample  
to half  of  the container. Lift the container with one hand and smash it from a height of about 
0.2m to a hard surface, such as a hard desktop. Repeat 25 times at intervals of 1 to 2 seconds. 
Observe whether there is free water or flow on the sample surface. If free water or flow occurs, it 
proves that the moisture content of the goods exceeds its FMP; it should reject the goods and carry 
out independent laboratory test on the moisture content of the goods. 
1.2 
必须注意，上述罐测无法检测货物的含水率是否低于适运水份限 TML，不能只凭
罐测而接受货物并进行装船，还应结合其他检测方法来确定货物是否可以装运。 
 It must be noted that the above-mentioned can not detect whether the moisture content of the 
goods is lower than the TML, can not accept the goods and proceed with shipment only on the 
basis of the tank test, but also determine whether the goods can be shipped in combination with 
other test methods 
2 
其他简易测试方法Other Simple Test Methods 
2.1 
烘干法Drying method 
2.1.1 
将货样称重后放入微波炉（烤箱等）烘干，再重新称重，通过计算重量差可推算
出粗略的货样含水率。由于不可能将货物中的水分完全烘干，如据此得到的含水
率接近适运水份限， 则完全有理由怀疑货物不适合装运。 
After weighing the sample, put it into  microwave  oven  (oven,  etc.)  to  dry  and  
reweigh.  By calculating the difference in weight, it can deduce the rough moisture content of the 
sample. Since  it is impossible to dry the moisture content in the goods completely, it is entirely 
reasonable to suspect that the goods are not suitable for shipment if the moisture content obtained 
therefrom is close to the TML. 
2.1.2 
取一容器（如可乐瓶、平底玻璃杯），装入约一半容积的样品，来回不停摇动 震
荡五分钟，如样品表面出现游离态水分或流动情况时，表示含水率过高。Take a 
container (e. g. Coke bottle, flat glass) and place it in about half of the volume of the sample. 
Shake it back and forth for five minutes. If there is free water or flow on the surface of the sample, 
it indicates that the moisture content is too high. 
2.1.3 
样品放在一平板上，经快速来回移动，有液体流出，表示含水率过高。The sample is 
placed on a flat  plate  and  moved  back  and  forth  rapidly,  with  liquid  outflow 
indicating the moisture content is too high. 
2.1.4 
样品放入一平盘，压成锥形，用盘子抨击桌面，锥形倒塌且流落在盘底如薄煎饼，
表示含水率过高；反之，锥形仅呈碎块(片)裂开而不流塌，则含水率大致低于适运
水份限。The sample is placed on a flat plate, pressed into a cone, and hit the table with a plate. 
The cone  collapses and falls on the bottom of the plate like a pancake, indicating that the 
moisture content is too high; conversely, the cone only cracks (pieces) and does not collapse, the 
moisture content is roughly lower than the TML.

2.1.5 
用手抓货物成团后，即松开，发现货物散开，则该矿粉含水量小于适运水份 限；
若货物抱团不散，则矿粉含水量接近或大于适运水份限。After the goods are 
agglomerated by hand and released, if the goods are scattered, the moisture content of the mineral 
powder is less than the TML; if the goods are agglomerated and not scattered, the moisture content 
of the mineral powder is close to or greater than the TML. 
2.1.6 
手抓一把货物并握紧，在 1.5  米高度上松手，使货物自由坠落到甲板或硬地 上，
若货物崩散，则含水量小于 TML，若矿粉仍为一团，则含水量接近或大 于TML。
Grab a handful of goods and hold tight, and loose at a height of 1.5 meters, so that the goods free     
fall to the deck or hard ground, if the goods collapse, the moisture content is less than TML, if the 
powder is still in a lump, the moisture content is close to or greater than TML. 
2.1.7 
人踏在精矿粉表面，出现松散现象，直至如流沙样流动，表明含水率过高，不适
运。When people step on the surface of concentrate powder, it will be loose until it flows like 
quicksand, indicating that the moisture content is too high and it is not transport. 
3 
样品来源Sample source 
从岸上货堆中、皮带机上、货车上，或驳船舱内货物表面下 50cm 处取样。建议
取样数量：15000 吨以下，每120 吨取200 克；15000-60000 吨，每 250 吨取 200 
克；60000 吨以上，每500 吨取 200 克。作为证据的样品，要密封保存在 容器
内，并标明取样时间、地点。 Samples shall be taken from the onshore stockpile, on the belt 
conveyor, on the truck, or 50cm below cargo surface in the barge hold. Recommended sampling 
quantity: below 15000 tons, 200 grams per 120 tons; 15000-60000 tons, 200 grams per 250 
tons; over 60000 tons, 200 grams per 500 tons; as evidence, the sample shall be sealed and 
stored in containers and the sampling time and place shall be indicated.

第11 节  散货船装运集装箱安全规定 
Section 11 Regulations for Container Transportation Management on Bulk Carrier 
1 
职责： 
Responsibilities: 
1.1  海务部负责集装箱运输管理的指导工作； 
The marine department is responsible for the guidance of container transportation management; 
1.2  大副负责集装箱预配图的审核、装载、卸货、运输途中的集装箱管理工作，负责监管
绑扎/解绑工作，负责监管绑扎系固设备的检查和维护； 
The Chief Officer is responsible for verifying the pre-stowage plan, the loading and unloading of 
containers and the container management during transportation; and responsible for supervising the 
lashing and unlashing. supervise the inspection and maintenance of lashing tools. 
1.3  船长负责对船舶集装箱运输管理的指导和监控； 
The Master is responsible for the guidance and monitoring of container transportation management of 
ships; 
1.4  值班驾驶员执行大副有关集装箱装卸管理的指令； 
The officer on duty shall execute the instructions of the Chief Officer on container handling 
management; 
1.5  大副负责装卸过程中的检查、保管、养护，提供良好、足够数量的绑扎锁具，确保开
航前和航行中绑扎处于良好状态。 
The Chief Officer shall be responsible for the inspection, storage and maintenance during loading and 
unloading, and provide a good and sufficient number of lashing locks to ensure that the lashing is in 
good condition before and during sailing. 
2 
 配载： 
Stowage: 
2.1 大副在收到预配图后，应对船舶稳性、吃水差以及装卸港序和甲板负荷等进行校核，
在证实符合要求后签字确认并报送船长批准后实施；大副应在预配图上标注装货注意
事项，并取得港方签字确认； 
After receiving the pre-stowage plan from, the Chief Officer shall check the stability of the ship, trim, 
loading and unloading port sequence and deck load, sign for confirmation and submit it to the Master for 
approval before implementation; the Chief Officer shall mark the loading precautions on the pre-stowage 
plan and obtain the signature of the port side for confirmation; 
2.2 船长和大副在审核配载图时,应考虑和注意如下各点： 
When reviewing the stowage plan prepared, the Master and the Chief Officer shall consider and pay 
attention to the following points: 
2.2.1 计算及校核船舶稳性，确保稳性符合船舶安全的要求； 
Calculate and check the ship stability to ensure that the stability meets the requirements of ship safety; 
2.2.2 确保船舶具有良好的总纵强度,除考虑装货的船体强度外, 还应考虑到中途港装卸货
后的船体强度； 
To ensure that the ship has good general longitudinal strength, in addition to the strength of the loaded 
hull, the hull strength after loading and unloading at the midway port should also be considered; 
2.2.3 保持船舶具有适当的吃水差； 
Maintain the ship with proper trim; 
2.2.4 计算及校核甲板、舱盖、舱底的局部强度，防止超负荷装载； 
Calculate and check the local strength of deck/hatch cover and tanktop to prevent overloading; 
2.2.5 同一港卸的货不应过于集中，以缩短船舶在港装卸时间；

04_19_22.text:
货运操作                             版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-11 
Shipping Operation                      Version/Rev.:3.0/0.0                        SHIP-07-11 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2022/05/10          第2/8页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.       Effective Date: 2022/05/10             Page 2/8 
The cargo discharged at the same port should not be too concentrated, so as to shorten the loading and 
unloading time of the ship at the port; 
2.2.6 对于甲板集装箱的配载，应遵守SOLAS公约第II-2章第10.7.3.2条的要求。如果船舶没
有配备移动消防水炮，需注意集装箱装载的高度限制： 
When the containers are carried on weather deck, the SOLAS Chapter II-2 Regulation 10.7.3.2 should be 
met. If the vessel is not equipped with the mobile water monitors, the follow limitation of loading tiers 
should be observed: 
 集装箱装载高度在甲板上含舱盖顶不能超过4层。 
The vessel shall not load containers more than four (4) tiers on weather deck, including that on hatch 
cover. 
 如果在甲板上的某些部位仅装载空集装箱，而且得到挂旗国和船级社的批准，可以
装到5层或以上，大副须事先参阅批准的装载手册和挂旗国、船级社的书面批复；
正常情况下，有货的集装箱在甲板上（含舱盖）最多装到4层。 
If the vessel only carries empty containers at certain bay, and it is approved by the flag administration and 
classification society, it may be allowed to be load up to five (5) tiers or more. Chief Officer shall refer to 
the approved Cargo Securing Manual and the approval document from the flag administration and 
classification society.  Under normal condition，the containers with cargo can not be loaded more than 
four (4) tiers on weather deck including hatch cover. 
2.2.7 应充分考虑特殊货箱的特殊要求。 
The specific requirements of special containers shall be fully considered. 
 
3 
装卸货作业： 
Loading and unloading operation: 
3.1 装卸货作业前大副应把配载图交给值班驾驶员，并详细交待注意事项；值班驾驶员应
严格按照大副要求做好监装监卸工作，装货时注意下述各点： 
Before loading and unloading, the Chief Officer shall hand over the stowage plan to the officer on duty 
and explain the precautions in detail; the officer on duty shall supervise the loading and unloading in strict 
accordance with the requirements of the Chief Officer, and pay attention to the following points during 
loading: 
3.1.1 应确保实际装箱位置与预配图一致； 
The actual packing position shall be consistent with the pre-stowage plan; 
3.1.2 应注意检查工人是否按规定摆放好箱底锁和扭锁；装毕是否按要求关锁和做好绑扎
工作；对冷藏箱要检查压缩机朝向，是否接通电源以及冰机是否工作，装船时的温度
记录是否正常； 
Pay attention to check whether the workers put the bottom lock and twist lock according to the 
regulations; whether the lock and lashing work are closed according to the requirements after loading; 
check the orientation of the reefer containers, whether the power is connected, whether the ice machine is 
working, and whether the temperature record during loading is normal; 
3.1.3 按3.3的要求进行检查,发现问题应做好记录并及时向大副报告。 
Check according to the requirements of 3.3, record the problems found and report to the Chief Officer in 
time. 
3.2 卸货时注意下述各点： 
Pay attention to the following points during unloading: 
3.2.1 严格按照大副卸货计划卸货，防止绑扎锁具损坏、丢失； 
Unload goods in strict accordance with the Chief Officer’s discharging plan to prevent damage and loss of 
lashing locks; 

702

货运操作                             版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-11 
Shipping Operation                      Version/Rev.:3.0/0.0                        SHIP-07-11 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2022/05/10          第3/8页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.       Effective Date: 2022/05/10             Page 3/8 
3.2.2 应先拔去冷藏箱的电源插头； 
Remove the power plug of the reefer containers first; 
3.2.3 记录装卸货的有关情况，必要时，请有关人员确认。 
Record the loading and unloading situation, and ask the relevant personnel for confirmation if necessary. 
3.3 集装箱的检查： 
Container inspection: 
3.3.1 集装箱外表检查包括：有无损伤、变形、凹陷、破口等异样现象；箱角柱、上下端梁
有无弯曲变形裂缝腐蚀现象；箱底有无折断、曲翘、有无泄漏、箱门有无变形、是否密
封；开顶箱篷布是否齐全； 
Container appearance inspection includes: whether there are abnormal phenomena such as damage, 
deformation, depression and break; whether the corner pillars and upper and lower beams are bent, 
deformed, cracked and corroded; whether the bottom of the container is broken, warped, leaked, deformed 
and sealed; whether the open top box tarpaulin is complete or not; 
3.3.2 应保证集装箱箱号铅封与舱单上记录相符合；冷藏箱的机械、电器设备运转正常，冷
却温度必须达到进出口文件记载要求；  
The lead seal of the container number shall be consistent with the record on the manifest; the mechanical 
and electrical equipment of the reefer container shall operate normally, and the cooling temperature must 
meet the requirements of the import and export documents; 
3.3.3 危险货物集装箱须经值班驾驶员确认标志与货物清单所记载的内容一致，箱体并无损
坏、渗漏等异常情况,才能装船；如有异常，可拒绝装船，或要求发货人修复。 
The container with dangerous goods can be loaded only after the officer on duty confirms that the mark is 
consistent with the contents recorded in the cargo list, and the container is free from any abnormal 
conditions such as damage and leakage; if there is any abnormality, the container can be refused to be 
loaded or the shipper can be asked to repair it. 
3.3.3 当发现装船集装箱有损伤、变形、不水密等异常，不能修复也不能下船时，大副需在
《集装箱设备交接单》上如实签署备注，并递交发货人。 
When the loaded container is found to be damaged, deformed, not watertight and other abnormalities. But 
the container cannot be repaired or discharged to shore, the Chief Officer should sign the remarks on the 
"Container Equipment Interchange Receipt " and submit it to the shipper or consignee. 
4 
 冷藏箱运输： 
Reefer container transportation: 
4.1  大副要合理配载，冷藏箱的装载位置便于接通电源和检查及维修，避免冷箱压缩机上
浪受损； 
The Chief Officer shall stow the containers reasonably, and the loading position of the reefer container 
shall be convenient for power connection, inspection and maintenance, so as to avoid damage to the 
compressor in the reefer container due to shipping seas; 
4.2  电子电气员在装货前把电源接通，卸货前先撤卸电源；每天应巡查冷藏箱两次，发现
问题应及时维修，如压缩机出现故障，应会同大管轮进行维修并做好记录； 
The electrical and electronic personnel shall connect the power supply before loading, and remove the 
power supply before unloading; inspect the reefer container twice a day, and timely repair the problems 
found. If the compressor fails, repair it together with the Chief Engineer and make records; 
4.3  在海上、整个航次期间，大副应确保检查人员每天检查冷箱至少2次，并记录其温度,
发现问题应及时向船长报告； 
At Sea, throughout the voyage, Chief Officer should ensure the temperatures are taken at least twice a day 
by inspector, record its temperature, and report the problem to the Master in time; 
4.4  如果冷箱接电后工作不正常，大副应及时通知船长。并且当船长认为装运该冷箱不安

703

货运操作                             版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-11 
Shipping Operation                      Version/Rev.:3.0/0.0                        SHIP-07-11 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2022/05/10          第4/8页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.       Effective Date: 2022/05/10             Page 4/8 
全时，应通知航运部卸船或在离港前修好； 
The Chief Officer should inform Master if the reefer unit is found to be malfunction at the time of “Plug 
In” on board the vessel, If the Master believed the same is not safe to carry on board, then he should 
inform Operation Dept. to discharge or repair prior to sailing; 
 
5   危险品箱运输: 
Transportation of containers with dangerous goods: 
5.1  大副在预配时结合危险货物的种类、性质、危险程度制定积载计划，严格按照《国际
危规》和船舶危险品适装证书的要求合理配载。 
Chief Officer shall formulate stowage plan considering the type, nature and risk degree of dangerous 
goods, and carry the cargo reasonably in strict accordance with the requirements of the international 
dangerous goods code and the ship’s dangerous goods certificate. 
5.2   装载要求： 
Loading requirements: 
5.2.1 大副应及时编写危险品清单，并将危险品的装载位置、特性、消防、急救等措施张
贴并进行培训和做好记录； 
Chief Officer shall prepare the list of dangerous goods in time, and post the loading position, 
characteristics, fire control, first aid and other measures of dangerous goods, and carry out training and 
make records; 
5.2.2  船舶在装载危险品箱时，值班驾驶员必须检查箱体外观、危险标志、铅封和装载位
置，如有异常，及时报告大副；船舶装载危险品应按规定悬挂或展示危险品号旗、号
灯； 
When the ship is loading containers with dangerous goods, the officer on duty must check 
the appearance of the containers, the dangerous signs, the lead seal and the loading position. 
If there is any abnormality, report to the Chief Officer in time; when the ship is loading 
dangerous goods, the flag and light of dangerous goods shall be hung or displayed according 
to the regulations; 
5.3   危险品箱运输途中必须坚持每班按规定的巡回路线和次数进行防火巡回检查； 
During the transportation of containers with dangerous goods, fire patrol inspection shall be 
carried out according to the specified itinerary and times for each shift; 
5.4 
危险品箱卸货时，值班驾驶员必须检查督促装卸工人严格按照有关操作规程进行卸
货作业。 
When unloading containers with dangerous goods, the officer on duty must check and urge the loading 
and unloading workers to discharge the goods in strict accordance with the relevant operation regulations. 
 
6    特殊箱运输： 
Transportation of special containers: 
6.1  特殊箱一般专指超高、超宽、超长、开顶、托盘、半开门、液罐箱等类型的集装箱； 
Special containers generally refer to ultra-high, ultra-wide, ultra-long, open top, pallet, semi-open door, 
liquid tank container and other types of containers; 
6.2  配载此类特种箱时应合理利用舱容并注意甲板局部强度及稳性影响； 
When loading such special containers, the hold capacity should be reasonably used and the local strength 
and stability of the deck should be paid attention to; 
6.3  装此类特种箱前，大副应到现场利用专业判断确认货物绑扎是否满足海上安全运输要
求；如不满足要求应拒装或重新加固满足要求后装船； 
Before loading such special containers, the Chief Officer shall go to the site to make professional 
judgment to confirm whether the goods are bound to meet the requirements of safe maritime

Shipping Operation                      Version/Rev.:3.0/0.0                        SHIP-07-11

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.       Effective Date: 2022/05/10             Page 5/8 
transportation; if the requirements are not met, refuse to load or reinforce again, and then ship the goods 
after meeting the requirements; 
6.4  半开门箱应尽量避免配于两舷侧位置，开口应向船尾方向，防止甲板上浪造成货损； 
The semi-open container should be avoided to be arranged at the two sides of the ship as far as 
possible, and the opening should be towards the stern of the ship to prevent the cargo damage caused 
by the shipping seas on the deck; 
6.5   海上航行时应经常检查此类箱加固和绑扎情况,若有松动应立即加固。 
When sailing on the sea, the reinforcement and lashing of such containers should be checked frequently, 
and if they are loose, they should be reinforced immediately. 
 
7     集装箱绑扎及检查 ：  
Container lashing and inspection: 
7.1   船长督促甲板部船员做好绑扎或检查工作，只有在证实所有集装箱均绑扎妥当后才能
开航； 
The Master shall urge the crew of deck department to do a good job of lashing or inspection, and only after 
confirming that all containers are properly lashed can the ship sail; 
7.2   大副具体负责组织船员全面检查货箱的绑扎情况，发现不符合要求的要重新绑扎； 
The Chief Officer shall be responsible for organizing the crew to check the lashing of the containers 
comprehensively, and re-lash the containers if they do not meet the requirements; 
7.3   如果由装卸工人负责绑扎工作，开航前大副应组织甲板部船员对工人绑扎情况进行检
查； 
If the stevedores are responsible for the lashing work, Chief Officer shall organize the crew of the deck 
department to inspect the lashing condition of the stevedores before sailing; 
7.4   航行途中，根据航程情况定期检查装箱的绑扎，一般每天应检查一次，大风浪天气前
后均应检查，发现松动的应及时绑牢。 
During the voyage, the lashing of containers shall be checked regularly according to the voyage 
conditions, generally once a day, before and after heavy weather, and the loose ones shall be lashed in 
time. 
 
8 
  绑扎工具的保管与保养： 
Storage and maintenance of lashing tools: 
8.1 
大副负责对船上货箱绑扎所用底锁、扭锁、拉杆、松紧螺丝等工具的管理工作， 
The Chief Officer is responsible for the management of bottom lock, twist lock, pull rod, turnbuckle and 
other tools used in the lashing of containers on board the ship, 
绑扎工具清单和维护，依据系固手册； 
Regarding to the inventory and maintenance of lashing tools, refer to the Cargo Securing Manual; 
8.2  大副应按照装卸货计划，将所需的绑扎工具提供给绑扎人员，完毕后大副应督促水手
长整理多余的绑扎工具并及时进库； 
The Chief Officer shall provide the necessary lashing tools to the lashing personnel according to the 
loading and unloading plan. After the completion, the Chief Officer shall urge the bosun to sort out the 
surplus lashing tools and enter the warehouse in time; 
8.3  卸货时，值班人员应注意监督，防止绑扎工具随货箱一起被卸走； 
During discharging, the persons on duty shall pay attention to supervision to prevent the lashing tools 
from being discharged along with the container; 
8.4  航行时，由水手长组织人员对绑扎锁具进行维护、保养；损坏的设法修补，拆下的零
部件要注意保存，以备修理用；绑扎工具消耗，损坏需增补时，应及时向船管部申请。 
During navigation, the bosun shall organize personnel to maintain and upkeep the lashing locks; repair the

货运操作                             版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-11

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.       Effective Date: 2022/05/10             Page 6/8 
damaged parts and components, and pay attention to the preservation of the removed parts for repair; when 
the lashing tools are consumed and the damage needs to be supplemented, the bosun shall apply to the 
technical department in time. 
 
9    货物系固手册（CSM）和安全通道布置（CSAP）要求 
 Requirements of Cargo Securing Manual and Cargo safe passage arrangement  
9.1  人员培训及熟悉 
 Personnel Training and familiarization 
9.1.1  参与集装箱系固操作的人员应进行锁紧以解锁集装箱的培训，并尽可能以安全方式
来完成。该培训应包括预期使用的不同类型的系固设备。 
Personnel involved in container securing operations shall be trained in locking and unlocking containers 
and shall be completed in a safe manner as far as possible. The training shall include the different types of 
securing equipment expected to be used. 
9.1.2  参与集装箱系固操作的人员应进行培训，以便可以根据不同船舶的程序识别及处理
失效的系固零部件，以及可以拆卸该零部件进行修理、维护或丢弃。 
Personnel involved in container securing operations shall be trained so that they can identify and deal with 
the failed securing parts according to the procedures of different ships, and can be disassembled for repair, 
maintenance or discarding. 
9.1.3  参与集装箱系固操作的人员应进行培训，以便掌握安全及有效的手动操作技巧，以
及培养分辨以避免潜在危险的安全意识。 
Personnel involved in container securing operation shall be trained to master safe and effective manual 
operation skills, as well as to develop safety awareness of discrimination to avoid potential hazards. 
9.1.4  人员进行安全工作系统的培训。当人员在高处工作，应对相关设备进行培训。如可
行，应优先使用掉落防护设备代替掉落防护系统。 
Personnel shall be trained on safety work system. When personnel are working aloft, the use of relevant 
equipment shall be trained. If possible, the use of fall protection equipment in place of the fall protection 
system should be preferred. 
9.1.5  使用热电缆或连接温度控制单元的人员应进行培训，以便了解失效的电缆、插座以
及堵用插头。 
Personnel using hot cables or connecting temperature control units shall be trained to understand the failed 
cables, sockets and plug plugs. 
9.1.6  参与集装箱货物操作的人员应熟悉船舶的特性以及作业时的潜在危害。 
Personnel involved in container cargo operation shall be familiar with the characteristics of the ship and 
the potential hazards during operation. 
9.2   操作程序一般规定 
General provisions of operation procedures 
9.2.1  安全绑扎系固、通道使用，参考系固手册和安全通道布置。 
Safe lashing & securing operations and use of safe passage have be included in the ship’s Cargo Securing 
Manual(CSM) and Cargo Safe Passage Arrangement (CSAP). 
9.2.2  船舶到达后，在系固工作开始前，应对于绑扎位置及其通道进行安全评估。 
After the arrival of the ship, safety assessment shall be carried out for the lashing position and its passage 
before the start of the securing work. 
9.3   维护 
Maintenance 
9.3.1 根据MSC.1/Circ.1353《货物系固手册编制指南》中2.3（检验及维护），所有船舶应持
有记录册，记录册应包括货物系固设备的接受、维护、修理及拒绝。记录册还应包含检

706

货运操作                             版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      SHIP-07-11 
Shipping Operation                      Version/Rev.:3.0/0.0                        SHIP-07-11 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2022/05/10          第7/8页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.       Effective Date: 2022/05/10             Page 7/8 
验的记录。 
According to 2.3 (inspection and maintenance) in MSC.1/CIRC.1353 guide for compilation of cargo 
securing manual, all ships shall keep a record book, which shall include the acceptance, maintenance, 
repair and rejection of cargo securing equipment. The record book shall also contain records of inspection. 
9.3.2  应保证合适的照明。 
Proper lighting shall be ensured. 
9.3.3  通道、梯子、楼梯以及护栏应进行定期维护以防止发生腐蚀。 
Access, ladder, staircase and guardrail shall be regularly maintained to prevent corrosion. 
9.3.4  腐蚀的通道、梯子、楼梯以及护栏应尽快进行修理及替换，如果腐蚀可能影响安全
操作，应立即进行有效修理。 
Corroded passages, ladders, stairs and guardrails shall be repaired and replaced as soon as possible. If 
corrosion may affect safe operation, effective repair shall be carried out immediately. 
9.3.5  被油污覆盖的花篮螺丝很难进行张紧。定期对绑扎、系固设备、属具的活动部件加
油。花篮螺丝除螺牙外应保持清洁 
It is difficult to tighten the turnbuckle covered with oil. Oil the moving parts of lashing and securing 
equipment and accessories regularly. The turnbuckle should be kept clean except for the screw teeth. 
9.3.6  存储箱以及运输器应保持在安全条件下。 
Storage containers and transporters shall be kept in safe conditions. 
9.4   特殊集装箱的安全设计（如有时） 
Safety design of special containers (if any) 
9.4.1  温度控制单元(冷藏箱)的供电插座应提供安全、水密的电力连接。 
The power socket of temperature control unit (reefer container) shall provide safe and watertight power 
connection. 
9.4.2  温度控制单元(冷藏箱)的供电插座应为大电流、联锁并且有断流器保护的电力输出。
因此除非插头完全进入，操作手柄调到“有电（on）”位置之前，插座不会被调为“输出”。
将操作手柄调为“off”位置，应能手动切断回路。 
The power socket of temperature control unit (reefer container) shall be of high current, interlocking and 
power output protected by cut-out device. Therefore, unless the plug is fully in, the socket will not be set 
to “output” until the operating handle is turned to the “on” position. When the operating handle is set to 
“off” position, the circuit can be cut off manually. 
9.4.3  在“有电（on）”位置，如果插头被突然拔出，温度控制单元(冷藏箱)的动力回路应能
自动切断。同样，应能在插头未完全脱离插座时切断。这能够通过杜绝插头和插座的电
弧破坏来为操作者提供安全以及防护电击伤害。 
In the “on” position, if the plug is suddenly pulled out, the power circuit of the temperature control unit 
(reefer container) shall be automatically cut off. Similarly, it shall be possible to cut off the plug when it is 
not completely detached from the socket. This can provide the operator with safety and protection against 
electric shock injury by eliminating the arc damage of plug and socket. 
9.4.4  温度控制单元(冷藏箱)的插座应设计为人员在调控温度时不直接站在插座前面。 
The socket of temperature control unit (reefer container) shall be designed so that personnel do not directly 
stand in front of the socket when regulating temperature. 
9.4.5  温度控制单元(冷藏箱)的插座应避免软电缆的布置会导致人员绊倒。 
The socket of temperature control unit (reefer container) shall avoid tripping due to flexible cable 
arrangement. 
9.4.6  需要操作温度控制单元(冷藏箱)电缆连接的船员应接受培训来识别失效的电缆及插
头。 
The crew who need to operate the cable connection of temperature control unit (reefer container) shall be 
trained to identify the failed cable and plug.

9.4.7  应提供温度控制单元(冷藏箱)电缆的布置方法以免系固设备在操作中会掉落在上面。 
The cable layout of temperature control unit (reefer container) shall be provided to avoid the securing

失效或不能操作的温度控制单元(冷藏箱)插头或电气单元应该被识别并被标示为不

Failed or inoperable plug or electrical unit of temperature control unit (reefer container) shall be identified 
and marked as unavailable.

Recorder 
集装箱货物运输、绑扎检查、装卸货操作，记录在航海日志；

entered the logbook.  
船舶的积载及稳性资料应留船，大副保存至少二年。 
The cargo stowage plan and ship stability information should be kept on board at least two years by

第02 节 滑油定期化验制度  
Section 02 Lubricating Oil Periodic Laboratory Test System 
 
1.0 范围  
Scope 
本制度规定了滑油定期化验规则,适用于公司船管部和所管理的船舶。  
This regulation stipulates the lubricating oil periodic laboratory test system, applicable to the Fleet 
Department and the ships managed by the company. 
2.0 滑油化验制度  
Lubricating Oil Laboratory Test System 
2.1 主管轮机员负责职责范围内所管理设备滑油取样工作。  
The concerned engineers are responsible for the sampling work of the equipment under his management 
within the scope of responsibilities. 
2.2 主、副机润滑油要求每3 个月取样化验一次。尾轴系统滑油、舵机系统滑油、甲板机
械系统滑油每6 个月或不超过6 个月取样化验一次，特殊情况下，可按照实际需要取
样化验。其他如应急发电机、空压机、救生艇艇机等设备的系统滑油，按照说明书要
求及时换新，无需化验。 
Sample testing on the lubricating oil of the Main Engine and Auxiliary Engine should be made once 
every three months as required. Lubricating oil for stern tube system, steering system and deck 
machinery should be sample tested every six months or no more than six months. Under special 
circumstances, sample testing shall be conducted according to the actual need. For other equipment such 
as emergency generators, air compressors, lifeboats, etc. the lubricating oil want be replaced in 
accordance with the requirements of the manual in a timely, no need to carry out sample test. 
2.3 为确保油样具有代表性，应在设备稳定运转时取样，要使用专用油样瓶、标签（如有
缺少时应提前在滑油申请时报告。样瓶、标签将在下一次滑油供应时供船），放油考克
打开后，先放出少量滑油以除去取样管内的死油和杂质，然后取样。取样点应当在泵
后。  
To ensure the oil samples are representative samples, the sampling should take place during stable 
operation of the equipment. Special-purpose oil sample bottles and labels (In case of shortage, report it 
when submitting lubricating oil application in advance. The oil sample bottles and labels will be sent 
along with the next ship supply of lubricating oil.) –sampling kit should only be used. When the oil 
discharge cock is unplugged, discharge a small quantity of lubricating oil to remove the dead oil and 
impurities, and then perform sampling. Sampling should be made behind the pump. 
2.4 轮机长将取好的油样，封妥瓶口。按标签要求的内容用英文正确填写。报送船长，交
由代理邮寄给化验公司。同时，应注意保管好注明船方保存的标有油样编号的标签（贴
入“滑油化验”文件夹内），注明油样所对应设备，以便出现问题时能及时核查；船长
应将滑油油样交验情况及时电告机务总管，以便及时取得化验结果。  
After the Chief Engineer takes the oil samples and seals the bottle, write in English accurately according 
to the label requirements. Submit it to the Master, and send it to the agent to mail it to the laboratory 
company. At the same time, pay attention in handling the labels in good care, which indicates the oil 
sample number and to be kept by the ship (stick them inside the “Lubricating Oil Laboratory Test” folder). 
Indicate the corresponding equipment as to the oil samples, so that inspection can be made timely when 
problem is found. The Master should inform the Technical Superintendent by phone timely as to the 
conditions of lubricating oil sampling and delivery, in order to receive laboratory test results on time.  
2.5 标签应写明如下内容：船名、船舶代码、公司名称、何种机器的用油、润滑油牌号、
运转时间、取样日期及位置、送样日期及港口。如非定期化验的滑油应说明送检目的

和原因。  
The label should include the following: ship name, ship code, company name, equipment, the brand of 
lubricating oil, running hour, date and location of sampling, date of landing sample and the port name. As 
for lubricating oil with non-periodic laboratory test, the purpose and cause of inspection must be 
indicated. 
2.6 当机务总管收到滑油化验报告后应尽快对化验结果给出技术分析，将分析批注或应采
取的措施和化验结果一起通报船上，同时将技术分析和化验报告一并存档。  
When the Technical Superintendent receives lubricating oil laboratory test report, perform technical 
analysis to the laboratory test as soon as possible, report the comments of analysis or the measures that 
should be taken to the ship along with the laboratory test results, and keep the technical analysis and 
laboratory test in the archives. 
2.7 机务总管负责监控应采取措施的实施情况。轮机长按照化验报告要求的纠正措施，在
化验报告上写明所采取的纠正行动，监督主管轮机员予以落实。如有必要，应再次提
交油样进行化验，直到滑油化验报告结果正常。  
Technical Superintendent is responsible for monitoring the execution condition of the encounter measures. 
The Chief Engineer record the correction activity taken on the laboratory test report according to the 
corrective measures required by the laboratory test report, and monitor the engineers to execute 
accordingly. If necessary, an oil sample should be submitted for laboratory test again, until the result 
shown in the laboratory test is classified as normal. 
2.8 船管部和船上应建立滑油化验文件夹，记录设备名称和滑油牌号、各项性能指标、化
验日期、设备运转时间和所采取的措施等。  
The Fleet Department and the ship should create a folder for the lubricating oil laboratory test, record the 
equipment name, the brand of lubricating oil, all kinds of function indexes, date of laboratory test, time of 
equipment operation, the measures taken and so on.   
2.9 更换滑油牌号和申请报废要求如下；  
Requirements of changing the brand of the lubrication oil and the application of discard are as followed: 
2.9.1 船舶如果需更换润滑油牌号、规格，必须报告船管部经理批准。  
If the ship needs to change the brand and standards of the lubrication oil, report to the Fleet Department 
manager for approval. 
2.9.2 船管部应将所更换的润滑油技术标准和要求通知船舶并进行技术指导。  
The Fleet Department should inform the ship as to the technical standards and requirements of the new 
lubricating oil and provide technical guidance. 
2.9.3 经油样化验如果已变质，需更换或报废时，必须报告机务总管并经船管部经理批准。  
If the oil sample for laboratory test is already deteriorated, and in need of change or discard, report to 
the Technical Superintendent and geet approval from the Fleet Department manager. 
2.9.4 有条件的船舶应根据船管部的批示努力做好更换下来的污润滑油的净化处理，净化处
理后的润滑油在重新使用前，应进行油样化验，并经船管部批准。  
Ship with conditional provisions should strive to discharge the dirty lubricating oil for purification, and 
perform oil sample laboratory test with approval from the Fleet Department before reuse of purified 
lubricating oil.

第03 节 船舶备件和物料管理规定 
Section 03 Ship Spare Part and Store Management Regulation 
 
1.0 船舶备件管理规定 
Ship Spare Part Management Regulation 
1.1 目的 
Purpose 
制定船舶备件的申请、审批、使用、保管、质量反馈程序，以保证船舶备件的供应在
数量上和质量上满足船舶设备维修保养的最基本需要，从而确保船舶安全和高效地营
运。 
This regulation stipulates the application, approval, usage, keeping and quality feedback procedures of the 
ship spare part, in order to guarantee the basic need of ship equipment maintenance can be satisfied by the 
supply of ship spare part in terms of quantity and quality, to ensure the ship can operate safely and 
effectively.  
1.2 适用范围 
Scope 
本规定适用于公司所管理的船舶。 
This regulation is applicable to all ships managed by the company. 
1.3 定义  
Definition 
由轮机部所管的机电设备和其它备用设备、零部件等的总称都属于本规则所指的范围。 
The machinery and electrical equipment, spare equipment, components, parts and so on – as a collective 
term, is included in the scope of this regulation. 
1.4 职责 
Responsibilities 
1.4.1 船管部负责船舶备件的年度额度计划和审核，供应部负责订购并保证按时供应。船管
部对船舶备件的管理、使用进行监督检查和评定。 
The Fleet Department is responsible for the annual quota plan and approval for the spare parts, whereas 
the Purchasing Department is responsible for the purchase and ensure the supply on time. The Fleet 
Department supervises the inspection and evaluation to the management and usage of ship spare part. 
1.4.2 船舶负责备件的申请、验收、保管和使用及报耗。 
The ship is responsible for the application, examination, reception, keeping, usage and consumption 
reports of the spare parts. 
1.4.3 备件分别由轮机部各所属设备的主管轮机员、电机员负责储备、申领、使用、保管。 
The concerned engineers and electricians is responsible for the storage, application, reception, usage 
and keeping of the spare parts for their own equipment in the Engine Department respectively. 
1.4.4 轮机长对备件的储备、申领、使用、保管进行最终的审核和控制并对备件的质量进行
全程跟踪和反馈，以不定期的形式及时反馈给公司船管部。 
The Chief Engineer is responsible for the final verification and control to the storage, application, 
reception, usage and keeping of the spare parts, perform follow-up and give feedbacks to the quality of 
spare parts for the whole course, and give feed backs to the Fleet Department timely by an irregular 
form. 
1.4.5 机务总管对以上过程进行跟踪、控制和监督。 
Technical Superintendent is responsible to follow up, control and monitor the above process. 
1.5 实施步骤 
Procedures

1.5.1 备件储存 
Spare part storage 
 根据船舶的航线和设备的维修保养计划储存必要的备件。 
Ship should keep the necessary spare parts according to the ship voyage and equipment maintenance 
plan. 
 船舶备件储存定额必须满足船级社《钢质海船入级与建造规范》对船存备件的要求。 
The ship spare part storage quota should satisfy the requirements of ship spare parts storage in the 
“Rules and Regulations for the Construction and Classification of Steel Ships” as required by the Ship 
Classification Society.  
 备件的储存数量应充分考虑设备出现故障时，不能够由于缺少该备件而可能发生紧
迫局面或对正常营运造成重大影响。 
The problem of equipment breakdown should be taken into consideration on the storage quantity of 
spare parts, since the lack of spare parts may lead to the occurrence of emergency situations or big 
influence to a normal operation. 
1.5.2 备件的申请 
Spare Part Application 
 船舶备件的申请计划应根据航线、船存数量、维修保养计划由各主管轮机员、电
机员提出申请要求，编制《备件申请单》，经轮机长审核后通过SMIS 系统报公司
船管部。 
The application plan of ship spare parts should be submitted by all concerned engineers and 
electricians according to the navigation route, ship storage quantity and maintenance plan. Develop 
the “Spare Parts Application Form”, to be approved by the Chief Engineer. After that, it will be sent 
to the Fleet Department through SMIS system. 
 备件的申请应尽量做到对同一台设备或同型号设备的备件统一申请集中订购, 以
避免多次订购造成附加费用的增加和管理上的混乱。 
The purchase application of spare parts of the same equipment or equipment with the same model 
should be centralized, to avoid the increase of extra charges and confusion in management due to 
repeated purchase. 
 备件申请应考虑备件供应周期和满足1.5.1 的要求下, 每半年申请一次并应提前2
个月提出申请。 
When submitting spare part application, the supply cycle of spare part and the requirement by 
section 1.5.1 in this chapter should be taken into consideration. Apply once every half year and 2 
months in advance. 
 备件申请单应按照规定填写,包括以下内容: 
Fill in the spare part application form according to the requirements, which should include the 
following: 
 所属设备的制造厂名、机型、出厂号。 
Name of manufacturer, model and factory number of the concerned equipment. 
 备件名称、编号或图号、规格。 
Name, serial number / drawing number, descriptions of the spare parts. 
 船存量和申请量。 
ROB and quantity requested. 
 申请理由，备件需要的时间（紧急或一般）。 
Reason for application, the time when the spare part is needed (emergency or general). 
 船舶在国外港口由于设备故障需要订购的少量紧急备件, 可以经船长向公司船管
部请示后直接向代理或供应商递交申请，直接订购。

When the ship at the foreign port have to purchase small quantity of emergency spare parts due to 
equipment breakdowns, ask for instructions from the Fleet Department via the Master, and then 
submit application to the agent or supplier for direct ordering. 
1.5.3 备件接收 
Spare receipt 
 备件到船时，各主管轮机员、电机员应认真检查核对，如发现型号、规格、数量
不符或质量不佳，应立即报告轮机长，轮机长应立即报告机务总管。 
When the spare part delivered to the ship, all concerned engineers and electricians should perform 
inspection and verification seriously. If the model, standard and quantity is found to be incorrect, or 
the quality is not good, report to the Chief Engineer immediately and the Chief Engineer should 
report to the Technical Superintendent immediately. 
 仔细核对单据，确认无误后再签收，如有异义，签写备注。无需填写或不适用项
目用斜线划掉，严禁签写空白单据。 
Check the receipt carefully and sign for receipt after confirmation. Make REMARK on it if there is 
any discrepancy, do not need to fill in or do not apply items with slash cross out, do not sign blank 
receipt. 
 备件核准无误后，应及时把相关信息输入计算机的SMIS 系统，并且在港口轮机长
要及时报告船长，船长以书面形式报告公司船管部。 
After verification of the spare part, enter the relevant information into the SMIS system in the 
computer timely, and the Chief Engineer should report to the Master at the port timely. The Master 
will report to the Fleet Department in writing. 
1.5.4 备件保管 
Spare Part Keeping 
 各种备件应按所属设备分类整齐地存放在固定处所，不同设备的备件不要混放一
起。 
All kinds of spare parts should be stored in the designated place in order according to the category of 
equipment. Spare parts of different equipment should not be put together.  
 各种备件，尤其是大的、重的、精密的重要备件妥善放置，做好衬垫、绑扎工作，
防止翻倒、震动、碰撞。 
All kinds of spare parts, especially for big, heavy or refined important spare parts, these should be 
kept in due care. Dunnage and lashing should be made to prevent turnovers, vibration and collision.  
 各种备件应系挂识别牌号（包括机器名称、型号、备件编号），以便准确地判明其
名称规格和所属的设备。 
Tag a label(including equipment name, model, spare part serial number) to all kinds of spare parts, in 
order to identify its name and its corresponding equipment accurately. 
 凡使用过的但仍可继续使用的零部件，除识别牌号外还应记载如下内容： 
For spare parts which had been used previously and can continue to be in use, other than the 
identification plate, the following information should also be recorded: 
 更换下来的原因。 
Reason for replacement. 
 更换之前已累计使用的时间。 
The total service time before replacement. 
 如已经过加工、翻新，加工的时间和项目。 
If it has been processed or renovated, record the time and item. 
 目前的质量或规格（尺寸等情况）。 
The currently quality or standard (conditions such as size and so on).

 今后在使用时应注意的问题。 
Problems that should pay attention with during usage hereafter. 
 各种更换下来的零部件，除明显无使用价值者经请示公司批准而作为废料处理外，
均应妥为保管，并修旧利废。如仍有使用价值，则应报请机务总管，以送厂修理
（或用于与修旧厂进行已旧换旧，调换成可用的旧件）。 
All components and parts dismantled during replacement should be kept in due care for reuse in 
repairs, but unusable components and parts are of exception, seek permission from the company and 
perform waste disposal. If they have value in use, report to the Technical Superintendent for shipyard 
repair (or perform exchange with the repair factory, to exchange for usable spare parts). 
 非正常损坏的零件，应尽可能原样保存好，以便日后分析研究其损坏原因，避免
重复损坏，或以备提请索赔（保险）时提供证据。 
Components damaged under abnormal condition should be kept as they are for further analysis as to 
the reason of damage, so as to prevent repeated damages in future. It can also be the proof for claim 
application (insurance). 
 根据备件保存的要求，定期进行清洁保养，防止锈蚀、变质、变形。使各种备件
随时处于可用状态。 
According to the requirements of the spare part keeping, perform periodic cleaning and maintenance 
to prevent it from corrosion, deterioration and deformation. All spare parts should be kept in a usable 
condition at any times.  
 登记和清点； 
Registration and making an inventory: 
 各主管轮机员、电机员应备有相应的备件清册，记载各自主管设备的备件账目。 
All concerned engineers and electricians should have a respective spare part detailed list which 
record the spare part accounts of their own equipment. 
 所有备件应在SMIS 上及时填报。名称及备件号应准确；规格要齐全，数量要准
确。备件的放置地点应注在清册的附注栏内，如存放在箱柜屉格内，应注明箱柜
屉格的编号，并要有详细的备件细目, 以便查找。 
All spare parts should be recorded in the SMIS timely. The name and spare part serial number 
should be accurate with complete specifications, and the quantity must be precise. The storage 
location of the spare parts should be indicated under the remark column of the list, such as inside 
the drawer of the cabinet, with the number of drawer indicated, and details of the spare parts should 
be included for the ease of convenience. 
 尚可使用的旧件也应登记入册，并注明质量规格或新旧程度（百分比成色）。若经
过加工，则应填注加工后的尺寸。 
Old spare parts that is still usable should be registered in the list, and indicate the quality standard 
or aging degree (Mass Percent Composition). If it has been processed, indicate the size after being 
processed. 
 凡领到或使用备件，均应及时在SMIS 中登记增消，统计并核定SMIS 中备件登
记的正确性。 
When receiving or using a spare part, the increase and decrease should be registered in the SMIS 
timely. Count and verify the accuracy of the spare part registration in the SMIS. 
 根据新购或消耗后备件的变化情况，每季度应清点备件并修改备件清册，将消耗
备件填写“备件消耗季度报表”，以SMIS 系统上报船管部。  
Make an inventory on the spare part and modify the spare part detailed list every quarter 
according to the changing conditions of newly purchase spare parts or spare parts after 
consumption. Fill in the “Spare Part Consumption Quarterly Report” and report to the Fleet

Department through the SMIS system. 
 要建立备件进、出库登记簿（草本），随时记录备件入库、消耗、出库情况 
Create a spare part storage incoming and outgoing registration book (draft), to record the storage 
incoming, consumption and outgoing of the spare part at any times.  
 新造船和新购船在接船之后，轮机长应督促各主管轮机员、电机员在最短的时间
内清点库存备件，在SMIS 中登记，并根据备件储备情况和设备实际状况提出申
购计划报公司审批，并按本制度进行管理。 
After reception of the new built ship and newly purchased ship, the Chief Engineer should 
supervise all concerned the engineers and electricians to make an inventory of the spare parts as 
soon as possible, and register in the SMIS. Submit a purchase plan according to the storage 
conditions of the spare parts and actual conditions of the equipment, to be approved by the 
company and managed under this regulation. 
1.5.5 备件的使用 
Spare Part Usage 
 更换备件，由各设备的主管轮机员、电机员对需换的零部件认真检查和测量，对照
说明书的要求, 确实不能安全使用时，经轮机长同意后方可更换。 
To replace spare part, the concerned engineers and electricians of all equipment should perform 
inspection and measurement to the components and parts seriously according to the requirements of 
the instruction. When it is confirmed to be unsafe, it can be replaced after the approval of the Chief 
Engineer. 
 凡更换重大备件应事先请示船管部同意。已经更换下来且确实不能继续使用的重大
备件，如需报废也应请示船管部同意。 
To replace an important spare part, request permission from the Fleet Department in advance. For 
important spare part dismantled during replacement and confirmed to be unusable in service, request 
permission from the Fleet Department before abandonment. 
1.5.6 质量反馈 
Quality feedback 
轮机长要对备件的质量进行全程跟踪，当发现所供备件存有质量问题时，应立即以“船
舶备件、物料反馈表”形式通过SMIS 系统报告公司船管部。若数量与签收单不符，
应以实际供应数量为准，进行签批。与此同时，采取适当措施以避免由此对船舶的正
常营运造成影响。 
The Chief Engineer and the Chief Officer should follow up the quality of the spare parts for the whole 
course. When the supplied spare part is found to have quality issue, make use of the “Ship Spare Part

2.0 船舶物料管理规则 
Ship Store Management Regulation 
2.1 目的 
Purpose 
制定船舶物料的储备、申请、审批、使用、保管、质量反馈，以保证船舶物料的供应
在数量和质量上能够满足船舶及设备维修保养的需要，从而确保船舶安全和高效地营
运。 
This regulation stipulates the application, approval, usage, keeping and quality feedback procedures of the 
ship stores, in order to guarantee the basic need of ship and equipment maintenance can be satisfied by 
the supply of ship stores in terms of quantity and quality, to ensure the ship can operate safely and 
effectively.  
2.2 适用范围 
Scope 
本规定适用于公司所管理的船舶。 
This regulation is applicable to all ships managed by the company. 
2.3 职责 
Responsibilities 
2.3.1 船管部负责船舶物料的年度额度计划和审核，供应部负责订购并保证按时供应。船管
部对船舶物料的管理、使用进行监督检查和评定。 
The Fleet Department is responsible for the annual quota plan and approval for the stores, whereas the 
Supply department is responsible for the purchase and ensure the supply on time. The Fleet Department 
supervises the inspection and evaluation to the management and usage of ship stores.  
2.3.2 船舶负责物料的申请、验收、保管和使用及报耗。 
The ship is responsible for the application, examination and reception, keeping, usage and consumption 
of the store. 
2.3.3 轮机部物料由大管轮负责管理, 机工长负责保管。 
The Second Engineer is responsible for the management of stores in the Engine Department, whereas 
the chief motorman is responsible for the keeping. 
2.3.4 甲板部物料由大副负责管理，水手长负责保管。 
The Chief Officer is responsible for the management of stores in the Deck Department, whereas the 
Boatswain is responsible for the keeping. 
2.3.5 生活物料由大副负责管理，服务生负责保管。 
The Chief Officer is responsible for the management of living stores,  the steward is responsible for the 
keeping. 
2.3.6 轮机长、大副对物料的储备、申领、使用、保管进行最终的审核和控制并对物料的质
量进行全程跟踪和反馈，以不定期的形式及时反馈给公司船管部。 
The Chief Engineer and the Chief Officer is responsible for the final verification and control to the 
storage, application, reception, usage and keeping of the stores, perform follow-up and give feedbacks 
to the quality of stores for the whole course, and give feed backs to the Fleet Department timely by an 
irregular form.

Store storage

 船舶物料的申请计划应根据航线、船存数量、维修保养计划由各部门主管人员提出

加和管理上的混乱，物料申请单应填写完整。

good, report to the department supervisor immediately and contact the supplier for replacement.

receipt.

to the Fleet Department in writing for confirmation.

Store keeping, registration and inventory

求的物料要妥善放置。

another. For bigger and heavy stores, and stores with special requirements, these should be kept with 
due care.  
 各种物料应挂识别牌号（名称、用途等）；以便准确判明其名称所属。

Chemicals management

所有化学制品应该被存放在一个指定的存储场所。易燃、易爆、易挥发或易腐蚀的物
品严格按照MSDS说明要求进行存放，酸性化学品和碱性化学品分开存放，化学品的存贮
应远离油漆和润滑油，应存贮在通风良好和安全的舱室内，在明显位置显示操作说明和危
