All chemicals should be stowed in a designated storage location. Flammable, explosive, volatile or easily 
corrosive items are stored in strict accordance with the MSDS instructions, acidic chemicals and alkaline 
chemicals are stored separately, the storage of chemicals should be away from paint and lubricating oil, should 
be stored in a well-ventilated and safe cabin, display operating instructions and hazard warnings in a prominent 
position, and prepare appropriate personnel protection devices. Information for each chemical should be 
readily available by means of the products MSDS. 
 船用化学品的供应每年集中1～2 次在方便的特价港口供应，船上每次至少申请半
年的用量。每次申请时要考虑所有品种的需要，严禁多次申请。 
The supply of marine chemicals is concentrated once or twice a year in convenient special ports, and the 
amount of use on board is applied for at least half a year each time. The needs of all varieties should be 
considered each time of application, and multiple applications are strictly prohibited. 
 船舶需对船用化学品的有效期进行检查，确保产品处在质量有效期范围内。要求
船舶在接收新供船用化学品时，将供船日期标注在产品外包装上，将开桶（罐）启用
日期标注在外包装上，凡自供船日期起超过5 年或自启用日期起超过2 年的均认为过
了有效期，船舶应立即停止使用该包装的化学品，封存并报告公司主管部门安排退岸
处置。 
Ships are required to check the expiry date of marine chemicals to ensure that the product is within the 
validity period of quality. Ships are required to mark the date of supply to ships on the outer packaging of 
the product when receiving new chemicals for shipping, and the date of opening of barrels (cans) on the 
outer packaging, where more than 5 years from the date of supply to the ship or more than 2 years from 
the date of use are deemed to have passed the validity period, the ship should immediately stop using the 
chemicals in this package, seal and report to the competent department of the company to arrange for the 
disposal of the shore. 
 任何发生化学品或混有化学品的溢出清理，特别注意PPE 和清理方法必须进行风
险评估。 
Any spillage occurs or mixing of chemicals special attention to PPE and clean-up methods must be risk 
assessed. 
 化学品存放地点应注意通风，要做到标准化管理，由相关主管人员负责造册登记。
物品在仓库中要堆放整齐并建立物资卡片，做到帐、物、卡相符。存放现场应有防护
服（塑料围裙）、护目镜、手套、面罩和清水等。存放现场每一品种的化学品都有材料
安全数据单（MSDS）。 
Chemical storage sites should pay attention to ventilation, to achieve standardized management, and the 
relevant supervisors are responsible for making records and registering. Items should be stacked neatly in 
the warehouse and material cards should be established to ensure that the accounts, objects, and cards 
match. Protective clothing (plastic apron), goggles, gloves, respirators and water should be available at 
the storage site. Every variety of chemicals stored on site has a Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS). 
 容器在使用后必须标识、密封和固定。MSDS 应张贴在每种类型的化学品附近，并
强调每种化学品的特殊危险。 
Containers must be identified, sealed and secured after use. MSDS are to be posted up adjacent to each 
type of chemical and the particular dangers of each are to be highlighted. 
 使用时应防止化学品与眼睛、皮肤及衣着接触。处理时要戴上橡皮手套和护目镜。

2.5.3 管理腐蚀性、酸性和其它有害物品 
HANDLING CAUSTICS, ACIDS & OTHER HAZARDOUS MATERIALS  
在舱储、管理和使用腐蚀性、酸性和其它有害化学品时必须特别注意，因为除少数外
他们都能引起人身伤害。他们具有腐蚀、高度挥发性和严重刺激皮肤、眼睛和呼吸道。即
使有急救也经常造成严重损伤。当可能接触腐蚀性和酸性物时，请高度重视和小心，并参
考如下。 
Caustics, acids and other hazardous chemicals must receive special attention in storage, handling and use, 
because with few exceptions they can cause immediate harm to personnel. They are corrosive, highly volatile 
and severely irritating to the skin, eyes and respiratory tract. Often significant injury may occur even before 
first aid can be applied. This standard should serve as a reminder to exercise utmost caution and care when 
possible exposure to caustics and acids exist. 
 需要保护眼睛。面罩和防护镜能提供进一步保护。 
Eye protection is required. A face shield and goggles provide superior protection. 
 用抗化学品的手套防护双手。 
Hands must be protected by the use of chemical resistant gloves. 
 用抗化学品的围裙和胶靴保护好身体。 
Body protection shall consist of chemical resistant aprons and rubber boots. 
 使用过浓酸的房间必须打开或良好通风。 
Rooms in which concentrated acids are used must be open or well ventilated. 
 容器必须有合适的装置能安全消除泄露及泼洒的物品以减小危险。 
Containers must have suitable means to allow extracting the material in a safe manner to minimize 
risk if spillage and splashing. 
 打开容器时要穿防护装备，因为内在压力可能引起喷洒。 
Wear protective equipment when opening containers, because of the possibility of internal pressure 
which may cause spraying. 
 在稀释某种酸时，将酸向水里倒并不停搅拌。决不能向强酸中倒水。 
When diluting an acid, pour the acid into the water, stirring constantly. Never pour water into a 
strong acid. 
 在调制腐蚀性物质时，通常是向水中慢慢加腐蚀性物质以减小泼溅的危险。决不
能向腐蚀性物质中加水。 
When mixing caustic, always add the caustic to the water, slowly, to minimize risk of splashing. 
Never add water to caustics. 
 一定要遵照容器上的调制说明 
Always follow any mixing directions that may be on the container. 
 所有保留船上的空容器要彻底冲洗以消除任何残留物，如果打算做它用，则必须
用高压空气清除里边的残留气体。 
All empty containers retained on board should be rinsed and washed thoroughly to eliminate any 
residue. If they are intended for other use, they must also be purged of any residual gases by 
introducing compressed fresh air. 
 当用火、动力工具或锤子/錾子等割开或改装空容器时，容器的所有开口必须保持
开着。

When empty containers are to be cut or altered using a flame, power tools or hammer/chisel, all 
openings to the container must be kept uncovered.  
 如果身体接触了酸或腐蚀性物质，用清水冲洗受影响的部位15到20分钟。这一点
对眼睛是尤为重要。 
If acids or caustics come into contact with the body, flush the affected parts for 15 to 20 minutes 
with clean water. This is particularly important for the eyes. 
 
3 
备件物料绑扎固定安全规定 
Safety regulations for storing and securing of spare parts and materials 
船舶机舱备件、物料、钢板的储存、绑扎、固定程序十分重要，以确保船舶运行安全和顺利,避免
钢板、备件、物料处理不当导致严重伤害。 
The procedures for storing, lashing and securing of spare parts, materials and steel plates in the engine 
room of a ship are very important to ensure safe and smooth operation of the ship. Prevent improper 
handling of steel plate, spare parts and materials from causing serious injury. 
3.1 储存程序Storage procedures:  
a. 分类储存Categorized storage： 
将备件和物料按照种类、尺寸、重量等特征进行分类，便于管理和取用。 
Spare parts and materials are categorized according to type, size, weight 
and other characteristics for easy management and access. 
b. 定期检查Regular Inspection： 
定期检查储存区域，确保备件和物料处于良好状态，避免受潮、受潮、腐蚀等问
题。  
Regularly inspect the storage area to ensure that the spare parts and 
materials are in good condition and to avoid problems such as moisture, 
dampness and corrosion. 
c. 标记清晰Clear marking： 
在储存区域标明备件名称、规格、数量等信息，以便快速识别。 
Mark the name, specification, quantity and other information of spare parts 
in the storage area for quick identification.  
d. 防潮防湿Moisture and humidity prevention： 
采取措施，如防潮剂、密封储存容器等，避免备件受潮。 
Take measures, such as moisture-proofing agents and sealing storage 
containers, to avoid moisture exposure of spare parts.  
e. 避免混淆Avoid confusion： 
避免将不同类型的备件混放在一起，以免混淆和错误使用。 
Avoid mixing different types of spare parts together to avoid confusion 
and misuse. 
3.2 绑扎程序lashing procedure： 
a. 选择合适的绑扎材料Selection of suitable lashing materials： 
根据备件的特性和重量，选择合适的绑扎材料，如钢筋、角铁、花篮螺丝、钢丝
绳等。 
According to the characteristics and weight of the spare parts, select 
suitable lashing materials, such as steel wire rope, nylon rope and so on.  
 
b. 正确绑扎位置Correct lashing position： 
将备件固定在合适的位置，避免在船舶运行过程中出现移动或者碰撞。

themselves. 
d. 定期检查绑扎情况Regular checking of the lashing condition: 
在船舶运行期间，定期检查绑扎情况，确保备件的稳定性。 
During the operation of the vessel, check the lashing condition regularly 
to ensure the stability of the spare parts. 
3.3 固定程序Securing procedure： 
a. 选择合适的固定装置Select suitable securing devices： 
根据备件的特性和重量，选择合适的固定装置，如吊具、支架等。 
Select suitable securing devices, such as spreaders, brackets, etc., 
according to the characteristics and weight of the spare parts. 
b. 确保固定位置牢固Ensure the securing position is firm： 
在选择固定位置时，要确保其结构牢固，能够承受备件的重量和运动。 
when choosing the securing position, make sure its structure is firm and 
can bear the weight and movement of the spare parts.   
c. 合理布局Reasonable layout： 
根据备件的大小和形状，合理安排固定位置，避免相互干扰或者碰撞。 
According to the size and shape of the spare parts, arrange the fixing 
position reasonably to avoid mutual interference or collision. 
 
定期检查固定装置Regular inspection of fixtures： 
定期检查固定装置的状态，确保其稳定性和可靠性。 
Regularly inspect the status of fixtures to ensure their stability and 
reliability.

绑扎、固定过程中，也要注意人员安全，避免发生意外 
The above procedures should be adapted and implemented according to the situation of the specific ship 
and the characteristics of the spare parts. At the same time, in the process of storage, lashing and securing, 
attention should be paid to personnel safety to avoid accidents.

第04 节  船舶保养油漆管理和使用的规定 
Section 04  Ship Paint Management and Usage Regulation 
 
1.0 目的： 
Purpose: 
规定油漆的订购、使用和保养要求，以保证保养油漆满足船舶维护保养的需要。 
This regulation stipulates the purchase, usage and maintenance requirements of the paints, to ensure the 
paint is able to satisfy the needs of ship maintenance. 
2.0 适用范围： 
Scope: 
本规定适用于公司所管理的船舶。 
This regulation is applicable to all ships managed by the company. 
3.0 职责： 
Responsibilities: 
3.1 全船油漆由大副负责统一申请和监督管理。 
The Chief Officer is responsible for unified application and supervision management of all paints on the 
ship. 
3.2 甲板部的油漆由水手长负责管理、发放、监督使用。 
Boatswain is responsible for management, distribution and supervision on usage of all paints in the Deck 
Department. 
3.3 轮机部的油漆由水手长负责管理，机工长负责领取、监督使用。 
Boatswain is responsible for paint management in the Engine Department, whereas the Chief Motorman 
is responsible for reception and supervision on usage. 
4.0 实施步骤： 
Procedures: 
4.1 油漆供应与申请 
Supply and application of paint 
4.1.1 船舶油漆的供应，根据船舶维护保养的工作量及需除锈的面积制定船舶油漆供应量。 
The supply of ship paint is arranged according to the ship maintenance working load and the areas in 
need of rust removal.  
4.1.2 轮机部的保养油漆做出计划，送交大副统一制定计划报船管部。 
The paint maintenance plan of the Engine Department should be submitted to the Chief Officer. The 
Chief Officer will make a unify development plan and report to the Fleet Department. 
4.1.3 在申请时应充分考虑到可能的小品种油漆，避免多次供应造成费用增加。 
During the application, please consider the possible use of less popular paint, to prevent the increase of 
cost due to multi times supply. 
4.2 油漆的管理 
Paint management  
4.2.1 建立油漆申领记录，内容包括：购漆日期、地点、油漆厂商名称、油漆品种、规格、
数量等。记录油漆生产批号和生产日期。 
Create a record for paint reception, the content should include: purchase date, location, the name of the 
paint manufacturer, the type of paint, description, quantity and so on. 
4.2.2 建立油漆消耗记录，内容包括：涂漆部位和面积、漆种、数量使用日期。 
Create a record for paint consumption, the content should include: the parts to be painted, area, the type 
of paint, quantity and the date of usage. 
4.2.3 对于长期没有使用的油漆，应存放在远离高温的环境、通风并有灭火装置的专用油漆

4.2.6 油漆的消耗和库存数量应在SMIS 中登记。

4.3 船舶保养油漆使用注意事项 
Precautions on the ship maintenance management and usage 
4.3.1 为了确保除锈油漆的效果，提高船舶的维护保养水平，对除锈油漆工作要求如下： 
To ensure the effect of rust removal painting and improve the ship maintenance level, the requirements 
of rust removal painting construction listed as followed: 
 除锈时必须完全、彻底，保养过的部位要不留死角，决不允许带锈涂漆，对局部
除锈的部位，必须将除锈区域边缘暴起的老锈皮彻底铲除后，才能补漆。 
Rust removal must be complete and thorough. Do not leave out dead zones in the area which have 
already gone through maintenance. Do not paint when the rusts have not been removed. For areas 
with partial rust, the old rust at the edge of rusting zone must be removed thoroughly before 
painting.  
 除锈后对除锈部位彻底清洁。清除表面的污垢油迹和盐分，保证表面无任何杂物，
方可进行涂漆，如果有条件，最好先用淡水清洗，干燥后进行涂漆。 
After rust removal, clean the parts thoroughly. Remove dirt, oil stains and salt on the surface. Paint 
only after ensuring there is nothing on the surface. If possible, wash by fresh water, and paint after it 
is dry. 
 除锈当天必须涂上底漆，如果条件允许，按照说明书的要求，当天应涂上面漆，
防止夜间因上浪、结露或下雨而使除锈部位返锈，影响油漆效果。 
Undercoat must be painted on the same day of dust removal. If possible, paint the final coating that 
day according to the requirements of the instruction. This is to prevent the parts to rust again due to 
waves, dews or rains during the night, which influence the effect of paints. 
 全船各保养场所要及时局部除锈、涂漆，以不见锈迹为原则，保证船舶在任何情
况下，不能有锈迹出现。 
All ship areas under maintenance should undergo partial rust removal and painting. The principle is

4.3.2 环氧油漆的使用和用量要求： 
The requirements of usage and use level of the epoxy paint: 
 环氧漆必须两种组分按比例混合后方可使用，在混合后存在化学自然凝固现象，
因此环氧漆在使用过程中，必须用多少调多少，随用随调。 
The epoxy paint must be mixed with two components by ratio before use. Chemical natural 
coagulation will occur after blending, so during the usage of epoxy paint, only blend the amount 
needed. 
 施工参数： 
Process of construction: 
施工方法； 无气喷涂 
Construction method: airless spray painting 
混合比率（体积比）A 组份（基料）：B 组份（固化剂）=7：1 
Blending rate (volume ratio) Constituent A (base material) : Constituent B (hardener) = 7 : 1 
备注：* 基料和固化剂混合后温度为15°C 以上，否则需添加溶剂以达到正确的
粘度。 
Remarks: After the base material and hardener blends mixed, the temperature will be 15
оC or above. 
Or else, more dissolvent should be added to attain the accurate viscosity. 
* 过多的溶剂会导致抗流挂性降低，且固化缓慢。 
Too much dissolvent will result in the reduction of anti-sagging and slow solidification.  
* 如需要，混合后应加入额外的溶剂。 
If necessary, add extra solvent after mixing. 
 表面处理：动力工具处理至St2 级，无氧化皮。提高表面处理等级会提高性能。
用于旧的涂层系统时，表面必须清洁干燥。 
Surface treatment: power tool to the level St2, scale free. Increase of the surface treatment level will 
lead to an increase in the performance. To apply it to the old coating system, the surface must be 
clean and dry. 
 施工条件：底材温度应在10°C 以上，比空气露点温度高出至少3°C，温度和相
对湿度要在底材附近测量。在狭窄部位施工时，应保持通风良好。溶剂从漆膜中
挥发前不要使用热空气，以避免表面干燥，使溶剂截留。完全固化前不接触油和
化学品，不承受机械压力。 
Construction condition: the steel temperature should be 10
оC or above, at least 3
оC higher than the 
air dew point. Measure the temperature and relative humidity near the steel. When the construction 
is operated in narrow space, maintain a good ventilation. Before the dissolvent volatilized from the 
varnishes, hot-air is prohibited from usage to prevent the occurrence of dry surface which holds back 
the dissolvent. Before completely harden to ensure there is no contact with oil and chemical and no 
physical stress on the surface. 
 干燥时间：干燥时间一般和空气流通、温度、膜厚和涂层数有关，并且相应地受
到这些因素的影响。如施工前表面无粉化和其它污物，一般无复涂间隔限制。在
前道油漆固化前施工后道油漆会取得最佳的层间附着力。如油漆受阳光直射一段
时间，必需注意表面清洁，取得良好的附着力。 
Drying duration: The drying duration concerns the ventilation, temperature, the thickness of 
varnishes and the layers of coating, and is influenced by these factors correspondingly. If there is no 
powder or other dirt on the surface before the construction, generally there is no limitation on the 
time interval between the layers of coating. Perform a new coating before the paint solidifies can 
attain the best layer-to-layer adhesion. If the paint is shot by the sunlight directly for a period of time,

Do not use too much paint thinner during construction. It should be controlled at the range of

第05 节 船舶电气设备管理注意事项 
Section 05  Ship Electrical Equipment Management Precautions 
 
1.0 适用范围：  
Scope 
本规定适用于公司所管理的船舶。 
This regulation is applicable to all ships managed by the company. 
2.0 职责： 
Responsibilities: 
本规定由电机员负责执行，轮机长具有监督职能。 
This regulation is executed by the Electrician Engineer, and to be supervised by the Chief Engineer. 
3.0 实施步骤： 
Implementation Procedures: 
3.1 船舶电站的管理 
Ship power station Management  
3.1.1 发电机轴承要定期加油，时间为3 个月，其他设备半年。 
Top up oil to the generator bearing every three months periodically, whereas the duration is half year for 
other equipment. 
3.1.2 发电机滑环碳刷的磨损不能超过原长度的2/3。 
The worn-out part of the generator’s slip ring carbon brush should not exceed 2two/3third of the 
original length. 
3.1.3 发电机的各接线端定期清洁并对接线排进行紧固。 
Perform periodic cleaning to all generator terminals, and  
3.1.4 发电机的电气运行保护装置厂修时应校验。 
The electrical operation protective device of the generator should be inspected during shipyard repairs. 
3.1.5 发电机应定期进厂进行检修提高绝缘。 
Generator should go through periodic inspection in the shipyard in order to increase insulation. 
3.1.6 配电板，船舶进厂时应进行清洁并紧固接线端。 
Switchboard should be cleaned and terminal post should be strengthened during shipyard repairs. 
3.2 用电设备 
Electrical equipment  
3.2.1 船舶所有用电设备每季度要进行绝缘测量，填报电气设备绝缘测量记录。 
Insulation test must be performed on all electrical equipment on the ship every quarter, and fill in the 
“Electrical Equipment Insulation Measurement Record Book”. 
3.2.2 对于绝缘低于规定值的电气设备要查找绝缘下降的原因，并采取措施消除缺陷。 
If the insulation value of the electrical equipment falls below the requirement, inspection must be 
carried out to find out the cause, and take measures to eliminate the deficiency. 
3.2.3 对于发现用电设备的绝缘突然恶化，尽管没有超过低于规定的绝缘值，也必须查找原
因。 
If the insulation of the electrical equipment is found to be worsened suddenly, even the insulation value 
has not fallen below the requirement, inspection must be carried out to find out the cause. 
3.2.4 电机员应充分考虑工作场所对用电设备造成的油、油气、水气等的污染情况，定期对
用电设备进行拆检和进行必要的修理。 
Electricians should consider the workplace pollution conditions caused to the electrical equipment, such 
as oil, oil vapor, water vapor and so on. Perform periodic overhaul to the electrical equipment and 
necessary repairs.

3.3 电气控制和检测设备 
Electrical Control and Equipment Inspection 
3.3.1 应至少每半年检查一次各控制电器元件的接线是否牢固和动作是否灵活(正常情况)。 
Perform inspection on the wires which controls the electrical components, to ensure whether they are 
secure and of flexible motions (normal condition) at least once every half year. 
3.3.2 应每季度检查一次各控制箱的接线，检查接线、继电器等部位（正常情况）。 
Inspect the wires in all control boxes every quarter. Inspect the parts such as wires and relays (normal 
condition). 
3.3.3 各安全警报监测、监控装置，每月进行效能试验，每半年检查、测量和校验各传感元
件的情况，并记录“设备报警和安全保护装置试验记录”。 
Electrician Engineer should test all safety alarm monitor and control device monthly and 
check/measure/calibrate the sensor and its component every six monthly. A recorded in the “Equipment 
Alarm and Safety Protection Device Testing Record” should well be maintained. 
3.3.4 曲拐箱油雾探测器应在启动前给予调试，每航次擦拭透镜及透镜室。 
The crankcase oil mist detector should be adjusted and tested before operation. Optical lens and optical 
lens room should be wiped every voyage. 
3.3.5 机舱火警警报应每周进行效能试验。机舱和舱室烟雾报警每季度进行测试（如警报点
或检测点较多可按照编号顺序进行抽查），无论如何，每季度要求覆盖全部警报点或
检测点，并对各感受元件检查清洁。并填报“火灾检测探头检查表”和“火灾报警按
钮检查表”。 
The fire alarm of the engine room should go through efficiency test every week. Buoyant smoke alarm 
of the engine room and cabins should be tested every quarter (if there are many alarms or control points, 
selective examination can be conducted according to the code number in chronological order). In any 
case, all alarms and control points must be tested every quarter, and all sensing components should be 
inspected and cleaned. Fill in the “Fire Detection Probe Checklist” and “Fire Alarm Manual Call Point 
Checklist”. 
3.4 照明设备 
Light Equipment  
3.4.1 所有工作场所和公共生活场所的照明随时进行检查，更换损坏的灯具。 
Perform inspection to the lightings in all working area and living area at any times, and replace the 
damaged lamps. 
3.4.2 船员居室的照明设备的损坏由居住人进行检查并报告，以便电机员及时修复。 
As to the damages to the lightings in the crew’s cabin, it should be inspected and reported by the 
resident, so that the electricians can repair it timely. 
3.4.3 船员居室不得使用大功率的电气设备，私自布设电线和照明设备。若确实需要时必须
经电机员同意。 
High-power electrical equipment should not be used in the crew’s cabin. Implementation of electrical 
wires and lighting equipment without permission is prohibited. If necessary, approval from the 
electrician must be made. 
3.4.4 应急供电和照明应定期进行试验并保持记录。 
Perform periodic testing to the emergency power supply and lightings, and take record accordingly.

第06 节 船舶进水报警装置及其排水系统维护规定 
Section 06  Maintenance Regulations on the Water Ingress Detecting System 
 
1.0 目的  
Purpose 
确保船舶进水报警装置及其排水系统处于正常、有效的状态。  
Ensure the water ingress detecting system are in normal and effective condition. 
2.0 适用范围  
Scope 
公司所有船舶的进水报警装置及其排水系统，应包括安装在货舱及其他舱室（例如：
首尖舱、水手长库房）的进水报警装置及其排水系统。  
All water ingress detecting system, including the one installed in the cargo hold and other cabins (e.g. 
fore peak tank and boatswain’s storehouse). 
3.0 职责  
Responsibility 
大副是船舶进水报警装置及其排水系统的负责人，负责“船舶进水报警装置及其排水
系统检修、试验记录簿”的记录和保管；负责设备检查、维护保养工作。  
The Chief Officer is the supervisor for the water ingress detecting system, responsible for record and 
keeping of “Water Ingress Detecting System Examination, Repairs and Testing Record Book”; 
responsible for equipment inspection and maintenance work. 
电机员负责电器部分的检查、维护保养，并为大副提供技术支持。  
Electrician is responsible for the inspection and maintenance of the electrical appliances, and provide 
technical support to the Chief Officer. 
4.0 检查和维护管理  
Inspection and Maintenance Management  
4.1 大副在装、卸货前提醒作业人员注意避免对货舱内的电缆管及探头造成损坏，对于卸
完货的舱室尽快安排有关人员进行检查，发现问题及时纠正，如果船上纠正困难时立
即与船管部机务总管人员联系，请求岸基支持。  
Before cargo loading and discharging, the Chief Officer should remind the cargo operator to pay attention 
in order to prevent damages to the electrical cable and probe, arrange the concerned personnel to perform 
inspection to the cargo holds and cabins as soon as possible after cargo discharged. When problem is 
found, correct it timely. If there is difficulty in correction, contact the concerned Technical Superintendent 
of the Fleet Department immediately, and seek for shore-based support. 
4.2 每次卸完货后洗舱时，对探头安装底座内外、大滤器以及探头滤器进行冲洗，避免积
存货物或泥沙；由于探头为压力式传感器，当过多的货物粘结在探头感压片上时，会
产生较大的压力，导致误报警。  
Every time when washing cargo holds after cargo finished discharging, wash inside and outside the 
probe mount set, big strainer and the probe strainer, to prevent the pile up of cargo residue or mud and 
sand. Since the probe is a potentiometric transducer, when too much cargo sticks on the pressure sensor, 
it produces a larger pressure and leads to false alarm. 
4.3 每航次装货前电机员协助大副进行检查和功能试验，注意检查液位传感器的密封盖、
接线入口等部位的密封情况，发现密封损坏及时修复。  
Every voyage before cargo loading, the electrician as an assistance with the Chief Officer to perform 
inspection and functional test. Pay attention to the sealing condition of the sealing grand and wire inlet of 
the level gauge. If the seal is found to be damaged, repair it timely.

第07 节 货舱舱盖维护保养规定 
Section 07 Hatch Cover Maintenance Regulation 
 
1 
目的Purpose 
保障船舶和货物的安全，加强对货船舱口盖、舱口围板、甲板开口装置及其附属
装置的维护保养，保证其处于良好的状态。 
This regulation guarantees the ship and cargo safety, strengthen the cargo ship maintenance of hatch 
cover, hatch coaming, deck opening device and other auxiliary device, and ensure they are in good 
condition. 
2 
适用范围Scope 
本须知适用于公司所管理的船舶。 
This regulation is applicable to all ships managed by the company. 
3 
职责Responsibilities 
3.1 
大副负责舱盖、舱盖的运动部件、封舱围紧、舱口围板结构和拉动舱盖链条(钢丝)
的日常维护保养工作。 
The Chief Officer is responsible for the routine maintenance work of hatch cover, moving parts of 
hatch cover, cleat, hatch coaming structure and hatch cover chain (wire).  
3.2 
轮机长负责舱盖开关舱驱动装置及其液压系统的维护保养工作。 
The Chief Engineer is responsible for the maintenance of hatch cover operation driving device and 
its hydraulic system. 
4 
维护保养计划和记录Maintenance Plan and Record 
4.1 
舱盖的检查和维护保养是船舶维护保养系统的一个重要组成部分，船管部机务总
管负责跟踪保养情况。 
The inspection and maintenance of the hatch cover is one important part of the ship maintenance 
system. The Fleet Department is responsible to follow up the maintenance condition. 
4.2 
按照MSC 169 (79)通函决议要求，散货船必须制订一份《散货船舱盖维护保养计
划》，该计划包含舱盖的形式、型号、规格参数及各部件的维护保养内容、周期、
检查内容和周期，舱盖的维修记录等。 
According to the requirements of MSC 169 (79) resolution, the bulk carrier should develop a “Bulk 
Carrier Hatch Cover Maintenance Plan”, which includes the layout, model, standard of the hatch 
cover; the maintenance content and cycle, as well as inspection content and cycle for all parts; the 
maintenance record of the hatch cover and so on. 
4.3 
大副根据本船货舱舱盖的结构及形式，制订《散货船舱盖维护保养计划》，该计划
需经船长确认，并得到公司机务总管的审核批准。 
The Chief Officer should develop the “Bulk Carrier Hatch Cover Maintenance Plan” according to 
the structure and layout of the ship’s cargo hatch cover. The plan is subject to the confirmation of the 
Master, and review and approval of the company’s Technical Superintendent.  
4.4 
大副根据《散货船舱盖维护保养计划》的要求进行实施，并做好相关记录。 
The Chief Officer should execute according to the requirements laid out in “Bulk Carrier Hatch 
Cover Maintenance Plan” and record accordingly.  
4.5 
船长和机务总管进行监督。 
The Master and the Technical Suprintendent are responsible for supervision.  
5 
实施步骤Procedures 
5.1 
对舱盖的检查和维护保养工作如下： 
Inspection and maintenance work of the hatch cover are as follow: 
5.1.1 
舱盖结构、舱口围板及附属装置的外表面涂层状况，水手长负责每周对表面涂层

常用测试方法如下： 
common test methods are described below: 
⚫  观测法 Observational method 
这主要是针对日常维护保养中所进行的一种水密性监测，通过检查舱盖及舱
口固板上各部分，找出隐患，发现漏水处。 
This is mainly for a kind of watertight monitoring carried out in daily maintenance， by 
inspecting the various parts of the hatch cover to find hidden dangers and find water leaks 
主要方法:开舱之后检查舱盖各部分锈蚀状况。 
The main method is to check the rust condition of each part of the hatch cover after open. 
特别是舱盖连接部位，密封橡胶带是否老化、脱落；压紧钢条是否有缺陷； 
In particular, the connecting part of the hatch cover attachment, whether the sealing rubber 
belt is aging or falling off; Whether the pressed steel bar is defective； 
封舱设备是否齐全、正常等；据此来判断舱盖等处是否有漏水处的存在。 
Whether the sealing equipment is complete and normal, etc.; According to this, determine 
whether there is a leakage in the hatch cover, etc. 
如果阳光比较强烈还可以将舱口关闭井封舱后，检查人员进入舱内，

若发现舱盖与舱口围板之间有漏光现象，则表明此处为漏水处。

location. 
再有根据船舶运送货物表面出现无规则而又集中某处的水湿痕迹来判断是否

Or according to the surface of the goods transported by the ship appeared irregular and 
concentrated in a certain place of water wet marks, to determine whether it was due to the 
leakage of the hatch cover. 
这种检查是必要有效的，能准确地发现漏水处，及时采取措施，保证船舶的
安全航行。 
This inspection is necessary and effective, can accurately detect the leaks, timely measures to

⚫ 痕迹测试 Chalk test 
利用粉笔的痕迹来检测密封橡胶带是否水密。 
Use traces of chalk to check whether the sealing rubber strip is watertight. 
其方法是用粉笔在舱口围板上的压紧钢条上和舱盖间连接部位的压紧钢条上
涂出粉痕，关闭舱盖并封舱，然后打开舱盖，查看舱盖上的密封橡胶带是否
有粉笔痕迹。若有，则表明此处在封舱状态下处于封闭状态；若无，则表明
此处在封舱状态下存有空隙，也就是说此处为漏水处。此方法操作简单易行，
无需配备其他专门设备来试验，不受船舶舱内装载状况限制和天气温度的影
响。其不足之处是可靠性和准确度不太高，不能反映出舱盖密封程度，单纯
反映压紧钢条与密封橡胶带是否接触，不能测试出舱盖其他部位由于严重锈
蚀而产生的漏水孔。 
The method is to use chalk to apply powder marks on the pressed steel bar on the hatch 
coaming and the connection between the hatch cover, close the hatch cover and seal, and then 
open the hatch cover to see if there are chalk marks on the sealed rubber strip. If there are 
chalk marks, it indicates that the place is watertight when it is closed; If there are no chalk 
marks, it indicates that the place has a gap in the closed state, which means that it is not 
watertight, this method is simple and easy to operate, does not require additional specialized 
equipment to test, and is not affected by the limitations of the ship's loading conditions and 
weather temperatures. Its disadvantages are that the reliability and accuracy are not too high, 
can not reflect the degree of sealing of the hatch, simply reflect whether the pressed steel bar 
and the sealing rubber strip are in contact, can not test other leakage of the hatch cover due to 
serious rust. 
⚫ 冲水试验 Hose test 
它是利用具有一定压力的水龙带水柱冲射舱盖有关部位，检测舱盖各部分是
否水密。此方法是船舶检验部门检验舱盖水密性的试验方法。工作中可以根
据舱盖说明书要求进行冲水实验，另外也可以按照下列方法进行： 
将舱盖关闭，用压紧器压紧。一根消防水龙带着一个直径不小于12.5 毫米的
喷射型喷嘴。向消防水带提供0.2Mpa 的水压，然后在舱口盖侧面和密封件
的交叉连接处进行喷射，大约距离待测区域1-1.5 米，同时以缓慢的行走速
度移动，检查是否有漏水现象。这也是一种行之有效的监测水密性的方法。 
The principle is to use the hose water with certain pressure to jet the hatch cover, in order to 
test whether the parts of the hatch cover are watertight. This is the method to test the water 
tightness of the hatch cover by the ship survey department. The hose test can be carried out 
according to the requirements of the hatch cover manual during the work, and the following 
methods can also be used: 
Hatch covers are closed and cleated. A fire hose is rigged with a jet type nozzle fitted with a 
diameter not less than 12.5mm. Water pressure of 0.2Mpa is supplied to fire hose, which is 
then played at the hatch cover sides and cross joints in way of the seals, approximately 
1-1.5meters away from the area to be tested while moving at a slow walking speed to check 
whether there is a water leakage. This is also a proven method for monitoring water tightness. 
试验时应注意以下几点： 
The following points should be noted when testing: 
a. 
冬季不宜采用， 由于天冷，易发生冷冻现象，影响试验效果； 
It should not be used in winter, because it is cold, and it is easy to freeze and affect the test 
effect. 
b. 
应在舱内无货时进行，以免发生不必要的货损； 
It should be carried out when there is no cargo in the hold to avoid unnecessary damage to

The personnel inside and outside of the hold should cooperate well and carefully. 
 
⚫ 超声波试验  Ultrasonic test 
此种监测方法需要超声波设备。它由一个发射机和一个探头所组成。 
The test method need ultrasonic equipment. It consists of a transmitter and a receiver. 
试验时，将发射机置于舱内，此时应按海上航行状态封舱，探头由试验人手
持，沿舱盖各部位行走，根据探头发出声音大小或显示屏上的分贝值来判断
舱盖是否有密封不好之处。正常时，探头的声音像收音机调谐不好发出的低
噪音，若有漏孔存在时，噪声增大，再靠近舱盖，根据显示分贝值的最大位
置而断定漏孔处的位置。此方法能达到与冲水试验同样效果，国外的大型散
装干货船普遍采用此种方法试验。其特点是单人可进行、不受气温、装载状
况的影响。 
During the test, the transmitter should be placed in the hold. At this time, the hold should be 
sealed according to the state of sea navigation. The receiver should be held by the tester and 
walk along various parts of the hatch cover. Normally, the sound of the receiver is like the low 
noise emitted by the radio tuning is not good, if there is a leak hole, the noise increases, and 
then close to the hatch cover, according to the maximum position of the display decibel value 
and determine the location of the leak hole. This method can achieve the same effect as the 
hose test. It is widely used in large bulk cargo ships abroad. It is characterized by a single 
person can be carried out, not affected by temperature, loading conditions.

每航次进行下列检查和维护保养工作,根据检查结果填写“散货船舱盖维护保养检
查表”并在《航海日志》上记录。 
Perform the following inspection and maintenance work every voyage, fill in the “Bulk Carrier 
Hatch Cover Maintenance Checklist” according to the inspection results and record in the “Deck 
Log Book”.  
1） 舱盖滚轮及销轴、导向轮及销轴、链条滚轮及销轴之间，舱盖盖板铰链及其
他活动部件加注润滑油脂涂； 
Add lubricating oil and smear it between hatch cover roller and the pin, guide wheel and the 
pin, chain roller and the pin, the hatch cover’s hinge pintle and other motion parts. 
2） 舱口围紧螺纹检查，活动部位（包括螺纹涂牛油）； 
Inspect the hatch cover cleat and motion parts (including to grease the thread); 
3） 保持活动部件表面清洁、无残留碎片、无活动障碍； 
Maintain the surface of motion parts clean without remaining fragments or disturbance in 
motion; 
4） 舱盖纵向、横向及中间交接处的密封胶条、胶条接头、压头进行检查，发现胶条脱落
及时粘补，对老化或已永久变形的胶条进行换新； 
Perform inspection on the sealing tape, connection and pressure head located at the 
longitudinal, transverse and central connections of the hatch covers. If the sealing tape is 
found to be fallen off, remedy them timely. For sealing tape which have aged or deformed, 
replace them with new one; 
5） 保持流水槽畅通，流水槽的止回阀进行检查疏通，保持其有效；

注意事项Precautions 
1） 在更换胶条前要纠正胶条槽和舱盖与舱口围接触的部位的缺陷，否则新的胶
条在短时间内还会损坏； 
Before replacing the rubber packing, rectify the deficiency at the parts where rubber slot 
touches the hatch cover and hatch coaming. Or else, the rubber packing will be damaged 
again within a short period of time; 
2） 发现损坏的胶条立即更换，更换的长度不能少于1 米； 
When damage is found on the rubber packing, the length of replacement should be no less 
than 1 meter; 
3） 不要将油漆或润滑油涂到胶条上； 
Do not smear paint or lubricating oil to the rubber packing; 
4） 在舱盖打开后一定要插上保险销； 
Safety pin must be locked after the opening of hatch cover; 
5） 装在舱盖上的货物应符合设计的要求，并按《系固手册》的要求进行帮扎紧
固； 
Cargo on the hatch cover should fulfil the design requirement. Perform lashing on the cargo 
according to the requirements laid out in the “Cargo Securing Manual”. 
6） 在舱盖上装载货物时，舱盖围紧仍然要上紧。 
Hatch cover cleat must be tightened when loading cargo on the hatch cover. 
7） 在换新舱口围紧的橡胶垫块时，应注意同一舱口更换相同位置的垫块，防止
造成上紧后受力不均匀，局部超负荷； 
When replacing the rubber pad of the hatch cleat, pay attention to replace the pads of the same 
location at the same hatch, to prevent the uneven distribution of stress after tightening which 
may lead to overloading; 
8） 应经常检查各舱口围紧的上紧力度，尽量使之均匀受力； 
Always perform inspection on the tightening level of each hatch cover cleat so that the stress 
is well-distributed; 
9） 经常检查和调整链条的长度，使之均匀受力，防止超负荷，甚至造成舱盖跑
出轨道。 
Always perform inspection and adjustment on the length of the chain so that the stress is 
well-distributed and thus prevent overloading. Or else, the hatch cover may run out of the 
guide rail. 
10） 经常检查舱盖滚轮的情况，发现滚轮变形、偏移或轴承损坏，应及时换新或
修理，防止增大舱盖的阻力而引起开关舱困难。 
Always inspect the conditions of hatch cover rollers. If the rollers are found to be out of shape, 
drifting or having damage in the bearing, repair or replace them timely. It can avoid the 
difficulty in hatch operation due to an increase of hatch cover resistance.

第08 节 船舶修理须知  
Section 08  Ship Repairs Safety Instruction 
 
1.0 目的：  
Purpose: 
保证船舶的厂修顺利，按期保质完成修理任务。  
This instruction ensures the smooth operation of the shipyard repairs, and complete the repair duties on 
schedule with good quality. 
2.0 适用范围：  
Scope: 
本规定适用于公司所管理的船舶。  
This regulation is applicable to all ships managed by the company. 
3.0 写修理单时应注意以下几点：  
Pay attention to the following points when preparing repair list: 
3.1 凡需要进厂修理的工程，应是船上无能力自修解决的问题。  
All works that needs shipyard repairs, should be problems that cannot be solved by crew-member on the 
ship. 
3.2 各部门制定修理工程单时，部门负责人根据各主管员上报的修理项目并召集相关人员
开会讨论，必要时现场勘验，最后由部门负责人统一整理修理工程单报机务总管，并
与机务总管做进一步沟通、核定。  
When all departments are developing the repair list, the department head should call a meeting with 
concerned personnel according to the repair projects reported by all supervisors, and perform 
investigation on site if necessary. Lastly, the department head is responsible to centralize the organization 
of repair list and report it to the Technical Superintendent, communicate and verify with the Technical 
Superintendent.  
3.3 修理工程单力求合理、准确、具体。如位置、尺寸、数量、规格、型号等要明确。  
Repair list must be reasonable, accurate, concrete. For example, location, size, quantity, standard, model 
and so on must be specific. 
3.4 应明确所需修理工程存在的主要问题即所需解决的问题及验收要求；  
Clarify the main problem as to the necessary repair work, that is the problems to be solved as well as the 
requirements of examination and verification; 
3.5 修理工程所需要更换的零部件，特别是关键的、特殊的零部件，是船供还是需厂供必
须写清楚；  
All components and parts that need replacement in the repair, especially the key and special components 
and parts, whether it is supplied by the ship or shipyard must be indicated clearly; 
3.6 所需换新材料的工程，应写明材料质量和规格；  
In project which needs a change for new material, the quality and standards of material should be 
indicated;  
3.7 所需修理的工程的辅助工程，应逐项写明；  
Auxiliary project of the necessary repairs should be explained item by item; 
3.8 有些工程必要时应附图说明；  
Some projects should be explained with sketch and/or drawing if necessary; 
3.9 必要时，对换下的设备、零部件及材料应注明处理意见；  
If necessary, indicate the handling comments as to the equipment, components, parts and stores that are 
being replaced. 
3.10 所有工程项目应根据前面所述的工程分类进行编号编写，文字应通顺有条理，层次分

明，不得混淆。  
All projects should be classified by number codes according to the previous numbering plan, the 
wordings should be clear and coherent with good structure layout. Do not mix up. 
3.11 参考所附“船舶修理单格式”  
Please refer to the “Ship Repair List Format”. 
4.0 准备工作  
Preparation work 
4.1 与厂方联系,明确分工与配合事项,如拆件的保管，移泊的分工职责，修理项目、拆装、
验收等。  
Liaise with the shipyard to clarify the division of work and co-operative items, such as the keeping of 
dismantled parts, division of duties as to shifting, berthing, repair projects, dismantling, installing, 
examination, verification and so on. 
4.2 船上一切高压容器或易燃易爆品应妥为安置或进厂后存放厂内。  
All high pressure vessels, inflammable and explosive items on the ship should be kept in a proper place or 
stored in the shipyard after entering the shipyard. 
4.3 一切可移动而暂时不用的备品、物件收存入库，以防遗失、损坏。  
To prevent loss and damage, all movable spare parts and items which will not be in use temporary should 
be put in the storehouse.  
4.4 进厂前提前准备妥修船备件和物料，并做好标识。  
Prepare the spare parts and stores for the ship repairs and complete labelling work in advance before 
entering the shipyard. 
4.5 油舱、油柜、油管应特别标明“禁止明火”。若涉及到修理工程时，应清除残油、油脚，
经清洁、通风，申请检验取得易燃气体清除证书。  
“No Naked Fire” should be displayed on the oil tanks and oil pipe. If the repair  involves these locations, 
remove the oil residues and dead oils; after cleaning and ventilation, apply for inspection to attain the Gas 
Free Certificate. 
4.6 吊杆放平，吊货索具拆下、做出标记，集中存放。根据需要将货舱口打开，双层底舱、
深舱、首尾尖舱等人孔盖及污水沟、污水井盖板打开，以备检查。  
Laid flat the derrick, dismantle the cargo rigging and do labeling, put them to storage together. Open the 
cargo hatch if necessary. Open the manhole, the bilge and the bilge well shutter of the double bottom tank, 
deep tank, forepeak tank and after peak tank to keep them ready for inspection. 
4.7 标出肋骨号数，便于寻找修理项目位置，防止误拆。  
Label the frame by number so that the location of repairs can be found easily, and prevent from making 
mistake in dismantling. 
4.8 提供进坞图，以便排墩，并避免测深仪收发器、计程仪和船底塞等部位坐落在坞墩上；
如有低于船基线的结构应事先通知厂方；坐墩位置应与上次进坞墩位错开。  
Provide the docking plan in order to make arrangement for the docking blocks, and prevent the parts such 
as echo sounder transceiver, speed log and the bottom plug to sit on the docking blocks. If there is 
structure below the ship base line, inform the shipyard in advance. The location for dock blocks should be 
staggered with the previous arrangement. 
4.9 进坞前按坞方要求调整吃水差并尽量调整船舶无横倾。  
Before docking, adjust the trim and ensure the ship is not listed according to the requirements of the dock. 
4.10 备妥系泊设备。船上主机、舵机、锚机、绞缆机等如能使用应准备就绪。如果不能使
用，应事先通知厂方。  
Prepare the mooring equipment. If the ship Main Engine, steering gear, windlass etc. can be used, they 
should be ready in all respects. If not inform the shipyard in advance.

Provide the structure chart of the parts which needs to be dismantled, so as to smoothen the process of

5.0 坞修注意事项  
Dock repairs precaution 
5.1 坞内水排干后,船长、轮机长、大副应立即带领有关人员对船体进行仔细检查，对查出
的缺陷制定追加工程单报机务总管，同时会同厂方检查船体坐墩是否合适,特别是船尾
框架处。  
After docking, the Master, the Chief Engineer and the Chief Officer should guide all concerned personnel 
to perform detail inspection to the ship hull immediately. If deficiency is found, make an additional repair 
list to the Technical Superintendent, and inspect whether the docking blocks of the ship hull are 
appropriate at the same time, especially for those at the stern framing.  
5.2 厂方拆卸船底塞时，大副与木匠应在现场。油舱船底塞应在存油清除后才能拆卸。如
气温在冰点以下时，需防止残水在双层底内结冰，也不能进行水舱内涂水泥浆作业。  
When the shipyard is dismantling the bottom plug, the Chief Officer and carpenter should be on site. The 
bottom plug of the oil tank can only be dismantled after the removal of oil in storage. If the temperature is 
below freezing point, operations should be made to prevent the remaining water in the double bottom 
tank from being frozen, and cement operations in the water tank is prohibited. 
5.3 不可向舷外倾倒油、水、杂物。  
Do not dump oil, water and objects overboard. 
5.4 进行水压试验前要检查人孔及船底塞是否封好，水压应达到规定要求。  
Before doing the hydraulic testing, inspect whether the manhole and bottom plug is sealed, and the water 
pressure should fulfil the requirements. 
5.5 船底测深仪、计程仪的振荡器和阴极保护装置入坞后即用纸贴封，不应涂油漆。防腐
锌块表面也不应涂刷油漆。  
After docking, the  oscillator of speed log and echo sounder and the Impressed Current Cathodic 
Protection should be sealed by paper immediately. Do not paint on them. Also, do not paint on the surface 
of anticorrosive zinc slabs. 
5.6 进坞后，凡放水、调整压载水和补充水都必须事先征得浮坞负责人员同意。  
After docking, the discharge and refill of water as well as the adjustment of ballast water can only be 
made after the approval of dock supervising personnel granted. 
5.7 船上生活污水禁止排入坞内。  
Do not discharge the sewage into the dock. 
5.8 进入油、水舱时，要先清除有害气体和油气，并应保持舱内足够的通风，测氧（爆）
合格后方可进入并严禁一人单独前往工作，入口处要有专人负责联络、照料。作业前、
后应认真做好检查，具体操作应按《进入封闭处所的安全规定》的进行。  
When entering the oil tank and water tank, remove all noxious gas and oil vapor, and maintain sufficient 
ventilation within the cargo hold. Personnel can only enter after oxygen inspection (gas free inspection) is 
tested and qualified. Personnel is prohibited to work alone in this area. Designated personnel is 
responsible for communication and care at the entrance. Perform inspection seriously before and after the 
operation. The operation should be performed according to the “Enclosed Space Entry Safety 
Regulation”. 
6.0 修船管理  
Ship Repair Management  
6.1 厂修期间各部门作出自修计划，自修项目不能影响厂修项目进行。  
All departments have to develop repair plans by crew member during shipyard repairs, and the plan

The onboard supervising personnel should ensure the standard of repair process, examination and 
verification, especially to all kinds of trial, testing, and configuration, in order to meet and fulfil the 
technical standards and quality requirements, and record accordingly. 
6.5 修船期间的安全，执行船舶手册《修船安全须知SHIP-02-20》.  
Execute the Ship Manual “Ship Repairs Safety Instruction SHIP-02-20” during ship repairs.

第09 节 船舶管理信息系统（SMIS）操作须知 
Section 09 Ship Management Information System (SMIS) Operation Instruction 
 
1.0 目的  
Purpose 
1.1 运用先进的计算机、网络、数据库、现代通信等综合技术在船岸双方进行数据交换，
是船岸管理工作互动的操作平台，能使船舶的周期性维修保养及时有效的运行。  
The ship and the ashore can perform data interchange by the application of comprehensive technologies 
such as advanced computers, network, database and modern communication. This is an operation 
platform for the interaction of ship and ashore management work, to ensure the ship maintenance cycle 
can operate effectively timely. 
1.2 系统可帮助公司对所属船舶进行维修保养管理工作的监督与指导，船舶安全监控，船
舶检验、船舶修理安排与过程控制，船舶备件、物资采购过程控制，船舶运行成本控
制等工作。  
This system can help the company to manage the ship by supervise and provide guidance in maintenance 
management work, ship safety monitoring, ship inspection, ship repair arrangement and process control, 
ship spare part and supply purchase process control and ship operation cost control.  
1.3 可为决策层提供技术方面的决策依据。  
Able to provide the executive level with technical foundations for making decision. 
2.0 定义和缩写    
Definition and Abbreviation 
2.1 《船舶管理信息系统》，全称SHIP MANAGEMENT INFORMATION SYSTEM 简称
SMIS 系统。  
“Ship Management Information System”, the full title is SHIP MANAGEMENT INFORMATION 
SYSTEM, and the abbreviation is SMIS system. 
2.2 该系统涵盖了船舶管理过程中的各项基本功能。根据管理公司的现行管理机构设置与
业务流程要求，船舶管理信息系统分成公司版与船舶版两个版本，分别用作公司与船
舶的业务管理。  
This system includes all general functions in the ship management process. According to the requirements 
of current management organization establishment and operation flow, the ship management information 
system is divided into two versions: company version and ship version, for the operation management of 
the company and the ship respectively. 
2.3 本系统适用于公司所管船舶以及公司岸基各个部门。 
This system is applicable to all ships managed by the company, and all shore-based departments. 
3.0 职责  
Responsibilities 
3.1 公司岸基各个部门相关人员日常工作中要及时关注SMIS 中与自己相关的内容，及时
更新相关数据以及签名等  
All shore-based departments personnel should pay attention to the information related to them in the 
SMIS during routine work. Update the relevant data and sign timely.

Engineer and the Chief Officer is responsible for the execution of specific work.

4.0 SMIS 的实施  
Execution of SMIS 
4.1 当新接船开始营运后，根据船舶的航次计划，船管部在三至六个月内为船舶建立SMIS
系统，在SMIS 系统建立之前，船舶的相关日常工作联系通过邮件系统进行。  
When the new takeover ship begins service, the Fleet Department should build a SMIS system for the 
ship within three to six months. Before the completion of SMIS system, all routine work of the ship 
should be communicated through the mailing system. 
4.2 新造船营运开始时，SMIS 系统即投入使用。船管部在新造船营运前2 周内为船舶建立
SMIS 系统。  
When the newbuild ship begins service, the SMIS system is put into operation immediately. The Fleet 
Department should build a SMIS system for the ship two weeks before the new ship begins service. 
4.3 SMIS 数据采集  
Data Collection of SMIS 
4.3.1 公司将用于数据采集的模板（设备、备件、证书等）发到船上。由船舶根据自身情况
填写反馈回公司。  
The company should send the data collection module (equipment, spare parts, certificates and so on) to 
the ship, and the ship gives feedback to the company according to its own conditions. 
4.3.2 公司将模板发给SMIS 技术人员，导入系统数据库。后期船舶或公司在使用中，发现
有缺少、错误的信息可以自行编辑修改，船舶也可汇报公司进行修改。  
The company submits the module to the SMIS technical personnel to import it into the system database. 
In the later stage, when missing or incorrect information is found during the usage, the ship or the 
company can edit and modify the information accordingly. Also, the ship can report to the company for 
the modification. 
4.4 SMIS 模块功能说明与注意事项  
SMIS Module Function Illustration and Precautions 
4.4.1 SMIS 系统船舶版主要分为设备管理、备件管理、物资管理、工程管理、油品管理、
热工管理、安全管理、证书管理、体系管理和系统维护十个功能模块。  
Ship version of the SMIS system is mainly divided into 10 function modules, which is equipment 
management, spare part management, store management, repair management, oil management, 
perforamance management, safety management, certificate management, system management and 
system maintenance. 
4.4.2 公司版分为设备管理、备件管理、物资管理、修船管理、安全管理、证书管理、航次
管理、船员管理、费用管理、油品管理、通函及资料管理、系统维护十二个功能模块。  
Compony version is divided into 12 function modules, which is equipment management, spare part 
management, store management, ship repair management, safety management, certificate management, 
voyage management, crew management, expense management, oil management, correspondence and 
information management, and system maintenance.

Working Procedure

Equipment Management – Ship Version and Company Version 
5.1.1 设备管理模块包含了船舶详细的设备清单和设备的维修保养内容。船舶通过此模块生

 月度维修保养计划制定前，部门长需在工单安排中进行工作安排。  
Before developing the monthly maintenance plan, the department head must arrange the working

 月度计划 生成后，驾驶员和轮机员用各自账户登录到工单报告中，对部门长安排

every month should be completed on time, and fill in the work done report, or else it may influence 
the generating of working plan next month.

5.2 备件管理–船舶版与公司版  
Spare Part Management – Ship Version and Company Version 
5.2.1 船舶通过系统提出备件申请，公司收到后进行审批、定购。备件到船后，船舶进行入
库操作。此外，通过此模块，船舶还可进行备件的出库操作、质量反馈、报表生成等
工作。  
The ship submits spare part application through the system. When the application is received, the 
company will approve and purchase. Once the spare part arrives the ship, the ship will perform storage 
incoming operation. Apart from this, the ship can also perform storage outgoing operation, give 
comments and generate reports for the spare parts through this module. 
5.2.2 在备件管理的操作中，须注意：  
Pay attention to the following during the operation of spare part management:  
 
轮机长是备件管理的责任人。轮机长应根据船上的实际情况，合理适量的制定
备件申请计划，并对生成的备件申请单进行审批操作，再由船长进行审批操作。  
The Chief Engineer is the supervisor for spare part management. The Chief Engineer should 
develop spare part application plan with reasonable quantity according to the actual situation, 
examine and approve the spare part application list generated, and submit it to the Master for 
approval. 
 
备件申请时若遇到系统中不存在的备件，需船舶自行添加到备件信息里，再进
行申请。  
In case of spare part application, if the spare part is not listed in the system, the ship should add it 
to the spare part information, and then submit application.  
 
船舶备件库存数量是通过备件到船登记，备件出入库的形式来修改的。  
Ship spare part inventory quantity is registered once the supply arrives the ship, and is amended 
when supply incoming and outgoing occurs. 
 
船舶每季度须对库存的备件进行清点，再根据实际库存的数量，及时地用备件
出入库的形式对SMIS 中备件库存的数量进行调整，确保SMIS 中备件库存的
数量与船存的实际情况相符。  
The ship must make inventory to the spare part stored every quarter, perform adjustment to the 
SMIS spare part inventory quantity timely according to the actual inventory quantity when 
supply imcoming and outgoing occurs, to ensure the SMIS spare part inventory quantity is 
complied with the actual condition of ship storage.

Store Management – Ship Version and Company Version 
5.3.1 类似备件管理的操作。这里的“物资”包括物料、生活物料、滑油、药品、化学品和
油漆六个类别。在进行物料管理操作的时候，须注意：  
It is similar with the operation of spare part management. “Store” includes six categories, general stores, 
living stores, lubricating oil, medicine, chemicals and paints. 
 
轮机长、大副是物资管理的部门责任人。轮机长、大副应根据船上的实际情况，
合理适量的制定物料申请计划，并对生成的物资申请单进行审批操作。

Repair Management – Ship Version and Company Version (Ship Repair Management) 
5.4.1 航修申请由船舶或者机务通过系统提出，公司进行审批；厂修申请由公司通过系统提
出，然后由船舶添加具体修理项目，最后传回公司进行审批。  
The ship or technical superintendent submit the voyage repair application through the system, to be 
approved by the company. The company should submit the shipyard repair applications through the 
system, and the ship is responsible for adding concrete repair projects, and return it to the company for 
approval.

Oil Management – Ship Version and Company Version 
5.5.1 船舶在此进行《航次燃、润油消耗报告》及油品检验记录的录入。公司进行《航次燃、
润油消耗报告》的审批及录入油品检验报告等工作。  
The ship is responsible for data entry of the “Voyage Fuel Oil and Lubricating Oil Consumption Report” 
and the oil lab-test record. The company is responsible for approving the “Voyage Fuel Oil and 
Lubricating Oil Consumption Report” and data entry of the oil lab-test record. 
5.6 热工管理–船舶版  
Performance Management – Ship Version  
5.6.1 船舶在此填写《柴油机热工工况报表》、《锅炉工况报表》及《冷却水处理记录》。公
司在公司版的设备管理模块下进行审批。  
The ship is responsible for fill in the “Diesel Engine Performance Report”, “Boiler Performance 
Report” and “Cooling Water Treatment Record”, to be approved by the company under the company 
version’s equipment management module.  
5.7 安全管理–船舶版与公司版  
Safety Management – Ship Version and Company Version 
5.7.1 船舶在此主要进行PSC\FSC 检查的详情登记，公司收到后相关部门进行审批。船舶
还可在此进行海图、书籍、磁罗经校正记录的登记。

Ship-to-shore Communication

The Master is the supervisor for ship-to-shore communication operation. The ship should synchronize the 
data once every day.

In case of emergency condition, the Master should synchronize at any times. During the synchronization, 
the ship should pay full attention to the conditions of data interchange. If error notification occurs, inform 
the SMIS supervisor timely for assistance.

影响SMIS 系统的同步操作。

7.0 其他注意事项  
Other Precautions 
7.1 由于SMIS 系统在船舶的运行是依靠电脑局域网和服务器的模式来进行工作的，船长
应监督船员对船舶局域网电脑的使用，避免出现因电脑操作系统病毒等原因而影响
SMIS 系统的运行。  
Since the operation of SMIS system on the ship depends on the local area network and server, the Master 
should supervise the crew in the usage of computers with local area network, to avoid all factors which 
may influence the operation of SMIS system, such as virus infection of the computer operation system 
and so on. 
7.2 服务器电脑上存有SMIS 数据库，应在船长的监督下限制使用，避免出现服务器崩溃
而导致船舶SMIS 系统停止运行的情况出现。  
The server contains the SMIS database, it should be of limited use under the supervision of the Master, to 
prevent the breakdowns of server which will lead to a stoppage of ship SMIS system operation. 
7.3 如果出现问题，可及时通知SMIS 主管以寻求协助。  
If any problem is found, inform the SMIS supervisor timely for assistance. 
SMIS 内数据属公司内部重要资料，公司原则上不允许船员个人电脑安装SMIS 系统。  
Data within the SMIS is important internal data for the company. The crew should not install SMIS 
system on their personal computers according to the principles of corporate governance. 
7.4 个人电脑感染病毒的可能性较大，一旦感染病毒，将通过局域网影响到其他工作电脑。
禁止将个人电脑接入局域网。  
There is a high level risk of virus infection in the personal computers. Once virus is infected, it will 
influence other working computers through the local area network. Do not link the personal computer to 
the local area network.

SMIS Contingency Operation Plan 
8.1 如果船舶SMIS 服务器/局域网系统一旦出现故障而影响SMIS 系统的运行，且故障因
为条件限制而船舶不能自行解决，请通知公司，SMIS 系统将暂时停用。SMIS 主管会
尽快采取相应方式恢复SMIS 系统。  
If the ship SMIS server / local area network system breaks down and influence the operation of the SMIS 
system, that the ship is unable to solve the problem alone due to certain restrictions, inform the company 
and deactivate the SMIS system temporarily. SMIS supervisor will take measures to recover the SMIS 
system as soon as possible.

善保存。  
During the time where the SMIS system is deactivate, the Technical Superintendent should send the 
monthly maintenance plan to the Master by mail. The Chief Engineer and the Chief Officer should 
arrange the relevant work according to the plan, supervise the concerned personnel to complete the work, 
fill in the working report in writing, and keep them with due care. 
8.3 船舶备件、物料的申请以电邮、传真或其他形式发回公司，出入库操作记录以其它方

第10 节 散货船船体结构检查规定 
Section 10  Bulk Carrier Inspection of Hull Structures Regulations 
 
1.0 目的 
Purpose 
为加强对散货船的船体、结构强度的管理，确保其船体、结构强度的安全，制定本办
法。 
This regulation is developed to strengthen the ship hull and manage their structural strength, so as to 
ensure the safety of ship and its structural strength. 
 
2.0 范围 
Scope 
本规定适用于散货船和矿砂船。 
This regulation applies to bulk carriers and ore carriers. 
3.0 检查周期 
Inspection Period 
3.1 船龄大于14 年的船舶应以不超过6 个月的间隔； 
When the ship’s age is more than 14 years, shall be conducted at least every 6 months. 
3.2 船龄在14 年以内的船舶应以不超过12 个月的间隔； 
When the ship’s age is within 14 years, shall be conducted at least every 12 months. 
3.3 船龄18 年以上（包括18 年）的老龄船舶，每一个重载航次检查1 次； 
When the ship’s age is more than 18 years (including 18 years), shall be conducted once for each 
heavy load voyage; 
3.4 对于超过18 年的老龄船舶，对应力集中点，重点部位，应加强检查频次； 
For the ship over 18 years, the inspect of stress concentration and critical areas should be 
increased in frequency; 
3.5 遭遇恶劣天气或其他异常情况，可能对船体造成损伤时。 
After the vessel encounter heavy weather and other abnormal situation, maybe damage to hull, the 
structural survey shall be conducted. 
4.0 职责 
Responsibility 
4.1 船管部负责监督所管理的船舶执行本规定； 
The Fleet Department is responsible for the ships implement the regulation; 
4.2 船长负责监控船上人员执行本规定； 
Master is in charge of monitoring the ship’s crew to implement regulation; 
4.3 大副负责组织实施。 
Chief Officer is in charge of organizing deck personnel to implement the regulation. 
5.0 检查和评估 
Inspection and Assessment 
5.1 船舶应对货舱、舱口围、压载舱、隔离空舱、管子弄、主甲板和船首尾等进行结构性
检查，如受条件限制可进行重点抽查，检查结束后填写船舶状况检查报告和相关舱室
的状况报告发送公司,为了更直观解读报告，建议附上照片。 
The structural inspection to cargo holds, hatch coamings, ballast tanks, VOID /cofferdam Space, cuct keel, 
the main deck, forecastle and poop deck of a ship should be carried out, if the condition is limited, some 
important parts inspection should be carried out, and fill in the Ship Condition General Inspection 
Report and Relevant Space Condition Report. as to understand the result of inspection, it is 
recommended to include some photos.

5.2 船管部根据船舶填写的船体状况检查报告，确定是否组织专业技术人员对船舶的结构
状况进行全部或部分勘验。 
The Fleet Department should decide whether the professionals shall conduct overall or partial inspection 
to the condition of the ships according to the Ship’s Hull Condition Inspection Report written by the 
Master. 
5.3 船管部根据船舶的实际情况，结合每次年度检验、期间检验和特别检验、，可组织专业
技术人员按照4.4 项的要求对船舶技术状况进行勘验，也可请船级社做出船舶安全评
估报告（包括进行总纵强度计算）。 
The Fleet Department could, in accordance with the condition of the ship, and their annual surveys, 
intermediate surveys and special surveys, either arrange professionals to inspect the ship's technical 
conditions based on requirements elaborated in 2.6, or request the class society to issue the "Ship's Safety 
Evaluation Report" (including the calculation of longitudinal strength) .  
5.4 船体勘验 
Thorough survey of the hull  
勘验由机务总管与船方一起组织进行，勘验工作要配备必要的勘验工具、设备如榔头、
测厚设备等，明显腐蚀及可疑区域、部位要拍照，如有必要，勘验记录可由船级社认
可。 
The thorough survey shall be carried out jointly by the Technical Superintendent and the ship side. 
Necessary tools such as hammer, thickness-measurement appliance, etc. shall be equipped, photos shall 
be taken to areas of obvious erosion or suspicion; the inspection records could be authorized by the class 
society if necessary. 
5.4.1 根据勘验情况，结合营运中检查发现的损坏及蚀耗、故障等缺陷进行全面的船体部分
勘验，包括对船舶主甲板、舱间甲板、舱盖、舱口围、上边水舱（柜）、货舱、空舱、
干隔舱、双层底、艏尖舱、尾尖舱和首尾舱室、船体外板、龙骨板、肋骨、扶强材、
压载管、透气管、测量管、液压管及支架等构件进行检查并做出记录。 
Based on the inspection result as well as defects discovered during operation such as damage, corrosion 
and malfunction, the overall inspection to hull shall be conducted and recorded, including the main deck, 
cross deck, hatch covers, hatch coaming, topside tanks, cargo holds, voids, cofferdam, double bottom, 
fore peak tank, after peak tank, bow store and stern spaces, shell plating, keel plating, frames, and 
stiffeners, ballast pipe, ventilation pipe, sounding pipe, hydraulic piping and brackets, etc. 
5.4.2 至少对船体三个横剖面、外板、甲板、双层底及其纵向构造进行测厚并做出记录。如
蚀耗接近或局部超过容许值，应按照入级要求适当扩大测厚范围。 
The thickness measurement shall be carried out to at least 3 transverse sections of hull, shell plating, 
deck, double bottom and longitudinal structure, with results well recorded. If the corrosion approaches 
or partly exceeds the admissible value, the range for thickness measurement shall be expanded properly 
according to the classification requirements. 
5.4.3 进坞时需对船体的水下部分、舵设备、轴系、螺旋桨和舷侧开口的附件等进行勘验。 
The underwater part of hull, rudder, shafting, propeller, and the mountings of the side openings, etc. 
shall be inspected after docking. 
5.4.4 勘验必须全面反映船舶状况，满足船级社进行安全评估提出的要求。 
Inspection must reflect the overall ship conditions to fulfil the requirements of the safety assessment 
performed by the ship classification society. 
5.5 船管部根据各船船舶状况检查结果，进行一次经济、技术论证，以确定船舶修理政策、
对船舶适用进行分类，或限制航区，或减载使用，或做出退役决定。 
The Fleet Department conducts an economic and technical demonstration according to the ship condition 
survey of the ships, in order to determine the repair policy and categorization of ships' serviceability,

第11 节 船舶电池管理和保养规定 
Section 11 Ship’s Battery Management and Maintenance Regulation 
 
1.0 适用范围：  
Scope of application: 
本规定适用于公司所管理的船舶的救生艇、救助艇、电台、驾驶台通用充放电板、应
急发电机、白昼信号灯等的蓄电池，及驾驶台通导设备（VDR,TWO WAY VHF,SART，
电子海图,UPS，手电等）和机舱机电设备控制系统的内部电池（含纽扣电池），普通/
消防对讲机的可充电电池等，及以上设备产生的废旧或者过期电池。 
This regulation applies to the batteries of lifeboats, rescue boat, radio station, general battery charger，
emergency generators, daylight signal light (aldis lamp) of vessels managed by the company, internal 
batteries including button cell of navigation and communication equipments （VDR,TWO WAY 
VHF,SART,ECDIS,UPS，torch etc.）, internal batteries of mechanical and electrical equipments’ control 
system, rechargeable batteries of normally used/ fire-fighter’s walkie-talkies, and waste batteries from 
equipments above.  
2.0 职责： 
Responsibilities: 
本规定由电机员负责执行，各设备主管人员配合执行，轮机长具有监督职能。 
The regulations shall be implemented by the electrical engineer, the supervisors of concerned equipments 
execute in cooperation, and supervised by the chief engineer. 
3.0 电池存放要求和管理 
Requirements and managements for storage of batteries. 
3.1 电池存放应该确保周边环境干净整洁，照明良好，周围不能堆放杂物，无热源，尤其
是不能靠近易燃物质。电池存放不能叠堆和倒置。如果电极裸露，应使用绝缘胶带临
时包裹一下，防止短路。 
Storage of batteries in the place should be kept clean，good lighting，no miscellaneous items and heat 
source around, especially should not be close to flammable substances. The batteries should be placed 
with no stacking and upside down. If the electrode is exposed, please using insulating tape to protect in 
order to avoid of short circuit. 
3.2 新供船电池在未使用之前由相关主管人员进行存放，主管人员应尽快制定电池更换计
划。产生的废旧电池交由电机员统一进行定点存放。 
New supplied batteries should be placed in good order by relevant supervisors, the supervisors should 
make new plan for replacing batteries as soon as possible. The waste batteries after replacements should 
be handed over to electrical engineer for good storage. 
3.3 电机员将废旧电池接收、整理后按照要求进行存放，并填写《废旧电池管理记录》。船
舶靠港后，将废旧电池进行整理然后报告船长，交由垃圾回收服务商进行专业化回收
处理，并做好记录。 
The waste batteries should be stored according to requirements after good receipt by the electrical 
engineer, and be recorded in “Record of waste batteries management”. After ship’s berthing, the 
electrical engineer tidy the waste batteries, report to the captain, hand over to the shore garbage receiving 
facilities for professional treatment, and record. 
4.0 对可充电电池管理要求 
Requirements for rechargeable batteries managements. 
可充电电池应该避免长时间充电，充电完毕后应该断掉电源，防止一直充电造成电池
过快老化，如TWO-WAY VHF,普通对讲机，消防对讲机，及个人生活电器充电等。可
充电电池在发现电池性能不佳，电池容量明显不足的情况下，应尽早申请更换，防止

Rechargeable batteries should avoid being long time charged, the power source should be disconnected 
after fully charged, and this is to prevent from aging too quickly. For example，TWO-WAY VHF, 
normally used and fire-fighter’s walkie-talkies，and personal electric appliance . Rechargeable batteries 
should be replaced as soon as possible if found in bad condition and no enough capacity, to prevent 
overaging batteries from self-ignition and explosion when in charging. 
5.0 蓄电池保养实施步骤： 
Implementation steps: 
存放蓄电池的处所要保持干净清洁，不得堆放杂物，照明良好 
Storage of batteries in the place to keep clean, good lighting, do not pile up debris. 
5.1 每周检查：表面、接头、电压、电流、绝缘、温度 
Weekly inspection: surface, joint, voltage, current, insulation and temperature 
 表面清洁,电瓶间（处所）干净清洁、照明良好 
   Surface cleaning, battery (space) cleaning, good lighting 
 接头无松动、无腐蚀、裸露部分涂有凡士林 
Joint no looseness, no corrosion, exposed part coated with Vaseline 
 浮充充电电压： 12V 的为13.4V, 24V 的为26.8V 
   Float charge voltage: 13.4 V to the12 V battery, 26.8 V to the 24 V battery 
 浮充充电电流：单节电池容量的1% 
   Floating charge current: 1% of the single section battery capacity 
 充电屏绝缘表指示>3 兆欧 
Indication of charging screen insulation meter exceeds 3 megohm 
5.2 蓄电池应避免长期充电不足和过放电等，防止极板硫化（即老化）导致电池损坏或性
能下降（指电压很快充足，断开充电后又很快下降）。 
The battery should avoid long-term charging shortage and over-discharge, etc., to prevent the plate 
vulcanization (that is, aging) caused by battery damage or performance decline (refers to the voltage is 
soon enough, and soon decline after disconnecting charging). 
5.3 不要新旧电池混用，并联的电池更换时必须同时换新，使用相同规格的电池。 
The old and new batteries don’t be mixed, the parallel battery must be replaced at the same time, and be 
using of the same specifications of the battery when the replacement. 
5.4 好坏的判断： 24V 串联的两块电池电压应该是一样的，相差超过0.5V,说明其中一块
出了问题；在充足电的情况下，发电机或救生艇启动应该很顺利，顺利就是“呼噜”
一下就转起来，如果启动时间较长，“噗吐、噗吐、噗吐”好多声，启动吃力，电瓶
端电压下降到11v 一下，说明电池容量不足了。如果电瓶端电压与启动马达端电压差
值超过1 ~ 2v，说明线路连接接触不好， 或开关不好。 
The judgment on good or bad the voltage of two batteries in series of 24V should be the same, and 
indicating that one of them has a problem when a difference of more than 0.5v; In the case of sufficient 
power, the generator or lifeboat should be started smoothly, which means that "snore" will turn up after a 
while. If the starting time is long, "puff, puff, puff" a lot of sound, starting hard, the voltage at the battery 
end drops to 11v once, indicating that the battery capacity is insufficient. If the voltage difference between 
the battery terminal and the starting motor terminal exceeds 1 ~ 2v, which means that the circuit 
connection contact is not good, or the switch is not good. 
5.5 电池使用寿命 
Battery life 
启动蓄电池： 2 年 
Start battery: 2 years

For batteries inside the equipment, if the specification or regulations has relevant life requirements, 
the specification or regulations shall prevail. 
5.6 安装蓄电池组的托架或托盘应结实可靠，并用不吸潮、耐电解液腐蚀的绝缘材料楔隔、
衬垫和固定。各电池组及与托架之间应有足够的空间进行检查和维护。 
The brackets or pallets used to install the battery pack shall be strong and reliable. And shall be wedged, 
padded and fixed with non-moisture absorbing and electrolyte-resistant insulating materials. Sufficient 
space between batteries and battery banks should be provided for carrying out inspections and 
maintenance. 
5.7 每12个月应对无线电设备的蓄电池进行一次容量效用试验， 但禁止在海上对电池进行
大容量的试验性放电。可以选择在系泊后测试，同时有充足的充电时间。 
The battery for radio equipment shall be subjected to a volumetric utility test every 12 months, but it is 
prohibited to conduct high-capacity experimental discharge on the battery at sea. The test may be 
conducted after berthing and have sufficient charging time.

第12 节  锚机及系泊设备的检查、试验和维护保养 
Section 12  Windlass and Mooring Equipment Inspection, Test & Maintenance 
 
1.0 目的： 
Purpose: 
保证锚机、系泊设备得到良好的维护保养，使之处于良好的状态，防止锚及锚链的损
坏或丢失，防止系泊设备的损坏。 
This regulation stipulates that windlass and mooring equipments should be well maintained, keep them 
proper working condition., prevent the damage or loss of anchor and chain, and prevent the damage of 
mooring equipment. 
2.0 适用范围： 
Scope: 
本规定适用于公司所管理的船舶。 
This regulation is applicable to all ships managed by the company. 
3.0 职责： 
Responsibilities: 
3.1 大副负责对锚机及其锚设备和绞缆机的检查、试验和维修保养。 
The Chief Office is in charge of inspection, test and maintenance for windlass, its anchoring equipment 
and mooring winches 
3.2 水手长协助大副执行工作。 
The bosun assists the Chief Officer to do the jobs. 
3.3 三管轮负责检查及维修保养液压部份。 
The 4th Engineer is in charge of the inspecting and maintenance of the hydraulic parts. 
3.4 大管轮负责绞缆机刹车测试。 
The Second Engineer is in charge of winch brake test. 
4.0 维护保养 
Maintenance 
4.1 锚机和绞缆机本体部份 
Windlass and Mooring Winches Structure 
4.1.1 锚机和绞缆机日常维护保养必须遵守设备的说明书，设备只有在良好的润滑条件下工
作，才能减少磨损、延长机器寿命，日常保养要特别注意零件各磨擦面的润滑，必须
确信各处润滑良好，才能开动油马达。每次加油后，应使机器空车运转片刻，以便油
脂均匀地涂在滑动表面上。 
The inspecting, repairing and maintenance are strictly following up the instruction manuals for windlass 
and mooring winches, they should be properly lubricated to avoid worn out and extend their service life, 
you should pay attention to lubricate the parts of the friction surface in daily maintenance, ensure that 
all points were well lubricated before starting the motor, idle running or running with lower speed few 
minutes to spread the grease well-distributed on the moving surfaces after each lubricating. 
4.1.2 根据需要用牛油枪注入牛油到各润滑点，将牛油涂于人力制动的螺杆上和齿轮轴的离
合器上。 
Lubricate the greasing points of each component monthly or where necessary, including wheel gear, 
clutch and control handle of the brake. 
4.1.3 锚机和绞缆机的所有不工作表面也必须经常保持清洁，锚机/绞缆机的外露表面必须
经常油漆涂补，以防生锈。 
To maintain clean of the entirety of the windlass and mooring winch and maintain the integrate of the 
coatings. The external parts shall be derusted and repainted usually.

4.1.4 定期检查锚机/绞缆机的机座和固定螺栓，松动的螺母应上紧。 
The foundation and fasten bolts of the windlass and mooring winch should be checked periodically. 
Re-tighten the bolts once loosen found. 
4.1.5 检查锚机和绞缆机刹车带顶丝，按照厂家说明书要求设置间隙。 
The clearance of band supporter should be adjusted according to the manufacturer's manual.  
4.1.6 定期检查锚机/绞缆机的传动机构（包括轴承）特别是检查齿轮和离合器的啮合程度
和磨损状况，防止离合器的手柄在运转中脱开。 
The driving mechanism (including bearings) should be checked periodically, especially for checking the 
meshing condition of the wheel gear and clutch and worn-down status to avoid accidentally getting out 
of the clutch during working. 
4.1.7 仔细检查制链器保持其正常状态，能避免制链器的安全销在恶劣天气中脱落。如果发
现锚链轮磨损过度,制链器的变形,滚轮变形或过度磨损、制链器的轴销变形、损坏、
间隙过大等等,所有这些损失应该修理和调整,或在磨损表面堆焊保持其功能。 
Checks the Chain Stopper carefully to maintain its proper condition. The safety pin of the chain stopper 
can be prevented falling off in bad weather. If found the Cable Lifter excessive worn down, deformation 
of the Chain Stopper, Idler Wheel deformation or excessive worn out, deformation and damages of the 
Pins on the Chain Stopper, large gap between pin bracket, etc. all of these damages should be repaired 
and adjusted, or bead welding on the worn out surface to maintain its function. 
 
 
4.1.8 每次使用锚机时检查刹车带的磨损状况，如达到极限应予更换（可参考说明书）。大
副应确保船上备有备用的刹车带可换。 
The brake lining of the windlass and mooring winch should be checked every time before using, the 
excessive worn down of the brake lining should be renewed (Ref. instruction manual of winch). The 
chief office should ensure a set of brake lining on board for exchanging 
4.1.9 始终保持一套备用的锚固定钢丝和松紧螺丝，用于替换，也能用于不良状况的绑扎固
定和修理固定。 
At least one set of Extra anchor lashing wire and turnbuckle to be always maintained onboard for 
replacing/renewing existing lashing set and securing in case found un-suitable or fault repairing. 
4.2 锚机和绞缆机液压部份 
Hydraulic System of Windlass and Mooring winches 
4.2.1 启动油泵前要检查油柜油位，所有阀门开/关在正确位置，油
马达控制手柄应放置在零位。检查液压油膨胀柜油位正常
（如有）。 
Check the oil level in the oil tank and ensure the valves are in correct 
position, ensure the handle of the hydraulic motor controller is idle 
position before starting the pump. The oil level of the hydraulic oil 
expansion tank is normal (if application). 
4.2.2 启动油泵后，要检查油压是否正常、系统有否漏油和有否异
声，一切正常后才能操作油马达。在寒冷季节应提早启动油

Check the oil pressure and leakage from the system and abnormal sound after starting the pump. Once

4.2.3  如果油泵和油马达经过解体、或油管更换等, 应清洗滤器，并且在组装后一定要彻底
放清空气。 
If hydraulic pump and motor have been dismantled, or changed the hydraulic pipe line, or other repaired, 
should clean the strainer, and release thoroughly the air inside after assembly. 
4.2.4 为了维护液压油质量，在使用时保证系统清洁，无油泥、无水分、无锈、无金属屑，
换新油时，要彻底清洁油柜。加新油一定要通过过滤。 
To maintain the quality of the hydraulic oil, keeping the system clean, free of oil residues, free of water, 
free of rusts and metal scraps. The oil tank should be thoroughly cleaned before replenishing the oils and 
refilling through the strainer. 
4.2.5 进出港前大副和三管轮必须根据船舶进出港安全制度的要求试验检查锚机和绞缆机，
试验结果记入驾驶台抵港准备工作检查表。 
The inspection and testing prior departure and prior arrival should follow up the Ship Arrival & 
Departure Safety Regulations, and record its status into the Arrival prepare checklist 
4.3 绞缆机刹车测试 
Winch Brake Testing 
4.3.1 目的和频率 
Purpose and Frequency 
4.3.1.1 主刹车在第一层绞缆滚筒上应保持80%的船舶设计系泊力，即：刹车力性能需满足
80%的船舶设计系泊力。 
ISO 3730 requirement that the primary brake holding capability should be 80% ship design 
MBL on the first layer. it is means that BHC=80% the ship design MBL. 
4.3.1.2 刹车测试的主要目的是验证在负载小于缆绳设计的MBL时刹车应滑动。建议绞缆机
刹车力（刹车打滑力）设定为船舶设计系泊力的60%。 
The main purpose of brake testing is to verify that the brake will render at a load less than the ship design 
MBL. Recommends that brakes of rendering power test should be set at 60% of the ship design MBL. it 
is means that BRP=60% the ship design MBL.

Test procedures 
每个绞车制造商都有自己的测试设备和程序，操作人员应该遵守，详细的测试设备和
程序请参考绞缆机的说明书。 
Each winch manufacturer will have their own test equipment and procedures, which should be followed 
by the operator, Details of the equipment and procedures should be in the instruction manual for the 
mooring winch. 
绞缆机测试程序应包括： 
绞缆机测试准备； 
 设置测试装置和使用的测试负载； 
 关于液压千斤顶试验压力与管线拉力的曲线或表格； 
 设计的刹车滑动时液压千斤顶的压力。 
 绞车刹车的设置包括扭矩扳手的值或压力表安装设置刹车。 
 绞缆机刹车设置包括转矩扳手或压力表的数值应适合于装配的刹车； 
 记录测试结果并在滚筒上做好正确和可见的标识。 
The winch test procedure should include: 
 preparation the winch for testing,  
 setting up the test gear and applying the test load. 
 A curve or table relating hydraulic jack test pressure to line pull. 
 Hydraulic jack pressure at which the brake is designed to render. 
 Setting of the winch brakes including the values for torque wrench or pressure gauge fitted for setting 
up the brakes. 
 Recording the test results and enduring markings on the drum are correct and visible.  
4.3.3 测试设备 
Testing equipment  
建议完成测试后，将测试设备被放置在适当的位置妥善保管；也可以在船队中为每种
类型和尺寸的绞缆机配备一套或两套测试设备，储存在一个方便的地方，以便交给船
舶测试或根据需要作为修理工具。 
It is recommended that ships have access to complete set of test equipment kept on board and stowed in 
an appropriate location. Alternatively, a ship operation may opt to have one or two sets of test equipment 
for each type and size of winch in the fleet, stored in a convenient central location for delivery to the ship 
or to repair facilities as required. 
测试刹车的重要设备包括下列项目: 
Typical equipment for testing the brakes includes the following items: 
 连接杆，一般由两根短杆组成。连接杆通过测试工具提供的螺栓固定在绞车的滚筒
上，并通过滚筒法兰上提供的小孔安装，连接杆应该很轻，便于操作。 
A lever, usually consisting of two pieces of bar. The lever is secured to the drum of the winch by 
bolts provided in the test kit and fitted through holes provided in the drum flange. The lever should be 
lightweight for easy handling. 
 液压千斤顶及压力表； 
A hydraulic jack with pressure gauge. 
 为分配负荷到甲板结构安放在液压千斤顶下的基座。 
A foundation to be placed under the hydraulic jack for distributing the load into the deck structure. 
4.3.4 测试的监督  
Supervision of testing 
所有绞车试验应在监督下或在熟悉绞车操作、试验程序和船舶安全管理体系的负责人
在场的情况下进行。这可能是由船长、轮机长或修理主管指定的人。

维修保养 
版本/修改：3.0/2.0                    SHIP-08-12 
Maintenance                        Version/Rev.: 3.0/2.0                     SHIP-08-12   
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                       生效日期2022/05/10         第5/11页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 2022/05/10    Page 5/11 
All winch testing is to be carried out under the supervision or in the presence of a responsible person 
familiar with the operation of the winches, the test procedure and the ship’s safety management system. 
This may be a person designated by the Master, Chief Engineer or a repair superintendent. 
4.3.5 测试方法 
Method of Testing  
4.3.5.1 在对绞车制动器进行测试前，应确定刹车和刹车滚筒的状况良好。任何损坏或故障
都应该在测试之前进行修复。 
Before testing a winch brake, the condition of the brake and the brake drum should be confirmed as 
satisfactory. Any damage or failure should be fixed before testing takes place. 
4.3.5.2 详细的测试说明包含在测试规范中，开始测试前应认真阅读，并根据要求准备相应
的设备。 
The detailed instructions for testing included in the test specification should be reviewed before testing 
begins and the equipment prepared accordingly. 
4.3.5.3 基本步骤如下 
The procedure should be as follows: 
1) 连接杆或支撑用螺栓固定在缆车滚筒的法兰，并置于底座上。液压千斤顶安在其指
定位置。 
The lever or brace is bolted to the flange of the winch drum with the hydraulic jack pressed under the 
end of the arms at the designated location and resting on the foundation. 
2) 液压千斤顶，应首先校准压力表。 
If they are set hydraulically the pressure gauge should first be calibrated. 
3) 准备好测试绞缆机后，将测试设备牢固定连接就位，并根据测试说明将绞缆机刹车
刹紧，给液压千斤顶施压。 
With the winch prepared for testing, the testing gear securely in place and winch brakes set according 
to the testing instructions, pressure is applied to the hydraulic jack. 
4) 当测试绞缆机刹车打滑力（BRP）时，千斤顶压力大小应设定在60%设计系泊力的
压力处，逐渐松刹车，当滚筒滑动时，该刹车杆扭矩位置产生的刹车力就是刹车打
滑力。 
When test the brake rendering power, the jack pressure should be set at a pressure of 60% the ship 
design Minimum Breaking Load, then gradually release the brakes. When the rope drum slips, the 
braking holding force under this position is brake rendering power.  
5) 当测试刹车带性能（BHC）时，应继续给千斤顶施压，并采取以下行动: 
When test the Brake Holding Capacity, should continue add pressure to the hydraulic jack, and the 
following action should be attention: 
a) 如果未达到BHC对应的压力发生滑动，表示刹车力不够，则应调整刹车带。 
If slippage occurs at less than the design pressure of BHC, the brake should be adjusted. 
b) 如果压力表与设计BHC压力相符，代表刹车性能满足设计要求。则应松开千斤
顶，并拆卸测试设备。 
If the pressure corresponds to the design pressure of BHC, it means that the braking performance 
meets the design requirements. the jack should be released, and the test gear removed. 
4.3.5.4 一旦刹车被测试和校准，刹车杆的扭矩位置应该被标记下来。对于传统的螺旋刹车，
应该附加一个标签，表明刹车杆的扭矩值。对于应用弹簧的刹车，应记录弹簧压缩距
离，并用铅封固定弹簧调整装置。 
Once the brakes are tested and calibrated, the torque setting should be recorded. For conventional screw 
brakes, a tag should be attached stating the torque value. For Spring applied brakes the spring 
compression distance should be recorded and the mechanism secured with a seal.

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 2022/05/10    Page 6/11 
4.3.5.5 不应在刹车杆上使用锁紧螺母等止动装置，因为止动装置会妨碍刹车使用，例如减
少刹车行程。 
A stopper arrangement, e.g. locking nut on the threaded end should mot be used on the tightening screw, 
Stopper arrangements can impede the brake setting and reduce the brake holing load. 
4.3.6 测试结果和刹车带更换 
Result of Testing and Brake Lining Replace 
4.3.6.1 测试正常，填写绞缆机刹车测试报告表 
    If the testing result，should fill the < Winch Brake Test Report Form> 
4.3.6.2 如刹车性能不满足，需更换刹车带，或者调整安装工艺 
If the brake performance does not meet the design requirements, the brake lining needs to be replaced, or 
the installation process needs to be adjusted.     
4.3.6.3 当锚机缆机的刹车带磨损状况达到极限，应予更换（可参考说明书，例如刹车带磨
损到刹车螺丝接触轮毂）。每半年测量一次，如有异常报告机务总管。 
Excessive wear of the friction lining of mooring winch or windlass (reference the finish plan, e.g., the bolt 
heads about against the band brake race), the brake lining needs to be replaced. Measure and inspect 
every six months, and report to the technical supervisor if there is any abnormality. 
4.3.6.4 当锚机缆机的刹车带安装达到5 年，应予更换。 
When the brake lining of the windlass or mooring winch was installed up to 5 years, it should be replaced. 
4.4 系泊装置 
Mooring Fittings 
4.4.1 由导向轮、缆桩和导缆孔等组成的系泊装置应该依据年度维护保养计划进行检查。 
Mooring fittings consisting of the deck stand rollers / mooring bits and fairleads shall be inspected as per 
PMS.  
4.4.2 安全负荷的标识应该经常检查，如需要重新标识。 
The SWL markings shall be checked and refreshed as necessary  
4.4.3 检查甲板导向轮，保持转动灵活。 
Deck stand rollers shall be inspected to ensure that they rotate freely  
4.4.4 应定期对系泊缆桩和导缆孔进行维护，确保其表面光滑，无不平整的挖沟现象，防止
缆绳磨损。 
Mooring bollard and mooring leaders shall be maintained at regular intervals to ensure that they have a 
smooth surface and no uneven gouging to prevent chafing of ropes Tending of Mooring 
4.5 系泊缆绳 
Mooring ropes 
所有系泊缆绳必须经过认证，证书应妥善保管。 
All mooring ropes must be certificated and the certificates maintained properly. 
4.5.1 缆绳的存放 
Storage of mooring ropes 
在航行过程中，太阳的紫外线会损坏暴露在外的绳索纤维。切勿将系泊索放在阳光直
射的地方，但应采取以下措施。 
While under navigation, Sun’s ultraviolet rays can damage exposed rope fiber. Never leave (store) 
mooring ropes in direct sunshine, but take the following measures. 
1） 缆绳使用后缠绕滚筒上，让其风干，它们必须保持尽可能干燥，必要时用帆布或

then be kept as dry as possible, and so it is necessary to cover the drums with canvas or other

4.5.2 缆绳的检查和记录 
Check and record the condition of mooring ropes 
缆绳的检查和维护，应参考厂家要求和航业惯例，以下指导作为参考。 
For the inspection and maintenance of mooring ropes, the manufacturer’s requirements and industry 
practices should be consulted, the following guidelines are for reference. 
1) 使用前检查 
Check mooring ropes before use  
 每次使用前，检查损坏或老化情况。检查上述情况时，请仔细检查是否有断股、拉
伤或磨损的迹象。对于尾索，还应关注拉伸情况。如发现异常，应进行换向或更换。 
Before each use, check for symptoms of damage or deterioration. When checking the above, look 
carefully for signs of cut strands, tear, or wear. The tensile of the tails should also be paid attention to. 
If any abnormality is found, execute reversal or replacement. 
2) 周期性检查 
Periodic check 
 每月对每根缆绳进行检查，将《缆绳统计表》发回公司； 
Check every mooring rope，report the《Mooring Ropes Management List》 to the company. 
 每三个月进行一次定期检查，通过外观检查仔细检查是否有老化、磨损、扭结、化
学腐蚀、便面熔化等迹象。通过《缆绳检查记录》报告公司。   
Execute periodic checks every three months, and check closely by appearance inspection for signs of 
deterioration / abrasion/ kinking/ chemical attack and surface fusion. report the《Inspection Record 
for Mooring Ropes》. 
 每根缆绳，不超过12个月，应拉出全面详细检查，然后填写《缆绳检查记录表》。 
No more than 12 months, The full length of every mooring ropes shall undergo detailed inspection, 
fill  the 《Inspection Record for Mooring Ropes》。 
 缆绳在使用2500 小时后应调头使用，并且新缆绳调头时间不应超过2.5年。在缆绳
更换或调头时，应该重新填报《系泊缆绳统计表》和《系泊缆绳检查记录》。 
Mooring ropes shall be turned/rotated end to end at a minimum 2500 hours of active service，and the 
reversal no more than 2.5 years from the time in first use. When the mooring rope was replaced and 
reversed，《Mooring Ropes Management List》and《Inspection Record for Mooring Ropes》should be 
updated and reported. 
 缆绳使用时间累计满5年，缆绳报废换新。 
The mooring rope should be retired and replaced when the mooring active service time of mooring 
rope was accumulated to 5 years。
