第13 节 船舶视频监控系统管理和使用规定 
Section 13  Regulations on the management and use of CCTV system 
 
1 目的： 
Purpose： 
明确船舶视频监控系统（CCTV）使用和管理规定，规范船舶驾驶台值班纪律、安全行
为，促使驾驶台值班人员养成遵守驾驶台纪律的良好习惯，严格地按照驾驶台规则、
避碰规则、STCW 规则等履行值班职责，避免事故发生。 
Make clear the regulations on the use and management of CCTV system, standardize the discipline and 
safety behavior of bridge watch, urge the bridge duty personnel to develop the good habit of obeying the 
discipline of bridge watch, and strictly perform their on-duty duties in accordance with the bridge watch 
rules, marine regulations for prevention of collision, and STCW rules, etc., so as to avoid accidents. 
 
2 适用范围： 
Scope: 
本规定适用于公司所管理的船舶。 
This regulation is applicable to all ships managed by the company. 
 
3 职责： 
Responsibility： 
3.1 船长为船舶视频监控使用和管理的总负责人，负责驾驶台视频记录的回放检查，其他
船员若需调阅视频记录，需取得船长同意。 
The captain is the general person in charge of the use and management of the CCTV system and 
responsible for the playback and inspection of the video records. If other crew members should obtain the 
consent of the captain before accessing the video records. 
3.2 二副负责（电机员协助）驾驶台视频监控系统的日常维护、保养和管理工作，包括摄
像头、监控主机、视频压缩机、显示器、监控软件、电源等设备的检查、测试和时间
校对等（时间采用北京时间），并将结果记录在《船舶CCTV 维修保养记录表》内。 
2/O is responsible for (electrical engineer to assist) CCTV system daily maintenance and management, 
including cameras, NVR, video compressor unit, monitor unit, CCTV application software and power 
supply unit, verify the CCTV system is in good condition (the system time is Beijing time). And the 
results shall be recorded in the CCTV maintenance record form. 
 
4  视频监控系统的日常使用 
Precautions for daily use of CCTV system 
4.1 船舶在航行、锚泊期间，视频监控系统如无硬件问题，应长期开启,不得随意关闭。 
If there is no hardware problem, the CCTV system should keep power on when the vessel is under sail or 
at anchor. 
4.2 坞修船舶为避免船电与岸电转换时电流不稳定而损坏设备，应于船电和岸电切换前提
前关闭设备，换电结束后再开启设备。 
When the ship is in the dry dock at shipyard, in order to avoid equipment damage due to unstable power 
supply, CCTV system should be powered off before the conversion of ship power and shore power, and 
keep power on after conversion finished. 
4.3 各摄像头位置、摄像头方向、摄像头焦距范围等，已经测试完毕，不得擅自改动。如
必须变动，船长应说明变动原因，并报公司主管部门批准，由船舶主管人员进行调整
并做好记录。摄像头调整后需截取所摄图像发公司主管部门，确认符合要求。 
The camera position, camera direction, camera focal length range, etc., have been tested, do not change 
without authorization. If any change is necessary, the master shall explain the reason for the change and 
report it to the competent department of the company for approval, and the adjustments shall be made and

4.4 任何人发现摄像头工作异常或损坏等情况，应立即报告船长报修，并由设备主管人员
在《船舶CCTV 维修保养记录表》内做好记录。 
Anyone who finds abnormal of CCTV system should report it to the captain immediately, and the 
Supervisors are responsible for keeping records in the CCTV Maintenance Record Form. 
 
5  设备管理 
Instructions of Equipment Management  
5.1 船舶视频监控的视频数据对外保密，任何人不可手动删除，除公司检查人员外，其他
人未经船长授权不得拷贝视频资料。重要事件的视频信息，船长应亲自拷贝相关视频
内容，妥善保管备查。船长应妥善保管CCTV 设备数据备份、删除、后台管理等相关密
码，未经授权，不得告知他人。 
The video data of the CCTV is confidential to the public. No one is allowed to delete it except the 
company's inspectors. Do not copy data without authorization of the captain. For video information of 
important events, the captain shall personally copy the relevant video content and properly keep it for 
future reference. The captain shall properly keep the password related to CCTV equipment data backup, 
deletion, background management, etc., and shall not disclose it to others without authorization. 
5.2 CCTV 系统的摄像头等设备直接置于暴露的环境中，需要重点做好清洁、防潮、防尘、
防腐的保养工作。 
Cameras and other equipment of CCTV system are placed directly in the exposed environment, so it is 
necessary to focus on cleaning, moisture-proof, dust prevention and anti-corrosion maintenance. 
对室外摄像头接线盒、电缆接头等，定期检查水密状况，对发现水密不良现象，及时
维护、排除隐患。 
Check the watertight conditions of outdoor camera junction boxes and cable joints regularly, and timely 
maintain and eliminate hidden dangers if watertight defects are found. 
定期检查摄像头安装固定是否牢固，尤其注意室外摄像头固定螺丝的状况，有无松动。 
Periodically check whether the camera is securely installed, especially whether the outdoor camera screws 
are loose. 
5.3 CCTV 设备在维护过程中必须对防雷击问题高度重视，保持良好接地。 
Keep the CCTV equipment well grounded and pay close attention to lightning protection. 
5.4 每周对设备显示器进行清洁，并校对监视器画面，确保画面清晰。 
Clean the monitor every week and check the monitor picture to make sure the picture is clear. 
5.5 每月进行一次除尘、清理，擦掉监控设备显露的尘土，对摄像机、防护罩等部件吹风
除尘；将各个镜头擦拭干净，防止由于机器运行、静电等因素将尘土吸入监控设备机
体内。  
Dust removal and cleaning should be carried out once a month to prevent dust inhalation into the body of 
the CCTV system due to machine operation, static electricity and other factors. 
5.6 每月对监控主机、视频压缩机的运行状况进行检查，确认各指示灯显示正常，各接线
连接牢固。视频压缩主机等部件散热正常。 
Verify the running status of the NVR, video compressor unit every month, confirm that all indicators are 
normal and all cables are securely connected. The video compression unit and other components dissipate 
heat properly. 
5.7 船队CCTV 设备均接入VSAT 网络，在进行视频数据备份或者厂商要求的软件升级等，
确保插入的U 盘无病毒。 
The CCTV system is connected with the VSAT network. During video data backup or software upgrade 
required by the manufacturer, ensure that the inserted USB disk is virus-free. 
 
6  视频检查 
Video inspection 
6.1 船长负责对驾驶台值班情况实施有效监督，船长每周应进行视频监控回放检查工作，
确保系统运行、存储正常。

第14 节 船舶检验通道检查及维护保养须知 
Section 14 Instructions for inspection and maintenance of Ship’s Means of Access 
 
1.0 目的 
Purpose 
船舶通道定期进行检查和维护保养，保持使其处于良好状态，保障使用船舶通道人员
的安全。  
Ship’s means of access is regularly inspected and maintained to keep it in good condition and ensure the 
safety of people using the ship's means of access。   
2.0 定义 
Definition 
2.1  PMA（Permanent Means of Access）永久检验通道，在船舶的营运期间，为方便船员及检验人
员对船体结构进行全面检查、测厚，在货舱区域设置的固定式通道。 
PMA (permanent means of access) is a fixed channel set up in the cargo hold area during the 
operation of the ship to facilitate the crew and surveyors to conduct a comprehensive inspection and 
thickness measurement of the hull structure 
2.2  便携式通道设备和附件（portable access of equipment and attachments）， 
船舶结构通道手册里规定的辅助设备，方便船员及检验人员通过便携式梯子、固定工具、绳
索等临时组建成一套安全可靠的临时通道方便人员到达某些永久检验通道无法到达的区域。
The auxiliary equipment specified in the ship's structural access manual is convenient for the crew 
and surveyors to temporarily assemble a set of safe and reliable temporary access through portable 
ladders, fixed tools, ropes, etc., so as to facilitate personnel to reach some areas that cannot be 
reached by permanent inspection access 
2.3  进入货舱的通道：散货船利用槽型舱壁分别在前后两舱壁设置了直梯和旋转梯，在甲板上方
设置了水密人孔舱盖。从舱盖及其附件和梯子及其附件都要定期检查并确保完好 
Access to the cargo hold: The bulk carrier uses the trough bulkhead to set up a straight ladder and a 
revolving ladder in the front and rear bulkheads, and a watertight manhole hatch cover is set above 
the deck. Both hatch covers and their attachments and ladders and their attachments are regularly 
inspected and in good condition。 
2.4  通往甲板下结构的检查通道：如果从内底板到上甲板的垂直距离超过 17 m，需要设置检查通
道对甲板下结构进行检查。一般设置在横向甲板下1.6~3 m 处的横向永久通道。 
Inspection access to the structure below deck: If the vertical distance from the inner floor to the 
upper deck exceeds 17 m, an inspection channel needs to be set up to inspect the structure below 
deck. Generally, it is set up in the transverse permanent passage at 1.6~3 m below the transverse 
deck 
2.5  边舱的检查通道：对于高度大于 6 m 的顶边舱，应在甲板下方1.6~3 m 处沿舷侧外板设置纵
向连续永久通道。对于高度大于 6 m 的底边舱，应在环形腹板净开口顶部以下至少 1.2 m、
沿舷侧外板设置一个纵向连续的永久通道。 
Inspection access of side tank: For the top side tank with a height greater than 6 m, a longitudinal 
continuous permanent access should be set along the outboard along the side 1.6~3 m below the 
deck. For bottom decks with a height greater than 6 m, a longitudinally continuous permanent 
access should be provided along the outboard at least 1.2 m below the top of the net opening of the 
annular web 
2.6  舱内肋骨（Hold Frame）的检查：对于单舷侧散货船，在所有货舱内均应设置垂向永久通道，
能够对左右舷均匀分布在整个货舱中至少25% 以上的舱内肋骨进行检查。在任何情况下，

每舷不得少于 3 个垂向永久通道，即货舱前部、后部和中部。 
Inspection access of Hold Frame: For single-side bulk carriers, vertical permanent access should be 
provided in all holds, which can inspect at least 25% of the ribs evenly distributed on the port side 
and port side throughout the hold. In no case shall there be less than 3 vertical permanent access per 
port, i.e. the forward, aft and middle parts of the cargo hold. 
2.7  双舷侧散货船的检查：对于双舷侧结构而言，不要求利用垂直梯对货舱表面进行检查。这种
结构的检查应在双壳处所内进行 
Inspection access of double-sided-side bulk carriers: For double-sideboard structures, it is not 
required to use vertical ladders to inspect the surface of the cargo hold. Inspection of such 
structures should be carried out in the bivalve premises 
 
3.0 结构通道清单 
List of ship structure inspection means of access 
依据船舶结构检验通道手册，编写本船的船舶结构检验通道清单。参见《SHIP-08-14 -1-船舶结构检
验通道清单》 
According to the Ship Structure Access Manual, compile the List of ship structure inspection means of 
access. Reference 《SHIP-08-14 -1- Inventory of ship structure inspection means of access》 
 
4.0 职责 
Responsibility 
4.1 船长负责监控船上人员执行本规定；  
Master is in charge of monitoring the ship’s crew to implement regulation; 
4.2 大副负责组织实施。大副应组织船员对检查通道有计划进行定期检查维护保养，防
止锈蚀损坏。 
Chief Officer is in charge of organizing deck personnel to implement the regulation. The chief 
officer shall organize the crew to carry out regular inspection and maintenance of the Ship’s Means 
of Access to prevent corrosion and damage 
 
5.0 检查与维护保养要求 
Inspection and maintenance requirements 
 
5.1 结构检查通道和器材应保持良好的工作状态，如发现实质损坏应及时处理，受影响部分在修复
之前不得继续使用。实质损坏和恶化情况应记录在《SHIP-08-14 -2-船舶通道检查和保养记录表》
中。 
The structure inspection means of access and equipment shall be maintained in good condition, and 
any Substantial Damage found should be dealt with in time, and the affected part shall not be used 
further until repaired. Substantial Damage and deterioration are to be recorded in the SHIP-08-14 -2 - 
Records of Inspections and Maintenance of Means of Access 
5.2 验证检验通道包括便携式设备及其附件是定期检验的一部分，目的是在受检验对象的空间内保
持检验通道的有效性。在为检验空间通风、清洁和照明后，船员和/或授权人员应对检验通道
进行检查 
Verification of means of access including portable equipment and their attachment is part of 
periodical surveys for continued effectiveness of the means of access in that space which is subject to 
the survey. After a space has been ventilated, cleaned and illuminated for the survey, an inspection of 
means of access should be carried out by the crew and/or an authorized person.

5.3 作为定期检查和维护的一部分，船员和/或授权人员应定期检查通道，间隔时间应考虑到空间内
可能存在的任何腐蚀性气氛来确定，但至少每年一次 
Periodical inspections of means of access should be carried out by the crew and/or an authorized 
person as a part of regular inspection and maintenance, at intervals, which are determined taking into 
account any corrosive atmosphere that may be within the space, but at a minimum annually. 
5.4  任何使用检验通道的授权人员都应承担检查员的角色，并在使用通道设施之前检查是否有明
显损坏。在使用检验通道时，检查员应通过仔细检查这些部分来验证所用部分的状况，并注
意这些部分的任何恶化。如果发现任何损坏或恶化，则应评估此类恶化的影响，以确定损坏
或恶化是否影响继续使用通道的安全。如发现被认为影响使用安全的缺陷，应定为“实质损
坏”，并应采取措施确保在完成有效维修前，不会再使用受影响的部分。 
Any authorized person using the means of access should assume the role of inspector and check for 
obvious damage prior to using the access arrangements. Whilst using the means of access the 
inspector should verify the condition of the sections used by close up examination of those sections 
and note any deterioration in the provisions. Should any damage or deterioration be found, the 
effect of such deterioration should be assessed as to whether the damage or deterioration affects the 
safety for continued use of the access. 
Deterioration found that is considered to affect safe use should be determined as "substantial 
damage" and measures should be put in place to ensure that the affected section(s) are not to be 
further used prior to completing effective repair 
5.5  对任何包含检验通道的空间进行定期检验时，应包括验证该空间内检验通道的保持有效性。
通常，对检验通道的检验预计不会超出正在进行的检验的范围和程度。如果发现检验通道存
在不足，则应在认为适当的情况下扩大检验范围 
Periodical surveys of any space that contains means of access should include verification of the 
continued effectiveness of the means of access in that space. Usually, survey of the means of access 
is not expected to exceed the scope and extent of the survey being undertaken. If the means of 
access is found deficient the scope of survey should be extended if this is considered appropriate 
5.6  所有检查的记录应根据SMS 中详述的要求创建。使用检验通道的人应随时取用有关纪录，并
应附于检验通道手册的副本。检验通道设施部分的最新检查记录应至少包括检查日期、检查
员的姓名和职务、确认签名、检验通道设施部分的检查、对持续可用状态的验证或任何变坏
或重大损坏的详细信息。应保留已签署的文件以供验证 
Records of all inspections should be established based on the requirements detailed in the ships 
Safety Management System. The records should be readily available to persons using the means of 
access and a copy attached to the access manual. The latest record for the portion of the means of 
access inspected should include as a minimum the date of the inspection, the name and title of the 
inspector, a confirmation signature, the sections of means of access inspected, verification of 
continued serviceable condition or details of any deterioration or substantial damage found. A file 
of permits issued should be maintained for verification 
5.7  如果可移动检验通道由岸基供应商提供，则应根据设备供应商记录的维护和检查制度来确定
其安全和充分的使用。在判断设备供应商的检查周期性和维护的彻底性时，应认识到设备的
复杂性 
Where movable means of access are supplied by a shore-based provider, the conformation of its 
safe and adequate use should be made based on recorded maintenance and inspection regime by the 
provider of the equipment. Cognizance should be taken of the complexity of the equipment when 
making the judgment on the periodicity of the inspections and thoroughness of maintenance by the 
provider of equipment

第15 节 船舶起重设备和可拆卸零部件的保养维护规定 
Section 15 Maintenance Regulations on the Lifting Appliances and Loose Gear 
1. 
目的 
Purpose 
为规范船舶起重设备及其可拆卸零部件的检查、维护、试验和操作，确保其始终处于安全工作
状态，防止事故发生，并满足SOLAS 公约、船旗国及船级社的相关要求 。  
In order to regulate the inspection, maintenance, testing and operation of ship Lifting Appliances and 
Loose Gear, to ensure that they are always in safe working conditions, to prevent accidents, and to 
meet the relevant requirements of SOLAS Convention, flag states and classification societies  
2. 
适用范围 
Scope 
本规定适用于公司旗下所有船舶的起重设备和可拆卸零部件，包括但不限于：吊车、吊杆、货
物绞车、吊艇架、伙食吊，以及与之配套的吊钩、滑车、卸扣、链条、吊环、转环、吊梁、钢
丝等。 
This regulation applies to the Lifting Appliances and Loose Gear of all ships under the company fleet, 
including but not limited to: cranes, booms, cargo winches, davits, food cranes, as well as hooks, 
pulleys, shackles, chains, rings, swivels, beams, wire rope etc. 
3. 
定义 
Definitions 
3.1 
船舶起重设备：系指任何装卸的船舶设备：  
means any load-handling ship's equipment 
1) 
用于货物装载、转运或卸货；used for cargo loading, transfer, or discharge 
2) 
用于升高和降低舱口盖或活动舱壁；used for raising and lowering hold hatch covers or 
moveable bulkheads 
3) 
用作机舱吊机；used as engine-room cranes 
4) 
用作储物吊机；used as stores cranes 
5) 
用作软管起升吊机；used as hose handling cranes 
6) 
用于释放和回收补给船和类似应用；和used for launch and recovery of tender boats and 
similar applications; and 
7) 
用作人员起升吊机。used as personnel handling cranes 
3.2 
可拆卸零部件： 指船舶装备中可用于将货物连接至起重装置或锚机卷扬机，但本身不构成该装
置或货物组成部分的部件。 
Loose gear means an article of ships equipment by means of which a load can be attached to a lifting 
appliance or an anchor handling winch but which does not form an integral part of the appliance or 
load 
3.3 
负责人员: 由船长或公司任命，具备履行本规定职责所需知识和经验的人员。 
Responsible person means a person appointed by the Master or Company who has the necessary 
knowledge and experience to perform the duties specified in this regulation， 
3.4 
适任人员: 经主管机关接受，具备履行全面检查和负荷试验职责所需知识和经验的人员（通常为
船级社验船师或经认证的第三方）。通常指主管机关认可的船级社验船师、制造厂代表或其授权
的具备资质的第三方服务机构人员。 
Competent person means a person accepted by the competent authority with the necessary 
knowledge and experience to perform comprehensive inspection and load testing duties (usually 
classification society surveyors or certified third parties)。It usually refers to the classification society 
surveyor recognized by the competent authority, the representative of the manufacturing plant or the

qualified third-party service agency personnel authorized by it 
3.5 
全面检查: 由适任人员进行的详细评估，以确定起重设备或可拆卸零部件是否符合主管机关的
适用要求。 
Thorough examination means a detailed assessment carried out by a competent person in order to 
determine whether or not the lifting appliance or loose gear is in compliance with the applicable 
requirements of the Administration. 
3.6 
负荷试验: 系指在适任人员在场的情况下进行的超过SWL 的试验，目的是检查起重设备的结构
完整性及其与支撑结构的连接性和充分性。 
Load test means a test in excess of the SWL, carried out in the presence of a competent person in 
order to check the structural integrity of the lifting appliance and its attachment to and adequacy of its 
supporting structure。 
3.7 
操作测试：系指由负责人员进行的测试，以验证部件的正常运转或起重设备和/或相关可拆卸零
部件的操作 
Operational testing means a test carried out by a responsible person to verify the correct functioning of 
a component or operation of the lifting appliance and/or associated loose gear 
3.8 
安全工作负荷（SWL）：系指在指定半径内，起重设备或可拆卸零部件经认证可在指定作业条件
下起重的最大静负荷 
Safe working load (SWL) is the maximum static load at a specified radius which a lifting appliance or 
item of loose gear is certified to lift for a specified operating condition 
4. 
职责  
Responsibility 
船长: 对起重设备的安全操作负总责，授权操作人员，监督本规定的执行； 
Captain: Responsible for the safe operation of lifting appliances, authorizing operators, and 
supervising the implementation of these regulations 
大副：是船舶起重设备和可拆卸零部件的总负责人，组织、实施并监督所有检查、维护和记录
工作；负责“船舶起重设备和可拆卸零部件检查维护记录簿”的记录和保管；参照SHIP-08-01
船舶检修责任分工明细表，分配相应工作。确保部门下属人员经过培训，并正确执行日常检查、
维护和操作 
Chief officer: is the general person in charge of the ship's lifting appliances and loose gear, organizing, 
implementing and supervising all inspection, maintenance and recording work; Responsible for the 
recording and storage of the " Inspection and Maintenance Record Book of ship’s Lifting Appliances 
and Loose Gear "; Refer to SHIP-08-01 Ship Maintenance Responsibilities Division of Labor 
Schedule to assign corresponding tasks. Ensure that department subordinates are trained and perform 
routine inspections, maintenance, and operations correctly 
主管轮机员：负责各个起重设施机械部分的检查、维护保养工作和填写记录簿； 
In charge of Engineer: Responsible for the inspection and maintenance of the mechanical parts of each 
lifting facility and write in Record Book. 
电机员：负责电器部分的检查、维护保养和填写记录簿；  
Electrician: responsible for the inspection and maintenance of electrical parts and write in Record 
Book 
操作人员: 负责使用前检查，并严格按照安全操作规程进行作业； 
Operator: Responsible for pre-use inspection and strict operation in accordance with safety operating 
procedures 
5. 
检查和维护管理  
Inspection and Maintenance Management  
依据船舶起重设备和可拆卸零部件的维护与操作手册，进行日常定期检查，维护保养。

起重设备的检查和维护可能涉及在高空、进入封闭处所和其他危险中作业。请参考
SHIP-02-09/05. 
Inspection and maintenance of lifting appliance may involve working aloft, in enclosed space, and in 
other hazards， please reference SHIP-02-09/05

SHIP-02-05 进入封闭处所的安全规定 Safety Rules for Enclosed Space Entry 
需要特别注意如下项目： 
1) 
结构部分: 检查吊臂、基座、焊缝、支架等有无腐蚀、裂纹、变形。 
Structural components: Inspect the boom, base, welds, brackets, etc., for corrosion, cracks, or 
deformation. 
2) 
机械部分: 检查刹车、离合器、减速箱、液压系统（软管、缸体、阀门）、轴承、钢丝绳卷
筒等。 
Mechanical Components: Inspect brakes, clutch, gearbox, hydraulic system (hoses, cylinders, 
valves), bearings, wire rope drums, etc. 
3) 
安全装置: 测试限位开关、超负荷保护、应急停止按钮、声光报警等。 
Safety Devices: Test limit switches, overload protection, emergency stop buttons, audible and 
visual alarms, etc. 
4) 
钢丝绳: 按GB/T5972—2023/ISO 4309:2017 标准检查断丝、磨损、腐蚀、变形，并定期润
滑。 
Wire Rope: Inspect for broken wires, wear, corrosion, and deformation in accordance with 
GB/T5972—2023/ISO 4309:2017 standards and lubricate regularly. 
5) 
可拆卸零部件: 检查磨损、裂纹、变形，确保标识（SWL、编号）清晰 
Loose Gears: Inspect for wear, cracks, and deformation; ensure markings (SWL, serial number) 
are clearly legible. 
6) 
起重设备的整体状况和正确运转，特别是液压或气动装置，液压/气动气缸，马达，软管，
管道，绞车，制动器和卷筒； 
Overall condition and proper operation of lifting appliances, particularly hydraulic or pneumatic 
systems, hydraulic/pneumatic cylinders, motors, hoses, piping, winches, brakes, and drums. 
7) 
起重设备的所有安全通道的腐蚀和损坏，包括连接的维护平台和延伸部分，特别要注意支
撑支架和焊缝； 
Corrosion and damage to all safety passages of lifting appliance, including connected 
maintenance platforms and extensions, with particular attention to support brackets and welds. 
8) 
损坏、断裂、磨损或腐蚀的钢丝绳，包括其端部，应按照制造商的建议、相关行业标准、
国际标准（如 GB/T5972—2023/ISO 4309:2017 起重机--绳索--维护和保养、检查和报废）
或主管机关接受的船级社的要求进行检查和报废。 
Damaged, broken, worn, or corroded wire ropes, including their ends, shall be inspected and 
discard in accordance with the manufacturer's recommendations, relevant industry standards,

standards 
(such

Cranes—Ropes—Maintenance and care, inspection and discard), or the requirements of

Daily inspection 
工作人员应在每次作业前进行日常检查，不得遗漏。对即将使用起重设备和可拆卸零部件进行

Personnel shall conduct daily inspections before each operation without omission. Visually inspect 
lifting appliances and loose gears prior to use to ensure no visible defects, deformation, or damage 
exists. Inspect electrical equipment, brakes, hooks, and wire ropes for lubrication, overheating, 
abnormal noise, tightness/looseness, and contact areas. If abnormalities are detected, repair or replace 
components. Immediately cease operations and inspect suspect parts if any abnormalities are 
discovered during operation. Record inspection results promptly in the Ship Lifting Appliances and 
Loose Gears Inspection and Maintenance Record Book. 
5.2 
定期检查 
Regular inspections 
定期检查：负责人员按计划依据维护与操作手册进行更详细的定期检查，检查应涵盖结构、机
械、电气、安全装置及可拆卸零部件。具体检查项目、方法、标准和周期应参照本规定附件《船
舶起重设备和可拆卸零部件定期检查建议》及制造商手册执行；定期检查间隔也应该考虑使用
频率和工作量；至少需要进行年度大检和月检。 
Regular Inspections: Responsible personnel shall conduct more detailed periodic inspections according 
to the maintenance and operation manual and established schedule. Inspections shall cover structural, 
mechanical, electrical, safety devices, and loose gears. Specific inspection items, methods, standards, 
and intervals shall be carried out in accordance with the Appendix to these Regulations, " 
Recommendations for Periodic Inspection of Shipboard Lifting Appliances and Loose Gears," and the 
manufacturer's manual. Inspection intervals shall also consider usage frequency and workload. Annual 
major inspections and monthly inspections shall be conducted at minimum. 
Regardless of the existence of defects or abnormality, overhaul inspection of major parts is performed 
at regular intervals, where, such defects can be found that are not detected in daily inspection, The 
interval of regular inspections should be determined depending on the frequency of use and work 
amount. Annual major inspection and monthly inspection are required at least 
5.3 
全面检查 
Thorough examination 
全面检查：适任人员每年一次，以及在负荷试验后、重大修理后，对设备进行详细检查，以确
定其是否处于良好状态并符合安全标准。签发证书。 
Thorough examination means Competent personnel shall conduct a detailed inspection of the 
equipment annually, as well as following load tests and major repairs, to ascertain that it remains in 
good working order and complies with safety standards. Certificates shall be issued. 
5.4

Load test

按MSC.1/Circ.1663 表1 确定，使主管机关满意，签发证书。

determined in accordance with Table 1 of MSC.1/Circ.1663 based on the SWL, to the satisfaction of 
the competent authority, which shall issue a certificate.

Proof tests 
适任人员在投入使用前或重大修理/改装后进行，至少每5 年一次。试验负荷根据SWL 和可拆

6. 
记录管理 
Records Management 
6.1 
船上应永久保存《船舶起重设备和可拆卸零部件登记册》，其中应记录所有经认证的起重设备与
可拆卸零部件，并附上有效的《试验与全面检查证书》。 
A “Ship's Register of Lifting Appliances and Loose Gears” shall be permanently maintained on board, 
recording all certified lifting appliances and loose gears, accompanied by valid “Certificate of test and 
thorough examination” . 
6.2 
所有日常检查、定期检查、维护保养、操作测试及缺陷处理，均应在《船舶起重设备和可拆卸
零部件检查维护记录簿》中予以记录。 
All daily inspections, regular inspections, maintenance, operational tests and rectification of defects 
shall be recorded in the “Ship’s Lifting Appliances and Loose Gears Inspection and Maintenance 
Record Book”. 
6.3 
船舶起重设备及可拆卸零部件的维护与操作手册保存在船，确保随时查阅。 
Maintenance and operating manuals for shipboard lifting appliances and loose gears shall be kept on 
board to ensure they are readily available for reference. 
 
7. 
 操作人员资质与培训 
Operator Qualifications and Training 
所有操作起重设备和使用可拆卸零部件的人员必须合格、熟悉设备，并经由船长授权。 
All personnel operating lifting appliances and loose gears must be qualified, familiar with the

所有参与起重作业的人员都应了解他们在作业中的角色，特别是开始、协调或停止作业时可能
需要的信号;  
All personnel involved in a lifting operation should understand their role during the operation and, in 
particular, the signals that may be required to commence, coordinate or stop the operation. 
公司应确保提供必要的培训。 
The company shall ensure that necessary training is provided. 
 
8. 
失效与不合格品处理 
Inoperative lifting appliances and loose gear 
当起重设备或可拆卸零部件被发现存在安全隐患或失效时： 
When lifting appliances or loose gears are found to present safety hazards or inoperative, 
应立即停用：清楚标记“禁止使用”，并采取物理隔离。 
Immediately stop using: Clearly mark as "Prohibited for Use" and implement physical isolation. 
报告：立即向船长和公司报告。 
Report: Immediately report to the captain and the company. 
记录：在记录簿和设备册中记录失效详情。 
Record inoperative details in the record book and equipment register. 
评估与修复：由适任人员或根据其指导进行评估和修复。 
Assessment and repair: carried out by competent personnel or under their supervision. 
恢复使用：修复后，必须通过相应的试验和全面检查，经适任人员或负责人员确认后方可重新
投入使用。 
Return to service: Following repairs, the equipment must undergo appropriate testing and a thorough 
examination and be confirmed as fit for service by competent personnel or the individual responsible 
before being returned to operational use.
